abstract_en: The invention provides a power supply data processing method and device based on big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring reference power supply data of a plurality of regions; classifying the reference power supply data according to regional characteristics to generate a plurality of characteristic power supply data sets, wherein the regional characteristics comprise regional environment parameters, regional development parameters, regional area parameters, industry structure parameters and population flow parameters; acquiring regional characteristics corresponding to a target region; based on the predicted power supply model, power supply reference data of the target region is predicted according to a characteristic power supply data set corresponding to the region characteristic of the target region. Compared with the scheme of manually generating the SVG topological graph by the traditional Web terminal, the method ensures the prediction accuracy on the premise of ensuring the simple and convenient prediction method.

title_en: Crown block task scheduling method and crown block task scheduling device based on MES (manufacturing execution system) cooperation
abstract_en: The application provides an overhead travelling crane task scheduling method and device based on MES system cooperation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a preset production plan from an MES system, determining associated overhead travelling cranes based on the production plan and generating initial carrying task instruction sequences corresponding to the associated overhead travelling cranes, carrying out work scheduling on the associated overhead travelling cranes based on the initial carrying task instruction sequences corresponding to the associated overhead travelling cranes, obtaining abnormal state information of a semiconductor processing production line from the MES system, sending an emergency scheduling instruction to a target overhead travelling crane based on the abnormal state information of the semiconductor processing production line and the current running state of the associated overhead travelling cranes so as to control the target overhead travelling crane to adjust operation parameters, timely obtaining the abnormal state information of the semiconductor processing production line from the MES system, carrying out emergency scheduling on the overhead travelling cranes, and further reducing the influence of the abnormal state of the semiconductor processing production line on material carrying efficiency to the maximum extent.

title_en: Sterilizing equipment operation fault detection system based on entry port parcel express mail
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of operation safety of disinfection equipment, in particular to a disinfection equipment operation fault detection system based on an entry port parcel express, which comprises a disinfection effect acquisition module, a data comparison module, a disinfection system inspection module, a conveying system inspection module, an operation check module and an early warning module, wherein the invention integrates and analyzes effect risk factors through the data comparison module to judge whether the parcel express disinfection equipment has faults, and the obtained step-by-step verification signals are sent to a disinfection system verification module, a conveying system verification module and an operation checking module to check places with faults in two systems in the disinfection equipment step by step, so that the comprehensiveness of fault checking is ensured, fault parts can be accurately found, the maintenance efficiency is improved, the fault influence in the disinfection equipment is reduced, the operation safety of the disinfection equipment is ensured, and the stability of disinfecting parcel express items is improved.

title_en: Intelligent agricultural supply chain supervision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent agricultural supply chain supervision method which comprises the steps of data acquisition, data preprocessing, establishment of an agricultural supply chain supervision model, model parameter optimization and agricultural supply chain supervision. The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an intelligent agricultural supply chain supervision method, which introduces a convex combination definition Lu Bangshang based on two Laplacian functions to further define a robust loss function; the loss function based on mixed entropy guidance is converted into a convex optimization problem, a parameter updating mechanism is formulated, the constraint optimization problem is processed, and the reliability of model optimization is improved; initializing and optimizing the individual position by using a lens imaging reverse learning method and an optimized round chaotic map; dynamically adjusting the searching capability and controlling the searching range by designing a self-adaptive nonlinear decreasing weight factor; and the parameters of the supervision model of the agricultural supply chain are efficiently and accurately optimized, and the supervision capability and the prediction precision of the supply chain are improved.

title_en: Recommendation method and device for soil pollution risk enterprise investigation and classification supervision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recommendation method and a device for soil pollution risk enterprise investigation and classification supervision, which relate to the technical field of enterprise soil pollution risk management and supervision, and are used for screening and integrating important industry enterprise lists needing to be concerned as investigation base numbers according to specific rules from a full-caliber enterprise list; the method is characterized by converging multi-source data such as enterprise production characteristics, environment distribution characteristics and the like, integrating high-efficiency data processing technologies such as knowledge graphs, large language models and space analysis and the like, accurately focusing enterprises which are easy to form soil pollution from a full-caliber enterprise list, further focusing on the influence of pollution diffusion on the surrounding environment, distinguishing enterprise risk types by combining with geographical environment conditions and the like of the pollution diffusion, automatically calculating and recommending to form a classified supervision list, supporting related managers to complement and perfect the supervision list, and promoting subsequent risk management, control and repair activities.

title_en: Knowledge map-based flood prevention rescue knowledge processing method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a flood prevention emergency knowledge processing method and device based on a knowledge graph. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring experience knowledge texts related to the field; extracting a term topic from the experience knowledge text, and constructing a domain ontology model based on the term topic, wherein the domain ontology model comprises domain key concepts and concept relations; constructing a multi-group knowledge chain according to entity knowledge extracted from experience knowledge text; and determining a knowledge graph through relation connection of nodes of the multi-group knowledge chain so as to search based on the knowledge graph. According to the method, the high-quality domain knowledge and knowledge association is extracted by adopting a text data mining method to construct the flood control emergency domain knowledge map, and then the knowledge management and semantic association capability of the knowledge map is utilized to efficiently organize and visualize the domain knowledge, so that flood control emergency personnel can conveniently acquire, display or update the knowledge map, and the like, and the accuracy and the efficiency of flood control emergency treatment are improved.

title_en: Method and device for generating part commonality list, electronic equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application provides a part commonality list generation method, a device, electronic equipment, media and products, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a vehicle type project input by a user; the vehicle type project corresponds to at least one first basic vehicle type; according to the vehicle type project, determining an initial vehicle type project and a development mode corresponding to each first part; wherein the first part is a part used in at least one first basic vehicle model; the initial vehicle type item corresponding to the first part is used for indicating the vehicle type item of the first part to be used first; the development mode corresponding to the first part is used for indicating the development mode of the first part on an initial vehicle type project; determining a commonality attribute value corresponding to the first part according to the vehicle type project, the initial vehicle type project corresponding to the first part and the development mode aiming at any first part; and generating a part commonality list corresponding to the vehicle type project according to the commonality attribute values corresponding to the first parts, so that the cooperative efficiency and the updating efficiency after part change can be improved.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method, device and equipment for electric quantity unbalance of new energy power system
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device and equipment for quantitatively evaluating electric quantity unbalance of a new energy power system, which are used for constructing a joint probability prediction model aiming at different prediction time scales of a future period to be evaluated by considering random fluctuation of output and load demand of an uncertainty power supply and mutual influence of the output and the load demand, generating probability distribution of an uncertainty electric quantity net difference in the period to be evaluated by utilizing working state information of the uncertainty power supply and the load in the time dimension provided by the joint probability prediction model and an operation scheduling plan, and accurately predicting electric quantity unbalance distribution condition of the whole power system by considering the net difference of the uncertainty electric quantity and the load, thereby providing accurate data support for scheduling and operation of the power system.

title_en: Steel production data real-time processing method based on Kafka
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of iron and steel iron production, and discloses a Kafka-based real-time processing method for iron and steel production data, which realizes the release and subscription mode, topic partition, stream calculation, message storage and the like of iron and steel industry data by means of advanced real-time data processing technology, namely Kafka real-time processing, and the method combines the data preprocessing and the improved clustering analysis method to realize the real-time processing and intelligent grading of steel data, thereby being beneficial to improving the real-time dynamic adjustment capability of a production plan and enabling the steel system to have toughness and strain capability.

title_en: Method and system for predicting tomato quality
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tomato quality prediction, in particular to a method and a system for predicting tomato quality, comprising the following steps: s1, data acquisition and pretreatment: collecting soil data by using a sensor, and measuring quality parameters of tomatoes in the maturity stage of the tomatoes; s2, extracting features: extracting relevant characteristics from the preprocessed soil data and the quality parameters; s3, analyzing the quality of the soil microorganism metabolic products: analyzing the influence of the microbial metabolites of the soil on the quality of tomatoes; s4, tomato quality prediction: predicting tomato quality through a tomato quality prediction model; s5, result analysis: analyzing the predicted tomato quality result, identifying soil factors affecting the tomato quality, and feeding back the analysis result to the grower to provide management advice. The invention can obviously improve soil environment, promote growth conditions of tomatoes and finally improve quality and yield of tomatoes.

title_en: Medium-long-term random production simulation method, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medium-long term random production simulation method, a system, a medium and equipment, which are used for acquiring basic technical data of an electric power system containing renewable energy sources and forecast distribution data of the renewable energy sources, constructing a Markov decision process based on the basic technical data of the electric power system and the forecast distribution data with the aim of realizing safe power supply of the system, consumption of the renewable energy sources and reduction of the total cost of the system under the condition of considering complex constraint, and carrying out iterative training on the Markov decision process by adopting an approximate dynamic programming method, and searching to obtain an optimal group of decisions as a medium-long term operation mode. According to the invention, the optimal operation mode is obtained through the distributed search of random factors, the interference of subjective factors is avoided, the total cost of the system is reduced under the condition of ensuring the power supply safety of an extreme scene and the consumption of renewable energy sources, the medium-long operation mode and the evaluation result which have better performance than the traditional scheme are finally obtained, and the reference is provided for the safe operation of the power system.

title_en: Environment-friendly monitoring management system for sponge industrial production
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly monitoring management system for sponge industrial production, which relates to the technical field of environment-friendly monitoring management, and discloses a production line environment-friendly monitoring module, an environment-friendly finishing analysis module and an environment-friendly finishing notification module, wherein the production line environment-friendly monitoring module is arranged to monitor the environment of a sponge production line according to each production step, and a reasonable production step monitoring sequence is formulated according to production lines of different sponge types, so that the method not only meets the environment-friendly monitoring requirement of sponge industrial production, but also ensures that the key steps of the sponge production lines are preferentially monitored in an environment-friendly manner, and all the steps of a plurality of production lines are not required to be monitored in an environment-friendly manner at the same time, and the environment-friendly monitoring pressure of the system is reduced.

title_en: Hierarchical dynamic assessment method for reactive comprehensive support capacity of power distribution network considering new energy access
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network reactive comprehensive support capacity grading dynamic evaluation method considering new energy access, which comprises the following steps: characteristic indexes and evaluation indexes which influence the reactive comprehensive support capacity of the power distribution network are subjected to correlation analysis, and key indexes which influence the reactive comprehensive support capacity of the power distribution network are screened out from the characteristic indexes; constructing a reactive comprehensive support capacity evaluation model of the power distribution network according to the key indexes, and adjusting the key index weight in the reactive comprehensive support capacity evaluation model of the power distribution network by utilizing a dynamic entropy weight method and assigning points; and collecting key index historical data of new energy access to the power distribution network, calculating scores under each data section by using a constructed power distribution network reactive comprehensive support capacity evaluation model, and clustering by adopting a semi-supervised clustering method to obtain a power distribution network reactive comprehensive support capacity grading evaluation result. The invention realizes the dynamic grading of the reactive comprehensive support capacity of the power distribution network, and more scientifically and intuitively reflects the comprehensive reactive level of the system.

title_en: Low-lift pump station scheduling method considering boundary dynamic state and operation stability
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-lift pump station scheduling method considering boundary dynamics and operation stability, which comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of groups of first pump station parameters and at least one group of initial water level parameters, inputting the number parameters of pump station units, the angle parameters of pump station blades and the initial water level parameters corresponding to the groups of first pump station parameters into a pre-trained dynamic boundary prediction model aiming at each group of first pump station parameters, obtaining a predicted dynamic boundary, obtaining optimal parameters to be selected based on the predicted dynamic boundary, the number parameters of pump station units, the angle parameters of pump station blades, the second pump station parameters, time interval information, scheduling target influencing factors and water lifting amount constraint parameters, and completing a scheduling scheme of a scheduling target pump station based on the number parameters of target units and the angle parameters of target blades by taking the optimal parameters to be selected meeting preset optimal conditions as target optimal parameters. Therefore, the operation efficiency of the pump station can be improved, the maintenance cost is reduced, and the operation stability of the pump station unit is improved.

title_en: Power distribution network-micro power grid collaborative optimization scheduling method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a power distribution network-micro grid collaborative optimization scheduling method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of controlling active power output by a micro grid by using a flexible direct current interconnection line, and establishing a power distribution network-micro grid based on the flexible direct current interconnection line; establishing a collaborative optimization scheduling model based on a micro-grid and a power distribution network to be collaborative optimization scheduled; based on an ideal point method and an overall coordination degree satisfaction evaluation function, carrying out optimal solution solving on the collaborative optimization scheduling model to obtain an optimal collaborative optimization scheduling result; and carrying out collaborative optimization scheduling operation on the flexible direct current interconnected power distribution network-micro power grid according to the optimal collaborative optimization scheduling result. The invention can improve the power supply reliability and the dispatching operation economy of the power distribution network, is beneficial to the increase of renewable energy acceptance of the micro-grid, improves the energy utilization rate and promotes the realization of source-load power balance. The optimal configuration of each energy source and the multi-objective dynamic balance are realized on the whole.

title_en: Novel flexible load regulation and control method and system for power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel flexible load regulation and control method and system for an electric power system, which belong to the field of electric power control, and the novel flexible load regulation and control method for the electric power system comprises the following steps: the method adopts a flexible load classifying, converging and layering control method, namely, control levels are divided according to geographic distribution, and production type, transfer type and consumption type loads are classified, converged according to flexible load characteristics by the same control level. And each level gathers the state data of the level according to an uplink data model, then sends the gathered state data to the upper level of gathering layer, and receives the control target of the upper level of gathering layer. Each convergence layer is converged through overall, different flexible load regulation and control methods are adopted for different types of loads according to the control level power grid, so that the problems of low single-point capacity and low control efficiency of control objects with scattered positions are solved, and the reliability of a novel power system is improved.

title_en: Equipment tracking performance analysis and evaluation method and device for command system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for analyzing and evaluating the tracking performance of equipment of a command control system, which fully utilize a large amount of test data collected in a command control center, automatically analyze the tracking performance of the measurement and control equipment of the command control system and output an analysis result, thereby providing scientific basis and auxiliary means for intelligentization of command decisions.

title_en: Optimization method for power grid operation safety and electric vehicle charge-discharge interconnection
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optimization method for power grid operation safety and electric vehicle charge-discharge interconnection, which comprises the following steps: step 1, determining upper and lower layer evaluation indexes of an ordered charge-discharge double-layer optimization scheduling model of an electric automobile; step 2, collecting and constructing related data of an ordered charge-discharge double-layer optimal scheduling model of the electric automobile; step 3, establishing an ordered charge-discharge double-layer optimal scheduling model of the electric automobile; the upper model takes the optimal running safety of the power grid as a target, and takes battery capacity, battery expectation at the end of charging and the like as constraint conditions to establish an optimization model; the lower layer optimization model takes the minimum daily load peak-valley difference of the power grid as a target, and takes the optimal power grid operation safety of the upper layer optimization calculation as a constraint condition to establish an optimization model; and 4, solving an upper model by using an improved algorithm to obtain the optimization method of the power grid operation safety and the charging and discharging interconnection of the electric automobile. The invention can realize the orderly charge and discharge control of the electric automobile.

title_en: Verification method for authentication application information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of information authentication, in particular to an authentication application information auditing method. Comprising the following steps: determining a first processing rule for processing the information to be classified in response to the information type to be classified and the first information to be authenticated submitted by the provider; processing the first information to be authenticated by using a first processing rule to obtain second information to be authenticated, wherein the second information to be authenticated comprises region information and time information associated with the first information; obtaining classified authentication information associated with the first information based on the region information and the time information associated with the first information, and determining the association degree of the first information and the classified authentication information; and in response to the association degree of the classified authentication information being greater than a preset value, verifying the first information to be authenticated through the application program interface, and determining the authenticity of the first information to be authenticated. Therefore, the problems of low manual auditing efficiency, error easiness and service acceptance time limitation of the certification authorities are solved.

title_en: Data processing method and device for text recitation and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a data processing method and device for text recitation and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of data processing. In the method, a text recitation request input by a user is responded; determining a standard text according to the text recitation request; acquiring recitation voice data of a user; determining a real-time recitation text according to the recitation voice data; acquiring recitation behavior data of a user, wherein the recitation behavior data comprise head action data and facial expression data of the user; generating a cheating detection result based on the head motion data and the facial expression data; and if the real-time recitation text is determined to be consistent with the standard text, and the cheating detection result is determined to indicate that the user does not cheat, determining that the user text recitation is qualified. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, whether the recitation of students is qualified or not can be conveniently and accurately evaluated.

title_en: River and lake evaluation scoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river and lake evaluation grading method and system, which relate to the technical field of water environment evaluation, wherein monitoring points are selected in a target area, then the target area is marked on an electronic map covering the target area, the fluctuation degree of each monitoring index is calculated by monitoring data, the target index is screened out from the monitoring index according to the fluctuation degree, if the maximum value of trend coefficients of the target index exceeds expectations, a water prediction instruction is sent out, the target area is divided into a plurality of area blocks by using a clustering algorithm, an evaluation grade is output for each area block by a water grading model, an evaluation value is built by the evaluation grade of each area block, and an evaluation report is formulated for the target area or a river and lake environment improvement scheme corresponding to the output of a lake and river water environment improvement knowledge map is formulated by the relationship between the evaluation value and an evaluation threshold. The multi-dimensional judgment of the water body environment state in the target area is realized, the grading stability is higher, the coverage is wider, and the obtained evaluation value is more prospective.

title_en: Intelligent government affair service method and system based on artificial intelligence technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent government service method and system based on an artificial intelligence technology, which belongs to the technical field of data management and specifically comprises the following steps: dividing the proposed texts into different similar proposed combinations by using text similarity coefficients, determining the number of the proposed texts in the different similar proposed combinations, determining the recommendation processing priority of the different similar proposed combinations by combining the text similarity coefficients among the different proposed texts and the submission time of the proposed texts, determining the recommendation processing sequence of the different proposed texts in the similar proposed combinations by using the text similarity coefficients between the proposed texts in the similar proposed combinations and other proposed texts and the text matching coefficients of the main management mechanism, and adopting a preset AI model to determine the recommendation processing sequence of the different proposed texts in the similar proposed combinations, thereby improving the processing efficiency of the proposed texts.

title_en: Integrated drilling and information collaborative emergency system and emergency platform
abstract_en: The application provides an integrated drilling and information collaborative emergency system and an emergency platform, wherein the system comprises: the emergency information unit is at least used for storing historical emergency treatment results corresponding to all network security events so as to uniformly manage emergency resources; the emergency drilling unit is at least used for providing drilling schemes for simulating various network security events and displaying drilling processes; the emergency command unit is at least used for managing all network security events, acquiring emergency resources in the emergency information unit to generate disposal schemes corresponding to various network security events for emergency command, and sending all the disposal schemes to the emergency information unit for storage; the emergency treatment unit is at least used for responding to various network security events, acquiring a treatment scheme corresponding to the current network security event from the emergency command unit and controlling the execution of the treatment scheme to carry out emergency treatment. The application solves the problem of low emergency processing efficiency of network security events in the prior art.

title_en: User satisfaction management and control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of communication, and provides a user satisfaction management and control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining a service interruption risk assessment value of the OLT equipment based on the user complaint information associated with the OLT equipment and at least one service interruption risk assessment parameter; determining a user complaint risk assessment value based on at least one complaint risk assessment parameter and its weight; determining a user dissatisfaction evaluation value based on the service interruption risk evaluation value and the user complaint risk evaluation value; and determining a user risk level of the user based on the user dissatisfaction evaluation value, and determining a management and control measure based on the user risk level. The application calculates the business interruption risk evaluation value, the user complaint risk evaluation value, the user dissatisfaction evaluation value and the user risk grade division, thereby realizing the whole-flow control of the satisfaction degree of the wide-home user with low cost, high efficiency and one-stop, and improving the positioning accuracy of the dissatisfaction user, thereby improving the user satisfaction degree.

title_en: Method, apparatus, device, medium and program product for sales call generation based on causal large model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program product for generating sales call based on a causal large model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring dialogue voice input by a current user; inputting the user information extracted from the dialogue voice into a large model, identifying the sales flow to which the next dialogue link belongs, and determining a solution to the user information through the large model, wherein the large model comprises a causal link for representing the causal relationship between the user information and the solution; and generating sales call according to the sales flow and the solution. According to the method and the device, the corresponding sales flow of the next link can be identified from the dialogue voice, so that accurate sales can be obtained based on the causal link in the model.

title_en: Association relationship determination method, apparatus, device, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program product for determining an association relation, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The association relation determining method comprises the following steps: acquiring target enterprise information and target building information; identifying the target enterprise information and the target building information by utilizing the target identification model to obtain an identification result; and determining whether the association relation exists between the target enterprise information and the target building information according to the identification result.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for grading stability of goaf of closed coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for grading stability of a goaf of a closed coal mine, which relate to the technical field of utilization of underground space of the closed coal mine, the invention obtains rock mechanical parameters of a study area by carrying out physical mechanical test on strata in the mining influence range of the study area, carries out numerical simulation on a stress field and a deformation field of surrounding rock of the study area by combining a three-dimensional geologic model, obtains the numerical simulation grade of the stability of the study area according to stress distribution and deformation characteristics, meanwhile, a plurality of evaluation indexes of the research area are optimized according to engineering geological conditions of the research area, a theoretical analysis grade of the stability of the research area is obtained by combining a vulnerability model, and the research area is comprehensively evaluated by combining a numerical simulation grade and the theoretical analysis grade, so that more unknown conditions and complex conditions in the research area can be accurately displayed, the stability of the research area is accurately graded, and the method is widely applied to the space utilization aspect of a goaf.

title_en: Multi-device system maintenance method and device, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-device system maintenance method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining maintenance intervals of a plurality of devices in the multi-device system; determining maintenance time of the multi-equipment system according to the maintenance interval; determining maintenance cost balances of a plurality of devices according to the maintenance time, wherein the maintenance cost balance of each device in the plurality of devices represents a change of maintenance cost caused by maintenance of each device at the maintenance time; a maintenance policy is determined based on maintenance cost balances of the plurality of devices, wherein the maintenance policy includes information indicative of at least one of the plurality of devices that is being maintained at a maintenance opportunity. According to the application, a better maintenance strategy can be provided so as to realize the maintenance of the multi-equipment system.

title_en: User management method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user management method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring credit card behavior data of a target user; predicting the expected use condition of the credit card of the target user according to the credit card behavior data, and obtaining a prediction result; and calculating the activation promoting attention score of the target user according to the prediction result based on a preset convolution attention network, and carrying out activation promoting treatment on the target user according to the activation promoting attention score. The invention realizes credit card user management based on convolution attention network and activation processing of credit card users, and improves the retention rate of credit card users.

title_en: Multi-time-scale low-carbon optimization method of comprehensive energy system considering carbon constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-time scale low-carbon optimization method of a comprehensive energy system considering carbon constraint, which comprises the following steps of: s1, establishing a multi-objective optimization model; s2, establishing a multi-time scale low-carbon scheduling model based on the multi-objective optimization model; s3, inputting data to a multi-time-scale low-carbon scheduling model; s4, data output: and solving a low-carbon optimization model of the comprehensive energy system by using a Gurobi solver based on Matlab software Yalmip tool box to obtain an optimal day-ahead optimization scheduling strategy, an intra-day-real-time optimization scheduling strategy, effective carbon reduction and economic benefits of each energy device. The invention considers the primary energy consumption, the wind abandoning punishment and the green certificate transaction in the IES, so that the consumption of renewable energy sources is improved.

title_en: Cloud-edge integrated intelligent water conservancy management system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a cloud-edge integrated intelligent water conservancy water management system and a cloud-edge integrated intelligent water conservancy management method, which belong to the field of management systems, the application introduces all water conservancy facility data in a water body flow area into a water conservancy facility risk assessment model for water conservancy facility risk assessment, introduces the water conservancy facility risk assessment result and the water conservancy facility risk assessment result into a water conservancy facility risk analysis model for water conservancy facility risk analysis, carries out water conservancy facility risk early warning according to the obtained water conservancy facility risk analysis result, according to the method, the water conservancy facilities are reinforced by the cloud platform, the water flow information and the dangerous conditions of floaters in the water flow are comprehensively analyzed, meanwhile, the basic conditions of the water conservancy facilities are comprehensively analyzed, the dangerous degree of the water conservancy facilities in the flood arrival process is accurately analyzed through the water flow dangerous condition analysis result and the water conservancy facility basic condition analysis result, and the dangerous degree analysis accuracy and the safety of the water conservancy facilities in the flood arrival process are improved.

title_en: Urban infrastructure event chain analysis method based on large model and logic atlas
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban infrastructure event chain analysis method based on a large model and logic atlases, belonging to the technical field of public safety. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out multi-dimensional identification and extraction of emergency accident carriers based on a large model; constructing an accident entity attribute library through accident carrier abstract entity aggregation and ontology feature deconstructment; excavating accident non-space-time disaster transfer paths based on logic patterns, and supervising large model training to obtain disaster transfer coping schemes; extracting accident multidimensional disaster transfer characteristics, and carrying out disaster transfer characteristic analysis and entity space-time association rule construction; optimizing logic the map based on the entity space-time correlation analysis; carrying out event chain sequencing through risk analysis; carrying out dynamic update of the event chain according to the feedback information; and outputting and visually displaying results. The invention can realize the automatic association, dynamic prediction, rapid deduction and scientific prevention and control of single/cross-system and single/multi-disaster accident evolution scenes of urban infrastructure through comprehensive consideration of accident carriers and disaster transfer.

title_en: Control method and system for low-voltage photovoltaic source terminal autonomy of transformer area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid safety, and the method comprises the steps of monitoring the power generation parameters of a low-voltage photovoltaic source end of a station area in real time, and constructing AIoT data analysis frames; analyzing historical data and environmental factors, and predicting short-term output power of the photovoltaic system; according to the prediction result, adjusting the angle of the photovoltaic panel to obtain the maximum output power; according to the maximum output power, performing automatic control on the energy of a low-voltage photovoltaic source end of the transformer area, and updating the angle of the photovoltaic panel to obtain the optimal output power; and (3) grid connection of the areas is performed, cooperative control is performed, and an energy exchange strategy is adjusted autonomously. The invention realizes the accurate control and the optimized operation of the photovoltaic system, improves the operation efficiency of the power grid, can realize the real-time monitoring and the adjustment of the photovoltaic system by the control method, improves the power generation efficiency of the photovoltaic system, and improves the automation degree of the system, thereby realizing the optimized operation of the power grid.

title_en: Multi-source industrial data fusion method based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a multisource industrial data fusion method based on edge calculation, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and is characterized in that equipment use record sets and material taking record sets of a plurality of equipment areas and material areas in a preset time period are acquired, a personnel distribution sequence in the preset time period is obtained based on the edge calculation, congestion degree information of the plurality of equipment use and congestion degree information of the plurality of material taking are analyzed, a plurality of equipment optimization step sizes and a plurality of material optimization step sizes are respectively set, the production positions of the plurality of equipment areas and the plurality of material areas are optimized, an optimal production position scheme is obtained, and the production positions of the plurality of equipment areas and the plurality of material areas are scheduled. The technical problem that the production efficiency is low due to the fact that the production position of a factory cannot be estimated and optimized accurately in real time in the prior art is solved. The technical effect of real-time and accurate evaluation and optimization of the factory production position is achieved, and therefore the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Homeland space ecological restoration scheme optimization method based on GIS and multi-objective decision analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for optimizing a national soil space ecological restoration scheme based on GIS and multi-objective decision analysis, which belongs to the field of ecological restoration and solves the problem of low ecological restoration efficiency, and concretely comprises the following steps of S1, determining vegetation change rate, water flow change rate and sand content change rate in an area to be optimized, combining the geographic space model and the ecological environment data, determining a plant restoration scheme, S3, dividing a protection range into organisms based on the geographic space model and the ecological environment data, determining an animal restoration scheme, and S4, summarizing the plant restoration scheme and the animal restoration scheme, and feeding back the animal restoration scheme to a user.

title_en: Cost calculation method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a cost calculation method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, which relate to the technical field of cost calculation and comprise the following steps: acquiring part information and part injection parameters of a part to be injection molded; wherein the part information includes at least one of part length, part width, part height, part average wall thickness, part material, and part net weight; obtaining the part process cost of the part to be injection molded by using the part length, the part width, the part height, the part average wall thickness, the part material and the part injection molding parameters; obtaining the part material cost of the part to be injection molded by using the part material and the part net weight; and obtaining the total part cost of the part to be injection molded based on the part process cost and the part material cost. The application can uniformly calculate the calculation standard of the total cost of the parts to be injection molded.

title_en: Data analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a data analysis method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data processing time of a plurality of components in the transaction process; constructing daily-divided order books according to the historical transaction records; determining an order success rate according to the arrival time of a first order in the order book and the data processing time of the plurality of components; and determining a data analysis result according to the order success rate, the data processing time and the change period of the order book, wherein the data analysis result is the dependency relationship between the transaction execution conditions and the data processing time in different periods. And the transaction quotation is comprehensively analyzed by acquiring the time required by order processing and the order success rate and taking the time required by order processing and the order success rate into consideration on the basis of the change period of the order book to obtain a result, so that the accuracy of the transaction quotation analysis is improved.

title_en: Substation business function node assessment method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substation business function node assessment method and system based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of substation automation, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting influence data of business function nodes and operation data of an electric power system, cleaning abnormal data and acquiring state assessment characteristics through decoupling dimension reduction; based on the cleaned data and the feature quantity after dimension reduction, constructing a service function node state of the service predicted by the service function node state evaluation model; and evaluating the service function state according to the prediction result of the service function node state, and retraining and updating the service function node state evaluation model. According to the method, based on the data after cleaning and dimension reduction, the service function node state evaluation model is constructed through the deep learning technology, so that the operation safety and stability of the transformer substation are improved; and the state evaluation model is adjusted and updated according to the evaluation result, so that the adaptability and long-term effectiveness of the model are improved, and the evaluation model is ensured to be always kept in an optimal state.

title_en: Natural gas pipe network gas supply reliability assessment method based on pipe network degradation model
abstract_en: The invention provides a natural gas pipe network gas supply reliability assessment method based on a pipe network degradation model, and belongs to the technical field of natural gas pipe network gas supply reliability assessment; the technical problems to be solved are to provide a natural gas pipe network gas supply reliability assessment method based on a pipe network degradation model, the technical scheme adopted for solving the technical problems is that a natural gas pipe network system is considered to be specifically influenced by compressor station degradation and pipeline random degradation factors, different influence rules of gas supply quantity of the natural gas pipe network system are respectively modeled according to the degradation conditions of the compressor station degradation process and the pipeline random degradation process, probabilities of the pipe network in various running states are analyzed and calculated, and the supply and demand relation of the pipe network in various states is assessed based on the obtained pipe network maximum gas supply quantity under the influence of the pipeline and the compressor station degradation, so that the reliability of the pipe network gas supply is assessed.

title_en: Nuclear power unit safety state supervision and evaluation method, system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a supervision and evaluation method, a system and a readable storage medium for the safety state of a nuclear power unit, wherein the supervision and evaluation method comprises the following steps: identifying deviation information of each production activity of the nuclear power unit, determining abnormal risk items according to the deviation information, and carrying out importance analysis on each abnormal risk item to determine importance level of each abnormal risk item; acquiring a plurality of performance index data of a nuclear power unit, and carrying out importance analysis on each performance index data to determine the importance level of each performance index data; and determining the safety state of the nuclear power unit according to the importance level of each abnormal risk item and the importance level of each performance index data. By implementing the technical scheme of the application, quantitative evaluation of the safety state of the nuclear power unit is realized, and the situation that the evaluation result has larger deviation due to the difference of personnel knowledge and experience can be avoided.

title_en: Game system
abstract_en: The invention provides a game system capable of distinguishing which player is placed a plurality of stacks of coins placed in the same placement area by a plurality of players. The game system of the present invention comprises: a game table (2) having a placement area (6) in which a plurality of types of placement objects are placed; a camera (10) that photographs the game table (2) and generates a photographed image; and an information processing device (12) that determines, based on the captured image and based on the position of the bundle (80) of medals (8) within the captured image, on which placement object (7) the bundle (80) is placed; when the medals (8) of a plurality of stacks (80) are placed in the same placement area (6), the information processing device (12) determines which stack (80) is the stack (80) of the master player (3 m) and which stack (80) is the stack (80) of the slave player (3 b) based on the captured image (11).

title_en: Expressway reconstruction and expansion traffic diversion model construction method based on multi-vehicle type system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic model research, in particular to a method for constructing a traffic diversion model for highway reconstruction and expansion based on a multi-vehicle type system, which comprises the steps of selecting the influence range of a road network of a reconstruction and expansion highway region, and obtaining traffic flow data of each road in a target region according to OD investigation; determining a diversion road section capable of bearing additional traffic according to traffic information of each road of the reconstruction and expansion area road network and the upper limit of traffic capacity, and constructing a diversion road network topology structure; comprehensively considering a plurality of influence factors and constraint conditions, and constructing an optimal expressway reconstruction and expansion traffic diversion model based on a multi-vehicle type system; and solving the model according to the Frank Wolfe algorithm thought to obtain a shunt path and shunt quantity of each OD pair. The total travel time of the traffic flow of the regional road network is optimized, the traffic flow ratio of the large vehicles in each road section is minimized, adverse effects caused by transition diversion and unbalanced diversion of the large vehicles are avoided, smoothness of construction roads is ensured, and the traffic safety level of the regional road network is improved.

title_en: Service data processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a service data processing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: responding to a service data processing instruction, determining service data to be processed, and generating a processing task for processing the service data; splitting service data into at least two pieces of sliced data by executing a processing task, and generating subtasks corresponding to each piece of sliced data in the at least two pieces of sliced data respectively; aiming at each of the at least two generated subtasks, processing the fragmented data corresponding to the subtasks by executing the subtasks to obtain a processing result of the fragmented data; and under the condition that at least two sub-tasks are executed and completed, obtaining a processing result of the service data according to the processing results respectively corresponding to the partitioned data. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the processing time of the service data can be shortened by splitting the service data and generating the subtasks respectively corresponding to the obtained pieces of fragmented data.

title_en: Production management system for precast beam steel bars on construction site
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel bar production, in particular to a construction site precast beam steel bar production management system which comprises a center console, a production module and a detection module, wherein production management software is installed in the center console, the production management software comprises a model building unit, a production planning unit and a detection unit.

title_en: Water affair intelligent alarm method and device based on water affair large model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet of things and discloses a water affair intelligent alarm method and device based on a water affair large model, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an IOT sensor group of a water treatment assembly, calculating real-time coefficients of the IOT sensor group, and collecting water outlet index data of the water treatment assembly corresponding to water outlet indexes when the real-time coefficients meet preset standard real-time coefficients; the method comprises the steps of constructing a sequence state curve of water indexes, analyzing sequence index analysis values of the water indexes by using a trained water affair early warning model, constructing a state analysis curve of the water indexes based on the sequence index analysis values, fitting the sequence state curve and the state analysis curve to obtain an index state curve, calculating index abnormal coefficients of the index state curve, constructing an abnormal early warning report of a water affair scene based on the index abnormal coefficients, constructing a multi-mode warning strategy of the abnormal early warning report, and executing intelligent warning of the water affair scene. The invention can improve the intelligent alarm effect on the water service scene.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station equivalent modeling method and system based on inverter controller transformation
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic power station equivalent modeling method and system based on inverter controller transformation, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power station equivalent modeling; obtaining external environment parameters of a photovoltaic power station and setting initial values of various parameters of a solar battery; calculating the sum of the output power of the inverters of the photovoltaic power generation units by combining the five-parameter model, and taking the sum of the output power minus the power loss of the transformer and the circuit as the power of the photovoltaic power station connected to the power grid; constructing a Norton equivalent circuit of the photovoltaic power generation unit based on the five-parameter model, and respectively carrying out quick change new and slow change correction on electric variables and circuit parameters; the parameters after the fast change update and the slow change correction are fed back to the solar cell model, whether the parameter is out of limit or not is judged, and if the parameter is out of limit, the initial values of all the parameters of the solar cell are reset; and if the power station is not out of limit, obtaining an equivalent modeling result of the photovoltaic power station. The invention can accurately represent the steady-state characteristics of the large grid-connected photovoltaic power station.

title_en: Renewable energy and user uncertainty demand response planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a renewable energy and user uncertainty demand response planning method and system, which relate to the technical field of power distribution network demand side management and comprise the steps of collecting air temperature prediction data and determining the day-ahead running state of equipment participating in demand response; the economic cost is output through the equipment power utilization and the purchased electric quantity, the main residual error and the secondary residual error are updated, and the equipment state is adjusted according to the cost; scene decomposition algorithm based on ADMM iterates optimization. According to the scene decomposition algorithm iterative optimization based on the renewable energy and user uncertainty demand response planning method provided by the invention, the optimal balance between the user comfort level and the economic cost of the finally obtained demand response plan is ensured, a large number of scenes are used for simulating real conditions, the scene decomposition is performed by the ADMM, the calculation complexity is reduced, and the invention has better effects in the aspects of efficiency, practicability and reliability.

title_en: Forward and reverse stepped iterative configuration method and system for phase-regulating machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of distributed camera optimal configuration in a new energy source sending end system, and particularly discloses a forward and reverse stepped iterative configuration method and a forward and reverse stepped iterative configuration system for a camera, wherein the forward and reverse stepped iterative configuration method and the forward and reverse stepped iterative configuration system for the camera comprise the steps of selecting addresses based on the short circuit ratio of a machine end node of a new energy station to obtain an address selection result; performing forward iteration configuration on the address selection result to obtain forward iteration configuration results of all cameras; screening nodes with the short-circuit ratio larger than a preset threshold value from the forward iteration configuration result to carry out reverse iteration configuration, so as to obtain a final configuration scheme of the camera; the camera is configured based on the final camera configuration scheme. The method can achieve the optimal effect of improving the overall short-circuit ratio of the system by adopting the forward stepped iterative configuration.

title_en: Data monitoring method, apparatus, computer device, readable storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a data monitoring method, apparatus, computer device, readable storage medium and program product. The method comprises the following steps: and acquiring various commodity data of the target commodity in the target platform, determining a monitoring result of the target commodity according to the commodity data, and determining a target sales strategy of the target commodity in the target platform according to the monitoring result, wherein the various commodity data comprise sales data of the target commodity in the target platform, product attribute values of the target commodity in the target platform, inventory data of the target commodity in the target platform and competition data of the target commodity in other platforms. By adopting the method, the accuracy of monitoring the data can be improved.

title_en: Multi-mode traffic passenger flow dynamic prediction method based on long-term and short-term memory network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimode traffic passenger flow dynamic prediction method based on a long-term and short-term memory network, which relates to the technical field of passenger flow prediction and comprises the following steps: acquiring demand data of passenger flows of each traffic mode, wherein the demand data of the passenger flows of each traffic mode comprises a plurality of passenger flow demand bases; constructing a depth convolution automatic encoder, training the depth convolution automatic encoder, and carrying out passenger flow demand base decomposition encoding based on the trained depth convolution automatic encoder to obtain high-level representation characteristics of the demand data of passenger flows in each traffic mode; building a passenger flow distribution model based on an M-LSTM neural network, inputting the high-level representation characteristics into the trained passenger flow distribution model to perform multi-mode traffic passenger flow distribution analysis, and performing multi-mode traffic passenger flow dynamic prediction by using a passenger flow collaborative prediction model. The invention can analyze the relation between the space and the time of the passenger flow generated by various traffic modes, and further accurately and dynamically predict the distribution information of the multi-mode traffic passenger flow.

title_en: Analysis method and analysis equipment thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of data processing, in particular to an analysis method and analysis equipment thereof, comprising the following steps: acquiring characteristic parameters of the bidding documents; carrying out logic association on the characteristic parameters to form a compiling logic tree so as to reflect the processing sequence and the processing combination of the characteristic parameters; calling all feature parameters covered by the processing combination in the current processing sequence from the compiling logic tree; obtaining a classification value of the processing combination according to the called characteristic parameters, and calling a processing method according to the classification value; invoking characteristic information of the bidder according to the class value of the processing method, and processing the characteristic parameters and the characteristic information through the processing method to complete the compiling of the current part of the bidding document; calculating the loss values of all the compiled parts, and comparing the loss values with standard values to verify all the compiled parts; if the requirements are met, the braiding is continued, and otherwise, the braiding is re-performed. The application can improve the generation efficiency of the bidding document and reduce the generation error rate of the bidding document.

title_en: AR panoramic technology-based road traffic potential safety hazard investigation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road traffic safety hidden trouble shooting method and system based on an AR panoramic technology. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a standardized data processing module, a scene and investigation content identification module and a potential safety hazard investigation module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires road multi-view panoramic picture data; the standardized data processing module forms a standardized data set for the multi-view image data of the road by taking time as unified corresponding content; the scene and investigation content identification module is used for constructing a scene model based on the picture data and the standardized data, identifying, analyzing and investigating specific road scene types in the process, and constructing an investigation content database; the potential safety hazard checking module performs systematic checking, finds hidden dangers according to the scene and the checking content identification result, and proposes a treatment suggestion. The invention applies the problems of the road hidden trouble of the AR panorama and the treatment effect of the AR panorama to the integrated and developed system for checking the road traffic hidden trouble, so that the checking of the road hidden trouble is more intelligent, visual and efficient.

title_en: Interactive intelligent analysis management system and method based on data center
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interactive intelligent analysis management system and method based on a data center, and belongs to the technical field of data centers. The invention tracks the order state of the business system, collects the whole life cycle data of each order in the business system and uploads the data to the data center, processes the whole life cycle data of each order in the business system based on the data center, calculates the satisfaction attenuation degree of each order, generates a first attention order set according to the satisfaction attenuation degree of each order, analyzes the demand of each order according to the first attention order set, screens enterprise resources based on the data center to generate a corresponding business object list, sends an allocation prompt of the first attention order to each business object according to the business object list, and manages the business system according to the selection of each business object. The invention actively recognizes the orders with satisfaction attenuation, and performs service optimization processing, thereby effectively improving the satisfaction degree of service processing.

title_en: Automatic generation method of power distribution network investigation report based on LDA probability model
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic generation method of a power distribution network research report based on an LDA probability model, which comprises the steps of obtaining power grid equipment ledger information and an electric topology connection relation thereof, generating a ledger document containing equipment name, type, position and connection relation information, constructing a graph structure of a reference power grid by using the obtained ledger attribute and the electric topology relation, marking standby line and standby equipment data, generating a marked document containing the reference power grid structure and marked information, training the LDA model, setting the number of topics, performing iterative training, extracting the topic distribution of each document and the vocabulary distribution of each topic, constructing a feasibility report generation model based on redundancy information, and analyzing potential topics and modes in the redundancy information to generate a power distribution network redundancy feasibility report.

title_en: Industrial and commercial management method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a business management method and a business management system based on the Internet of things, which belong to the technical field of business management and aim at the problems of one-sided and limited of the existing business management strategy of the Internet of things, and comprise the following steps of S1, determining requirements and targets; S2, designing an Internet of things framework, S3, selecting proper sensors and equipment, wherein the data acquisition and transmission module, the equipment monitoring and remote control module, the analysis and decision support module and other modules are mutually matched, so that the Internet of things business management system integrates the modules, and the aspects of production, supply chains, customer service and the like are covered from data acquisition to operation and maintenance management, the comprehensive design enables enterprises to comprehensively consider and manage the data and information of each link, the one-sided performance brought by a single module or a local solution is avoided, the comprehensive efficiency and decision quality of enterprise operation can be improved, the resource utilization can be optimized, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Automatic deviation correcting door plate intelligent cutting processing optimization method and optimization system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an intelligent cutting processing optimizing method and optimizing system for a door plate capable of automatically correcting deviation, and belongs to the technical field of industrial automation. According to the embodiment of the invention, the point cloud identification is carried out on the target door plate laser sensing detection information, the image descriptor is mined, and the information in multiple aspects such as size, contour, surface state and the like is covered, so that the initial state of the door plate can be comprehensively and accurately grasped. And aiming at a plurality of cutting processing task events, deviation rectifying judgment and processing parameter mining are respectively carried out, so that an automatic deviation rectifying execution strategy is determined. The door plate processing precision is effectively improved, and errors caused by manual measurement and adjustment can be reduced. The processing requirements of different door plate shapes, sizes and surface states can be met, the cutting process is optimized, the rejection rate is reduced, the production efficiency is improved, the production cost is reduced, and the adaptability of door plate processing under different application scenes is enhanced.

title_en: Energy scheduling method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium based on multi-objective model solving
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy scheduling method, a device, a terminal device and a storage medium based on multi-objective model solving, which can utilize a causal neural network to predict an output scheduling strategy at the next moment, and continuously update causal coefficients in the neural network based on the comparison result of a prediction result and an actual result in the training process of the causal neural network, so that the causal neural network can learn and capture causal relation between a historical output scheduling strategy and a future output scheduling strategy, the uncertainty and the dynamics of an energy supply and demand system are better adapted, the reliability of prediction is improved, and therefore, when solving a multi-objective scheduling optimization model, the invention can carry out multi-objective solving based on each accurate output scheduling strategy at the next moment, so as to obtain an accurate target output scheduling strategy with the minimum running cost, provide a reliable data base for subsequent scheduling optimization, and avoid the occurrence of energy shortage or surplus situations.

title_en: Carbon emission reduction calculation method for sludge anaerobic low-carbon treatment and biomass energy efficient utilization process
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon emission reduction calculation method of a sludge anaerobic low-carbon treatment and biomass energy efficient utilization process. Specifically, the invention innovatively provides a carbon emission reduction calculation method of a whole set of sludge anaerobic low-carbon treatment and biogas heat energy efficient utilization process based on a CDM methodology. Meanwhile, a calculation method for calculating the carbon emission reduction effect through the heat value of the dried sludge after the dried sludge is combusted and utilized and a calculation method for directly discharging CO  2  generated by decomposing the added fossil-source-containing carbon medicament are specifically provided. By utilizing the method provided by the invention, the carbon emission reduction effect of the sludge anaerobic digestion and biomass energy efficient utilization process can be accurately and completely calculated, and the problem of a similar process carbon-free emission reduction calculation method is solved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for monitoring abnormal carbon emission of coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for monitoring abnormal carbon emission of a coal-fired power plant, and belongs to the technical field of environmental monitoring. According to the method, the normal range is identified by analyzing carbon emission data of the coal-fired power plant in different time periods and using a plurality of abnormal value detection methods, and the target normal range is determined. Screening out carbon emission data of a target abnormal period, and calculating an abnormal duty ratio. And matching according to a preset carbon emission abnormal treatment table to obtain corresponding treatment measures. According to the invention, through integrating a plurality of anomaly detection methods, the carbon emission anomaly is rapidly positioned and quantified, and accurate treatment measures are provided for the coal-fired power plant, so that the carbon emission is effectively reduced.

title_en: Virtual try-on method, model training method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a virtual fitting method, a model training method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are used for acquiring an image and a first image of clothes to be fitted, wherein a first person wears the first clothes in the first image, the first clothes in the first image are separated to obtain a binary mask image of the first clothes and a second image of the first clothes which is shielded, gesture extraction is carried out based on the first image and a figure gesture analysis model to obtain gesture characteristic information of the first person, the clothes images are respectively input into a clothes detail analysis model and a clothes appearance analysis model to obtain detail characteristic information and appearance characteristic information of the clothes, the gesture characteristic information added with hidden noise is used as a conditional input side of a pre-trained diffusion model, and the binary mask image, the second image, the detail characteristic information and the appearance characteristic information are used as a main input side of the pre-trained diffusion model to obtain a target image of the clothes to be fitted. The application improves the virtual try-on effect.

title_en: Intelligent shopping cart system based on deep reinforcement learning and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent shopping cart system based on deep reinforcement learning and an implementation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of firstly, deploying the system; the method comprises the steps of data acquisition, preprocessing, commodity detection and classification, commodity tracking and state updating, gesture estimation and state judgment, anomaly detection and security alarm, user interaction and recommendation, settlement and payment, data synchronization and model updating, high-precision commodity classification, tracking and gesture estimation are realized through multi-mode data acquisition and fusion and an improved deep learning algorithm, deep reinforcement learning, self-supervision learning, meta-learning and federal learning technologies are introduced, robustness, adaptability and instantaneity of a model are improved, differential privacy and security multiparty computing technologies are adopted, safety and privacy of user data are protected, operation cost is effectively reduced, shopping efficiency is improved, and user experience is improved.

title_en: Method and system for prompting receipt and repayment reminding based on large model multiple modes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-mode prompting and repayment reminding method and system based on a large model, which belong to the field of finance and comprise the steps of S1, obtaining repayment information, consumption information and active information of a customer, S2, analyzing the customer information obtained in the step S1 through a repayment evaluation large model, combining the latest information of a user by using a RAG technology to obtain a repayment reminding strategy of the customer, S3, generating corresponding reminding content according to the repayment reminding strategy, and sending the corresponding reminding content to the customer in a corresponding time node in combination with a corresponding channel in the repayment strategy.
