The invention has the advantages that the prompting text of the traditional fixed template is difficult to attract attention again at present that social media are more and the content is more and more abundant. The technology is not only extremely rich and novel in prompting content, but also combines a plurality of channels, can be used for prompting customers in a diversified manner, and is attractive to the customers, so that the repayment efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Automatic auditing and analyzing method for farmland soil data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic auditing and analyzing method for farmland soil data, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting soil original data to form a data set through an Internet of things sensor and unmanned aerial vehicle multispectral imaging, S2, reducing noise and removing abnormal values by adopting an extended Kalman filter, and supplementing missing data by utilizing time sequence interpolation, S3, analyzing auditing pretreatment data based on time sequence, identifying an abnormal mode, S4, analyzing and fusing auditing data by utilizing a causal reasoning graphic neural network, S5, performing multidimensional analysis and prediction on the fused data by applying a big data analysis technology, S6, realizing real-time data visualization and interactive display by adopting a quantum computing driven visualization method, S7, generating a report on the soil data set and analysis results by using a natural language generation technology, and S8, and implementing encryption and access control in the data processing and transmission process. The invention provides a comprehensive soil data processing solution, and effectively improves the data auditing efficiency, accuracy and safety.

title_en: Intelligent movable closed system for cooling cabinet
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an intelligent mobile closed system for a cooling cabinet. Disclosed herein is an intelligent mobile closure system that allows access to the interior from the exterior of a cabinet. In some embodiments, the movable structure may be coupled with a cabinet interior adapted to be maintained at a colder temperature than an external cabinet ambient temperature, for example, to store perishable consumer products in a retail environment. In particular, the smart mobile closure system may include electronic components that display a graphical rendering corresponding to one or more products stored in a retail product container. Additionally, the intelligent mobile closure system may include a controller that determines an inventory status of products in the closure system and controls graphics rendering based on the determined inventory status.

title_en: Power transmission and transformation project settlement super-probability early warning method and device based on attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a settlement super-probability early warning method and device for power transmission and transformation project based on an attention mechanism, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining first settlement data of the power transmission and transformation project and establishing a first settlement data set; sequentially carrying out abnormal value and missing value processing on the first settlement data set to obtain a second standard data set, carrying out weight analysis on the second standard data set to generate attention weight data, carrying out attention weighting to obtain a third weighted data set, constructing a settlement cost prediction model based on a deep learning model by taking settlement cost as a target by the third weighted data set, inputting the real-time first settlement data into the settlement cost prediction model to calculate the estimated settlement cost of the power transmission and transformation project, comparing the estimated settlement cost with the project batch approximate calculation to obtain a fourth comparison result and automatically triggering corresponding super-schematic early warning. The invention realizes timely mastering and warning of the engineering overtime condition, improves the efficiency of engineering management and reduces the occurrence of the overtime risk.

title_en: Intelligent management and control transaction system based on big data dynamic model platform membership card
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transaction negotiation management and control, in particular to a membership card intelligent management and control transaction system based on a big data dynamic model platform, which comprises the following steps: s1, a merchant draws up and issues membership card clauses; s2, generating a rights interval by a dynamic model; s3, generating and issuing a digital contract; s4, the consumer selects and purchases the membership card. Compared with a single payment mode which is lack of selection by consumers in the prior art, the invention automatically generates optimal member clauses through a big data dynamic model and an algorithm, so that merchants are more convenient to manage, and the consumers can quickly perceive the integrity of the merchants, thereby quickly facilitating transactions.

title_en: Defect detection and safety evaluation method for construction period of high and large template support frame
abstract_en: The application discloses a defect detection and safety evaluation method for a construction period of a high and large template support frame, which comprises the following steps: the strength and sinking parameter data of the connecting pieces in different construction periods are analyzed, classification and cluster analysis are carried out, defects and potential safety hazards are identified, the strength classification clustering database dynamically monitors strength change, stability evaluation is carried out by combining the sinking data and environmental factors, the fault critical point of the support frame is predicted, early warning and construction optimization suggestions are provided, and the safety and stability of the support frame in the construction period are ensured. Compared with the existing detection method, the method provided by the application is simpler, more convenient and easier to realize, and has higher casting load analysis accuracy, avoids dangerous accidents and ensures construction safety.

title_en: Method and system for realizing full-channel self-service response based on electric power IT service
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of IT service, in particular to a method and a system for realizing full-channel self-service response based on the power IT service, which solve the problems of providing reasonable response and guidance for users according to the query habits of the users; the method comprises the steps of obtaining query habits of a user through a questionnaire form, obtaining adjustment query content according to the query habits, obtaining historical query records of the user, determining response grades of the adjustment query content according to the historical query records, providing initial response information and query guidance according to the response grades, tracking subsequent operation of the user in target time, counting the guidance times of the user using the query guidance, transferring the adjustment query content to a manual service platform when the guidance times reach a guidance threshold value, and giving ideal response information by the manual service platform.

title_en: Multistage linkage plan management and control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multistage linkage plan management and control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method automatically generates a trial main plan of whole vehicle production according to a model database by establishing the model database of automatic scheduling of the whole vehicle trial plan; the method comprises the steps of initiating a whole vehicle trial-manufacture application according to a trial-manufacture main plan, generating a grid plan according to the whole vehicle trial-manufacture application, calling a corresponding preset algorithm according to the grid plan, matching a process period library according to the preset algorithm, and automatically generating the first edition plans corresponding to welding, final assembly and shipping, so that consistency and linkage of data among different level plans can be ensured, plan management and control requirements of different stages of different roles can be met, risk early warning can be timely and actively sent, sample vehicle delivery risk is reduced, reasonable period can be calculated more accurately, the model period library is updated and completed, accuracy of trial-manufacture plan scheduling is improved, and multi-level linkage plan management and control efficiency is improved.

title_en: Benefit maximization recommendation method and system based on entropy weight plastic characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides a benefit maximization recommendation method and system based on entropy weight plastic characteristics, which relate to the technical field of telecommunications and comprise the steps of grouping users according to ordered commodities to obtain all groups of user attribute data as multiple groups of training data; the method comprises the steps of taking sales or profits as dependent variables and the association attribute of a user and commodities as independent variables for each group of training data, obtaining numerical attribute data for each group of training data, calculating the independent variable association degree of each group of training data, presetting an association degree threshold, remolding the characteristic of high similarity of each group of training data by using entropy weight TOPSIS for each group of training data with the association degree larger than or equal to the association degree threshold, obtaining multiple groups of fused training data, respectively establishing a recommendation prediction model of each commodity by using LightGBM tree algorithm model based on the multiple groups of fused training data, and predicting recommendation profits of the user. The method and the device avoid the overfitting caused by the recommendation of the accuracy, and enable enterprises to obtain larger profits.

title_en: Commodity information issuing method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a commodity information issuing method, system and equipment, which comprise the steps of obtaining first image data selected by a user, carrying out commodity identification on the first image data to obtain target commodity information, obtaining associated resource data from a preset resource group according to the target commodity information, obtaining a group to be displayed corresponding to the target commodity information on a preset platform, generating image display information corresponding to the target commodity information according to the first image data and/or the resource data, determining corresponding text display information according to the group to be displayed, generating commodity display information according to the image display information and the text display information, and issuing the commodity display information to the group to be displayed on the preset platform.

title_en: Method for calculating deicing composite failure probability of power transmission line based on conditional probability
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for calculating deicing composite failure probability of an icing transmission line based on conditional probability, which belongs to the technical field of safety deicing of the icing transmission line, and finally, the composite failure probability of the icing transmission line is determined, a reliability evaluation system for deicing the icing transmission line is comprehensively and simply established, a probability-based evaluation index is provided for normal service of the icing transmission line, and the capacity of the transmission line for resisting icing disasters is improved. The invention comprehensively considers a plurality of factors such as the type of deicing technology, the deviation degree of the thickness of the ice coating during deicing, the falling time of the ice body and the like, can more comprehensively and accurately analyze the deicing reliability of the ice-coated power transmission line, improves the capability of the power transmission line for resisting ice-coated disasters, and reduces the power transmission accidents caused by ice coating.

title_en: Engineering change cost prediction and management method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engineering change cost prediction and management method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a data set, S2, carrying out data preprocessing on the data set, S3, training a basic deep learning model, determining an initial model framework and parameters, S4, continuously collecting real-time change data and actual cost data as dynamic feedback input to obtain real-time feedback data, S5, triggering a progressive learning process based on the real-time feedback data, S6, carrying out hybrid optimization by combining a self-adaptive differential evolution algorithm and fuzzy logic control, finally and automatically selecting an optimal network layer number, node number and an activation function, S7, carrying out dynamic prediction on the future change cost of a project, continuously optimizing a prediction result along with continuous updating of the project data, and S8, automatically generating project management suggestions by a system according to the optimized prediction result. The invention combines the deep learning and the self-adaptive optimization method to realize the prediction and management of the dynamic engineering change cost.

title_en: Intelligent fuel dispatching system for ship
abstract_en: The invention provides a fuel intelligent dispatching system for ships, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent dispatching and comprises a data acquisition module, a correlation analysis module, a model construction module, a scheme generation module and a scheme adjustment module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring various real-time data and historical data, the correlation analysis module is used for analyzing target requirements to acquire a plurality of requirement constraint conditions, performing correlation analysis on each requirement constraint condition and the acquired various data, predicting possible influencing factors, the model construction module is used for performing input and output analysis on the acquired various data by taking minimum fuel consumption as a target function to construct a ship dispatching model, the scheme generation module is used for generating a ship dispatching scheme based on the possible influencing factors and the ship dispatching model, and the scheme adjustment module is used for displaying the ship dispatching scheme based on a visual operation interface, combining the target objects to obtain a final dispatching scheme based on interactive operation of the visual operation interface on the ship dispatching scheme and executing the final dispatching scheme. The operating efficiency is improved while satisfying low fuel consumption.

title_en: Communication engineering quality monitoring and analyzing method and device based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication engineering quality monitoring and analyzing method and device based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence and communication engineering, and the method comprises the steps of collecting communication engineering quality data; the communication engineering quality data is preprocessed to obtain preprocessed data, the preprocessed data is input into a communication engineering quality analysis decision model to obtain analysis decision results corresponding to the communication engineering quality data, the communication engineering quality analysis decision model is generated by training a machine learning model in advance according to the mapping relation of the communication engineering quality sample data and the quality data analysis decision, and the communication engineering quality data and the analysis decision results are displayed through an application display platform.

title_en: City wisdom management platform based on video monitoring
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban intelligent management, and relates to a video monitoring-based urban intelligent management platform. According to the invention, the environmental sanitation personnel scheduling requirements of all subareas belonging to all types of areas of the target city are analyzed, the areas needing to be cleaned preferentially are accurately judged, the waste of manpower and material resources is avoided, the environmental pollution is reduced, the life quality of residents is improved, the fine management of urban environmental sanitation is realized by analyzing the sanitation evaluation feedback indexes of all subareas belonging to all types of areas of the target city, the efficiency and the quality of environmental sanitation work are improved, the timely problem discovery and the adoption of targeted measures are also facilitated, the working quality and the efficiency of the environmental sanitation personnel are intuitively known by analyzing the working evaluation feedback indexes of all the environmental sanitation personnel of all subareas belonging to all types of the target city, the problem discovery and the defect are facilitated, and the overall environmental sanitation work quality is improved by adopting the targeted measures.

title_en: Advertisement recommendation method and system based on click rate estimation model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an advertisement recommendation method and system based on a click rate prediction model, which relate to the technical field of advertisement recommendation and comprise the steps of collecting advertisement recommendation feature data, processing through feature engineering, outputting user feature vectors, inputting user interest vectors into the click rate prediction model, training the click rate prediction model through a causally optimized cross entropy loss function, outputting click probability values of each advertisement, taking the click probability values as the input of a reinforcement learning algorithm, combining user interaction behaviors, generating advertisement sequencing results through dynamically optimizing a multi-target reward function, updating user interest offset values of the causally inference model in real time according to real-time feedback data in the user interaction behaviors, and correcting user interest vector offset.

title_en: Capacity allocation method of off-grid optical firewood storage system based on investment recovery analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to a capacity configuration method of an off-grid optical firewood storage system based on investment recovery analysis, and belongs to the field of new energy system optimization design. According to the invention, the capacity configuration model of the photovoltaic, energy storage and diesel engine is constructed through the load demand data, the regional illumination data and the equipment cost parameters provided by the user, and the configuration design of the capacity of the optical diesel storage system is realized by combining the economic analysis of the investment recovery years. The method optimizes the photovoltaic support load operation time by utilizing a particle swarm optimization algorithm PSO And energy storage support load run time And generating a two-dimensional curve of the return on investment period, and intuitively displaying the economy of different configuration schemes. The invention solves the problems of insufficient flexibility and incomplete economic analysis of the capacity configuration model in the prior art, and provides scientific and careful decision support for the design of the off-grid high-efficiency optical diesel storage hybrid system.

title_en: Air ticket reform recommendation system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air ticket change recommending system based on data analysis, relates to the technical field of air ticket change recommending, and solves the technical problems that in the prior art, risk early warning cannot be carried out when external factor analysis and internal factor analysis are normal, and the running efficiency of the air ticket change is reduced; the analysis units needing the flight change are subjected to real-time data acquisition and analysis, and the flight change selection or selection is provided for the analysis units through the data acquisition and analysis, so that the flight can be matched with a proper route in time when the flight needs to change the period, the change efficiency of the analysis units is ensured, and the influence caused by the change period is reduced.

title_en: Marine pasture site selection evaluation method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine learning-based marine ranch site selection evaluation method, which relates to the technical field of marine ranches and comprises the following steps of determining a marine ranch site selection target, collecting regional data of the site selection target, dividing the regional data into historical data and real-time data, preprocessing the collected historical data and real-time data, and screening site selection influence factors, wherein the site selection influence factors comprise climate influence factors and ecological influence factors, and constructing a comprehensive suitability evaluation model based on the historical data and combined with specific requirements of marine ranch site selection. The invention processes and analyzes massive real-time data including information of climate, ecology, topography, socioeconomic and the like through a machine learning technology, so that site selection evaluation is more accurate, errors of human judgment are reduced, and meanwhile, key climate and ecological factors influencing the site selection of the marine pasture can be accurately identified through analysis of historical data and real-time data.

title_en: Digital engineering full life cycle management method based on unified data source
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital engineering intelligent management, and discloses a digital engineering full life cycle management method based on a unified data source; the method comprises the steps of creating projects on a platform, determining project requirements, carrying out task division according to each requirement item in the project requirements, distributing each requirement item in the project requirements to corresponding tasks, carrying out priority assessment on each task according to the requirement items, carrying out model design on each task according to the priorities, obtaining corresponding model data, feeding back the requirement items and the model data of each task to the platform, and interconnecting tasks with adjacent priorities through work package association in the platform.

title_en: Agricultural product ingredient content analysis method and system based on multispectral imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural product ingredient content analysis method and system based on multispectral imaging, and relates to the technical field of agricultural product ingredient content detection, wherein the agricultural product ingredient content analysis method comprises the following steps of extracting ingredient content characteristic data of agricultural products; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a change trend of the ingredient content of the agricultural product in a future time period based on a content prediction model, judging whether the quality of the agricultural product meets the requirement or not, and identifying the ingredient content of the agricultural product related to a target index. According to the invention, the component content prediction model is established, so that the component content change trend of the agricultural product in a period of time in the future can be predicted, the nutritional loss or quality change of the agricultural product can be predicted, whether the quality of the agricultural product meets the requirements can be accurately estimated based on the component content change trend, the agricultural product is ensured to be sold and eaten in the optimal state, and the quality standard of the whole agricultural product can be improved.

title_en: Method and system for associating e-commerce commodity with commodity quality certificate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for associating an electronic commerce commodity with a commodity quality certificate, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing an electronic commerce commodity information database and a blockchain; the method comprises the steps of obtaining goods codes of electronic commerce goods to be associated, obtaining corresponding electronic commerce quality certificates from an electronic commerce goods information database according to the goods codes of the electronic commerce goods to be associated, calculating hash values of electronic commerce quality certificate contents of the electronic commerce goods to be associated to obtain first hash values, combining the goods codes of the electronic commerce goods to be associated, the electronic commerce quality certificate contents of the electronic commerce goods to be associated and the first hash values into a json character string, carrying out hash processing on the json character string to obtain second hash values, and storing the second hash values in a block chain. The invention solves the problem that the tamper detection difficulty is increased due to the fact that the hash value data structure calculated by utilizing the whole-process circulation information including the commodity quality certificate content is too simple in the existing product quality security traceability system.

title_en: Shale oil mobility and adsorptivity prediction method and device based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of petroleum geological exploration, and particularly relates to a shale oil mobility and adsorptivity prediction method and device based on machine learning. The method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining a land shale data set, S2, inputting the land shale data set into a machine learning algorithm model, and outputting predicted shale oil mobility parameters and adsorptivity parameters, wherein the land shale data set comprises shale mineralogy types, basic geochemical parameters, porosity and multi-temperature-order pyrolysis data, and the machine learning algorithm model comprises RF-PSO and RF-DE. According to the invention, the optimal OMC and OSC prediction model is screened out based on mineralogy, basic geochemistry and porosity data, so that the OMC and OSC of shale can be accurately calculated.

title_en: Application model of intelligent financial information system in digital park
abstract_en: The invention provides an application model of an intelligent financial information system in a digital park, which comprises a park application layer, a business logic layer, a data access layer and a park data layer, wherein the park application layer is used for displaying, operating and managing the park financial information, the business logic layer is used for realizing a business processing function, processing park financial business according to defined rules, analyzing financial data and providing reports of financial indexes and business data, the data access layer is used for providing access and operation functions to a database, checking data integrity and accuracy before data enter the database, buffering and optimizing, improving operation speed and park user experience, and the park data layer is used for storing all financial and related information data of the park and processing data resources through the database, a data center and a cloud computing center. The application model of intelligent financial information system in digital garden has promotion financial processing efficiency, reduces the rule risk of garden enterprise, improves the advantage of garden enterprise operating efficiency.

title_en: Stacker, control method and device of stacker and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics storage, in particular to a stacker, a control method and a device of the stacker and computer equipment, wherein the control method of the stacker comprises the steps of determining target actions required to be executed by the stacker according to task types by acquiring task types and target positions issued by a scheduling system, wherein the target positions comprise row positions, column positions and layer positions, controlling the stacker to complete issued tasks according to the target positions and the target actions, so that the stacker and the scheduling system can be matched, the three-dimensional automation can be realized, and meanwhile, the target positions issued by the scheduling system comprise the row positions, the column positions and the layer positions, so that the stacker can be positioned more accurately when the tasks issued by the scheduling system are completed, and the working efficiency of an automatic three-dimensional warehouse is improved.

title_en: Method for obtaining all paths among any nodes in directed acyclic graph
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of path searching, in particular to a method for acquiring all paths among any nodes in a directed acyclic graph, which comprises the steps of setting a given starting point and a given end point, acquiring an adjacency matrix of the directed acyclic graph, converting a multi-source directed acyclic graph into a single-source directed acyclic graph, solving all paths between the end starting point and the end point of the single-source directed acyclic graph, generating a path list, traversing the path list to obtain effective paths, deleting nodes before the given starting point and after the given end point in the effective paths, and outputting all path information between the given starting point and the given end point. According to the technical scheme, the multi-source directed acyclic graph is converted into the single-source directed acyclic graph, the method for acquiring all paths of the single-source directed acyclic graph is expanded to the multi-source directed acyclic graph to be used, the method for acquiring all paths of the single-source directed acyclic graph is based, the acquisition of paths among any nodes is further realized, and verification among gateway nodes in an evaluation rule is convenient.

title_en: Intelligent management method and system for electricity purchasing and selling
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for intelligently managing electricity purchasing and selling, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing an event bus, configuring an independent event monitor for each application system, establishing initial database connection for each data source, storing the initial database connection in a database connection pool, acquiring connection from the database connection pool to acquire data when the application system initiates a data query request to the data source through event driving, receiving the data query request by an aggregation management platform and analyzing an aggregation requirement, searching an optimal aggregation scheme according to the aggregation requirement, performing aggregation calculation to generate an aggregation result, and distributing the aggregation result to the application system for analysis and display after the aggregation is completed. The invention realizes loose coupling and efficient cooperation among components through event driving, database connection pools, aggregation management and other mechanisms, is more stable and reliable, can cope with various complex electricity purchasing and selling business analysis scenes, greatly improves the aggregation accuracy and efficiency, and is convenient for efficient and accurate management of electricity purchasing and selling businesses.

title_en: Method and device for optimizing reactive compensation configuration of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for optimizing reactive compensation configuration of a transformer substation, wherein the method calculates reactive requirements of the transformer substation according to load data in an acquired setting time period, clusters a plurality of daily reactive requirement curves to obtain a plurality of types of typical daily reactive requirement curves so as to determine total compensation capacity of a capacitor, configures different parallel capacitor combinations according to the total compensation capacity of the capacitor by taking the number of capacitor groups, the capacity of a capacitor single group and the bus voltage of the transformer substation as constraint conditions, and then determines the optimal configuration of reactive compensation of the transformer substation by taking the sum of the investment cost of the capacitor, the investment cost of a static reactive compensator and the reactive compensation mismatch cost under the different parallel capacitor combinations as an objective function. Compared with the traditional isovolumetric grouping method, the reactive power fine compensation of the transformer substation can be realized, reactive power loss cost caused by reactive power mismatch is reduced, and the stability and the electric energy quality of the electric power system are improved.

title_en: Dense oil reservoir productivity prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dense oil reservoir productivity prediction method and device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining dynamic and static data of a well in a tight oil reservoir, obtaining data of a plurality of candidate capacity master control parameters and capacity parameters of the well, determining correlation coefficients of the candidate capacity master control parameters and the capacity parameters, screening the capacity master control parameters, determining weight of the capacity master control parameters on the capacity parameters, inputting a selected machine learning model, obtaining a capacity prediction model by combining a long-short-time memory and a attention weight mechanism, based on learning of the capacity master control parameters and the capacity parameter data of the well, inputting the capacity master control parameter data of a well to be predicted in a target tight oil reservoir into the capacity prediction model, and predicting the capacity parameter data of the well to be predicted according to an output result. The method can systematically and completely analyze the main control factors of the production capacity of the tight oil reservoir, and realize scientific and reasonable prediction of the production capacity of the tight oil reservoir.

title_en: Photovoltaic and energy storage optimal configuration method and device based on snowflake net
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid optimization, and provides a photovoltaic and energy storage optimal configuration method and device based on a snowflake network, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining typical scenes of photovoltaic and load correlation and occurrence probability of each typical scene based on load demand historical data and photovoltaic output historical data; the photovoltaic and energy storage double-layer optimization configuration model comprises a planning layer and an operation layer, wherein the photovoltaic and energy storage double-layer optimization configuration model comprises the planning layer and the operation layer, the planning layer is used for determining the access positions and the capacities of the photovoltaic and the energy storage, the constraint conditions and the objective functions of the planning layer are calculated based on the optimization results of the operation layer, the access positions and the capacities of the photovoltaic and the energy storage are optimized, the operation layer is used for optimizing the photovoltaic and energy storage output conditions of each period based on the load curve corresponding to a typical scene with the occurrence probability larger than a set value, the photovoltaic output curve and the optimization results of the planning layer, and the optimization results are fed back to the planning layer based on the objective functions and the constraint conditions of the operation layer. The adaptability and the flexibility of the snowflake net can be improved.

title_en: Mixed flow shop scheduling optimization method and system based on equipment green degree ordering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mixed flow shop scheduling optimization, in particular to a mixed flow shop scheduling optimization method and a mixed flow shop scheduling optimization system based on equipment green degree sequencing, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a comprehensive green degree evaluation matrix of each equipment based on the comprehensive green degree evaluation index system; the method comprises the steps of respectively calculating relative paste progress and gray correlation according to a comprehensive green degree evaluation matrix of each device, determining comprehensive green degree evaluation values of each device according to the relative paste progress and gray correlation, sorting according to the sequence from large to small of the comprehensive green degree evaluation values of each device, screening an initial population from a sorted device set according to a set selection strategy, taking the initial population as an input value of a differential evolution algorithm, executing the differential evolution algorithm to obtain an optimal solution, and taking the optimal solution as a mixed flow shop scheduling optimization result. The invention efficiently and reasonably generates the mixed flow shop scheduling scheme.

title_en: WebXR-based immersive scientific experiment demonstration system and WebXR-based immersive scientific experiment demonstration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an immersed scientific experiment demonstration system and method based on WebXR, comprising a tube body, wherein two ends of the tube body are of an opening structure, the top end opening of the tube body is of a first opening of a flat elliptic structure, the bottom end of the tube body is connected with a nut, the inner wall of the top end opening of the tube body is provided with first tooth blocks, the outer wall of the top of the tube body is provided with second tooth blocks which are positioned at the bottom of the first opening at intervals, the first tooth blocks are arranged at the first opening, so that tissues can be rapidly cut when a needle head is drawn back and forth, the tissues can fall off and enter the first opening to be rapidly extracted, the second tooth blocks can be used for further cutting the tissues, the cutting range is increased, the tissue falling speed is accelerated, the first tooth blocks and the second tooth blocks can also be used for hooking and storing the tissues, the tissues can be collected in the tube body, the cut tissues are prevented from being separated, and the falling tissues can be prevented from being rapidly guided into the tube body, and the tissues can be prevented from adhering to the outer wall of the tube body.

title_en: Multi-agent collaboration method and system for engineering construction projects
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-agent cooperation method and a system for engineering construction projects, which relate to the field of railway engineering management and comprise the steps of training an expert model in the railway engineering field, generating a prompt instruction by using dialogue information input by a user through expert model processing, generating a query statement by using a content perception agent according to the prompt instruction and returning the query statement to the expert model, calling a mixed search agent by using the expert model according to the query statement to search, generating a chart by using a chart generation agent according to a chart making request and returning the chart to the expert model, carrying out data analysis by using a data analysis agent according to the data analysis request and returning the chart to the expert model, and integrating and outputting a search result, the chart and an analysis result by using a language question-answer agent. The invention can effectively cooperate with various intelligent agents to play respective advantages, improves the retrieval speed and accuracy, and can output more comprehensive and understandable retrieval results according to the input natural language.

title_en: Real-time monitoring and optimizing method and system for recycling construction waste
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time monitoring and optimizing method and a system for recycling construction waste. The method comprises the steps of acquiring vibration frequency, material images and weight data of a crusher, a screening machine and a sorting device through a multi-source sensing network to obtain an original parameter data set, extracting features to obtain a standardized feature data set, establishing a crushing dynamics model, a screening efficiency model and a sorting process model, coupling through a material balance equation and an energy balance equation, carrying out model parameter identification through a least square method and a genetic algorithm to obtain a technological process mathematical model, inputting current technological parameter combination and historical quality data into an epsilon-constraint optimizer to obtain a Pareto optimal solution of resource conversion rate and energy consumption, and calculating control quantity of an executing mechanism through a model prediction controller to generate an optimal technological parameter combination. The implementation of the invention realizes the real-time optimization adjustment of the technological parameters of the resource utilization of the construction waste.

title_en: Building construction quality prediction method and system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of predictive analysis, in particular to a method and a system for predicting the construction quality of a building based on data analysis, which comprise the following steps: data of material hardness, water absorption, environmental temperature and humidity are collected from a construction site, the data are cleaned and formatted into unified standards, and an average value, a standard deviation and a deviation coefficient are calculated to generate data statistical characteristics. In the invention, the deep finding of complex data relationship of the construction site is provided by collecting data of the construction site in real time and using a Gaussian process model and adjusting kernel function parameters, so that the accuracy and reliability of the model are optimized, the model is adjusted in real time by an incremental learning method, the synchronous update of the model and the data of the construction site is ensured, the real-time property and adaptability of prediction are improved, in addition, more comprehensive risk assessment is provided for a construction team by using a confidence interval, the early warning of potential quality problems is realized, and the structural safety risk and maintenance cost are reduced.

title_en: Budget management integrated operation and maintenance monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a budget management integrated operation and maintenance monitoring method and device, the method comprises the steps of regularly obtaining setting data, converting the setting data according to a setting format to obtain required data, processing the data to obtain processed data, modeling a telephone work order using line diagram and a histogram through different time dimensions in the week, the month and the year, predicting trend of the future telephone work order, displaying the processed data, and displaying the processed data for operation and maintenance report and analysis of management personnel, wherein the data of all subsystems can be integrated, and key indexes are displayed through a highly visual interface, so that decision efficiency and overall operation and maintenance management level of a system are improved.

title_en: Goods shelf commodity management method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a goods shelf commodity management method and related equipment, the method comprises the steps of obtaining goods shelf pictures through equipment interface interfaces, obtaining a goods shelf detection diagram according to predefined identification area configuration, inputting the goods shelf detection diagram into a trained commodity identification model, carrying out single forward propagation and non-maximum value inhibition processing by utilizing the commodity identification model to generate commodity identification results, matching the commodity identification results with a commodity information list in an application end database, and updating the commodity information list according to the matching results. The application has higher accuracy, reliability and management efficiency, can effectively solve the problems existing in the prior art, and provides a new solution for the field of shelf management.

title_en: Electric vehicle schedulable potential evaluation method considering user two-dimensional response will
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle schedulable potential assessment method considering user bi-dimensional response will, which comprises the steps of establishing a user participation power grid scheduling uncertainty model under different excitation levels, including an electric vehicle user participation scheduling response rate model and a charging time margin uncertainty response model, calculating the acceptance of an electric vehicle based on the user participation power grid scheduling uncertainty model under different excitation levels, quantifying the response will of the electric vehicle user participation scheduling, and assessing the schedulable potential of an electric vehicle cluster based on the user acceptance. Aiming at the problem that the dispatching acceptance of the electric automobile user participating in the power grid is not comprehensive, the responsivity and response deviation of different users under different excitation levels are analyzed, a response rate model of the electric automobile user under different excitation levels is constructed, the dispatching willingness of the user under different excitation levels is reflected, and therefore the accuracy of the dispatching capacity evaluation of the electric automobile is improved.

title_en: Semiconductor cutting bar integration optimization system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor processing, and particularly relates to a semiconductor rib cutting integration optimization system and method, wherein the influence on adjacent structures in the cutting process is minimized by dynamically adjusting cutting parameters and planning an avoidance route to avoid sensitive points; the method comprises the steps of maintaining a stable cutting environment by applying a multi-stage cooling strategy, preventing material damage caused by overheating, monitoring temperature change in real time in the cooling process, adaptively correcting the cutting speed, ensuring the flexibility and the accuracy of the cutting process, and finally verifying the consistency of products through strict quality control inspection. The measures act together, so that the cutting quality and the yield are remarkably improved, defects are reduced, and a more stable production process and a higher quality of the semiconductor chip are realized.

title_en: Water quality patch line range determining method and interfered water quality monitoring point position identification method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a water quality patch range determining method and an interfered water quality monitoring point position identifying method. The water quality patch range determining method comprises the steps of carrying out cluster analysis on water quality monitoring data of existing monitoring points by adopting various cluster numbers to determine a cluster set of the water quality monitoring data under various cluster numbers, calculating corresponding cluster errors and values based on the cluster sets under various cluster numbers, determining elbow cluster numbers based on the cluster errors and values corresponding to various cluster numbers, selecting the selected cluster numbers from the cluster numbers larger than the elbow cluster numbers, and taking the upper limit and the lower limit of the cluster including the water quality assessment index in the cluster set corresponding to the selected cluster numbers as the upper limit and the lower limit of the water quality patch range.

title_en: Harmonic state estimation method, device, electronic apparatus, storage medium, and program
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a harmonic state estimation method, a device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining electric energy quality monitoring data of a bus to be monitored in a target electric power system, wherein the electric energy quality monitoring data are data of asynchronous measurement, calculating target phase differences among different measurement points in the bus to be monitored according to the electric energy quality monitoring data, and calculating harmonic state quantities among different measurement points in the bus to be monitored according to the target phase differences and a harmonic state estimation model of the target electric power system. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can improve the accuracy of the harmonic state estimation in the power system.

title_en: Knowledge tracking method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a knowledge tracking method, a knowledge tracking device, knowledge tracking equipment and a storage medium, wherein the knowledge tracking method comprises the steps of counting input data and classifying the data, constructing a base diagram according to the association relation between a question and knowledge points and a corresponding embedded matrix, obtaining an online augmentation diagram by combining the base diagram and an online augmentation function, generating online representation according to the online augmentation diagram, obtaining the initial prediction characteristic of the question according to online representation prediction, fusing the characteristics of various attributes to obtain interactive characteristics, extracting knowledge state according to the initial prediction characteristic of the interactive characteristics and the question to obtain an implicit knowledge state, and refining the implicit knowledge state to obtain a model predicted value. The knowledge tracking method can give consideration to various learning characteristics and can more accurately predict the future learning condition of students.

title_en: Method and device for determining risk level, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for determining risk levels, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a decision matrix, determining a weight value of each criterion, establishing a risk matrix according to the weight value and the decision matrix, determining a distance between a target scheme and each alternative, determining a target scheme in a plurality of alternatives according to the distances, determining the risk level of the target scheme according to the risk matrix, and determining the risk level of the target scheme as the risk level of the target scheme, wherein matrix elements in the risk matrix are used for indicating whether each alternative belongs to each risk level or not.

title_en: Full-period benefit assessment method and system for biological detention pond
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-cycle benefit evaluation method and a full-cycle benefit evaluation system for a biological detention pond, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a biological detention experimental column according to structural parameters and internal layering conditions of the biological detention pond; obtaining the failure time of the biological detention pond according to the change of the permeability coefficient of the biological detention experimental column and the full-period operation benefit of the biological detention pond according to the failure time of the biological detention pond. According to the invention, a biological detention experimental column is established according to the biological detention pond, the relation between the osmotic coefficient change and the water inflow is obtained through experiments, the service life of the biological detention pond is estimated, and the full-period operation benefit of the biological detention pond is calculated. By the assessment method of the invention it is possible to determine whether the bioretention facility has economic benefits during its life cycle and whether an improved design or an optimized maintenance scheme is required.

title_en: Enterprise verification system, method, equipment and storage medium based on handwriting identity characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides an enterprise verification system, method, equipment and storage medium based on handwriting identity characteristics, wherein the method comprises the steps of verifying authenticity of an enterprise to be resident and an enterprise legal representative, obtaining handwriting biological characteristic information of the enterprise legal representative, generating handwriting characteristic IDs of the enterprise legal representative and an enterprise authorized person to complete enterprise resident, generating an authorization document signed by the enterprise legal representative and the enterprise authorized person, obtaining handwriting biological characteristic information of the enterprise authorized person, generating handwriting characteristic IDs of the enterprise authorized person to complete enterprise authorization, and comparing the handwriting biological characteristic information of the enterprise legal representative and the enterprise legal representative with the handwriting characteristic IDs of the enterprise authorized person in a signing process during enterprise verification to complete verification. The invention completes the enterprise authentication while signing or signing in the business handling process of each enterprise, can prevent the falsification risk of enterprise personnel, reduce the real-name authentication cost of the enterprise Internet, and ensure that the expression will is necessarily the legal representative or authorized management operator of the enterprise.

title_en: Estuary coastal wetland ecological vulnerability assessment method and model calculation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating ecological vulnerability of a estuary coastal wetland and a model computing system, which comprise the steps of obtaining vegetation coverage real-time data and satellite cloud layer real-time data through satellite monitoring, obtaining hydrologic real-time data and sediment real-time data through monitoring of an estuary coastal wetland ecology through surveying equipment, carrying out initialization setting on a preset estuary coastal wetland ecology coupling model according to the vegetation coverage real-time data, the satellite cloud layer real-time data, the hydrologic real-time data and the sediment real-time data, inputting water area reclamation data and pollutant emission data into the estuary coastal wetland ecology coupling model, carrying out landform dynamic deduction to obtain ecological landform information with set time by the estuary coastal wetland ecology coupling model, carrying out ecological vulnerability evaluation based on the ecological landform information, and comprehensively considering influence of human activities and hydrologic-hydrodynamic processes on the estuary coastal wetland ecology, and improving the prediction accuracy of the ecological vulnerability.

title_en: Food safety supervision system based on cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safety supervision, in particular to a food safety supervision system based on a cloud platform, which comprises an acquisition module, a control module and a control module, wherein the acquisition module acquires a packaged outline map and a target food form map; the packaging system comprises a contour map, a fit degree analysis module, a shaking risk analysis module, a packaging material evaluation module and a safety determination module, wherein the contour map is used for determining whether the fit degree and the edge distance of a target food are qualified according to the contour map and the form map, the fit degree of the target food and a package is determined based on the contour map and the edge distance, the shaking risk analysis module is used for detecting the package with qualified fit degree so as to obtain the deformation degree and the distribution condition of package folds in the transportation process and determine whether shaking risks are qualified, the packaging material evaluation module is used for performing migration test on the package with qualified shaking risks so as to evaluate the material safety of the package according to the migration condition of substances in the packaging material to the food, and the safety determination module is used for determining that the target food in the package is safe food according to the fit degree, the shaking risks and the material safety. Provides comprehensive guarantee for food safety.

title_en: CCER forestry carbon sink project development system based on artificial intelligence technology monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CCER forestry carbon sink project development system based on artificial intelligence technology monitoring, and relates to the technical field of carbon sink monitoring and optimization. According to the CCER forestry carbon sink project development system based on artificial intelligence technology monitoring, space-time estimation is carried out on CCER forestry carbon sink project data through a deep learning model, and dynamic changes of carbon sink quantity are accurately predicted. And extracting spatial characteristics through a convolutional neural network, and analyzing time sequence data by combining a long-term memory network to construct a carbon sink quantity prediction model. Through statistical analysis and a spatial interpolation algorithm, the carbon sink change is monitored in real time, abnormal trends are identified, and early warning is provided. Based on a mixed integer linear programming algorithm, the forest land resource allocation and vegetation types are optimized, a carbon sink optimization scheme is generated, and carbon sink benefit maximization is promoted. Through intelligent carbon assembly management scheme, sustainable ecological development of helping hand and green economy's popularization.

title_en: Time sequence simulation analysis method and system for urban area electric hydrogen coupling energy network
abstract_en: A time sequence simulation analysis method and a time sequence simulation analysis system for an electric hydrogen coupling micro-energy network in an urban area are provided, a time sequence simulation model of the electric hydrogen coupling micro-energy network is built, a time sequence simulation data set is formed by load simulation data, a wind power generation power predicted value, a photovoltaic power generation power predicted value, weather data of a wind power plant and weather data of a photovoltaic power station, the time sequence simulation model takes the time sequence simulation data set as input, after a supply and demand state of a power system and a supply and demand state of a hydrogen energy system are determined, a first type scheduling scheme of the electric hydrogen coupling micro-energy network in a set time period is formulated by taking the highest energy utilization efficiency as a target, a second type scheduling scheme of the electric hydrogen coupling micro-energy network in the set time period is formulated by taking the lowest running cost as a target, an optimal scheduling scheme of the electric hydrogen coupling micro-energy network in the set time period is determined by adopting an optimization algorithm according to the first type scheduling scheme and the second type scheduling scheme, and the optimal scheduling scheme of the electric hydrogen coupling micro-energy network in the set time period is improved.

title_en: Safety supervision system for full-period operation of power grid based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-period operation safety supervision system of a power grid based on artificial intelligence, which belongs to the field of power grid safety supervision and comprises the steps of collecting historical charge data and corresponding timestamp records, conducting preprocessing, dividing the obtained time sequence data into a training sample set and a verification sample set, obtaining an optimal prediction model by constructing a prediction model and conducting training and optimization evaluation, obtaining predicted charge data of the next time step by collecting real-time charge data and inputting the real-time charge data into the optimal prediction model, calculating charge change rate, comparing the charge change rate with a preset change threshold value, judging the charge data of the next time step as abnormal data or normal data, conducting fault type prediction on the abnormal data by utilizing a preset random forest model, periodically traversing fault records to obtain all fault types, setting power grid operation safety level, conducting risk assessment on power grid operation by calculating risk indexes, and obtaining the power grid operation safety level.

title_en: Operation and maintenance risk early warning method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an operation and maintenance risk early warning method, an operation and maintenance risk early warning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining first entity information of each owner system, second entity information of each reference system and third entity information; comparing the third entity information with the first entity information, generating a correlation topological graph according to the first entity information, the second entity information and the third entity information if each third entity information is successfully compared with any one of the first entity information, and determining other nodes connected with the variation nodes based on the correlation topological graph by taking the node corresponding to any one of the entities as the variation node and taking the entity corresponding to the other nodes as the risk early warning entity under the condition that any one of the entities is changed. Therefore, through the association topological graph of the overall view, the iterative optimization of the operation and maintenance association risk management is realized under the condition that the operation and maintenance is carried out from the own side without changing the owner system and the reference system, the operation and maintenance efficiency and reliability are greatly improved, and the operation and maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Monitoring and early warning method and system for engineering project synchronous prevention
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring and early warning method and a system for synchronous prevention of engineering projects, which belong to the technical field of engineering management, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining planning data of engineering projects, adjusting model parameters of a pre-built monitoring and early warning model based on the planning data, determining the monitoring and early warning model, and sampling period of engineering project progress data at each stage in the whole process of the engineering projects; and sampling the project progress data of each stage in the sampling period through the monitoring early warning model, judging whether the sampled project progress data meets a preset threshold, and sending early warning when the sampled project progress data is determined not to meet the preset threshold or not to be sampled to obtain the project progress data. The implementation of the invention can effectively monitor and manage the engineering project, thereby ensuring the effective construction of the engineering project.

title_en: Wind power prediction method and system based on dominant component analysis and IOOA-KELM
abstract_en: A wind power prediction method based on dominant component analysis and IOOA-KELM comprises the steps of obtaining wind power original data, decomposing a time sequence of wind power through ICEEMDAN to obtain a plurality of subsequences, extracting dominant components of the subsequences obtained through decomposition through SSA, overlapping residual errors of the subsequences, dividing the data obtained through extraction of the dominant components into a test set, a training set and a verification set, modifying an eagle optimization algorithm OOA through changing random initialization into logic chaos initialization, introducing a Levy flight strategy when updating a local development position, obtaining an improved eagle optimization algorithm IOOA, constructing KELM models, predicting all subsequences respectively, calibrating KELM model super parameters through an improved eagle optimization algorithm IOOA, obtaining optimal parameters of a IOOA-KELM prediction model, and overlapping prediction results of all subsequences to obtain a final wind power prediction result. The method solves the problem that the super-parameter selection of the prediction model of the nuclear extreme learning machine is difficult, and improves the precision of wind power prediction.

title_en: Address standardization method, device and equipment based on AC automaton
abstract_en: The application discloses an address standardization method, device and equipment based on an AC automaton, which comprises the steps of taking an address in a Chinese character form in an address standard library as a tree node in the construction process of the AC automaton, determining the level relation among tree nodes of Chinese characters, constructing a Chinese character tree structure, taking an address in a pinyin form in the address standard library as a tree node, determining the level relation among the tree nodes of pinyin, constructing a pinyin tree structure, responding to an address standardization instruction, acquiring an address to be standardized, which is input into the AC automaton, utilizing the AC automaton to be standardized, carrying out address matching by adopting a multi-mode matching algorithm based on the Chinese character tree structure and the pinyin tree structure, and obtaining the standardized address according to a matching result. Therefore, the problems that the traditional deep learning algorithm is limited by resources, the traditional matching algorithm searches according to character string matching, and the addresses cannot be well processed by the algorithms, such as different words and voices, are not well processed are solved.

title_en: Cloud platform-based underground water data intelligent processing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a cloud platform-based underground water data intelligent processing system. According to the invention, the historical average value and standard deviation of each detection point are calculated through real-time receiving and analyzing of the groundwater data, the data reference of the groundwater is identified, the deviation is identified in time through comparing the groundwater data with the set reference, the sensitivity and accuracy of anomaly detection are improved through comprehensively evaluating the duration time, the project number and the anomaly coverage range of the data deviation, the frequency and the strategy of data processing are automatically adjusted according to the data fluctuation and the anomaly record, the resource allocation is optimized, the unnecessary data processing burden is reduced, a more flexible and accurate management mode is provided by a dynamic adjustment mechanism, the sudden water quality problem can be effectively handled, the processing efficiency is improved, and the possibility of false alarm is reduced.

title_en: Method for monitoring ecological environmental effect of protective forest
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the ecological environmental effect of a protective forest, which relates to the technical field of ecological environmental monitoring and comprises the following steps of data acquisition, data processing, data analysis and result display, wherein the method comprehensively covers meteorological, soil and vegetation data in the protective forest and surrounding areas on the basis of data acquisition and provides a rich basis for accurate evaluation; the standardized data is obtained through preprocessing, the comparability and the analysis accuracy of the data are enhanced, and the long-term influence and the short-term dynamic are reflected by calculating the average value and the change rate of a plurality of time nodes. Comprehensive wind-proof sand-fixation coefficient, water-soil conservation coefficient and climate coefficient are synthesized to obtain an ecological effect comprehensive index, the ecological effect of the protective forest is comprehensively estimated by combining a preset weight value and a threshold value, and a display signal is transmitted to a monitoring center, so that relevant departments can know the situation in time and take measures. The method has great significance on the management and ecological protection of the protection forest, can discover problems in time, and guides scientific management and maintenance.

title_en: User loss cause identification method, device, equipment, storage medium and program
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program for identifying user loss reasons. The method comprises the steps of obtaining behavior characteristic data of a user, inputting the behavior characteristic data into a pre-trained fusion recognition model, determining characteristic weights corresponding to all behavior characteristics based on the behavior characteristic data through the fusion recognition model, calculating the average value of all the characteristic weights to obtain a loss coefficient of the user, determining that the user is a potential loss user when the loss coefficient is smaller than or equal to a preset loss threshold value, inputting the behavior characteristic data of the user into a pre-trained loss reason recognition model, carrying out clustering operation on the behavior characteristic data according to the characteristic types of the loss reasons, outputting probability values corresponding to a plurality of loss reasons, and determining the reason corresponding to the maximum probability value as the target loss reason of the user. Therefore, the method can accurately identify the potential loss user, and accurately predict the cause of the loss of the potential loss user.

title_en: Self-service toll collection method and terminal system based on intelligent interaction for toll station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-service toll collection method and a terminal system of a toll station based on intelligent interaction, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting the entering condition of a real-time vehicle, and carrying out identity verification and fee verification on the real-time vehicle based on the entering condition; the method comprises the steps of obtaining payment demands of an owner, determining a payment channel according to the payment demands, performing deduction operation on a real-time vehicle through the payment channel, collecting voice information of the owner in a payment process, extracting problem description features or request description features according to the voice information, activating a visual intercom function to realize video interaction between the owner and staff, determining whether the owner needs invoice demands, and if so, generating a payment electronic invoice through an applet and storing the payment electronic invoice into an applet ticket root of the owner. Any problems and requests of the vehicle owners in the payment process can be manually solved, and the charging efficiency and the passing efficiency are improved.

title_en: Active power distribution network optimization operation method and system containing distributed power supply
abstract_en: The method and the system for optimizing operation of the active power distribution network comprise the steps of establishing an active power optimization scheduling model of the active power distribution network with the minimum operation cost of the power distribution network as a target, establishing a reactive power optimization model of the active power distribution network with the minimum system loss as a target, establishing a double-layer optimization problem with the active power optimization scheduling model as a lower layer and the reactive power optimization model as an upper layer, and solving the layer optimization problem by adopting a particle swarm algorithm to obtain a scheduling plan of the active power distribution network. The invention obtains the optimal operation mode of the active power distribution network, thereby providing basis for the dispatching of the active power distribution network.

title_en: Working medium optimization method, system, medium and equipment for offshore high-temperature waste heat organic Rankine cycle power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of industrial waste heat utilization and discloses a working medium optimizing method, a system, a medium and equipment of an organic Rankine cycle power generation system by using marine high-temperature waste heat, wherein the method comprises the steps of preliminarily screening out an organic working medium suitable for the working condition of the marine high-temperature waste heat according to project heat source conditions by taking the technical index of preliminary screening of the organic working medium as the standard; the comprehensive evaluation method comprises the steps of establishing a hierarchical structure model, constructing a judgment matrix, checking consistency of the judgment matrix, calculating index weights, comprehensively grading and making decisions, analyzing environmental health of the organic working medium, evaluating safety and stability of the organic working medium, and screening out ORC system organic working medium suitable for special working conditions of an offshore platform. The invention realizes the selection of the organic working medium of the offshore high-temperature waste heat organic Rankine cycle power generation system, and improves the economic benefit and the safety stability of the power generation system.

title_en: Cross-border financial declaration data verification method and system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-border financial declaration data verification method and system based on a blockchain, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining data content and declaration parameters of cross-border financial declaration data to be verified; the method comprises the steps of selecting a target verification neural network from a plurality of candidate verification neural networks according to the declaration parameters and a preset parameter screening algorithm, pulling historical uplink data corresponding to data content from a target block chain according to the declaration parameters and a preset parameter association algorithm, inputting the data content and the historical uplink data into the target verification neural network to obtain a data verification result corresponding to the cross-border financial declaration data, wherein the data verification result is used for indicating authenticity and rationality corresponding to the cross-border financial declaration data. Therefore, the invention can more efficiently and accurately carry out data verification on cross-border financial declaration data, and reduces cost and errors caused by manpower.

title_en: Reel type sprinkler scheduling method for soil mechanical compaction and reduction
abstract_en: A reel type sprinkler dispatching method for soil mechanical compaction and reduction relates to the field of agricultural machinery dispatching. The problem that the influence of machines on soil compaction is not considered in the existing spray irrigation scheduling method is solved.
