The invention constructs the dispatching total objective function by the lowest dispatching cost of the reel type sprinkler and the highest satisfaction of the total compaction of the field, and makes the dispatching total objective function minimum according to the set constraint condition so as to carry out optimization solving, and allocates corresponding reel type sprinklers and service paths of the reel type sprinklers for each field corresponding to each water source point. The invention is mainly used for dispatching the reel type sprinkler.

title_en: Power plant production management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of equipment management, in particular to a power plant production management system, which can well realize the power plant equipment management by utilizing a plurality of sensors and a deep learning algorithm, and the algorithm of the invention can give out difficult expectations of equipment maintenance according to the equipment operation state and corresponding maintenance conditions related to the production system, the invention can enable maintenance staff to make specific maintenance difficulty assessment and corresponding maintenance intervals according to an algorithm formula, so that equipment updating can be planned in advance, equipment replacement and maintenance expectations can be made, equipment maintenance information can be updated regularly, and system operation stability can be ensured.

title_en: Transaction service processing method and device, program product and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transaction service processing method and device, a program product and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of financial science and technology or other related fields, wherein the processing method comprises the steps of constructing a preset number of transaction strategies for transaction services, carrying out preset times of return test on each transaction strategy to obtain a return test result corresponding to each return test, determining an input value of the transaction strategy based on a transaction difference value and the preset times, judging whether the transaction strategy is an effective transaction strategy based on the input value, determining transaction funds distributed for each effective transaction strategy based on the input value of each effective transaction strategy under the condition that the transaction strategy is judged to be the effective transaction strategy, and processing the transaction services based on each effective transaction strategy and the transaction funds corresponding to the effective transaction strategy. The invention solves the technical problem that the transaction service is easy to have income loss due to the fact that the transaction strategy of the transaction service cannot be effectively managed in the related technology.

title_en: Hotel intelligent room state monitoring method and monitoring system
abstract_en: The application discloses a hotel intelligent room state monitoring method and a monitoring system, which belong to the technical field of hotel room state monitoring, and comprise the steps that a data processing center receives first monitoring data and first authority data, confirms room state according to the first monitoring data and generates a personalized service library according to the first authority data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out standardized processing on first authority data, carrying out discretization processing on the first authority data, carrying out classified transmission, encrypting the first authority data after the discretization processing, establishing a privacy risk assessment model, and monitoring the whole data processing flow. In the implementation process of the technical scheme, by implementing the authority management mechanism, all data processing activities are ensured to be performed within the user authorization range, and meanwhile, the temporary storage identification is combined, so that the safety of user data in the storage and transmission processes is ensured, the requirements of continuously changing user requirements and privacy protection are met, and the overall intelligent level of hotel services is improved.

title_en: Intelligent online video teaching effect management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent online video teaching effect management system which comprises a self-adaptive capturing device, a multiple optimizing device, a target identifying device, an area storage mechanism, a visual judging mechanism and a warning triggering mechanism. The intelligent online video teaching effect management system is compact in structure and simple to operate.

title_en: Electronic medical record automation quality control system and method based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic medical record automation quality control system and method based on a large language model, comprising the steps of extracting medical record data from a medical information system and preprocessing the data; and carrying out deep semantic analysis on the medical text by using the large language model, and extracting key diagnosis and operation information. Semantic representation of medical terms is performed by fine tuning a pre-trained language model in combination with a multi-layer attentiveness mechanism. And constructing an ICD coding knowledge graph, and calculating semantic similarity between diagnostic terms and ICD coding terms in the electronic medical record by using an embedded vector technology to realize automatic matching. And according to the predefined quality control rule, automatically auditing the electronic medical record through the logic expression, and generating a quality control report and an improvement suggestion. And finally, visually displaying the quality control and the coding result and outputting a quality control report. The invention improves the efficiency and accuracy of the quality control of the electronic medical record and realizes the standardization and automation of the quality control work.

title_en: Advertisement space distribution method, device, equipment and medium based on time intersection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data popularization and discloses an advertisement space distribution method, device, equipment and medium based on time intersection, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting current advertisement information and scheduling advertisement information from a preset advertisement information database according to the name of the current advertisement; the method comprises the steps of carrying out strategy analysis on current advertisement information to obtain a current advertisement distribution strategy and obtaining a current advertisement distribution strategy time period, matching a current strategy advertisement pre-selling time period set corresponding to the current advertisement distribution strategy to calculate a current strategy effective time period, carrying out effective time calculation on the scheduling advertisement information according to a pre-selling configuration file to obtain a scheduling strategy effective time period, and carrying out advertisement space distribution according to the current strategy effective time period and the scheduling strategy effective time period. The invention can realize the switching of the advertisement space aiming at no sense and can improve the flexibility of the distribution of the advertisement space.

title_en: Information retrieval method oriented to high-end equipment fault maintenance scene and related equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an information retrieval method and related equipment for a high-end equipment fault maintenance scene. The method comprises the steps of responding to a query request which is input by a user and aims at fault maintenance of high-end equipment, carrying out vectorization processing on fault query fields in the query request, extracting fault description features based on vectorization processing results, determining global retrieval weight and local retrieval weight according to the fault description features, the current running state of the high-end equipment and historical running data, retrieving based on a global knowledge base according to the global retrieval weight and the fault description features to obtain a first retrieval result, retrieving based on the local knowledge base to obtain a second retrieval result according to the local retrieval weight and the first retrieval result, and generating a coherent information retrieval result based on the first retrieval result and the second retrieval result. The method has the advantages of improving the retrieval efficiency in the high-end equipment fault maintenance scene, and improving the retrieval accuracy and the comprehensiveness.

title_en: Rural intelligent energy area three-dimensional data acquisition method
abstract_en: The invention provides a rural intelligent energy area three-dimensional data acquisition method which comprises the steps of constructing a data acquisition sample set, constructing a gridding area set based on an energy facility position, iteratively processing the sample set by using an optimized data processing algorithm to generate a high-precision three-dimensional point cloud model, adjusting model weights and sample weights according to fitting errors during processing, updating weights and labels of the infrastructure sample set, obtaining a final three-dimensional data model by weighting and combining the three-dimensional point cloud models, analyzing a data set to be analyzed by using the model, and mapping data into the gridding area set so as to analyze the spatial positions and running states of energy facilities and infrastructures. The invention can improve the precision and management efficiency of rural energy area data acquisition.

title_en: Global scheduling system containing global riding information and data processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a global scheduling system containing global riding information and a data processing method, wherein the system comprises a global riding information server, a global scheduling system and a data processing system, wherein the global riding information server is used for acquiring information related to passengers on a line provided by the global scheduling system; the system comprises a global dispatching system, a mobile platform, a personal mobile terminal, a station passenger information terminal, a global dispatching system, a global riding information server and a station passenger information terminal, wherein the global dispatching system is used for receiving the response information of the station passenger information terminal, the mobile platform is communicated with the global dispatching system, the query information of the personal mobile terminal is sent to the global riding information server, and the response information is received and returned to the personal mobile terminal, the personal mobile terminal is used for sending the query information to the mobile platform and receiving the response information of the mobile platform, the station passenger information terminal is communicated with the global dispatching system, the query information is sent to the global riding information server, and the response information is received and displayed on a display interface of the station passenger information terminal. The information related to passengers on the line of the global dispatching system is directly provided to the global riding information subsystem, so that the problem that the riding information system data has delay and the overline data is difficult to process is fundamentally solved.

title_en: Quality inspection method and device for offline network customer service, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a quality inspection method and device for off-line network customer service, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining offline customer service data, identifying and extracting facial expressions from each image data, carrying out emotion analysis and keyword extraction on each voice dialogue data to obtain service items and voice emotion analysis, carrying out emotion analysis based on the facial expressions and the voice emotion analysis to obtain fusion emotion analysis, carrying out evaluation on the fusion emotion analysis to obtain a first evaluation score, carrying out evaluation on the service items by using preset evaluation standards to obtain a second evaluation score, carrying out fusion on the first evaluation score and the second evaluation score to obtain a machine quality inspection result, carrying out manual sampling inspection on each voice dialogue data and the image data to obtain a manual quality inspection result, carrying out fusion on the machine quality inspection result and the manual quality inspection result, obtaining a service quality inspection result based on the fusion result, and realizing accurate online network customer service quality inspection.

title_en: Parameterized modeling method and system for carriage of dump truck
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of dumpers, in particular to a parametric modeling method and system for a dumper carriage, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a vehicle running parameter, a carriage pressure parameter, a material attribute parameter and an operation environment parameter in a full load state; according to the vehicle running parameters and the carriage pressure parameters, the contact degree of the materials in the carriage and different areas in the carriage is estimated, according to the contact degree estimation result and combining the material attribute parameters and the operation environment parameters, the carriage sticking degree of the materials in different areas in the carriage is estimated, and according to the carriage sticking degree of the materials in different areas in the carriage, the carriage sticking area is identified and the carriage sticking prevention optimization is carried out on the carriage sticking prevention area. According to the application, through evaluating the material sticking degree of different areas in the carriage and pertinently adjusting the carriage design parameters of the easy sticking area, the anti-sticking performance and the dumping efficiency of the carriage are effectively improved.

title_en: Food safety tracing system and tracing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a food safety tracing system and a tracing method, which are characterized in that food safety tracing data is generated by analyzing original food data submitted by a node server, the food safety tracing data comprises a food relation chain, an encrypted data unit and a hash value of the encrypted data unit, an upstream node server and/or a downstream node server are determined according to the food relation chain, the hash values of the upstream relation unit and the encrypted data unit of the food relation chain are sent to the upstream node server, and/or the hash values of the downstream relation unit and the encrypted data unit of the food relation chain are sent to the downstream node server, and the hash values of the encrypted data unit, the hash values of the upstream relation unit and the hash value of the downstream encrypted data unit are sent to the node server submitting the original food data.

title_en: Control method and device for automatic flow, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a control method and device of an automatic process, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The control method of the automatic process comprises the steps of correspondingly distributing virtual consumable materials to each consumable material node in the automatic process, determining the virtual position of the virtual consumable materials, judging whether the current operation step in the automatic process corresponds to real consumable materials or not based on the operation step planned for each virtual consumable material in the automatic process, matching the real consumable materials according to the consumable material template corresponding to the virtual consumable materials of the current operation step if the current operation step does not correspond to the real consumable materials, replacing the virtual consumable materials with the matched real consumable materials, and executing the current operation step for the real consumable materials based on the virtual position of the virtual consumable materials. The method can flexibly adapt to the change of consumable use requirements and match with proper real consumable. This effectively avoids systematic errors, ensuring the smooth completion of each step in the automated process.

title_en: Method and system for rearranging travel transit scheme based on two-stage method
abstract_en: A method and a system for rearranging travel transit schemes based on a two-stage method relate to the field of intelligent travel. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of first travel transit schemes and corresponding fine-ranking scores after fine ranking, inputting the plurality of first travel transit schemes and corresponding fine-ranking scores into a preset sequence generation model to obtain a plurality of first ordered sequences, wherein the preset sequence generation model comprises a plurality of generation formula algorithms, each generation formula algorithm generates one or more first ordered sequences, inputting the plurality of first ordered sequences into a context-aware preset sequence evaluation model to determine a target ordered sequence with the highest exposure purchase rate score, and displaying the target ordered sequence. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the efficiency and satisfaction of the user for selecting the travel scheme are improved.

title_en: Lake pre-release time determining method and system based on short-term rainfall forecast
abstract_en: The invention provides a lake pre-release opportunity determining method and system based on short-term rainfall forecast, and relates to the technical field of urban flood control and drainage. The method comprises the steps of obtaining short-term rainfall forecast data, calculating hourly yield and sink flow based on the short-term rainfall forecast data, calculating total lake inflow amount according to the hourly flow meter before a set moment, calculating total lake outflow amount according to pump station design drainage flow, a water amount balance equation and the total lake inflow amount, determining total lake inflow amount, carrying out combined calculation by utilizing the water amount balance equation, the total lake inflow amount and the total lake outflow amount, and obtaining pump station starting moment, wherein the pump station starting moment is used for determining lake pre-leakage moment. The invention can dynamically optimize the pumping mode of the pump station in time, determine the pre-discharging time of the lake and improve the capability of coping with the urban heavy rainfall.

title_en: Agricultural insurance operation control method based on crop knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural insurance operation management and control method based on an agricultural crop knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps of S1) constructing an agricultural crop knowledge graph based on agricultural crop data, weather disaster data and disease and pest data, S2) integrating the knowledge graph data into a insurance claim-receiving process, S3) planting corresponding crops in an area where an insurance policy is located through the agricultural crop knowledge graph in an insurance-receiving link, checking whether the crops are subjected to insurance before a seedling emergence period, grading the insurance policy by the aid of the current agricultural insurance score of the area so as to determine a check-up risk level, S4) checking whether the weather disaster data and/or the pest data of the area are subjected to claim-receiving corresponding disaster in the claim-receiving link, and finally determining whether the claim-receiving proportion is reasonable according to the growth period data and the term setting. The agricultural insurance operation management and control method based on the crop knowledge graph provided by the invention can finely manage and control the insurance claim in a multi-dimensional and scientific way.

title_en: Real-time modification control method, device, equipment and medium applied to cloud printing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cloud printing, and particularly discloses a real-time modification control method, device, equipment and medium applied to cloud printing, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a printing stage according to a printing progress based on a modification request sent by a user side; if the target order is in the printing stage of incomplete printing, suspending the current printing task; the method fully considers the real-time modification requirement in the cloud printing process, realizes the real-time modification of the printing content, meets the requirement of flexible modification of a user, protects the benefit of a merchant through reasonable bill adjustment, and realizes the balance of user experience and benefit of the merchant.

title_en: Patent tree and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of patent data management, in particular to a patent tree and a construction method thereof, comprising the following steps: based on patent text data, technical features in the patent text are analyzed, and the technical features of each patent are classified and integrated to obtain a patent technical feature set. In the invention, accurate positioning of the technical elements of the patent is realized through intelligent information extraction and semantic analysis, and the deep semantic analysis of verbs and noun phrases is combined, so that the technical targets and the realization modes of the patent are carefully extracted, and the functions of the technical targets and the realization modes are decomposed and integrated, so that the core content of the patent is presented in a clear and structured mode. Further, technical features are integrated in a segmented mode according to time nodes and application fields, historical dependent features are identified by combining fluctuation feature analysis of a time sequence, and the development state of a patent technology can be effectively predicted. The patent can be precisely grouped and analyzed through the combination of the field-crossing characteristics through the characteristic matching and the similarity calculation.

title_en: Electronic recruitment matching method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic recruitment matching method and system based on the Internet of things, which relate to the technical field of electronic recruitment, wherein the invention analyzes the recruitment quality of target enterprise recruitment when the target enterprise recruits, provides upgrade service for the target enterprise when the recruitment quality of the target enterprise recruitment is lower, then provides the target enterprise with the upgrade service according to the matching condition between the target job seeker and each competing enterprise when the target job seeker is matched with the target enterprise during subsequent recruitment, the recommendation frequency of the target enterprise on the target job seeker side is increased, a targeted recommendation scheme on the job seeker side is provided for the target enterprise, the exposure of the target enterprise on the target job seeker side is increased, the competitiveness and the attraction of the target enterprise are increased, and therefore the probability of the enterprise to recruit preferentially is improved, a foundation is provided for the enterprise to recruit high-quality job seekers, the recruitment quality of the enterprise is guaranteed, the probability of competing the enterprise to recruit the high-quality job seeker is reduced, and the comprehensive strength of the enterprise is improved.

title_en: Method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product for page rendering
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide methods, apparatus, devices, storage media, and program products for page rendering. The method includes presenting a target page associated with a target user, the target page including a plurality of navigation tags configured to navigate to corresponding pages and the plurality of navigation tags including at least a first navigation tag corresponding to a live broadcast of the target user, and responsive to the first navigation tag being selected, presenting a live broadcast interface of the live broadcast in a first page corresponding to the first navigation tag based on determining that the target user is in a live broadcast state, or presenting first direct broadcast information associated with the target user in the first page corresponding to the first navigation tag based on determining that the target user is not in a live broadcast state. Thus, the user experience of the user can be improved.

title_en: Data report generation method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a data report generation method, a data report generation device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining N data reports in a target time period, wherein the N data reports are tables for recording transaction data of a target product based on N recording angles, N is a natural number greater than 1, performing data processing operation on the N data reports to obtain the target data table, the data processing operation sequentially comprises data integration operation, data verification operation, data cleaning operation and data format conversion operation, and generating the data report of the target product according to the target data table, wherein the data report is used for representing transaction risk change of the target product in the target time period. The application solves the problem that the data report cannot be accurately generated in the related technology, and achieves the effect of accurately generating the data report.

title_en: Wear-resisting performance optimization method and system for rubber transmission belt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimizing wear resistance of a rubber transmission belt, and relates to the technical field of transmission belts. The method comprises the steps of collecting a material history transmission log meeting a service life threshold, configuring a cover rubber abrasion thickness prediction version model, obtaining a material transmission scheme, based on the failure abrasion thickness of the cover rubber of a transmission belt, calling the cover rubber abrasion thickness prediction version model, analyzing abrasion resistance times to obtain transmission prediction times, and adjusting a material set temperature, a blanking set height and a material set weight when the transmission prediction times are smaller than or equal to the transmission times threshold to obtain an optimized material transmission scheme for transmission control. The technical problem that the abrasion degree of the conveying belt caused by the materials is difficult to quantitatively analyze in the prior art, so that the specifications of the materials which can be borne cannot be accurately determined is solved, the material conveying scheme is optimized through data analysis and model prediction, the excessively rapid abrasion of the conveying belt is avoided, and the technical effect of prolonging the service life of the conveying belt is achieved.

title_en: Model training method, device and power load prediction method
abstract_en: The application discloses a model training method, a model training device and a power load prediction method. The model training method comprises the steps of obtaining power load data, carrying out decomposition processing on the power load data in a training set to obtain a plurality of IMF components, carrying out combination and superposition processing on the IMF components to obtain a plurality of target IMF components, updating model parameters in a neural network model to obtain a target neural network model, predicting the target IMF components by using the target neural network model to obtain a plurality of prediction results, carrying out fusion processing on the plurality of prediction results to obtain a target prediction result corresponding to the power load data, determining an error between the target prediction result and a test set, and determining that the neural network model completes training under the condition that the error is smaller than a preset threshold value. The application solves the technical problem of lower prediction accuracy of the power load in the related technology.

title_en: Process flow reconstruction method for flexible operation mode of assembly workshop
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reconstruction method of a reconfigurable technological process of a production process flow in a final assembly workshop, which solves the problems that a flexible reconfigurable design scheme of the production process workshop of final assembly production ignores the flexible design of a specific technological execution process, and a method for realizing reconstruction response of a production execution rationalized process by depending on the existing resources of the flexible reconfigurable production workshop is unavailable. The method comprises the steps of carrying out detailed investigation and analysis according to a final assembly workshop process execution design, carrying out modularized design on a product process, guiding the product process into production management and control of a digital management and control platform, dividing logic relations among different modules in the final assembly process modularized design scheme, establishing a process knowledge base platform, designing a final assembly production sequence according to a product three-dimensional design model, dividing a process execution level, a material alignment sleeve scheme, an equipment tool scheme, personnel configuration and the like according to the sequence relation in the final assembly process modularized design scheme, and forming a basic assembly process scheme matched with production conditions. The invention is efficient and stable, and improves the flexible control level of the workshop in the final assembly production process.

title_en: Data visualization method, system and medium suitable for digital processing workshop
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a data visualization method, a system and a medium suitable for a digital processing workshop, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining sea cucumber daily output sequences and sea cucumber daily raw material supply sequences in a preset time period; the method comprises the steps of determining a daily raw material supply characteristic value and a sea cucumber daily yield characteristic value, determining a neighborhood radius in a clustering algorithm, correcting the neighborhood radius according to a Pearson correlation coefficient between a sea cucumber daily yield sequence and a sea cucumber daily raw material supply sequence to obtain a corrected neighborhood radius, clustering positions of a characteristic group in a coordinate system based on the corrected neighborhood radius to obtain a plurality of clusters, determining a data amount of a unit scale of a visual coordinate system, and visually displaying sea cucumber yield based on a visual map formed by the data amount of the unit scale, a sea cucumber daily yield maximum value, a sea cucumber daily yield minimum value and the number of scales. Therefore, the invention improves the accuracy of evaluating the increase and decrease of the sea cucumber yield.

title_en: Coal mining data management system and method based on video artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mining data management system and method based on video artificial intelligence, which relate to the field of big data, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for accessing video data of each scene of a coal mine; the system comprises a device and personnel identification module, an analysis module, an information selection module, a comprehensive management module, a control linkage protection module and a user interface module, wherein the device and personnel identification module is used for identifying devices and personnel, the analysis module is used for realizing artificial intelligent scene analysis, the information selection module is used for obtaining selected characteristic scene data, the comprehensive management module is used for realizing resource sharing and information intercommunication, the control linkage protection module is used for realizing intelligent linkage, and the user interface module is used for providing an operation interface. The invention can accurately identify and understand key elements and dynamic changes thereof in the coal mining scene, and more intuitively display and analyze the fusion condition of virtual reality and real scene.

title_en: Regenerated material intelligent classification and identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image recognition, in particular to an intelligent classification recognition method and system for regenerated materials. Dividing the garbage area into a first material garbage area and a second material garbage area according to the identification result of the material coding identification. The first membership degree can be obtained by comparing the contour similarity between the second material garbage region and the first material garbage region of each material class. And comparing the first similarity between the representative garbage area and the second material garbage area under different appearance dimensions, and obtaining the second membership degree through comparing the weight and the first similarity. A random forest decision tree model can be constructed based on the first membership degree and the second membership degree, and decision conditions in the decision tree can be continuously adjusted according to the classification error rate of training results in the training process. The invention combines image recognition and machine learning, and obtains accurate material classification results from the trained random forest decision tree model.

title_en: Energy storage system optimization method and system based on benefit analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power energy storage system optimization, and discloses an energy storage system optimization method and system based on benefit analysis, wherein the energy storage system optimization method based on benefit analysis comprises the steps of setting adaptability factors of different types of energy storage systems based on power distribution network load data, running conditions and basic performance data of the energy storage system; the method comprises the steps of taking full life cycle economic benefit optimization as an optimization target, constructing a benefit analysis objective function, establishing a constraint condition set according to power balance, energy storage system charge and discharge power limit, life cycle limit and safe operation constraint, constructing a full life cycle economic benefit model based on the benefit analysis objective function and the constraint condition set, and solving the full life cycle economic benefit model by utilizing a plurality of group genetic algorithms to obtain an optimal configuration scheme of different types of energy storage systems. The method is used for optimizing the configuration of the energy storage system in the regional power distribution network, can reduce the economic cost and improve the energy utilization efficiency.

title_en: Simulation analysis and optimization method for AGV logistics distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation analysis and optimization method for AGV logistics distribution, and belongs to the technical field of electric core wire AGV logistics distribution in the lithium battery industry. The method comprises the steps of collecting basic data, building an electric core AGV logistics distribution simulation model, outputting quantized simulation data, rapidly verifying an AGV logistics planning scheme and optimizing the AGV logistics planning scheme, wherein the electric core AGV logistics distribution simulation model is built to serve as a mode for simulating project implementation, the quantized data and a visual interaction model are simulated according to the planning scheme, the rationality of the AGV logistics planning scheme is rapidly verified, risks can be rapidly identified before project implementation is carried out, the AGV logistics scheme is optimized, project safe and efficient implementation is facilitated, and therefore planning cost is reduced.

title_en: Semi-empirical hybrid high-speed service area consumption prediction method and related device
abstract_en: The invention provides a semi-empirical hybrid high-speed service area consumption prediction method and a related device, and relates to the technical field of energy management. The method is used for predicting the energy consumption and the water consumption of the expressway service area through a traffic data analysis-based method. By combining vehicle flow data, time information and specific vehicle type statistics, the energy and water resource consumption of the service area at different times and under different conditions is accurately predicted through a series of calculation models.

title_en: Method and device for transmitting three-dimensional data of process pipeline
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for transmitting three-dimensional data of a process pipeline, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a three-dimensional data intermediate file of the process pipeline; the method comprises the steps of carrying out data analysis on the three-dimensional data intermediate file to generate pipeline information, material information and weld junction information, carrying out automatic batching according to the pipeline information and the material information, carrying out automatic welding on a prefabricated production line according to batching results, carrying out construction according to installation information in the pipeline information and preset construction information, and visually displaying a construction plan, a construction progress and a construction state. The method solves the problems of unsmooth data flow and information island generation in the existing construction process, realizes information sharing of all links, and realizes construction production automation, management informatization and production visualization.

title_en: Digital analysis method and system for farmland soil data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a farmland soil data digital analysis method and system, which comprise the steps of obtaining farmland images, dividing the images into different planting areas according to plants, dividing the images of the different planting areas into a plurality of subareas based on the images of the different planting areas, obtaining soil samples in each subarea, analyzing the samples to obtain soil fertility in each subarea, obtaining soil fertility change conditions based on soil fertility of different time nodes in each subarea, and comprehensively evaluating and analyzing the soil fertility change conditions of the planting areas based on the soil fertility change conditions in each subarea. The method has the advantages that accurate monitoring and dynamic tracking of farmland soil fertility are realized through image analysis and soil sample acquisition, and scientific decision support is provided for agricultural production. By analyzing the soil fertility change trend, the fertilization scheme is helped to be optimized, the land utilization efficiency is improved, and sustainable agriculture development is promoted.

title_en: Scheduling management method and system based on ocean emergency plan
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean safety, in particular to a scheduling management method and system based on an ocean emergency plan, comprising the following steps: based on the emergency processing request information, marine accident information is analyzed, text content is extracted, a plurality of keywords are detected, the types of accidents are identified by analyzing the combination and the context relation of the plurality of keywords, and accident type identification information is generated. According to the invention, through accident type identification and combination of offshore environment conditions and accident types, accurate matching of the emergency plan is realized, resources are ensured to be effectively utilized in the most needed places, the capability of handling sudden marine accidents is improved, the execution process of the emergency plan is recorded in real time, the execution efficiency is scored, the traceability of the emergency response process is optimized, a data basis is provided for subsequent optimization, the response speed and quality to the marine accidents are improved through analyzing and optimizing the emergency plan, and the damage to the marine safety accidents is effectively reduced.

title_en: Multi-agent-based mobile vehicle scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of scheduling management, and provides a mobile vehicle scheduling method and system based on multiple intelligent agents. According to the invention, the goods taking monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle, the goods placing monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle and the plurality of mobile carrying forklifts are selected, inspection monitoring data are received, the basic carrying route is optimized, the plurality of mobile carrying forklifts are subjected to transportation scheduling control, the target goods taking forklift and the target goods placing forklift are selected to be subjected to goods taking scheduling control, and accumulated risk analysis and risk scheduling processing are performed. The system can carry out inspection monitoring, goods taking position monitoring and goods placing position monitoring through the goods taking monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle and the goods placing monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle, and then carry out route optimization, so that transportation dispatching control, goods taking and placing dispatching control, accumulated risk analysis and risk dispatching treatment are carried out on a plurality of mobile carrying forklifts, intelligent configuration of each forklift is not required to be enhanced, application cost is effectively reduced, management efficiency and response speed of forklift dispatching can be guaranteed, and popularization and application are facilitated.

title_en: Detail prediction method and device suitable for retail industry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detail prediction method and device suitable for the retail industry, which are used for solving the technical problems that currently adopted detail prediction means model is insufficient in generalization capability and unreasonable in feature selection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical fine sales data set, carrying out feature dimension reduction and screening on the historical fine sales data set to obtain a feature enhancement data set, carrying out fine prediction training on a random forest model constructed in advance by adopting the feature enhancement data set and combining linear regression to obtain a fine prediction model, obtaining fine sales data to be detected, and inputting the fine sales data to be detected into the fine prediction model to carry out fine prediction to obtain a fine prediction result. Therefore, through feature dimension reduction screening, more reasonable and reference features can be selected, and the feature dimension reduction screening is combined with a random forest algorithm and linear regression to perform detail prediction training, so that the generalization capability of the model can be further improved, and the accuracy of detail prediction can be improved in the follow-up practical application.

title_en: Construction engineering quality monitoring and supervision platform and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction engineering quality monitoring and supervising platform and method, comprising a data acquisition module, a data transmission module, a data processing and analyzing module, a supervising module, a decision support module and a user management module. The construction engineering quality monitoring and supervising platform and method can acquire various quality data of a construction site in real time through the intelligent sensor and the data acquisition equipment, ensure the timeliness of monitoring, automatically process and analyze a large amount of data by utilizing an advanced artificial intelligent algorithm, effectively identify potential quality problems and early warn in advance, monitor engineering quality at any time and any place through multiparty supervision and data sharing of the platform, greatly improve supervising efficiency, reduce the dependence of traditional manual inspection, reduce the risk of human errors and omission, and help a decision maker to make scientific and accurate quality management decisions through big data analysis by the platform, thereby improving the quality control level of a construction process.

title_en: IT asset health assessment method, system, device and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an IT asset health evaluation method, a system, equipment and a computer storage medium, relating to the technical field of asset security, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring asset data of IT assets and carrying out standardized processing; the method comprises the steps of respectively calculating protection attribute weight, business attribute weight, compliance score, risk attribute score and attack attribute score according to the conditions of the protection index, business index, compliance index, risk index and attack index, calculating asset health, wherein a calculation formula for asset health assessment is that asset health = total score-business attribute weight is the risk attribute score-attack attribute score-compliance score, and the asset health condition is assessed based on the score of the asset health.

title_en: Electric power system dynamic optimization method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system dynamic optimization method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining a topological structure and a device state of a power system, obtaining a random power flow equation through calculating a steady state condition, designing a reward mechanism according to the random power flow equation, training the mechanism through reinforcement learning to generate a scheduling strategy of the power system, verifying the scheduling strategy through a power system simulation platform, and dynamically optimizing the reward mechanism to reduce the probability of illegal operation.

title_en: Transport vehicle reservation management scheduling system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transportation vehicle reservation management scheduling system and method based on the Internet of things, and belongs to the technical field of transportation management. According to the invention, through intelligent scheduling optimization and task matching, the scheduling efficiency of transport vehicles is improved, the empty rate and resource waste are reduced, the optimal driving path and scheduling scheme are generated based on real-time acquired vehicle state information, historical transportation data and current road traffic conditions, the most suitable vehicles can be automatically matched, the transport tasks can be ensured to be completed in the shortest time and high efficiency, users can accurately reserve transport resources, the resource idling is reduced, the overall transport efficiency is improved, the running states of the vehicles are acquired in real time through the Internet of things technology, intelligent matching is performed in combination with task demands, the vehicles most suitable for executing the tasks are screened out based on the transport demands, the matching scheme is optimized, the accuracy and rationality of task allocation are ensured, automatic and accurate task matching can be realized, and the execution success rate of the transport tasks is improved.

title_en: Optimal scheduling method, system, equipment and medium based on micro-grid active support
abstract_en: The application discloses an optimal scheduling method, system, equipment and medium based on micro-grid active support, which are used for obtaining a plurality of target source load prediction error scenes, scene probabilities and net load scenes through sampling, calculating power requirements of active support on a grid side based on frequency variation on the grid side, constructing a first evaluation equation of the power requirements of the active support of the micro-grid based on the scene probabilities, the power requirements of the active support on the grid side and inertia support forms of the micro-grid, constructing an optimal scheduling model of the micro-grid based on scheduling cost equations and risk cost equations constructed according to loss costs, circulating energy costs and the first evaluation equation in the scheduling process of the micro-grid by taking the plurality of net load scenes as constraint conditions, and obtaining an active supporting scheduling scheme of the micro-grid based on the optimal scheduling model of the micro-grid. The method provided by the application fully considers and utilizes the active supporting frequency of the micro-grid, obviously enhances the frequency response capability of the power distribution network, and improves the operation efficiency and stability of the power distribution network.

title_en: Water conservancy water regime monitoring management system based on big dipper short message communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water conservancy water condition monitoring management system based on Beidou short message communication, and relates to the technical field of water condition monitoring. The scheduling module determines a transmission queue by marking the water level state, calculating various scores and correction parameters, and implements a preemption mechanism and silence period setting optimization transmission; the invention effectively realizes the monitoring and management of water conservancy water conditions, has obvious advantages in the aspects of data transmission, processing, early warning and the like, improves the accuracy and timeliness of water condition monitoring and provides powerful support for water conservancy management.

title_en: Multi-terrain factor-based terrain gradient effect evaluation method, computer system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of land utilization change evaluation, in particular to a terrain gradient effect evaluation method based on multiple terrain factors, a computer system and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps of determining elevation values, gradient values and topography fluctuation degrees under an optimal statistical unit of the land to be evaluated, and distribution indexes corresponding to land types in the land to be evaluated, and determining topography gradient effect evaluation results of the land to be evaluated based on at least one of the elevation values, the gradient values, the topography fluctuation degrees and the distribution indexes. The method aims at solving the problem of how to eliminate the evaluation influence of the difference of the terrain section and the land utilization area on the terrain gradient effect.

title_en: Dynamic optimal configuration method for ecological restoration plants in acid mine waste land
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic optimal configuration method for ecologically restoring plants in an acid mine abandoned land, which relates to the field of ecological restoration, and comprises the following steps of 1, collecting soil attribute data in a preset range of the acid mine abandoned land in a dot shape, synchronously obtaining growth attribute data of plants to be selected and periodic weather data of a target area, 2, extracting a degradation characteristic set with a degradation effect on plant growth based on the soil attribute data, analyzing the bioremediation characteristic set capable of inhibiting the degradation characteristic in the plant attribute data to generate a candidate plant set, and 3, constructing a dynamic environment simulation model based on a deep learning algorithm, wherein the input dimension comprises weather data time sequence characteristics, soil degradation characteristic vectors and plant bioremediation characteristic matrixes, accurately predicting the restoration effect of the plants under different climates and soil conditions, simulating the effect of different intervention measures in real time, outputting an optimal intervention scheme, and guaranteeing balance of resource utilization efficiency and restoration effect.

title_en: Material demand planning method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of material demand planning, and particularly discloses a method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for material demand planning, which comprise the steps of establishing a bill of materials, and obtaining the net demand of each material based on the bill of materials in the same demand day; responding to the substitution relation of materials as incomplete substitution, splitting initial wool demands of substituted materials in a bill of materials, determining the net demand of the substituted materials based on the available stock of the substituted materials, selecting the materials with the minimum net demand, splitting the materials according to the minimum wool demands and the minimum values in the available stock to enable the net demand to be zero, supplementing the residual wool demands of the demand items corresponding to the materials by the substituted materials of the materials, updating the bill of materials, repeating the process until all the substituted materials are split, and finally generating the final net demand according to the original demand materials. The method can accurately calculate the available amount of the substitute material and avoid the accumulation of unnecessary stock.

title_en: Transaction analysis method in blockchain system and blockchain node
abstract_en: A transaction analysis method in a blockchain system is characterized in that contract states of intelligent contracts deployed in the blockchain system are divided into a plurality of data objects, the plurality of data objects have different storage positions in a data storage system, the blockchain system comprises a plurality of APIs for accessing the plurality of data objects, an objective function in the intelligent contracts expected to be called by a first transaction is determined, a plurality of objective APIs called in the objective function are determined, an analysis result is determined according to the first transaction, the plurality of objective APIs and access types corresponding to the plurality of objective APIs, the analysis result is used for judging whether read-write conflict exists between the first transaction and other transactions, the analysis result comprises a plurality of grouping keys and access types corresponding to the grouping keys, the grouping keys comprise contract addresses of the intelligent contracts, and the first transaction indicates identification information of the plurality of data objects accessed through the plurality of objective APIs, and the access types corresponding to the contract addresses are read.

title_en: Power grid load increment prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a power grid load increment prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium. According to the method and the device, the daily increment of the power grid load is predicted according to the human comfort level, the human comfort level change rule and the maximum load value change rule of the power grid in the area where the power grid is located, so that the prediction difficulty of the power grid load increment can be greatly reduced, and the accuracy of the power grid load increment prediction is improved.

title_en: Full-period management method for section steel concrete member based on industrial big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-period management method for a section steel concrete member based on industrial big data, which comprises the steps of building a member model through BIM modeling software, combining finite element buckling analysis to screen a buckling-easy region, setting buckling monitoring points on the surface of an analysis plate body and setting plate body monitoring points on the spliced edge, extracting model coordinate data to generate processing parameters to guide plate cutting and monitoring point marking, obtaining actual coordinates of each monitoring point in the section steel member through laser scanning and comparing the actual coordinates with the model coordinates, triggering rework when errors exceed the limits, building a neural network model, inputting each parameter related to buckling of the analysis plate body to obtain an out-of-plane displacement value of the buckling monitoring point and judging compliance, and acquiring final deformation data for model iterative optimization after site construction.

title_en: Method for dispatching escalator passenger car for aviation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a passenger elevator car scheduling method for aviation, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent airports and comprises the steps of obtaining flight arrival information in a future time period T, calculating the number Ni of passenger elevator cars required by each time subinterval Ti according to flight arrival time, sequencing the operation priorities of the passenger elevator cars according to the current residual quantity Q of each passenger elevator car, wherein the higher the current residual quantity Q is, the higher the operation priority is, selecting the passenger elevator car which can finish charging in the time period T as a candidate passenger elevator car based on the current residual quantity Q, and carrying out charging operation from the candidate passenger elevator car according to the order of the residual quantity Q from high to low. By the scheme of the embodiment of the disclosure, the service interruption of the machine connection can be prevented.

title_en: Remote check-in method, system and storage medium based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote check-in method, a remote check-in system and a storage medium based on a large language model, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting check-in interaction information into a pre-trained large predictive model for semantic analysis to obtain interaction semantics; the method comprises the steps of carrying out interaction feedback on a user according to interaction semantics, determining the check-in preference according to historical check-in information if the interaction semantics comprise preset remote check-in semantics, determining check-in recommendation information according to the check-in preference, a trip destination and check-in requirements, carrying out remote check-in recommendation on the user by the check-in recommendation information, and carrying out remote check-in on the user according to the remote check-in recommendation. According to the embodiment of the invention, the remote check-in recommendation can be effectively performed on the basis of the check-in habit of the user through the check-in recommendation information, so that the remote check-in operation of the user is effectively facilitated, and the use experience of the user is improved.

title_en: Multidimensional tax data analysis and prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multidimensional tax data analysis and prediction method, which relates to a data processing technology and comprises the steps of extracting tax identity information of corresponding asset tax chains and taking the tax identity information as a first specific chain if a first specific node meets a combination condition, screening a second specific chain corresponding to the tax identity information in a tax database based on the tax identity information, extracting a second specific node in the second specific chain, combining the first specific node and the second specific node into a combined chain if the first specific node and the second specific node correspond to each other, then storing the combined chain in a tax database, and decomposing the combined chain based on the first specific node of a history, the second specific node of the history and the current third specific node to obtain at least one verification segment if any third specific node exists in the combined chain, and analyzing time dimension and value dimension of the verification segment to determine an analysis target end. The invention can realize the efficient extraction, combination and analysis of the asset data and predict the potential tax risk.

title_en: Chinese herbal medicine false discrimination method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-mode large model
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, a system, a device and a medium for identifying the false of Chinese herbal medicine based on a multi-mode large model, which belong to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to target multi-mode data as image data, and performing registration processing on the image data based on space matching to obtain multi-type space registration image data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out pixel normalization processing on the basis of multi-class spatial registration image data to obtain multi-class consistent image data, responding to target multi-mode data as text data, carrying out standardization processing on the text data to obtain multi-class consistent text data, taking the multi-class consistent image data and the multi-class consistent text data as target consistent multi-mode data, and inputting the target consistent multi-mode data into a target multi-mode large model to obtain a quality identification result of target Chinese herbal medicines. The method and the device can improve the discrimination capability under the condition of small samples, thereby improving the accuracy of false discrimination.

title_en: Park environment monitoring system and method based on Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of campus supervision, in particular to a system and a method for monitoring a campus environment based on the technology of the Internet of things, wherein the system comprises a monitoring point distribution capturing module, a distribution performance evaluation module, an Internet of things perception acquisition module, a parameter comparison analysis module, a campus environment management and control decision module and an application display management module; according to the invention, the distribution performance evaluation module is used for carrying out distribution performance evaluation analysis on all monitoring points in the park based on the positions of all monitoring points in the park, the monitoring points in the park are adjusted when the distribution alarm signal is generated, effective monitoring on the environment in the park is realized, the environment parameter data of all the monitoring points in the park are collected and compared, corresponding environment improvement measures are timely made, the park environment management and control performance is comprehensively analyzed through the park environment management and control decision module, the supervision on the park environment is enhanced when the management and control alarm signal is generated, the park environment safety is ensured, and the management difficulty of the park environment is remarkably reduced.

title_en: Method and system for efficiently expanding service object attribute of multi-business state middle station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for efficiently expanding the attribute of a business object of a multi-business state middle platform, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a flattened multi-module middle platform field object design; scanning and collecting service object definition based on dependency relation, reading description object expansion relation file set to screen expansion relation, splitting service object set with expansion relation and service object set without expansion relation, merging the former and de-duplication attribute definition, outputting service object complete definition, and not processing the latter. According to the invention, the modularized disassembly and assembly recombination thinking of the business object attributes are combined with the flattened expansion design method, so that the middle platform system can easily cope with the multiple requirements of adding, adjusting, even rejecting and the like of the new business attributes, thereby being capable of rapidly responding to market changes, powerfully supporting and enabling diversified business scenes.

title_en: Short-term wind power prediction method for dynamic time sequence fusion of multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention provides a short-term wind power prediction method for dynamic time sequence fusion of multi-source heterogeneous data, which comprises the steps of reading multi-source data, preprocessing, extracting time sequence characteristics, constructing a unified characteristic representation space by using a resistive hash generator, performing disturbance immune training and projection diversity regularization processing, integrating physical rules and data distribution characteristics of a wind power system into an enhanced hash code set, performing constraint projection and distribution calibration, constructing a heterogeneous relation diagram based on the processed hash code, correcting by using historical similar condition data, and performing short-term wind power prediction by using GCN on the dynamic fusion relation diagram. The method remarkably improves the prediction precision and the robustness, and particularly reduces the prediction error by about 50% under extreme meteorological conditions.

title_en: Greenhouse plant remote disease collaborative diagnosis method and system based on cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent agriculture, and relates to a cloud platform-based greenhouse plant remote disease collaborative diagnosis method and a cloud platform-based greenhouse plant remote disease collaborative diagnosis system, wherein the cloud platform-based greenhouse plant remote disease collaborative diagnosis method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time image data of greenhouse plants, and eliminating image shielding interference to form enhanced visual data; generating a preliminary disease characteristic judgment result, automatically triggering a plant surface sampling device to collect trace tissue fluid for rapid biological detection, acquiring pathological judgment evidence by identifying a pathogen characteristic molecular identifier through biological detection, carrying out dynamic weighted calculation by combining the illumination accumulation amount and the moisture absorption curve of the plant history growth period to obtain a comprehensive diagnosis conclusion, monitoring a pesticide spraying path in real time through a motion sensor arranged on spraying equipment to judge the matching degree of an actual execution motion and a guiding scheme, and carrying out self-adaptive adjustment on monitoring parameters of other plants in a region according to a deviation type to form a dynamic protection strategy. The invention solves the problem of pesticide waste caused by equipment calibration errors or manual misoperation in actual execution.

title_en: Weighted address selection method based on maximum coverage algorithm and all-in-one machine thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a weighted address selection method based on a maximum coverage algorithm and an integrated machine thereof, and relates to the technical field of material distribution network processing, comprising the following steps of S1, defining a demand point set and weights thereof, wherein the weights reflect the importance degree or the demand quantity of demand points; and determining available library station sets and material limiting conditions, and defining a material demand point set and a candidate library station position set, wherein the material demand point set is D [ i ] = {1,2, & gt, N }, and each demand point i has a certain material demand. The scheme is clear and visual, can combine emergency guarantee tasks, integrates factors such as road conditions, geographical environments, safety and the like which influence the guarantee effect into a maximum coverage algorithm, flexibly configures the priority and the weight of each influencing factor, ensures that the method is more accurate in calculation, ensures that the result meets the actual needs more and improves the accuracy and the usability of the method. When the method is applied to more emergency fields, the method has flexibility for multiple fields.

title_en: Electric power spot market unbalanced cost compensation allocation method under different modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compensation and allocation method for unbalanced cost of an electric power spot market under different modes, and relates to the technical field of electric power markets. The method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining power compensation data of each area of a power spot market in different modes, S2, constructing a weight function according to the power compensation data in different modes, S3, carrying out weighting processing on the weight function to obtain an allocation coefficient, S4, calculating compensation allocation proportion of each area according to different allocation coefficients, and S5, distributing unbalanced cost of the power spot market into corresponding accounts according to the compensation allocation proportion of each area. According to the invention, the power compensation data of each area of the power spot market in different modes are obtained, the weight function is constructed to calculate the allocation coefficient, and the compensation allocation proportion of each area is calculated according to the difference of the allocation coefficient, so that the rationality and fairness of the compensation allocation of each area are improved.

title_en: District carbon reduction potential evaluation method considering user side interaction response
abstract_en: The invention provides a platform area carbon reduction potential assessment method considering user side interaction response, which comprises the steps of obtaining platform area node carbon potential according to platform area power data and sampling time periods, obtaining user side carbon emission according to the platform area node carbon potential, user side power data and sampling time periods, obtaining new energy output duty ratio average value and energy storage equipment capacity duty ratio according to the platform area power data, obtaining platform area power supply reliability and user comfort level according to the user side power data, obtaining user side interaction response capability according to the user side carbon emission, constructing an assessment matrix of a platform area to be assessed according to the user side interaction response capability, the new energy output duty ratio average value, the energy storage equipment capacity duty ratio, the platform area power supply reliability and the user comfort level, and selecting the platform area with the most carbon reduction potential based on the assessment matrix. The assessment method provided by the invention can scientifically and comprehensively assess the carbon reduction potential of the station area, and provides decision support for making an effective carbon emission reduction strategy and an action plan.

title_en: Multi-step prediction method, equipment and medium for index value of material supply system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-step prediction method, equipment and medium for index values of a material supply system, which belong to the technical field of material supply management and artificial intelligence intersection, and solve the technical problems of realizing accurate prediction and dynamic regulation and control of each link of a supply chain, improving the intelligent level and risk handling capacity of material industrial management; the method comprises the steps of performing anomaly detection and replacement on historical operation data of material supply by using a gating circulation unit from an encoder GRU_AE, constructing an index value multi-step prediction model by using a gating circulation unit network LA_GRU with a local attention mechanism, performing deep learning incremental update on the index value multi-step prediction model by using an elastic weight integration EWC algorithm, and obtaining the index value multi-step prediction model with updated model parameters.

title_en: Power distribution network fault identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault identification method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are used for solving the technical problems of poor stability and reliability of the existing power distribution network fault identification method. The method comprises the steps of collecting power distribution network fault signals through fault traveling wave collecting equipment, decomposing the power distribution network fault signals through an optimization CEEMDAN algorithm to obtain IMFs signals with intrinsic mode functions of different time scales, optimizing the IMFs signals through a Harris hawk optimization algorithm through an optimization CEEMDAN algorithm, generating energy spectrums of the IMFs signals, and identifying the power distribution network faults through the energy spectrums.

title_en: Inter-bank network time sequence prediction method based on generation of antagonism level fusion model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inter-bank network time sequence prediction method based on an inter-bank network generation countermeasure layer fusion model, which is used for generating an inter-bank network through a minimum density method and carrying out data enhancement by adopting a parameter disturbance and data disturbance method, wherein the inter-bank network generation countermeasure layer fusion model comprises WGAN and a layer fusion network HFN, the HFN comprises a graph convolution network, a graph annotation force network and a transducer, in addition, the training of the model is optimized through a self-adaptive edge density control module SAEDC provided by the invention, the effectiveness of the method is verified through model comparison and ablation experiments, and the method is used for time sequence prediction of the inter-bank network, and meanwhile, the limitation of the time sequence prediction model in terms of data, training efficiency and prediction accuracy is solved, so that a reliable basis is provided for research of the bank systematic risk field.

title_en: Vehicle rescue management method and system based on cloud platform and edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle rescue management method and system based on a cloud platform and edge calculation, and relates to the field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a vehicle rescue service station setting scheme and an edge calculation configuration scheme of a target area according to historical vehicle rescue data of the target area, setting a plurality of vehicle rescue service stations in the target area, and setting a plurality of edge calculation stations in the target area; the method comprises the steps of determining a dynamic scheduling scheme of vehicle rescue resources and a dynamic scheduling scheme of edge calculation according to real-time road information of a target area through a cloud platform, scheduling a plurality of edge calculation stations based on the dynamic scheduling scheme of edge calculation to determine vehicle rescue requirements of the target area according to the real-time road information of the target area, receiving vehicle rescue requests through the plurality of edge calculation stations, and carrying out vehicle rescue according to the vehicle rescue requirements and the vehicle rescue requests of the target area through the plurality of edge calculation stations.

title_en: Method and system for constructing coronary intervention postoperative risk prediction model
