abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a coronary intervention postoperative risk prediction model, and belongs to the technical fields of medical care information and health monitoring. A method for constructing a coronary intervention postoperative risk prediction model comprises the steps of constructing an experience scoring system of a main doctor and a capability scoring system of a nurse, and carrying out weighted fusion on results of the experience model of the doctor and the model of the nurse to form final additional model output. According to the method and the system for constructing the coronary intervention postoperative risk prediction model, the main model is combined with the additional model, the main model is based on static and dynamic characteristic data of a patient, the regression model and the time sequence model are used for comprehensively modeling, individualized health state changes of the patient are captured, the additional model is used for evaluating influences of medical team and relative care on postoperative risk by quantifying doctor experience and carer capability, and the defect that the traditional model only depends on patient data is overcome.

title_en: Multifunctional regulation and storage pool optimization method based on rain and flood regulation and reclaimed water regulation and storage
abstract_en: The application provides a multifunctional regulation and storage tank optimization method based on rainfall flood regulation and storage and reclaimed water regulation, which is characterized in that firstly, the rainfall flood regulation and storage tank optimization design is carried out based on short-duration rainfall to obtain a series of Pareto solution sets, then, the capacity, water supply and scheduling strategies of the rainwater-reclaimed water combined regulation and storage are optimally designed based on long-duration rainfall, and finally, an optimal scheme is selected through comprehensive evaluation, so that the comprehensive functional value of the obtained regulation and storage tank is obviously improved through the multi-level, comprehensive and long-time sequence optimization design, and a more efficient and sustainable solution is provided for modern urban water resource management.

title_en: Dynamic configuration method, device, equipment and medium for aggregation capacity of virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system resource allocation, in particular to a dynamic allocation method, a device, equipment and a medium for aggregation capacity of a virtual power plant, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a power grid flexibility gap to be analyzed, solving the maximum adjustable boundary of a monomer distributed resource by utilizing an affine transformation method based on a basic isomorphic polyhedron, and further carrying out dimension reduction, solution aggregation and depiction on the large-scale flexible resource through the two items to generate a virtual power plant dynamic feasible domain adapting to the gap; setting the minimum resource utilization number and configuration cost as model objective functions and the overall external characteristics of the virtual power plant, wherein the power grid flexibility gap is required to be met as constraint conditions, and carrying out simulation analysis on the dynamic feasible region of the virtual power plant, the model objective functions and the constraint conditions to obtain the configuration capacity of each type of distributed flexible resources. Therefore, the method effectively processes the restriction influence of the flexibility of the internal resources, thereby guiding the accurate allocation of the resources of the virtual power plant under the requirements of flexible adjustment of multiple time sequences and multiple types of systems.

title_en: Micro-grid energy scheduling method, equipment and medium based on improved differential algorithm
abstract_en: The application discloses a micro-grid energy scheduling method, equipment and medium based on an improved differential algorithm, wherein the method comprises the steps of predicting photovoltaic output power, load and charging pile required power based on a pre-built algorithm model and combining historical data, and determining charging and discharging power of energy storage equipment based on a pre-built energy storage power model; setting up a double objective function, combining photovoltaic output power, load, charging pile demand power and charging and discharging power of energy storage equipment to determine corresponding constraint conditions, dividing power consumption time periods, checking whether the iteration number of an algorithm reaches the maximum iteration number by improving a differential algorithm to determine an iteration optimal result, controlling the output of the photovoltaic equipment, the charging and discharging of the energy storage equipment and a main power grid electricity purchasing strategy by an energy router and a controller according to the iteration optimal result, and adjusting the load demand and the charging pile power to realize micro-grid energy scheduling.

title_en: Energy-saving effect evaluation method and system for high-rise building
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving effect evaluation method and system for a high-rise building, which particularly relate to the technical field of building energy conservation and are used for solving the problems of dynamic heat transfer delay effect and energy-saving effect evaluation result misalignment caused by neglecting thermal inertia of a glass curtain wall in the prior art, acquiring time sequence data of the outer surface temperature of a target building glass curtain wall under various weather types and corresponding indoor air conditioner refrigeration energy consumption data, extracting time sequence offset of a daytime temperature peak value and a nighttime energy consumption peak value from time to time, calculating dynamic delay time length by combining material heat transfer attenuation characteristics, screening nighttime energy consumption data which accords with a stable delay threshold value, quantifying additional refrigeration energy consumption caused by daytime heat accumulation based on delay time weight, finally generating an energy-saving evaluation result comprising the heat transfer delay effect by dynamically weighting and superposing the daytime and nighttime energy consumption data, avoiding evaluation deviation caused by nighttime recessive load omission, and improving reliability and engineering guiding value of the evaluation result.

title_en: Probiotics tablet production traceability method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of image processing, in particular to a method and a system for tracing the production of probiotics tablets, which construct a tracing matrix by collecting data of temperature and humidity, pH, equipment number, pressure and the like of various links such as strain selection, culture amplification, fermentation, drying, formulation, forming, coating, quality inspection, packaging and the like; and meanwhile, a pilot amplification colony image is acquired by utilizing high-definition camera shooting, colony geometric and texture characteristics are extracted by adopting pretreatment, watershed and dynamic threshold algorithm, complementary parameters are formed, and finally, after all data are spliced, unique tracing source codes are generated by utilizing SHA-256 hash and are sprayed on a packaging unit, and meanwhile, a chain is used for storing evidence, so that the tracing of a whole-flow product is realized, and the quality safety is ensured. According to the invention, the characteristic is extracted through integrating the data of each link and the colony image by dynamic threshold watershed, and then the tracing code is generated through SHA-256 encryption.

title_en: Power distribution network vulnerability assessment method and system based on random fault scene set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network vulnerability assessment method and system based on a random fault scene set, and belongs to the technical field of disaster affected assessment of power equipment. The method considers the fault probability of an upstream distribution transformer and the fault probability of a line which are possibly caused under a single random extreme condition scene, obtains the downstream distribution transformer which is possibly faulty based on the line which is possibly faulty, judges the land where all the distribution transformers possibly faulty belong, can obtain three-level indexes by combining the importance of the land and the occurrence probability of the distribution transformer, further obtains two-level indexes and one-level indexes, and can judge the vulnerability of the whole distribution network under the random fault scene after combining all the one-level indexes. The method can rapidly identify the most seriously affected area and facility through deep analysis of specific extreme events, and the derived index can guide short-term emergency resource layout, so that scientific basis is provided for emergency rescue and resource allocation.

title_en: High-voltage integrated and cooperative control method and system for energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-voltage integrated and cooperative control method and a system of an energy storage system, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out three-dimensional space coupling design on a high-voltage box and a PCS (power conversion system) through a topology optimization algorithm according to the power grade and heat distribution requirements of the energy storage system, and generating a physical layer architecture scheme of the high-voltage integrated machine; the physical layer architecture scheme based on the high-voltage integrated machine utilizes a time stamp alignment technology to construct a collaborative optimization data set, inputs the collaborative optimization data set into a model predictive control framework to generate a dynamic adjustment PCS working parameter, calculates the internal temperature distribution of the high-voltage integrated machine in real time through a three-dimensional thermal field reconstruction model according to the PCS working parameter, dynamically adjusts the rotating speed of a heat dissipation fan and the switching frequency of a power device, and generates a collaborative control instruction. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the integration level and the cooperative control capability of the high-voltage energy storage system can be improved, and the high-efficiency and stable operation of the energy storage system can be realized.

title_en: Intelligent charging decision-making method and system for photovoltaic storage and charging integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent charging decision-making method and system of photovoltaic storage and charging integrated equipment, and relates to the technical field of charging decision-making, wherein the intelligent charging decision-making method comprises the steps of constructing a decision-making intelligent body based on double-end decision-making by combining a network entry scene with a source-network-charge-storage-control construction state space aiming at target optical storage equipment, wherein the decision-making intelligent body comprises a power grid end and a load end; the method comprises the steps of receiving a charging decision task, inputting the charging decision task into a decision agent, carrying out non-dominant sorting decision optimization under double-end decision and double-end strategy registration correction in parallel through an initialization state space, determining a charging strategy and conducting charging management and control in response to target optical storage equipment. The method solves the technical problem that in the charging process of the photovoltaic power storage integrated equipment, the intelligent decision and the practical application scene have insufficient fitting degree, and achieves the technical effect of improving the intelligent level of the charging strategy.

title_en: Causal graph-based intelligent ammeter electricity consumption behavior interpretability analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a causal map-based intelligent ammeter electricity consumption behavior interpretability analysis method. The method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-level causal map through multi-source data fusion and triple nesting time window mechanisms, identifying an affected area by adopting a local influence propagation algorithm when electricity utilization abnormality is detected, correcting and realizing dynamic map maintenance, dividing a path into key, important and background three stages according to importance by adopting a hierarchical lazy index updating mechanism, verifying only the queried path, quickly reconstructing the causal path through a multi-level degradation searching strategy, and generating an interpretable analysis report by combining counterfactual reasoning. The method reduces the updating complexity and the index maintenance cost, improves the query efficiency, and provides a high-efficiency interpretable technical scheme for the electricity consumption behavior analysis of the intelligent electric meter.

title_en: Method and system for optimizing production process of recycled lightweight aggregate concrete wallboard
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building materials, in particular to a method and a system for optimizing a production process of a recycled lightweight aggregate concrete wallboard, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a building solid waste set and a carbonization box, carrying out crack scanning analysis on a solid waste sample to obtain a recycled concrete set, crushing and cleaning the recycled concrete set to obtain initial aggregate, obtaining n comprehensive test groups, carrying out carbonization analysis on the aggregate sample based on the comprehensive test groups and the carbonization box to obtain a sample carbonization value, taking the comprehensive test group corresponding to the maximum value of the sample as an optimal test group, carrying out carbonization treatment on the initial aggregate based on the optimal test group and the carbonization box, carrying out water absorption performance test on recycled aggregate, calculating the addition amount of the recycled aggregate, and obtaining a target concrete wallboard based on the addition amount of the recycled aggregate and the recycled aggregate, thereby completing production process optimization of the concrete wallboard. The invention can improve the automation degree of recycling the lightweight aggregate and the product quality of the finally produced concrete wallboard.

title_en: Shallow water delta diversion river reservoir prediction method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a shallow water delta diversion river reservoir prediction method and a shallow water delta diversion river reservoir prediction system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an initial reservoir prediction model of a target oil field area according to drilling data, logging data and seismic data of the target oil field area, wherein the target oil field area is obtained by historical shallow water delta sediment development; and correcting an initial reservoir prediction model of the target oilfield region by taking the continuous diversion channel width curve as a constraint to obtain a target reservoir prediction model. The application utilizes the modern remote sensing technology, can provide more comprehensive and accurate data support for reservoir prediction through accurate channel width statistics and dynamic analysis, and improves the reservoir prediction precision of the shallow water delta diversion channel.

title_en: Intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system for high-altitude equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system for high-altitude equipment, which relates to the technical field of high-altitude equipment management and has the technical scheme that the intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system comprises the following main points of collecting operation parameter values of the high-altitude equipment and dividing the condition area of the high-altitude equipment into area division groups according to the operation parameter values of the high-altitude equipment; the regional division set comprises a target fault region, a first region to be divided and a second region to be divided, an initial steering state of the detection device is set according to the position relation of the regional division set, the initial steering state of the detection device and condition data in the target fault region are processed, analyzed and set to be the initial working state of the detection device, the regional coverage range of the target fault region towards the direction of the detection device is collected, and the parameter fluctuation trend of high-altitude equipment is obtained in real time.

title_en: Intelligent decision-making method and system for post-disaster emergency repair of highway infrastructure network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent decision-making method and system for post-disaster emergency repair of a highway infrastructure network, which comprise the steps of acquiring aerial images of the post-disaster highway infrastructure by using an unmanned aerial vehicle, automatically identifying and analyzing characteristics of damaged areas of the highway infrastructure to generate multidimensional damage characteristic vectors, acquiring coordinates of a repair team and current emergency repair resource information, calculating space geometric distances between each damaged area and the repair team, generating a distance matrix, integrating normalization processing and the multidimensional damage characteristic vectors into a three-dimensional tensor, mapping the three-dimensional tensor into an importance matrix, formulating an emergency dispatch scheme of the repair team by using an optimization algorithm, and assigning the repair team. Compared with the prior art, the invention can dynamically plan according to the real-time process of the rush-repair, ensure the optimal matching of the rush-repair task and the resource and maximize the utilization efficiency of the resource.

title_en: Method and equipment for identifying tobacco shred box number and comparing task information of automatic guide vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and equipment for identifying tobacco shred box numbers and comparing task information of an automatic guiding vehicle, wherein a control system is connected with the automatic guiding vehicle in a wireless mode, the control system sends production scheduling task information to the automatic guiding vehicle, when the automatic guiding vehicle conveys the tobacco shred boxes according to the production scheduling task information, the control system shoots images of current tobacco shred boxes on the automatic guiding vehicle, the control system identifies the current tobacco shred box numbers of the current tobacco shred boxes according to the images, the control system compares whether the current tobacco shred box numbers meet the production scheduling task information or not, and when the current tobacco shred box numbers do not meet the production scheduling task information, the control system sends alarm reminding signals. The capacity of verifying materials in conveying is realized, timely discovery is facilitated at the quality accident occurrence stage, rapid correction is promoted through the alarm reminding signal, mixing and wrong card mixing caused by misholding of a smoke box due to system faults, manual operation errors and the like are effectively avoided, and the stability of production quality and the high efficiency of operation are ensured.

title_en: User electricity stealing behavior detection method and system based on entropy measurement of fuzzy relation
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for detecting user electricity stealing behavior based on entropy measurement of fuzzy relation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing first upper fuzzy entropy and first lower fuzzy entropy for different users according to a first membership relation obtained by normalized data processing of each user by a measurement algorithm, calculating second upper fuzzy entropy and second lower fuzzy entropy of each user by using the first upper fuzzy entropy and the first lower fuzzy entropy, calculating first outliers of each user according to the first upper fuzzy entropy and the first lower fuzzy entropy, calculating second outliers of each user according to the second upper fuzzy entropy and the second lower fuzzy entropy, and comparing the outlier scores calculated according to the first outliers, the second outliers and a weighting function with a preset outlier threshold to judge whether electricity stealing behavior exists for each user. According to the invention, heterogeneous data is directly processed by a fuzzy relation method, a discretization preprocessing step is not required for the digital data, and the loss of effective information of the data is effectively avoided.

title_en: Intelligent diagnosis system and method for paddy field drought
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural drought control and drought resistance, in particular to an intelligent paddy field drought diagnosis system and method, which comprises the steps of firstly acquiring paddy field images corresponding to inspection points; acquiring space-time acquisition data and rice growth period corresponding to each inspection point, inputting the paddy field image, the space-time acquisition data and the rice growth period corresponding to each inspection point into an inspection point drought grade diagnosis model for identification to obtain drought grades corresponding to each inspection point, determining the corresponding area proportion of each grade of drought grade in an inspection area based on the drought grades corresponding to each inspection point, and finally calculating the corresponding drought grade of the inspection area based on the corresponding area proportion of each grade of drought grade in the inspection area. The invention comprehensively considers the rice growth period and the time and space acquisition data so as to accurately identify the drought grade corresponding to each inspection point and the drought grade corresponding to the inspection area.

title_en: Route optimization method and system based on genetic algorithm and geographic information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a route optimization method and a system based on genetic algorithm and geographic information, which relate to the technical field of intelligent navigation and path planning, and comprise the steps of receiving geographic data related to route planning and constructing a multi-level spatial index; the method comprises the steps of adopting a waypoint optimization algorithm, determining a waypoint sequence of a route by using a genetic algorithm based on population diversity self-adaptive adjustment under the support of a spatial index, adopting a path optimization algorithm aiming at any two adjacent waypoints in the waypoint sequence, combining geographic information provided by the spatial index, generating a corresponding optimal path segment by using the genetic algorithm, performing iterative optimization on the optimal path segment, performing iterative optimization on the waypoint sequence and the optimal path segment, and integrating an optimization result into an autonomous navigation system after convergence. The space information processing efficiency is remarkably improved, high-risk and limited areas are effectively removed, and the optimal layout of the global route structure is realized.

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, computer equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to a resource allocation method, apparatus, computer device, computer readable storage medium and computer program product. The method comprises the steps of constructing comprehensive evaluation results corresponding to all target indexes based on index values of target indexes of all objects in a preset time window, determining deviation values of all target indexes of the target objects based on the comprehensive evaluation results, determining index level results of all target indexes based on preset index level division rules and the deviation values of all target indexes, determining target user levels of the target objects based on user level division rules and index level results of all target indexes of the target objects, and determining resource allocation results corresponding to the target objects according to mapping relations between the user levels and service resources and the target user levels. By adopting the method, the accuracy of resource allocation can be improved.

title_en: Marine wind turbine generator gearbox fault diagnosis method based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for diagnosing faults of a gearbox of an offshore wind turbine generator based on image recognition, which relates to the technical field of gearbox fault diagnosis, and the method remarkably improves the reliability of crack diagnosis of the offshore wind turbine gearbox through imaging optimization and deep learning architecture innovation of multi-physical field coupling; the method comprises the steps of combining polarization filtering with dynamic frequency domain filtering, effectively inhibiting optical artifact interference of a salt crystallization layer, realizing artifact characteristic decoupling by a double generator against a network, avoiding crack information loss, capturing crack spectrum energy distribution by frequency domain branches, strengthening key region detection by combining a stress distribution priori, solving the difficult problem of cross-scale identification of micropunching and macroscopic tooth breakage, and enabling an algorithm to cope with complex working conditions of different salt fog concentrations and crystal forms by self-adaptive frequency band selection and deformable convolution design, thereby reducing dependence on hardware transformation.

title_en: Cutter management system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of cutter management, in particular to a cutter management system and method. The system comprises a receiving and returning management module, a positioning and tracking management module and a life cycle management module, wherein the receiving and returning management module is used for carrying out pairing storage on identity information of a borrowing person and tool information of a borrowing tool in a tool lending stage, verifying whether the identity of the returning person is legal or not according to the tool information of the returning tool in the tool returning stage, the positioning and tracking management module is used for receiving the tool information of the tool to be searched and determining position information of the tool to be searched according to the tool information, the life cycle management module is used for obtaining historical loss data and current loss values of a blade, formulating loss standard values according to the historical loss values, comparing the loss standard values with the current loss values and judging whether the loss of the blade is abnormal or not. The application can improve the cutter management efficiency.

title_en: Method and system for optimizing automobile delay service cost based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile delay service cost optimization method and system based on big data analysis, and particularly relates to the technical field of cost optimization; the vehicle-mounted diagnosis method comprises the steps of carrying out semantic analysis on vehicle historical maintenance record data to generate fault feature vectors, carrying out time sequence alignment processing on real-time vehicle-mounted diagnosis data streams to construct time sequence fault features, dividing a high-frequency fault mode and a low-frequency fault mode based on the fault feature vectors and the time sequence fault features to respectively construct a high-frequency fault probability distribution model and a low-frequency fault risk factor set, calculating expected maintenance cost for the high-frequency fault mode by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method, constructing a fault propagation network for the low-frequency fault mode based on topology association analysis, optimizing and outputting an delay cost decision matrix through a risk loss function, and generating delay service pricing strategies by combining an insurance calculation rule base to improve accuracy and stability of delay cost assessment.

title_en: AI-based data quality intelligent evaluation optimization system
abstract_en: The application provides an AI-based data quality intelligent evaluation optimization system which comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a multi-source data integration module, a data quality evaluation module and a data quality optimization module, wherein the multi-source data acquisition module is used for acquiring multi-source data, the source of the multi-source data comprises a database, a network interface and data acquisition equipment, the multi-source data integration module is used for carrying out structural processing on the multi-source data and processing the multi-source data into structural data in a unified data storage format, the data quality evaluation module is internally provided with a multi-dimensional data quality evaluation model based on deep learning and used for evaluating multi-dimensional quality scores of the structural data, the evaluation dimensions of the structural data comprise integrity, accuracy, consistency and timeliness, and the data quality optimization module is used for analyzing the data quality problem of the structural data and generating prompt information based on the multi-dimensional quality scores. According to the scheme, an artificial intelligence technology is introduced to carry out intelligent evaluation optimization on the data quality, so that accurate evaluation on the data quality is realized, the reliability and the efficiency of data quality evaluation are remarkably improved, and a solid data base is provided for enterprise decision.

title_en: BIM-based municipal road construction method
abstract_en: The application discloses a municipal road construction method based on BIM, which is characterized in that an automatic feature mapping mechanism between design requirements and construction elements is established by deep fusion of BIM technology and municipal road construction process, key features strongly related to the design requirements are accurately extracted from construction data by semantic query matching technology based on deep learning, so that accurate interaction between the design requirements and actual construction data is realized, the obtained design requirement-data item query features are input into a preset BIM model, a municipal road construction BIM model with dynamic response to real-time construction conditions is formed, and real-time construction information is dynamically injected into the BIM model, so that intelligent optimization iteration of a construction scheme is driven. The application improves the information integration level and the real-time performance of the construction stage, so that the design scheme can be quickly adapted to the change of the construction site, thereby ensuring that the construction activity is always propelled along the optimal path, and improving the completion quality of the whole project.

title_en: Fresh quality degradation pre-judging method and system based on multi-mode dynamic coupling
abstract_en: The application provides a fresh quality degradation prediction method and a fresh quality degradation prediction system based on multi-mode dynamic coupling, and aims to solve the problem of prediction hysteresis caused by data isolation and dynamic coupling loss in the traditional storage and transportation process. The method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting sensory layer data, environment layer data and operation layer data through a multisource sensor, carrying out color difference quantification, chemical bond characteristic extraction and space chemistry fusion treatment on the sensory data to generate a quality degradation characteristic tensor, then constructing a dynamic coupling parameter set of quality degradation characteristics and environment parameters based on a graph network model and frequency domain analysis, then fusing loading and unloading pulse track tensor, cold chain stability distribution and coupling parameter set, generating a degradation constraint distribution matrix through multivariate weight mapping, and finally combining acoustic resonance modal coherence analysis and constraint matrix evolution to output a four-level quality label. The method remarkably reduces fresh storage and transportation loss and improves the cold chain management efficiency through multidimensional real-time sensing, dynamic coupling modeling and grading management and control.

title_en: New energy automobile energy regulation and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy automobile energy regulation and control method and system, and relates to the technical field of energy regulation and control, wherein the method comprises the steps of deploying an edge calculation unit in a preset area of a new energy automobile, constructing a distributed edge calculation network, and obtaining energy data of each preset area; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing energy data, combining vehicle working conditions, carrying out local energy regulation and control to obtain a local energy regulation and control strategy, carrying out reinforcement learning according to a state space and an action space of a new energy automobile and with the aim of maximizing energy utilization rate based on the local energy regulation and control strategy, carrying out iterative optimization to obtain a global energy regulation and control strategy, and adjusting parameters of a distributed edge computing network and a global energy regulation and control unit in a mode of energy output and energy feedback to correct energy deviation.

title_en: Auxiliary decision-making method and system for regional coal market purchase
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary decision-making method and system for regional coal market purchase, belonging to the technical field of coal market purchase decision-making, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing model input parameters by collecting data of a coal demand plan of a power plant, the maximum supply quantity of a supplier, a coal quality index, purchase price and transportation cost; the method comprises the steps of constructing a mixed integer linear programming model taking total purchase cost minimization as an objective function, setting requirement meeting constraint, supply capacity constraint and coal quality standard reaching constraint, adopting a two-stage approximation algorithm to solve the mixed integer linear programming model, converting the obtained approximate optimal solution into a visualized purchase scheme chart and report, supporting a user to dynamically adjust the purchase scheme through an interactive interface, and generating a final purchase decision. According to the invention, the purchasing plan of the coal can be optimized on the basis of comprehensively considering the coal quality, purchasing cost, transportation mode and supplier capacity, so that the cost is minimized, and the overall quality of coal purchasing is improved.

title_en: Automatic logistics system based on image recognition and embedded control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic logistics system based on image recognition and embedded control, which comprises an image recognition module, a three-dimensional point cloud processing module, an embedded control module and a dynamic information acquisition terminal. The three-dimensional point cloud processing module generates a package three-dimensional model through three-step methods of voxel filter downsampling, RANSAC segmentation and poisson reconstruction, the model error is less than or equal to 2mm, and the sorting path is corrected in real time, and the embedded control module drives the sorting mechanical arm based on STM32 chips and PID algorithm to realize sorting error at the speed of 2.5m/s, wherein the sorting code recognition rate is more than or equal to 99 percent, and the phone number recognition rate is more than or equal to 99.5 percent. The invention solves the problems of low identification precision, difficult compromise between sorting speed and precision of the traditional logistics system, remarkably improves the adaptability of complex scenes and the closed-loop control efficiency, and is suitable for scenes such as express delivery, e-commerce storage and the like.

title_en: Airport equipment operation and maintenance multi-party inspection tracing and evidence-storing method and system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital information of civil airports, and discloses a multi-party inspection tracing and evidence-preserving method and system for operation and maintenance of airport equipment based on a block chain. The method comprises the steps of calculating data uplink storage structure levels, constructing civil aviation professional equipment inspection data uplink storage structures under different storage structure levels, constructing non-civil aviation equipment inspection data uplink storage structures under different storage structure levels, storing target equipment environment data under a line, constructing and initializing an encrypted uplink inspection data structure based on whether the civil aviation professional equipment is the supervision monitoring and uplink storage structure levels, constructing a quick index structure, and carrying out inspection data uplink. The invention realizes the unified and efficient inspection record and evidence storage of different inspection types of different equipment of different participants, provides a reliable and sufficient data basis for the responsibility definition of multiple parties and the investigation and analysis of the problems in the subsequent occurrence of the problems, and is beneficial to the efficient and reliable coordination of the multiple parties in the field of airport equipment inspection.

title_en: Intelligent power scheduling method of energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power scheduling method of an energy storage system, which relates to the related field of power distribution, and comprises the steps of determining time-of-use power price information of a power utilization area corresponding to a target energy storage system; the method comprises the steps of collecting first electricity demand information of an application area of a target energy storage system in a first time zone, collecting energy storage capacity of the target energy storage system, executing charge and discharge planning based on the energy storage capacity, time-of-use electricity price information and the first electricity demand information to generate charge and discharge planning, and performing power scheduling control by using the target energy storage system based on the charge and discharge planning. The technical problems of lack of accuracy and flexibility in power dispatching of the existing energy storage system are solved, and the technical effects of accurate and flexible control of power dispatching are achieved.

title_en: Photovoltaic ultra-short term power prediction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clean energy and discloses a photovoltaic ultra-short-term power prediction method which comprises the steps of obtaining radar cloud image data of a target photovoltaic station, taking real-time radar cloud image data as report starting data, conducting weather extrapolation based on fusion cloud cluster change characteristics of the radar cloud image data to obtain extrapolated radar cloud image data, inputting the extrapolated radar cloud image data and historical radar cloud image data into a pre-trained extrapolated cloud image correction model to obtain corrected radar cloud image data, determining weather characteristics of the target photovoltaic station based on the corrected radar cloud image data, conducting photovoltaic power prediction on the target photovoltaic station based on the weather characteristics to obtain photovoltaic power prediction results, and conducting weather characteristic extraction and photovoltaic power prediction by adopting the radar cloud image data, so that the influence of low accuracy of distributed photovoltaic ultra-short-term power prediction caused by complex weather phenomena under low accuracy or lack of measured cloud amount can be reduced.

title_en: Multi-mode fused online account opening method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a multimode fused online account opening method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and is suitable for the technical field of finance and technology. The method comprises the steps of responding to an account opening request sent by a client, sending a connection success notification message to the client, starting a camera and a microphone, enabling the camera to be used for collecting a target face, enabling the microphone to be used for collecting target voice, obtaining the target face sent by the client, conducting micro-expression recognition on the target face to obtain target micro-expression features, obtaining target voice sent by the client, conducting voiceprint recognition on the target voice to obtain target voiceprint features, conducting attention fusion on the target micro-expression features and the target voiceprint features to obtain target fusion features, conducting identity verification on the target object according to the target fusion features to obtain a legal object, generating a digital signature for the legal object, and opening an account for the legal object based on the digital signature. The application can improve the accuracy and reliability of online account opening.

title_en: Automatic processing method and system for crime-free record evidence based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for automatically processing crime-free record evidence based on artificial intelligence, which belong to the technical field of data processing, and are characterized in that the crime-free record request data transmitted by an applicant is obtained, and network flow characteristics are acquired in real time in the process of accessing the applicant, and then the crime-free record request data and the network flow characteristics are comprehensively processed through the artificial intelligence, and finally, encrypting the request result of the no-crime record by adopting an encryption algorithm to obtain an automatic processing result of the no-crime record certification, and returning the automatic processing result of the no-crime record certification to the applicant, thereby not only effectively improving the acquisition efficiency of the no-crime record, avoiding the error problem caused by manual auditing, but also effectively ensuring the data access security.

title_en: Test question repeatability detection method and system based on multi-mode large language model
abstract_en: A test question repeatability detection method and system based on a multi-mode large language model comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode test question data to be used as a question bank data set, conducting data cleaning on the question bank data set to obtain a cleaned data set, generating multi-mode high-dimensional semantic vector representation of the test questions by combining the multi-mode large language model according to the cleaned data set, pooling the multi-mode high-dimensional semantic vector representation to obtain final vector representation of the questions, constructing Milvus sets and HNSW indexes by combining the final vector representation of the questions and the test question data exchange format JSON data, and visually displaying response results by combining the multi-mode representation of the to-be-checked set with HNSW indexes of Milvus. The invention is based on Milvus vector database and multi-mode characterization technology, so that the invention can support similarity retrieval scoring of millions of question bank millisecond level more accurate response.

title_en: Simplified method for achieving microcosmic result acquisition by utilizing macroscopic evacuation simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a simplified method for obtaining microscopic results by utilizing macroscopic evacuation simulation. According to the method, factors such as obstacle avoidance, collision, waiting and the like are considered in combination with a plan semantic segmentation result, a new result is adjusted and calculated on the basis of a macroscopic simulation result, and a visual effect of an evacuation simulation result is achieved in combination with a plan. The method provided by the invention not only inherits the calculation efficiency of macroscopic simulation, but also combines the advantages of microscopic simulation, thereby breaking through the limitation of macroscopic simulation, being capable of rapidly realizing microscopic evacuation simulation under different layout conditions of a single building and providing a multi-dimensional evaluation basis for building safety design.

title_en: Virtual card interaction control method and terminal suitable for chemistry laboratory security education
abstract_en: The application provides a virtual card interaction control method and a terminal suitable for safety education in a chemical laboratory, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method is applied to a terminal and comprises the steps of moving out a virtual chemical event card from a preset card set, recording the virtual chemical event card as a first card, displaying a plurality of virtual counter measure cards related to the preset card set in the card-out area, acquiring first display content of the card-in area when preset conditions are met, combining the first card, updating the score displayed in the statistics area, judging whether the preset card set is an empty set, returning to move out one virtual chemical event card from the preset card set if the preset card set is not empty, and generating a test report corresponding to the preset card set according to the updated score displayed in the statistics area if the preset card set is not empty. The application can effectively assist in cultivating the emergency treatment capability of the user in the chemical experiment operation.

title_en: A case is by extraction system for judicial document
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural language processing, in particular to a case and bag extraction system for judicial documents, which comprises a history information input module, a case and bag statistics module, a language data acquisition module, a history information processing module, a core feature extraction module, a judicial document extraction module and a judicial document extraction module, wherein the history information input module is used for inputting a history judicial document, the case and bag statistics module is used for generating a corresponding relation table, the language data acquisition module is used for acquiring a deactivated word table and a text vector file of the judicial document, the history information processing module is used for preprocessing the history judicial document to obtain a history fact phrase and a history judicial phrase, the text vector marking module is used for analyzing the correlation degree of the fact word and the judicial phrase, the core feature extraction module is used for extracting core features of each history judicial document, the judicial document extraction module is used for carrying out rule weight ordering on the target judicial document, and extracting the case and bag types of the target judicial document. The invention effectively improves the extraction efficiency of the judicial document case.

title_en: Path optimization method based on energy valley optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path optimization method based on an energy valley optimization algorithm, and particularly relates to the technical field of path optimization, comprising the following steps of firstly marking a received well lid abnormal signal, and extracting a path of the well lid abnormal signal through a track extraction method; initializing parameters of an energy valley optimization algorithm, wherein the initialized parameters comprise a search space (X, xnew i=X  i  +r), a neutron enrichment level NEL, an enrichment boundary EB, a stability level SL and a stability boundary SB. According to the invention, the signals are output after being subjected to time-frequency analysis by combining with the short-time Fourier transform of the convolutional neural network, so that an optimal route can be extracted, and after pooling-convolution is added, the target is anchored and extracted, so that the required route is quickly found, the multi-target behavior of the traditional transformation is overcome, the path optimization time is greatly saved, and maintenance personnel can arrive at the target place as soon as possible.

title_en: Educational resource intelligent distribution system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent educational resource distribution system based on big data analysis, which belongs to the technical field of educational resource distribution and comprises the following steps of starting the intelligent educational resource distribution system to prepare data acquisition and analysis, collecting relevant data of students, teachers, courses and schools, preprocessing the collected data, and storing the preprocessed data into a system database to ensure the safety and accessibility of the data. According to the invention, through big data analysis, the system can provide personalized learning resources and teaching plans according to the learning progress, interests and demands of each student, so that the learning effect is improved, and secondly, a teacher can accurately learn according to the learning data of the students provided by the system, so that the learning demands of different students are better met, and meanwhile, the system helps the teacher to timely adjust the teaching method and content and improve the teaching effect through analyzing the data in the teaching process.

title_en: Charging management method and system for electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent energy management of electric vehicles and discloses a charging management method and system of an electric vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring vehicle data, user charging demand data and charging station data; according to charging station data, historical data of vehicle data are combined to calculate to obtain load data, the load data are compared with available upper limit data, charging demand data are combined to generate priority charging sequence data, idle charging piles are grouped, an integer programming algorithm is adopted to obtain an optimal power distribution scheme, a charging plan is generated according to the optimal power distribution scheme, real-time charging data are collected and updated in the plan execution process, according to the real-time charging data, historical operation data of the charging station are combined, a deep learning algorithm is adopted to optimize intelligent scheduling strategies, and intelligent distribution of charging station resources is completed. The method can integrate the historical data and the real-time charging data to realize the dynamic optimization of the charging plan of the electric automobile.

title_en: Painting and calligraphy evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of painting and calligraphy evaluation, in particular to a painting and calligraphy evaluation method which comprises the following steps of S1, confirming the authorship of a painting and calligraphy, determining the creation year of the painting and calligraphy, measuring the size of the painting and calligraphy, S2, detecting the authenticity of the painting and calligraphy through style analysis and technology, S3, selecting a plurality of market forming cases of the same author of an evaluation target as comparison samples, S4, respectively correcting the samples according to a correction formula, wherein the correction formula is a correction value = sample value x a known coefficient x an art coefficient x a ruler coefficient x a mounting coefficient x an intact coefficient, the sample value represents the actual trading price of the painting and calligraphy of the same author in the market, quantifying the difference of the evaluation target and the sample in terms of the degree of awareness, the art level, the ruler, mounting and the intact degree through the coefficient formula, enabling the correction value to be more accurate, and eliminating the accidental calculation of a single sample through the average calculation of the correction values of the plurality of the samples.

title_en: Industry big data monitoring and risk assessment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial data evaluation, in particular to an industrial big data monitoring and risk evaluation system. The multi-dimensional industrial big data risk assessment is realized through throughput monitoring, operation monitoring, AGV equipment monitoring, associated equipment health monitoring and supply chain monitoring, finally, an intelligent switching key rule between the current monitoring time period and the next monitoring time period is constructed based on the assessment data and the assessment result of each time through a dynamic key management scheme, the flexibility and the safety of data management are improved, and meanwhile, the potential safety hazards caused by key leakage are reduced.

title_en: Method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium for processing medical insurance data
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for processing medical insurance data, and relates to the technical field of medical insurance data processing. The method for processing the medical insurance data comprises the steps of determining initial data standards and data security levels corresponding to the initial medical insurance data, obtaining target data standards corresponding to the initial medical insurance data, determining conversion calculation force corresponding to the initial medical insurance data based on the initial data standards and the target data standards, screening target medical insurance data from the initial medical insurance data based on the conversion force and the data security levels, generating data processing rules corresponding to the target medical insurance data, and sending the data processing rules to target terminals corresponding to the initial medical insurance data so as to control the target terminals to perform data processing on the target medical insurance data based on the data processing rules. The application can reduce the data conversion calculation force requirement of the terminal which is stored in a centralized way.

title_en: Batch picking-up system and batch picking-up method for storage cabinets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a batch picking-up system and a batch picking-up method for storage cabinets, wherein the batch picking-up system for the storage cabinets comprises user equipment, a central server and an intelligent storage cabinet group, wherein the user equipment is communicated with the central server through a network, and the central server is communicated with the intelligent storage cabinet group through the network. A method for picking up parts of a locker batch picking up part system comprises the following steps of S1, task initiation and order uploading, S2, order processing and path planning, S3, article identification and identity verification, S4, article picking up and progress updating, and S5, consumable monitoring and replenishment. The invention can automatically complete order grouping and path planning, effectively reduce the walking distance and operation time of couriers and users, and the multi-mode identification technology sub-module and the batch identity verification sub-module can rapidly process article information and identity verification, thereby remarkably improving the overall efficiency of batch picking-up of articles.

title_en: 5G-based remote care collaboration platform task allocation processing system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to a 5G-based remote care collaboration platform task allocation processing system and method. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a task distribution module, a task monitoring module and an evaluation feedback module. The system can provide accurate basis for generating nursing tasks, enable task allocation to be scientific and reasonable, balance the workload of nursing staff, acquire the working behaviors and operation processes of the nursing staff and the execution completion conditions of the nursing tasks, help the nursing staff to find problems, adjust working plans and efficiently complete work, calculate evaluation data according to the working behaviors, the operation processes and the execution completion conditions, update task allocation rules, help to standardize nursing workflow and improve nursing efficiency and service quality.

title_en: Railway emergency material scheduling optimization method based on distributed system architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway emergency material dispatching optimization method based on a distributed system architecture, which comprises the following steps of obtaining disaster condition multi-dimensional information, predicting emergency material demands, obtaining the demand quantity of emergency materials at each disaster point, using shortest path rules to draw out initial dispatching paths of the emergency materials at each disaster point, updating disaster condition evolution information collected according to big data to obtain final dispatching paths, constructing a multi-objective emergency material dispatching optimization model, respectively solving the perception of the disaster people on risks and the unevenness of the emergency material dispatching at each disaster point, carrying out directional distribution according to solving results, carrying out satisfaction evaluation, updating the demand quantity and the dispatching paths if a preset satisfaction value is not reached, and carrying out model solving until the preset satisfaction value is reached. The invention shortens the response time of resource scheduling, optimizes the fairness of material scheduling, and ensures that the scheduling process of emergency materials is more scientific and effective.

title_en: Financial data analysis and statistical model construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a financial data analysis and statistical model construction method, which relates to the technical field of financial big data analysis and comprises the steps of collecting client transaction running water, public opinion text and industrial chain data from a transaction system, a social media platform and an industrial chain database of a financial institution, cleaning the collected data, removing noise data, carrying out standardized processing, extracting key features, constructing an initial knowledge graph according to the extracted information, continuously monitoring time sequence changes of the data, and continuously updating the knowledge graph. According to the invention, through comprehensively fusing multi-source data, potential information can be more accurately evaluated and potential association and risk can be found in time, risk misjudgment caused by a single data source is reduced, event-driven self-adaptive updating is realized, and timeliness of a map can be kept to follow market change, so that decision accuracy and timeliness are improved, a three-dimensional attribution analysis system is constructed, decision transparency can be improved, and reliability and fairness of financial data analysis are enhanced.

title_en: Euro option pricing method based on mixed secondary fractional brownian motion and jump diffusion model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pricing of financial derivatives, in particular to an European option pricing method based on mixed fractional brownian motion and a jump diffusion model, which comprises the steps of introducing a jump diffusion process into the mixed fractional brownian motion, describing an asset price process, and solving the mixed fractional jump diffusion process according to the asset price process The method comprises the steps of obtaining a formula, calculating a partial differential equation of related derivative prices under the mixed fraction jump diffusion condition based on a self-financing investment strategy, and deducing European type rising option pricing under the mixed fraction jump diffusion environment under the incomplete market based on the related derivative prices. In the invention, the pricing formula of the European expansion option is deduced under the assumption that each target asset is jointly influenced by geometric Brownian motion, secondary fractional Brownian motion and a Poisson process. The invention aims to solve the problems of long memory and self-similarity of captured assets and sudden jump of the price of the reflected assets.

title_en: Teaching resource recommendation method based on teaching scene association
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource recommendation, and discloses a teaching resource recommendation method based on teaching scene association. Furthermore, the high-dimensional data can be subjected to dimension reduction processing by the principal component analysis method, so that the complexity and the calculated amount of the data are reduced. Furthermore, the similarity degree between the teaching scene feature vector and the teaching resource feature vector can be measured through the cosine similarity calculation method, and the obtained attention weight value can reflect the importance of different features in recommendation, so that the teaching scene and the resource can be matched more accurately, and the problem of inaccurate recommendation in the prior art is solved. And finally, recommending by using the attention weight value and the teaching resource feature vector, and comprehensively considering a plurality of factors, recommending the teaching resource which is most suitable for a specific teaching scene for the user, thereby improving the accuracy and the practicability of the recommendation.

title_en: Method for treating stability of surface mine slope greening ecological restoration slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating the stability of a slope of an open pit mine by greening ecological restoration, which relates to the field of mine slope greening and comprises the steps of setting a horizontal shaft net above the slope, vertically dividing the slope surface based on the shaft net, enabling each grid of the shaft net to correspond to a sub-slope surface, and collecting the structural state and restoration information of the slope based on an unmanned plane module carrying collection device; the invention divides the slope surface by setting the horizontal axis net, combines the unmanned plane module to accurately collect information according to the net, realizes the fine monitoring of the slope, can accurately monitor the slope restoration stability safety situation, and provides reliable technical support for the ecological restoration and stability management of the surface mine slope greening.

title_en: Index prediction method and device for natural language dialogue
abstract_en: The invention provides an index prediction method and device for natural language dialogue. Integrating multi-source index data, constructing a subject domain knowledge graph, defining index, dimension value and date fields, establishing an association relation between the index and the dimension, extracting index, dimension value and time information in a user prediction problem through a natural language processing technology, judging the prediction problem as a single-index time sequence prediction problem or a multi-index correlation joint prediction problem, predicting the single-index time sequence prediction problem through an ARIMA model, and predicting the multi-index correlation joint prediction problem through a linear regression algorithm. The scheme of the invention can solve the real-time problem of index prediction, the problem of inaccurate intention recognition of a large model on the prediction problem and the black box problem of a large model index prediction algorithm.

title_en: Sanitation operation management and control method, system, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environmental sanitation operation control method, which comprises the steps of constructing a target knowledge graph based on historical data and/or environmental data, determining an operation scheduling sequence based on processing of a large language model on the target knowledge graph, and determining an optimal operation scheme based on processing of an optimization algorithm on the operation scheduling sequence. Sanitation operation data can be dynamically adjusted based on the data updated in real time, and operation effects can be dynamically monitored.

title_en: Ecological damage evaluation system based on pollution diffusion simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological damage evaluation system based on pollution diffusion simulation, which relates to the technical field of marine ecological safety, and comprises the following steps that an oil spill sensing monitoring network takes the berth center of a wharf as an origin, a plurality of buoy probes are distributed on the water surface, and the plurality of buoy probes jointly form the oil spill sensing monitoring network; the buoy probes are respectively provided with a communication device, collected information is wirelessly transmitted to the data analysis module, the data analysis module constructs a calculation grid according to the oil spill sensing monitoring network, maps each buoy probe to grid nodes, obtains a continuous space field in the whole area through a Kriging interpolation method, constructs a pollution diffusion equation, solves a pollution concentration field, defines a real-time ecological damage rate and an ecological accumulated damage amount, continuously transmits the real-time ecological damage rate and the ecological accumulated damage amount to the early warning module, and the early warning module expands a prevention and control trigger mechanism according to comparison of the real-time ecological damage rate and the ecological accumulated damage amount with a preset threshold value.

title_en: Intelligent management system and method for intelligent washing lease cabinet
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent management of rental cabinets, and discloses an intelligent management system and method for an intelligent washing rental cabinet; the system comprises a device data acquisition module, an influence data acquisition module, a comprehensive characteristic generation module, a device utilization reference value generation module, a resource allocation module, an energy consumption optimization module and a report transmission module, wherein a device data set is acquired, an influence data set is acquired, the device data set and the influence data set are subjected to characteristic extraction to obtain a comprehensive characteristic data set, the device data set, the influence data set and the comprehensive characteristic data set are analyzed to obtain a device utilization reference value, and the device utilization reference value and regional delivery data are analyzed to obtain a device gap report.

title_en: Multi-mode database dynamic fusion optimization method and system based on large model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power data processing, and discloses a multi-modal database dynamic fusion optimization method and system based on a large model, wherein the method comprises the steps of cleaning power multi-modal data based on a large language model to obtain cleaned power multi-modal data; the method comprises the steps of performing cross-modal feature extraction based on cleaned electric power multi-modal data to obtain features of each mode, aligning the features of each mode through a cross-modal alignment loss function, calculating weight of each mode based on the aligned features of each mode, a data quality index, a service label and a life cycle parameter of equipment, and dynamically adjusting weight distribution of each mode through preset emergency keyword detection and sensor mutation response strategies to complete optimization. The invention improves the utilization rate of multi-mode power data, reduces the manual cleaning cost, improves the data processing efficiency and quality, and provides powerful support for the operation, maintenance and management of the power system.

title_en: Priority rule method for scheduling problem of random flexible project
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of project scheduling optimization, in particular to a priority rule method for a random flexible project scheduling problem, which comprises the steps of carrying out priority calculation on residual activities by using activity construction period information when selecting and sequencing the residual activities by utilizing priority rules for the resource restricted project scheduling problem, solving the random flexible project scheduling problem in the resource restricted project scheduling problem by adopting a method based on the priority rules, constructing an example covering different scheduling environments based on standard test examples for comparing and analyzing the performance of the priority rules when solving the random flexible resource restricted project scheduling problem, and obtaining experimental results.

title_en: Intelligent mental health education system and method for realizing family-school interaction and discipline fusion based on education robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent mental health education system based on an educational robot, which comprises (1) an AI home school cooperation, wherein an improved YOLOv algorithm captures classroom behaviors, dynamic Gaussian blur protection privacy is realized, students with desensitization ID are pushed in a directed manner to participate in images, the AI is supported to generate personalized ditch conversation, parental participation is improved, (2) a cross-discipline fusion engine, knowledge map associated psychological courses, mathematics, sports and other disciplines are constructed, optimal fusion time is predicted by combining teaching business data, a double-discipline cooperative teaching plan is generated, (3) interest and emotion driven daily penetration is realized, namely student interest labels are analyzed by combining multi-mode emotion recognition based on a lingering model (LFM), personalized family task pushing is triggered, intelligent penetration of mental health education in home scenes is realized, 4) full-link privacy protection is realized, differential privacy, block chains and federal learning technology are adopted, data are all anonymous, information security is ensured through three-level desensitization and quantum encryption, and the system meets the requirements of personal information protection law.

title_en: Enterprise liability risk quantitative assessment method and system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine learning-based enterprise liability risk quantitative assessment method and system, which are divided into two stages of model training and practical application. In the model training stage, marking and grading are carried out by using five major indexes by reading data containing a plurality of financial reports. Training is performed based on the processed data using XGBoost machine learning algorithms. In the actual application stage, the unprocessed financial data is read, and is firstly preprocessed and then input into a trained model for risk level assessment, and a risk level result is output. According to the invention, the central enterprise liability risk quantitative assessment model is adopted to carry out risk level assessment in the data preprocessing stage, the scores of all indexes are important bases for assessing the liability risk of the enterprise, and the conditions of the enterprise in aspects of financial structure, liability management and the like can be accurately measured through an accurate calculation formula, so that potential liability risks can be effectively identified and assessed.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based intelligent recommendation method for suppliers
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge graphs and discloses a provider intelligent recommendation method based on the knowledge graphs, which comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic association knowledge graph comprising a provider, a product and area nodes, and predefining a relationship activity probe interface aiming at weak signal types at a relationship side; the method comprises the steps of receiving multi-source heterogeneous signals through light weight processing to generate probe activation signals, triggering corresponding probe interfaces based on signal types, driving dynamic accumulation and natural attenuation of activity values at sides of a relation to form knowledge graph dynamic printing and dyeing reflecting real-time situations, and evaluating comprehensive health according to activity states at each side of a supply path to generate a recommendation list. The invention realizes the autonomous perception capability of the knowledge graph on the weak signals of the supply chain environment through the probe interface preset and activity dynamic regulation mechanism, avoids the excessive dependence of the traditional recommendation method on the historical data, and provides decision support with both prospective and interpretability for the selection of suppliers.

title_en: System for intelligent distribution and path planning of multi-robot collaborative operation and tasks
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system for multi-robot collaborative operation, task intelligent allocation and path planning, which comprises a task receiving module, a task decomposing module, an executing module, a path planning module and a path calculating module, wherein the task receiving module is used for receiving task information and transmitting the task information to the task decomposing module, the task decomposing module is used for generating subtask information aiming at the received task information and distributing the subtask information to a corresponding robot through the task allocating module of the executing module, the executing module is used for allocating tasks according to subtask difficulty, duration and current load of the robot, and the path planning module is used for sending planning path information and controlling collision-free operation based on the position state of the robot. According to the invention, through a multi-module collaborative task intelligent allocation mechanism, dynamic obstacle avoidance path planning based on an artificial potential field method and a multi-terminal self-adaptive adjustment strategy, multi-robot operation load balancing, path collision-free and environment dynamic adaptation are realized, and the collaborative efficiency and safety are remarkably improved.

title_en: ESN and SSA-based dynamic optimization control method and system for performance of air conditioner room
abstract_en: The invention provides an air conditioner room performance dynamic optimization control method and system based on ESN and SSA, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting real-time operation data of an air conditioner room; the method comprises the steps of inputting real-time operation data of each device into a pre-built ESN model of each device, dynamically generating operation stability of each device according to the real-time operation data, constructing a multi-objective optimization function by combining the ESN energy consumption model and the operation stability of each device, searching an optimization control strategy of the device by adopting an SSA algorithm, executing the optimization control strategy, collecting device feedback data, rolling and updating an input sequence of the pre-built ESN energy consumption model, and carrying out model updating iteration for forming a control strategy of a next control period. The invention constructs the multi-objective optimization framework which simultaneously meets the minimum total power of the system and the maximum operation stability of the equipment, and can ensure that the energy efficiency and the operation stability of the machine room are kept optimal under the condition of dynamic changes of the load and the state of the equipment of the machine room.
