title_en: Asphalt pavement maintenance data processing method and system considering multidimensional influence factors
abstract_en: The application provides an asphalt pavement maintenance data processing method and system considering multidimensional influence factors, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and comprise the steps of firstly determining a target pavement, acquiring the multidimensional influence factors corresponding to the target pavement in a target maintenance period, then, based on the multidimensional influence factors, and obtaining the target pavement from the server, then obtaining target loss data of the target pavement in the target maintenance period based on the data in the server, and finally predicting the actual loss data of the target pavement in the target maintenance period based on the target loss data. According to the asphalt pavement maintenance data processing system considering the multidimensional influence factors, under the condition that the data volume is enough, data detection can be carried out on a larger range or a larger number of pavement, and maintenance strategies are executed according to pavement loss, so that labor cost is saved.

title_en: Intelligent evaluation method for service performance of tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent evaluation method of tunnel service performance, which relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering, and comprises the steps of selecting a key tunnel defect type, designing service performance evaluation indexes, collecting sample data required by tunnel service performance evaluation to form an evaluation index data set, and grading part of tunnel samples according to the tunnel service performance evaluation indexes by an expert in the field of tissue tunnel engineering to obtain tunnel service performance scores. According to the invention, a plurality of basic machine learning models are integrated through a Bayesian model averaging method to form the tunnel service performance evaluation super model, the advantages of each basic machine learning model are fully utilized, and meanwhile, the defects are compensated, so that the accuracy and stability of grading are remarkably improved.

title_en: Credit card refusal early warning, anti-dialect and guarantee to pay compensations processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic commerce transaction safety, and discloses a credit card rejection early warning, anti-debt and guarantee to pay compensations processing method, wherein the invention can inform a merchant of impending rejection before rejection initiation by using a rejection early warning technology of a trade company, so that the merchant has enough time to process, eliminate the rejection by using active refund, avoid loss by stopping shipping and interrupting transaction, automatically collect information required by anti-debt by using the trade company through technical means, through the recognition of the rejection reasons and the combination of understanding of card group rules and anti-debate requirements of card issuing rows, a set of complete and professional anti-debate materials is arranged for merchants, so that the anti-debate victory rate is greatly improved, services such as merchant responsibility judgment, merchant loss pricing and the like are provided for insurance companies through cooperation of trade companies and insurance companies, and rejection insurance schemes based on rejection flows are designed for the insurance companies, so that the merchants acquire collection security through insurance application.

title_en: Social session risk type identification method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of user management, and provides a risk type identification method and device for social sessions, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining information to be detected, wherein the information to be detected comprises session information and related information thereof; obtaining a first risk type label and initial confidence coefficient thereof according to information to be detected, obtaining a prompt word character string according to the first risk type label if the initial confidence coefficient is not smaller than a first threshold value, inputting the prompt word character string into a large language model to obtain the first confidence coefficient of the first risk type label, and judging that the information to be detected is a risk type corresponding to the first risk type label if the first confidence coefficient is not smaller than a second threshold value.

title_en: Digital standard-based power grid operation digital intelligent review system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field and provides a digital standard-based power grid operation digital intelligent review system which comprises a platform front page, a digital standard middle platform and an intelligent review platform, wherein the platform front page is a total portal accessed by the whole platform and is used for realizing single sign-on and registration, the digital standard middle platform is used for checking a data document, automatically checking up a reference standard, searching up a reference document which does not meet the latest standard in the data document and pushing the latest standard information, and the intelligent review platform is used for extracting regional information of a file and a picture, automatically analyzing the extracted regional information, obtaining transmitted review data after analysis and intelligently reviewing the transmitted review data. The invention can automatically analyze and intelligently review the data after sending the review data, realizes the automation and the intellectualization of the review process, and improves the review efficiency and the accuracy.

title_en: GEP-based regional item recommendation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a regional item recommending method and device based on GEP and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to a received scheme recommending instruction, and calculating a GEP increase difference value of the current year of a target region indicated by the scheme recommending instruction; based on the GEP increment difference value of the current year, performing multi-objective optimization on all candidate items corresponding to a target area by adopting a non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm to obtain a plurality of item recommendation schemes, wherein the item recommendation schemes are used for realizing the filling of the GEP increment difference value of the current year of the target area, calculating a target index value and a comprehensive index value of each item recommendation scheme, generating an item recommendation report of the current year, analyzing the characteristics of each group of item recommendation schemes for users more deeply, and better helping the users to select items suitable for the area.

title_en: Industrial maintenance operation management system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of maintenance management of industrial production lines, in particular to an industrial maintenance operation management system and method based on artificial intelligence, comprising the steps of comprehensively analyzing the importance degree of fault equipment on the industrial production lines and the recovery production adaptability of the fault equipment after the repair by corresponding maintenance and repair plans; the method comprises the steps of importing importance degree analysis results of fault equipment on an industrial production line and recovery production adaptability analysis results of the fault equipment repaired by corresponding maintenance and repair plans into a plan execution risk assessment model, assessing the plan execution risk of the maintenance and repair plans, and selecting the maintenance and repair plans according to the plan execution risk assessment results of the maintenance and repair plans. Therefore, blind maintenance of the fault equipment can be avoided, the fault shutdown time is shortened through proper maintenance planning, the cascading losses caused by long-time shutdown are reduced, and the production benefits of enterprises are maintained.

title_en: Construction diagram auditing system and method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The application provides a construction drawing auditing system and method based on reinforcement learning, which are characterized by extracting multi-scale feature vectors from a construction drawing to be audited, determining a scene topology feature drawing of the construction drawing to be audited in actual application according to the multi-scale feature vectors, dividing the scene topology feature drawing into a plurality of conflict detection grids, carrying out association deconstruction on coupling conflicts among the conflict detection grids to obtain conflict domain feature tensors of conflict hot areas in the construction drawing to be audited, determining a cooperative feature aggregation drawing of the construction drawing to be audited according to the conflict domain feature tensors and the multi-scale feature vectors, carrying out anomaly analysis on the construction drawing to be audited according to the cooperative feature aggregation drawing in combination with the reinforcement learning model, and further outputting a partition anomaly localization drawing of the construction drawing to be audited. By adopting the scheme of the application, the influence of multidimensional conflict in the construction diagram on the scene compound rule evaluation in the construction diagram can be reduced.

title_en: Dynamic intelligent maintenance path planning method and system for generator set
abstract_en: A dynamic intelligent maintenance path planning method and system for a generator set relates to the technical field of intelligent maintenance of power generation equipment, and solves the problems of insufficient dynamic quantification of potential safety hazards and low response efficiency of sudden working conditions in traditional generator set maintenance planning. The method comprises the steps of constructing a constrained directed graph model based on a three-dimensional topological relation of equipment, enabling nodes to represent components to be overhauled, enabling edges to represent feasible moving paths, introducing a temperature risk sensing mechanism, dynamically adjusting safety coefficients in path edge weights, and designing an overhauling sequence with the lowest total cost for solving by a hybrid optimization algorithm. Through engineering verification, the invention can effectively reduce the risk of high-temperature operation, shorten the construction period and remarkably improve the operation and maintenance intelligent level of the generator set.

title_en: Shopping system based on WeChat applet and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of internet shopping, in particular to a shopping system based on a WeChat applet and a use method thereof, comprising the steps of acquiring shopping cart operation behavior sequence data through WeChat applet front end event monitoring; the method comprises the steps of extracting time dimension and space dimension characteristics, outputting decision vectors of three-dimensional orthogonal components through vector synthesis algorithm and orthogonal normalization, establishing a strategy template library, calculating Euclidean distance between the decision vectors and templates to match strategies, and adjusting intensity parameters according to vector module length. According to the invention, the user behavior is converted into the three-dimensional orthogonal vector purchase intention strength, the price sensitivity and the decision hesitation, each component is calculated through algorithms such as the logarithmic growth rate, the maximum time interval, the standard deviation and the like, so that the numerical expression of behavior characteristics is realized, the limitation of the traditional binarization model is broken through, the discrete operation behavior is quantized into the characteristic vector which can be calculated and compared, and a merchant can accurately analyze the user decision tendency from multiple dimensions.

title_en: Project progress chart time scale self-adaptive generation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a project progress chart time scale self-adaptive generation method, device, equipment and medium, and relates to the technical field of project supervision. The method comprises the steps of firstly continuously slicing a construction time interval, establishing a micro-epoch ruler sequence, then extracting control drawing elements from process progress data, calculating the adaptation width of the drawing elements based on patterns, labels and the like of the drawing elements, establishing a corresponding relation between the drawing elements and the micro-epoch based on the time sequence, distributing the adaptation width of the drawing elements to micro-epoch contained in the drawing elements, carrying out micro-differentiation on the drawing element width, and finally generating a time ruler according to the micro-epoch ruler sequence and the maximized width of the micro-epoch ruler sequence. The self-adaptive time scale of the time scale network diagram can be automatically generated according to the process progress, drawing efficiency and accuracy are improved, uniform distribution of drawing information is ensured, scale adjustment efficiency is improved, and adjustment difficulty is reduced.

title_en: Logistics distribution service evaluation method and device based on voice recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides a logistics distribution service evaluation method and device based on voice recognition, which are characterized in that a voice evaluation data set submitted by a user for logistics distribution service is received, voice transcription and feature extraction operations are carried out on the voice evaluation data set to obtain a text semantic sequence and a voice emotion parameter set corresponding to a voice interaction fragment, the text semantic sequence and the voice emotion parameter set are input into a pre-trained service evaluation reasoning model to carry out feature fusion and classification reasoning to generate a preliminary evaluation result comprising evaluation dimension scores and problem description labels, comprehensive evaluation grade and key improvement dimension information of the logistics distribution service are determined based on the evaluation dimension scores and the problem description labels in the preliminary evaluation result, and a service evaluation result is generated based on the comprehensive evaluation grade and the key improvement dimension information. The method solves the problem that the traditional evaluation result is difficult to directly support the service optimization decision, and improves the supporting effect of the evaluation data on the service improvement.

title_en: Reservoir intelligent prediction system and method based on multi-mode space-time fusion
abstract_en: The reservoir intelligent prediction system and method based on multi-mode space-time fusion integrate satellite remote sensing (NDVI, LST), radar monitoring (PI) and traditional climate parameters, build a multi-mode space-time feature fusion system of 15-dimensional feature vectors, introduce a space-time attention mechanism, dynamically weight features based on mutual information and Euclidean distance, strengthen key element association capture, design an event-driven extreme climate online learning framework, shorten model updating period through SGD algorithm, build a cross-basin element learning migration framework, and realize efficient adaptation of a new basin by using meta training and single-step fine tuning. The system comprises a training stage (feature fusion, network training, online learning and meta learning transfer) and an operation stage (data real-time access, dual-mode prediction and decision support), wherein the water storage quantity prediction error can be controlled within 5%, and the intelligent level of the scenes such as dynamic regulation and control of water resources, flood control and disaster reduction is remarkably improved.

title_en: Intelligent advertisement adjusting system for 7×24-hour emergency response
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent advertisement automatic adjusting system for 7×24 hours emergency response, which is used for identifying sudden events and influence degrees thereof in real time by monitoring multi-source text data, and intelligently judging response rhythm and strategy strength by combining a dynamically adjustable trigger threshold mechanism and event heat prediction based on a time sequence model. Aiming at similar historical events, the system supports a rapid migration response strategy, and the decision efficiency is remarkably improved. The policy reasoning module fuses the rules and the machine learning model to generate an optimal advertisement delivery scheme with multi-dimensional scores, and the advertisement scheduling module automatically executes policy adjustment. The feedback learning module is based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, and utilizes the advertisement effect real-time data to carry out iterative updating on the strategy model, so that closed-loop self-learning of prediction, execution, evaluation and re-optimization is realized.

title_en: Method for predicting withered water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting withered water, which belongs to the technical field of hydrologic forecasting and has the technical key points that the method comprises the following steps of collecting water level data of a river hydrologic station and rainfall data of a control river basin and determining a withered water sample. And carrying out data training set, verification set and test set division and design. The method comprises the steps of carrying out first-step optimization adjustment on super parameters of a prediction model by adopting an improved shampoo algorithm based on a training set so that the model can better predict samples on the training set, carrying out continuous optimization adjustment on the super parameters of the model by adopting a meta-learning algorithm based on different water level samples of a construction verification set so that the model can better predict a common water level and an extremely dead water level at the same time on the basis of the first step, carrying out optimizing the layer number proportion of a freezing network of the model based on a grid search algorithm so as to obtain the optimal freezing layer number, and carrying out parameter optimization and adjustment based on the design of the verification set and the three steps so that the prediction capability of the model on the dead water can be improved obviously.

title_en: Aeroengine group health evaluation method based on multi-working-condition dynamic clustering
abstract_en: An aeroengine group health evaluation method based on multi-working condition dynamic clustering belongs to the field of aeroengine health state evaluation. Firstly, carrying out cluster analysis on set parameters in engine operation data, carrying out merging treatment on small-scale abnormal clusters to obtain working condition class division results, secondly, constructing a health baseline data set, carrying out standardized pretreatment and nonlinear dimension reduction on sample data in the working condition class division results to obtain a low-dimension characteristic data set, thirdly, carrying out cluster analysis on the low-dimension characteristic data set by adopting a Gaussian mixture model, calculating average Markov distances between samples of each cluster class and a health reference center to obtain multi-level health grades corresponding to different cluster classes, and finally, constructing continuous health scores and obtaining a health grade judgment interval by fusing membership soft probability and sample individual Markov distances. The invention can effectively identify the health status characteristics under different working conditions, support individual difference modeling and group transverse comparison evaluation, and improve the accuracy.

title_en: Gas well oil pipe accumulated liquid height prediction method and system integrating particle swarm and decision tree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting the accumulated liquid height of a gas well oil pipe by fusing a particle swarm and a decision tree, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining production data of a gas well site, generating a gas well data set, preprocessing the gas well data set, and obtaining a preprocessed gas well data set; dividing the preprocessed gas well data set into a training set and a testing set, constructing a regression decision tree model of a fusion particle swarm algorithm, inputting the training set into the regression decision tree model of the fusion particle swarm algorithm for training, performing model parameter adjustment and optimization to obtain optimal parameter assignment of the regression decision tree model, retraining the regression decision tree model by the optimal parameter assignment, and predicting based on the regression decision tree model according to the testing set to obtain a prediction result of the accumulated liquid height of the gas well oil pipe. The method can judge the production condition of the gas well, accurately predict the accumulated liquid height of the oil pipe of the gas well with low cost, has high prediction precision, and can lay a foundation for the subsequent drainage and gas production process.

title_en: Salesperson scheduling method, salesperson scheduling system, intelligent terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a scheduling method, a system, an intelligent terminal and a storage medium for sales personnel, and relates to the technical field of computers, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting shift data and sales indexes in a history period, wherein the shift data comprise sales personnel and working periods corresponding to the sales personnel, and the sales indexes comprise sales data, sales activities, payment modes and passenger flow data; classifying sales indexes according to working time periods to obtain segmented sales indexes corresponding to the working time periods, generating employee images of sales personnel, training a scheduling influence factor model by taking the working time periods, the employee images and the segmented sales indexes as training samples, acquiring predicted influence factors of future time periods after the scheduling influence factor model finishes training, calling the scheduling influence factor model, and carrying out data processing on the predicted influence factors to obtain a scheduling scheme of the sales personnel. The application has the effect of improving the sales conversion rate of sales personnel.

title_en: Intelligent material rack device and method based on AIoT and graph retrieval
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent storage and discloses an intelligent material rack device and method based on AIoT and graph retrieval, wherein the device comprises a material rack body, an infrared matrix sensor array, a singlechip, an edge computing unit and a communication bus; the method comprises the steps of collecting two-dimensional space distribution vectors of materials through an infrared array, preprocessing the two-dimensional space distribution vectors through an edge computing unit, constructing high-dimensional feature vectors by fusing perception, positions and semantic attributes at a cloud end, storing the high-dimensional feature vectors into a multi-mode database, adopting a three-layer retrieval mechanism of coarse recall of a vector library, association reasoning of a graph database and path optimization when responding to a retrieval request, and utilizing a graph neural network to learn an implicit relation to generate a precise inventory decision.

title_en: Method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium for processing sign-dismantling data
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, an electronic device and a storage medium for processing sign-dismantling data, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a sign-dismantling service data set and generating a question set; preprocessing a question set to generate a question answer data set, carrying out answer copying through a preset large language model according to the question answer data set to generate a first question answer rewriting data set, screening to obtain a second question answer rewriting data set, constructing a positive and negative sample data set through a pre-training language model according to the second question answer rewriting data set, training the pre-training language model through a preset optimization algorithm to generate a target large language model, and inputting to-be-processed sign dismantling data into the target large language model for data processing to obtain a target processing result. The embodiment of the application can relieve the problem of lack of the marking data of the actual service scene, improve the stability and training effect of the processing of the sign-dismantling data and improve the accuracy and the correctness of the processing of the sign-dismantling data. The application can be widely applied to the technical field of artificial intelligence.

title_en: Automobile energy supplementing facility site selection method, equipment and medium based on digital twin and multi-mode decision optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides an automobile energy supplementing facility site selection method, equipment and medium based on digital twin and multi-mode decision optimization. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and preprocessing traffic, energy and city data, constructing an energy fusion knowledge graph, calculating energy supplementing requirements through path reasoning, and screening candidate points. And then constructing a digital twin model to carry out dynamic simulation deduction, combining a multi-objective optimization algorithm to output a Pareto optimal site selection scheme set, and screening a typical scheme through a TOPSIS method to form a final site selection scheme set. And finally, carrying out comprehensive scoring calculation on the patterns in the site selection evaluation model, and screening site selection patterns meeting the requirements. The method remarkably improves the site selection accuracy and the operation benefit, reduces the cost and the risk by dynamically analyzing the requirements, fusing multi-source data, virtual-real linkage simulation and multi-target optimization, realizes the transition from the empirical decision to the data-simulation dual-drive decision, and has remarkable technical advancement and commercial landing value.

title_en: Personnel abnormal behavior early warning method and system for accommodation service places
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel abnormal behavior early warning method and system for accommodation service places, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining multi-source comprehensive data of a plurality of accommodation service places, S2, digging potential features based on a TF-IDF technology, S3, taking basic features and the potential features of each accommodation service place as input, outputting abnormal behavior assessment results of each accommodation service place, S4, marking areas according to the abnormal behavior assessment results, and determining target risk places and target risk personnel according to the marking results, and early warning. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the possible abnormal behavior is mined from multiple dimensions, the supervision system of the accommodation service place is perfected, and the abnormal situation is early warned in advance.

title_en: Scheduling management system and method for hardware mold production process
abstract_en: The application discloses a scheduling management system and method for a hardware die production process. The scheduling management method of the hardware die production process comprises the steps of obtaining a hardware die order uploaded by a sales department, extracting die design image data from the hardware die order, inputting the die design image data into an AI-driven machining process analysis engine to obtain a recommended machining process list and sequence, after receiving confirmation instructions for the recommended machining process list and sequence provided by a technician, extracting a material demand list from the hardware die order, inputting the recommended machining process list and sequence and the material demand list into a productivity evaluation module to obtain an estimated feasible date of the hardware die order, extracting an expected feasible date from the hardware die order, and determining whether a delay delivery warning prompt is generated or not based on comparison between the estimated feasible date and the expected feasible date.

title_en: Landslide risk dynamic early warning method and system based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide risk dynamic early warning method and system based on a Bayesian network, which belong to the field of geological disaster intelligent prediction and comprise the steps of constructing a disaster causing factor data set, screening key factors based on a Pearson correlation coefficient and an information gain method, further utilizing an FP-Growth algorithm to extract association rules among high confidence factors, guiding the optimization of a Bayesian network structure, constructing a Bayesian network model with causal relationship, supporting an incremental learning mechanism based on a newly added landslide sample, dynamically updating a condition probability table, and combining a Bayesian forward reasoning result to realize landslide probability prediction and risk classification. The intelligent risk assessment and early warning system has the advantages of strong causal reasoning capability, high model structure expression capability, excellent prediction precision and support of real-time updating and risk partitioning, and is suitable for landslide disasters.

title_en: Digital agriculture automatic control management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural management, in particular to a digital agricultural automatic control management system which comprises the steps of utilizing a plant production status picture in a satellite acquisition area to divide the picture, dividing the picture into different areas, numbering the areas, utilizing a GPS positioning technology to match a farmland data sensor into the divided areas, acquiring a plant growth image training set, establishing a plant growth prediction model of an ST-LSTM architecture, inputting the plant growth image into the prediction model to obtain a trained model, inputting the divided image into the trained model to obtain a plant growth status prediction result, comparing the plant growth status prediction result with the plant growth model, judging the plant growth status, matching the corresponding areas according to the result, and supplementing nutrients in time according to data.

title_en: Special management method and system for education and study platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a special management method and a special management system for an education and research platform, wherein the special management method and the special management system comprise the steps of respectively checking the identities of the persons corresponding to each person to be checked in, issuing corresponding research tasks and research authorities, respectively obtaining authority exercise data generated when each person to be checked in executes the research tasks, constructing a research file of each person to be checked in according to the corresponding research authorities, constructing a research access path of the person to be checked in the education platform according to the authority exercise data, obtaining corresponding current research results and transmitting the corresponding research results to a corresponding login page for display, further analyzing research reports of all the person to be checked in under different disciplines, transmitting the research reports to a platform front page for display, and making a study plan for each student in the education and analyzing the study effect of the student in the education and research platform, so that the study effect of the student in the education and research platform is effectively improved.

title_en: Grouting operation robot cluster cooperation system and cooperation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grouting operation robot cluster cooperation system which comprises a grouting robot system and a grouting regulation and control center, wherein the grouting robot system comprises a plurality of carrier vehicles, a plurality of grouting operation modules and cleaning and waste liquid recovery devices, the grouting regulation and control center regulates and controls the operation of each device in the grouting robot system, the grouting operation modules are used for grouting operation, the carrier vehicles and each grouting operation module are detachably connected and combined to form a robot with a corresponding grouting operation function, the cleaning and waste liquid recovery devices are used for cleaning the carrier vehicles and the grouting operation modules and recovering residual slurry, the carrier vehicles are combined into the robot according to distributed tasks and the corresponding grouting operation modules and move according to planned travelling tracks, and each grouting module and each multicomponent grouting module are provided with a controller and an execution device for executing grouting operation, and the controllers are communicated with the grouting regulation and control center. The invention improves the construction efficiency and realizes unmanned, fine and full-flow automatic grouting operation.

title_en: Model training method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a model training method and electronic equipment. The model training method comprises the steps of obtaining historical demand data, wherein the historical demand data comprises a sequence that the demand quantity corresponding to commodity combinations of N brand price bands changes along with preset unit time, forming a plurality of eigenvoices corresponding to different demand quantity changing frequencies according to the historical demand data corresponding to commodities of the ith brand price band, respectively determining sample entropy corresponding to each eigenvoice function, clustering the eigenvoices according to the sample entropy to form an mth reconstruction data set corresponding to an mth sample entropy range, training demand prediction capacity of an mth frequency division model through the mth reconstruction data set, forming an ith sub-model corresponding to the ith brand price band according to Mi frequency division models corresponding to the Mi reconstruction data set, forming a target prediction model according to the N sub-models corresponding to the N brand price bands, and predicting the demand quantity of the commodity combinations. The embodiments of the present disclosure may improve supply chain management efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Production scheduling scheme generation method, system and device based on digital twin model
abstract_en: The invention provides a production scheduling scheme generation method, system and device based on a digital twin model, and relates to the technical field of digital twin, wherein the scheme comprises the steps of determining a process route according to order information; the process route comprises a plurality of working procedures and flow sequences among the working procedures, order information at least comprises delivery time, distribution table calculation is carried out on each working procedure in the process route according to the order information, the process route and preset parameters to obtain distribution table number, the distribution table number and the order information are input into a digital twin model which is built in advance so as to carry out simulation calculation by the digital twin model to obtain a simulation result, and a production scheme is determined according to the simulation result and the order information. According to the scheme, the production demand is accurately predicted, the production scheduling scheme is optimized, the production process is monitored in real time through the digital twin technology, the digital twin model is built, intelligent and flexible production management is realized, the efficiency, the delivery accuracy and the capability of coping with sudden events are effectively improved, and the intelligent transformation of the power assisting industry is realized.

title_en: Construction and transportation integrated management method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a construction and operation integrated management method, a construction and operation integrated management device and computer equipment, and relates to the field of construction engineering. The method comprises the steps of determining construction and operation management indexes corresponding to a foundation project, wherein the construction and operation management indexes at least comprise green supervision indexes and facility supervision indexes, the green supervision indexes are used for representing the influence of construction of the foundation project and operation of facilities obtained after the construction of the foundation project on the environment, the facility supervision indexes at least comprise operation indexes of the facilities obtained after the construction of the foundation project is completed, engineering data of the foundation project are obtained through all Internet of things equipment in a foundation site, index values of the foundation project under the construction and operation management indexes are determined according to the engineering data, and construction and operation management early warning is carried out on the foundation project based on the index values of the foundation project under the construction and operation management indexes. By adopting the method, the environmental influence of the foundation engineering can be managed, and the facilities obtained after the construction of the foundation engineering can be managed.

title_en: Power grid energy storage planning method, electronic equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application provides a power grid energy storage planning method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product, and relates to the field of power planning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining characteristics of flexible controllable loads in a power distribution network, constructing a virtual energy storage operation model corresponding to the flexible controllable loads according to the characteristics, building a corresponding power distribution network optimization planning model based on the virtual energy storage operation model, executing fuzzification operation on the power distribution network optimization planning model to obtain a fuzzification planning model, and solving the fuzzification planning model to obtain a virtual energy storage configuration result of the power distribution network. By the method, the construction and application costs of the corresponding energy storage system are reduced.

title_en: Multi-channel digital marketing data management system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-channel digital marketing data management system and method based on big data, which belong to the technical field of sample size, and concretely comprise a scene intelligent adaptation module, a sample size intelligent calculation module and a sample size calculation module, wherein the scene intelligent adaptation module is used for intelligently identifying and adapting a research scene after a user submits a research requirement and providing accurate parameters and algorithm selection basis for subsequent sample size calculation, and the sample size intelligent calculation module is used for firstly identifying key factors in the research scene, comprehensively analyzing the factors, calculating initial sample size, monitoring data change and external environment factors in real time, triggering a sample size dynamic adjustment algorithm, and calculating and giving an adjusted sample size suggestion. According to the invention, through a risk assessment function, various risks possibly faced in research can be analyzed by utilizing an algorithm, risk indexes are quantized and an assessment report is provided, a previous mode of determining sample size by means of subjective experience of researchers is changed, and a decision is made more objectively and scientifically.

title_en: Intelligent early warning and self-adaptive regulation and control platform driven by digital twinning of water affair system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy project intellectualization, and discloses an intelligent early warning and self-adaptive regulation and control platform for digital twin driving of a water service system, which comprises the following steps of collecting multi-source data related to the operation of the water service system through Internet of things equipment to generate a data set with a uniform format; the method comprises the steps of integrating multi-source data through a cross-domain data fusion engine to generate a fusion feature set, analyzing causal relations among variables in the multi-source data through a time sequence causal reasoning engine to generate a dynamic causal graph, optimizing a system operation mode through information interaction among nodes to generate distributed cognitive data, generating a state graph of a water service system through a synchronous state graph visualization engine based on a topological network and the dynamic causal graph, generating a regulation command according to a multi-target cooperative regulation strategy, and updating the data set. According to the invention, through the cross-domain data fusion engine and the time sequence causality reasoning engine, abnormal events in the water service system can be accurately identified.

title_en: Intelligent prediction method and device for natural gas productivity of logging small-layer lamination test
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent prediction method and device for natural gas productivity of a well logging small layer test, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a plurality of target small layers of a target gas well reservoir according to acquired various well logging curve data of the target gas well, respectively constructing a corresponding productivity prediction machine learning model to predict single-layer daily gas yield and single-layer daily water yield, determining interference coefficients representing interlayer interference of the plurality of target small layers according to the plurality of target small layers, obtaining a combined production prediction result of the well logging small layers after interference loss is subtracted according to the interference coefficients, the single-layer daily gas yield and the single-layer daily water yield of each target small layer, and/or adopting a deep learning algorithm to establish a well logging small layer test productivity prediction model to output a combined production prediction result of the corresponding target small layer test. The method is used for improving the efficiency and accuracy of the natural gas well-testing productivity prediction.

title_en: Intelligent project performance evaluation and optimization platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of performance evaluation, and provides an intelligent project performance evaluation and optimization platform which comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data fusion module, an association rule deep mining engine, a self-adaptive dynamic performance evaluation model, a closed-loop optimization decision module and an intelligent interaction system. By integrating the advanced artificial intelligence technology and the project management theory, an intelligent, dynamic and closed-loop project performance evaluation and optimization platform is constructed, and the scientificity, the refinement and the intellectualization level of project management are greatly improved.

title_en: Wind-solar-energy-storage cooperative power financial decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar-energy-storage cooperative power financial decision-making method, belongs to the technical field of wind-solar-energy-storage cooperative power financial decision-making methods, and solves the problem that the wind-solar-energy-storage cooperative decision-making parameters are not collected by a conventional enterprise, and the wind-solar-energy-storage cooperative power financial decision-making method cannot be evaluated or has influence on evaluation accuracy when a large power grid is connected to perform power price operation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining regional meteorological data, regional new energy output data and electric market data through an external data access module, collecting enterprise total load power, energy storage running states and equipment parameters in real time through an enterprise local data collection module, and executing output and load decomposition calculation in a migration calculation engine. According to the invention, the regional public data and enterprise parameters are fused, the wind-light output estimated value and the decomposition load characteristic are generated by transfer learning, the electric power market bidding strategy is constructed by combining multi-stage robust optimization, the hedging risk of the financial derivative is dynamically configured, and the problem of price evaluation misalignment of enterprises due to the loss of monitoring data is solved.

title_en: Training evaluation method and device for electronic information equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an electronic information equipment training evaluation method and device, wherein the electronic information equipment training evaluation method comprises the steps of S1, constructing and deploying an electronic information equipment training environment, S2, performing electronic information equipment training operation by an operator based on training requirements and a current test environment, S3, completing acquisition of operation data of the electronic information equipment by the operator in real time in the electronic information equipment training process, and S4, collecting, analyzing and evaluating the self state data recorded by a test target in the training environment. The application provides a simulation environment for training, provides a solution for training data acquisition, and provides a usable means for training effect evaluation.

title_en: Custom map node visualization method based on business attribute dynamic rendering
abstract_en: The invention provides a service attribute dynamic rendering-based custom map node visualization method, which is characterized by receiving and verifying node style configuration in a JSON format, analyzing the node style configuration into an internal model comprising graphic definition, style, rules and positions, dynamically evaluating whether graphic elements are displayed according to the rules to generate a set to be rendered by combining node service data, and finally performing hierarchical rendering, namely firstly drawing basic shapes and styles, and then sequentially rendering dynamic elements conforming to conditions to finish node drawing. The user only needs to set rules and patterns through the configuration interface, drawing codes are not required to be written, the system can automatically and dynamically render the nodes with rich visual elements according to the service data, and the expressive force and the development efficiency of map visualization are greatly improved.

title_en: Energy storage power station site selection method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a system for selecting an energy storage power station, which relate to the technical field of energy storage power stations and comprise the steps of collecting a detection address of the energy storage power station and a power grid parameter of the detection address; the method comprises the steps of obtaining building specifications through the power grid parameters, calling a detection range from the detection addresses, obtaining the building ranges and reference parameters through the building specifications, defining the detection addresses larger than the detection ranges of the building ranges as selection addresses, calling the detection parameters of the selection addresses, matching detection weights from a preset detection comparison table through the detection parameters and the reference parameters, taking the selection addresses corresponding to the detection weights larger than the preset reference weights as mark addresses, and outputting the mark addresses to a preset display area. The application has the effect of improving the site selection efficiency of the energy storage power station.

title_en: Plastic packaging bottle precise forming method driven by three-dimensional simulation analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of plastic packaging bottle processing, and provides a three-dimensional simulation analysis driven plastic packaging bottle precise forming method. The method comprises the steps of processing orders interactively, extracting basic molding information to construct a three-dimensional simulation model, fitting production line equipment precision to generate a first molding influence coefficient, setting molding tolerance bandwidth, deriving the three-dimensional simulation model based on the influence coefficient and the tolerance bandwidth, processing samples according to preset parameters, acquiring simulation molding samples by utilizing the multi-point images, matching the derived model to obtain a target model, generating adjustment parameters by twin analysis, and controlling molding of the target plastic bottle. The application solves the technical problem of low control efficiency caused by the fact that the prior art only adjusts according to the three-dimensional simulation model of the finished product during processing and ignores the influence of the processing capacity of the processing production line, and realizes the effect of comprehensively considering the processing capacity of the processing production line and the tolerance interval of the quality of the finished product to determine the molding adjustment parameters, thereby improving the control efficiency.

title_en: Project risk monitoring and management method based on general large model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a project risk monitoring management method based on a general big model, which comprises the specific steps of constructing a field-enhanced project risk monitoring model based on the general big model of a transducer-Decoder structure, namely injecting project management knowledge base and historical risk cases into an Attention module of the general big model, dynamically accessing the field-enhanced project risk monitoring model into an project management system API, analyzing logical relations, resource allocation and progress deviation among project tasks in real time, carrying out multiple risk chain reasoning based on the logical relations, the resource allocation and progress deviation among the project tasks and the historical risk cases, generating a risk root map, synchronously matching intervention strategies and conducting paths of the project tasks, deploying a risk-strategy linkage detector, acquiring monitoring data and environment parameters of a construction site in real time, simulating a comparison scene without implementing the intervention strategies, quantifying actual benefits of the intervention strategies, and carrying out real-time adjustment on parameters of the big model.

title_en: Trademark registration method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a trademark registration method and device, which automatically compares the registration information of a trademark with forbidden registration information in a preset database and quickly and effectively determines whether the trademark can be registered. The method comprises the steps of obtaining registration information of an input trademark, automatically comparing the registration information of the trademark with forbidden registration information in a preset database to determine whether the trademark can be registered, determining whether the trademark is a trademark with registration risk according to whether a risk vocabulary is contained in the name of the trademark and/or whether the registered number of the trademark in the name of an applicant exceeds a preset value, and sending a risk warning to a user if the trademark is the trademark with registration risk.

title_en: Photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on multi-model fusion and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power prediction method, a system and electronic equipment based on multi-model fusion, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power prediction, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining photovoltaic power prediction results of a preset photovoltaic power station in a second preset time period respectively by utilizing each preset power prediction model based on photovoltaic power related data of the preset photovoltaic power station in a first preset time period, wherein the second preset time period is positioned behind the first preset time period in time sequence; and fusing all photovoltaic power prediction results based on the weight distributed to the photovoltaic power prediction results obtained through each preset power prediction model, so as to obtain a final photovoltaic power prediction result of the preset photovoltaic power station in a second preset time period. The photovoltaic power prediction method can provide more accurate photovoltaic power prediction for power grid dispatching, and assist the stable operation of the power grid and the efficient energy distribution.

title_en: Energy storage control method and device based on battery cycle attenuation, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage control method, a device, a terminal device and a storage medium based on battery cyclic attenuation, belonging to the technical field of energy storage control, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the capacity characteristic data of the battery and the stored energy data, an energy storage system capacity fading model for representing dynamic association between capacity fading and charge-discharge operation of the battery is constructed, meanwhile, various constraint conditions such as capacity fading constraint and the like are fully considered when the energy storage system profit model is constructed, so that the energy storage system profit model can be accurately solved under the energy storage system capacity fading model and related constraint conditions to obtain a target control strategy when the energy storage system profit is maximum.

title_en: Outbound reminding method, outbound reminding device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the fields of artificial intelligence, medical health and financial science and technology, and discloses an outbound reminding method, an outbound reminding device, outbound reminding equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of screening and analyzing service information to obtain target service information and a corresponding state of the target service information, triggering an outbound reminding program corresponding to the service information if the state corresponding to the target service information is not determined to reach the target service state, determining an outbound reminding scene and an outbound list corresponding to the service information according to the service information if the outbound reminding program is determined to be triggered, determining an outbound reminding robot and a corresponding outbound reminding parameter according to the outbound reminding scene, controlling the outbound reminding robot to execute a corresponding outbound operation according to the outbound list based on the outbound reminding parameter, and obtaining call content corresponding to the outbound operation and determining an outbound reminding result according to the call content if the outbound is successful. The application aims to solve the problems of lower outbound reminding efficiency and higher cost in the related technology.

title_en: Automatic segmentation method and device for high-consequence area of oil pipeline, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic segmentation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for a high-consequence area of an oil pipeline, wherein the method comprises the steps of merging any left identification object and at least one right identification object into a high-consequence area if any left identification object is intersected with at least one right identification object; if the length of any left identification object is smaller than the maximum length of the appointed high result area and the distance between any left identification object and at least one right identification object is smaller than the minimum splitting distance of the high result area, merging any left identification object and at least one right identification object into a high result area, if the distance between any two identification objects is larger than the minimum splitting distance of the high result area, splitting any two identification objects into different front and rear high result areas, and automatically splitting and merging the oil pipeline full-line identification objects to realize automatic segmentation of the high result area of the oil pipeline and improve segmentation efficiency.

title_en: Financial wind control decision method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a financial pneumatic control decision method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the field of artificial intelligence and comprise the steps of obtaining a user transaction request, storing the user transaction request in a target message queue, obtaining the user transaction request from the target message queue by using a first pneumatic control decision engine and a second pneumatic control decision engine, executing a target script chain by using a preset pneumatic control decision rule configured in the first pneumatic control decision engine to generate a first decision result corresponding to the user transaction request, generating a second decision result corresponding to the user transaction request by using a target risk reasoning model configured in the second pneumatic control decision engine, and fusing the first decision result and the second decision result by using a target dynamic weight algorithm to obtain a fused decision result corresponding to the user transaction request so as to execute corresponding target pneumatic control operation based on the fused decision result. The application improves the accuracy and service adaptability of the wind control decision.

title_en: Digital evaluation and parameterization combined construction method and system for urban micro wetland
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for digitally evaluating and parameterizing combination construction of urban micro-wetland, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting field multi-source remote sensing data by an unmanned aerial vehicle and preprocessing, digitally evaluating ecological factors of the field to obtain field characteristics, constructing a standard ecological factor coding tag set according to preset evaluation standards, distributing corresponding codes for the field based on the field characteristics, splitting ecological functions of the ecological factors into different splice functional components and forming a component library, judging field scene types and construction targets and determining adaptation conditions, calling parameterized functional component libraries based on the standard ecological factor codes, matching corresponding functional components according to the adaptation conditions and the adaptation rules, and parameterizing and configuring an output functional component coding combination configuration scheme to generate a design scheme of the urban micro-wetland. The application can improve the design efficiency of the urban small micro wetland design scheme.

title_en: Community fire control toughness optimization promotion strategy method and system based on complex network and ISM-MICMAC model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimizing and improving the fire-fighting toughness of a community based on a complex network and an ISM-MICMAC model, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a community fire-fighting toughness evaluation index system and defining an index association relation; based on the community fire-fighting toughness evaluation index system and the association relation, a community fire-fighting toughness complex network is established, key influence factors of the community fire-fighting toughness are defined, based on the factors and the association relation, the emergency degree and the importance degree of the factors are defined by using an ISM-MICMAC model, a community fire-fighting toughness grade matrix is established based on the emergency degree and the importance degree, the key influence factor optimization priority of the community fire-fighting toughness is defined, and a community fire-fighting toughness optimization promotion strategy is formulated. The method can realize grading of key factors of the fire control toughness of the community, construct a fire control toughness promotion strategy of the community, and provide powerful support for realizing omnibearing fire control toughness promotion of the community.

title_en: Ecological environment protection supervision and management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment protection, in particular to an ecological environment protection supervision and management system, which is pushed according to the principle of rapid deployment and gradual optimization by taking daily and special supervision and inspection processes of engineering projects as cores and considering the full life cycle supervision demands of the early engineering construction period, the construction period and the operation period, thereby constructing an efficient, scientific and systematic ecological environment protection supervision and management system, comprehensively improving the digital level of ecological environment protection and management, and providing effective supervision function guarantee and powerful and scientific support for ecological environment protection.

title_en: Method and system for controlling resource scheduling of production line
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of production line scheduling, in particular to a method and a system for controlling the resource scheduling of production lines, which comprises the steps of connecting end equipment of each production line through a parallel pipeline and a controllable valve to form a shared equipment resource pool, acquiring the operation data information of each production line when a production request is received, the operation data information comprises material flow and equipment load rate of the terminal equipment, calculation is carried out based on the material flow and a preset target yield, a demand calculation result is obtained, and the terminal equipment in the shared equipment resource pool is dynamically scheduled based on the equipment load rate and the demand calculation result. By constructing a shared equipment resource pool, the barrier of isolated resources of each production line in the prior art is broken, and the resource elastic allocation and sharing of the cross-production line are realized, so that the resource utilization rate of terminal equipment is improved, and the comprehensive output efficiency of the whole production system is improved.

title_en: Multi-energy complementary dynamic load management method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-energy complementary dynamic load management method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of power systems, and the method comprises the steps of predicting the electricity consumption and the electricity generation of energy equipment in a park and in a preset period by combining historical electricity consumption data and environmental information of the park; the method comprises the steps of calculating the sum of the residual stored electric quantity of energy equipment and the electric quantity of generated energy, calculating the difference value of the electric quantity of the energy equipment and the electric quantity of the energy equipment when the sum of the electric quantity of the energy equipment and the electric quantity of the energy equipment is smaller than the electric quantity of the energy equipment, generating a load guarantee coefficient of a park according to regional characteristics of the park, generating an initial electric quantity scheduling plan of the park according to the load guarantee coefficient, acquiring the charge and discharge characteristics of energy storage equipment, and adjusting the initial electric quantity scheduling plan according to the charge and discharge characteristics to generate a target scheduling plan. The method has the technical effects that the specific pertinence of the generated scheduling scheme is ensured, and the complex and changeable electric field scene can be effectively treated.

title_en: Intelligent evaluation method and system for distributed photovoltaic resources
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids and renewable energy sources, in particular to an intelligent evaluation method and system for distributed photovoltaic resources. The method comprises the steps of S1, calculating to obtain physical absorption capacity of a grid connection point based on collected static topological data and dynamic operation data of the power distribution network through coupling thermal stability constraint and voltage stability constraint, S2, calculating to obtain a light abandoning risk index by combining the physical absorption capacity with expected photovoltaic output predicted based on weather forecast data, S3, calculating to obtain total benefits after risk adjustment by combining the light abandoning risk index, the expected photovoltaic output and predicted market electricity price, S4, generating a photovoltaic investment value index through normalization processing based on the total benefits after risk adjustment and preset reference total benefits, and S5, outputting an investment decision support strategy by combining the photovoltaic investment value index and a preset value grading threshold. The invention overcomes the defect that the prior art adopts static and fixed limit values to evaluate, which results in the disjointing of the evaluation result and the actual running condition of the power grid.

title_en: Ship green fuel filling point position layout planning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship green fuel filling point layout planning method and device, which comprises the steps of determining a planning year and a planning range, dividing a harbor space unit, predicting filling demand of each space unit in the planning year by adopting a random forest algorithm based on ship AIS historical data, harbor throughput and green fuel filling data, calculating optimal economic cost of a supply chain by taking the minimum total cost of preparation, storage and transportation as a target through a mixed integer linear programming model, evaluating external conditions of each space unit from preset dimensions and generating scores, constructing an evaluation system containing indexes of the requirements, the costs and the external conditions, determining weights by adopting a hierarchical analysis method after standardized processing, weighting and calculating comprehensive evaluation values to determine a priority layout harbor region, and finally planning and filling a priority harbor region. By means of multi-source data fusion and multi-target optimization, scientificity and economy of filling point position layout are improved, and decision support can be provided for ship green fuel filling system construction.

title_en: Multi-dimensional evaluation method and device for power system planning based on safety, economy and green
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-dimensional evaluation method and device for power system planning based on safety, economy and green, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a candidate scheme set of power system planning; the method comprises the steps of calculating partition supply and demand balance capacity according to a candidate scheme set, extracting unit climbing rate of the candidate scheme set, extracting transmission channel transmission limit of the candidate scheme set, constructing power grid safety space-time constraint based on the partition supply and demand balance capacity, the unit climbing rate and the transmission channel transmission limit, embedding the power grid safety space-time constraint into a pareto screening process, restricting and filtering infeasible solutions through the pareto screening process, and generating a pareto front edge for power system planning multidimensional evaluation. According to the application, a multi-dimensional evaluation system covering safety, economy and green is constructed, and a pareto front edge and distance measurement method are combined, so that a planning scheme is comprehensively and systematically evaluated, the accuracy of identifying the advantages and disadvantages of the scheme is improved, and a scientific basis is provided for power system planning.

title_en: Intelligent matching and inventory management system for automobile wire harness production materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of material management in production and manufacturing, in particular to an intelligent matching and inventory management system for automobile wire harness production materials. The intelligent matching and the stock dynamic management of the automobile wire harness production materials are realized through the cooperative operation of the work order analysis module, the replenishment triggering module, the distribution scheduling module and the execution feedback module. The system is used for accurately calculating material demands and preparation rate based on production work orders and real-time inventory, generating an executable work order queue and predicting consumption standard, further realizing intelligent triggering of replenishment through dynamic replenishment points, carrying out priority ordering on replenishment instructions by combining multidimensional factors, and finally forming a management closed loop through execution feedback.

title_en: Integrated-aggregation prediction method and system considering prediction precision
abstract_en: The application relates to an integrated-aggregated prediction method and system for calculating prediction accuracy, which comprises the steps of obtaining wind power generation power data at the current moment and wind power generation power data in a period before the current moment, calculating by combining a pre-constructed wind power generation power prediction integrated-aggregated model based on the wind power generation power data at the current moment and the wind power generation power data in the period before the current moment to obtain a predicted value of the wind power generation power data at the next moment, wherein the wind power generation power prediction integrated-aggregated model is obtained by training and integrating a plurality of estimation-evaluation models comprising a predictor model and a classifier model by utilizing the wind power generation power data at the historical moment.

title_en: Data analysis method and device of photovoltaic and wind power integrated energy storage device
abstract_en: The application discloses a data analysis method and equipment of a photovoltaic and wind power integrated energy storage device, and relates to the technical field of data analysis for the photovoltaic and wind power integrated energy storage device. The method has the advantages that multidimensional power generation and energy storage data and future weather forecast values are obtained in real time, the weight is dynamically determined according to the wind-light fluctuation rate (the first weight is larger), the monitoring period is set according to weather, and the long-term adjustment weight of the power generation characteristics can be adapted. The charging and discharging scoring comprehensive multifactor combines equipment aging and power grid load threshold adjustment, has scientific instructions, can efficiently store electricity to avoid waste, timely grid-connected to protect power grid load, stabilizes power generation fluctuation, and improves system practicability.

title_en: Discrete commodity transaction processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a discrete commodity transaction processing method and a discrete commodity transaction processing system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining discrete commodity transaction request data, including image data, text prefix and voice; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing image data into unstructured images and enhancing the quality of text prefixes and voices, marking the data, designing a thinking chain based on the unstructured images and combining expert knowledge in the discrete commodity field, outputting structured transaction request text descriptions and forming image text pairs, training a visual language big model based on the image text pairs, inputting new discrete commodity transaction request data into the trained visual language big model, and outputting the structured transaction request text descriptions for automatically generating transaction records. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving the accuracy of discrete commodity transaction request text description, realizing automatic generation of transaction records and the like.

title_en: Calculation method and calculation system for background value of heavy metal environment of soil with land parcel scale based on steady statistics-iteration method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of calculation methods of heavy metal environmental background values of soil with a plot scale, in particular to a calculation method and a calculation system of the heavy metal environmental background values of soil with a plot scale based on a robust statistics-iteration method, which are used for obtaining soil heavy metal content data with a plot scale, wherein the soil heavy metal comprises thallium, the soil heavy metal content data obtained in the step one is subjected to normal distribution type inspection by adopting K-S inspection, the soil heavy metal content data is subjected to data decomposition according to the mixed distribution of the environmental background heavy metal-artificially discharged heavy metal based on the robust statistics-iteration method, and parameters of each sub-distribution are calculated based on a W estimation method in the robust statistics, so that the soil heavy metal content data obtained in the step one is subjected to normal distribution type inspection in two adjacent iterations And reaching a preset threshold value as an iteration termination condition.

title_en: Wind power prediction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a wind power prediction method, a device, equipment and a medium, which are used for acquiring historical wind power data and historical meteorological features, wherein the historical meteorological features correspond to a plurality of different feature categories, the historical wind power data and the historical meteorological features are subjected to correlation analysis through Pearson correlation coefficients, a plurality of target categories are determined from the feature categories, an initial wind power prediction model is established through an extreme learning machine algorithm according to the historical wind power data and the historical meteorological features under the plurality of target categories, the initial wind power prediction model is optimized based on a particle swarm algorithm, a target wind power prediction model is obtained, and wind power prediction is carried out through the target wind power prediction model. The method can effectively improve the prediction precision and generalization capability of wind power and solve the problem of local optimum caused by random initialization and non-stationary association in the traditional method. The application can be widely applied to the technical field of new energy.
