title_en: Market-adjusted data-driven team strength scoring for accurate event simulation
abstract_en: Embodiments disclosed herein relate generally to a system and method for updating a set of strength-based scores for sporting events using market information. The present embodiment provides a data driven method for determining updated team strength levels by utilizing market information immediately prior to a held event. For example, the predictive model may internally determine an initial team strength assessment value. The predictive model may also obtain future market information and update the initial team strength assessment value with the future market information.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating large language model of power industry by considering influence of data pollution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating a large language model of an electric power industry by considering the influence of data pollution, which belong to the technical field of large language model evaluation of the electric power industry, and the evaluation method comprises the steps of marking electric power elements in evaluation data, calculating the confusion degree of the electric power elements in the evaluation data, and calculating the calculated confusion degree and a confusion degree threshold value Comparing, if the confusion degree of the power elements in the evaluation data is evaluated Determining that the evaluation data is polluted, and rewriting the polluted evaluation data with the meaning of not changing sentences until the confusion degree of the electric power elements in the evaluation data is > The method comprises the steps of judging that evaluation data meet requirements, calculating weights for the evaluation data meeting the requirements, and obtaining an evaluation score by taking a weighted average value of the language large model answer scores of the power industry by using the calculated weights. The invention considers the influence of data pollution on the evaluation result, and the evaluation result can more accurately reflect the real capability of the large language model of the power industry.

title_en: Judicial evidence-preserving data analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a judicial evidence data analysis method and a judicial evidence data analysis system, relates to the field of judicial evidence management and data analysis, and has the advantages of overcoming the defect of dependence of traditional time stamps, being beneficial to restoring real time sequences of events, being capable of identifying the logical contradictions among the evidence by analyzing the key information in the evidence, overcoming the defect of dependence of the traditional time stamps, being beneficial to restoring the real time sequences of the events and improving the fairness of judicial.

title_en: Child reading level prediction method and system based on drawing book reading record
abstract_en: The invention discloses a children reading level prediction method and a children reading level prediction system based on a drawing reading record, which comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting ecological behavior data in a parent-child co-reading process, wherein the ecological behavior data at least comprise drawing book-child interaction data, parent-child interaction data and child-reading content feedback data; the ecological behavior data is preprocessed, a plurality of characteristics are extracted and standardized coding is carried out, the characteristics at least comprise a drawing book, key illustration touching rate of children interaction dimension, page turning force entropy value and confusing expression duty ratio, the multi-modal ecological behavior data system is constructed by collecting drawing book, children interaction data, parents, children interaction data and children-reading content feedback data, physical interaction details, language interaction quality and children cognitive feedback in the parent-child co-reading process are comprehensively captured, and the unilaterality caused by dominant data such as reading duration, frequency and the like is avoided.

title_en: Distribution transformer replacement decision method, device and nonvolatile storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution transformer replacement decision method, a distribution transformer replacement decision device and a nonvolatile storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining electricity consumption of a current distribution transformer at a plurality of moments in a first preset historical period and electricity generation of a plurality of distributed power sources in a target platform area at a plurality of moments in a second preset historical period, predicting the sum of the electricity generation corresponding to the plurality of moments of all the distributed power sources in the target platform area in a preset future period, determining the future heavy overload proportion of the current distribution transformer based on the sum of the electricity generation and the electricity consumption of the current distribution transformer at the plurality of moments in the first preset historical period, judging whether the future heavy overload proportion exceeds a preset proportion threshold, and determining to replace the current distribution transformer under the condition that the future heavy overload proportion exceeds the preset proportion threshold. The invention solves the technical problem that the improper selection of the distribution transformer affects the stability and the economy of the power grid.

title_en: Unit combination optimization method driven by large language model
abstract_en: A large language model driven unit combination optimization method relates to the technical field of electric power systems and comprises the steps of obtaining economic operation basic data of an electric power system, constructing an integer relaxation safety constraint unit combination model according to the economic operation basic data, solving the unit combination model, further obtaining the unit combination model, solving the unit combination model, constructing a variable dimension reduction algorithm, a constraint dimension reduction algorithm and an infeasible solution restoration algorithm, sequentially carrying out single algorithm evolution on the variable dimension reduction algorithm and the constraint dimension reduction algorithm by adopting the large language model, carrying out single algorithm evolution on the infeasible solution restoration algorithm by adopting the large language model, solving and calculating the unit combination model after the integer relaxation safety constraint, calculating the variable constraint dimension reduction safety constraint unit combination model to obtain an optimal solution, and restoring the optimal solution of the variable constraint dimension reduction safety constraint unit combination model based on the optimal infeasible solution restoration algorithm to obtain a result, wherein the method is used for solving the problem that the conventional model dimension reduction method is insufficient in terms of generality, stability and interpretability.

title_en: Intelligent matching performance system and method for green electricity retail transaction, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent matching performance system, method, medium and equipment for green electricity retail trade. Firstly, the intelligent contract checks, gathers, stores order information and traces back data according to green electricity retail packages, generates the trading details of the marketing user numbers and green electricity types of the electricity selling companies and (retail) users, intelligently calculates the highest distributable electric quantity of each green electricity type of each marketing user number, and provides basic data for subsequent matching. And then, accurately matching the retail side green electricity wholesale contract with the green electricity wholesale contract of the same power supply type in the wholesale market of the electricity selling company, and constructing a chain type relation. And finally, setting up an elastic performance and dynamic regulation mechanism of the electricity selling company, wherein the electricity selling company can adjust and distribute electric quantity in a window period, the electric quantity performance takes the minimum value of the three, and the price performance is restricted to the wholesale price and does not exceed the retail price, so that the complete performance of the transaction is ensured.

title_en: Recycling management system and method for building material degradable material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building material recycling management, and discloses a recycling management system and method for a degradable building material. The system comprises a material characteristic extraction network, a state prediction model network and a recycling optimization module. The material characteristic extraction network generates initial characteristic space representation data and current characteristic space representation data according to degradation monitoring data of the building material degradable material, the state prediction model network predicts a recovery state change sequence of the material by combining the initial characteristic space representation data and the initial degradation monitoring data, the recovery optimization module compares the current characteristic space representation data with the material states on the predicted recovery state change sequence, calculates optimization parameters of each current material state, and the intelligent agent learns a strategy for maximizing expected accumulated optimization indexes according to the optimization parameters to obtain the optimization parameters of the current degradation monitoring data so as to guide the recovery recycling process of the building material degradable material.

title_en: Dynamic deposit allocation method based on user consumption behavior and risk factors
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of financial science and technology insurance, in particular to a dynamic deposit allocation method based on user consumption behavior and risk factors, which comprises the steps of firstly encrypting consumption and health data at a terminal, constructing a heterogeneous hypergraph by a cloud end, and generating a user graph for embedding by using a self-adaptive shielding variation code; the invention discloses a method for realizing millisecond-level personalized guarantee configuration, privacy-friendly fund management and automatic payment, which comprises the steps of inputting an embedded amplitude into quanta, randomly walking, constructing Ha Midu quantity discrete evolution according to an edge weight to obtain an interference kernel, optimally transmitting the interference kernel through entropy regularization Sinkhorn to be aligned with historical claim settlement distribution, outputting risk shares, casting a insurance token according to the shares by an intelligent contract, pricing a circuit by using a neuromorphic memristor, injecting the token into an unexpected, serious illness and clinic three dangerous seed pool, selling the amount token such as a damaged token in a preset threshold value and completing payment when a claim settlement request of zero knowledge proof is received, and updating a causal model by a write-back event.

title_en: Satellite final assembly state visualization method and system based on flow and lightweight model
abstract_en: The invention provides a satellite assembly state visualization method and system based on a flow and a lightweight model, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, simplifying a satellite assembly model, removing irrelevant detail features in each product model, retaining outline features and forming the lightweight model, S2, setting the assembly flow of a satellite based on the lightweight model, defining the assembly stage of the satellite, S3, planning the satellite in each assembly stage to be used for testing and testing a product needing to be assembled to form the satellite assembly state requirement of the stage, and S4, forming a satellite assembly state design model according to the satellite assembly state requirement of each assembly stage and generating an assembly state implementation model according to feedback values of product state implementation parameters. The invention not only promotes the information bidirectional flow of the design and manufacturing links, but also promotes the development of satellite assembly to digital and visual development.

title_en: Method and system for managing whole-flow service of aero-engine test
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for managing an overall process service of an aeroengine test, which belong to the technical field of overall process service management, and are characterized in that structured data are determined by extracting information in test project information documents and test personnel information documents, an initial test plan is formed based on the structured data, the initial test plan is subjected to test personnel allocation optimization to determine a target test plan, the target test plan is generated based on the target test plan, the target test card is continuously updated by adopting an editable blockchain according to data in the test process until the test is finished, and after the test is finished, operation authority of the target test card is removed to form the overall process service data of the aeroengine test which cannot be tampered and is decentered. The information utilization efficiency of each link is effectively improved, the distribution rationality of test personnel is improved, and the safe storage of test data is ensured.

title_en: Glass fiber composite material intelligent production method and system based on multi-target genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glass fiber composite material artificial intelligence production, in particular to an intelligent glass fiber composite material production method and system based on a multi-objective genetic algorithm; the method comprises the steps of firstly combining order tasks with real-time dynamic parameters of production lines to generate target production tasks of each production line, then implementing differentiated task adjustment for different fault scenes, adopting waiting maintenance or directly starting alternative schemes or carrying out task splitting according to fault maintenance duration and whether other production lines have executed target production if the current production line fails before executing the target tasks, adopting waiting maintenance or carrying out partial task splitting according to the fault maintenance duration if the current production line fails after executing the target tasks, or dividing the production line tasks into other production lines, and replacing manual subjective decisions to realize accurate quantitative judgment of fault response and improve production flexibility and intelligence.

title_en: Enterprise energy intelligent monitoring analysis method and system based on multidimensional analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise energy intelligent monitoring analysis method and system based on multidimensional analysis, which relate to the technical field of industrial energy efficiency management and realize dynamic sensing of environmental states in a steam pipe network area by collecting environmental disturbance data and constructing an environmental disturbance data set S and combining a thermal-wet transition index YQ and a pressure disturbance coefficient Meanwhile, the latent heat loss index Qr and the comprehensive risk score PF are introduced, quantitative analysis and risk level grading response are carried out on energy leakage of a steam pipe network, and the system has higher abnormality identification precision and risk early warning reliability through fusing environment, structure and energy consumption multidimensional factors, so that the intelligent monitoring and active management and control capability of an enterprise energy system is improved.

title_en: Operation and maintenance method and system for ultra-high-speed optical module production equipment based on three-dimensional modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation and maintenance method and system of ultra-high speed optical module production equipment based on three-dimensional modeling, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting images of the ultra-high speed optical module production equipment to be tested from multiple angles, constructing a three-dimensional real object model of the ultra-high speed optical module production equipment to be tested, collecting images of key components of the ultra-high speed optical module production equipment to be tested from multiple angles, solving current pose information of the key components, inputting the current pose information of the key components into a pre-constructed three-dimensional model, assembling and calibrating to obtain a three-dimensional standard model of the current pose of the ultra-high speed optical module production equipment to be tested, carrying out point cloud registration and error analysis on the three-dimensional real object model and the three-dimensional standard model, and taking an error analysis result as reference information for correcting the ultra-high speed optical module production equipment. The invention can improve the operation and maintenance efficiency of the ultra-high speed optical module production equipment and meet the real-time operation and maintenance requirements.

title_en: Method, system and medium for estimating SOC of energy storage lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium batteries, in particular to an energy storage lithium battery SOC estimation method, an energy storage lithium battery SOC estimation system and an energy storage lithium battery SOC estimation medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining power step response data of an energy storage lithium battery, collecting battery voltage dynamic change characteristics based on the power step response data, evaluating electrochemical response activity conditions based on the battery voltage dynamic change characteristics, carrying out least square fitting processing on the electrochemical response activity conditions, establishing transfer function relation data of power change and voltage response, and measuring steady-state voltage values of different power levels in a plurality of SOC states according to the transfer function relation data, so that a three-dimensional mapping database of the SOC states, the power levels and the steady-state voltages is constructed. The invention utilizes the power switching instant detection triggering technology to accurately capture and synchronize the execution time of the scheduling instruction, realizes the synchronization of the prediction calculation and the actual power change, and ensures the real-time response capability in the frequency modulation application of the power grid.

title_en: Database generation method, system, device, program product and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a database generation method, a system, equipment, a program product and a storage medium, which acquire target risk data based on a target business strip line and a target business system; carrying out standardized processing on the target risk data to obtain standardized risk data; and storing the standardized risk data to obtain a risk database. The standardized risk data is stored in a centralized manner to form a risk database, the database can directly provide data service for an external application system, replaces a traditional repeated storage mode to save IT resources, lays a foundation for improving centralized computing force, and comprehensively adapts to requirements of digital risk management of an insurance group on data integrity, timeliness, accuracy and sharing.

title_en: Workflow generation method and device integrating large language model and knowledge base
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a workflow generation method and device integrating a large language model and a knowledge base, and aims to solve the problem of lower accuracy of workflow automatic generation based on the large language model in the prior art; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a workflow definition model, searching an enterprise private knowledge base according to multi-dimensional context information to obtain a domain knowledge segment related to workflow generation, guiding and restricting a large language model by taking workflow demand description, the multi-dimensional context information and the domain knowledge segment as prompt words to generate the workflow definition model, and finally creating a target workflow based on the workflow definition model by adopting a workflow engine, so that the accuracy of natural language processing of automatic workflow generation can be improved, the workflow is highly matched with the actual business demand of an enterprise, and the method can be applied to the technical field of intelligent management of business processes.

title_en: Dynamic coupling identification method and device for carbon sequestration environment risk
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a carbon sequestration environment risk dynamic coupling identification method and device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining monitoring data and receptor data of a target area of carbon dioxide geological sequestration, calculating a monitoring index value based on the monitoring data, carrying out risk classification on the target area based on the monitoring index value to obtain an initial risk level of the target area, simulating a carbon dioxide diffusion path by using a multi-field coupling model to obtain a carbon dioxide concentration equivalent graph, carrying out risk classification on the carbon dioxide concentration equivalent graph based on the carbon dioxide concentration ratio of different positions in the carbon dioxide concentration equivalent graph to obtain a classification result, inputting the monitoring data, the receptor data and the classification result into a random forest model to obtain a vulnerability level, fusing the classification result with the vulnerability level, and determining the target risk level based on the fusion result. The scheme can realize that the accuracy and the rationality of carbon dioxide emission risk identification are improved.

title_en: Method for predicting heavy metal pollution space risk of retired electroplating heavy metal site
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the space risk of heavy metal pollution depth of a retired electroplating field, which aims to provide an efficient, accurate and economic prediction scheme, integrates three innovation points of a Stacking integrated learning model, predicting deep pollution by surface data and evaluating the space risk of a sensitive receptor, and solves the problems that the traditional method depends on a large amount of drilling, has high cost and cannot comprehensively evaluate ecological and health risks. The method comprises the steps of 1, obtaining site history investigation, surface layer environment characteristics and multi-source data of a key point vertical profile, 2, grading surface soil risks by a pollution load index method and quantifying the vertical profile risks by a ground accumulation index method, 3, constructing a two-stage hybrid model, predicting surface layer risk distribution by Stacking, and 4, generating a three-dimensional risk distribution map, and accurately identifying and early warning a high risk area by combining a BP neural network with the surface layer risk prediction deep vertical pollution. The method combines horizontal and vertical prediction to comprehensively and accurately evaluate the three-dimensional risk, and provides scientific basis for site repair, management and control and redevelopment.

title_en: Balanced control method and system for dynamic health weight group network of lithium battery energy storage cluster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of battery energy storage, in particular to a balance control method and a balance control system for a dynamic health weight group network of a lithium battery energy storage cluster, wherein a health weight group network is built in the energy storage cluster, and single batteries are connected in parallel through a DC-DC converter to realize bidirectional power flow; the method comprises the steps of constructing a health degree evaluation model based on a topological graph neural network, constructing a battery topological relation graph by taking single batteries as nodes and connecting DC-DC converters as edges, acquiring voltage, current, temperature and cycle history data of the single batteries, generating a health degree evaluation result based on the evaluation model, constructing a health degree weight vector comprising a capacity contribution rate, a power contribution rate and an aging rate through a homolunar path optimization algorithm, and obtaining rated current set values of the single batteries based on the health degree weight network and the health degree weight vector through predictive control optimization of the distributed model, so that dynamic balance of the single batteries in a cluster is realized, the evaluation precision of the health state of the single batteries is remarkably improved, and the whole service life of an energy storage cluster is prolonged.

title_en: Artificial intelligence model training method for education evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligent model training method for education evaluation, which comprises the steps of obtaining learning track data of students from a multi-source heterogeneous learning behavior database through a distributed data acquisition node, extracting a learning behavior feature sequence through a deep semantic analysis algorithm to generate an initial learning behavior feature vector, carrying out time sequence alignment processing on the learning behavior data according to the initial learning behavior feature vector, judging the matching degree of the aligned feature vector and a preset evaluation standard template, determining preliminary matching of the learning behavior if the matching degree exceeds a preset threshold, and extracting historical learning record data of the students from a distributed storage system.

title_en: Multi-space-time coupling planning method, system, device and medium for regional power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of regional power distribution network planning, in particular to a regional power distribution network multi-space-time coupling planning method, a system, a device and a medium, which comprise the steps of firstly constructing wind power, photovoltaic and load prediction space-time models, combining source network load storage dynamic coupling characteristics to build a power distribution network operation model, and then synthesizing influence of multiple aspects, and constructing a lower-layer optimization model and a planning model, then establishing a power supply side, a power distribution network side, an energy storage side and a network loss multidimensional coupling model, then introducing the lower-layer model to construct an upper-layer optimization model based on a multi-space-time scale supply-demand matching relationship, and finally solving through the double-layer planning model to output the optimal power output characteristic. According to the invention, the dynamic coupling characteristic of the source network load stored under the multi-time space scale is considered, the time space change rule of the new energy output and the load demand is established through the space-time prediction model and the operation model, the double-layer planning model is constructed, the cooperative optimization of short-term cost and long-term targets is realized, and the safe and stable operation of the power distribution network is ensured.

title_en: Risk identification method, apparatus, device, medium, and program product
abstract_en: The application provides a risk identification method, a risk identification device, a risk identification medium and a risk identification program product. Relates to the technical field of risk identification. The method comprises the steps of obtaining content to be identified, which is input by a user, identifying at least one entity contained in the content to be identified, performing risk identification on the at least one entity by adopting a preset risk word database to obtain a first risk identification result, performing risk identification on the content to be identified by adopting a pre-trained word-slot negative content identification model to generate a second risk identification result, performing segmentation processing on the content to be identified by adopting a sliding time window with a preset window size to obtain a plurality of content segments, performing risk identification on each content segment to generate a third risk identification result, and determining the risk identification result corresponding to the content to be identified according to the first risk identification result, the second risk identification result and the third risk identification result. The method solves the problem of low risk identification coverage rate and accuracy, and improves the overall reliability of the large model.

title_en: Multi-dimensional fire safety management system based on Internet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional fire safety management system based on the Internet, which relates to the technical field of fire safety management systems and comprises a perception layer, a network layer, a platform layer and an application layer, wherein the perception layer comprises a user positioning module, an environment monitoring module and a people stream monitoring module, the platform layer comprises a data processing center and a decision engine, and the application layer comprises a user side APP. This multidimension degree fire control safety control system based on internet is when finding the condition of a fire and is evacuated, based on the people's flow on each evacuation route, is shunted by APP or broadcasting guide evacuation personnel, and through calculating in order to ensure that shunted personnel can safe evacuation to carry out emotion by the special man when evacuating the guide, prevent from evacuating on the route that people's flow is intensive and lead to crowding or trample from this, and effectively improve evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Transaction processing system and method based on authentication identity
abstract_en: A system and method for dynamically generating subscriptions and executing checkout requests is disclosed. The system includes a user equipment application and a server. The method includes issuing a subscription request, providing login information, issuing a registration request, and providing login information again. In addition, the method includes checkout without requiring the attendant to retrieve the customer's card.

title_en: Crop total growth period nutrient demand prediction method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a crop total growth period nutrient demand prediction method based on multi-source data fusion, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data through a field sensor network and an unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing platform in a crop total growth period, combining historical agricultural records and marking, constructing a multi-source data training set, dividing the weather phases and collecting time point sets according to the crop growth period, calculating the similarity of the time points by dynamic time regularity and performing self-adaptive interpolation to obtain interpolation data of each weather phase, constructing a multi-source fusion feature extraction and nutrient demand prediction model, realizing multi-scale fusion based on the interpolation data, combining the nutrient transfer extraction features among the weather phases and classifying, calculating and training a training optimization model through a loss function, and inputting the preprocessed collected data in a new planting scene into the trained model to conduct demand prediction. The method improves the accuracy of crop nutrient demand prediction, and can help improve the agricultural production efficiency and optimize the resource utilization.

title_en: Service recommendation method for digital text travel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of travel service recommendation, in particular to a service recommendation method for digital travel. The method comprises the steps of establishing a sequence set according to travel destinations browsed by a user on a travel APP, calculating the interestingness of each travel destination in the sequence set based on a browsing action track of the user on the sequence set, collecting interactive action data of the user on each travel destination on the travel APP, constructing a user-travel destination interactive graph based on the interactive action data, calculating the tendency of the user and each travel destination based on the user-travel destination interactive graph, determining a travel destination recommendation sequence based on the interestingness and the tendency of the travel destination, sequentially generating a travel route of each travel destination in the destination recommendation sequence according to the recommendation sequence of the destination recommendation sequence, and pushing the travel route to the user.

title_en: Method and system for obtaining port equipment operation and maintenance results based on scene perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for obtaining operation and maintenance results of port equipment based on scene perception, comprising the following steps of S1, receiving natural language query of a user about the operation and maintenance of the port equipment, S2, executing document offline processing and scene modeling, establishing association relation between a document block and a knowledge graph, S3, executing scene perception dynamic programming expansion, establishing a dynamic programming state table, recording optimal paths and scores of each entity under different expansion hops, guiding compound score calculation by using scene weight factors, judging whether continuous expansion can bring valuable new information or not through a marginal gain mechanism, controlling expansion depth through dynamic threshold attenuation, S4, executing multi-level knowledge organization, integrating a core spanning tree and a supplementary spanning tree in a hierarchical mode to form a final knowledge context, S5, inputting the final knowledge context into a large language model, and automatically reasoning and generating a solution text of the operation and maintenance of the port equipment.

title_en: Channel layout method, channel layout device, channel layout apparatus, channel layout storage medium, and channel layout program product
abstract_en: The invention provides a channel layout method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining input data corresponding to each grid in a geographic range to be laid out respectively, determining target grids in each grid based on the input data, wherein the input data comprises user position data, channel contact data and service handling data, the user position data reflects the position of a user, the channel contact data reflects the interaction condition of the user and a channel, the service handling data reflects the service handling condition, the layout priority of the target grids is higher than that of other grids in each grid, classifying candidate grids, determining the operation scene category of the candidate grids, wherein the candidate grids comprise target grids and neighborhood grids of the target grids, and generating a channel layout scheme of the candidate grids based on the operation scene category of the candidate grids. The invention can realize the improvement of the accuracy of channel layout.

title_en: Three-phase unbalance dynamic regulation and control method for power distribution network based on hybrid intelligent optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-phase imbalance dynamic regulation and control method for a power distribution network based on a hybrid intelligent optimization algorithm, which belongs to the field of power system automation and comprises the steps of collecting current values and initial phase sequence states of each single-phase load in a power distribution area, establishing a dynamic regulation and control model with minimum three-phase current imbalance degree and minimum switching action times as double targets, solving the model based on an improved genetic algorithm of a fusion experience knowledge guiding mechanism, a pareto optimal selection mechanism and a global and local collaborative search mechanism, generating a phase-change control instruction according to the obtained optimal phase-change scheme, and issuing the phase-change control instruction to a load phase-change switch for execution. The comprehensive improvement of the algorithm in the aspects of convergence speed, solution diversity and global optimality is realized by introducing a gene library to guide the propagation process, a multi-objective selection mechanism based on non-dominant sorting and a local optimization strategy combined with tabu search.

title_en: Distributed backup and recovery system for administrative management data of block chain guarantee
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain guaranteed administrative management data distributed backup and recovery system, which comprises a regional master node group module, a block chain bottom layer supporting module, an intelligent contract executing module, a data interaction module and a consensus verifying module, wherein the regional master node group module is divided into at least two levels of node groups according to administrative region levels, each level of node group comprises a plurality of backup nodes deployed in corresponding administrative regions, each backup node pre-stores regional master right qualification certificates of administrative regions to which the backup node belongs.

title_en: Big data-based energy management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy management method and system based on big data, belonging to the technical field of energy management, wherein the method constructs a digital twin model of an enterprise energy system through a digital twin modeling module, and establishes a physical and virtual real-time mapping relation; the method comprises the steps of integrating multidimensional data such as energy consumption, service operation, environmental parameters and real-time electricity price through a multisource data fusion module, generating a unified energy state feature vector based on self-adaptive fusion weights, learning an optimal energy configuration strategy through a reinforcement learning optimization module by adopting a deep Q network algorithm, evaluating the energy configuration effect in real time through a closed loop feedback adjustment module, generating feedback adjustment parameters and transmitting the feedback adjustment parameters to a front module, and forming a deep coupled closed loop cooperative system through the four modules.

title_en: End-to-end power transmission efficiency evaluation system applied to photovoltaic energy storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an end-to-end power transmission efficiency evaluation system applied to photovoltaic energy storage, which relates to the technical field of efficiency evaluation and comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and an efficiency analysis module, wherein the efficiency evaluation is carried out on the whole photovoltaic end, and when the efficiency evaluation is abnormal, whether the equipment loss of the photovoltaic end is abnormal or not is indirectly judged through the efficiency of a photoelectric conversion part of the photovoltaic end, so that the reason for the abnormal efficiency can be rapidly determined when the operation efficiency of the photovoltaic end is abnormal, in the operation process of each load end, the operation data of each load end in a time window are removed from the efficiency evaluation system through an efficiency screening mode, and the influence of the proposed load end on the whole power transmission efficiency of the photovoltaic end and the load end is indirectly judged through the change of the whole power transmission efficiency of the photovoltaic end after the removal, thereby realizing effective monitoring of the operation efficiency of the photovoltaic end and the load end.

title_en: Metal fitting production parameter optimization method and system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of machine learning technology, and specifically discloses a method and system for optimizing production parameters of metal parts based on machine learning. By integrating machine learning technology with real-time monitoring mechanisms, intelligent and adaptive management of the production process is achieved, thereby significantly improving production efficiency and product quality as a whole. This method can quickly respond to changes in the characteristics of new batches of raw materials, effectively reduce trial and error costs and resource waste in production through systematic parameter optimization and feedback adjustment, ensure the stability and consistency of the processing process, and enhance the adaptability of the machine learning based metal parts production parameter optimization system to complex conditions, providing reliable data-driven support for metal parts manufacturing.

title_en: Complex river forecast flood level risk quantitative evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a complex river channel forecast flood level risk quantification assessment method which comprises the steps of collecting historical actual measurement flood data of a hydrological station at an outlet of a river basin to be forecasted, judging a flow value range corresponding to a flood prevention characteristic water level, sampling and reading all water level values on all water level flow relation curves corresponding to flow at each interval end according to a certain flow interval, normalizing according to a mean value and a standard difference value of the water level values, merging the normalized values into a series, drawing a data histogram, judging a data distribution rule, judging whether a sample approximately accords with normal distribution from the histogram, judging whether the judgment is acceptable or not based on chi-  2  test, fitting the water level flow single-value curve by using a least square method to obtain a relation formula of average water level and flow, and finally assessing the probability of exceeding the flood prevention characteristic water level. The invention fills the blank that the deterministic flood level forecast cannot quantify risk assessment, and provides more abundant forecast information for flood control decision departments.

title_en: Financial data management method, system and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a financial data management method, a system and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting entity names from financial texts by using a natural language processing technology, generating a main body unique identifier in a disambiguation mode, constructing an entity knowledge graph according to the entity knowledge graph, marking relations and dynamically updating a network, calculating network centrality and other identification key nodes, analyzing risk conduction effects of the network, combining historical data and key node information, analyzing and capturing anomalies through time sequences, supplementing main body missing attributes through entity links, training relation classifier identification relations based on the knowledge graph and the like, receiving text updating networks in real time, and early warning in real time according to the network, the key nodes and the abnormal modes, so that the purposes of improving financial data management efficiency, supporting financial decisions and controlling risks are achieved.

title_en: Automatic weight picking and dynamic sorting treatment method for food processing industry
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic weight picking and dynamic picking processing method in the food processing industry, which relates to the technical field of computer application and comprises the steps of receiving package food data from a food processing line, wherein the data comprises a food ID, a production date, a quality guarantee period and a package weight, configuring weight picking rules for the package food, wherein the weight picking rules comprise an allowable weight error range, a minimum package weight and a maximum package weight, automatically picking and calculating the package food according to the weight picking rules, judging whether the package food meets weight requirements or not, marking the package food which does not meet the requirements, planning a picking path based on a dynamic optimization picking path algorithm according to order information and a warehouse model, and sending picking tasks to an execution system, wherein the picking tasks comprise the picking path.

title_en: Digital bus system passenger flow intelligent prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based intelligent passenger flow prediction method for a digital public transportation system, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting historical passenger flow time sequence data, public transportation topology, external events and knowledge rules to form a data set, S2, symbolizing the passenger flow time sequence data and constructing a self-evolution multi-scale graph structure, S3, identifying abnormal driving factors through causal inference to generate anti-facts scene data, S4, extracting multi-source features by adopting an improved TsFresh module fusion compression reconstruction mechanism, S5, carrying out knowledge distillation fusion modeling on a feature input multi-expert cooperative system, S6, combining the knowledge rules and neural symbol fusion to generate knowledge guiding features, and S7, outputting a public transportation passenger flow prediction and scheduling optimization scheme by utilizing a game theory mechanism. The invention improves the bus passenger flow prediction and intelligent scheduling level under complex scenes.

title_en: Large health food tracing system and method using plants as main raw materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large health food tracing system and a large health food tracing method using plants as main raw materials, wherein a germplasm environment tracing unit integrates a germplasm DNA bar code identification device and an environment monitoring sensor group (comprising a water quality heavy metal detector, a soil nutrient analyzer and an air particulate matter sensor) to generate a raw material base and planting environment compliance report, a geographic space-time data acquisition module comprises an image acquisition terminal with GPS positioning and time stamping functions and is used for uploading field images of raw material plant growth stages and harvesting links and automatically embedding longitude and latitude coordinates and acquisition time, and the multidimensional information acquisition and recording of the whole life cycle of plant raw materials from planting to circulation are realized through the cooperation of a plurality of modules such as the germplasm environment tracing unit and the geographic space-time data acquisition module, the raw material base, the planting environment, the growth process, the processing links and the like are covered, and consumers and supervision departments are ensured to acquire comprehensive and accurate tracing information.

title_en: Charging and discharging control method and system for intelligent automobile charging pile
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of charge and discharge control of charge piles, in particular to a charge and discharge control method and a charge and discharge control system of an intelligent automobile charge pile, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining that the intelligent automobile charge pile in a district power system enters a charge and discharge mode; the method comprises the steps of dividing an electric automobile into charging and discharging nodes, calculating the charging and discharging priorities of the charging and discharging nodes respectively, and controlling the charging and discharging of the charging and discharging nodes from large to small according to the priorities in a charging and discharging mode of an intelligent automobile charging pile in a district power system. According to the application, the charging and discharging modes of the intelligent automobile charging pile are adaptively controlled according to the real-time electricity demand and load conditions of residents, so that the superposition with the peak of the electricity consumption of the residents is reduced, and the running efficiency of the power grid is improved.

title_en: Production line digital twin intelligent simulation and analysis method and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of production line digital twin intelligent simulation and analysis scheme design, in particular to a production line digital twin intelligent simulation and analysis method and system and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital model of a physical production line to form a digital twin body, collecting multi-source operation data in real time and synchronizing the multi-source operation data to the digital twin body, carrying out process simulation and operation state analysis based on the multi-source data, generating a production line optimization strategy through an intelligent optimization algorithm, and feeding back the optimization strategy to the physical production line to execute closed-loop control. The system comprises a digital modeling module, a data acquisition and synchronization module, a process simulation and state analysis module, an intelligent optimization engine and a closed-loop control interface module. The transition from data visualization to intelligent decision making is realized through the intelligent optimization engine, the effective execution of an optimization strategy is ensured through a closed-loop control mechanism, the problem that the traditional digital twin technology lacks deep analysis and decision closed-loop capability is solved, and the production line operation efficiency and management level are remarkably improved.

title_en: Product quality life cycle management method of projection lamp for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a product quality life cycle management method of a projection lamp for a vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of quality management and specifically comprises the steps of disassembling a production recovery database of the projection lamp for the vehicle to be scrapped, generating a reliability coefficient curve of each part under each provider through statistical analysis of failure time data, analyzing co-occurrence data of multi-part failure in the same complete machine, calculating failure association coefficients among parts of different providers, automatically traversing and evaluating all possible provider combinations by combining the reliability coefficients and the failure association coefficients, generating a plurality of supply chain combination schemes by constructing a system survival probability model and integrating and calculating the expected reliability of the whole lamp of each combination, and screening out a target scheme by integrating cost parameters and expected reliability to guide production and establishing a traceable file for the product. The invention realizes the dynamic closed-loop optimization of the supply chain based on the inversion of the recovery data, and improves the scientificity and the accuracy of the product quality and the supply chain management.

title_en: Perishable food distribution system and method fused with nerve combination optimization model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a perishable food distribution system and method integrating nerve combination optimization models, wherein the perishable food distribution system comprises data simulation preprocessing, virtual customer division, maximum group grouping, nerve combination path planning, complete path merging and large neighborhood search optimization units. The method comprises the steps of firstly, splitting a virtual customer through data preprocessing, converting a multi-object demand customer into a single demand virtual customer, then grouping by using a maximum group algorithm with temperature compatibility as constraint, planning an initial path for each group through a pre-trained neural combination optimization model, and optimizing by a large neighborhood search algorithm of an improved operator after splicing. The invention integrates the high-efficiency searching and the accurate optimizing capability of large neighborhood searching of nerve combination optimization, realizes the distribution of perishable food with temperature compliance, optimal path and lowest cost, adapts to the requirements of multiple scenes, and improves the distribution efficiency and quality.

title_en: Realization method capable of verifying data asset transaction of Internet of things equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing data asset transaction of verifiable internet of things equipment, which is based on a data seller, a blockchain and a data buyer related to an internet of things data asset transaction system. The smart contract is responsible for verifying the integrity and authenticity of the data and transmitting the decryption key to the data buyer after verification passes. Finally, the data buyer decrypts the data using the key and completes the transaction. If the buyer finds that the decrypted data is abnormal, the intelligent contract is invoked to initiate arbitration. By obfuscating the encryption mode, RSA accumulator technique, hash verification mechanism and on-chain arbitration mechanism, these attacks are effectively resisted, ensuring the privacy, integrity and verifiability of data transactions.

title_en: Enterprise field expert semantic network construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of enterprises, which is used for solving the problems that in the construction process of the existing expert semantic network, the expert semantic network stays in an unstructured carrier for text files, manual records and experience summarization, so that the expert's capability boundary is fuzzy, the professional attribute lacks definite semantic connection, and systematic semantic link expression is difficult to form; in particular to a method and a system for constructing an expert semantic network in the enterprise field, wherein the method comprises a pre-dividing module, an updating module, a reconstruction module and a network construction module; according to the invention, through semantic hierarchy construction, relation extraction and network expansion mechanisms, deeper semantic modeling can be performed on the internal logic of expert knowledge, and the expert knowledge originally scattered in documents, experience records and unstructured texts can be uniformly extracted, analyzed and organized, so that the expert knowledge has expandability, relativity and scalability, and the integrity and accuracy of the expert knowledge in the enterprise field in the semantic depiction level are effectively improved.

title_en: Early warning method, device and program product for business network point-under-line transaction
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device and a program product for early warning business under a business network point line, which relate to the field of artificial intelligence and are applied to the field of financial science and technology; the method comprises the steps of extracting first transaction characteristics from text data, wherein the first transaction characteristics at least comprise first transaction behaviors and first transaction amounts, acquiring a to-be-executed instruction of a target object through an application program interface, extracting second transaction characteristics from the to-be-executed instruction, comparing the first transaction behaviors with the second transaction behaviors, comparing the first transaction amounts with the second transaction amounts, and triggering transaction early warning according to a first comparison result and confidence. The application solves the problem of wrong execution of the transaction caused by errors of transaction amount or wrong touch of a keyboard and the like in manual processing when a salesman of a business website processes the transaction of a customer in the related technology.

title_en: Policy selection and intelligent classification method for urban updating unit driven by time-context pedigree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strategy selection and intelligent classification method of a city updating unit driven by a time context pedigree, which comprises the following steps of forming a land block sample and a strategy template through multi-source data acquisition and standardization, calculating update potential by utilizing a multi-target benefit model, screening land blocks to be updated, clustering and selecting update test points, constructing the time context pedigree through randomization allocation strategy and periodic monitoring, screening optimal test points, forming update classification, combining similarity matching and space connectivity analysis to popularize to non-test point land blocks, automatically demarcating the updating unit, identifying strategy achievement, realizing dynamic strategy combination and feedback adjustment through multi-target optimization, and finally carrying out visual display to assist planners and residents in immersive decisions. The method realizes intelligent classification and strategy coordination of urban updating under the drive of time pedigree, has the advantages of comprehensive data and high efficiency of a method system and decision, and can be widely applied to urban updating and space optimization practice.

title_en: Expressway toll pre-payment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of expressways and Internet of things, in particular to a method for pre-paying toll on expressways. The method solves the problems of low traffic efficiency and easy congestion of the existing toll lane, and realizes the advanced payment of toll by the cooperative work of ramp license plate recognition equipment, a pre-payment system, a mobile terminal pre-payment small program and a lane toll system. The method has the core advantages that the reconstruction cost is obviously reduced, license plate recognition equipment is deployed mainly by means of the existing toll station ramp, transaction data of the main portal are utilized, and high investment for constructing a special pre-transaction portal and antenna equipment is avoided. The vehicle finishes payment before entering the lane, and the exit lane only needs to be checked rapidly, so that the single vehicle passing time is shortened greatly, the toll station passing efficiency is improved effectively, and the toll station has good system compatibility and popularization feasibility.

title_en: Intelligent regulation and control method and system for draining and changing salt in coastal saline-alkali soil based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil drainage and salt change, in particular to an intelligent regulation and control method and system for coastal saline-alkali soil drainage and salt change based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps of firstly dividing treatment units and arranging sensing equipment, and collecting multi-source heterogeneous data to form a data set; the method comprises the steps of cleaning data, carrying out space-time synchronization, obtaining standardized feature vectors through sectional physical perception standardization, constructing a graph neural network micro-area irrigation quantity demand prediction model, predicting recommended irrigation quantity and soil salinity variation, calculating a loss function of the model, carrying out iterative training on the model, carrying out periodic decision regulation and control circulation on the trained model, converting output of multi-source heterogeneous data acquired at each decision moment after the model into instructions to be issued, and synchronously carrying out drainage regulation and control. The invention can realize the optimal regulation and control of the water-salt environment and form an intelligent treatment closed loop.

title_en: Three-coordinate detection data analysis method for blade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-coordinate detection data analysis method of blades, which comprises the steps of 1, collecting blade profile detection reports of the blades and generating CSV files, 2, reading the CSV files of each blade, obtaining the number of sections, the number of evaluation items, the names of the sections, the names of the evaluation items and the tolerances of the evaluation items, 3, extracting the tolerances of the evaluation items or manually setting the tolerances in the CSV files, judging whether the blades are qualified or not according to actual measurement values and tolerance values of the evaluation items, 4, automatically dividing qualified blades and out-of-tolerance blades into different folders in batches, 5, counting the batch numbers, detection time, detection personnel and out-of-tolerance numerical information of all the blades to form a statistical table, 6, counting the number of qualified blades and out-of-tolerance blades in different tolerance numerical ranges, 7, automatically screening the blade profile detection reports according to the measurement time, batch numbers and detection personnel, and drawing a broken line analysis chart of the evaluation items.

title_en: Photographing signing method, photographing signing device, photographing signing equipment and photographing signing medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent logistics, in particular to a photographing signing method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the number of photos and the information of a photo face list based on a photo file, carrying out quantity verification on the number of the photos to obtain a first verification result, obtaining real-time space-time information based on the photo file when the first verification result is passed, carrying out verification on the real-time space-time information by adopting a space-time authenticity verification algorithm to obtain a second verification result, checking the single-sheet information by adopting a multi-mode single-sheet checking algorithm to obtain a third checking result, carrying out three-dimensional scene construction processing on the photo file by adopting a SIFT algorithm to obtain dense point clouds, calling a pre-trained semantic segmentation model to carry out semantic segmentation processing on the dense point clouds, and when the second check result and the third check result are passed, outputting the natural language description for the receiver to check, so that the receiver can rapidly locate and acquire the package according to the natural language description.

title_en: Industrial multi-mode data alignment method, device and medium for carbon emission management
abstract_en: The invention relates to an industrial multi-mode data alignment method, device and medium for carbon emission management, which belong to the technical field of industrial intelligence and carbon emission monitoring, and the method comprises the steps of constructing an industrial carbon management field knowledge graph; the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode original data related to carbon accounting in an industrial field, inquiring constraint rules in a knowledge graph based on the original data, inputting the original data and the constraint rules into LLM to obtain standardized data output by the LLM, adding semantic tags to the standardized data based on mapping relations in the knowledge graph, and performing alignment after time stamping. According to the industrial multi-mode data alignment method for carbon emission management, provided by the invention, the knowledge graph is utilized to automatically inject carbon accounting semantic tags into the cleaned data, and all the data are aligned under the three-dimensional space-time reference of unified equipment-working procedure-time, so that a high-quality data set which can be directly used for carbon emission analysis, accounting and optimization is formed.

title_en: RIES cooperative scheduling method, system, equipment and medium for single large-load electric-heat-cold flexible mutual aid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy, and discloses RIES cooperative scheduling method, system, equipment and medium for single heavy load electric-thermal-cold flexible mutual aid. The method comprises the steps of performing prospective energy storage by constructing a flexible load transfer strategy and utilizing the time sequence characteristics of heat energy and cold energy, starting cross-energy mutual aid under extreme load, and realizing electric-heat-cold bidirectional support through energy conversion equipment. The system takes cross-energy mutual-aid as a core, integrates energy production, conversion, storage and load links, and monitors and coordinates a sensor network in real time. Establishing a multi-main-body collaborative framework covering an energy producer, a manager and a comprehensive energy system, setting constraint conditions and optimizing a multi-main-body target, introducing a great wall optimization algorithm, solving a system model and optimizing energy pricing to obtain an optimal collaborative scheduling result. The operation toughness, economy and energy utilization efficiency of the system under single heavy load are improved, the operation cost and carbon emission are reduced, and the safety and stability of the system are ensured.

title_en: Patrol data processing method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for processing patrol data, belongs to the technical field of information processing, and solves the problems of low patrol data processing efficiency and difficult execution process control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining inspection target data, wherein the inspection target data comprise inspection time data, inspection execution equipment data and inspection object data, performing traversal filling processing on an inspection form database according to the inspection target data to obtain inspection work order data, sending the inspection work order data to a client, receiving a plurality of inspection feedback data sent by the client, generating operation instructions according to the inspection work order data by the client and executing the inspection feedback data to obtain the inspection work order data, and performing statistical classification processing on the inspection result data to obtain inspection report data. The scheme realizes automatic triggering and accurate execution of the inspection task.

title_en: Cross-channel marketing automation method and system based on real-time behavior triggering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-channel marketing automation method and system based on real-time behavior triggering, and the method comprises the steps of capturing a user behavior event stream in real time through a front-end acquisition unit, carrying out real-time mode matching on the event stream by utilizing a complex event processing engine, generating a marketing trigger signal when a preset rule is matched, responding to the signal, dynamically selecting an optimal channel for a user based on a real-time scoring model, sending marketing content to the selected channel through a unified execution module, and finally tracking user feedback and updating model parameters and user preferences in real time to form closed-loop optimization. The corresponding system comprises five modules, namely front-end data acquisition, stream event processing, real-time intelligent decision making, multi-channel execution and closed-loop optimization, which are used for realizing the steps. The invention realizes channel intelligent decision and data-driven self-adaptive optimization closed loop with millisecond intention perception and optimal cost and experience, and solves the problems of lag of traditional marketing response, rough channel and lack of self-adaptation.

title_en: Air-space-ground collaborative ecological quality multi-source data fusion method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment monitoring and multi-source data fusion, and discloses an air-to-ground collaborative ecological quality multi-source data fusion method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data, at least comprising satellite remote sensing image data, unmanned aerial vehicle aerial image data and ground observation time sequence data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out standardization and space-time alignment treatment on multi-source data to obtain a multi-mode data set, constructing a multi-mode prediction model, carrying out model training and data assimilation fusion by utilizing the multi-mode data set, inputting multi-source data of a region to be tested, which are acquired in real time, into the multi-mode prediction model after training is finished, and outputting an evaluation and prediction result of an ecological quality core index, wherein the ecological quality core index comprises at least one of the integrity of an ecological system, the water conservation capacity and the degree of permafrost degradation influence. The invention can integrally improve the inversion precision and generalization capability of the ecological quality index.

title_en: Multi-dimensional quantitative analysis method for operation efficiency of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidimensional quantitative analysis method for operation efficiency of an electric power system, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing the dynamic index based on the established index system; normalizing the data of the static index and the dynamic index; carrying out mixed weight distribution on the static index and the dynamic index; comprehensively scoring the static index and the dynamic index according to the chaotic dynamics model; punishment and excitation mechanism correction are carried out on the static index and the dynamic index; the invention provides a multidimensional and dynamic adaptive novel power system operation efficiency evaluation method, which utilizes high-order dynamic quantitative analysis to quantify the operation efficiency of a novel power system, combines nonlinear modeling, chaos theory and policy sensitivity analysis, provides a more scientific and objective quantitative analysis system, and provides a quantifiable decision reference for planning and policy making of an urban power system.

title_en: Defect acceptance auxiliary system, method, equipment and medium based on robot process automation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of defect acceptance of power grid automation, and discloses a defect acceptance auxiliary system, method, equipment and medium based on robot process automation. The data acquisition unit combines interface element identification and man-machine interaction simulation, so that the comprehensiveness of data acquisition is ensured. The multi-mode data integration unit processes and integrates the defect elimination image data, and ensures the accuracy and completeness of the data. The self-adaptive execution unit maintains a plurality of alternative identification rules, and reduces the condition that the system cannot operate due to interface change. The exception handling unit automatically restores or alarms in time when encountering an exception event, so that the stability of task execution is ensured. The output unit automatically distributes the structured checking and accepting machine account to the preset receiving end, so that the automation degree of work is improved, and an efficient and reliable solution is provided for checking and accepting the defects of the power grid.

title_en: Redemption recommendation method, redemption recommendation device, redemption recommendation equipment, redemption recommendation storage medium and redemption recommendation product
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of computers and discloses a method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a product for recommending redemption, wherein the method, the device, the equipment, the storage medium and the product comprise the steps of responding to a user recommendation request triggered by a user, obtaining a user image of the user and dynamic value coefficients of all target articles, wherein the target articles are articles converted by points, determining context characteristics corresponding to the user recommendation request, inputting the user image, the dynamic value coefficients and the context characteristics into a fusion ordering model, outputting final recommendation scores of the target articles, and generating a recommendation list for redemption according to the final recommendation scores. By integrating the user portrait, the dynamic value coefficient of the target object and the contextual characteristics corresponding to the request, the recommendation result can be matched with the long-term preference of the user and can be matched with the current demand scene of the user and the real-time value of the object, so that the individuation and the accuracy of the redemption recommendation are remarkably improved, and the acceptance of the user to the recommendation list and the conversion rate of the redemption of the points are improved.

title_en: Enterprise policy matching method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an enterprise policy matching method and device and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining policy information of government departments, analyzing the policy information to obtain feature information, constructing a policy knowledge graph according to the feature information, updating the policy knowledge graph to obtain a target policy knowledge graph when the government policy information is changed, and determining a target policy matched with an enterprise from the target policy knowledge graph. The scheme provided by the application can improve the matching precision of the benefit-enterprise policy and the enterprise.

title_en: Coal rock dynamic disaster prediction method and system based on multiple modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal rock dynamic disaster prediction method and system based on multiple modes, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining original data in a coal rock exploitation process, wherein the original data comprises time sequence data, image data and text data; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing original data to obtain model input data, constructing a coal-rock dynamic disaster prediction model, inputting the preprocessed time sequence data, image data and text data into the prediction model, respectively extracting time sequence features, image features and text features by utilizing a feature extraction module, inputting the time sequence features, the image features and the text features into a dynamic gating fusion layer with time sequence leading to generate multi-mode time embedded representation, inputting the multi-mode time embedded representation into a full-connection layer and a classification layer, outputting a coal-rock dynamic disaster prediction classification result, and carrying out risk classification. The method can realize accurate prediction of disaster occurrence time and risk level, and provides reliable decision support for mine safety production.

title_en: Electric carbon emission metering method and device for energy storage equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric carbon emission metering method and device of energy storage equipment, which comprise the steps of calculating attached carbon emission amount of the energy storage equipment after the (n+1) th time of electric energy input based on electric carbon emission factors, input electric quantity and output electric quantity of the energy storage equipment after the (n+1) th time of electric energy input, calculating electric carbon emission factors of the energy storage equipment after the (n+1) th time of electric energy input based on the attached carbon emission amount of the energy storage equipment after the (n+1) th time of electric energy input, and calculating attached carbon emission amount of the energy storage equipment after the (m+1) th time of electric energy output based on the attached carbon emission amount of the (n+1) th time of electric energy input and the electric carbon emission factors of the energy storage equipment.
