According to the method, the carbon emission factors of the charge and discharge behaviors of the energy storage device are accurately quantized by coupling the real-time operation data of the energy storage with the space-time dynamic carbon emission factors of the power grid, so that the defects that the existing method is extensive in metering and cannot reflect space-time characteristics can be overcome, and technical support can be provided for objectively evaluating the carbon metering of the energy storage device.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based enterprise production security portrait construction method and system
abstract_en: A method for constructing enterprise production security portrait based on knowledge graph includes such steps as 1) making risk index system, 2) obtaining production security knowledge according to relative data, constructing body library, storing it in MySQL database, 3) importing the production security knowledge stored in MySQL database into map database Neo4j, 4) extracting relation and attribute of the production security knowledge stored in map database Neo4j by knowledge graph technique, and 5) using knowledge graph inference model TransE to form risk evaluation result, early warning two disaster types including explosion risk and operation risk and providing effective suggestion. According to the method and the system, the safety management efficiency is effectively improved, and scientific basis is provided for decision making.

title_en: Combined evaluation method for wind-solar complementary project synergistic benefit quantification and economical efficiency
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of project assessment, in particular to a method for evaluating the combination of the quantification of the synergistic benefit and the economical efficiency of a wind-solar complementary project, which comprises the steps of comprehensively judging the basic data of the cooperative operation and the basic data of the economical efficiency based on a preset evaluation threshold value to obtain an initial combination evaluation grade; the method comprises the steps of carrying out coupling simulation based on the wind-solar resource coupling distribution to obtain a synergistic effect simulation result, determining the current predicted synergistic effect of the project based on the synergistic effect simulation result, and determining the joint evaluation result of the project based on the cooperative operation basic data, the economic basic data and the current predicted synergistic effect. According to the invention, by adopting an iterative algorithm and an error checking mechanism in the evaluation process, the prediction model can be continuously optimized according to the actual change condition, the reliability of the evaluation result is ensured, the dynamic updating mode can adapt to the change of the actual condition, the evaluation standard is adjusted in time, and the adaptability and the flexibility of project operation are improved.

title_en: Quotation monitoring method and device, storage medium, electronic equipment and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a quotation monitoring method, a quotation monitoring device, a storage medium, electronic equipment and a product, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a first settlement price corresponding to a first futures contract and a second settlement price corresponding to a second futures contract in a target transaction day, and determining a first price difference value corresponding to the first settlement price and the second settlement price; the method includes calculating a price difference change value based on a first price difference and a second price difference, the second price difference being a difference corresponding to a first settlement price and a second settlement price obtained on a last transaction day before a target transaction day, determining a plurality of price difference change values between the plurality of date pairs and calculating a first arithmetic average value of the plurality of price difference change values in case that a plurality of date pairs exist within a preset period, and determining a second arithmetic average value in case that at least one transaction day is increased in the preset period, and determining settlement price fluctuation corresponding to at least one transaction day after the increase based on the first arithmetic average value and the second arithmetic average value.

title_en: Safe production warehouse stock detection method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer vision and safety production, in particular to a method and a device for detecting stock of a safety production warehouse, and aims to solve the problems of low manual efficiency, poor precision of the traditional technology and weak environmental adaptability of the stock detection of the conventional dangerous chemical warehouse. The method comprises the steps of collecting images through an industrial camera, performing CLAHE light normalization and Gaussian filtering pretreatment, adopting improved stacking segmentation, extracting characteristics such as stacking outline and area, performing multidimensional dynamic correction through distance, shape, size and physical characteristics, calculating actual volume according to a formula to obtain stock, and triggering an alarm by using an ultra-safe threshold. The device comprises a data acquisition terminal, a processor, a memory and a bus. The invention realizes automatic real-time detection, improves detection precision and environmental adaptability, reduces personnel safety risk, and is suitable for dangerous chemical storage scenes.

title_en: Charging method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product for communication ticket
abstract_en: The invention provides a charging method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product of a communication ticket, relating to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical ordering service data of a user; sample feature division is carried out on historical subscription service data of a user, a plurality of sample features obtained through division are input into a user prediction model, the user type of the user is output, if the user type is a long-term user, the deduction calculation force of the long-term user is dynamically distributed, the deduction calculation force characterizes calculation resources required by calculation and processing of deduction tasks, the long-term user is a user with a continuous subscription service wish, and charging operation is carried out on the user based on the adjusted deduction calculation force. The invention dynamically distributes the fee deduction calculation force of the long-term user, thereby avoiding a great amount of fee deduction calculation force from being concentrated on a certain fee deduction day or a certain fee deduction time, balancing the calculation force resource of the system, reducing the fee deduction processing delay and the bad account rate, and further improving the reliability of the communication system.

title_en: Industrial park scheduling method and system integrating data center workload migration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial park scheduling method and system integrating data center workload migration, which belong to the technical field of energy scheduling and comprise the steps of obtaining an industrial park energy constraint rule according to an energy conversion coefficient representing energy conversion characteristics and energy requirements of an industrial park, constructing a workload queue based on a dynamic change relation of task receiving capacity, task processing capacity and task migration capacity of a data center host, obtaining a scheduling rule according to migration constraint conditions and migration execution rules of the workload queue, constructing a final objective function according to the minimum total operation cost of the industrial park, the minimum operation cost of the data center and the long-term stable operation of the data center as final objectives through Liapunov optimization, and obtaining an optimal scheduling strategy based on the industrial park energy constraint rule, the scheduling rule and the final objective function by using TD 3. The technical problem that the stability of the system is guaranteed while the utilization rate of resources is difficult to improve in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Intelligent warehouse logistics real-time goods space optimization method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a real-time cargo space optimizing method and system of intelligent warehouse logistics, relating to the technical field of intelligent warehouse logistics, by acquiring the real-time data of the warehouse, constructing a warehouse dynamic state map, generating an initial allocation scheme, inputting a distributed decision network for parallel collaborative evaluation optimization and issuing global instructions, the problems of delay and conflict of the traditional method in peak period are solved, and warehouse operation efficiency and system throughput can be improved.

title_en: Resource transfer risk identification method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a resource transfer risk identification method and a system, wherein the resource transfer risk identification method comprises the steps of responding to a resource issuing request of a request party node, generating a risk resource pool abstract list based on a resource pool of the request party node, generating first resource transfer information of target resources based on the resource issuing request, wherein the first resource transfer information comprises the risk resource pool abstract list, storing the first resource transfer information on a blockchain, enabling a receiver of the first resource transfer information to point to a second processing node, so that the second processing node can identify the first resource transfer information from the blockchain, identifying a next hop transfer node of the target resources based on the first resource transfer information, generating risk information if the next hop transfer node is a target resource pool and the abstract of the target resource pool falls into the risk resource pool abstract list, and recording the risk information on the blockchain. By the scheme of the invention, the post-loan wind control capability is improved.

title_en: Task workflow processing method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly discloses a task workflow processing method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of responding to description texts of target tasks, disassembling the target tasks into a plurality of subtasks according to the description texts, determining atom operation units corresponding to the subtasks respectively and dependency relations among the atom operation units, determining workflow execution agents corresponding to the atom operation units respectively, planning target workflows for the target tasks according to the dependency relations and the workflow execution agents, and completing the target tasks by executing the target workflows. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention solves the problems that a professional technician is required to finish the task workflow processing process and the task workflow processing process is difficult to adapt to frequently changed task scenes.

title_en: Data processing method and device, nonvolatile storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method and device, a nonvolatile storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining business situation data, extracting entities and relations from the business situation data, constructing a business situation knowledge graph based on the entities and the relations, mapping the entities and the relations in the business situation knowledge graph into semantic vectors to obtain a business situation semantic vector set, aligning and aggregating the business situation semantic vector set based on a time dimension, combining user behavior data and event data, constructing node states of each entity in the business situation knowledge graph on continuous time steps to obtain a node state sequence, generating an initial demand prediction vector, constructing a hypergraph structure, and optimizing the initial demand prediction vector based on the hypergraph structure to obtain a target demand prediction vector. The method solves the technical problem of low prediction accuracy of the requirements caused by the difficulty in effectively integrating business condition data and user behavior information in the related demand prediction model.

title_en: Biological detection data analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a biological detection data analysis method, which belongs to the technical field of data analysis and comprises the steps of obtaining inspection data, generating a unique sample number, calling a standard template, matching standard detection items, generating sample preparation guidance, receiving a triggered preparation confirmation instruction, obtaining a sample preparation completion instruction, triggering a sample detection instruction, obtaining equipment original data, judging according to a judgment standard, obtaining a detection result, calling a multidimensional data analysis engine to carry out statistical analysis on the detection result based on the detection result, and obtaining an analysis result by calculating the epidemic disease positive rate and comparing the epidemic disease positive rate with a preset positive rate reference range, thereby realizing the intelligent upgrading of the biological detection field, ensuring the traceability and the processing standardization of sample information, effectively solving the problems of large artificial error and data analysis hysteresis in the traditional detection flow, and achieving the comprehensive purpose of improving the detection accuracy, efficiency and risk early warning capability.

title_en: Fault evaluation management method and system based on AI Agent
abstract_en: The application relates to an AI Agent-based fault evaluation management method and system, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data of industrial equipment, such as vibration, temperature, pressure and lubricating oil quality parameters, constructing a first characteristic association matrix and a second characteristic association matrix, combining to generate a comprehensive characteristic association map, analyzing the running state of the equipment in real time by using the AI Agent based on the map and outputting a fault evaluation result, accurately judging whether the fault exists, determining the fault type and severity, and providing a processing scheme.

title_en: Correlation analysis method and device based on carbon footprint data and species perch data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ecological environment monitoring, in particular to a correlation analysis method and device based on carbon footprint data and species inhabitation data. The method comprises the steps of obtaining species perch data and carbon footprint data of a target area, constructing a cooperative feature matrix by using the species perch data and the carbon footprint data, respectively calculating a perch quality evaluation index for representing the comprehensive state of the species perch and a net carbon footprint index for representing the net carbon exchange capacity of the target area based on the cooperative feature matrix, and establishing a quantification relation between the species perch data and the carbon footprint data in the ecological environment of the target area through the perch quality evaluation index and the net carbon footprint index. In contrast, the intrinsic relation between the mined data was analyzed using two data correlations, establishing a quantitative relationship between habitat assessment and carbon footprint. The method solves the problem of data fracture in traditional monitoring, realizes comprehensive evaluation of multiple dimensions and deeper of the ecological environment, and improves the comprehensiveness and accuracy of environmental evaluation.

title_en: Multi-heat source heat supply cooperative scheduling method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-heat source heat supply cooperative scheduling method, device, equipment and medium, which comprises the steps of obtaining heat source scheduling combinations corresponding to each historical moment in a historical heat supply period according to heat source proportion information in the historical heat supply period, determining effective heat supply quantity of each heat source by utilizing a conversion model according to the historical energy supply information of each heat source obtained in advance, combining unit energy acquisition cost and carbon emission factors of each heat source obtained in advance, obtaining by utilizing an optimal stopping criterion of a greedy algorithm, constructing the conversion model according to the historical heat supply data obtained in advance and energy conversion coefficients of each heat source, selecting the heat source scheduling combinations at the current target moment according to the heat source scheduling combinations corresponding to each historical moment in the historical heat supply period, and cooperatively scheduling the corresponding heat source according to the selected heat source scheduling combinations. The invention can effectively cope with peak load of municipal heat source and reduce energy consumption while taking economy and environmental protection into account.

title_en: Cloud edge cooperative system calculation force-electric power joint optimization scheduling method considering heterogeneous characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cloud edge cooperative system calculation power-electric power joint optimization scheduling method considering heterogeneous characteristics, wherein an upper cloud data center is used as a scheduling main body, in each scheduling period, based on the number of delay tolerant tasks, the unloading capacity of delay sensitive tasks and a local electric energy cost characteristic curve, the total operation profit in the whole scheduling period is maximized as an optimization target, calculation service unit cost signals of the scheduling period are obtained in an optimization mode and are sent to all edge base stations, and all edge base stations of a lower layer receive time-sharing electric energy cost signals from a power grid, combine the calculation service unit cost signals received from the upper layer, independently optimize the real-time task unloading capacity of the cloud data center by taking the maximum self comprehensive effect as an optimization target, and upload the calculation service unit cost signals to the cloud data center. Compared with the prior art, the cloud edge computing system has the advantages of taking modeling heterogeneous characteristics of cloud and edge computing facilities into consideration, effectively realizing computing-electricity coordination of the cloud edge system and the like.

title_en: Modularized and standardized design method for GIS equipment slot box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modular and standardized design method of a GIS equipment slot box, which comprises the steps of disassembling a GIS slot box subsystem into functional units comprising a slot box body, slot box accessories and a slot box connecting piece, enabling the functional units to be connected through standardized interfaces, dividing the slot box body into sub-modules with single functions and standard interfaces, establishing a slot box body optimized specification library, determining optimized specification and module matching relation of the sub-modules, establishing a standardized module shelf, realizing parameterized modeling, centralized management and efficient calling of the modules, establishing a fixed configuration system of the slot box accessories and the connecting piece, ensuring the adaptation with the slot box body module, and establishing a full-voltage-class adaptation mechanism to realize the slot box design coverage of GIS projects with different voltage classes. The design method of the invention realizes the quick calling, splicing and full voltage class coverage of the slot box design by constructing a standardized module library and configuration system, thereby remarkably improving the design efficiency, the multiplexing rate and the product quality.

title_en: Behavior evolution-based operation compliance intelligent monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation compliance monitoring method and system based on behavior evolution, which relate to the technical field of operation monitoring and comprise the following steps of acquiring operation bottom layer configuration data in a target service system, analyzing the operation bottom layer configuration data to obtain an initial operation compliance base line model, acquiring a real-time flow operation sequence of a target operation object in a current time window, calculating single microscopic deviation vectors of the real-time flow operation sequence relative to the initial operation compliance base line model, recording all the single microscopic deviation vectors of the target operation object in a plurality of continuous time windows, and carrying out operation deviation evolution according to all the single microscopic deviation vectors to obtain a target operation deviation result.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle and unmanned aerial vehicle mixed distribution material transfer path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for planning a mixed delivery material transfer path of an unmanned aerial vehicle and an unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the technical field of path planning and comprises the steps of obtaining a delivery line corresponding to the unmanned aerial vehicle, and a delivery building, path time and building time corresponding to the unmanned aerial vehicle; the method is used for solving the problems that in the conventional unmanned aerial vehicle and unmanned aerial vehicle mixed delivery material transfer path planning method, when the delivery process of the unmanned aerial vehicle delivering the materials is abnormal, the position of the abnormal point cannot be associated with the delivery line of the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the materials in the abnormal process cannot be efficiently taken over by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and delivery is delayed.

title_en: Intelligent safety management method, equipment and medium for engineering construction
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent safety management method, equipment and medium for engineering construction, which comprise the steps of obtaining a monitoring video stream, identifying a plurality of targets to be detected contained in the monitoring video stream according to predefined detection target characteristics in an intelligent camera, extracting a motion track sequence of the targets to be detected in real time, identifying cooperative relation among the targets to be detected to determine a construction cooperative group contained in the monitoring video stream, identifying abnormal behavior nodes corresponding to constructors in the construction cooperative group to obtain estimated risk events corresponding to the abnormal behavior nodes, simulating a risk conduction path of the estimated risk events to obtain constructors influenced by the abnormal behavior nodes, and calculating a risk area corresponding to the risk conduction path to determine a risk avoidance instruction of the constructors. The method solves the technical problem that the safety risk caused by individual abnormality in a construction group cannot be predicted by the long-distance engineering construction safety management method in the prior art.

title_en: LLM-Agent-based intelligent recommendation method for early warning, prevention and control of pig-raising epidemic disease of building
abstract_en: The invention relates to a building pig raising epidemic early warning and prevention and control intelligent recommendation method based on LLM-Agent, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent breeding and pig farm epidemic risk management, and comprises the steps of carrying out grading early warning on pig farm epidemic risks and generating corresponding risk factor analysis results by combining an anomaly detection algorithm and knowledge resources in the epidemic prevention and control field, further generating various prevention and control and management strategies according to different risk grades, carrying out comprehensive evaluation and sequencing from multiple dimensions such as prevention and control effects, execution difficulty and economic cost, outputting a preferable prevention and control strategy scheme, and simultaneously carrying out dynamic adjustment and continuous optimization on the prevention and control strategies by introducing a user feedback, prevention and control execution result and system cooperative linkage mechanism to form a closed-loop control system of 'prevention and control recommendation-execution-feedback-optimization'. The method can realize prospective early warning and scientific decision of the epidemic disease risk of the pig farm of the building, improves the intellectualization, the interpretability and the economic feasibility of epidemic disease prevention and control, and has good application value and popularization prospect.

title_en: Multi-source data fusion subway station dynamic congestion degree monitoring method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a medium for monitoring dynamic congestion degree of a subway station by multi-source data fusion, which relate to the technical field of subway safety monitoring, and are used for acquiring the number of people acquired by each Internet of things sensor, carrying out weighted fusion calculation on the acquired number of people according to the type of each Internet of things sensor to obtain the estimated number of people in each key area, calculating an environment correction parameter pre-estimated value of each key area according to the initial number of people, verifying the environment correction parameter pre-estimated value and the acquired environment correction parameter value, dynamically adjusting the weight of each Internet of things sensor during each weighted fusion calculation according to the verification result, finally outputting the number of people in each key area, integrating the congestion degree of each key area and generating the congestion space distribution condition of the whole subway station. Personnel data are collected through a non-vision-based multi-source sensing network, and a multi-source data fusion result is corrected through environment correction parameters, so that a more reliable crowdedness detection result is obtained.

title_en: Carbon-electricity-heat coupled multi-energy system carbon emission energy consumption cost collaborative optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon emission energy consumption cost collaborative optimization method of a carbon electrothermal coupling multi-energy system, and relates to a carbon electrothermal coupling model of the multi-energy system and a carbon emission energy consumption cost collaborative optimization operation technology. The method comprises the steps of firstly inputting data information of a multi-energy system, respectively constructing a multi-energy system carbon-electricity, carbon heat seal and carbon electric heat coupling model, then constructing a multi-energy system flexible adjustment electric heating load model and a carbon electric heat coupling energy flow carbon balance model, finally constructing a multi-energy system carbon exhaust energy consumption cost collaborative optimization operation model, and outputting the multi-energy system data information through optimization solution. The invention builds the carbon electrothermal coupling and carbon emission energy consumption cost collaborative optimization operation refinement model, is beneficial to unified integrated analysis of the carbon flow and the energy flow of the multi-energy system, is beneficial to promoting energy conservation, emission reduction and new energy consumption of the multi-energy system, and can provide reference and guidance for multi-scene carbon emission energy consumption cost adjustment, carbon flow space-time distribution and dynamic tracking analysis, carbon electrothermal collaborative operation and the like of the multi-energy system.

title_en: Data processing method, device, equipment and medium of tax database
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method, device, equipment and medium of a tax database, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining structural design documents of a to-be-audited table, extracting structural design elements through a large model analysis engine, conducting audit judgment on the structural design elements through a rule reasoning engine based on a pre-built standard specification knowledge base and an audit scheme knowledge base, generating and outputting an audit report according to the result of the audit judgment, wherein the standard specification knowledge base stores tax audit standards in a vectorization mode and associates dimension labels, the audit scheme knowledge base contains audit schemes of different scenes with reference specifications and priorities, and when audit is conducted, multiple specifications of the same audit point are compared according to priority vectors, semantic model analysis conflict is called, and reasonable but non-compliance conflict and non-compliance conflict are identified. By the technical scheme, the complex problems of multiple standards, multiple versions, semantic understanding and the like in the tax industry can be solved.

title_en: Action normalization real-time assessment method and system based on edge calculation and dynamic weight analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motion normalization real-time assessment method and system based on edge calculation and dynamic weight analysis. According to the method, the video stream is acquired through the edge computing terminal, key points of human bones are extracted, and the dual modes of teaching input and real-time evaluation are supported. In the teaching mode, the system automatically generates a dynamic weight matrix focused on the key action part by analyzing joint displacement variance of standard actions, and in the real-time evaluation mode, the actions are judged in millisecond level by combining a multistage cascade filtering mechanism and a geometric feature normalization algorithm and combining the dynamic weight matrix. The method solves the problems that the traditional visual monitoring scheme depends on a high-power cloud server, has high privacy leakage risk and poor adaptability of fixed rules, realizes high-precision, low-delay and non-contact type action normalization monitoring on low-power consumption equipment, and is suitable for the fields of industrial safety production, rehabilitation training, sports examination and the like.

title_en: Intelligent scheduling method and system for cleaning service
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling method and system for cleaning service, which relate to the field of intelligent scheduling and comprise the steps of acquiring cleaning service management information and real-time monitoring data corresponding to the cleaning service management information; the method comprises the steps of sequentially extracting characteristics of acquired cleaning service management information to acquire corresponding service characteristic data, carrying out demand analysis on the acquired service characteristic data according to real-time monitoring data, setting a cleaning service demand analysis comparison table, setting corresponding scheduling path information according to the cleaning service demand analysis comparison table, carrying out multi-dimensional scheduling evaluation on the acquired scheduling path information to acquire corresponding scheduling evaluation data, carrying out comparison analysis on the corresponding scheduling evaluation data in the cleaning service demand analysis comparison table, determining the scheduling path information according to comparison analysis results, and carrying out scheduling notification.

title_en: Consumer coupon processing method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product for processing a consumption ticket. The method comprises the steps of obtaining all coupon operation requests corresponding to at least one consumption coupon from a coupon operation queue, determining a net operation value corresponding to each consumption coupon according to all coupon operation behaviors requested by the coupon operation requests corresponding to the consumption coupon, wherein the net operation value represents the coupon operation request condition of the consumption coupon, freezing or thawing the associated consumption coupon corresponding to the consumption coupon according to the net operation value corresponding to the consumption coupon, and the associated consumption coupon is another consumption coupon held by a user to which the consumption coupon belongs. The method can remarkably improve the accuracy of the consumer ticket state of the user and reduce the complaint rate.

title_en: Network attack influence assessment method for automatic driving fixed route and demand response public transport system
abstract_en: The invention provides a network attack influence assessment method for an automatic driving fixed route and a demand response public transportation system, which comprises the steps of respectively constructing a fixed line public transportation system model and a demand response public transportation system model, wherein the fixed line public transportation system model aims at minimizing the total operation cost of an intelligent network bus in an operation time domain, the demand response public transportation system model aims at minimizing the total cost of the system, under a preset network attack scene, operation assessment is carried out based on operation results of the fixed line public transportation system model and the demand response public transportation system model, a first operation assessment result and a second operation assessment result are correspondingly obtained, meanwhile, damage assessment is carried out based on service state output of the fixed line public transportation system model and the demand response public transportation system model, and a first damage assessment result and a second damage assessment result are correspondingly obtained. The method and the system can improve the robustness and the safety of the public transportation system based on the intelligent network-connected vehicle.

title_en: Method and system for managing full life cycle information of clothing product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of Internet of things and information technology, in particular to a method and a system for managing full life cycle information of clothing products, wherein the method comprises the steps of embedding an RFID tag stored with clothing identity information into a washing label of clothing; the method comprises the steps of continuously inputting information data covering tracing, production and processing and logistics sales of clothing raw materials into an RFID tag and a cloud database associated with the RFID tag, reading the RFID tag by a consumer through terminal equipment with a near-field communication function, accessing tracing and use information related to clothing, and classifying waste clothing by a recovery mechanism based on fabric component information acquired from the RFID tag. By embedding the RFID tag into the wash water label and associating with the cloud database, a tamper-proof full life cycle data chain is established for each garment from raw materials, production, circulation to sales. The reputation of brands in terms of sustainability is enhanced, and the increasing expectations of consumers for product transparency are also met.

title_en: Intelligent decision support system for bidding complete process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bidding decision making, and discloses an intelligent decision support system for bidding complete flows, wherein a model construction module analyzes the bidding complete flows to obtain bidding complete flow nodes, constructs a bidding complete flow node model and outputs corresponding node evaluation values; the method comprises the steps of determining a node evaluation value set according to all node evaluation values by a first calculation module, calculating corresponding node evaluation fluctuation metric values, analyzing all node evaluation fluctuation metric values by a second calculation module, calculating bidding difference coefficients, intelligently deciding the whole bidding process by a process decision-making module according to the bidding difference coefficients and preset bidding difference coefficients, calculating quantization indexes capable of representing the whole health of the whole process by deep mining and analysis of all node evaluation values, providing clear and reliable decision support for management staff, realizing the intellectualization and the precision of bidding management, and effectively improving the project success rate and the resource utilization efficiency.

title_en: Failure pre-judging and full-period operation and maintenance method for subway power distribution system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of edge calculation, and discloses a failure pre-judging and full-period operation and maintenance method of a subway power distribution system, which effectively eliminates the physical system difference between an alternating current power grid and a direct current subway system by constructing a physical impedance characteristic alignment mechanism, solves the technical problem of cross-domain failure characteristic migration distortion, utilizes an embedded circuit constitutive equation and a physical perception type generating network of thermodynamic cumulative effect, the method overcomes the defect that the artificial intelligent model is easy to generate pseudo data against physical common sense under the condition of a small sample, remarkably improves the physical credibility of an extended sample set, further, based on the entropy increase self-acceleration random dynamics model and the train kinematics energy theorem, realizes the accurate prediction of fault nonlinear evolution tracks and the real-time calculation of dynamic safety envelope, and can accurately trigger an active defense strategy before the system fails, thereby greatly improving the full-period operation and maintenance safety and emergency response efficiency of the subway power distribution system.

title_en: Evaluation system for secondhand vehicle, information processing device, program, and evaluation method for secondhand vehicle
abstract_en: In the evaluation system for the second-hand vehicle, a plurality of pieces of authentication information are stored in a storage device, and each piece of authentication information includes an authentication value of the second-hand vehicle associated with a category information setting of the second-hand vehicle. The category information includes at least one of the information of the money of the second-hand vehicle and the information of the years of the second-hand vehicle and the total mileage of the second-hand vehicle. The information processing device performs processing of selecting a plurality of pieces of identification information belonging to a determined category from among the plurality of pieces of stored identification information as comparison information, processing of calculating a statistical value of identification values of the second-hand vehicles associated with the plurality of comparison information settings based on the plurality of pieces of comparison information selected, and processing of generating information of the identification values of the comparison-target vehicles and the calculated statistical value.

title_en: Method and device for identifying seat number of business person, electronic equipment and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a program product for identifying seat numbers of business personnel, which relate to the field of artificial intelligence and are applied to the field of financial science and technology; the method comprises the steps of extracting text semantic features, character space features and business logic features from a preprocessed text, carrying out feature fusion to obtain a fusion feature vector, inputting the fusion feature vector into a target recognition model, and outputting business person seat numbers recognized from collection information, wherein the target recognition model is obtained by training a preset recognition model by adopting historical collection information, and the preset recognition model at least comprises a bidirectional long-short-term memory network, a converter encoder and a conditional random field model. The application solves the problem that the seat number of the business personnel in the collection information is difficult to identify based on the traditional keyword matching method in the related technology.

title_en: Measuring and calculating management system based on modularized framework
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of budget measurement management systems, in particular to a measurement management system based on a modularized framework, which comprises an intelligent semantic analysis module, a modularized layer management module and a calculation management module, wherein the intelligent semantic analysis module is used for receiving policy text data, extracting a quota entity, a basic quota numerical value and a logic constraint relation through a natural language processing model, outputting a dynamic attribute configuration instruction and a layer reference formula, and the modularized layer management module is used for receiving the dynamic attribute configuration instruction and the layer reference formula, constructing a multi-level structure comprising a parameter layer, a resource layer and a reference layer, setting constraint attribute marks for calculation parameters in the parameter layer, and the constraint attribute marks are used for distinguishing a rigid constraint state and an elastic variable state of the calculation parameters. According to the invention, the structured quota and constraint data capable of directly driving the measuring and calculating model are generated by automatically analyzing the policy text, so that the manual input workload is obviously reduced, and the landing efficiency and accuracy of policy change in a system are improved.

title_en: Manufacturing process remote supervision and management method and system based on cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manufacturing process remote monitoring and management method and system based on a cloud platform, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining manufacturing process working condition data, integrating the manufacturing process working condition data through cleaning, complementing and standardization processing to form a structural chemical working condition data set, constructing a self-evolution monitoring rule engine based on the data set, presetting an evolution target and dynamic adjustment logic, setting an intelligent working condition recognition and rule adjustment function, initializing a split scene rule storage pool, constructing a directed cross-modal causal association map through condition independence analysis, reversely tracing and positioning a defect core cause by combining the map, verifying a conduction path, carrying out differential privacy protection according to grades, and driving the engine to carry out iterative optimization by combining a defect tracing result and historical data. The method realizes the dynamic adaptation of the supervision rule to complex working conditions, accurate defect traceability, and combines data security and sharing efficiency, improves the intellectualization and robustness of the system, and adapts to the severe demand of remote supervision of high-end manufacture.

title_en: Aircraft control quality evaluation method based on transducer model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aircraft control quality evaluation method based on a transducer model, and belongs to the field of aviation ergonomics. The method comprises the steps of designing flight task subject primitives, collecting multi-mode physiological signals and flight task performance data of pilots, extracting key features from the physiological signals through multi-level screening, fusing the key features with the results of task performance grading, constructing a transform prediction model combining convolution and multi-head self-attention mechanisms, effectively modeling local features and cross-mode global dependency relationships, realizing automatic prediction of manipulation quality grades, adopting a small sample fine tuning strategy based on dynamic weight freezing, enabling the model to be quickly adapted to different pilots, improving generalization capability, and finally obtaining final evaluation of an aggregate group prediction result. Objective and automatic evaluation of multi-source data driving is realized, the limitation of the traditional subjective evaluation method is overcome, and the consistency and efficiency of evaluation are improved.

title_en: Intelligent recommendation method and recommendation system for suppliers facing purchasing of automobile parts
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of provider recommendation, and particularly relates to an intelligent provider recommendation method and system for purchasing automobile parts. The recommendation method comprises the steps of constructing a knowledge graph formed by nodes and edges according to historical orders of a purchasing company, determining accessory model nodes or adaptive vehicle model nodes as demand nodes according to purchasing demands, screening a plurality of qualified provider nodes of the demand nodes in the knowledge graph based on a Monte Carlo Dropout mechanism by a graph neural network model, screening a plurality of potential provider nodes from all the qualified provider nodes based on a self-adaptive multi-objective optimization function, calculating edge note meaning scores of the potential provider nodes, and outputting the top k providers with the edge note meaning scores in descending order as recommendation degree descending order. The method can combine purchasing requirements and preferences on the basis of integrating multi-source heterogeneous data to carry out scientific and reasonable supplier recommendation.

title_en: Novel power system dispatching optimization method integrating renewable energy sources
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply or distribution circuit devices or systems and electric energy storage systems, in particular to a novel power system dispatching optimization method integrating renewable energy sources. The method solves the technical problem that the prediction accuracy and reliability of the existing method are difficult to meet the actual requirements of fine scheduling of the power grid. The method comprises the steps of determining a first target value among various environmental data based on first data of a first time point, wherein the first target value is used for representing relevance among the various environmental data, determining a second target value among the various environmental data based on the first target value, a fluctuation variable of a first environment monitoring value at a second time point and a power variable of first power generation power at a second time point, wherein the second time point is a time point when the first power generation power fluctuates, and determining predicted power generation power of a target time point based on the first data, the second target value and a second environment predicted value of the target time point.

title_en: Reservoir hydrodynamic force improving effect evaluation method and system based on multi-index comprehensive index
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir hydrodynamic force improving effect evaluation method and system based on multi-index comprehensive indexes, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and water environment simulation. The method comprises the steps of setting a plurality of groups of control working conditions according to actual operation data of a reservoir and scheduling targets, simulating a reservoir flow field by utilizing a three-dimensional hydrodynamic numerical model to obtain parameters such as flow velocity, water depth and the like, respectively calculating three core indexes of surface retention area ratio, water scouring time and flow velocity space variation coefficient based on simulation results, dynamically distributing weights of all indexes according to scheduling targets in different periods, weighting and integrating to obtain hydrodynamic force improvement indexes, and quantitatively evaluating hydrodynamic force improvement effects and optimizing scheduling schemes by comparing index values under different working conditions. The invention solves the problem that the prior method lacks systematic and quantitative evaluation and scheduling effect on hydrodynamic environment improvement, and provides an operable and generalized decision tool for reservoir refinement and eco-friendly scheduling management.

title_en: Land conventional oilfield ground oil collection mode optimization judging method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of oil and gas gathering and transportation, in particular relates to a land conventional oilfield ground oil gathering mode optimization judging method, and aims to solve the problem of how to select an oil gathering mode under different working conditions. The method comprises the steps of determining alternative oil collecting modes corresponding to block influence parameters according to an oil collecting process judging table, wherein the oil collecting process judging table comprises mapping relations of the block influence parameters and the oil collecting modes, and when more than one alternative oil collecting modes are adopted, calculating the total cost of each alternative oil collecting mode respectively, and selecting the oil collecting mode with the lowest total cost. The invention can determine economic, applicable and safe ground oil collecting modes for conventional oil field blocks under different development conditions, scientifically and reasonably provides basis for the optimization of the ground oil collecting process of the oil and gas field, and ensures the cost reduction and synergy of the ground oil collecting engineering construction of the oil and gas field. According to the oil collecting process judging table, the economical, applicable and safe ground oil collecting process can be quickly and conveniently selected.

title_en: Intelligent examination method, examination system and storage medium for sterilizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sterilizer intelligent examination method, an examination system and a storage medium in the technical field of training examination. The intelligent sterilizer examination method is characterized in that a classification response mechanism is implemented in the actual operation process of judging whether an operator passes the examination or not, the classification response mechanism comprises a multi-source sensing data set for collecting the examination, the multi-source sensing data set comprises equipment state parameters, operator physiological state parameters and environment parameters, and when the equipment state parameters, the operator physiological state parameters and the environment parameters exceed preset values, corresponding mechanical alarm signals, human alarm signals and gas alarm signals are generated, and corresponding intervention measures are executed. The invention can actively execute the intervention measures when accidents happen on the examination site, clearly indicate personnel to withdraw from dangerous areas, minimize potential hazards and avoid the situation that operators may miss the optimal treatment time due to tension or lack of experience in the process of confusion, thereby deteriorating the situation.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for determining AC/DC cable laying path of photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for determining an alternating current/direct current cable laying path of a photovoltaic power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining position information of a target photovoltaic array, wherein each photovoltaic panel in the target photovoltaic array is arranged on a bracket; the method comprises the steps of determining a box transformer installation position in a target photovoltaic square matrix, determining a bracket grouping scheme of the target photovoltaic square matrix and an inverter installation position in each bracket grouping, determining a direct current cable laying path in each bracket grouping according to the bracket grouping scheme and the inverter installation position in each bracket grouping, and determining an alternating current cable laying path in each bracket grouping according to the box transformer installation position and the inverter installation position in each bracket grouping. The scheme of the invention can obtain the efficient and economic laying path result of the AC/DC cable in the photovoltaic power station.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging demand prediction method, system, terminal and medium considering uncertainty quantification
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging demand prediction method, a system, a terminal and a medium considering uncertainty quantification, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing original charging station data, constructing a probability distribution model based on the preprocessed original charging station data, and constructing a space-time diagram structure; the method comprises the steps of establishing a probability map attention network model, establishing a negative log likelihood loss function, training and optimizing the probability map attention network model based on the negative log likelihood loss function to obtain a trained probability map attention network model, inputting preprocessed data of a period to be predicted into the trained probability map attention network model, outputting a prediction mean value and a standard deviation, and establishing a dynamic placement interval based on the distribution property of a probability distribution model to realize the prediction of the charging requirements of the electric automobile. The method and the system realize the self-adaptive quantification of the fluctuation risk of the charging demand, and provide scientific decision basis for the power grid operators to formulate an elastic scheduling strategy.

title_en: Optimization and scheduling system based on multi-department review appointment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of department appointment and scheduling, and discloses an optimization and scheduling system based on a multi-department review appointment system, which comprises a doctor operation module, a data integration module, a scheme generation module, a scheme display and selection module and a doctor and patient confirmation module; the system can be used for generating a diversified review scheme by utilizing an advanced algorithm, so that not only the requirements of the patients on weekend treatment are considered preferentially, but also various choices are provided, and the convenience and independent option of the patients on medical treatment are remarkably improved.

title_en: Distributed replacement flow shop scheduling optimization method with preventive maintenance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of distributed replacement flow shop scheduling in intelligent manufacturing, and particularly relates to a distributed replacement flow shop scheduling optimization method with preventive maintenance. The method comprises the steps of dividing a population into two populations of an explorer and a developer, performing state evaluation and search action decision based on population improvement rate and diversity through Q learning, combining a multi-arm slot machine model to adaptively select eight types of neighborhood disturbance operators including a factory layer, a workpiece layer and a local layer for an individual, constructing an elite library to finish deep search after propagation diffusion, local search, competitive exclusion and population immigration iterative optimization, and finally using a heuristic algorithm global optimal solution as a heat starting point to finish final optimization through constraint planning CP model. The invention obviously improves the solving precision and efficiency of the scheduling problem and effectively balances the global exploration and local development capacity of the algorithm.

title_en: Novel energy storage project comprehensive benefit evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel comprehensive benefit evaluation method and system for an energy storage project, and belongs to the technical field of energy project evaluation. The method comprises the steps of constructing a comprehensive benefit evaluation index system which comprises four dimensions of economy, technology, society and environment, determining weights of indexes of all levels by adopting a network analytic hierarchy process, fully considering association and feedback relations among the indexes, determining membership of each index by an expert scoring process to form a membership matrix, calculating scores by adopting a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation process by combining the weights and the membership matrix, determining evaluation grades, and completing project comprehensive benefit analysis and outputting evaluation results. The system comprises an index system construction module, a weight calculation module, a membership determination module, a comprehensive evaluation module and a result output module, and realizes the automatic execution of the evaluation method.

title_en: Intelligent generation system for online courses of protection skills
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent education and public health intersection, in particular to an intelligent generation system for online courses of protection skills. The invention comprises a demand acquisition module, a test point label generation module, a course intelligent generation module, a learning execution module and a wrong question closed-loop learning module. The invention aims to provide an intelligent generation system for online courses of protective skills, which solves the problems of fixed, poor pertinence and limited effect of the existing protective training courses.

title_en: Real-time energy consumption intelligent analysis method and system for fusion of multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a real-time energy consumption intelligent analysis method and system for fusing multi-source heterogeneous data. And receiving the multi-source heterogeneous original data stream, analyzing and extracting the associated fields, and establishing a cross-data source mapping relationship to fuse and generate a unified data record. And monitoring the load of the processing channel, distributing records, and performing aggregation calculation in the target channel based on a time window and a water line mechanism to generate a fusion aggregation value sequence. And extracting sequence characteristic prediction energy consumption, calculating residual errors, and dynamically generating an abnormality judgment threshold value to identify an abnormality. And tracing the abnormal window records, and calculating the abnormal contribution degree of each data source to identify the main abnormal source. The method realizes real-time fusion and efficient processing of the multi-source data, and improves the accuracy and traceability of energy consumption abnormality detection through dynamic threshold value and contribution degree analysis.

title_en: Hydropower station isolation fence intelligent maintenance system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent maintenance system and method for a hydropower station isolation fence based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of equipment; the functional failure transfer tree comprises a top event, a middle event and a bottom event, a defect feature library is constructed based on a historical maintenance record, running state data of sensors of all fence nodes are obtained in real time, the running state data are compared with the defect feature library, if the nodes are identified to enter a certain stage of a state transition path, the nodes are analyzed to develop into predicted failure probability and residual safety time corresponding to the bottom event, if the nodes are identified to be abnormal, the nodes are matched with the corresponding bottom event, the comprehensive probability of occurrence of the top event is dynamically analyzed based on the functional failure transfer tree according to the predicted failure probability or the corresponding bottom event, and early warning information is generated according to the comprehensive probability and the residual safety time.

title_en: Logistics scheduling simulation method, device and system for sand mold 3D printing workshop
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of logistics simulation and high-end equipment manufacturing, in particular to a logistics scheduling simulation method, device and system for a sand mold 3D printing workshop and computing equipment. According to the application, by constructing the exclusive database fusing the large logistics hard constraint and the sand mould aging window and embedding the process cooperation requirement as the hard constraint into the improved genetic algorithm supporting dynamic weight adjustment, the problems that the scheduling scheme is not feasible and disturbance cannot be responded dynamically due to neglecting the physical feasibility and time sequence cooperation of large transportation in the sand mould 3D printing workshop in the conventional logistics simulation method are solved.

title_en: Photovoltaic and energy storage integrated intelligent energy management system for multi-charging pile micro-grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy management systems, and discloses a photovoltaic and energy storage integrated multi-charging pile micro-grid intelligent energy management system which comprises a cloud layer central server, an edge layer area server and a plurality of intelligent charging piles of a terminal layer, wherein the cloud layer central server is provided with an antagonistic environment simulator and a federal element learning aggregator, the antagonistic environment simulator is constructed based on a generated antagonistic network and is used for learning desensitization characteristic distribution uploaded by each intelligent charging pile and generating multi-mode virtual scene data conforming to a real statistical rule. This merge little electric wire netting wisdom energy management system of many charging piles of photovoltaic and energy storage is through realizing the whole flow protection of terminal data privacy, the data sparse operating mode of new charging pile of throwing of adaptation simultaneously accomplishes the fine setting of lightweight model of terminal side, finally effectively promotes the whole energy utilization efficiency of many charging piles little electric wire netting, provides better technical scheme for the wisdom energy management in this field.

title_en: AI auxiliary system for assisting underground pipe network production
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI auxiliary system for assisting underground pipe network production, which relates to the technical field of AI application and comprises an AI auxiliary system, wherein the AI auxiliary system comprises an input interface, a word segmentation module, an AI identification model, an SQL filtering module, a professional data retrieval module, a data back display module and a digital diagram linkage module, a real pipe network project database is queried based on real information generation of pipe network detection data, difficulty of common users in applying different unit pipe network professional databases is reduced, users are helped to quickly and freely integrate queried pipe production data and application data in different professional pipe network data, cost of the users for learning the professional pipe network technical system is reduced, a multi-dimensional display module generates a three-dimensional model of a pipe according to the pipe production data, visual display of the pipe production data and states in the pipe network after pipe production construction can be visually seen according to user input requirements, and working performance of the AI auxiliary system is greatly improved.

title_en: Work injury auditing and managing method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for auditing and managing industrial injury, and relates to the technical field of industrial injury auditing, wherein the method comprises the steps of information extraction, namely acquiring expense information to be settled, converting a expense list in the expense information to be settled into an editable text by adopting an OCR (optical character recognition) technology, and extracting project information from the editable text; the method comprises the steps of judging whether project information is complete or not, if yes, executing an auditing step, otherwise, correcting incomplete project information to obtain a correction result, updating the correction result into project information, and executing auditing, wherein the auditing step comprises the steps of auditing the project information according to a preset operation path by adopting an RPA robot to obtain an auditing result, and sending an alarm signal when the auditing result does not accord with expectations. The application can improve the efficiency of the industrial injury auditing process.

title_en: Accurate marketing method based on large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise marketing method based on a big model, which comprises the following steps of obtaining multi-source behavior data of a user and historical marketing interaction data, constructing a marketing semantic input structure, generating a semantic game state hypothesis set based on a decision sequence big model by combining the marketing semantic input structure with a preset marketing target, generating a candidate marketing strategy set based on each semantic game state hypothesis through the decision sequence big model, constructing a counter fact game model, introducing a CFR algorithm, calculating counter fact gain mapping, dividing time sequence game steps, calculating a counter fact regreture sequence and generating regreture distribution results, determining a long-term optimal marketing strategy based on the regreture distribution results, inputting the long-term optimal marketing strategy and the regreture distribution results into the decision sequence big model, and executing reverse modulation updating on strategy generation parameters. The invention realizes the long-term stable optimization and self-adaptive evolution of the marketing strategy.

title_en: Intelligent service arrangement method and system based on SAAS micro-service architecture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of service computing, and provides an intelligent service arrangement method and system based on an SAAS micro-service architecture, comprising the steps of obtaining a service flow model, wherein the service flow model comprises a plurality of meta-service nodes and connecting edges thereof; before or during starting the dynamic directed acyclic graph, calculating comprehensive criticality scores for each meta-service node, wherein the comprehensive criticality scores are weighted sums of resource sensitivity, topology importance and business importance, marking meta-service nodes with the comprehensive criticality scores higher than a threshold value as critical path nodes, forming subgraphs by the critical path nodes and connecting edges thereof as critical paths, sending high-priority scheduling requests for the critical paths, and adopting standard shared resource pool scheduling strategies for non-critical path nodes. The overall response efficiency and patient experience of the medical service is optimized.

title_en: Pile-plate type roadbed structure digital twin modeling method based on intelligent inversion of geological parameters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pile-plate type roadbed structure digital twin modeling method based on intelligent inversion of geological parameters, in particular to the technical field of digital simulation and parameter identification, which is used for solving the problem of low reliability of long-term performance prediction caused by parameter physical state mismatch of a digital twin model constructed by using construction data in the prior art; the pile pressing force-penetration data, construction records and initial settlement data are obtained, abnormal modes are associated and analyzed to judge data reliability, masking effect intensity of construction disturbance on stratum characteristic expression is evaluated, construction transient response parameters and long-term stable response parameters are analyzed according to the intensity, evolution association rules between the construction transient response parameters and the long-term stable response parameters are established, contribution degree differences of stratum parameters in different space areas are analyzed, soil body state parameters are decoupled into key damage parameters and key recovery parameters based on the evolution rules, and a pile plate type roadbed structure digital twin model is constructed according to the key parameters and the contribution degree differences.

title_en: Electric power capital construction intersection intelligent generation system and method based on large model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of crossing of electric power infrastructure engineering and artificial intelligence, and discloses an intelligent generation system and method for electric power infrastructure construction traffic base based on a large model. The intelligent power generation and visualization system comprises a multi-source data acquisition and integration module for acquiring and processing power basic construction data to construct a structured knowledge base, an electric power vertical large model core module for generating initial intersection content based on the knowledge base and project information, an intelligent generation and visualization module for generating a standardized document and loading a BIM/GIM model to correlate technical parameters to construct a three-dimensional visual intersection scene, a compliance examination and optimization module for comparing and checking the document and marking information with the compliance knowledge base to generate examination comments and receiving corrected target intersection, and an interaction and output module for outputting the target intersection and providing intelligent question-answering and multi-terminal service. According to the invention, through a large model with enhanced domain knowledge, multi-source data fusion, three-dimensional visualization and intelligent examination, intelligent generation and closed-loop optimization of the bottommost content are realized, and the efficiency and compliance guarantee capability are improved.

title_en: WPS-based one-key intelligent discharging bill generation system
abstract_en: WPS-based one-key intelligent discharging bill generation system and data processing method thereof relate to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and industrial data processing. The system comprises an intelligent process enhancement engine, a double-dimensional automatic classification system and a WPS native function integration architecture. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a bill of materials derived by design software, automatically completing weight calculation, allowance addition and process marking by using the engine, automatically grouping according to dual dimensions of materials and shapes by using a classification system, and outputting the automatic grouping to an independent worksheet. The invention is realized by completely relying on the WPS original function and the script, does not need any third-party plug-in, solves the problems of complex manual operation, low efficiency and easy error in the industrial bill processing, realizes the full-flow automation from design data to production instructions, and improves the efficiency and the data accuracy of the production preparation link of the manufacturing industry.

title_en: Interactive self-adaptive generation method and device for transformer substation main wiring diagram
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interactive self-adaptive generation method and device for a transformer substation main wiring diagram, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent substations. The method comprises the steps of loading a pre-constructed typical design frame template and a bus branch interval template of a transformer substation, instantiating the typical design frame template and the bus branch interval template of the transformer substation to generate a typical setting template instance and a branch interval template instance, respectively carrying out graph-mode association on the typical setting template instance and the branch interval template instance to generate a typical setting template instance and a branch interval template instance after graph-mode association, expanding an arrangeable interval according to the typical setting template instance and the number and the shape of the branch intervals after graph-mode association, and centering the branch interval template instance after graph-mode association to the arrangeable interval based on an interactive graph-forming configuration mechanism to generate a transformer substation main wiring diagram. The invention can solve the problems of nonstandard manual drawing, low efficiency, easy error of drawing and model association and difficult control of automatic drawing to drawing effect.

title_en: Time limit early warning monitoring supervision method and system based on AI technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of time limit early warning management and control, in particular to a time limit early warning monitoring management method and a system based on an AI technology, which firstly extract target tasks from a task library, analyze the target tasks by utilizing a natural language processing technology to extract task types, expiration dates and responsible person information of the target tasks, and further judging the emergency degree and importance of the task, further setting the early warning level and frequency of the target task according to the emergency degree and importance of the task, automatically triggering a monitoring supervision mechanism when the deadline of the task reaches the set early warning level, and sending early warning information to relevant responsible persons according to the set frequency to check and remind the task progress. By the method, the efficiency and the effect of service task management can be effectively improved, and the loss caused by task delay is reduced.

title_en: Carbon emission prediction method and system based on full life cycle of transformer substation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a carbon emission prediction method and a system based on a full life cycle of a transformer substation, wherein the carbon emission of the full life cycle of the transformer substation is divided into an installation stage and an operation stage, first type multi-source data corresponding to the installation stage comprises periodic fluctuation data and causal association data, second type multi-source data corresponding to the operation stage comprises node state data and environment association data, a carbon emission prediction model comprising an installation stage sub-model and an operation stage sub-model is constructed, the installation stage sub-model comprises a VMD-LSTM module and a causal interaction module, a total carbon emission prediction value of the installation stage is obtained, the operation stage sub-model adopts a graph neural network structure, the total carbon emission prediction value of the operation stage is obtained, and a total carbon emission prediction result of the full life cycle of the transformer substation is combined with the total carbon emission prediction value of the installation stage and the total carbon emission prediction value of the operation stage and is output.
