The method can realize accurate prediction of the carbon emission of the whole life cycle of the transformer substation.

title_en: Electric automobile charging load prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for predicting charging load of an electric automobile, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source historical data for preprocessing, constructing a robust WRVFL model, taking RVFL as a main body, introducing Wave loss function, xavier initialization, secondary nuclear explicit feature mapping and sparse error matrix for explicit error modeling, adopting an improved boomerang pneumatic ellipse optimization algorithm IBAEO to automatically optimize model super parameters, using the optimized model for load prediction, constructing a multi-objective optimization model with the minimum user charging cost and the minimum power grid load fluctuation as targets based on a prediction result and a time-of-use electricity price, and adopting IBAEO solution to obtain an optimal charging and discharging scheduling matrix. According to the invention, through fusion of the deep learning and intelligent optimization algorithm, the accuracy and the robustness of the electric vehicle charging load prediction under the influence of multiple factors are improved, and the collaborative optimization of the user cost and the power grid stability is realized.

title_en: Multi-mode AI large model-based power grid dispatching automation intelligent operation and maintenance method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for power grid dispatching based on a multi-mode AI large model, which relate to the technical field of power grid dispatching operation and maintenance and comprise the steps of firstly collecting multi-mode information of power grid dispatching operation and maintenance and coupling processing and outputting a coupling characteristic set; the method comprises the steps of inputting a coupling feature set into a multi-mode AI large model to mine an operation and maintenance risk chain, carrying out front deduction, outputting risk evolution chain and full-stage risk state description information, deducing a plurality of operation and maintenance intervention strategies adapting to different risk nodes based on the risk evolution chain and the full-stage risk state description information, carrying out full-scene effectiveness simulation verification on the operation and maintenance intervention strategies to output optimal strategies, converting the optimal strategies into standardized instruction sequences, pushing the standardized instruction sequences to an execution end, carrying out tracking execution, and outputting operation and maintenance intervention results. The invention improves the accuracy, safety and intelligent level of power grid dispatching operation and maintenance.

title_en: Blood donor retention prediction system and method based on survival analysis
abstract_en: The application discloses a donor retention prediction system and method based on survival analysis, and relates to the technical field of donor behavior prediction and blood management. The time-to-live construction module constructs time-to-event status pairs for each donor based on the historical data and aggregates the time-to-event status pairs into a dataset. The risk calculation module calculates the retention probability of each donor at a specified future time point based on the risk ratio of each influencing factor, the reference survival function and the historical data of each donor. The application can accurately predict the retention probability of the donor in the future time period.

title_en: Data processing method and device, digital energy management system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method and device, a digital energy management system and electronic equipment, and belongs to the field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining equipment state characteristic data corresponding to at least one group of power equipment data, analyzing each group of equipment state characteristic data to obtain event identification information and corresponding equipment identification information of each group of equipment state characteristic data, and generating and sending event information to a data acquisition server according to the event identification information and the corresponding equipment identification information so that the data acquisition server can send the power equipment data corresponding to the at least one group of equipment state characteristic data to a designated server. The method can meet the low-time delay and high-efficiency requirements of the energy storage power station in a large-data-volume application scene.

title_en: Agricultural space optimization layout method for cooperatively improving ecological and production benefits
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural space optimization layout method for improving ecological-production benefits in a cooperative manner, which comprises data acquisition and processing, ecological service value and economic value evaluation, multi-objective quantity optimization model construction, space optimization rule construction, space pattern optimization based on Cellular Automaton (CA), scene simulation and scheme evaluation. The invention combines quantity optimization and space optimization, overcomes blindness of traditional experience layout, and provides a set of systematic and scientific industrial space layout decision support method. The invention fully considers the terrain heterogeneity and the industry compatibility of ecological fragile areas such as karst and the like, has reasonable design of optimization rules and strong local adaptability. The space simulation result based on the CA model is visual and visual, so that the planner can understand and apply the space simulation result conveniently, and the optimized layout scheme can be directly used for guiding actual production.

title_en: Bill generation method and device based on intelligent principal payment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a bill generation method and device based on agent entrusting payment, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting resource consumption data in an agent execution task, reporting the resource consumption data to a charging server in real time, determining corresponding agent service fees, generating a disposable payment token application according to task target transaction information after the agent locks the task target, including a transaction target, a transaction object and transaction amount, sending the payment application to the charging server and forwarding the payment application to a payment gateway so as to enable the payment gateway to generate a disposable payment token, wherein the payment authority of the disposable payment token is limited by information in the disposable payment token application, and determining the task execution fees and sending the task execution fees to a user according to the payment amount and the agent service fees after the agent successfully carries out payment.

title_en: Data processing method, data processing device, electronic equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application provides a data processing method, a data processing device, electronic equipment, media and products, which can be applied to the technical fields of computers and big data. The method comprises the steps of responding to a data storage instruction, carrying out data splitting on each piece of data to be stored to obtain split data corresponding to at least one attribute dimension, wherein the attribute dimension represents a data type of the split data, the data to be stored represents a resource purchasing record of a user in historical time, identifying attribute parameters of each piece of split data and resource purchasing information of the user in the attribute dimension according to any attribute dimension, generating attribute aggregation data according to a plurality of split data related to the attribute parameters and respective resource purchasing information according to any attribute parameter, and storing the attribute aggregation data.

title_en: Intelligent scheduling system and method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent scheduling system and method based on multi-source data fusion, and relates to the field of earth construction. The multi-source data acquisition unit is used for acquiring multi-source data of a roadbed earthwork operation site, the digital twin unit is used for constructing and dynamically updating a digital twin body of roadbed earthwork operation according to the fused data, the edge fusion unit is used for carrying out space-time registration and data fusion on the data acquired by the multi-source heterogeneous sensing acquisition layer and extracting core characteristics of an operation situation, the equipment cluster intelligent scheduling unit is used for carrying out full-process linkage scheduling on an unmanned equipment cluster through a multi-target cooperative scheduling algorithm to generate a scheduling scheme, the quality closed loop control unit is in linkage with the unmanned equipment cluster intelligent scheduling layer to form quality closed loop control, the accuracy and the integrity of the data are improved, the comprehensiveness and instantaneity of operation situation sensing are improved, and the cooperative operation and quality closed loop control of the full process of excavation, loading, transportation, pushing filling and compaction are realized.

title_en: Smart city service operation management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart city service operation management method and system, and relates to the technical field of smart city operation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first city service operation strategy and a second city service operation strategy, wherein the first city service operation strategy is used for sealing roads in dangerous goods areas, and the second city service operation strategy is used for dredging roads in crowd gathering areas; and performing strategy parameter adjustment on the first city service operation strategy and the second city service operation strategy to block the road of the dangerous goods area and dredge the road of the crowd gathering area. The invention can analyze the resource competition of two city service operation strategies and adjust the strategy parameters according to the analysis result, thereby dynamically fusing different operation strategies to realize city service operation management and improve the reliability and city safety of strategy management.

title_en: Service soldier training authentication system
abstract_en: A service soldier training authentication system comprises a processing module, wherein the processing module is used for acquiring and preprocessing multi-mode data to acquire skill increment feature components, establishing a digital twin-wheel model, adjusting weights of corresponding skill points in the digital twin-wheel model according to the skill increment feature components and/or external feedback components to acquire a skill point weight matrix, acquiring a standardized course feature matrix, calculating cosine similarity between the skill point weight matrix and the standardized course feature matrix to acquire course content matching scores, acquiring a service soldier-course cross feature matrix and processing the service soldier-course cross feature matrix based on a matrix decomposition algorithm to acquire course prediction scores, linearly weighting and summing to acquire course final scores, sorting the stored courses according to the course final scores, and generating a course recommendation list for each registered service soldier and pushing the stored courses. The application can provide dynamic, personalized and quantifiable training paths for service soldiers.

title_en: Water resource management method and system based on pipe network hydraulic model
abstract_en: The application relates to a water resource management method and system based on a pipe network hydraulic model, and relates to the technical field of intelligent management of water supply pipes. The method comprises the steps of constructing a micro/macro integrated hydraulic model taking epyt tool bags as hydraulic calculation cores based on pipe network topology data, acquiring real-time monitoring data of pipe network water resources through an SCADA system pre-mapped with a pipe network topology structure, inputting the real-time monitoring data into a pre-trained calibration parameter prediction model, outputting a calibration parameter prediction value of the micro/macro integrated hydraulic model, inputting the calibration parameter prediction value into the micro/macro integrated hydraulic model to conduct hydraulic simulation, obtaining a hydraulic simulation result, and executing real-time management service of the pipe network water resources based on the hydraulic simulation result. By adopting the application, the running stability of the water supply system, the water resource utilization efficiency and the fine management level can be integrally improved.

title_en: Traffic accident and offence bailiff condition data analysis and judgment method and system based on large model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing and provides a traffic accident and violation bailiff condition data analysis and judgment method and system based on a large model, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving first query information which is input by a user and relates to traffic accident and violation bailiff condition data analysis and judgment; when the information density of the query information is determined to be high-concentration query, supplementing one or more of implicit accident types, time interval ranges, comparison dimensions or multi-place aggregation requirements in the query information based on a traffic knowledge base to obtain enriched second query information, determining the decomposition necessity of the second query information, when the decomposition necessity exceeds a threshold value, decomposing the second query information into a plurality of third query information with dependence, wherein each third query information corresponds to a single statistical index, a single time interval or a single place, and generating a research and judgment result based on a large model and the third query information. The method can accurately identify the implicit requirements of the high-concentration query, and improve the efficiency and accuracy of analysis, study and judgment of the police condition data.

title_en: Uranium resource investigation prediction method and system based on multi-source geological big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a uranium resource exploration prediction method and system based on multi-source geological big data, and belongs to the technical field of uranium ore exploration. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-source geological feature vector, constructing a multi-source heterogeneous data depth fusion network based on an attention mechanism, constructing an interpretability prediction model based on a graph neural network and a hybrid expert system, adopting a double-population collaborative correction evolutionary algorithm to perform joint optimization on the network and the model, predicting uranium ore potential by using an optimal model and decomposing and outputting feature contribution degree sequencing based on Shapley values, constructing a layering mineral index system based on the contribution degree to generate a comprehensive mineral index, constructing a three-dimensional geological model to stack the comprehensive mineral index, adopting a three-dimensional space clustering algorithm to circle a mineral finding target area, and realizing model dynamic update through incremental learning. The method solves the problems of insufficient data utilization, simple fusion mode, poor interpretation of the prediction result and incapability of dynamically updating the model in the prior art.

title_en: Dynamic generation and execution method of mobile terminal equipment renovation process route based on multidimensional defect characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic generation and execution method of a mobile terminal equipment renovation process route based on multidimensional defect characteristics, and relates to the technical field of intelligent mobile terminal equipment renovation production. The method comprises the steps of constructing a cloud-side-end cooperative four-layer system architecture, collecting equipment data to be renovated through a physical perception layer, generating a standardized multidimensional defect feature vector through edge calculation pretreatment, generating an initial optimal process route through a core business logic layer based on a process atom library and a topology sequencing algorithm, realizing dynamic updating of the process route in production through a thermal reconstruction mechanism, simultaneously realizing multi-source identity identification cooperative binding by matching with a seed triggering linkage calculation model, realizing controllable injection of a security key based on multidimensional environment fingerprints and a dynamic token, and realizing full-flow closed-loop verification through three-party data comparison and a production state machine. The invention realizes flexible control of the renovation process, and improves the production efficiency, the product compliance and the quality traceability.

title_en: Configuration scene generation method under multi-virtual power plant access, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a configuration scene generation method, a storage medium and electronic equipment under the access of multiple virtual power plants, which comprises the following steps of constructing a multiple virtual power plant resource aggregation model based on the resource composition proportion of the virtual power plants to obtain the overall output characteristics and the load probability distribution characteristics of the virtual power plants, generating an initial scene set covering the coupling relation among the virtual power plants by adopting improved Latin hypercube sampling introducing a correlation matrix based on the overall output characteristics and the load probability distribution characteristics of the virtual power plants, constructing the correlation matrix based on actual operation correlation data among the virtual power plants, carrying out voltage power constraint verification on each scene in the initial scene set by combining a power grid trend model and a Newton-Lafson method, screening to obtain an effective scene set, and carrying out dimension reduction optimization treatment on the effective scene to obtain a final configuration scene set. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of high scientificity and practicability of scene generation and the like.

title_en: Management system and management method
abstract_en: The management system (1) is provided with an information acquisition unit (11) that acquires use information (i) of a unit (50) that can be attached to and detached from a production device (20), and a control unit (15) that outputs a treatment instruction signal that instructs treatment of the unit (50) based on the use information (i).

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for evaluating business risk
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a business risk assessment method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving a high risk decision signal aiming at a target entity, executing risk tracing in a pre-constructed knowledge graph based on the high risk decision signal, determining at least one risk conduction path from the target entity, wherein the risk conduction path comprises a plurality of association entities and association relations, extracting key association entities, key association relations and attribute information of the key association entities and the key association relations which form key risk evidence from the risk conduction path, calculating the risk contribution degree of the key risk evidence to the target entity, and automatically generating a risk report comprising a text abstract describing a risk conduction process and a sub-graph visually displaying the risk conduction path based on the risk conduction path, the key risk evidence and the risk contribution degree.

title_en: Method for constructing intelligent report and examination agent for port dangerous goods safety
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for constructing a port danger safety intelligent control report examination intelligent body, which comprises the steps of collecting multisource data of port danger operation, constructing a digital twin body and a multisystem examination data set, obtaining a bluing examination model for resisting fake by red and blue countermeasure training, carrying out multidimensional deduction by using a causal replay verifier and colliding with actual data to generate a physical contradiction list, constructing a full chain evidence chain based on the list, obtaining an integrity score by detection and reasoning, calculating a risk vector by combining the score and risk data to generate a risk superposition state and a decision suggestion, activating historical experience by means of a memory palace system, outputting a structural examination conclusion, and feeding back and updating a core subsystem. The invention verifies report authenticity through digital twin and causal replay, establishes deep causal association, improves anti-fake capability by using countermeasure training, realizes system continuous evolution through feedback, and provides an intelligent examination solution.

title_en: Intelligent information hiding and visualizing method and system for entity commodity anti-counterfeiting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent information hiding and visualizing method and system for entity anti-counterfeiting, which belong to the field of image processing and information security, and balance hiding capacity, visual quality and robustness through a multi-objective optimization function, detect an embedded feasible region insensitive to selected human eyes in a combined region, encode anti-counterfeiting information into an invisible matrix with energy constraint, embed an image airspace to generate a dense carrier, acquire an image by using a smart phone, extract the information matrix through edge detection, reconstruct the visualized information through a decoding library, and finish true and false verification through cosine similarity, euclidean distance or SSIM.

title_en: Dynamic adjustment method and device for power grid fault rush-repair strategy under geological disaster
abstract_en: A dynamic adjustment method and device for a power grid fault rush-repair strategy under geological disasters relate to the field of data processing and can improve dynamic adaptability of task allocation. The method comprises the steps of encoding the matching relation between all to-be-allocated rush-repair tasks and available rush-repair teams in a time window into chromosome individuals, randomly generating an initial population comprising a plurality of individuals, calculating the total utility of individuals of each population, introducing a constraint penalty mechanism, applying adaptability penalty to an allocation scheme against the upper limit of resources in a geological disaster extremum environment, evaluating the population by using a global fitness evaluation mechanism, carrying out iterative optimization through selection, intersection and mutation operation until a preset convergence condition is met, outputting a global optimal rush-repair task allocation scheme under the current time window, reserving the optimal allocation scheme of the last time window as elite individuals, carrying out incremental local adjustment and population reinitialization on partial chromosomes affected by dynamic change, and iteratively updating the rush-repair strategy.

title_en: Deep reinforcement learning-based collaborative search and inspection method, system, equipment and medium for fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire-fighting rescue unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search inspection method, a system, equipment and a medium based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining thermal imaging data of a fire scene and smoke concentration data, generating a real-time fire scene state data set containing fire scene change parameters and trapped personnel position information, processing relevance and fusion of the two types of data by adopting a particle swarm optimization algorithm, generating a fire scene state diagram and a personnel distribution probability diagram, judging a fire scene change trend based on the fire scene state diagram, sequencing trapped areas according to the trend, generating a task priority sequence, generating each unmanned aerial vehicle search path by adopting an A-type path planning algorithm based on the task priority sequence, judging unmanned aerial vehicle transfer requirements according to fire scene change, and finally dynamically adjusting the resource allocation proportion of the unmanned aerial vehicle swarm according to the search path and the task priority sequence, and determining a final task execution scheme after correction. The method can improve the collaborative search and inspection efficiency and reliability of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Safety control method, system, medium and product for transformer substation construction operation
abstract_en: In the method, the position and scene data of operators are collected through deployment positioning base stations and video monitoring equipment, a dynamic dangerous boundary is determined by combining the running state and voltage level of the equipment, the risk level is evaluated by utilizing an operation behavior characteristic recognition model, and the comprehensive risk index is calculated based on weather conditions, so that early warning triggering and differentiated management and control are finally realized. The method realizes comprehensive perception of the behaviors and the equipment states of operators through multi-source data acquisition and fusion analysis, can adapt to complex operation scenes by adopting a mode of combining dynamic boundaries and behavior feature recognition models, and simultaneously corrects risk levels by introducing weather conditions, thereby realizing the influence quantification of environmental factors on safety control and improving the pertinence and effectiveness of the safety control.

title_en: Shared energy storage resource configuration method, shared energy storage resource configuration device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a shared energy storage resource configuration method, a device, computer equipment and a medium, which belong to the field of energy source configuration, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a power demand predicted value sequence and a capacity demand predicted value sequence under continuous unit time length of a multiple relation according to the multiple relation between the unit time length of a load side resource regulation and control system participating in operation and the minimum selling time length of shared energy storage usage right, and further determining a power configuration quantity and a capacity configuration quantity; the tail risk quantization value of the profit distribution under the historical market scene is calculated, the weighted combination of the tail risk quantization value and the expected profit is used as an objective function to be optimized, and the maximized objective function is solved to obtain the power calling price and the capacity calling price of the load side resource regulation system in the period corresponding to the minimum selling duration, so that the peak power requirement in the whole service period can be covered, the running risk caused by insufficient power configuration is avoided, and the running stability and the running economy of the system are enhanced.

title_en: Iterative culture method, device, equipment and medium based on dynamic knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis and discloses an iterative training method, device, equipment and medium based on dynamic knowledge graph, which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-mode initial evaluation data and business resource data of a training object to generate training basic data; generating an initial capacity portrait and constructing a dynamic knowledge graph, generating an initial culture path, target training content and an immersive training scene, collecting multi-mode interaction behavior data and task completion states, generating a training evaluation result, updating the dynamic knowledge graph and generating an iterative culture path, receiving a target processing task, and generating a task processing result. The invention can be applied to business scenes such as financial science and technology, medical health and the like, and the training evaluation result can participate in subsequent path updating and task processing by continuously correlating the capability evaluation, dynamic knowledge graph, culture path and target processing task, so that the continuity of converting the capability state into the task processing result is improved.

title_en: System and method for metering and tracing biomass carbon blending and emission reduction of coal-fired unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a biomass carbon blending emission reduction metering and tracing system and method for a coal-fired unit, belongs to the technical field of electric power energy and environmental protection, and can partially solve the problems of inaccurate metering, lag in carbon emission accounting and insufficient data credibility of the existing biomass carbon blending emission metering. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data storage and verification module and a data display and output module, wherein the data processing module comprises a dry basis correction unit, a combustion inversion calculation unit based on a carbon element conservation relation, a biomass back-pushing unit and a dynamic correction unit and is used for checking the actual participation combustion quantity of biomass through multi-source data fusion and calculating the blending ratio and the carbon reduction amount, and the data storage and verification module is used for carrying out encryption storage on key data so as to realize that the data cannot be tampered. The method is based on the system to realize on-line metering and tracing of biomass blending combustion quantity and carbon emission reduction quantity.

title_en: Intelligent allocation and optimization management method for smart city energy by utilizing AIoT
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent allocation and optimization management method for smart city energy by utilizing AIoT, which relates to the technical field of energy data processing and comprises the specific steps of data acquisition, model construction, valley allocation, peak allocation and dynamic adjustment; according to the method, the monitoring terminals are deployed AIoT on key nodes of the power grid and the distributed energy storage equipment, multidimensional operation data are comprehensively collected and are preprocessed and then transmitted to the energy management cloud platform, classification and trend fitting are carried out by combining load related records of the historical database, and initial power grid load prediction data are optimized through a load prediction correction formula.

title_en: Genetic algorithm-based intelligent scheduling method for post-class service cross-mechanism resources
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-class service cross-mechanism resource intelligent scheduling method based on a genetic algorithm, which comprises the steps of carrying out structural coding processing on acquired basic data to construct a graph chromosome population, carrying out global state coding on a current graph chromosome population to generate population state characterization, inputting the population state characterization into a strategy network pre-trained through meta reinforcement learning, outputting a structural genetic evolution action of the current population state, carrying out genetic evolution operation on the current graph chromosome population based on the genetic evolution action to generate a new generation graph chromosome population, iterating until preset convergence conditions are met, decoding optimal graph chromosomes in the converged population, and generating a final post-class service cross-mechanism resource scheduling scheme. The invention realizes the matching of the cross-institution education resource supply and the school post-class service demand, and the scheduling scheme is adapted to the teaching requirement.

title_en: Mattress comfort evaluation method and system based on force line balance system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of bedding comfort testing and evaluation. A mattress comfort evaluation method based on a force line balance system comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining subjective sleep quality scores, S2, collecting spine form maintenance degree, pressure distribution performance and muscle release degree, S3, establishing a BP neural network evaluation model, S4, repeating the step S2, inputting the other mattresses to be evaluated into a trained BP neural network evaluation model, outputting corresponding sleep quality scores by the model, and quantitatively evaluating mattress comfort according to the sleep quality scores.

title_en: Medicine management method, system and checking equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a medicine management method, a medicine management system and checking equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a video stream image of a medicine taking and placing area, wherein the medicine taking and placing area is an area through which medicines are taken and placed from a medicine box, constructing an identification area through corner features in the video stream image, tracking and counting hand features and medicine features entering and exiting the identification area, and updating counting results in a database corresponding to the medicine box and corresponding medicine storage positions according to obtained medicine box information and medicine information. Therefore, the medicine can be checked when being accessed, and the medicine box and corresponding medicine inventory data can be updated in real time synchronously, so that the accuracy and timeliness of the inventory data are improved.

title_en: Managing transactions on a blockchain network
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for managing transactions on a blockchain network are disclosed herein. One of the methods includes a scheduling device on a blockchain network obtaining transaction data comprising a plurality of original pending transactions to be performed between a plurality of accounts on the blockchain network, the transaction data stored on the blockchain network. The scheduling device performs a consolidated analysis of the plurality of original pending transactions to determine a plurality of modified pending transactions between the plurality of accounts, and the number of the plurality of modified pending transactions is less than the number of the plurality of original pending transactions. The scheduling device maintains the plurality of original pending transactions with the plurality of modified pending transactions without updating the transaction data stored on the blockchain network with the plurality of modified pending transactions.

title_en: Artificial intelligence platform system for artificial intelligence insurance consultation service
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence platform system for artificial intelligence insurance consultation service, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence financial service. The intelligent service platform is built, and an intelligent semantic analysis module, an insurance knowledge graph module, an intelligent consultation response module, a product intelligent matching module, a risk intelligent evaluation module, a compliance wind control module and a data storage and safety seven core module are integrated. The invention relies on the insurance field and the structured knowledge graph to realize intelligent response of insurance consultation, accurate matching of products, intelligent risk assessment and full-flow compliance wind control, thereby greatly improving the efficiency, accuracy and standardization of insurance consultation service, reducing the manual service cost and the business compliance risk, and being widely applied to consultation, insurance assistance and risk answering service scenes on various insurance lines.

title_en: Interpretable time sequence modeling method oriented to price prediction of environment-driven agricultural products
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interpretable time sequence modeling method for price prediction of an environment-driven agricultural product, which relates to the technical field of price prediction of the agricultural product and comprises the following steps: acquiring a historical price sequence, an environment variable sequence and agricultural product category information, and carrying out unified characterization processing on the historical price sequence, the environment variable sequence and the agricultural product category information to obtain an initial hidden representation; sequentially encoding the initial hidden representation to obtain a basic time sequence representation; according to the invention, the accuracy of environmental factor selection is improved by dynamically screening the key environmental state vector; through multi-scale decomposition and fusion processing, the multi-variable time sequence modeling capability is enhanced, and price change and environmental driving characteristics of different time scales can be considered; and through characteristic response analysis processing, a key environment characteristic contribution result can be output, and transparent explanation is provided for a prediction result.

title_en: Construction method and application of effluent quality prediction model of sewage treatment plant in cold region
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method and application of a water quality prediction model of effluent of a sewage treatment plant in a cold region, the method comprises the steps of obtaining water inlet working condition parameters and meteorological environment parameters of the sewage treatment plant, wherein the water inlet working condition parameters comprise water inlet temperature, generating time periodic characteristics, pollutant load characteristics and pollutant proportion characteristics based on the water inlet working condition parameters and corresponding time information, dividing a historical water inlet temperature range of the sewage treatment plant to obtain a plurality of temperature intervals, training a plurality of preset models according to the water inlet working condition parameters, the meteorological environment parameters, the time periodic characteristics, the pollutant load characteristics and the pollutant proportion characteristics of each temperature interval to obtain evaluation indexes, comparing the evaluation indexes of the preset models, screening optimization models corresponding to the temperature intervals, and coupling the optimization models of different temperature intervals to construct the water quality prediction model of the effluent. The scheme realizes the accurate prediction of the water quality of the effluent of the sewage treatment plant in the cold region.

title_en: Mine ecological environment wisdom monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent environmental monitoring, in particular to a mine ecological environment intelligent monitoring system which comprises a mine ecological environment twin body construction module, an ecological degradation path deduction module and a multi-agent cooperative game module, wherein the mine ecological environment twin body construction module is used for acquiring real-time monitoring data and historical disturbance records, fusing the real-time monitoring data with the historical disturbance records to construct a mine ecological environment twin body representing the current comprehensive state of a monitoring area, the ecological degradation path deduction module is used for inputting the mine ecological environment twin body into an evolution deduction model, and the evolution deduction model is internally provided with a multi-agent cooperative game module for simulating interaction rules of different environment disturbance factors to output a plurality of probabilistic evolution prediction paths comprising path occurrence probabilities. The invention realizes the cooperative balance and optimization of strategy effect, cost investment and system stability, provides a quantifiable, interpretable and decision-making intervention scheme for ecological restoration, and improves the intellectualization and scientificity of mine ecological management.

title_en: Electric charge data checking method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric charge data checking method and system, the method comprises the steps of reading electric charge service data, carrying out numerical value and null value mask pretreatment, constructing a three-dimensional tensor of charge data covering a user, a charging element and a time dimension, analyzing an electric charge auditing service rule, algebraically mapping the electric charge auditing service rule into a tensor calculation function based on the three-dimensional tensor, combining the calculation functions to construct a global operation dependency graph, combining a plurality of common tensor calculation nodes which are regularly shared, carrying out topological sorting on the combined graph, carrying out tensor operation in parallel in a layered batch mode, outputting an abnormal identification tensor, and finally extracting abnormal data based on coordinate extraction and high-dimensional tensor slicing and generating a diagnosis report. The invention converts the traditional discrete logic condition judgment equivalence into the bottom matrix parallel computation, reduces the video memory bandwidth consumption through an operator sharing mechanism, and realizes the extremely high concurrency and low-delay accurate diagnosis of millions of mass electricity charge data.

title_en: Multi-person accompanying business handling system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-person accompanying business handling system, which relates to the technical field of financial business and comprises a main business working unit, a temporary business handling unit, a sensing module and a controller, wherein a teller interaction terminal and a client terminal are arranged on the table top of the main business working unit, the temporary business handling unit is limited and slides in the main business working unit through a driving mechanism, the table top of the temporary business handling unit is enabled to be parallel to the table top of the main business working unit by being provided with a lifting mechanism, the controller is used for constructing a distributed interaction topology according to data acquired by the sensing module, and synchronizing the operation state of the teller to the client terminal and converging feedback data to complete collaborative handling.

title_en: Site selection and volume fixation method for distributed power generation and reactive compensation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for locating and sizing distributed power generation and reactive compensation equipment, which relates to the technical fields of reactive power adjustment, operation check and intelligent scheduling of an alternating current power grid in a power supply network, the method obtains the operation data of an operation section of a target alternating current power grid and constructs a power flow calculation basic model, the sensitivity of the reactive power change of each node to the active loss of a system is calculated to screen candidate grid-connected nodes, and setting grid-connected positions and capacities of the distributed power generation equipment and the reactive compensation equipment as joint decision vectors, constructing a multi-objective optimization model limited by the safe operation constraint of a power grid and the capacity constraint of the equipment, and outputting a locating and sizing result or a non-feasible solution prompt through self-adaptive genetic optimization, tide recalculation and final checking. According to the invention, the optimizing range can be reduced in the intelligent scheduling and operation checking scene of the power supply network, so that the equipment configuration result corresponds to the active loss, the node voltage deviation and the line power flow constraint, and the operation checking suitability is improved.

title_en: Adjustable control panel for batch hardcover room bim software system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of hardbound room intelligent system control technique and specifically relates to a batch control panel with adjustable hardbound room bim software system is used, including installing at the inside magazine of hardbound room building wall opening, installing at inside small-size step motor of magazine, human infrared sensor control ware. The utility model discloses a batch hardcover room bim software system is offered the side direction detection groove that is used for installing human infrared sensor controller and is used for installing the overhead turnover mouth of camera on the control button mounting panel with adjustable control panel, and the small-size step motor of human infrared sensor controller control magazine inside through different positions is just reversing to it is convenient to change the shooting, makes whole control panel structure adjustable, and the control is more intelligent; the external equipment that is fixed with end LED light at the camera lower extreme is supporting for whole control panel's functional and later stage expansibility promote greatly.

title_en: Power plant equipment overhauls instrument
abstract_en: The utility model aims at solving the difficult problem that current difficult to power plant equipment short-term test, disclose a power plant equipment overhauls instrument, including the connecting cylinder, the connecting cylinder left side is equipped with the fan, evenly the fastening has the link between fan and the connecting cylinder, fan surface left side cover is equipped with the lantern ring, lantern ring skin weld has the handle, the welding of connecting cylinder right-hand member has the ventilation pipe, ventilation pipe right-hand member fixed mounting has the cardboard, the cardboard is sectional type structure and evenly is connected with the pivot, the cardboard surface evenly is connected with coil spring, cardboard right flank bonding has the gasbag, connecting cylinder fixed surface installs the air pump, the switch-on has the pipe between air pump and the gasbag. The utility model discloses a heat and refrigerate power plant for power plant is in under the extreme temperature environment, observes power plant and whether appears unusually, and then can detect power plant's quality in advance, improves the safety in production.

title_en: Bidding evaluation expert portrait identification system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mark evaluation expert portrays identification system, including the master control device module, information input device module, information classification device module, the alarm device module, the input of signing in device module and statistics accumulator module, the input of information input device module is connected to the output electricity of speech recognition module and expert's information verification module, and the input of information classification device module is connected to the output electricity of information input device module, the SMS sending module, the input of SMS notice module is connected to SMS receiving module and SMS control module's output electricity. The utility model discloses evaluation expert portrays identification system gives speech recognition module and face scanning module with sound and image transmission through audio input and image input to can discern and match speech keyword and face, thereby can reach the information full aspect analysis and the grade to evaluation expert, make the analysis result more accurate with grade, thereby raise the efficiency and the reliability.

title_en: USB-DB 9 communication line applied to intelligent aggregation authentication payment terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a be applied to USB of intelligence polymerization authentication payment terminal and change DB9 communication line, change DB9 PCBA, USB HUB module, agreement conversion module, USB including USB-A male connector, DB9 male connector, communication cable, USB and change the RS-232 module, characterized by are changeed to TTL module and TTL: the top of one end of the communication cable is electrically connected with the USB-A male connector, and the top of the other end of the communication cable is electrically connected with the DB9 male connector; the top in the shell of the DB9 male connector is provided with a USB-to-DB 9 PCBA, and the DB9 male connector is electrically connected with the USB-to-DB 9 PCBA; the USB HUB module, the protocol conversion module, the USB to TTL module and the TTL to RS-232 module are electrically connected in sequence to form the USB to DB9 PCBA. The utility model relates to an interface protocol conversion technology field can realize that payment information system and intelligent polymerization authentication payment terminal directly link the butt joint.

title_en: Wisdom commodity circulation perception device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wisdom commodity circulation perception device, including data interface, processing core, external device is connected with processing core through data interface, processing core includes drive layer, application layer and intermediate level, the drive layer is connected with data interface, the drive layer is connected with the application layer communication through the intermediate level; the application layer comprises WEB service, equipment configuration, firmware upgrading, data fusion and information push. The hardware interface of the utility model is standardized, and can be connected with various logistics sensing peripherals; the ultra-small hardware module can adapt to various product structures; standardizing a logistics perception algorithm; docking various algorithms; standardizing and flatting logistics service data of the external unified interface; and repeated development work is reduced.

title_en: Unmanned bookstore management system based on RFID
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned bookstore management system based on RFID, the system includes spacer, thing networking terminal module, the electronic tags of setting on every books in the bookstore, and a plurality of settlement subsystems, spacer exports the inside regional interval with the bookstore of bookstore and exports at least one settlement passageway, the quantity of settlement passageway equals with the quantity of settlement subsystem, each settlement passageway sets up with each settlement subsystem one-to-one respectively, each settlement subsystem all includes RFID card reading module respectively, the settlement module, RFID settlement module reads the information on the electronic tags, acquire the price information that corresponds according to this information, send this price information to the settlement module and settle accounts. The utility model provides a system simple structure intelligence makes the bookstore realize unmanned management, has practiced thrift the human cost of bookstore management.

title_en: Quantitative loading logistics system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quantitative loading logistics system, which comprises a mobile phone terminal, a checking device, an automatic card receiving and sending terminal, a monitoring service subsystem and a charging terminal, wherein the mobile phone terminal, the monitoring service subsystem and the automatic card receiving and sending terminal are all connected with the checking device, and the mobile phone terminal, the charging terminal and the automatic card receiving and sending terminal are all connected with the monitoring service subsystem; the monitoring service subsystem comprises a monitoring host and a data storage device connected with the monitoring host; the charging terminal comprises a card reader, a serial server and a remote IO module which are sequentially connected with the monitoring service subsystem. The utility model discloses in, the cell-phone terminal is reserved in advance, and the time of registering the factory is distributed to the audit device according to the reservation information, has avoided the condition that the factory gate blocks up, improves thing efficiency; the monitoring host computer passes through long-range IO module control batcher feed, measures the weight of feed belt weigher through serial ports server real-time, and accurate control loading capacity avoids the condition of the repeated feed supplement of delivery vehicle, further raises the efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent detection equipment of tracing to source
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent detection traceability device, including the main casing body and detection instrument epitheca and detection instrument inferior valve of setting respectively at main casing body upper and lower surface, one side swivelling joint of the top of main casing body for the detection instrument epitheca has the beam split apron, the inside of main casing body is provided with detects print module, traces back identification module, beam split detection module, touch screen, display screen, screen mount, ship type switch, line concentration circuit board, colloidal gold immunochromatography detection module and mainboard; through setting up the protection component who comprises guide holder, slip fender lid, flexible fixture block, side slide, card hole and extending structure for during equipment stops using, operating personnel can slide the fender lid that slides to the dead ahead of rectangle breach, causes the rectangle breach can obtain good shutoff, thereby prevents foreign matter such as external dust from gluing on tracing back the identification module, and it brings the convenience to start again for follow-up equipment.

title_en: Energy Internet of things integrated system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy Internet of things integrated system, which comprises an energy Internet of things cloud platform, a plurality of energy integration stations and a plurality of vehicles, wherein the energy integration stations are connected with and manage the plurality of energy integration stations; the comprehensive energy station comprises a business unit, an energy supply unit and an energy storage unit, and is used for providing electricity conversion, hydrogenation and charging services for vehicles; the energy Internet of things cloud platform is connected with the service unit, the energy supply unit and the energy storage unit through the system control bus respectively. The energy internet of things cloud platform is used as an energy intelligent management center to connect all comprehensive energy stations and new energy vehicles in the whole network, has the capabilities of whole network information acquisition, data comprehensive analysis and prediction, energy supply intelligent scheduling, vehicle energy supply path optimization, operation support of various services of the energy stations and the like, fully links the energy, the cloud, the stations and the four sides of the vehicle end, and provides cheaper, cleaner and more convenient comprehensive energy supply service for vehicle owners.

title_en: Management and control equipment for trunk handover
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a management and control device for trunk handover, which relates to the technical field of Internet of things and comprises the following components: the RFID tag is arranged on the tail box; the RFID scanning equipment is arranged at an entrance and an exit of a trunk electronic fence area of a bank outlet and is used for scanning an RFID label on a trunk passing through the electronic fence area, awakening the RFID label, identifying an RFID identifier and sending the RFID identifier to the trunk management and control equipment; the face recognition equipment is arranged at an entrance and an exit of a trunk electronic fence area of a bank outlet and used for acquiring face feature information of escort personnel and sending the face feature information to the trunk management and control equipment; and the trunk management and control equipment is connected with the RFID scanning equipment and the face recognition equipment and is used for verifying the identity of escort personnel according to the face characteristic information when determining that the trunk is currently in a state capable of being handed over according to the RFID identification, and controlling to open the linkage door arranged at the entrance when the verification is passed. The utility model can ensure the high-efficiency and safe delivery of the trunk.

title_en: Remote monitoring system for logistics transportation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a logistics transportation remote monitering system, including information reading and writing equipment, with the RFID read write line of information reading and writing equipment communication for the RFID label of record information sets up the fixed RFID in the packing box and reads the ware and read the on-vehicle gateway of ware communication with RFID, sets up database and server in the high in the clouds, its characterized in that: the monitoring system further comprises the electronic scale, the electronic scale is communicated to the information reading and writing device through analog quantity, the information reading and writing device matches an independent RFID matching code for each piece of information sent by the electronic scale, the RFID reader-writer writes each matching code into an independent RFID label, and the weight information of goods is remotely monitored in three time periods before goods are packed, in the transportation process and after goods are unloaded, so that the purposes of monitoring the load information of a transport tool and determining the link of occurrence of artificial object loss are achieved.

title_en: Novel anti-fake encryption device of exempting from PCB cloth board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel exempt from anti-fake encryption of PCB fabric board device, include: the paper separator comprises a piece of dense cloth, wherein separation paper is arranged on the outer side edge of the dense cloth, and an edge side protective layer is integrally arranged on the outer edge side of the separation paper; meanwhile, bottom glue layers are arranged on the bottom surfaces of the encryption cloth, the separation paper and the side protection layer, and covering layers are arranged on the top surfaces of the encryption cloth, the separation paper and the side protection layer; the MCU main control module is arranged on the densely distributed upper surface, and 2 groups of contacts are arranged on the outer side of the MCU main control module; encrypt the DIE, encrypt the DIE setting at the lower surface of encryption cloth, and encrypt the DIE and pass through the contact and the connecting wire is connected with MCU host system to be provided with communication module between MCU host system and the encryption DIE. This novel exempt from anti-fake encryption device of PCB cloth board is convenient for laminate the use, can guarantee overall structure's stability, guarantees simultaneously that the less product of adaptation size uses, and can be applicable to on the different curved surface products.

title_en: Intelligent park management system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a smart park management system, which controls the circuit between an information acquisition unit and a power supply to be conducted when receiving an external trigger instruction corresponding to an emergency through a trigger unit; the information acquisition unit acquires the current emergency information of the position where the trigger unit is located and sends the current emergency information to the regulation and control unit; the regulation and control unit outputs the current emergency information to the information publishing unit, and displays the current emergency information through the information publishing unit so that management personnel can timely process the emergency according to the current emergency information. The utility model discloses to gather the present emergency information that the trigger unit position of occurrence put the position and demonstrate through the information issuing unit, handle emergency that the managers near messenger information issuing unit can be timely.

title_en: Thing networking payment equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses thing networking payment equipment, include: the system comprises a bottom plate and a communication module, wherein the communication module is used as a main control unit; a fixed structure SIM card is configured on the bottom plate; and the pulse input/output port is integrated on one pin and is connected with the communication module. The OPENPU scheme without the MCU is adopted in the Internet of things intelligent payment equipment, the communication module is used as the master control, the communication instantaneity of the Internet of things equipment is improved, and meanwhile, the production cost of the whole machine is reduced. The patch SIM card is adopted, so that no movable structure is arranged on the PCBA, and the risk of card vibration damage and illegal embezzlement is avoided. The filter capacitor is increased to 220uF at the input end of the DC-DC power supply, so that the payment equipment can normally work under the condition that the power supply of part of equipment is insufficient, and the cost is reduced. The pulse port integrates output pulses and detection input pulses to one pin, and can be flexibly selected according to specific scenes.

title_en: Face recognition payment scanner
abstract_en: The utility model provides a face identification scanner of paying money relates to the face of paying money and sweeps face conference equipment technical field, the utility model discloses a main part and clean structure, the surface of main part is equipped with clean structure, clean structure includes two smooth frames, two the surface and the main part fixed connection of smooth frame, two the equal sliding connection of inner wall of smooth frame has the threaded rod, the arc surface threaded connection of threaded rod has the card frame, the inner wall sliding connection of card frame has the cleaning pad. The utility model solves the problems that the traditional face recognition payment scanner is easy to cause the stain on the camera used for face recognition capture after being used for a long time, and the camera used for face capture is influenced to capture the face of the payer, the payment efficiency of the payer is reduced, the spot generated by the operation screen influences the normal use of the payer, and the problem of the working efficiency of the face recognition payment scanner is reduced.

title_en: Automatic electric energy meter terminal intelligent plugging device that matches
abstract_en: Automatic electric energy meter terminal intelligence grafting device of matching relates to electric energy meter technical field. The device comprises a base, wherein the base comprises a back plate and a bottom bracket; the bottom support is provided with a live wire inlet plug, a live wire outlet plug, a zero wire inlet plug and a zero wire outlet plug. The intelligent plug-in device is arranged along with factory preset of the ammeter box, and the ammeter is directly plugged into the intelligent plug-in device during site construction, so that extra wire-in work is not needed, the site installation efficiency is greatly improved, and the risk of site wiring errors is avoided; the operation of quickly installing the electric energy meter and replacing the electric energy meter without power failure is realized; when the temperature exceeds the early warning threshold value, early warning events and records can be generated, so that subsequent fault analysis and processing are facilitated; the binding and application processes of the connector are greatly simplified; the transmission efficiency is greatly improved by packing or uploading the uploaded data, and a powerful data support is provided for the fine line loss management and fault research and judgment of the power enterprises.

title_en: Campus digital platform network system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of education, in particular to a campus digital platform network system. A campus digital platform network system comprising: the intelligent management subsystem, the teaching informatization device, the life informatization device and the personal informatization device; the teaching informatization equipment is multiple in number and is used for assisting teaching; the number of the life informatization devices is multiple, and the life informatization devices are used for assisting daily life; the personal information equipment is used for interacting with the teaching information equipment to realize auxiliary teaching or interacting with the life information equipment to realize the function of assisting daily life; the intelligent management subsystem is respectively in communication connection with the teaching information equipment, the life information equipment and the personal information equipment and is used for managing data of the teaching information equipment, the life information equipment and the personal information equipment.

title_en: Unmanned on duty remote auxiliary device in toll station
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of highway electromechanical maintenance, and particularly relates to an unattended remote auxiliary device of a toll station, which comprises a lane industrial personal computer, a centralized monitoring room, a three-layer switch, a lane end multi-computer switching module, a monitoring room end multi-computer switching module and an optical transceiver integrated module, wherein the lane industrial personal computer is arranged on a toll station lane site, the video switch, a display, a keyboard, a mouse, a sound and remote control module are arranged in the centralized monitoring room, the three-layer switch is used for carrying out data exchange and transmission with the centralized monitoring room and transmitting control signals of the centralized monitoring room back to the lane industrial personal computer, the lane end multi-computer switching module is connected with the lane industrial personal computer through a video signal wire and a USB (universal serial bus) control wire, the monitoring room end multi-computer switching module is connected with the video switch through a video signal wire and the USB control wire, and the optical transceiver integrated module is arranged on the three-layer switch and the multi-computer switching module and is used for carrying out optical data transmission and reception. The utility model can effectively assist the centralized monitoring control room to rapidly process special-condition vehicles and remotely go to and out of duty, lighten the traffic pressure of toll stations and has better market application prospect.

title_en: Contextual auto-completion for assistant systems
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a method includes receiving a user input including a partial request from a client system of a first user, analyzing the user input to generate one or more candidate hypotheses based on a personalized language model where each of the candidate hypotheses includes one or more of an intent-suggestion or a slot-suggestion, sending instructions for presenting one or more suggested auto-completions corresponding to one or more of the candidate hypotheses, respectively, to the client system., where each suggested auto-completion comprises the partial request and the corresponding candidate hypothesis, receiving an indication of a selection by the first user of a first suggested, auto-completion of the suggested auto-completions from the client system, and executing one or more tasks based on the first suggested auto- completion selected by the first user via one or more agents.

title_en: Pending merge conflict notification
abstract_en: A first client computing device, including a display and a processor. The processor may execute a distributed source code authoring management system client configured to communicate with a codebase host server. The processor may output a graphical user interface (GUI) of the distributed source code authoring management system client and may receive a first edit to a code file in an editor window included in the GUI. The editor window may provide real-time mark-up of the code file. In response to the first edit, the processor may transmit change set information including the first edit to a codebase host server. The processor may receive, from the codebase host server, a first conflict notification indicating that the first edit and a second edit to the code file have a pending merge conflict. The processor may output the first conflict notification to the display for display in the editor window.

title_en: System and method for in-vehicle digital productivity enhancement through peer-to peer communication
abstract_en: In at least one embodiment, an in-vehicle system is provided that includes a transceiver system and a vehicle controller. The transceiver system may be positioned in a first vehicle and is configured to enable communication with one of a surrounding infrastructure to the first vehicle and a surrounding vehicle to the first vehicle. The vehicle controller may be positioned in the first vehicle and is programmed to transmit an electronic request, via the transceiver system, to a Customer Relationship Manager (CRM) server and to receive first information corresponding to the electronic request from the CRM server. The vehicle controller is further programmed to transmit the received first information to one a display in the first vehicle, the surrounding vehicle, and the surrounding infrastructure.

title_en: Welding system and methods of  asset tracking with heartbeat monitoring
abstract_en: A welding system for and methods of welding asset tracking with heartbeat monitoring are disclosed. The welding asset tracking system comprises an asset tracking network of tags, hubs, and/or gateways retained by welding assets within a welding area. The welding asset tracking system generates heartbeat signals that certain welding assets require for normal operation, so as to ensure the welding assets are used in appropriate welding contexts and/or welding areas. In some examples, information obtained from the asset tracking network may be used to determine whether one or more heartbeat signals should be discontinued.

title_en: Secure remote transaction framework using dynamic secure checkout element
abstract_en: Embodiments of the invention are directed to systems and methods of providing secure remote transaction (SRT) transactions. In some embodiments, a resource provider is able to embed a checkout element into a webpage that it hosts. The checkout element enables interaction between a user that has accessed the webpage and an initiator application server located remotely in order to complete a transaction while preventing the resource provider from gaining access to sensitive information. In some embodiments, the user's information may be determined by an initiator server and populated into the checkout element.

title_en: Method, apparatus, electronic device, storage medium and program for broadcasting voice
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, apparatus, electronic device and storage medium for broadcasting a voice, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. A specific implementation solution is: sending a voice broadcast request to a server, where the voice broadcast request includes at least one of scenario information, user information or voice packet setting information; receiving a voice broadcast instruction corresponding to the voice broadcast request returned by the server; and acquiring a personalized voice packet corresponding to the voice broadcast instruction in a local database and broadcasting the personalized voice packet. According to embodiments of the present disclosure, users can obtain consistent and personalized experiences in multiple scenarios, thereby improving the user satisfaction with voice broadcast.

title_en: Self-service product return using computer vision and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: Systems and methods for returning an item. The methods comprise: performing item return operations by a computing device using at least one of machine learned information about a person who purchased the item, machine learned information about a person returning the item, and machined learned information about a condition of the item at the time of sale and at the time of return; and automatively sorting the item using a conveyer system to move the item from a counter to a respective storage area of a plurality of storage areas assigned to different product types.

title_en: System for shared vehicle maintenance and recovery
abstract_en: System, apparatus, device and methods relating to a telematic vehicle sharing platform ecosystem and a telematic vehicle share I/O expander to automate sharing and management of a vehicle that is shared by more than one operator.

title_en: In-store printing of personalized, added value certificates
abstract_en: A method is provided that includes prompting a consumer to input an authentication credential in a network application to access an account in a server, the network application operating in a client device. The method also includes validating the authentication credential in a database and providing, for display by the network application in the client device, a personalized consumer item, the personalized consumer item associated with the account in the server. The method also includes receiving, from the network application in the client device, a print request from the consumer for a selected portion of the personalized consumer item and transmitting a print command to a printer for printing the selected portion of the personalized consumer item. A system to perform the above method is also provided.

title_en: A novel lightweight ceramic sand formulation from lignite fly ash and method of preparation thereof
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a novel lightweight ceramic sand formulation. The present invention particularly discloses the novel light weight ceramic sand formulation from lignite fly ash. More particularly, the present invention discloses lightweight ceramic formulation from lignite fly-ash and the method of preparation thereof.

title_en: Method for collecting data on dogs, accessing and handling these data and equipment for carrying out this method
abstract_en: A method of collecting, accessing and handling data on dogs, wherein access to the data on dogs is available to the user by means of a dedicated system for processing instructions from communication means comprising user devices, depending on the user's authorization level, wherein the system comprises at least two authorization levels for processing instructions from the user, particularly in accessing and entering data stored in a database, where the first group of user roles has the highest level of authorization and is in particular authorized to enter and/or edit data in the database, and another group of user roles is authorized by the system only to ask questions and give answers, wherein within user roles there are superiority and subordination relationships. At least one user role has an exclusive position of superiority over at least one other user role that is in a superior and/or subordinate relationship to other user roles, and furthermore at least two user roles are not in a subordinate and/or superior relationship to any other user role, where at least one user role without a subordinate and/or superior relationship belongs to the first group of user roles with the highest level of authority, wherein at least one user role which is in a superior and subordinate relationship to other user roles belongs to the first group of user roles with the highest level of authorization. The device for carrying out the method according to the invention comprises remote data storage, a mobile and/or non-portable computing device and a chip which marks the animals for subsequent identification of its owner.

title_en: Blockchain-based transaction from offline wallet
abstract_en: A solution (protocol) how to pay, using an offline device, with cryptocurrency associated with an electronic wallet in the offline device, without revealing the private key, is disclosed. The offline device has no connection, at the moment, to a blockchain network managing the cryptocurrency.
