The solution is based on delivering a transaction created and signed by the electronic wallet in the offline device via an electronic wallet intermediary application in an online device to nodes in the blockchain network.

title_en: Card and method for producing the card
abstract_en: The invention relates to a card, in particular a chip card, comprising a computing unit for managing electronic coin data sets, which are output by a central entity, and comprising a card body with visible data and at least one visible feature. At the same time, the central entity is the issuer or administrator of a banknote series, and the at least one visible feature identifies the card as part of the banknote series to an observer. The invention additionally relates to a method for producing such a card.

title_en: Cross-domain frequency filters for fraud detection
abstract_en: This disclosure relates to using probabilistic data structures to enable systems to detect fraud while preserving user privacy. In one aspect, a method includes obtaining a set of frequency filters. Each frequency filter defines a maximum event count for a specified event type over a specified time duration and corresponds to a respective content provider. A subset of the frequency filters are identified as triggered frequency filters for which an actual event count for the specified event type corresponding to the frequency filter exceeds the maximum event count defined by the frequency filter during a time period corresponding to a specified time duration for the frequency filter. A probabilistic data structure that represents at least a portion of the frequency filters in the subset of frequency filters is generated. A request for content is sent to multiple content providers. The request for content includes the probabilistic data structure.

title_en: Systems and methods for electronic portfolio management
abstract_en: Described herein are embodiments of an electronic gas emission management system. The system accepts values for a plurality of emission sources of a portfolio according to native input formats for the plurality of emission sources. The system translates the native input formats into a first format, wherein the first format allows comparing emissions among the plurality of emission sources. The system accepts user input specifying a target emission for the portfolio. The system determines values for one or more parameters using the emission values for the plurality of emission sources stored in the first format and generates a display for the portfolio based on the parameter(s).

title_en: Parcel locker and a method for operating the parcel locker
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for operating a door having a mechanical lock of a parcel locker compartment, comprised in a parcel locker having a service point ID. The method comprises the acts of transmitting beacon signals, comprising the service point ID and receiving a user electronic token tagged with a matching service point ID, comprising a piece ID and instruction of a user event. The method further comprises the acts of creating a parcel locker command for the received instructions and transmitting a parcel locker command signal for the parcel locker command for operating the lock. The invention further relates to a parcel locker, and a foundation thereof.

title_en: Control method, control program, and information processing device
abstract_en: Processing nodes (100) is arranged in a redundant configuration in a first blockchain (BC1), to detect generation of transaction data (D) on a first transaction in the first blockchain (BC1), and control whether to transmit a remote transaction after the first transaction to a second blockchain (BC2) based on the transaction data. For example, each processing node (100) performs a hash operation on data contents of the transaction data (D), and determines a priority order of execution of the remote transaction by each processing node (100). The remote transaction is transmitted to the second blockchain (BC2) when the priority order of a processing node A (100) is highest, transmission of the remote transaction to the second blockchain (BC2) is set to stand by when the priority order of the processing node A (100) is second highest or lower, thereby removing the need for special exclusive control in the redundant configuration.

title_en: Inhalation device, control method, and program
abstract_en:
[Problem] To provide a new mechanism for communication performed by an inhalation device which has a communication function and to which accessories can be attached. 
     [Solution] An inhalation device that uses a base material to generate aerosols that are inhaled by a user, said inhalation device being provided with a first communication unit which performs wireless communication and a control unit which controls the first communication unit, wherein the control unit switches the control of the first communication unit when it is detected that an accessory that is detachably attached to the inhalation device has been attached to the inhalation device.

title_en: Method for assisting with body care
abstract_en: Method for assisting with the body care of a user (100), the method being carried out by a connected mirror (10) and comprising the steps consisting of: - identifying a user (100), - capturing at least one image of the user (100), - extracting from the image at least one physical characteristic, - storing or updating, in the database of user profiles, the user profile (100) with the image and/or the physical characteristic(s) extracted from the image with a time stamp of the image capture, - identifying, in a database of treatments for the body, in accordance with the physical characteristic(s) extracted from the last image captured and time-stamped, a recommendation for body care, - sending a message relating to the recommendation for body care to the user (100) on a display screen of the connected mirror (10).

title_en: System, method, and computer program product for verifying a payment device using a magnetometer
abstract_en: Provided are methods, systems, and computer program products for verifying a payment device using a magnetometer. The method includes detecting a magnetic signature of a payment device based on a magnetic field of the payment device affecting the magnetometer. The magnetic signature may be determined based on the structural composition of the payment device or a circuit arranged on or embedded in the payment device. The method also includes receiving payment device data for a transaction requested between an account associated with the payment device and an account of a merchant. The method further includes comparing the magnetic signature detected from the payment device with a stored magnetic signature associated with the payment device. The method further includes, in response to determining that the magnetic signatures match, approving the transaction.

title_en: Human reliability evaluation method and system, and computer device and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention provides a human reliability evaluation method and system, and a computer device and a storage medium. The human reliability evaluation method includes the steps of: acquiring a task sequence including a diagnosis task sequence and an action task sequence (S201); performing correction processing on the task sequence, to acquire a diagnosis corrected shaping factor corresponding to the diagnosis task sequence and an action corrected shaping factor corresponding to the action task sequence (S202); and evaluating a human error probability according to the corrected performance shaping factor (S203). In the human reliability evaluation method of the present invention, by means of analyzing a task sequence and acquiring a corrected performance shaping factor via correction processing, the problems of qualitative analysis of a performance shaping factor being missing and unclear, qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis not being tightly combined, and credible digital human-machine interface basic data being absent in the prior art are solved, and the problem of an evaluation process involved in the prior art being ambiguous is effectively overcome, thereby effectively improving the credibility of human factor safety evaluation for nuclear power station design.

title_en: Vehicle damage detection system and method
abstract_en: A vehicle damage detection system operating on a computer system for evaluating specific damage to a vehicle. The vehicle damage detection system capturing a 3D point cloud of a damaged vehicle with a 3D scanner and identifies one or more sites of vehicle damage based on comparison of the captured 3D point cloud of the damaged vehicle to a baseline 3D file by identifying points within the 3D point cloud of the damaged vehicle that deviate from an original equipment manufacturer (OEM) standard vehicle of the same type. The damage detection system can be used to determine and identify replacement parts and components and generate an estimate and parts list based on previously damaged vehicles having a similar damage pattern, allowing an improved method for vehicle damage assessment and repair.

title_en: Method and system for digital search optimization
abstract_en: An AI-enabled digital search optimization system is described. The system includes a clustering module configured to cluster a set of keywords into one or more clusters. The system further includes a targeting Al module configured to determine a target audience cohort for a corresponding one of the at least one cluster. The system further includes an advertisement (ad) copy generation module configured to generate a personalized ad copy to the determined target audience. Herein each personalized ad copy comprises a headline and a description, wherein the headline and the description have at least one keyword from the corresponding one of the at least one cluster.

title_en: Billed consumption usage interval estimation
abstract_en: A utility consumption information system may generate a variety of data that is based on and/or derived from utility consumption or usage associated with a site. In some examples, the utility consumption information system may generate data to be provided or displayed by applying a load profile to utility consumption or usage data obtained at the site over a period of time. The utility consumption information system may generate the load profile based on sample interval data obtained from one or more devices (e.g., utility metering devices) sharing characteristics with the site at which the utility consumption or usage data was obtained.

title_en: On-demand applications to extend web services
abstract_en: Systems, methods, articles of manufacture, and computer-readable media. A web browser of a device may receive selection of a uniform resource locator (URL). An operating system may download an application from an application server based on the URL. The application may identify a plurality of applications installed on the device and select a first institution corresponding to a first application. The application may receive a cryptogram from a contactless card associated with the first institution and transmit the cryptogram to an authentication server. The application may receive an authentication result specifying the authentication server decrypted the cryptogram. The web browser may receive, based on the decryption of the cryptogram, an account number, an expiration date associated with the account number, and a card verification value (CVV) associated with the account number. The web browser may provide the account number, expiration date, and CVV to a server associated with the application.

title_en: Computer-implemented method for optimizing a retrofit instruction for retrofitting a technical system or at least one technical component of the technical system
abstract_en:
The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for optimizing a retrofit instruction for retrofitting a technical system or at least one technical component of the technical system, comprising the steps a. Providing a plurality of sustainability data items (S1); b. Providing at least one remaining lifetime and at least one performance indicator for at least one sustainability data item of the plurality of sustainability data items (S2); wherein the at least one remaining lifetime and/or the at least one performance indicator is determined using physics-based modeling; c. Optimizing the retrofit instruction with regard to a minimal ecological footprint based on the plurality of sustainability data items, the at least one remaining lifetime and the at least one performance indicator (S3); and d. Providing the optimized retrofit instruction as output (S4). 
     Further, the invention relates to a corresponding computer program product and technical system.

title_en: Security system
abstract_en: A smart emergency exit sign comprises a housing including a first section, the first section including a center section and two end sections disposed on opposite ends of the center section; a first light barrier disposed between the center section and each end section; light sources in the center section and each end section; and a first non-opaque panel extending from the housing, wherein the lights sources in the center section of the first section and each end section of the first section each illuminate separate portions of the first non-opaque panel.

title_en: Failure cause analysis for a machine line
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for determining the cause of a failure in a machine line for filling and packaging food and/or beverages. The machine line comprises a plurality of machines. The method is used to detect operating states for each of the machines and store same as a data set. After an operating standstill of a machine is detected, the period of time of the data set is requested in order to determine the cause of the failure, and said period of time is used as the basis for an input for a spatial-temporal relational graph convolution network. For each machine of the machine line, the stRGCN specifies the probability that the corresponding machine is the cause of the operating standstill.

title_en: Collaboration using conversational artificial intelligence during video conferencing
abstract_en: Techniques for using collaborative conversational artificial intelligence during video conferencing are provided. In an example method, a video conference provider joins first and second client devices to a video conference. The video conference provider receives, from the first client device, a first prompt and relays the first prompt to a conversational AI, which is followed by receipt of a first response. The video conference provider then outputs, to the second client device, a data structure including information about the first prompt and the first response. In some examples, the video conference provider receives, from the second client device, a second prompt and relays the second prompt to the conversational AI, which is followed by receipt of a second response. The video conference provider then outputs, to the first client device, a data structure including information about the second prompt and the second response.

title_en: Relay device for pos system, pos system, and control method for pos system
abstract_en: A relay device can be connected to at least one peripheral device related to an accounting process. Upon receiving a control request to the peripheral device from a first terminal device configured to accept input related to the accounting process, the control unit can control the peripheral device with the first terminal device as a control entity. Upon receiving a control request to the peripheral device from a second terminal device configured to accept input related to the accounting process after the control according to the control request to the peripheral device from the first terminal device is completed, the control unit can control the peripheral device with the second terminal device as a control entity.

title_en: Method and computer program product for selecting ventilation devices
abstract_en: In a method for selecting ventilation devices to a ventilation system a first subgroup (10) of possible ventilation devices is chosen based on the total supply air need and/or extract air need of the space and an acceptable noise level L(pA1) of the space is selected. The location and air throw pattern for at least one first ventilation device is/are determined, an estimated noise level L(pA,est) produced by a ventilation device in the space is calculated and at least one first ventilation device to the ventilation system is chosen from those ventilation devices of the first subgroup, which produce an acceptable estimated noise level L(pA,est). In the method at least one noise evaluation point inside an air throw pattern of the at least first ventilation device is/are determined and the estimated noise level L(pA,est) produced by a ventilation device is calculated in said noise evaluation point.

title_en: Method and device for communication using barcode image, and wearable component with embedded sensing core engine
abstract_en: The invention proposes barcodes, probably two dimensional (2D) barcodes, that contain data relating to service provided by networked servers. Typically, 2D barcodes may represent URLs which can be used by browsers to access web pages/services (No from S530). In embodiments the barcodes use a different preset coding rule/syntax/format for the data which is understood by the backend servers 41-43 which generate/publish the 2D barcodes (S500, S505) and provide the networked services (S540, S545). The camera which photographs the 2D barcode may be in a mobile device (e.g. smartphone) or wearable device (e.g. glasses). In embodiments the raw data from the 2D barcode may be sent to a backend server for decoding, mobile devices may modify and republish 2D barcodes (e.g. to get paid if modified barcode is used in a purchase), the 2D barcode may include links to download locations of software used to understand preset coding rule data. Embodiments include multiple backend servers which cooperate to provide services.

title_en: Recyclable product, tracking device and method of tracking a recyclable product
abstract_en: A method of tracking a recyclable product, by: activating a wireless communications device, arranged to monitor location, attached to the recyclable product; and in response to being activated 604, switching from an inactive state to an active state 606 in which the device transmits the location to a tracking entity 608. Also, a communications device having receiver, transmitter and controller circuitry, the controller configured to transmit location wirelessly upon being switched from an inactive state to an active state. Also, a method of determining whether to recycle a recyclable product, wherein a communication device is attached to the recyclable product, by: receiving an indication of the location of the recyclable product; and calculating, based on at least one of: recycling processes available to the recycling entity, the identity of the product and the location of the product, a request parameter used to determine whether to recycle the product. The invention provides improved transparency over the recycling process – location of the product can be tracked to verify that it has been recycled.

title_en: A microgrid control system and a method of controlling a microgrid
abstract_en: A microgrid containing power supply units and load units 101-110, providing a plurality of negotiation units configured to operate respective power units 101- 110 in response to collating from each other negotiation unit respective power outputs/demands and priority identifiers, and using a common method to determine which power units to operate, comprising: determining a current total power demand of the microgrid; determining a current total power available; determining a current power excess, equal to the current total power available less the current total power demand of the grid; grouping the power supply units in a priority ordered list of power supply priority; deactivating where necessary, in order of the power supply list, as many of the power supply units as possible without exceeding the current power excess; activating where necessary the remaining power supply units; determining a current power ceiling, equal to the current total power available to the grid; grouping the load units in descending order of priority identifier to obtain an ordered list of load priority; activating where necessary, according to the load priority list, as many of the load units as possible without exceeding the current power ceiling; and deactivating where necessary the remaining load units.

title_en: Production plan drafting support system
abstract_en: To provide a production plan drafting support system capable of supporting the drafting of a production plan.SOLUTION: A production plan drafting support system 1 is provided with a storage unit 12 for storing basic production information and production capacity information, a production basic information selection unit 16 for selecting at least one production basic information from among the production basic information stored in the storage unit based on customer request information, a production plan drafting unit 11 for generating a production plan based on the selected production basic information, the production capacity information, and production progress information obtained from a production site, and a production plan reflection unit 18 for reflecting the generated production plan as the production plan to be stored in the production plan storage unit. The basic production information is generated for each product model, and includes information on each process required for the production of the product and the amount of resource consumption for each resource used in each process, in which resources attributed to the same process among a plurality of resources are managed as a resource group.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Automobile and program for automobile
abstract_en: To provide an automobile configured so that reboarding can be adjusted smoothly.SOLUTION: An automobile is equipped with: urging means that urges a passenger to input a reboarding-plan while indicating whether to permit the other person other than the passenger to utilize or not; memorizing means that memorizes in a first memorizing part information on the reboarding plan inputted in response to the urging by the urging means; and determining means that when detecting a user who tries to utilize an own vehicle, determines whether to permit the user to utilize the own vehicle or not on the basis of information on the reboarding plan memorized in the first memorizing part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: CTI system for telephone sales
abstract_en: To implement a manager advice function in a CTI system that uses a portable telephone distributed to an operator.SOLUTION: A CTI server 5 (a) identifies a portable telephone 1 of an operator in the case of receiving advice data indicating an advice from a manager to the operator from a terminal device 8 in a period in which a group call with a portable telephone 7 of the manager is set, during a call between the portable telephone 1 of the operator and a customer and (b) designates the identified portable telephone 1 and transmits a push notification request including the advice data to a push notification server 6. The push notification server 6 transmits a push notification including the advice data to the designated portable telephone 1. The portable telephone 1 outputs an advice based on the advice data included in the push notification to the operator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Commodity processor, commodity selling method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a commodity processor, a commodity selling method, and a program, capable of controlling permission and prohibition of discounts on products with simple processing.SOLUTION: A commodity processor comprises an input unit and an instruction unit. The input unit receives input in a first period. The instruction unit permits a discount of a first commodity in the first period, and disallows a discount of the first commodity in a second period other than the first period. The instruction unit instructs a settlement device that settles prices of the first commodity and a second commodity so as to allow a discount of the second commodity in the first period and the second period.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Information processing device
abstract_en: To provide a technique which allows a movable body to receive an addition of transport of a new article by taking not only the restriction on the transportable weight of the movable body but also the restriction on the compliance of a driver into account when the movable body receives the addition of the transport of the new article.SOLUTION: A current state information acquisition unit 71 acquires a current state transport condition including each feature amount of one or more articles currently conveyed by a movable body including a prescribed article and a transport route of each of the one or more articles. An additional condition acquisition unit 72 acquires an additional transport condition including a feature amount of an article scheduled to be added and a transport route of the article scheduled to be added. A condition determination unit 73 determines whether or not the additional transport condition can be added to the current state transport condition within a range of the restriction on the prescribed compliance and the restriction on the transportable weight. A determination result notification unit 74 notifies a person who presents the additional transport condition of the determination to the effect that the additional transport condition can be added to the current state transport condition when it is determined that the additional transport condition can be added to the current state transport condition.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Information processor, information provision program, and information provision method
abstract_en: To provide an information processor, an information providing program, and an information providing method that enable a user to reach desired information without being confused.SOLUTION: An information processor includes a reception unit, a determination unit, a generation unit, and a communication control unit. The reception unit receives, when a service of a local government is provided on a chat format screen, selection of a menu item included in a displayed message or an answer to a question from a user. The determination unit refers to a storage unit that stores a table having a hierarchical structure in which a menu item or an answer to a question and transition destination information are associated with each other on a one-to-one basis, and determines the transition destination information corresponding to the selection of the received item or the answer to the question. The generation unit generates, based on the determined transition destination information, a message that displays information on a new menu or a service. The communication control unit transmits the generated message to a user terminal device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Automatic voice response device, server device, automatic voice response method, page transmission method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an automatic voice response device that responds with automatic voice to a call from a user, receives input information input by the user in response to the automatic voice, acquires a text corresponding to at least part of the input information and a unique first page identifier, and transmits the text and the identifier to a server device.SOLUTION: An information system includes an automatic voice response device 4 comprising: a call reception unit 141 for receiving a call from a user; an automatic voice response unit 142 for responding with automatic voice to the call; an input reception unit 143 for receiving input information input by the user in response to the automatic voice; a text acquisition unit 144 for acquiring a text corresponding to at least part of the input information; a page identifier acquisition unit 431 for acquiring a unique page identifier for identifying a page; and a page identifier transmission unit 441 for transmitting the text acquired by the text acquisition unit and a first page identifier, the page identifier acquired by the page identifier acquisition unit, to a server device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Information processing device
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device for achieving a service subscription of a user at cost corresponding to profit brought about by the user in the service.SOLUTION: In an information processing system, a first determination unit 35 of an information processing device 30 determines a relation between an access history of each user before the user subscribes a service and an excellent user score about the user after the user subscribes the service. A second determination unit 36 determines a relation between the excellent user score of each user and a profit score brought about to a service provider by the user. A calculation unit 37 calculates cost for allowing the user before subscribing the service to subscribe the service on the basis of the relation determined by the first determination unit 35 and the relationship determined by the second determination unit 36. An output unit 34 outputs information on a calculation result by the calculation unit 37.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Order management system, order management device, and program
abstract_en: To provide an order management system that prevents reception registration due to unfair use of a reception terminal.SOLUTION: An order management system that manages turn-waiting status in a facility, includes an order management server that manages the turn-waiting status for the facility with a turn-waiting list, and an order management terminal that receives registration for turn-waiting for the facility, with a login account and available area set. The order management server includes: a position information reception unit that receives position information of the order management terminal logged in with the account; a position information determination unit that determines, based on the position information, whether or not the order management terminal is within a preset available area; and a turn-waiting registration unit that registers, when the order management terminal is within the available area, turn-waiting registration via the order management terminal in the turn-waiting list.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Provider information management system and server
abstract_en: To provide a provider information management system and server for grasping provider information without changing a provider code given to the provider information.SOLUTION: An information management server 20 of provider information management system comprises: a first database that stores first provider information to which a provider code is given as a mother code; a second database that stores second provider information newly input; a determination module that determines whether or not the second provider information matches the first provider information; an egg code imparting module that gives a provider code for identifying an arbitrary provider different from the mother code to the second provider information as an egg code when the first provider information does not match the second provider information; and a mother code identification module that associates the egg code with the mother code of the matched first provider information when the first provider information matches the second provider information after giving the second provider information the egg code.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Method and apparatus for pushing information, electronic apparatus, storage medium, and computer program
abstract_en: To provide a method for pushing information, where automatic push of information is achieved and user experience is enhanced.SOLUTION: A method includes: performing informatization processing on all user comment sentences based on a consensus phrase set, to obtain a candidate recommendation information set, the candidate recommendation information set comprising at least one consensus comment sentence, and the consensus phrase set comprising a consensus phrase presenting in at least two pieces of user comment sentences; determining a representation vector of each consensus comment sentence in the candidate recommendation information set; and determining, based on the representation vector of each consensus comment sentence, an attractiveness ranking position of each consensus comment sentence in the candidate recommendation information set, and pushing information according to the determined attractiveness ranking positions.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Method, device and system for detecting person with high fever
abstract_en: To provide a method, device and system for detecting a person with a high fever which detect a person with a high fever whose body temperature exceeds a prescribed value and notify of the detection result.SOLUTION: A method, device and system for detecting a person with a high fever detect a person with a high fever whose body temperature exceeds a prescribed value by using a first signal obtained from a first optical sensor 806 having the sensitivity to infrared light and a second signal obtained from a second optical sensor 816 including an image pick-up device having the sensitivity to wavelength light other than the infrared light, and notify of the detection result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Information processing device and control program thereof
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device and a control program thereof which can efficiently perform handling processing to a plurality of code settlement brands.SOLUTION: An information processing device comprises acquisition means, reception means, and notification means. The acquisition means acquires a settlement code. The reception means accepts designation of a code settlement company. The notification means notifies users, when the code settlement company identified by a company identification code included in the settlement code acquired by the acquisition means does not match the code settlement company which accepted the designation by the reception means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Photo card providing system
abstract_en: To provide a photo card providing system capable of providing an original photo card and promoting purchase motivation of a purchaser.SOLUTION: A photo card providing system 1 includes a portable communication terminal 2, a server 3, and a card printing terminal 4. The portable communication terminal 2 includes access means 21 for accessing the server 3, upload means 22 of image data, code receiving means 23 for an authentication code. The server 3 includes giving means 31 for giving the authentication code, transmission means 32 for transmitting the authentication code, and transfer means 33 for transferring the image data to the card printing terminal 4. The card printing terminal 4 includes input means 41 for the authentication code, code transmission means 42 for the authentication code, receiving means 43 for receiving the image data, storing means 44 for storing a plurality of cards in a random order where various pictures are printed on one surface of the cards, and printing means 45 for printing the received image data on the other surfaces of the cards.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Checkout system
abstract_en: To provide a checkout system capable of facilitating settlement processing.SOLUTION: A checkout system includes a registration device for executing registration processing of a commodity to be sold to a customer, and a settlement device for executing settlement processing of the commodity registered by the registration device. One or a plurality of settlement devices are provided for each predetermined settlement method. The registration device includes discrimination means for discriminating a settlement method of the commodity for one transaction registered in the registration processing, and transmission means for transmitting a breakdown of commodities of one transaction registered in the registration processing to the settlement device capable of executing settlement processing by the settlement method discriminated by the discrimination means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, information processing program, and recording medium
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device, an information processing method, an information processing program, and a recording medium capable of estimating road congestion.SOLUTION: An information processing device includes: a first reception unit that receives traffic information; a second reception unit that receives action information; a first acquisition unit that acquires a first index regarding a frequency at which a user moves to a facility based on first action information (action information) regarding user's past action; an identifying unit that acquires driving status of a vehicle traveling on a road at the time when a user having a relatively high first index moves to the facility based on the traffic information received by the first reception unit and identifies a user who is moving to the facility when there are relatively few vehicles traveling on the road; and an estimation unit that estimates that there are relatively few vehicles traveling on the road when the user identified by the identifying unit is moving to the facility, based on second action information (action information) newly received by the second reception unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device and a related program capable of assisting in acquiring corporate information.SOLUTION: According to one aspect of the present invention, an information processing device includes a reception unit, an acquisition unit, an addition unit, and a management unit. The reception unit is configured to be able to receive an input of first corporate information. The acquisition unit is configured to be able to acquire second corporate information that can be acquired via the Internet. The addition unit is configured to be able to generate third corporate information in which the second corporate information is added to the first corporate information, in which the second corporate information is weighted according to an acquisition source of the second corporate information and included in the third corporate information. The management unit stores and manages the third corporate information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Telephone-corresponding business support system, telephone-corresponding business support method, and program
abstract_en: To support an operator of telephone-corresponding business to perform a plurality of tasks such as question and guide without omission.SOLUTION: A telephone-corresponding business support system includes: a task list DB14 g for storing a plurality of pieces of task data each including a task name of a task in telephone-corresponding business and speech data indicating speech contents to be performed in the task; a task list acquisition section 14d for displaying the task name included in each of the plurality of pieces of task data on an operator terminal of the telephone-corresponding business; and a task determination section 14e for determining which task data of a task among the plurality of pieces of task data is completed on the basis of a voice of the operator in the telephone-corresponding business and the speech data included in each of the plurality of pieces of task data, and for executing display control for discriminating the task name of the task determined to have been completed from the other task name on a display when any task determined to have been completed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method and information processing program
abstract_en: To accurately predict timing when excretion is done.SOLUTION: An information processing device includes: an acquisition unit for acquiring in-vivo information that is information relating to in-vivo excretion and body-outside information that is different from the in-vivo information but information relating to the outside of the body; and a prediction unit for predicting excretion timing when a wearer wearing an absorbent article excretes in the future on the basis of the in-vivo information and the body-outside information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Program, information processing method, information processing device, and system
abstract_en: To facilitate discriminating moving objects from each other, the moving objects corresponding to real-world race participants and mobile bodies.SOLUTION: A program to be run in a first computer causes a processor to execute: a step for receiving first information about a real-world race from a second computer; a step for generating, on the basis of the first information, a virtual object for presenting second information about the race to a user; and a step for displaying the virtual object superimposed on a real image captured by an image capturing unit. The first information includes at least participant information about race participants and/or mobile bodies. The virtual object includes at least moving objects 502a, 502b corresponding to the participants or the mobile bodies. At least some of the participant information is displayed in association with the moving objects 502a, 502b in the display step.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Transfer procedure assisting method
abstract_en: To provide a transfer procedure assisting method, despite of performing a former transfer procedure of bringing a transfer request form to a bank teller's window, capable of saving an office procedure for both of a customer and a bank and having high authenticity.SOLUTION: A bank server 20 includes a transfer request form format provision step and a transfer request reception processing step. A banking office terminal 30 includes an information embed code reading step of reading identification information of an information embed code displayed on a transfer request form 40 brought by a customer, a transfer information acquisition step of transmitting the identification information read by the information embed code reading step to the bank server 20 and acquiring transfer information to which the identification information is attached, from the bank server 20, an authenticity determination step of determining authenticity between the transfer information displayed on the transfer request form 40 and the transfer information acquired from the bank server 20, and a transfer processing step of performing the transfer processing when it is determined to be true in the authenticity determination step.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, program, system, and information processing method
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device, a program, a system, and an information processing method that can acquire in-zone history information indicating the history of a wireless communication device having a communication area in which wireless communication terminals have been in the past.SOLUTION: In a system, an information processing device 100 includes: an information acquisition unit that acquires in-zone history information indicating the history of a wireless communication device having a communication area in which a wireless communication terminal has been in the past; a distribution information determination unit that identifies a predicted course of a user of the wireless communication terminal based on the in-zone history information and determines distribution information to be distributed to the wireless communication terminal based on the predicted course; and a distribution control unit that performs control so as to distribute the distribution information to the wireless communication terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Assignment system and assignment program
abstract_en: To simplify in securing workers providing order-pickup services.SOLUTION: An assignment system comprises: an order reception section for, from client terminals connected via a web, receiving input of information about products to be purchased, and causing a prescribed storage section to store the input as order information; a worker management section for, upon receiving input of identification information stored in advance in the prescribed storage section as information to identify a work member, determining that the work member has entered into his/her assigned post; a selections provision section for providing the order information read from the storage section to receive selection operation; and an assignment processing section for assigning the order information to which the selections provision section has received the selection operation, as a job for the work member who has entered into the assigned post.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 11- 2

title_en: Control unit, communication system, program, and advertisement sales method
abstract_en: To sell an advertisement frame in association with a specific geographical range.SOLUTION: A control unit 20 comprises: a communication unit that transmits range data indicating a geographical range through which at least one vehicle 11 passes to at least one bidding device 40, and receives bidding data for bidding for an advertisement frame corresponding to the geographical range indicated in the range data from the at least one bidding device 40; and a control unit that determines a bidder to whom the advertisement frame is sold based on the bidding data received by the communication unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing system, information processing method, and information processing program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing system capable of increasing the number of users while preventing the work efficiency of a kitchen of a facility from decreasing, an information processing method, and an information processing program.SOLUTION: An information processing system includes: an acquisition processing unit that acquires reservation information of a reserved facility for which a first cooking menu is designated out of multiple cooking menus; and an output processing unit that outputs updated information of the first cooking menu on a target date of use or in a target time zone of use based on the reservation information acquired by the acquisition processing unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Product provision server and product provision system
abstract_en: To provide a product provision server with which everyone feels free to participate in a design market, and a product provision system provided with this server.SOLUTION: In a product provision server 1, a parts information acquisition unit 131 acquires parts information from a parts business operator terminal. A design interface unit 132 provides an interface for conducting the design of a product utilizing the acquired parts information. A product provision unit 133 provides a purchaser user terminal with information pertaining to the designed product. When a purchase request for the designed product is received from the purchase user terminal, a parts information transmission unit 135 transmits request information that is sent to a designated fabricator to the parts business operator terminal for the parts used in the product. Meanwhile, a product assembly information transmission unit provides the fabricator terminal with information for product assembly and delivery destination information for the finished product.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Management server
abstract_en: To provide an improvement plan provision system causing an AI to select improvement plans based on diagnostic results of work environment, etc. obtained from employees, further extracting improvement plans desired by users from the selected improvement plans and providing task management and a procedure manual.SOLUTION: An improvement plan provision system comprises: a user terminal 100 and a management server 120 to be connected to the user terminal 100 via a network. The management server includes: an analyzer 140 for acquiring diagnostic data 220 from the user terminal 100, calculating an evaluation score 310 based on responses 230 of all employees included in the acquired diagnostic data 220 and generating analysis results 300 based on the calculated evaluation score 310; an improvement plan list screen generator 150 for generating an improvement plan list screen 700 based on the analysis results 300; and an improvement plan list screen provider 151 for providing the generated improvement plan list screen 700 to the user terminal 100.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Management device, program, system, and management method
abstract_en: To provide a management device capable of suppressing an increase of malicious content in a conspicuous place on the basis of reliability of a content distributor, a program, a system, a management method, and a spectacle-type device.SOLUTION: In a system, a management server 100 receives registration of content from a communication terminal 200, and distributes the content to a spectacle-type device 300. The spectacle-type device 300 transmits evaluation of the content to the management server 100. The management server 100 determines reliability of a content distributor who registered the content on the basis of evaluation of the acquired content.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Program, method, information processing device and system
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide all-you-can-stuff shopping that a user can enjoy easily. 
     SOLUTION: A program causes a computer including a processor and a memory to execute processing. The program causes the processor to execute the steps of; assigning points to a user; receiving selection of products to which points are allocated, from the user; presenting, to the user, the assigned points, points allocated to the products and residual points obtained by subtracting a sum of the points of the selected products, from the assigned points; and in a state where the residual points are 0 or more, receiving termination of the product selection. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Power failure risk evaluation system and power failure risk evaluation method
abstract_en: To solve a problem that a reduction of power failure damage by a storage battery or a private power generation facility installed by a consumer is not considered, or even if being considered, it is evaluated based on a simple assumption that it will function without exception in an event of a disaster, and a risk of loss of a function of a power failure countermeasure itself is not considered.SOLUTION: A power failure risk evaluation system 1 includes a power failure probability evaluation unit 12 that analyses a power system with an event tree and evaluates a power failure probability of the power system, and a power failure risk evaluation unit 14 that evaluates a power failure risk of the power system based on the power failure probability. In this way, it is possible to contribute to consideration of a rational countermeasure for reducing the power failure risk.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 17

title_en: Electronic game parameter setting system, electronic game parameter setting program and electronic game parameter setting method
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To appropriately set a parameter in a different electronic game in a token used in an electronic game. 
     SOLUTION: An electronic game parameter setting system for setting a parameter in an electronic game different from the electronic game with respect to an object token being a token about the electronic game and being a transaction object in a transaction market, adjusts the parameter set in the object token according to an adjustment coefficient set in each electronic game. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Disease predication system, premium calculation system and disease prediction method
abstract_en: To provide a disease prediction system, a learnt model generation method and a disease prediction method capable of predicting a possibility that animals will be affected by disease in the future in a simple way.SOLUTION: A disease prediction system comprises reception means 31 of receiving occupancy data and diversity data of intestinal microbiota of animals other than humans, and determination means 11 of predicting and determining whether the animals will be affected by disease from the occupancy rate data and diversity data of the intestinal microbiota of the animals input to the reception means 31 using a learnt model. The determination means performs learning by using the occupancy data and diversity data of the intestinal microbiota of animals other than humans and the presence or absence of disease within a predetermined period from the acquisition time of the occupancy data and diversity data of the intestinal microbiota of the animals as teacher data; uses input as the occupancy data and diversity data of the intestinal microbiota of the animals; and uses output as predictive determination as to whether the animals will be affected by disease.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Delivery route generating device and delivery route generating method
abstract_en: To provide a delivery route generating device and a delivery route generating method that can conduct a delivery efficiently.SOLUTION: According to an embodiment, a delivery route-generating device has a memory, a communication unit, and a processor. The memory stores a parameter for generating a delivery route. The communication unit communicates with an external system that provides dynamic information. The processor updates dynamic routing information or the parameter as setting information for generating a delivery route according to the dynamic information that the communication unit acquires from the external system, if there is no update on the setting information according to the dynamic information, generates a delivery route using the basic routing information and the parameter, and if there is an update on the setting information according to the dynamic information, generates a delivery route using the updated dynamic routing information and the parameter.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Repair personnel management system
abstract_en: To provide a repair personnel management system capable of allowing a suitable repair inspection worker to respond to a failure or the like of a water heater.SOLUTION: A management server 3 communicably connected to water heater-side control means 7 and business office-side control means 8 of each of a plurality of water heaters 1 via communication means 5, includes: failure information prediction means 10 for predicting failure information about the water heaters 1; repair data management means 11 for managing past repair performance data; difficulty calculation means 12 for calculating repair difficulty based on the failure information; worker selection means 13 for selecting a repair inspection worker suitable for the repair difficulty based on the repair difficulty and the past repair performance data; and output means 14 capable of outputting information on the selected repair inspection worker to an external communication terminal 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Cleaning work support program, cleaning work support server and cleaning work support method
abstract_en: To provide a method allowing respective cleaning companies to appropriately perform cleaning work even when the number of personnel necessary for cleaning work changes with a change in a room occupancy ratio.SOLUTION: A cleaning work support program includes: when the number of workers in one business day specified for one cleaning area responsible to one cleaning company is less than the number of workers determined to be necessary for the cleaning work of the one responsible cleaning area in the one business day, filling the shortage of personnel in the cleaning work of the one responsible cleaning area with one or more excess workers (workers workable in the one business date and having no assigned cleaning duties) belonging to another cleaning company.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Disaster response assisting apparatus, disaster response assisting program, and disaster response assisting method
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable collecting information on damages received by each disaster victim due to a disaster, and providing suitable aid to each disaster victim at suitable timings. 
     SOLUTION: A disaster response support device includes: a disaster index data acquisition unit which acquires disaster index data; an investigation slip data transmission unit that transmits investigation slip data to a terminal, transmits inquiry destination data indicating at least one of an URL of a website or a chatbot for outputting an answer, wherein the URL shows at least one of an answer to inquiries made by a person who manages a building to an institution performing an activity of assisting users of the building or candidates of the answer, and if an index indicated by the disaster index data is equal to or greater than a prescribed threshold, transmits the investigation the slip data and the inquiry destination data to the terminal without delay after the disaster occurs, and transmits the investigation slip data and the inquiry destination data to the terminal after a prescribed period has elapsed once the disaster occurs; and an answer data receiving unit which receives answer data from the terminal. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3 
     COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Information processing apparatus, program, and information processing method
abstract_en: To provide an information processing apparatus, program and method configured to respond to an inquiry more smoothly online.SOLUTION: An information processing apparatus executes processing of a receiving step, an interaction connection step, a first display control step, and a second display control step. The receiving step receives call information and display information on a user terminal from the user terminal. The interaction connection step provides an interaction environment between an operator and a user, based on the call information. The first display control step displays, based on the display information, a website displayed on the user terminal on an operator terminal while reproducing a display mode thereof, and displays an image of the operator who operates the operator terminal or an avatar image synchronized therewith on the website, in the interaction environment. The second display control step displays guide information for moving on the website or screen transition, based on the operation of the operator, on the website.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Information management device, capsule toy sales device, reading terminal, capsule toy management system device, information management method, information processing method, capsule toy management method, program, and recording medium
abstract_en: To provide an information management device capable of supporting information management regarding objects and storage facilities.SOLUTION: An information management device 10 according to the present invention includes: a linking information acquisition unit 11 that acquires code information of an object and identification information of a communication destination, the communication destination being at least one of a storage facility that stores the object so as to be taken in and out and an accessory device of the storage facility; a management unit 12 that manages the object by linking the code information of the object and the identification information of the communication destination; and a communication destination information acquisition unit 13 that acquires communication destination information associated with the identification information from the communication destination, the communication destination information being information about at least one of the object, the storage facility, and the accessory device. The management unit 12 performs information management about at least one of the object, the storage facility and the accessory device using the communication destination information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Process management system
abstract_en: To enable input of a state of progress more easily.SOLUTION: A display device 104 includes a reception function 141 and a display function 142. The reception function 141 receives a BIM model, stored by a first storage device 101, and progress information, stored by a second storage device 103, via a network 105. The display function 142 displays the progress information received by the reception function 141 in association with attribute information of the BIM model received by the reception function 141. The display function 142 displays the progress information received by the reception function 141 in a display form different for every corresponding process in association with the attribute information of the BIM model. For example, the display function 142 displays the progress information received by the reception function 141 in a color different for every corresponding process in association with the attribute information of the BIM model.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an improved technique for generating vehicle health records.SOLUTION: A control unit of an information processing device 20 provided herein is configured to acquire location information of a vehicle 10, acquire season information at locations indicated by the location information, and identify a travel history in a coastal area in each season indicated by the season information on the basis of the location information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Data management device, data sharing system and method, and data management program
abstract_en: To allow a data user to easily find out desired data and share the data, which is the problem to be solved by the present invention.SOLUTION: In an aspect of the present invention, a data management device comprises a control unit that, based on setting information on publication of data to be shared that is transmitted from a first user terminal and stored in an exclusive storage area for a first user, publishes processed data obtained by processing the data to be shared, in response to a request for sharing the data to be shared that is the original data of the processed data, the request transmitted from a second user terminal, causes the first user terminal and the second user terminal to chat with each other, when sharing agreement is acquired between the first user and the second user, creates a common storage area accessible only by the first and second users, stores a copy of the data to be shared in the common storage area, and permits the second user terminal to have an access to the common storage area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Content management server, content management device, content management system, and content management program
abstract_en: To give motivation to a first user being watched before performing a specific action.SOLUTION: A content management server 20 transmits content to a first information terminal 30 used by a first user. The content management server 20 stores first content as an enhancer to improve the willingness of the first user to perform a specific action at the stage of preparatory actions before the specific action, receives preparatory action information related to preparatory actions before the specific action from the first information terminal 30, and transmits the first content to the first information terminal 30 in response to the reception of the preparatory action information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicle dispatch service system
abstract_en: To ensure that a vehicle dispatch service provided in consideration of user's convenience can function satisfactorily.SOLUTION: A vehicle dispatch service system that provides a vehicle dispatch service in which vehicles are dispatched to users in order to arrive at the hospital according to the reservation time of the user's hospital, comprises an arrival time calculation unit (111) for calculating a time at which the vehicle is estimated to arrive at the hospital as an estimated arrival time, an arrival estimation unit (112) for acquiring the estimated arrival time from the arrival time calculation unit and estimating whether or not the user can be in the reservation time of the hospital, a rebooking unit (113) for resetting the user's reservation time to a new reservation time based on the estimated arrival time when it is estimated that the user cannot be in the reservation time, a re-reservation output unit (114) for outputting the new reservation time to a predetermined output destination so that the new reservation time can be recognized by the user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Determination method, program, and determination system
abstract_en: To provide a determination method, program, and determination system for reducing a possibility to cause trouble due to deterioration of a cognitive function of an occupant of a vehicle.SOLUTION: A determination method includes a voice acquisition processing ST3, evaluation processing ST4, and output processing ST6. The voice acquisition processing ST3 includes acquiring voice data indicating voice uttered by an occupant of a vehicle via an information communication apparatus mounted on the vehicle and exclusive for driving. The evaluation processing ST4 includes evaluating the level of a cognitive function of the occupant based on the voice data acquired by the voice acquisition processing ST3. The output processing ST6 includes allowing notification information based on a result of the evaluation processing ST4 to be notified to at least one of the occupant and a person concerned of the occupant.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Remote control device and remote control program
abstract_en: To provide a remote control device and a remote control program that can improve guidance to users performed by remote attendants.SOLUTION: According to the embodiment, a remote control device includes an interface, a communication unit, and a control unit. The interface is connected to an operation panel including a display unit. The communication unit communicates with each device installed in a station. The control unit displays on the display unit a remote operation screen that is arranged with: an intercom control screen that includes a ticket display area that displays an image captured by a ticket camera that takes a picture of a ticket presented by a person using the user intercom installed in the station; and a station operation screen that displays a status of each station operation device installed in the station.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Advertisement for vehicles management device, advertisement for vehicles management method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an advertisement for vehicles management device with which it is possible to grasp direct effects deriving from the fact that an advertisement is displayed.SOLUTION: In a system where an advertisement for vehicles management device, a server and a plurality of vehicles are capable of communicating with each other via a network, an advertisement for vehicles management device 10 comprises: an advertisement display control unit 50 for causing advertisement information to be displayed in the display region of the plurality of vehicles; an image acquisition unit 52 for acquiring image information in which the surroundings of vehicles are imaged; an activity detection unit 54 for detecting the prescribed activities of people in the surroundings of the vehicles from the image information acquired by the image acquisition unit; a reaction estimation unit 56 for estimating the reaction to the advertisement information of the people in the surroundings of the vehicles from the activities detected by the activity detection unit; and an information output unit 58 for outputting information based on the degree of interest toward the advertisement information that is estimated by the reaction estimation unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: communication system
abstract_en: To facilitate communication useful for avoiding accidents and troubles in a vehicle during transportation even if a staff member familiar with mental care is not in the same vehicle as the vehicle transporting users such as elderly people with mental health issues.SOLUTION: A facility side management apparatus 30 and user communication devices 20A to 20C located near users on a shuttle vehicle 10 are connected in a communicable state via an on-vehicle device 11 mounted on the shuttle vehicle 10. Appropriate communication is achieved by transmitting support information from caregivers or the like on the facility side from the facility side management apparatus 30 to the user communication devices 20A to 20C and providing nonverbal information stimulation to the users from the user communication devices 20A to 20C. Visual stimulation, tactile stimulation, visual stimulation and the like are provided to the user by using stuffed animals with movable parts, sheets, or the like.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Equipment position setting system
abstract_en: To provide an equipment position setting system capable of easily creating a map in which a position of equipment is associated with equipment identification information of the equipment.SOLUTION: An equipment position setting system 1 includes a position information collection unit 2, an equipment information collection unit 3, a setting unit 4, and a map creation unit 5. The position information collection unit 2 collects multiple pieces of position information S1 comprising coordinate information S3 indicating positions of movable coordinate detectors 6 and first association information associated with the coordinate information S3. The equipment information collection unit 3 collects multiple pieces of equipment information S2 including equipment identification information S4 allocated to equipment 7 and second association information associated with the equipment identification information S4. The setting unit 4 generates correspondence information by associating the equipment identification information S4 with the coordinate information S3 on the basis of the multiple pieces of position information S1 and the multiple pieces of equipment information S2. The map creation unit 5 creates a map indicating positions of the equipment 7 on the basis of the correspondence information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Inspection item setting system, inspection item setting method, and inspection item setting program
abstract_en: To provide an inspection item setting system, an inspection item setting method and an inspection item setting program capable of easily setting inspection items for a facility.SOLUTION: A facility management system 1 comprises: an acquisition processing unit 211 that acquires facility information on a target facility that is a facility to be registered; a specific processing unit 212 that specifies target inspection items to be set for the target facility, based on the facility information acquired by the acquisition processing unit 211, from a storage unit 22 that stores inspection items associated with the registration facilities that are facilities having been registered; and an output processing unit 213 that outputs the target inspection items specified by the specification processing unit 212.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sale promotion support system, sale promotion support method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a sales promotion support system, a sales promotion support method and a program, which allow for contributing to an increase in product sales by displaying information being a hot topic on SNS on an electronic shelf label.SOLUTION: An sales promotion support system is provided, comprising a tag information acquisition unit configured to acquire trend tag information representing hot topic information based on information posted to SNS (Social Networking Service), an electronic shelf label control unit configured to display trend tag information relevant to a product on an electronic shelf label of the product relevant to the trend tag information, and a selection unit configured to preferentially select a product to be featured on a flyer as a product for which the tend tag information is to be displayed on the electronic shelf label.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Store support system, store support method, and store support program
abstract_en: To provide a store support system, a store support method, and a store support program that can improve the reliability of a self-scanning system.SOLUTION: A store support system 10 includes: an article acquisition processor 112 that acquires an article ID from a portable terminal 2 that reads an article when a shopper puts the article into a shopping basket; an image acquisition processor 113 that acquires an image from a camera 4 that captures an image of the shopping basket when the shopper checks out; and a reporting processor 116 that allows specific information to be reported based on the total number of articles read by the portable terminal 2 calculated based on the article ID obtained by the article acquisition processor 112 and the total number of articles contained in the shopping basket estimated based on the captured image obtained by the image acquisition processor 113.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method and program
abstract_en: To increase the number of shareholders attending a shareholders' general meeting.SOLUTION: A management server 30 includes: an output control part causing display parts of shareholders terminals 20 used by attendance shareholders attending a shareholders' general meeting to output a general meeting screen, the screen of the currently-held shareholders' general meeting; a receiving part for receiving, from the stockholders terminals 20, pros/cons data relating to pros/cons of the attendance stockholders for a proposal for immediate adoption that requires voting by the attendance shareholders during the shareholders' general meeting; a first tabulation part for specifying attendance shareholders expressing the approval based on the pros/cons data received from the shareholders' terminals 20 and calculating a first approval rate by using the number of specified attendance shareholders; and a first transmission part for transmitting a tabulation result including the first approval rate to a manager terminal 10 for managing the shareholders' general meeting.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electric charging support system and electric charging support method
abstract_en: To make a private electric charging facility available to a general user by reducing resistance felt by a manager of the private electric charging facility.SOLUTION: An electric charging support system 1 is provided with: a manager information acquisition unit 11 for acquiring manager information, i.e., information about a manager M of a private electric charging facility 51; a user information acquisition unit 12 for acquiring user information, i.e., information about a user U who desires to use the private electric charging facility 51; and when receiving application information to use the private electric charging facility 51 from a user terminal 65, an electric charging facility use permission determination unit 13 for determining whether or not a prescribed use permission condition is established between the user U and the manager M based on the pieces of information about the user U and the manager M, and transmitting use permission information to notify the use permission of the private electric charging facility 51 to the user terminal 65 when the use permission condition is established.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing system and information processing method
abstract_en: To specify a type of a found item with higher accuracy.SOLUTION: In an information processing system (1), a flag management unit (11) analyzes a video captured by a camera (90) attached to a cleaning tool (80) which a user (U) can carry, to generate (i) a finding start flag representing that the user (U) has started finding a found item (ST) as an object to be cleaned, by using the cleaning tool (80) and (ii) a finding completion flag representing that the user (U) has completed finding of the found item (ST) by using the cleaning tool (80). A frame extraction unit (12) extracts, as a frame of interest, one arbitrary frame out of frames from a frame at the time of generation of the finding start flag to a frame at the time of generation of the finding completion flag among a plurality of frames included in the video. A found item specification unit (21) analyzes the frame of interest to specify a type of the found item (ST) included in the frame of interest.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and information processing program
abstract_en: To identify an activity status of a learner who conducts various activities in an educational environment.SOLUTION: An information processing apparatus includes: acquisition units (111, 211) for acquiring location information indicating a location where a learner who conducts an activity relating to learning exists, activity content information indicating a content of the activity of the learner in the location, and activity time information indicating activity time of the learner in the location; recording units (112, 212) which record, on a database 30, the location information, the activity content information, and the activity time information in association with each other; and output units (113, 213) which output activity status information indicating an activity status of the learner, by referring to the database 30, in association with the location, the activity content, and the activity time.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Scheduling method and scheduling program
