abstract_en: To adjust differences between scheduled start points in time and start points in time in all surgeries to become minimal in the descending order of priorities when adjusting the start point in time of each surgery.SOLUTION: A scheduling method for determining start points in time of tasks is provided in which a server 1 determines the priorities of all tasks scheduled in a prescribed period according to a prescribed rule. The server 1 selects tasks corresponding to the priorities in the descending order of the priorities. The server 1 determines the start point in time of the selected task such that no conflict with other tasks whose start points in time have already been determined occurs and a difference between the start point in time and a predetermined scheduled start point in time becomes minimal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Information processing program, information processing device, and information processing system
abstract_en: To allow a user to experience, using means other than information known by the user, the growth of a dependent cared for by the user.SOLUTION: An information processing program according to the present application causes a computer to execute an acquisition procedure, an estimation procedure, and a display procedure. The acquisition procedure acquires information on a consumable that a user uses in caring for a dependent. The estimation procedure estimates use information of the consumable that was used in caring for the dependent on the basis of the information acquired by the acquisition procedure. The display procedure displays information pertaining to the care of the dependent and generated according to the use information estimated by the estimation procedure.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Digital content transaction management system and transaction management method
abstract_en: To provide a digital content transaction management system and a transaction management method which realize an arrangement in which unique digital content is selected and is opened on a market place on the Internet with express indication of an owner of the content in association with NFT on a block chain to thereby allow transaction of an ownership thereof.SOLUTION: A digital content transaction management system 100 according to the present invention has a plurality of nodes 3a through 3e forming a discrete network 2 superimposed on a communication network 1, an examination communication device 6 owned by a management organization 5 for receiving an application for setting an ownership of digital content to carry out examination with respect to a market place 4 having three function units such as an ownership registration unit 4a opened on a metaverse of the discrete network 2 and stored by a block chain, a digital content opening unit 4b, and a sales and contract unit 4c, and a management communication device 7 for recording the digital content which has passed the examination and for sending registration instructions to the ownership registration unit 4a.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, information processing system, control method therefor and program
abstract_en: To provide a mechanism capable of easily displaying positions relating to evacuation of evacuees according to information on a history of the positions.MEANS FOR SOLVING THE PROBLEM: An information processing device comprises: first determination means for determining next positions of evacuees depending on information of the evacuees, for performing evacuation simulation of the evacuees; and second determination means for determining the next position of the evacuees depending on the information on a predetermined spot, when the evacuees have arrived at the predetermined spot. The information processing device controls to display a first section which is identified based on the history of the position of the evacuees determined by the first determination means and the second determination means, and is a section from the position before the next position is determined by the first determination means to the next position determined by the first determination means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Paint usage amount management system, paint usage amount management method and program
abstract_en: To provide a paint usage amount management system, a paint usage amount management method, and a program that can accurately estimate a usage amount of paint.SOLUTION: A cloud server 1 includes: a usage amount estimation unit 112 that estimates a usage amount of at least one type of paint using a paint usage amount estimation model based on painting method type information, painting target part area information, and combination ratio information; a weight detection unit 4 that detects the weight of each paint storage container in which the paint is stored; an actual usage amount calculation unit 114 that calculates a differential weight corresponding to a difference between weights before and after a user takes out the paint necessary for painting a painting target part from the paint storage container as the actual usage amount of the paint; and a model updating unit 115 that updates the paint usage amount estimation model using past painting method type information, painting target part area information, combination ratio information, and actual usage amount information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Article estimation device, article estimation method and program
abstract_en: To enhance a determination precision for articles picked up from a rack.SOLUTION: An article estimation device includes a determining unit and an output unit. The determining unit determines that a person extends an arm to a position of a rack where a change in detection value by a weight sensor provided at the rack is detected using a height of the arm or a direction in which the arm is extended which is detected by a depth sensor capable of detecting a motion of the arm of the person located at a front space (a rack front space) of the rack where multiple articles can be placed. The output unit outputs information on the articles corresponding to the position of the rack where the person extends the arm among the multiple articles placed on the rack.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing method, information processing device and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing method, etc. capable of improving customer satisfaction of users including contract applicants and owners by improving quality of a real estate property introduction content through video content.SOLUTION: A computer outputs property information and video content relating to a plurality of real estate properties. When a contract for the real estate property whose property information and video content have been output is established, the computer provides a creator of the video content of the real estate property with an incentive.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Information management system and information management method
abstract_en: To link four pieces of basic information to accurate mobile phone numbers in identity confirmation.SOLUTION: An information management system includes: an external server that sends a confirmation request requesting identity confirmation of an inhabitant; an authentication server that performs public personal authentication using a personal card, which is a public certificate; a mobile carrier server that performs carrier authentication using carrier contract information with a telecommunications carrier that provides telecommunication services using phone numbers; and a management server. The management server includes: a public personal authentication control unit that executes a process for performing the public personal authentication by the authentication server in response to the confirmation request; a carrier authentication control unit that executes a process for performing the carrier authentication by the mobile carrier server; and an identity information generation unit that generates identity information linking four pieces of basic information on the inhabitant obtained by the public personal authentication, the carrier contract information on the inhabitant obtained by the carrier authentication, and a phone number of the inhabitant.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Prediction device, prediction method, learning device, learning method, and program
abstract_en: To predict highly accurately a water level of an adjustment pond or a river even when lead time becomes longer.SOLUTION: A prediction device comprises: an acquisition unit which acquires time series data of water levels measured by a water level indicator; and a prediction unit which predicts future values of the water levels, by inputting input data based on the time series data to a learned model having learned so that the future values of the water levels are outputted when input data based on the time series data of the water levels is inputted. The input data includes at least periodicity data obtained by executing processing which extracts a periodicity component of change of the water levels from the time series data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for evaluating geological storage suitability of carbon dioxide in sea area sedimentary basin
abstract_en: To provide a method for evaluating geological storage suitability of carbon dioxide in a sea area sedimentary basin.SOLUTION: A method for evaluating geological storage suitability of carbon dioxide includes the steps of: building a required index system to perform quantitative analysis with respect to the required index system; calculating weighting of secondary required indexes to determine importance for each secondary required index; classifying secondary required index values to assign values to classified results; building a core index system to perform a quantitative description thereof; and performing a double-index system coupling evaluation on the basis of each step A.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processor, information processing method, and information processing program
abstract_en: To provide a suitable search service to a user.SOLUTION: An information processor includes: an extraction section that extracts, using a first model trained so as to extract a model number character string indicating a model number given by a company uniquely from an explanatory text of a product, the model number character string from the explanatory text; and an estimation section that estimates, using a second model trained so as to estimate an attribute of the product from the model number character string, the attribute of the product from the model number character string extracted by the extraction section.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: System and method for recommending user based on shared digital experience
abstract_en: To provide a system and method for recommending a user based on a shared digital experience.SOLUTION: In a system 100, a processor 140 of a digital experience-based recommendation tool 105 uses an interface 150 to transmit first media files which presents a first choice between at least two options to a device 115 of a user. On receipt of a first selection in response to the first choice, the processor transmits a second media file which presents a second choice between at least two options to the device 115. On receipt of a second selection in response to the second choice, the processor identifies a second user as potentially compatible with the user, based at least in part on the first selection and the second selection, and transmits a profile of the second user to the device 115.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Application receiving apparatus, method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an application receiving apparatus, a method and a program that can prevent a fraudulent act in procedures.SOLUTION: In an application receiving apparatus 1, a reader 2 reads first personal information and a face image recorded on an IC (Integrated Circuit) chip equipped in a card, and reads second personal information including a card number written on the card. A face image acquisition unit 3 determines whether or not the first personal information and the second personal information are valid on the basis of a result of authentication on the IC chip, a result of authentication based on a check digit of the card number, and a result of face authentication obtained by comparing the acquired face image with the read face image, and determines whether or not an applicant is an authorized applicant. A generation unit 5 generates form data of an application form when a determination unit 4 determines that at least one of the first personal information and the second personal information is valid and that the applicant is the authorized applicant.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Reception/distribution system and energy management method for reception/distribution system
abstract_en: To provide a reception/distribution system in which regenerative power generated in a production facility is utilized to realize efficient energy operation.SOLUTION: A reception/distribution system 100 is formed of a commercial power supply facility 2, a solar power generation facility 3, a storage battery 4, and a production facility 5, and is equipped with an energy management system 1 that obtains data from the commercial power supply facility 2, the solar power generation facility 3, the storage battery 4, and the production facility 5, and controls the storage battery 4 and the production facility 5. When part of loads in the production facility 5 generates regenerative power, the energy management system 1 supplies the regenerative power to the remaining loads in the production facility 5, and then, if a surplus regenerative power is left, supplies the surplus regenerative power to the storage battery 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Inspection method, inspection system, and program
abstract_en: To provide an inspection method capable of confirming that building materials such as a sectional penetration processing material have been appropriately applied in a simple method and with high inspection accuracy.SOLUTION: An inspection method includes a photographing step of capturing an image of a construction site where building materials have been applied in a building and obtaining a captured image, and a determining step of determining whether the building materials have been applied as stipulated by analyzing the obtained captured image.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Component search system
abstract_en: To easily identify part numbers of components described in a service manual.SOLUTION: A component search system 100 for searching for a component includes: a service manual DB 150 that stores service manual information that records inspection work methods, repair work methods, and replacement work methods; a parts catalog DB 160 that stores parts catalog information that records component information of components; and a component list creation unit 110 configured to create a list of component information for a prescribed component read from the parts catalog DB 160. When receiving a component selection signal that selects a component described in a work method recorded in the service manual information, the component list creation unit 110 creates a list containing component information of the component corresponding to the component selection signal and outputs a list display signal that causes a display unit 21 to display the list.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Program, method, and information processor
abstract_en: To provide techniques of further motivating users to perform activities in a virtual space.SOLUTION: A program executed by a computer comprising a processor causes the processor to execute the steps of: receiving, from a first user who is not an administrator of the virtual space of users involved in an event implemented in a virtual space, an operation for specifying a second user who is another user involved in the event and different from the first user; and granting the specified second user and the first user the profit obtained from the event implemented in the virtual space.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 19

title_en: Question creation support apparatus, prediction apparatus, question creation support method, prediction method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a question creation support apparatus for reducing the burden on members due to a large number of questions in obtaining the total score.SOLUTION: A question creation support apparatus 1 includes: a correlation acquisition unit 132 which acquires correlation information on correlations between items corresponding to one or more questions and the total score, for each of two or more members, using member scores having the total score of the members and answer scores based on answers of the members to N (N is a natural number of 3 or greater) questions; a determination unit 133 which performs, using the correlation information for each item, at least one of a deletion determination process to determine a question to be deleted out of the N questions and an integrated determination process to determine two or more questions of the N questions to be integrated into one question, and acquires determination information related to the determinations; and an output unit 14 which outputs the determination information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing method, information processing system and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing method, system and program for providing users with more interesting experiences.SOLUTION: Provided is a method to execute the following steps: acquiring information provided based on subscription for respective users of first and second terminals, acquiring first content information and second content information on availability of providable contents, and executing first settlement processing and second settlement processing which allow the first and second terminals to provide subscription information until predetermined first and second time limits respectively; and if provision of the subscription information is allowed at the first terminal, allowing providing the subscription information at the second terminal until a predetermined response time limit at least corresponding to the first time limit, whether or not provision of the subscription information at the second terminal is allowed by the second settlement processing when the second user information is associated with the first user information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Yield rate calculation device, yield rate calculation method, and yield rate calculation program
abstract_en: To highly accurately calculate a yield rate by taking into account a consumption amount of a portion that is discarded other than finished products when performing product molding from resin using a molding machine.SOLUTION: A yield rate calculation device comprises: a master in which a master item as product, one or more resins as materials forming the master item, and the constitution number of each resin are registered in association with one another; and manufacturing result input means for, according to operations of an operator on a manufacturing result input screen, when manufacturing result number, manufacturing date, reception item as product, received order quantity, defective number, product weight per piece, runner weight per piece, and purge quantity are specified, calculating a total resin amount by (reception quantity + defective number)×(product weight per piece + runner weight per piece) + purge quantity, calculating reference resin amount for each resin obtained from the master using a reception item as a key, as a total of reference use quantity calculated by (reception quantity + defective number)×constitution number of the resin in the master, and calculating a yield rate by reference resin amount/total resin amount.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method, server and system for providing movables management service
abstract_en: To provide a method, a server and a system for providing a movables management service to a holder of movables by generating status information of the movables based on information on the movables.SOLUTION: A method, a server, and a system for providing a movables management service include: receiving measurement data collected by an asset information acquisition device attached to movables from the asset information acquisition device; deriving state information associated with at least one of the movables and the asset information acquisition device based on the measurement data; and transmitting status information to a holder terminal owned by a collateral entity providing collateral for the movables. The state information may include at least one of location information and preset event detection information of the movables.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing method, computer program, and information processing apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an information processing method, a computer program, and an information processing apparatus designed to support appraising mental capacity of a target person.SOLUTION: An information processing method causes an information processing apparatus to: acquire, from a terminal device of a client who requests appraising a target person, diagnostic information on cognitive capability of the target person, head image information of the target person, prescription information of drugs for the target person, care information of the target person, nursing record information during hospitalization of the target person, video information of the target person or voice information of the target information; store, on a database, the acquired information on the target person in association with identification information of the target person; transmit the stored information on the target person to a terminal device of a mental capacity appraiser who appraises mental capacity; acquire a result of appraising the mental capacity of the target person from the terminal device of the mental capacity appraiser; store, on the database, the acquired appraisal result in association with the identification information of the target person; and transmit the appraisal result to the terminal device of the client.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Registered matter certificate request assisting device, registered matter certificate request assisting method, and computer program
abstract_en: To reduce the time and effort when requesting an application object of a registered matter certificate by using a registration on-line application system, thereby reducing an input error.SOLUTION: A registered matter certificate request assisting device 1 assists an application for a registered matter certificate to a registration on-line application system 100 that allows an application for a request for a registered matter certificate, and comprises: real estate registration information acquisition means 30 that acquires a real estate number of a request target real estate for which a registered matter certificate is requested, and location information indicating the location of the request target real estate; agency name information acquisition means 50 that acquires agency name information indicating the name of the agency having jurisdiction over the request target real estate on the basis of the location information; and input means 61 that inputs the real estate number in a real estate number entry field on an on-line property search screen provided by the registration on-line application system 100, and selects the name of the agency based on the agency name information in a jurisdiction registry office selection field.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information providing system, information providing method, and information providing program
abstract_en: To enable appropriate information provision.SOLUTION: An information providing system outputs a congestion state of a plurality of restrooms provided in a facility to a display terminal. The information providing system comprises: a use state acquisition section that acquires a use state of an object to be used provided in each of the plurality of restrooms; a congestion state acquisition section that acquires congestion information on the plurality of restrooms on the basis of the use state of the object to be used acquired by the use state acquisition section; and a storage section that stores restroom information on each of the restrooms. A display mode in the display terminal includes: a first display form in which first restroom information on the plurality of restrooms based on the congestion information on the plurality of restrooms and the restroom information is displayed on the display terminal; and a second display form in which second restroom information obtained by detailing at least a part of the first restroom information on a specific restroom among the plurality of restrooms is displayed on the display terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, information processing system, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To easily grasp the total price of an object specified by a user.SOLUTION: An information processing device includes: a reception unit 120 that receives user identification information for identifying a user, object identification information for identifying an object specified by the user, and quantity information indicating the quantity of the object; an acquisition unit 130 that obtains value information indicating the value of the object indicated by the object identification information which is received by the reception unit 120; a calculation unit 140 that calculates a total value of the object to which the object identification information is added, based on both the value information obtained by the acquisition unit 130 and the quantity information received by the reception unit 120, for each user to which the user identification information is added; and an output unit 150 that outputs total value information indicating the total value for each user which is calculated by the calculation unit 140.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Real estate score calculation system, real estate score calculation method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a system for proposing a measurement model that measures stability of rent of investment real estate.SOLUTION: A system is configured to include a user terminal 20 of a user, and a real estate score calculation device 10 that is connected with the user terminal 20 in a data transmittable/receivable manner and calculates a P score as a measurement model that measures stability of rent of investment real estate. The real estate score calculation device 10 is configured to: input real estate information collected from the outside to a machine learning model; extract a plurality of feature quantities greatly affecting a rent index by analyzing the machine learning model; define the feature quantities as a plurality of parameters; set the maximum point and a point calculation reference for each parameter based on the rent index and a correlation level; calculate points for each parameter based on the point calculation reference, when parameter information is input as the real estate information from the user terminal 20; and calculate the P score from the calculated points for respective parameters.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicle assessment device
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle assessment device capable of promoting motivation for replacement of a vehicle for an owner of the vehicle.SOLUTION: A vehicle assessment device 20 includes: a vehicle information acquisition unit which acquires vehicle information on vehicles 52A to 52D owned by an owner 50; a vehicle price acquisition unit which successively acquires current assessment prices of the vehicles 52A to 52D with a prescribed interval on the basis of the vehicle information; and a notification unit which successively notifies the owner 50 of the acquired assessment prices.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Data converter, recording media, and method for converting aggregated data
abstract_en: To provide a data converter capable of converting aggregated data output from aggregation software into data according to a format capable of being taken into specific analysis software, recording media, and a conversion method for aggregated data.SOLUTION: A data-converter 100 is configured to cause a computer to execute a read-function F1 and a conversion function F2. The read-function reads aggregated data 20 output from aggregation software 200 for aggregating a record R composed of a combination of an item A classified into an aggregation item TA or a detail item SA as a breakdown of the aggregation item TA and a numerical value v corresponding to the item A. The conversion function converts, in accordance with a specification of the aggregation software 200, aggregated data 20 into captured data 10 formed in a format that can be captured by specific analysis software 300 for displaying results of analysis based on the aggregation data 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system which shortens a response time by transcribing an inquiry/claim of a customer and selecting an appropriate answer by an AI.SOLUTION: In a data processing system comprising a data processing apparatus 12 and a smart device 14, a specific processing unit 290 transcribes an inquiry or a claim from a customer by using a voice recognition technique and uses an emotion identification model to estimate an emotion of the user and selects an appropriate answer and presents the selected answer to an operator. The operator responds to the user by using the answer. If a word of abusive language or the like is detected, a notification is automatically sent to a leader. Thus, the leader can respond quickly, and a system for supporting members in a call center can be reinforced.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system.SOLUTION: The system includes cloud services, means for making natural language processing technology available, means for deploying to educational institutions at the national level, means for compiling a selection of smart phones, and means for incorporating local governments at the national level.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To allow a user to easily generate a synthesis image of an image of the user and an image of an item in an online shopping platform of clothing.SOLUTION: A system includes an image generation AI for automatically generating a synthesis image of an image of a user and an image of an item in an online shopping platform of clothing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To enable an information service customized to children's interests by providing a platform in the form of a cartoon for teaching children about the future possibilities and the importance of learning.SOLUTION: A system provides a platform in the form of a cartoon for teaching children about the future possibilities and the importance of learning. The system includes means for allowing children to enter keywords through messenger applications, means for analyzing information on the keywords using ChatGPT, and means for displaying information on the keywords in the form of a cartoon using generative AI.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To enhance an operative efficiency of a tweet, and select an appropriate tweet by coordination of human and AI.SOLUTION: A system includes means for automating a tweet operation, means for selecting a tweet by AI, and means for selecting a tweet by human.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a point for communicating new type of information, and to create a configuration of a whole on-line study session which can be learned in a cheerful way, in the present invention.SOLUTION: A system comprises: means of providing a point for communicating new type of information; and means of creating a configuration of a whole on-line study session which can be learned in a cheerful way.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system capable of optimizing events to increase the number of smart phones acquired by mapping real world data into digital space and simulating sales forecasts, effective measures, and event planning in a virtual space according to the market conditions of each store.SOLUTION: The system includes: means of mapping real-world data in a digital space; means of simulating sales forecasts and effective measures tailored to the market conditions of each store, and event planning in a virtual space; and means of staffing at the right times by simulating congestion level from traffic data in the virtual space.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system that enables appropriate verbalization of sensations or expressions and their communication to others.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment comprises a reception unit, an analysis unit, a generation unit, and a provision unit. The reception unit receives expressions from the user. The analysis unit analyzes the expressions received by the reception unit. The generation unit generates appropriate words based on the expressions analyzed by the analysis unit. The provision unit communicates the words generated by the generation unit to others.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system.SOLUTION: A system comprises: means for enabling a conversation between a character and a user; means for connecting the character, a voice actor, and generative AI; means for responding to questions posed to the generative AI using the voice of the voice actor of the character; and means for generating revenue outside a service through the use of the character.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system.SOLUTION: A system includes: means for giving questions corresponding to learning progress of a child; and means for diagnosing degree of understanding from contents of answers.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system.SOLUTION: A system includes: means for providing methods for proposing featured models and commercial materials; means for providing effective closing talks; means for providing success cases; means for providing customer attraction measures that can be implemented at agency shops; and means for replying to questions from crew members through dialogue with effective examples.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system comprising an AI butler that cannot only deal with what can be done digitally but also be a conversation partner or a game opponent.SOLUTION: Provided is a system comprising an AI butler that cannot only deal with what can be done digitally but also be a conversation partner or a game opponent.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To efficiently and automatically generate news that seems to exist but actually does not, and create a virtual newspaper.SOLUTION: Provided is a system comprising means for creating a virtual newspaper, means for delivering news that seems to exist but actually does not, and means for generating information through AI.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To predict earthquake occurrence and secure people's safety.SOLUTION: A system for predicting earthquake occurrence is provided, comprising: means for analyzing the relationship between past occurrence data, continental plate motion, lunar gravity, and ground surface/ocean temperature; and means for outputting prediction results.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system for supporting problem solution by efficiently collecting fault occurrence information and utilizing past cases.SOLUTION: A system includes: means to input fault occurrence date and time, a generation site, a frequency, a generation apparatus, and content of fault and cooperate with a corresponding database in the past; and means to extract similar data of generation in the past, output a cause and a solution with many examples, and isolate and request a requesting department.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To solve an issue of creating a medium- to long-term learning schedule by recommending learning contents suitable for a user in order to support skill improvement and reskilling suitable to a business strategy on the basis of personal data.SOLUTION: A system includes means for recommending free learning contents inside and outside a company by AI for skill improvement and reskilling suitable for a business strategy on the basis of personal data, and means for creating a medium- to long-term learning schedule by AI.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system.SOLUTION: The system is an in-house support system using artificial intelligence, including: generating means of generating information for supporting internal business; management means of managing and operating the generated information; and providing means of providing the managed information within the company.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Mirror device for barber/beauty parlor
abstract_en: To provide a mirror device for a barber/beauty parlor, supporting communication between a client and stuff.SOLUTION: A mirror device 1 includes: a half mirror 1M visible to a client C visiting a barber/beauty parlor T and stuff S of the barber/beauty parlor T; a display unit arranged at the rear side of the half mirror 1M and displaying an image projected to the half mirror 1M; and a control unit for acquiring input information previously input before a start of treatment to the client C, and analysis information analyzed by based on the input information. The control unit makes the display unit display the input information and the analysis information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system capable of proposing the optimal menu in consideration of food allergies and preferences of a customer.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment comprises a collection unit, a proposal unit, an acquisition unit, an introduction unit, and a processing unit. The collection unit collects information about food allergy and preferences of a customer. The proposal unit proposes a menu to the customer on the basis of the information collected by the collection unit. The acquisition unit acquires the past order history and trends. The introduction unit introduces a new menu and promotion to the customer on the basis of the information acquired by the acquisition unit. The processing unit processes the order and payment of the customer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Home delivery management control device and home delivery management method
abstract_en: To enable proper receipt of a stored package and prevent a reduction in the usage efficiency of a home delivery box.SOLUTION: A home delivery management control device comprises: a storage information acquisition unit 40 that acquires storage information indicating that a package has been stored in and locked in a storage part of a home delivery box; a notification destination information acquisition unit 41 that acquires notification destination information indicating a notification destination of a recipient; a storage notification control unit 42 that transmits storage notification information indicating that the package has been stored to the notification destination of the recipient when the storage information acquisition unit 40 acquires the storage information; and a control signal output unit 44 that outputs a control signal to restrict the operation of a predetermined facility in a residence of the recipient when the package is not retrieved from the storage part for a predetermined period of time or more from a time point at which the storage notification information has been transmitted.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Calculation device, calculation method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a technology for calculating the amount of carbon dioxide emissions of terminals used outside the company.SOLUTION: A calculation device 30 is provided with an extraction unit 31 for extracting operation logs of terminals 12 used outside the company for each user from operation log groups of a plurality of terminals 11 and 12 during a predetermined period, a determination unit 32 for dividing the operation logs extracted for each user by a predetermined unit time and determining whether or not each unit time is during telework according to whether or not there is an operation log in each unit time, and a calculation unit 33 for adding the unit time determined to be during telework for each user and calculating the telework time of each user. The calculation unit 33 calculates the amount of carbon dioxide discharged from the terminal 12 used outside the company based on the total time obtained by totaling the telework time of each user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Distribution planning device and distribution planning system
abstract_en: To perform appropriate train operations by adjusting power between transformer stations based on a power generation amount and a consumption amount in railroad business.SOLUTION: A distribution planning device for planning distribution in railroad business comprises: a power generation amount/consumption amount prediction section for acquiring a power generation amount and a consumption amount in a first management range managed by a first transformer station and acquiring a power generation amount and a consumption amount in a second management range managed by a second transformer station; and a distribution planning section for calculating a surplus power amount of the first transformer station based on the power generation amount and the consumption amount in the first management range managed by the first transformer station and a power shortage amount of the second transformer station based on the power generation amount and the consumption amount in the second management range managed by the second transformer station and, when there is surplus power in the first transformer station and there is power shortage in the second transformer station, planning distribution to supply power from the first transformer station to the second transformer station.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information generation device, information generation method and program
abstract_en: To allow information indicating a characteristic of an individual who has not participated in a survey to be obtained.SOLUTION: An information generation device includes characteristic information generation means for generating information indicating a characteristic of an individual by inputting information based on a product purchase history of the individual into a model that outputs information indicating a characteristic in response to input of the information based on the product purchase history.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Map information providing system, map information providing method, and map information providing program
abstract_en: To provide information with minimal deviation from the current situation.SOLUTION: A map information providing system comprises: an administrator information storage unit which stores information about administrators who have the authority to generate an object; a generation permission unit which permits the input of object information used to generate an object using the administrator information; a worker information storage unit which stores information about a worker who performs tasks in an area on a real space equivalent to the object; an input permission unit which permits the input of status information indicative of the status of the object with respect to the worker's terminal using the worker information; a display determination unit which determines the display of the object in the map using the status information input to the worker's terminal; and a display control unit which causes a map including the object whose display has been determined by the display determination unit to be displayed on the user's terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, program, and learning support system
abstract_en: To contribute to the provision of useful information in matching between a learner and a teacher on the basis of a learning object.SOLUTION: A control section of a server device 10 (information processing device) outputs a list of candidates for a teacher who teaches a learner a learning object registered by a learner who desires teaching among a plurality of registered members registered in advance (step E2, step A3). Here, the control section of the server device 10 outputs a list in which a predetermined index value related to the learning object is associated with each candidate. When the learner selects any of the candidates as a teacher from the list (step A4), the control section of the server device 10 transmits a teaching request notification to the selected teacher (step E3, step B1).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Information processing system, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing system, an information processing method, and a program which can improve employment of a person satisfying a prescribed condition.SOLUTION: The information processing system comprises: a selection unit which selects one or more job hunters satisfying a job hunter condition which opens one-off part-timer recruitment information for recruiting a one-off part-timer who will perform work with an arbitrary schedule; and an output unit which opens the one-off part-timer recruitment information to the one or more job hunters selected by the selection unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Program, method, and information processing apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a technique for smoothly proceeding with a workflow for approving document data between a sender and a receiver of the document data.SOLUTION: A storage unit holds operation histories of approval operation of each user made in the procedure for each user to approve document data, the operation histories including non-approval operations for the document data. A program causes a processor to execute the steps of: referring to the operation histories to evaluate the users regarding the possibility that the document data is to be approved, based on the history of non-approval operation; and presenting information according to the evaluation result of the possibility of each user being approved.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 11

title_en: Condominium unit fund procurement system, method and program
abstract_en: To further divide a condominium unit purchased by a business entrepreneur and to sell each of them as a token to thereby procure funds from investors who have purchased tokens.SOLUTION: A condominium unit fund procurement system according to the present invention acquires sales price data of the condominium unit operated by the business entrepreneur and token per-unit price data of a token to be issued, divides, by a predetermined token per-unit price, the sales price data or price data obtained by discounting by a predetermined amount from the sales price of the sales price data, and outputs the token per-unit price and the divided number to a terminal to sell the token.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Monitoring system
abstract_en: To provide a monitoring system capable of improving detection accuracy of a change in a mental and physical state of a user and achieving early detection.SOLUTION: A monitoring system includes a data acquisition unit that acquires inference data including one or both of a performance history of electrical devices 200 in a house and an operation history to the electrical devices 200, an inference unit that outputs a behavior pattern of a user 10 from the inference data acquired by the data acquisition unit using a first learned model for inferring the behavior pattern of the user 10 in the house from the inference data, a determination unit that determines whether there is a change in a mental and physical state of the user 10 on the basis of a temporal change in the behavior pattern of the user 10 output by the inference unit, and an output unit that outputs a determination result by the determination unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing system, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing system, an information processing method, and a program configured to propose a field for which greenhouse gases are to be calculated, out of E (information related to the environment), S (information related to the society), and G (information related to the governance) fields, to a company that initiates greenhouse gas calculation.SOLUTION: In an information processing system, a user terminal and an external server are connected over a communication network to communicate with each other. In the system, a management server includes: an acquisition unit which acquires disclosure information including information related to ESG in a business entity that constitutes an upstream or a downstream of a supply chain; an input unit to which business information indicating business activities in the business entity can be input; an analysis unit which serves as a specifying unit which specifies an ESG calculation boundary related to a predetermined business entity, based on disclosure information of the predetermined business entity; and an output unit which constitutes a presentation unit which presents the specified ESG calculation boundary.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Information processing apparatus, method for controlling information processing apparatus, and storage medium
abstract_en: To appropriately generate a unified design expressing an impression intended by a user by combining a plurality of pieces of merchandise.SOLUTION: The information processing apparatus includes a designation unit that designates a design element to be reflected in one or more products for which a design is to be generated and a creation condition for creating the one or more products, and a generation unit that generates a design of the one or more products by changing a color arrangement of the design element such that at least one color having a hue angle different from any color of the color arrangement included in the design element is included, based on the design element and the creation condition designated by the designation unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Processing apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a processing device capable of preventing a package from becoming undeliverable during delivery of the package.SOLUTION: A processing device (9) according to an aspect of the present invention includes a first determination unit (92) configured to determine, in a state where identification information of a package (B) is associated with identification information of a tray (2), whether an occupied area of a height to be virtually occupied on the first shelf (4) together with the tray (2) can be reserved, based on address information of a receiver (P1) included in the identification information of the package (B), height information included in the identification information of the tray (2), and use state information of the first shelf (4).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for uploading images and moving images of animals to be raised to a server; means for analyzing the uploaded images and moving images to generate a AI model that captures characteristics of the animals; and means for reproducing the generated AI model in a virtual space to simulate lives of the animals.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing apparatus, learning model creating apparatus, information processing method, learning model creating method, and program
abstract_en: To perform estimation in consideration of influence between batches.SOLUTION: The information processing device includes a manufacturing condition acquisition unit that acquires n-th manufacturing conditions that are manufacturing conditions of an n-th polymerization step that is a polymerization step of an n-th batch (n is a natural number), and a manufacturing result index estimation unit that estimates a manufacturing result index to be checked in a checking step of each of m batches (m is an integer of m ≥ 0) after the n-th batch based on a first learned model obtained by machine learning of a relationship between the manufacturing conditions of the polymerization step of a predetermined batch and the manufacturing result index to be checked in the checking step of a plurality of batches after the predetermined batch and the n-th manufacturing conditions acquired by the manufacturing condition acquisition unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to enable a user to efficiently learn skills and knowledge necessary for achieving a goal and to maintain an optimal schedule.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes an objective setting unit, a skill proposing unit, a schedule generating unit, an alarm setting unit, a schedule changing unit, and an execution checking unit. The goal setting unit sets a goal of the user. The skill proposal unit proposes a necessary skill or knowledge on the basis of the objective set by the objective setting unit. The schedule generation unit generates an optimal daily schedule on the basis of the skills and knowledge proposed by the skill proposal unit. The alarm setting unit sets an alarm based on the schedule generated by the schedule generation unit. The schedule change unit changes the schedule in real time based on the alarm set by the alarm setting unit. The execution confirmation unit confirms execution of the schedule changed by the schedule change unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for receiving unknown points from a user; means for analyzing the received unknown points using a generative AI model; means for automatically generating a manual based on the analysis results; and means for transmitting the generated manual to the user's device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes a means for acquiring lecture contents of another training lecturer as video recording data, a means for converting the video recording data into transcription data by using a voice recognition tool, a means for converting the transcription data into summary data by using a summarization tool, a means for storing and managing the summary data, and a means for making the stored summary data browsable.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system including means for a user to input a region, a means of transportation, a distance, and a theme to be drawn, means for transmitting input data to a server, means for analyzing map data based on the received data, means for generating a specific shape based on the theme, means for generating a route using an AI model in consideration of safety and traffic rules, means for verifying and adjusting the generated route, means for transmitting final course data to a terminal, and means for displaying the course data on the terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for collecting audio data; means for converting the collected audio data into textual information; generative artificial intelligence means for detecting fraud-related patterns using the converted textual information; and means for sending an alert when a fraud-related pattern is detected.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of the system according to the embodiment is to effectively appeal the approach to the SDGs without expertise.SOLUTION: A system includes a collection unit, an analysis unit, and a generation unit. The collection part collects business contents and basic information. The analysis part analyzes the information collected by the collection part and analyzes the activity contents of the enterprise. The generation part selects an activity target and generates a template on the basis of a result analyzed by the analysis part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system according to an embodiment aims to suggest personalized smartphone plans based on customer needs and usage patterns.SOLUTION: A system includes a collection part, an analysis part, a proposal part, an interaction part, an analysis part, and an introduction part. The collection unit collects information on a customer. The analysis unit analyzes the information collected by the collection unit and determines the needs and usage patterns of the customer. The proposal unit proposes a personalized smartphone plan based on the determination result obtained by the analysis unit. The interaction unit performs interaction with the customer on the basis of the plan proposed by the proposal unit. The analysis unit analyzes the use state of the customer based on the information obtained by the interaction unit, and proposes an appropriate plan or upgrade. The introduction unit introduces a new function or service based on the result obtained by the analysis unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for receiving as input a picture of a room from a user; means for receiving as input a drawing from the user; means for receiving as input a request for a reform from the user; means for generating a reformed image using a generative artificial intelligence model based on the received picture of the room, the drawing, and the request for the reform; means for determining whether the generated reformed image is workable; and means for providing the generated reformed image and the result of the workability determination to the user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for collecting expertise from a knowledge provider; means for storing the collected expertise in a database; means for training a generative model based on the expertise in the database; means for receiving a question from a user; means for generating an answer based on the question from the generative model; means for providing the generated answer to the user; and means for returning a portion of a consulting fee to the knowledge provider.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system includes a voice collection unit provided in a communication terminal used by a child, a voice transmission unit configured to transmit voice data collected by the voice collection unit to a server, a voice conversion unit configured to convert the voice data into text data by using a voice recognition technology, a bullying detection unit configured to analyze the text data and detect a word having a possibility of bullying, and a notification unit configured to transmit a notification to a parent when the bullying detection unit determines that the possibility of bullying is high.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to enable a user to easily try on clothing that suits the user and to create custom-made clothing even when there is no existing clothing.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a reception unit, a generation unit, a provision unit, a purchase unit, and an order-made unit. The reception unit receives an image of a user. The generation unit generates a plurality of different kinds of clothing based on the image received by the reception unit. The providing unit provides the image generated by the generating unit to the user. The purchase unit performs a purchase procedure if the clothing selected from the image provided by the provision unit is an existing product. The tailor-made unit tailor-makes the clothing selected from the image provided by the providing unit when the selected clothing is not an existing product.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of the system according to the embodiment is to optimize an evacuation route at the time of a disaster and to dynamically provide guidance in multiple languages.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a collection unit, an analysis unit, a route generation unit, a guidance unit, and a support unit. The collection unit collects data from a sensor or a monitoring camera. The analysis unit analyzes the data collected by the collection unit. The route generation unit generates an evacuation route based on the data analyzed by the analysis unit. The guidance unit guides the evacuation route generated by the route generation unit. The support unit finds and rescues the person in need of support.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to comprehensively provide travel assistance in multiple languages based on a travel desired condition of a user.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a reception unit, a generation unit, an assistance unit, an advice unit, and a support unit. The reception unit receives a travel desired condition of the user. The generation unit generates a travel plan based on the information input by the reception unit. The assistance unit provides language assistance based on the travel plan created by the generation unit. The advice unit provides specific advice on culture information and health and safety based on the language assistance provided by the assistance unit. The support unit provides video support based on the advice provided by the advice unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to automate document creation in order to reduce the workload of a nursery-school teacher.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a reception unit, an accumulation unit, an analysis unit, a generation unit, and a provision unit. The reception unit receives data from a nursery-school teacher. The accumulation unit accumulates the data received by the reception unit. The analysis unit analyzes the data accumulated by the accumulation unit. The generation unit generates a document based on the data analyzed by the analysis unit. The providing unit provides the document generated by the generating unit to the nursery-school teacher.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A means for receiving the body text and header information of a message received by a carrier mail or a short message service, a means for extracting the received message information, a means for transmitting the extracted message information to a central processing unit, a means for transmitting the message information to an automatic generation artificial intelligence system so that the central processing unit evaluates the message information, a means for performing Web search based on the message information and evaluating the possibility of fraud by the automatic generation artificial intelligence system, a means for receiving an evaluation result, a means for generating alert information when the possibility of fraud is high, and a means for transmitting the generated alert information to a terminal; Means for displaying the transmitted alert information to a user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes a user terminal for inputting a question, a server for recording the question received from the user terminal in a log, means for transmitting the question recorded in the log to a generative artificial intelligence system to generate an answer, and means for returning the generated answer to the user terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes a means for analyzing customer information, a means for summarizing and presenting the analysis result of the customer information, a means for generating proposal contents related to a negotiation, a means for converting conversation contents during the negotiation into a text by voice recognition in real time, a means for analyzing the conversation contents and summarizing related information, a means for generating and presenting minutes after the end of the negotiation, and a means for generating a next proposal schedule and extracting and presenting information on a similar negotiation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: System for managing commercial use of contents copyright and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a system for managing commercial use of copyright of content and a method thereof. By receiving certain costs from a content user, who needs content for copyright or portrait right of the content owned by a content owner, and providing a commercial use permission right, the content owner can be provided with a fair price for assets through content copyright use permission platform, and it can be clear that the content will be used in a legal and legitimate way by writing a use permission contract specifying the scope of use.

title_en: personalized automatic questionnaires learning method based on AI(artificial intelligence) and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for artificial intelligence-based learning using personalized automatic question generation. An education server that has built a network with the web, an external server, and a terminal is used for the method including: a first step in which the education server receives curriculum and achievement standard information from at least one of the web, the external server, and the terminal; a second step in which the education server generates evaluation standards with which the curriculum achievement standard can be evaluated; a third step in which the education server determines a learning unit to be covered based on the grade of a user provided with the personalized learning method; a fourth step in which the education server derives learning tags related to the progress of learning from the education unit; a fifth step in which the education server determines evaluation standard content set for each evaluation standard using the learning tags; a sixth step in which the education server automatically generates questions related to the progress of learning based on the determined evaluation standard content; and a seventh step in which the education server provides the user with the automatically generated question through at least one of the web, the external server, and the terminal.

title_en: Method and system for estimating a reading index using automatic analysis program for text of korean language
abstract_en: The present invention provides a more objective technical method capable of automatically analyzing the difficulty level of a Korean language text and measuring a reading comprehension index and a system therefor. According to a reading comprehension index measuring method through automatic analysis on a Korean language text and a system thereof in an embodiment of the present invention, by introducing the reading comprehension index (KReaD index), which is an objective standard in the learning and reading process of the Korean language group, a differentiated customized learning/reading service can be provided according to the grade level and/or reading comprehension level of the learner/reader who wants to learn or read the Korean language.

title_en: System, method and apparatus for smart management based on augmented reality
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method, a device, and a system for smart management based on augmented reality. The method of the present invention comprises the steps of: rendering an augmented reality image representing a pre-designed 3D modeling of a first device when a first tag corresponding to the first device is identified by a user terminal; displaying at least one real-time data related to the first device together with an augmented reality image of the first device; and synchronizing a pattern and timing of an operation of the augmented reality image with a pattern and timing of an actual operation of the first device as the at least one real-time data is reflected to the pre-designed 3D modeling of the first device. According to the present invention, more natural and realistic augmented reality can be provided.

title_en: Battlefield function conceptual-model-of-mission-space interrelated information provision system in modeling and simulation system, and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for providing interrelated information for the battlefield function conceptual model of the mission space (CMMS) of a defense modeling simulation system. The system and method thereof makes it possible to provide doctrines/manuals for each military institution (military training, class, etc.), an intermediate simulation logic book for simulating the doctrines/manuals, and mutual information between simulations.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing integrated control service using black box images
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for providing an integrated control service using black box images to solve problems caused by blind spots and low image quality of CCTVs. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps of: acquiring a first image including an object and a surrounding environment around a CCTV through the CCTV installed in a smart city; acquiring a second image including GPS information of a vehicle and an object and a surrounding environment located outside the vehicle through a camera installed in the vehicle; receiving a user input requesting current state information of a first zone on a map of the smart city; generating a third image by combining the first image and the second image on the basis of time information, weather information, traffic information, and the GPS information; acquiring current image information for the first zone from the first image when the first zone is an area in which the CCTV is installed; acquiring current image information for the first zone from the second image acquired from a vehicle located in the first zone when the first zone is an area where CCTV is not installed; providing the current image information for the first zone to the user; receiving a user input requesting detailed information about the first zone; acquiring detailed information of the first zone from the third image; and providing the detailed information of the first zone to the user.

title_en: Apparatus for calculating a flood damage risk index, and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for calculating a flood damage risk index and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the apparatus comprises: a memory storing region grid data, in which an analysis target region is divided into grid cells, and river overflow data including the location of an expected flood zone by each river when a flood occurs; a communication unit receiving index grid data, in which a value related to a preset index for calculating a flood damage risk index is stored as a grid cell value, from a server of a related institution; a flooded area calculation unit extracting flooded grid cells included in the expected flooding area from a plurality of grid cells of the area grid data on the basis of the river overflow data; and an index calculator calculating the flood damage risk index for the analysis target area on the basis of the grid cell value corresponding to the flooded grid cell extracted from the grid cell values of the index grid data. Accordingly, the flood damage risk index, which indicates the degree of potential damage from flooding, is calculated and provided for each unit area, thereby being usefully used as basic data for determining budget allocation and project priority for flood control projects.

title_en: 3D scanning equipment for structure maintenance
abstract_en: The present invention relates to 3D scanning equipment for structure maintenance. More specifically, the 3D scanning equipment (1) for structure maintenance includes a 3D scanner device (100), a high-definition camera (200), a control device unit (300), a storage unit (400), a transceiving device unit (500), an input/output unit (600), a mobile device unit (700), and a location information receiving unit (800). According to an embodiment of the present invention, the 3D scanning equipment for structure maintenance can be performed to detect cracks in dangerous structures by a scanner, manage systematic measurement data by efficient measurement, and store and manage measurement results as standardized data.

title_en: Recycled ice pack, manufacturing method of the recycled ice pack, and system for recycling ice packs
abstract_en: The present invention provides a recycling ice pack which comprises: a waste ice pack having a phase-change substance packaged in an inner space of first packaging paper and collected after used by at least once; and second packaging paper repackaging to cover the first packaging paper. Therefore, the present invention is formed by doubly packaging the new packaging paper while the packaging paper of the waste ice pack is not removed, thereby reducing environmental contamination caused by the wasted ice pack and improving efficiency of resources.

title_en: Method and apparatus for matching marry information using conversational keywords obtained through text analysis of voice and message
abstract_en: A method and an apparatus for matching marriage information using conversation keywords obtained through text analysis of voice and messages are disclosed. In one embodiment, a method for matching marriage information using conversation keywords obtained through text analysis of voice and messages comprises the steps of: receiving profile information and social activity information of a first member from a user terminal or a social activity server; predicting a propensity value of the first member with respect to at least one criterion by inputting the profile information and the social activity information into a propensity prediction model; inputting the profile information and social activity information into a preference prediction model, and predicting a preference value that is a preference range of the first member with respect to the at least one criterion; generating member matching coordinates for the at least one criterion; determining a counterpart member to be matched with the first member using the member matching coordinates; and transmitting the profile of the counterpart member to the user terminal.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing meeting matching service based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: According to various embodiments, a matching service providing server that recommends a suitable reason for a user based on AI may include: a DB management unit for registering users as members based on profile information of each user acquired from a plurality of user terminals, and storing the profile information; a preference condition-based recommendation unit for determining a user of the opposite sex to be recommended to another user based on the preference conditions of the users obtained from the user terminals; a preference type determiner configured to determine the user's preference type; an appearance evaluation score-based recommendation unit for calculating appearance evaluation scores for the users through collaborative filtering based on singular value decomposition, and determining the opposite-sex user to be recommended to the user based on the calculated appearance evaluation scores; a meeting result score-based recommendation unit in which appearance evaluation scores for the users are calculated through collaborative filtering based on singular value decomposition, and based on the calculated appearance evaluation scores, the opposite-sex user to be recommended to the user is determined.

title_en: A volume-based food processing system with intelligent sequential control function
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a volume-based food waste disposal system with an intelligent sequential control function that monitors the total cumulative collection amount in units of cleaning cycles of a collection container to extract a pattern of the total collection amount according to the date or day cycle and estimates the total collection amount of the corresponding cycle according to the extracted pattern to determine the number of the collection containers and the distribution of the collection containers. The system comprises: a plurality of collection modules each having a container module in an inner storage unit; and at least one control module for processing payment and controlling the opening and closing of an upper door of the collection module. Each collection module has a volume level sensor for detecting the volume level of its own container module. The control module includes a payment unit for processing payments and a control device for processing payments and controlling the opening and closing of the upper door. The control device predicts the final cumulative collection amount of food waste, determines the number of collection modules that can be put in according to the predicted final cumulative collection amount, allocates as many collection modules as the determined number of modules, and controls to open only the upper door of the allocated collection module. By the above system, by monitoring a collection amount pattern of food waste, automatically selecting a collection container depending on the collection amount pattern, and distributing a collection amount, the collection amount of each collection container is evenly distributed, making it easy to collect a plurality of collection containers and eliminating the inconvenience of using a container with a raised volume level.

title_en: Method and device for preventing forgery using ip tracking and did information of contents related to blockchain-based nft
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a device for preventing forgery by using IP tracking and DID information of content related to a blockchain-based NFT.
