The method comprises the steps of: providing a download service for content related to a blockchain-based NFT issued for the content registered in a platform to a user terminal, which is a device of at least one user accessing the platform; performing a qualification verification procedure for the user terminal by using communication information and verifiable credential information of the user terminal in a process of providing the download service; and managing the use of the download service for the content related to the blockchain-based NFT provided to the user terminal, based on the result of a qualification verification procedure. Therefore, the method can securely protect copyrighted content.

title_en: Method for providing music contents licensing platform service based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method, device, and system for providing a music content licensing platform service based on artificial intelligence. The method of providing a music content licensing platform service based on artificial intelligence according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: receiving video information from a user terminal; analyzing the video information based on artificial intelligence to form video category information; searching for music information matching the video category information; forming a video sample file by matching the video information and the music information; sending the video sample file to the user terminal; receiving a request to modify the video sample file from the user terminal; and modifying the video sample file according to the modification request to form a final video file. The present invention allows classification of the music information based on various criteria to easily search for music suitable for the type of video.

title_en: Touchable dynamic NFT operating system
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a touchable dynamic NFT operation system comprises: a database storing 3D content expressed in a three-dimensional shape and objects constituting a virtual space in which the 3D content is arranged; a dynamic NFT generating module that provides dynamic NFT content, which converts the 3D content into a virtual asset with a non-fungible token (NFT), to both a user terminal and the virtual space; and a dynamic NFT expression module that generates motion information according to a manipulation signal of the user terminal and moves the dynamic NFT content according to the motion information to provide the same to the user terminal.

title_en: Game management server for team matching based on artificial intelligence, method and program
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a game management server for artificial intelligence-based team matching, a method, and a program. The game management server for the artificial intelligence-based team matching of the present invention comprises: a communication unit which communicates with a game server which provides game information; and a processor which controls an operation related to automatic team matching based on an artificial intelligence. The processor receives the game information from the game server through the communication unit and verifies attribute information of a participant in the game information. Additionally, the processor learns and analyzes the attribute information of the participant based on an artificial intelligence model and extracts team matching information stored in connection with the attribute information of participant. Additionally, the processor transmits the team matching information to the game server to automatically match based on the extracted team matching information. An objective of the present invention is to provide something which can improve satisfaction with a game service.

title_en: Smart cable tray for disaster monitoring with a sensor attached to the cable tray with earthquake resistance, electromagnetic shielding, and fire prevention functions
abstract_en: Provided is a smart cable tray system which detects a disaster such as fire, earthquake, flood damage or the like occurring in a corresponding area through one or more cable trays installed in the area and notifies the outside of it so as to make rapid disaster prevention. The smart cable tray system receives sensing data from a cable tray to determine a disaster situation in the corresponding area and generates disaster occurrence information according to a determination result to be transmitted to at least one manager terminal.

title_en: Integration management system for grave roadway of entry prevention
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart automatic blocking integrated disaster management system for a road with a flood risk, which can protect a human life from a disaster and prevent property damage, comprising: a manager terminal for performing an operation procedure of a road blocking device; an operation server for operating a barrier; a measuring and monitoring device for providing measurement information; a road blocking device; and a linkage device for providing integrated disaster management.

title_en: System for providing business to business platform connecting licensor, manufacturer and distributor
abstract_en: A b2b platform service providing system comprises: a manager terminal for uploading a design of a product according to a license and a category; a manufacturer terminal for uploading a sample for the design of the product according to the license and the category; a license terminal for confirming the sample; a distributor terminal for pre-ordering the confirmed sample; and a platform service providing server including a prediction unit, a suggestion unit, a confirmation request unit, a distribution promotion unit, a pre-order management unit, an interactive provision unit, a person in charge designation unit, and a virtuous circulation unit. The present invention enables data-based decision-making, allows a licensee to select a reliable manufacturer, allows the manufacturer to reduce the burden of contract and design confirmation with the licensee, allows the manufacturer not to inventory due to the pre-order of the distributor, and allows the distributor to smoothly supply and demand products that satisfy the needs of users.

title_en: Arbitrage transaction prediction method, device, and system using an artificial intelligence model learned based on cryptocurrency transaction data
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a method, a device, and a system for predicting the occurrence of arbitrage using an artificial intelligence model learned based on cryptocurrency transaction data which realize profits based on margin by trading spot goods and futures in two different cryptocurrency exchanges, respectively, and predict in advance the time when arbitrage is possible to enable risk hedging.

title_en: English learning device using language model
abstract_en: An English learning device using a language model according to an embodiment generates multiple learning sentences that reflect speaking styles, regions, and age groups in a single English sentence through a language model and generative AI (Open AI). In the embodiment, the language model and generative AI provide English sentences in various speaking styles, such as formal, informal, business, polite, intimate, and aristocratic, and may provide regionally specific English expressions, such as American, Australian, and Middle Eastern. Furthermore, the device may provide different English sentences and expressions used by young, middle-aged, and older generations.

title_en: HACCP implementation inspection management system and method using HACCP management learning model
abstract_en: Provided is an HACCP implementation inspection management system using a HACCP management learning model, which comprises: a sensor learning model generation unit for generating a sensor management learning model by learning a data pattern when data of a sensor is normal, a data pattern when the data of the sensor is abnormal, and abnormal cause information; a network learning model generation unit for generating a network management learning model by learning a data pattern when data of a plurality of sensors is normal, a data pattern when the data of the sensor is abnormal, and abnormal cause information; a sensor result information generation unit for generating learning result information; a network result information generation unit for collecting the data patterns of the plurality of sensors, inputting the collected data patterns into the network management learning model, and generating learning result information; and an output unit for receiving the learning result information, receiving a data pattern obtained by other network equipment from other network equipment other than one network equipment, and outputting an HACCP implementation inspection report. According to the HACCP implementation inspection management system using the HACCP management learning model according to an embodiment of the present invention, when data sensed by a sensor is abnormal by using the HACCP management learning model, abnormal cause information can be clearly derived and an HACCP implementation inspection report can be output.

title_en: Method and system for providing interactive advertisements for uam and autonomous driving objects
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a system for providing an interactive advertisement. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for providing an interactive advertisement, which is performed by a device including a display, comprises the steps of: obtaining location information and entry direction information of a target device based on the location of the display; monitoring whether the target device enters a first area defined based on the display based on the location information and the entry direction; and providing first 3D advertisement content based on at least one of a movement trajectory of the target device, surrounding environment information of the target device, and passenger information of the target device based on whether it is determined that the target device has entered the first area. The display direction of the first 3D advertisement content may be changed in real time according to the movement trajectory of the target device.

title_en: Device and method for predicting audience action
abstract_en: The present technology relates to a computing device. An audience behavior prediction device according to this technology may comprise: an audience data acquisition unit for acquiring audience identification information to identify each of a plurality of audiences targeted by advertisements and a plurality of log data recording various actions of each audience; an audience data processing unit for generating behavior pattern data composed of continuous actions related to each other among the actions, based on the audience identification information and the log data; and a model learning unit for training a deep learning-based model to predict the behavior of each audience using the behavior pattern data as learning data.

title_en: Integrated distribution system for crops grown with calcium fertilizer and the method using it
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated distribution system for crops cultivated with calcium fertilizer and, more specifically, to an integrated distribution system for crops cultivated with calcium fertilizer for increasing income through the supply of organic calcium fertilizer and liquid fertilizer for the cultivation of functional crops in farms and the integrated distribution of crops cultivated through the same.

title_en: Method for monitoring illegal second-hand trade for target product
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, disclosed is a method for monitoring a used transaction for a target product, performed by a computing device. The method comprises the steps of: generating a first embedding vector based on information on a target product; generating a second embedding vector based on information on a used transaction product; and monitoring whether a used transaction for the target product is performed by using the first embedding vector and the second embedding vector.

title_en: Air pollution prediction and health impact assessment system and method using Artificial intelligence model
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an air pollution prediction and health impact assessment system using an AI model comprises: an air pollution prediction unit equipped with an AI model for predicting regional concentrations of air pollutants; a first calculation unit for estimating the number of deaths and human health damage caused by exposure to the predicted concentrations of air pollutants, based on disease-specific mortality rates from a reference year to subsequent years, regional/age-specific population projections, and relative risk (RR) values that measure the risk of disease occurrence due to air pollutant concentrations predicted by the above AI model; and a second calculation unit for setting the regional number of deaths in the reference year as a reduction target and calculating the necessary reduction in regional air pollutant concentrations to decrease the projected number of deaths in a future year to the level of the reference year.

title_en: Movable smart case
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a movable smart case, comprising: a frame having a detachable front cover to open a storage space; a plurality of partition plates provided on the frame to divide the storage space according to the size and number of items; and a plurality of fixing means provided on the storage space to securely fix the items by gripping them, wherein the frame further comprises a handle that can be grasped by hand and a plurality of casters coupled to be movable by rolling.

title_en: Construction material demand forecasting system using ARIMA model and industry association table and construction material demand forecasting method using it
abstract_en: Provided is a construction material demand prediction system using an ARIMA model and an input-output table, wherein the system is installed on a server connected through the Internet using a dedicated application installed on a user's terminal and includes an input module, an analysis module, and an output module. The construction material demand prediction system is characterized in that past construction completed amounts input through the input module are analyzed by the analysis module using an ARIMA model and an input-output table, thereby calculating an expected construction completed amount and an expected material demand amount for a desired period. The expected material demand amount is calculated by determining a proportion of each material from the expected construction completed amount. The expected material demand amount is classified and calculated by the analysis module according to categories including construction type, month, or region. The past construction completed amount is updated in real time through linkage with a related site, and the updated data is reflected in real time in the calculation of the expected construction completed amount and the expected material demand amount. According to the present invention, the system is specialized in construction materials, particularly civil engineering materials used in civil engineering works, and can accurately calculate future expected construction completed amounts and expected material demand amounts through a simple procedure based on past construction completed amounts and the like using techniques such as regression analysis.

title_en: Method for Displaying Popular Goods Information by Using Store Device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for outputting popular product information using a store device. According to the present invention, the method for outputting popular product information using a store device comprises the steps of: checking device-side order details; storing the checked device-side order details in a designated storage area; receiving POS-side order details; storing the POS-side order details in a designated storage area; determining a popular product; and outputting product information. According to the present invention, a customer can easily check popular products in a store.

title_en: Power Consumption Estimation Algorithm Considering Users' Usage Characteristics
abstract_en: Disclosed are a power consumption prediction method considering usage characteristics of a user and an apparatus thereof. An objective of the present invention is to provide a method and an apparatus to consider usage characteristics of a user to predict power consumption without an additional design in various systems and services. According to the present invention, the power consumption prediction method considering usage characteristics of a user comprises: a step of clustering raw data to extract a general load profile and a residual load profile; a step of embedding a sequence of the extracted general load profile and a sequence of the extracted residual load profile; a step of performing LSTM training on the sequence of the general load profile and the sequence of the residual load profile; a step of predicting the sequence of the general load profile and the sequence of the residual load profile; and a step of combining the predicted sequence of the general load profile and the predicted sequence of the residual load profile.

title_en: Work instruction method using smart devices
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method, which comprises the steps of: transmitting process data collected by a smart device (100) to a control unit (200); receiving, by the control unit (200), the collected process data, and analyzing the process data to generate analysis data; determining, by the control unit (200), positive data from the generated analysis data and learning the data; determining a work method in which the smart device (100) is located and a work condition of the product to be worked in the work method, by the control unit (200), and determining the positive data corresponding to the work condition and a location of the smart device (200) corresponding to the positive data to generate instruction data; and, by the control unit 200, transmitting the generated instruction data to the smart device (100).

title_en: Curation system of video learning contents of social media platform based on ontology
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a video learning content curation system of a social media platform based on ontology, and more specifically, to a video learning content curation system of a social media platform based on ontology, wherein video learning contents created by students in line with the change in the educational environment represented by MOOC massive open online course (MOOC) due to the development of an education technology industry that solves the problems of the existing cramming education with IT is used as a module content for learning of MOOC and flipped learning, and the voice of video learning content is analyzed to be used for online education of the MOOC through ontology-based curation of a grade, a subject, and table of contents, so that ultimately, the flip learning can be effectively realized.

title_en: Slow road guidance system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a slow road concept of novel road guidance system for guiding a slow road. The novel road guidance system comprises: a tourist attraction collection unit for periodically collecting and updating regional tourist attraction information; a road information storage unit for storing regional road information; a route search unit for searching the road information storage unit for all routes for connecting a starting point and a destination transmitted from the mobile terminal of a traveler; a route recommendation unit which extracts tourist attractions, matching traveler search conditions transmitted from the mobile terminal of the traveler, from an area including at least one of the starting point and the destination, and recommending and providing, to the mobile terminal of the traveler, one or more slow road routes, passing through the extracted tourist attractions, of the searched routes; and a slow road information provision unit for transmitting, to the mobile terminal of the traveler, location information related to starting points, tourist attraction stops, and destinations located in the slow road routes selected through the mobile terminal of the traveler. Therefore, the traveler can easily and conveniently find tourist attractions and travel leisurely.

title_en: System for providing job matching service and method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for providing a matching service between job offering and job seeking persons. In accordance with the present invention, when a job seeking terminal and a job offering terminal firstly determine job offering and seeking contracts by matching between the resume of a job seeker registered in the job seeking terminal and job offering information registered in the job offering terminal, a waiting state is maintained for a preset waiting time in accordance with a membership level of the job seeker of the job seeking terminal and an employer of the job offering terminal. Also, when the job seeking terminal and the job offering terminal finally determine the job offering and seeking contracts in the job seeking terminal and the job offering terminal within a waiting state, or a waiting time elapses, an employment contract of an electronic document form is created to more efficiently and stably match job seeking and offering persons. In addition, the time for deliberation before settling a contract is provided through accepting, waiting, and finishing processes in real time, such that unreasonable events are prevented from occurring to both the job seeker and the employer. Accordingly, the satisfaction of both the job seeker and the employer can increase.

title_en: Crowd funding system and method
abstract_en: A crowdfunding system includes a company terminal that transmits an investment promotion application signal including a target investment attraction amount and know-how information to be provided as a reward; an intermediary server that receives an investment promotion application signal and provides company information and know-how information of the company terminal online; and an investment terminal that selects at least one piece of know-how information from among the know-how information through an intermediary server with reference to the company information and the know-how information, and receives an investment amount corresponding to the selected know-how information. The intermediary server provides the selected know-how information to the company terminal so that a company can provide detailed content according to the selected know-how information to an investor. Therefore, the present invention can provide entrepreneurial opportunities to investors.

title_en: System for ordering and payment based smartphone
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention relates to a personal smartphone used by a customer who sits at a table in a restaurant and orders food, comprising: a customer installed with a restaurant ordering/payment application that receives the order information of the food ordered by the customer and transmits it to the input food order relay server, and performs payment for the food ordered through the payment screen provided by the food order relay server smartphone; a food order relay server that transmits the order information received from the guest smartphone to a restaurant smartphone provided at the ordered restaurant, and performs settlement of the payment amount for the ordered food with the restaurant smartphone; a personal smart phone used by a restaurant manager or employee of a restaurant, the restaurant smart phone transmitting order information received from the food order relay server to a kitchen terminal provided in the kitchen; and a wireless communication network providing wireless communication between the guest smartphone, the food order relay server, and the restaurant smartphone.

title_en: Interactive information provision system based on demand and supplier negotiation reflecting real-time energy costs and method as the same
abstract_en: Disclosed are a bidirectional information providing system based on consumer and supplier negotiations reflecting real-time energy costs and a method thereof. The bidirectional information providing system based on consumer and supplier negotiations reflecting real-time energy costs is a method for a demand response resource transaction which adjusts liquidity of power supply in a city with distributed power. The method comprises the following steps of: obtaining power consumption type information indicating a power consumption type of a consumer object; classifying consumer objects based on power consumption type information; calculating a real-time electricity price for the classified consumer object; and calculating the amount of surplus power of the consumer objects and setting a supply unit price so as to provide bidirectional information to enable a price negotiation with a consumer.

title_en: System and method for analyzing video preference using heart rate information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an image taste analysis system using heart rate information and a method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the system analyzes a taste of a user who is watching an image. The system comprises: a storage unit for storing heart rate information on a heart rate of a user for each hour measured while watching an image and classification information on keywords and weights related to people, backgrounds, or sounds for a plurality of classification sections in the image; and a control unit that analyzes preference of the user for the image based on a heart rate and a weight in each classification section.

title_en: Ontology-based knowledge provision system and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ontology-based knowledge provision system and a method thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the system comprises: an ontology knowledge model including knowledge information on a social and environmental context of context; a storage unit storing personal characteristic information and general knowledge information of a patient to be cared for; a reasoning machine configured to infer a response to a query input from a user on the basis of the ontology knowledge model and the information stored in the storage unit; and a user interface configured to receive the query from the user or output the response inferred by the reasoning machine. Accordingly, a reasoning machine and knowledge model in a unified form are provided to simultaneously infer a response related to a patient to be cared for on the basis of the personal characteristic information of the patient to be cared for and a general task response on the basis of the general knowledge information and the ontology knowledge model is structured to express knowledge information required for a caregiver who cares for to the patient to be cared for, thereby enabling anyone to take care of the patient to be cared for.

title_en: Happy communication support system in connection with kindergarten and nursery school
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a happy communication support system linked with a kindergarten and a nursery school, which is a communication web/application for parents and teachers of a kindergarten and a nursery school, which provides play and communication content to the parents to communicate with children, and which provides a counseling support environment to the teachers to communicate with the parents. The happy communication support system comprises: a parent terminal having a communication application for parents that provides a diagnostic test item for providing one among a parent-child communication test description page, an ego status test, a communication style test, a parenting attitude test page, and a diagnostic test result page, and a communication mission item for providing at least one among a happy communication mission introduction page, a communication mission step list page, a step-by-step mission list, a mission detail view page, a mission performance registration page, and a performance view page; a teacher terminal having a communication application for teachers that provides a diagnostic test item for providing one among a parent-child communication test description page, an ego status test page, a communication style test, and a diagnostic test result page, and a communication mission item for providing a class communication mission list page and a communication mission feedback registration page; and a management server for storing and managing data generated by the interaction between the parent terminal and the teacher terminal.

title_en: Mixed Beverage Manufacturing and Ordering Service Delivery System
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mixed beverage manufacturing and ordering service providing system. The system includes: a user terminal providing the membership registration, generating a mixed beverage recipe for manufacturing a mixed beverage, and receiving feedback information of the generated mixed beverage recipe; a beverage ordering and management server registering and storing a mixed beverage recipe transmitted from the user terminal, ordering and manufacturing the mixed beverage corresponding to the mixed beverage recipe, and generating and transmitting priority information of the mixed beverage recipe to the user terminal; and a beverage manufacturing module configured to receive the mixed beverage recipe transmitted from the beverage ordering and management server, and to manufacture and distribute the mixed beverage corresponding to the mixed beverage recipe.

title_en: System and method that provide differential rewards for providing real estate information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing a differential reward service according to provision of real estate information, which activates information transactions between buyers, and a method thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the system comprises: a plurality of first terminals providing the sale information and visit schedule of a real estate by using a real estate transaction platform; a plurality of second terminals using the real estate transaction platform to search and extract real estate information corresponding to user input information and provide an extracted goods, requesting a visit schedule reservation for the extracted goods, and registering status information and visit reviews for the extracted goods after the visit to the extracted goods on a reserved date; and a real estate brokerage server building a goods information provided through the real estate transaction platform in a database, after providing the goods information corresponding to a search keyword entered in the second terminal, and calculating a predetermined amount of a goods promotion fee registered in the first terminal through a preset calculation method to provide the calculated amount as rewards for a review when the visit review is registered from the second terminal.

title_en: System and method for having function of managing card image, mobile terminal and server applied to the same
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a system for managing a card through a mobile wallet comprises: a user terminal having a mobile wallet for performing a financial transaction function corresponding to a financial card; and a card management server for receiving and storing card image information on the financial card from the user terminal, and inquiring for the stored card image information to provide the same for the user terminal when the financial card should be used through the mobile wallet. The user terminal acquires a card image for the financial card. The card image information includes at least one of a text image representing a text including card information on the financial card in the card image, location information and size information on the card image corresponding to the text image. The card management server physically or logically separates and stores at least one of the text images, the location information, and the size information. Therefore, the card information is safely and efficiently backed up and restored.

title_en: Method for speaking book contents using a book reading device and a method for managing the book contents in a reading device
abstract_en: Provided is a technology for purchasing a book by combining a sound source or purchasing separately, in the case where the sound source for the content of the book is provided together with the book. Provided is a technology for allowing a buyer of a second-hand book to acquire the sound source at a second-hand price, in the case of second-hand sales of the above books at the second-hand price.

title_en: Method and system for presponding server overload in auction process
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an auction service providing server provides a server overload responding method of an auction process as a method for responding to server overload which comprises: (a) providing product information to a plurality of user terminals and managing an auction process by receiving a bid request; and (b) checking whether the bid request, transmitted from an arbitrary user terminal, exists without performing a successful bidder selection procedure for a preset waiting time after an expected auction closing time arrives.

title_en: server and its system that provides web services related to parallel imports
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a server for providing a parallel import-related web service, and to a system thereof. In addition, various embodiments disclosed in this document relate to an electronic device and method for performing purchase of a product. A server system may include one or more PCs and/or workstations.

title_en: System for cloud streaming service, method of image cloud streaming service based on quality information of application file and apparatus for the same
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system for providing a cloud streaming service, and a method and an apparatus for providing an image cloud streaming service based on quality information on an application file. The method for providing an image cloud streaming service according to the present invention comprises the following steps of: analyzing the number of colors of executable files on an application to generate a high-definition list including high-definition files; using the high-definition list to check whether at least one high-definition file is being executed when the application is executed according to a user request; and transmitting information on an encoding method corresponding to the high definition along with an execution screen of the application when the at least one high-definition file is executed. Accordingly, an image-based cloud streaming service having a guaranteed definition and speed can be provided.

title_en: Method for Controlling Hot Delivery Box for Delivery Goods Based on Time
abstract_en: According to the method for controlling a heating delivery box for time-based delivery products of the present invention, a method executed through a server capable of communicating with a control module for controlling a thermal function of a heating delivery box provided in a mobile delivery device includes the steps of: storing, in a designated storage medium, the delivery temperature setting information including the delivery temperature range for each N (N>=1) delivery product (or delivery product category) that can be delivered in the heating delivery box, and including at least one delivery times zone-specific delivery temperature range adjusted (or set) for each designated delivery times zone with respect to at least some designated delivery products (or delivery product categories) among the N delivery products (or delivery product categories); checking n-th (1<=n<=N) delivery products of a specific store to be delivered to a specific customer; checking an m-th control module of an m-th heating delivery box provided in an m-th (1<=m<=M) delivery mobile device to deliver an m-th delivery product among the M (M>=1) delivery mobile devices; checking the delivery temperature range of the n-th delivery product to be delivered through the m-th heating delivery box based on the delivery temperature setting information; communicating with the m-th control module of the m heating delivery box to control the internal temperature of the m-th heating delivery box so that the delivery completion temperature of the n-th delivery product matches the delivery temperature range of the n-th delivery product.

title_en: Survey banner monetization system
abstract_en: The present invention is a survey banner monetization system, comprising: an advertiser server that generates survey request information including survey items for each field; an operation server that generates survey banner information so that the survey request information received from the advertiser server conforms to a banner format; and a client terminal that generates survey response information in the survey items for each field included in the survey banner information posted on the operation server. The advertiser server transmits the received survey response information and compensation information corresponding to the operation server to the operation server, after receiving the survey response information from the operation server.

title_en: Server apparatus and controlling method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is a server device. The present server device comprises: a communication interface; a memory that stores the advertisement reproduction history information reproduced on a display device; and a processor that matches the sales information with the product information included in the advertisement reproduction history information to identify a field of an item related to the product information in the sales information, when the sales information for the advertisement product is received from a point of sales (POS) device through the communication interface, and calculates the sales analysis data based on the advertisement reproduction history information and sales information in which the field for each item is identified. Therefore, an objective of the present invention is to provide the server device capable of automatically identifying the field of the item.

title_en: Geofence service apparatus, and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a geofence service apparatus for determining a service geofence to provide a service to a terminal according to a service policy considering an overlapping state of geofences in an overlapping area where geofences overlap between affiliated stores, and an operating method thereof. The geofence service apparatus comprises: a checking unit which checks a service area that matches location information of a terminal; a determining unit which determines whether the service area is an overlapping area in which two or more geofences overlap each other; and a determination unit which determines, when the service area is determined to be the overlapping area, at least one of the two or more geofences as a service geofence capable of providing a service to the terminal according to geofence overlapping properties of the service area.

title_en: Method and program for providing electronic registration service based on virtual authentication code
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method of electronic registration service replacing an OTAC-based authentication certificate. The method is a method performed by a computer, comprising: a step of a virtual security code generation module generating a virtual security code which is a one-time code with a specific digit according to a user's request; a step of qualification code generation module generating a qualification number corresponding to the user based on the virtual security code and information related to the user; and a step of transmitting the qualification number to the user, wherein the virtual security code and the qualification number are changed and generated for each unit count by the qualification number generation module, and the unit count is set at a specific time interval and changed as the time interval elapses.

title_en: Methods, Systems and Computer-Readable Medium for Learning Machine-Learned-Model Evaluating Plural Competency
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method, device, and computer-readable medium for training a machine learning model that performs a competency evaluation for multiple competencies. Specifically, the present invention relates to the method, device, and computer-readable medium for training the machine learning model that performs the competency evaluation for the multiple competencies that enables efficient training of the machine learning model that outputs an evaluation result for each of a plurality of competencies from the input data related to a response and the like of the evaluated person. Therefore, the present invention is capable of exhibiting an effect of automatically providing the evaluation result.

title_en: System for performing simple payment registration based common encryption of account and name, and simple payment registration method
abstract_en: Disclosed is a simple payment registration method of a system. The present simple payment registration method comprises: a step of receiving, by a user terminal, the account holder information and the account information; a step of encrypting, by a server, the authentication information including the account holder information and the account information inputted through the user terminal; a step of decrypting, by a financial institution server, the encrypted authentication information; a step of comparing, by the financial institution server, the decrypted authentication information with information for a pre-stored account to determine whether an authentication is successful; and a step of registering, by the server, a simple payment through the user terminal according to a password set through the user terminal based on whether the authentication is successful. Therefore, the present invention can reduce a dropout rate.

title_en: Customized interior services and methods using artificial intelligence in 3D
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a service capable of enabling reasonable consumption through a virtual simulation in which a database is built based on three-dimensionally modeled design data and basic design outline data and the data are selected and placed on a drawing described by a user, and a method thereof. In accordance with an embodiment of the present invention, a coordination system using a virtual simulation includes a user interface setting a drawing, and a user interface selecting data. The method includes the following steps of: building a database to store three-dimensionally modeled data; displaying a completed arrangement through the virtual simulation; and enabling a consultation related therewith.

title_en: Song lyrics typing games and programs
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a song lyrics typing game and program. More specifically, the present invention relates to a rhythm action game which is able to play a song, provide lyrics of the song, display the lyrics to be more distinguished matching the song, mark the letters on the letter keyboard of the smartphone which matches the first letter of the word of the relevant lyrics, and let the user select it and get a score. The song lyrics typing game and program comprise: a step of playing a song, and displaying the lyrics matching the song, and providing a game execution interface made of the letter keyboard of the smartphone; a step of displaying the lyrics to be more distinguished matching the song and marking the letters on the letter keyboard of the smartphone which matches the first letter of the word; a step of selecting the relevant letter button at the determined time and getting a score; and a step of repeating the above process until the song ends and acquiring scores and enjoying the song.

title_en: Card terminal performing card payment using secure access module and method of operating the same
abstract_en: Disclosed is a card terminal for performing card payment using a secure access module (SAM). The card terminal according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a storage part; a communication part; and a processor for checking whether the SAM is registered in the card terminal, if the SAM is not registered in the card terminal, checking whether there is a history of the SAM issuing key information used to perform authentication for the SAM, if there is no history of issuing the key information, accessing the SAM to obtain the key information used to perform authentication for the SAM, controlling the communication part to transmit the identification (ID) information of the SAM and the obtained key information to a key management server, and controlling the communication part to receive, from the key management server, a response including an indicator indicating that the ID information of the SAM and the key information has been normally registered. Therefore, provided is a method for reducing replacement costs by reusing a SAM having issued a master key already when the master key is lost.

title_en: Parking site management system using raider sensor and operating method thereof
abstract_en: In accordance with one embodiment of the present disclosure, a parking lot management system, includes: a lidar sensor installed in a parking lot, and sensing a parking space including a plurality of parking surfaces and parking passages; and at least one server receiving sensor data from the lidar sensor, determining whether a vehicle is parked in each of the plurality of parking surfaces based on the sensor data, and checking the number of vehicles existing in the parking passages, wherein the at least one server can be formed to calculate the degree of congestion in the parking space based on whether a vehicle is parked in each of the plurality of parking surfaces and the number of vehicles existing in the parking passages, and transmit the degree of congestion to the parking lot. Besides, various embodiments can be possible. Therefore, the present invention is capable of identifying the degree of congestion in the parking lot at a low cost for installation and maintenance.

title_en: Image advertising intermediation service system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a video advertisement relay service system, comprising: at least one video advertisement transmission device transmitting unique device identification information with video advertisement transmission availability information that includes video advertisement transmission location and time information where a video advertisement is available, video advertisement income amount information desired by a video advertisement transmitter, and business type information of a place where a video advertisement is transmitted; at least one video advertiser terminal transmitting unique advertiser identification information with video advertiser requirement information that includes video advertisement transmission location and time information desired by a video advertiser, video advertisement payment amount information desired by the video advertiser, and business type information of a place where a video advertisement is desired to be transmitted; and a video advertisement relay server receiving the unique device identification information with the video advertisement transmission availability information transmitted from each video advertisement transmission device and the unique advertiser identification information with the video advertiser requirement information transmitted from each video advertiser terminal, analyzing a similarity between the video advertisement transmission availability information and video advertiser requirement information to create customized video advertisement relay recommendation information for relaying a video advertisement that matches video advertisement transmission availability and video advertiser requirements with the similarity higher than a preset similarity, and transmitting the created customized video advertisement relay recommendation information to the video advertisement transmission device and the video advertiser terminal, respectively. Therefore, the video advertisement relay service system can effectively create advertising revenue while providing a customized advertising service to a customer who want an optimal advertising effect at a desired place and time.

title_en: Computer-implemented systems and methods for artificial intelligence (ai)-based inbound plan generation
abstract_en: Provided are a computer-implemented system and method for generating an artificial intelligence (AI)-based inbound plan to generate an inbound plan for one or more fulfillment center (FCs) on the basis of optimization. According to the present invention, the system and method use a model to predict available storage associated with an FC; calculate constraint capability associated with the FC; predict demand capability associated with the FC; use the predicted available storage, the calculated constraint capability, and the predicted demand capability to determine inbound constraints on the basis of the predicted available storage and the calculated constraint capability; calculate a difference between the predicted demand capacity and the determined inbound constraints; perform preprocessing planning by outputting excess demand capability or remaining available capability on the basis of the calculated difference; and generate an inbound plan for the FC on the basis of the output of the performed preprocessing plan.

title_en: Method, system, and non-transitory computer-readable recording medium for controlling a serving robot
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, provided is a method for controlling a serving robot, comprising the steps of: determining a first time point for requesting payment from a customer based on identification information about the customer and information about an order of the customer obtained about the customer; obtaining information on an eating situation of the customer at a second time point associated with the first time point; and adjusting at least one of the first time point and the second time point based on at least one of information related to additional orders of the customer that are additionally obtained with respect to the customer and the information on the eating situation of the customer. Accordingly, a customer's eating situation can be efficiently monitored. Moreover, a payment can be requested at an appropriate time from the customer.

title_en: Electronic payment card for performing payment function according to a plurality of payment methods
abstract_en: An electronic payment card comprises: a communication interface, a memory, and a processor. The memory includes: a first applet which performs a payment function according to a credit card payment method; and a second applet which performs a payment function according to a prepaid transportation card payment method. When the processor executes the first applet and the second applet stored in the memory, the processor communicates with a card terminal for supporting the credit card payment method. By receiving a balance check request from a card terminal, the processor confirms balance information of a repaid rechargeable electronic wallet, and transmits the confirmed balance information to the card terminal. By receiving a balance reduction request including payment amount information from the card terminal, the processor deducts a balance of the electronic wallet, and transmits a transaction completion notification to the card terminal. The present invention allows the electronic payment card to facilitate payment in a transportation terminal.

title_en: Paper shredder management method for customer and after service for paper shredder using smartphon
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for customer service management using a paper shredder having customer management and customer service management method applied thereto using a smartphone, and more specifically, to a method for customer service management using a paper shredder having customer management and customer service management method applied thereto using a smartphone which has sensors formed inside a paper shredder, stores a state of the paper shredder through the sensors in a memory and at the same time records the same through a connected wireless network, and when a problem occurs, immediately provides a customer service, and reduces unnecessary labor force and time by having a customer serviceman with precise parts visit since failure causes of the paper shredder is clearly identified during the customer service.

title_en: System and method for building firefighting safety
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a building fire safety management system and method capable of providing speed and accuracy for fire inspection work. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the building fire safety management system comprises: an access sensor including an NFC module and communication module installed at an entrance door of each building; a fire engineer terminal transmitting identification information upon NFC tagging to the access sensor, and functioning as a door key as the NFC module determines whether the identification information is pre-registered identification information; and a building fire safety management server providing a fire engineer application outputting an NFC tag screen to the fire engineer terminal. The access sensor stores the first time when receiving the fire engineer's terminal identification information through the NFC tag screen as visit time information, and the fire engineer terminal receives fire inspection information and end time information from the fire engineer through the fire engineer application. When the fire engineer's terminal NFC-tags the access sensor after building inspection is completed, the fire engineer terminal transmits the fire inspection information and the end time information to the access sensor and the access sensor transmits building identification information, visit time information, fire inspection information, and end time information matched with the identification information of the fire engineer's terminal to the building fire safety management server.

title_en: Political tendency analysis device and service providing method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a political tendency analysis device and a service providing method using the same. The political tendency analysis device includes a processor and a memory operatively connected to the processor. The method may store instructions to allow the processor to: collect information related to a user; identify whether the information contains keywords related to politics; identify the information as information to be evaluated based on the fact that the information contains the keywords related to politics; identify whether the information to be evaluated contains keywords related to political tendencies; and assign points to the information to be evaluated based on whether the information to be evaluated includes the keywords related to political tendencies. In addition to this, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible. According to the present invention, the political tendency analysis device can improve the convenience and accuracy of political tendency analysis.

title_en: Management server of metaverse service for providing an information about carbon emissions
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a metaverse service operation server for checking carbon emission information, which is a server for calculating carbon emissions on the basis of a behavior performed in a metaverse service of a metaverse user who uses the metaverse service through the Internet, comprises: a behavior tracking unit for tracking a user behavior within a metaverse service; a location tracking unit for tracking a location and a movement path of a user; a distance comparison unit for comparing distances by matching a user movement within the metaverse service with an actual offline movement; and a carbon emission calculating unit for calculating and displaying carbon emission on the basis of the location, behavior and movement distance of the user. Therefore, user participation can increase.

title_en: Electronic device, method, and computer program for supporting the measurement and announcement of eco-friendly life level using the collection network of laundry franchise
abstract_en: According to the present invention, provided are an electronic device, method, and computer program for supporting clothing recycling by using collection and transportation network of a laundry chain store. In addition, according to the present invention, a compensation for clothing recycling can be paid to a customer according to a set compensation rate. Specifically, according to the present invention, each individual eco-friendly life level can be measured using the collection network of the laundry chain store and can be officially announced.

title_en: A method of acquiring information about water leakage by wirelessly sensing the sound wave value of a pipe during test operation and actual operation of a building
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for obtaining information on water leakage by wirelessly sensing a pipe sound wave value of a building during startup and operation, which can immediately check the occurrence and location of a water leakage. The method comprises the steps of: obtaining information on a size and a material of a plurality of pipes installed in a building; obtaining both a normal sound wave value and a water leakage sound wave value; generating a water leakage prediction model; determining whether a water leakage occurs, and obtaining the same as driving data; and obtaining integrated driving data.

title_en: The operating system of artificial intelligence-based logistics delivery drones
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an operating system for an artificial intelligence-based logistics delivery drone, comprising a drone device, a drone central server, a logistics control server, a charging station server, and a user terminal. The drone central server includes a distance calculation unit and further includes an artificial intelligence module. By using drones, drone logistics delivery can be implemented quickly and accurately.

title_en: Method and apparatus for a movineg terminal and mart shopping system for convineint shopping
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and device for operating a supermarket shopping system and a cart terminal, which are able to allow people to rapidly and conveniently shop at a supermarket and the like. As a method for operating a supermarket shopping system for the convenient and fast shopping, the method comprises: a step in which the supermarket shopping system receives an input of fingerprint information of a user; a step in which the supermarket shopping system receives fingerprint information from a display stand; a step in which the supermarket shopping system finds a fingerprint matching the fingerprint information received from the display stand among the fingerprints inputted thereinto; and a step in which, when there is a fingerprint matching the fingerprint information received from the display stand, the supermarket shopping system adds the relevant goods to the purchased goods list of the matching fingerprint. In addition, as a method for operating a cart terminal for the convenient and rapid shopping, the method includes: a step in which the cart terminal receives and stores fingerprint information of a user; a step in which the cart terminal receives goods information and fingerprint information through the D2D communication; and a step in which the cart terminal checks if the received fingerprint information matches the stored fingerprint information, and if they match, the cart terminal adds the goods of the received goods information to the purchased goods list.

title_en: Method for providing banking service to consent information provision and banking server using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a banking service for consent to information provision and a banking server performing the same. The method for providing a banking service includes the steps of receiving a request for a banking service from a user terminal; receiving a first document related to a user using the user terminal; determining a second document that requires additional submission based on the first document; requesting the second document from the user terminal and receiving the second document from the user terminal; identifying data contained in the second document; confirming a person whose consent is required when using the banking service based on the first document and the second document; providing a consent procedure notification window on the user terminal to perform the consent procedure for the person; and determining whether the banking service can be provided when completing the consent procedure for the person.

title_en: Similar word providing service server to operate the similar word providing service that provides the similar word corresponding to the neologism word and the operating method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a similar word provision service server and an operating method thereof. When a member wishes to receive similar words corresponding to a specific new word, by crawling the text posted on each of a plurality of preset web pages, after collecting a plurality of sentences, based on the plurality of collected sentences, similar words corresponding to the specific newly coined word can be selected and provided to the member.

title_en: remote monitoring simulator system and method based on V2X communication and C-ITS system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a virtual remote inspection simulator system based on a V2X communication and C-ITS system, which comprises: a virtual inspection terminal device for performing a virtual remote inspection simulation for a road traffic environment by a user; a simulator center server for controlling a simulation task to be performed in accordance with an input signal requested by the virtual inspection terminal device; a virtual inspection base station device connected to the simulator center server through a network communication (TCP/IP), and matching a roadside base station on an actual road to transmit and receive traffic information; and a virtual driving terminal for performing a function of a vehicle terminal for a virtual vehicle moved on a virtual driving path, connected to the virtual inspection terminal device and the simulator center server through the network communication (TCP/IP), and connected to the virtual inspection base station device through V2X communication applied with a WAVE communication technology to transmit and receive information. Therefore, work efficiency can increase.

title_en: System and method for providing overseas product information using global product certification standard
abstract_en: A system and method for providing overseas product information using global product certification standards are disclosed. The present invention provides matching authentication information for overseas products with product sales information, and accurate information regarding the safety of a product can be provided to a buyer when buying overseas products.

title_en: Apparatus and server for providing smart factory requirements and problem definition service
abstract_en: A method of providing requirements to achieve a purpose of a task required by a stakeholder at a manufacturing site by using a smart factory problem definition platform providing a cloud-based web service, for accurately and efficiently achieving the purpose of the task, comprises the steps of: receiving task information regarding the task from a mobile terminal or PC with Internet access of the stakeholder at the manufacturing site and uploading the same to the platform; receiving candidate requirements proposed based on the task information from each of the plurality of participant mobile terminals or PCs and uploading the same to the platform; receiving evaluation information for the candidate requirements from each of the plurality of participant terminals or PCs and deriving an evaluation score for the candidate requirements; and selecting at least some of the candidate requirements as requirements based on the evaluation score.

title_en: Campaign automation system utilizing target and action information and method for operating the same system
abstract_en: An operating method of a campaign automation system provided in the present invention comprises: a campaign algorithm setting step of setting a setting condition to automatically set media and contents of a campaign depending on acquired information; a target information acquiring step of acquiring client related information related to a subject of a client by a client analyzing unit; an action information acquiring step of acquiring client behavior information related to a behavior of the client by the client analyzing unit; a delivery medium determining step of determining a delivery medium by using the client related information and the client behavior information by a campaign generating unit; a delivery contents determining step of determining delivery contents by using the client related information and the client behavior information by the campaign generating unit; and a campaign executing step of executing the campaign generated based on the determined delivery medium and the delivery contents by a campaign automation executing unit. The present invention can automatically set a customized campaign to the client.

title_en: Method, device and system for providing live commerce platform service through show host and product matching
abstract_en: A method of providing a live commerce platform service through show host and product matching comprises the steps of: obtaining first product information and sales period information from a product company server; obtaining information associated with a show host from a broadcasting company server; classifying the show host available during a product sales period into a first group; extracting information matching a category of a first product from show host information of the first group; calculating a show host score based on the sales rate, sales time, and number of sales of a product matching the category of the first product; determining whether the show host score is greater than a preset first standard value; recommending the show host as a first product selling show host when the show host score is greater than the first standard value; and not recommending the show host as the first product selling show host when the show host score is less than the first standard value. In embodiments, sales information of the same type as the product being sold can be extracted from the show host information and the score is calculated by analyzing the sales rate, sales time, and number of sales of the show host to recommend and select the show host to sell the product.

title_en: Method, device and system for visualize product sales status based on timeline
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method, a device and a system for visualizing a product sales status based on timeline. The method of the present invention comprises the steps of: requesting, by an image server, a sales record, category information and a representative image of a plurality of products being sold in a first online shopping mall to a server of the first online shopping mall among a plurality of online shopping malls; selecting, by the image server, at least a part of the products on the basis of the sales record; generating, by the image server, a plurality of image information including a representative image of each of the products; and outputting, by the image server, the image information to a web page to which a user terminal is connected. The image information includes a dot indicating a release date of a product, a line with the length determined in accordance with the category information, and an area with a size of the representative image determined in accordance with the sales quantity of the products. Therefore, a visual effect on a product sales status is maximized.

title_en: Mixed reality real estate brokerage device and method using collective intelligence
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for mixed reality real estate brokerage using collective intelligence. The real estate brokerage apparatus includes: a communication unit communicating with a client terminal requesting a property for sale meeting conditions of a client and a plurality of real estate agent terminals holding at least one property; and a control part, when receiving a property request message from the client terminal, transmitting the conditions included in the property request message to the plurality of real estate agent terminals, and, when receiving information about a similar property meeting at least one of the conditions from at least one of the plurality of real estate agent terminals, transmitting the information about the similar property to the client terminal such that the real estate transaction can be made. Therefore, the present invention enables an efficient real estate contract process.

title_en: Automatic material cost calculation method and apparatus for performing the same
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for automatically calculating material costs and a device for performing the same. According to various embodiments of the present invention, provided is a method for automatically calculating material costs, which includes: an operation of generating unique ID information including shape information of an object, class information of the object, and size information of the object by performing 3D modeling of the object based on data related to the design of the object; an operation of obtaining a material code corresponding to the thickness information of the object and the material information of the object, based on the class information and the size information; and an operation of calculating the material cost of the object based on the specification information of the object including the thickness information and the material code.

title_en: Weight control based nutrient solution supply control device and method therefor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a solution supply control device for controlling a solution supply device, which comprises: a scanning unit that acquires and stores media weight data and soil moisture data from a weight sensor and a soil moisture sensor at preset scanning intervals; a variable calculation unit that calculates a difference between standard media weight data acquired when a preset time has elapsed since the time of supply and media weight data acquired after the preset time has elapsed since the time of supply among the media weight data to calculate a weight change; and a solution supply control unit that determines whether to supply a solution to crops through the solution supply device, based on the weight change. According to the present invention, the supply of a nutrient solution can be automatically controlled, based on various data to be customized for the growth season of each crop.

title_en: Portable Bus stop bell Receiver
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable bus disembarkation receiver. The present invention is to solve the problem that a bus disembarkation bell is pressed forcibly, causing a dangerous situation or that the bus disembarkation bell cannot be pressed due to a specific situation. The portable bus disembarkation receiver of the present invention is small in size and easy to carry, and when only one button is pressed, the disembarkation bell in the bus is automatically pressed, and additionally includes NFC technology that can be used as a substitute for a transportation card. Therefore, all members can safely and conveniently get on and off the bus.

title_en: System for Automatically Transforming Original Files of Webtoon to Conform with Platforms
abstract_en: An automatic webtoon conversion system comprises: a storage unit which stores file specification requirements which are previously set and requested to receive a webtoon; an input which receives input information including information designating a webtoon to be transmitted and information designating a platform to be transmitted from a worker terminal; and a conversion unit which converts the webtoon designated by the input information to correspond to the file specification requirements of each platform designated by the input information and generates a converted webtoon. The file specification requirements are defined as a first number of pixels which is the number of pixels in the horizontal direction and a second number of pixels which is the number of pixels in the vertical direction for one digital file. The conversion process of webtoon original files can be automatically performed to correspond to multiple platforms with different file specification requirements for the digital file of the webtoon to be transmitted.

title_en: Search engine bid auto-optimization method and system thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system, a method, and a server for automatic optimization for search advertisement bidding. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the method for automatic optimization for search advertisement bidding comprises: a step of collecting search advertisement result data of a keyword; a step of deriving an exposure estimation function for advertisement cost per click (CPC) based on analysis of the collected search advertisement result data; a step of using the relationship between the exposure estimation function and a plurality of KPIs to predict expected search advertisement results for the CPC of the keyword; a step of determining an optimal CPC of the keyword by using a multi-objective optimization algorithm based on the predicted expected search advertisement results; and a step of outputting bidding information in response to the determined optimal CPC of the keyword. The plurality of KPIs can be any two or more among click, switching, exposure, click through rate (CTR), and conversion rate (CVR).

title_en: Parking management system and method using laser sensor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a parking management system using a laser sensor. The present invention comprises: a vehicle detection device, equipped in an inner side car lane of a parking area and equipped with a laser sensor for confirming whether parked that detects an object within the parking area and on a side surface dividing line of the parking area, and consisting of the laser sensor for car lane detection that detects the object located on the side surface dividing line; and a control device that operates the laser sensor for car lane detection so as to detect whether a parked vehicle is intruding on the car lane within the parking area, when detecting that a sensing value is changed from the laser sensor for confirming whether parked. Therefore, the present invention is capable of having an effect of reducing damage to other drivers.

title_en: Information processing device, display system, and display device
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an information processing device, a display system, and a display device, which enables issued coupons to be effectively utilized. The information processing device according to one embodiment of the present invention is an information processing device capable of communicating with a plurality of display devices arranged in a store to correspond to each display area where products are displayed. The information processing device of the present invention comprises: an acquisition unit that acquires customer identification information that identifies a customer and customer location information that indicates the location of the customer; a selection unit that selects a coupon that can be used by the customer identified by the customer identification information acquired by the acquisition unit; and a specification unit that specifies the display device indicating that the product in the corresponding display area is a target subject to the coupon among the plurality of display devices, based on the customer location information acquired by the acquisition unit and the area information indicating the display area of the product subject to the coupon selected by the selection unit.

title_en: METHOD FOR Road surface condition analysis of vehicle roads and an electronic device
abstract_en: According to the present invention, disclosed are an electronic device for supporting road surface condition analysis of a vehicle road and an operating method thereof. the electronic device comprises a server communication circuit, a server memory, and a server processor. the server processor performs comparison between received sensing data and a pre-stored learning model of a first class, and is set to classify the sensing data into a class different from the first class according to a designated condition when the received sensing data is not classified by the learning model of the first class.

title_en: Method for managing battery record and apparatus for performing the method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a battery history management method and an apparatus for performing the same. A battery history management method may include the steps of: generating, by a battery history management device, a non-fungible token (nft) of a battery based on a blockchain; and generating, by the battery history management device, battery value evaluation data corresponding to the nft of the battery and recording the battery value evaluation data on the blockchain.

title_en: Solar Panel Monitoring System
