abstract_en: The present invention relates to a solar panel monitoring system comprising: a sensor module, equipped by comprising a reverse current prevention diode installed on each solar panel to prevent reverse current during solar power generation, for detecting a temperature, detecting failure of the reverse current prevention diode, and transmitting the detected data to a management terminal through a wireless communication method; and a management terminal for collecting, managing, analyzing, and monitoring data that detects a state of each solar panel received from each of the sensor modules. According to the present invention, the present invention has an effect of enabling to quickly and easily detect a performance and state information of each solar panel by individually equipping a sensor module to each solar panel, and enabling stable operation of the solar panel since being able to be checked at all times by a panel unit.

title_en: Map-based site management system for nuclear power plant decommissioning
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a system for supporting successful site restoration by accurately and efficiently tracking and managing pollution investigation in a site in stages according to the progress of decommissioning work of a nuclear power plant. A decommissioning nuclear power plant site management system comprises: a data processing module for inputting and processing site information data; a data management module for storing and managing the site information data; and a display module for displaying the site information data.

title_en: System and Method for identifying object in real time using object distance estimation scheme
abstract_en: A system that can identify an operator and a device based on Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Received Signal Strength Indicator (RRSI) values and object detection/tracking using an industrial field infrastructure is disclosed. The system comprises: a communication terminal that generates device status information and unique information thereof by exchanging signals with a safety device worn by an operator; an event detection device that uses a plurality of cameras and a plurality of received signal measuring devices to generate shooting video information and received signal sensitivity values for each object; and a comprehensive control server that performs a function of identifying the operator and the safety device worn by the operator by applying object detection tracking technology to the received signal sensitivity values and the shooting video information.

title_en: Internet web browser-based ancestral rites/funeral director congratulatory message printer output service
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an internet web browser-based ritual area/funeral instructor axial door printer output service. the service is designed to output ritual areas and funeral instructor axial doors that can be used for rituals through a printer connected to a user terminal in a smart device (smartphone, tablet pc, desktop, and electronic device) that anyone can use the internet web browser anytime, anywhere. according to the present invention, the ritual areas and funeral instructor axial doors are not written directly by hand to hold rituals, but can be conveniently and quickly printed out anywhere to hold rituals.

title_en: Method of processing order and apparatus thereof
abstract_en: Provided are a method and an apparatus for processing orders. The method according to an embodiment of the present invention may comprise the steps of: acquiring information on a transportation means for a user who delivers a product corresponding to an order and interest points related to the pickup or delivery of the products corresponding to the order; identifying an interest area that includes the interest points; determining waypoints within the interest area based on the information on a transportation means; and determining a recommended route to reach the interest points via the waypoints from the location of the user's user terminal. The interest area may be a collection of a plurality of interest points having common attributes.

title_en: Integrated tour service operation system using people-counter
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated tourism service operating system using a people-counter, capable of providing optimal course information including a tourist course, an accommodation, a restaurant, and the like suitable for a user using a tour date and personal information of schedule-information as input data when receiving the schedule-information including a tourist destination, a date, personal information, and the like from the corresponding user, while providing tourist destination information by the people-counter to the user, thereby enabling the user to quickly and accurately check the density of the tourist destination to which the user wants to travel as well as to receive the optimal course information according to his or her schedule, which can lead to a significant increase in the efficiency and convenience of the tourism service.

title_en: Method for Calculate Dispatch Estimation for Cargo Transport
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method for calculating a dispatch estimate for transferring cargo disposed in a target space comprises the steps of: receiving an image obtained by photographing the target space, a storage location of the cargo, and a transfer arrival location; identifying cargo information disposed in the target space from the image; selecting a type of a vehicle for transferring the cargo based on the identified cargo information; and calculating the dispatch estimate based on the type of the vehicle.

title_en: Method of managing user's information and apparatus thereof
abstract_en: Provided are a method and an apparatus for managing the information of a user. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method performed by an electronic device comprises the steps of: obtaining first activity information of a target user related to a first service from a first external device providing the first service; generating first profile information of the target user by processing the first activity information; calculating a first generation time point of the first profile information; storing the first profile information and the first generation time point in association with each other; and updating user management information integrating the information of the target user based on the first profile information and the first generation time point.

title_en: food delivery container unit and food delivery advertisement support system using the same and advertisement method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a food delivery container unit that supports advertising through a food delivery container, a food delivery advertising support system applying the same, and an advertising method thereof. The food delivery container unit comprises: a delivery container body having a food-receiving space capable of accommodating food and used for delivery; a container terminal operation unit that supports information input; a container terminal display unit mounted on the delivery container body and displaying information; a container terminal communication unit that performs communication; and a container terminal control unit that, when information received through the container terminal communication unit or information input through the container terminal operation unit corresponds to an advertising mode, processes the information to display corresponding advertising information on the container terminal display unit. According to the food delivery container unit, the food delivery advertising support system applying the same, and the advertising method thereof, the advantage of supporting food delivery through storage while also providing advertising information can be offered.

title_en: Learning Assistant Chatbot AI Service Using Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning
abstract_en: Provided is a chatbot artificial intelligence (AI) service for use in an educational environment including a database of curriculum data and Q&A data, an instructor AI bot assigned to each lecture, and a chatbot interface through which students can ask questions about the curriculum and receive immediate feedback. This learning assistant chatbot AI service technology can help improve student participation and satisfaction by providing personalized support and immediate feedback, thereby motivating students and inducing them to continue to participate in textbooks, which can increase better learning outcomes and student success rates.

title_en: System for creating an advertising material and method of creating an advertising materials using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an advertisement production system and an advertisement production method that can provide a production program capable of creating customer-specific advertisement videos and implement advertisements using the program. The method comprises the steps of: by a video segmentation unit, segmenting a target product implementation video into unit video data; by an event video extraction unit, extracting event video data from the unit video data segmented by the video segmentation unit based on deep learning; and by a video editing unit, preprocessing the event video data into layer video and editing the same according to advertisement purposes to generate an N-second video.

title_en: Method for operating power generation control system capable of reducing peak load power generated by using fossile fuels for carbon neutrality
abstract_en: A method for operating a power generation control system capable of reducing peak power generated by using fossil fuel for carbon neutrality includes: monitoring power consumption currently consumed by electricity consumers to calculate current total power consumption; monitoring base power generated by a base power generator, the peak power, first renewable power generated by a wind power generator, second renewable power generated by a solar power generator, and renewable power corresponding to the sum of the first renewable power and the second renewable power to calculate current total production power corresponding to the sum; calculating a power difference between the current total production power and the current total power consumption; correcting the power difference using power consumption big data; controlling a second control device for controlling the operation of the wind power generator to increase the renewable power within a range of the corrected power difference and a third control device for controlling the operation of the solar power generator; and controlling a first control device for controlling the operation of the peak power generator using a peak power control signal to reduce the peak power by the increased renewable power.

title_en: System for providing sensibility contents based on spatial recognition and context awareness
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a customized content provision system and a method thereof. According to the present invention, provided are a system for providing spatial and situational recognition-based emotional content and a method thereof, which are devised to solve the problems of conventional customized content provision systems and methods, in which a user's emotions and states are recognized and recommendation content is provided solely based on biometric information, such as the user's heart rate, or text, such as messages created by the user, resulting in the limitation that content that does not correspond to the user's actual and frequently changing emotions and situations is provided. To this end, the system and the method are configured so as to: recognize a space in which a user is located and the user's state and situation based on learning results; recommend and provide content suitable for the space and situation; and provide the most appropriate content for a plurality of users even when the plurality of users are present in the same space.

title_en: Cost management method for construction cite and cost management system using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for cost management of a construction site in which a plurality of buildings are constructed at the same time. The method for cost management of a construction site comprises: a BIM output amount recording step of recording an output amount, which is an amount calculated by a BIM, for each process of the plurality of buildings; an execution amount calculation step of calculating an execution amount, which is an amount actually required while constructing the plurality of buildings; a construction error calculation step of calculating a construction error by comparing the output amount with the execution amount; an error occurrence cause analysis step of analyzing an error occurrence cause and an error rate of the BIM from the construction error; and a period-specific material consumption amount prediction step of predicting a material consumption amount of the construction site of the plurality of buildings in a predetermined period unit in consideration of a process progress status and the error rate of the plurality of buildings. Accordingly, the amount of required materials is accurately predicted in accordance with the process of each building of the construction site in which the plurality of buildings are constructed, thereby enabling smooth supply and demand of materials.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging devices and charging methods that provide simple payment services
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an electric vehicle charging apparatus for providing a simple payment service comprises: a vehicle information receiving unit for recognizing a vehicle number through a camera module installed inside or outside the charging apparatus; a charging control unit for checking whether to subscribe to the simple payment service based on the recognized vehicle information, and controlling charging by converting a charging mode according to whether a payment means is registered; and a charging fee payment unit for approving payment for a settled charging fee when the charging of the corresponding vehicle is completed.

title_en: Method and appratus for controlling electric vehicle charging using energy storage system
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a method and an apparatus for controlling charging of an electric vehicle using an energy storage system. In an embodiment, a charger belonging to a first charger set and a charger belonging to a second charger set may be electrically connected to a first ESS and a second ESS, power charged in the first ESS may be preferentially provided to the electric vehicle when the electric vehicle is charged by the charger belonging to the first charger set, and power charged in the second ESS may be preferentially provided to the electric vehicle when the electric vehicle is charged by the charger belonging to the second charger set.

title_en: Method of providing SNS marketing service and a server for performing the method
abstract_en: Provided is a method for providing an SNS marketing service, which comprises: a step of receiving, by a first application, an event registration request including benefit conditions from a terminal of one or more advertiser users; a step of providing, by a second application, one or more flags including a location of a business corresponding to the event registration request and benefit contents based on a terminal location of a celebrity user; a step of providing, by the second application, a benefit condition including the benefit contents of the business selected in response to a flag selection command; a first authentication step of authenticating, by the second application, that a visitor of the business is a celebrity user; a second authentication step of receiving, by the second application, a review authentication request of the celebrity user who is the visitor of the business and receiving, by the first application, a review authentication approval from an advertiser terminal; and a step of deducting, by the second application, coupons or caches registered in an account of the advertiser user. According to the present invention, since the benefit provided by the advertiser to a celebrity is actual goods for sale, rather than the advertising cost in cash, the advertising cost can be reduced compared to paying the agency fee to the advertising agency.

title_en: System for providing platform for recommending eyebrow style
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a platform providing system for eyebrow style recommendation, which comprises: an image capturing unit for capturing a face image of a user including at least a nose portion, an eye portion, and an eyebrow portion of the user; a processor for receiving the face image, obtaining at least one nose feature point, at least one eye feature point, and at least one eyebrow feature point according to the face image, and performing calculation according to the at least one nose feature point, the at least one eye feature point, and the at least one eyebrow feature point to obtain an eyebrow guide block; and a display unit for displaying the face image and the corresponding eyebrow guide block, and guiding the user to makeup according to the eyebrow guide block.

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing solutions for developing brewing recipes
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for providing a solution for developing a brewed recipe. The apparatus for providing a solution for developing a brewed recipe comprises: a calculation unit for calculating a correlation of review information for each recipe from reviews for each question of a feedback questionnaire for a plurality of brewed liquor for each recipe; and a feedback information providing unit for extracting meaningful feedback information for each recipe based on the calculated correlation and providing the meaningful feedback information. The feedback information providing unit generates and provides comparison information with other liquor in the same grade to which the brewed liquor for each recipe belongs, and provides item information and feedback information for each item required for upgrading to different target grades in the same recipe.

title_en: Management method and management system for ship engine parts
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for managing engine parts of a ship. The method for managing engine parts of a ship comprises: a storage step of storing engine driving data in a database unit; an alarm determination step of determining whether an alarm is generated; a use period replacement determination step of determining a use period of the engine parts when the alarm is not generated (NO) and determining replacement of the engine parts; an alarm and weight replacement determination step of determining whether to replace the alarm generating parts when the alarm is generated (YES), assigning a weight to a replacement period of parts correlated with the alarm generating parts, and determining whether to replace the parts; and a display step of displaying a component replacement list. According to the present invention, the replacement period of the engine parts of the ship can be efficiently managed.

title_en: Daily recording system based on keyword and method of operation thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an operating method of a daily recording system operated by at least one processor, which receives a keyword including a plurality of attributes input by a user, extracts the plurality of attributes from the keyword, and then determines a selection category for the keyword among a plurality of preset basic categories. Based on the selection category, text and image for the keyword are generated, and daily records including the text and image are generated.

title_en: Method and device for providing difference-finding game based on augmented reality to provide traveler experience
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a method for providing a false picture search game based on augmented reality for providing a traveler experience, which is performed by a server by the server. The method comprises the steps of: (a) receiving a background image for a travel destination from a user terminal; (b) searching for a travel destination corresponding to the background image, generating a false background image by transforming a partial area of the background image in a preset method, and providing the false background image to the user terminal; and (c) providing cultural content for the travel destination when the user terminal finds all different partial areas from the false background image. The cultural content is information composed of at least one of text, sound, and image related to the travel destination.

title_en: Automatic system for hydroponic management
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for automatically managing hydroponic cultivation and, more specifically, to an automatic hydroponic cultivation management system which monitors a state of a water tank for supplying a culture medium to a gutter for hydroponic cultivation, and directly supplies the culture medium stored in another water tank to an existing water tank or gutter when the culture medium is not smoothly supplied due to a problem such as the water tank or the like, so that the culture medium is automatically supplied, thereby continuously maintaining an environment in which crops can grow.

title_en: Right to indemnity system of autonomous vehicle and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for processing a right to indemnify an autonomous vehicle and a processing method thereof. In order to process a right to indemnify an autonomous vehicle according to a rate of negligence when an autonomous vehicle accident occurs, the rate of recognition of the negligence of the autonomous vehicle is newly defined unlike a general vehicle, and when an autonomous vehicle accident occurs, the right to indemnify each accident is automatically processed by the newly defined rate of recognition of the negligence of the autonomous vehicle to match the autonomous vehicle according to an applicant's request for the right to indemnify the autonomous vehicle, thereby preventing disputes in advance in the era of the autonomous vehicle and minimizing related social costs.

title_en: Automated Cost Estimating System For Video Production
abstract_en: According to the present invention, disclosed is an automatic estimation system for producing an image. According to an embodiment of the present invention, disclosed is an automatic estimation system for producing an image, which comprises: a database storing a plurality of images and a required cost for each item of each image; and a producer terminal connected to the database and providing a reference image among images of the corresponding database to an orderer according to a request item of the orderer, wherein the producer terminal automatically calculates the cost according to the request item of the orderer and provides the cost to the orderer.

title_en: Digital treatment for diet and exercise for people with cardiovascular disease
abstract_en: Disclosed is a server for executing digital therapy software, which receives health information, which is a measured value of one or more of blood pressure and weight of a user every day through an application/web page, receives intake information, which is information on the amount and type of meal of the user, and receives exercise information, which is information on one or more of aerobic exercise amount and muscular exercise amount of the user, and analyzes the health information, the intake information, and the exercise information to predict the possibility of developing cardiovascular disease to the user and output the same on the application/web page.

title_en: Energy management system in industrial complex
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide an energy management system of an industrial complex which can provide an advanced energy management service and has enhanced security. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the energy management system of an industrial complex comprises: a plurality of individual consumers transmitting power data, energy data, and workplace data collected from a corresponding workplace; and a cloud server providing an energy management service analyzing an energy use pattern and a use status of the workplace corresponding to the plurality of individual consumers based on the power data, energy data, and workplace data transmitted from the plurality of individual consumers.

title_en: Corona Detection Thermal Imaging Diagnostic System and Method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a corona detection thermal image diagnosis system (1) and a method thereof. The thermal image diagnosis system (10) for providing a thermal image of a power receiving/distributing facility (100) to a diagnostic analysis device (40) indicating a deterioration state and a corona occurrence state includes a thermal image camera (20) linked to a filter (30) of infrared and ultraviolet rays. Therefore, it is possible to prevent the occurrence of corona, which is a cause of failure of equipment (110) of the power receiving/distributing facility (100), in advance with an ultraviolet filter.

title_en: Apparatus, method and recording medium storing commands for outputting benefit information
abstract_en: The present disclosure proposes an apparatus for displaying benefit information. According to the present disclosure, an apparatus comprises: one or more processors; and one or more memories in which instructions to be executed by the one or more processors are stored. When the instructions are executed, the one or more processors may be configured to obtain order information on an order of a user for purchasing one or more products, determine whether the user is a user who has subscribed to a membership based on user information on the user, perform payment for the order based on the order information according to a determination that the user is a user who has not subscribed to the membership, determine a benefit to be applied to the order when the user subscribes to the membership, and transmit first display information for displaying the benefit information on the benefit to a user terminal of the user after the payment for the order to the user terminal.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing content for personalized rehabilitation training based on cloud server
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method and an apparatus for providing content for cognitive or language rehabilitation training based on a cloud server. The method for providing content for cognitive or language rehabilitation training based on a cloud server comprises the steps of: checking an authority of a specific account when login of the specific account for a platform linked with the cloud server is detected; collecting at least one medical information for the corresponding patient input from at least one connection account linked with a patient account when the specific account is the patient account as a result of the checking; generating state information of the corresponding patient by analyzing the at least one medical information; searching for at least one content based on the state information using an artificial intelligence-based learning model; and generating and providing training information using the searched at least one content.

title_en: System for providing sustainable management consulting services for samll and medium-sized businesses using big data
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing a sustainable management consulting service for a small and medium-sized enterprise using big data, wherein a task to be solved is to realistically evaluate the management state of the small and medium-sized enterprise based on big data, and to provide consulting information regarding environmental, social, governance (ESG) management, sustainable management, and carbon-neutral management of the small and medium-sized enterprise as a countermeasure based on the evaluation result. According to one embodiment, disclosed is the system for providing the sustainable management consulting service for the small and medium-sized enterprise using big data comprising: a small and medium-sized enterprise terminal registering management information regarding the small and medium-sized enterprise and requesting a management consulting service; and a company management consulting server collecting management information from the small and medium-sized enterprise terminal, generating evaluation information according to the management information of small and medium-sized enterprise based on big data regarding a pre-constructed company management, and generating consulting information regarding the small and medium-sized enterprise based on the generated evaluation information.

title_en: Rehabilitation education provision system and method based on education card
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for providing rehabilitation education based on an education card, which support a guardian to diagnose a condition of a child and provide an appropriate rehabilitation education method accordingly.

title_en: Kiosk device and control method for operational control of screen golf practice simulator using internet of things
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, the purpose of the present invention is to provide a method for controlling a kiosk device to control the operation of a screen golf practice simulator using IoT. The object of the present invention is not limited to the above-mentioned object, and other objects not mentioned will be clearly understood from the following description. The present invention relates to a method for controlling a kiosk of a screen golf practice simulator using IoT. The control device identifies the user based on the code information recognized by the kiosk. The control device confirms the reservation history and reservation time. If the reserved time comes, it indicates an announcement, and the control device cancels to lock of door. It turns on the power source of simulator and the control device controls operation.

title_en: System and method for transmitting meter reading mumber images through code scanning
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a meter reading number image transmission system through code scanning comprises: a meter measuring usage; a meter reading terminal possessed by a meter reader, having a meter reading application installed thereon to scan a barcode or qr code displayed on the meter, and photographing and transmitting a meter reading number photo in which the barcode or qr code part and usage are displayed at the same time when an object number and customer information are normally mapped; and a cost calculation server extracting the usage from the meter reading number photo in which the usage transmitted from the meter reading terminal is displayed, and calculating costs by applying a predetermined discount rate or surcharge rate through calculation with previous usage. At the same time as scanning the barcode, a photographed image and customer information corresponding to the barcode are provided to the meter reader through a ui to allow the meter reader to perform additional confirmation by himself, thereby minimizing unnecessary on-site revisit (image shaking, photographing other meters, etc.).

title_en: Traffic signal apparatus having remaining time display function
abstract_en: In a traffic signal device having a signal display unit including green and red indicator lights for indicating a traffic signal and a signal controller for controlling the signal display unit, the indicator light of a signal display unit (10) includes a green indicator light (11) and a red indicator light (13) consisting of a plurality of light-emitting LEDs, and at least one of the green indicator light (11) and the red indicator light (13) has a remaining time display means (30) for notifying a remaining signal time. According to the present invention, the traffic signal device having a remaining time display function has a remaining time display means to notify a remaining time in a display lamp configured to visually notify a proceeding and stopping state, thereby improving implementability.

title_en: Method of identifying ecological corridor spatial range for ecosystem protection planning and implementation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method of identifying ecological corridor spatial range for ecosystem protection planning and implementation, which integrates ecological functional importance evaluation with ecological corridor spatial heterogeneity analysis, and belongs to the field of ecosystem management and territorial spatial planning. The method of identifying ecological corridor spatial range provided by the invention comprises the following steps: firstly, determining the spatial range of ecological sources by ecological functional importance evaluation; then, calculating ecological resistance values by combining a land use type with a nighttime light index; and finally, based on the circuit theory, determining a spatial range of an ecological corridor according to different thresholds of cumulative resistance and the change trends of relevant indexes that reflect landscape heterogeneity. The method solves the problem of identifying ecological corridor spatial range, supports for implementation protection and construction of the ecological corridor, and improves accuracy and rationality of ecosystem management.

title_en: A three-dimensional transportation system for urban travelers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional transportation system for urban travelers, including columns, support arms, a rail system, running vehicles, stations, a power center, a control center and a maintenance center; columns are fixed to the roads or buildings; support arms are fixed to the columns; the rail system is an overhead rail to connect a plurality of stations to form a rail network; the running vehicles are suspended or normally driving on the track; In the rail system, the power center is connected into the rail system to supply power for all electrical equipment in the transportation system; the control center is connected into the rail system, which is core of the transportation system; the maintenance center is connected into the rail system to provide care and maintenance for the running vehicles. The invention can completely replace existing urban manned system, and flexible arrangement of stations can realize point-to-point accurate transportation, greatly improving the efficiency of urban transportation; it has advantages of precise and flexible control, energy saving and environmental friendly, and it has good prospect and promotion value.

title_en: Serialized artificial insemination straws and systems and methods of authentication.
abstract_en: The invention provides serialized artificial insemination straws, as well as systems and methods for authentication of the serialized artificial insemination straws.

title_en: System and method for improving hazardous materials shipment logistics
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention include systems and methods for reducing physical and logistical transportation bottlenecks in the shipment of hazardous materials. The present invention includes a hub 100 which, in embodiments, is operatively connected to one or more of the following: manual data input means, automatic data input means, image capture device(s), data output devices, traffic signals, entry or exit gates, and one or more regulatory databases.

title_en: Blockchain-based service execution method and apparatus, and electronic device
abstract_en: Appearance data of a target entity is collected as appearance data, where the target entity comprises a physical entity capable of accessing, as a member, a blockchain. The appearance data is registered in a distributed database associated with the blockchain as an identity of the target entity. A target transaction initiated by a member node device in the blockchain is received, where the target transaction comprises the appearance data of the target entity that is collected by the member node device and a service event that is related to the target entity and that is detected by the member node device. A smart contract that corresponds to the service event is invoked. Based on the identity indicated by the appearance data of the target entity, a service logic stated in the smart contract is executed.

title_en: Systems and methods for facilitating product pickup by a friend or family member of the ordering customer
abstract_en: In some embodiments, methods and systems are provided that permit a customer to purchase products from a retailer and elect an option for a friend or family member of the customer to pick up the ordered products from the retail facility of the retailer associated with the geographic location of the customer. If the friend or family member of the customer agrees to pick up the products for the customer, and if the customer agrees to have the selected friend or family member of the customer pick up the products for the customer, the friend or family member is allowed to pick up the products at the retail facility associated with the geographic location of the customer. The customer is then allowed to either pick up the products from such a friend or family member or the friend or family member may deliver the products to the customer.

title_en: Method and system for automated audit of construction data using smart contracts and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method and system for automated audit of construction data using smart contracts and artiﬁcial intelligence (AI). The method comprises: acquiring construction data; performing a smart contract-based audit on the construction data; determining whether the construction data complies with predeﬁned construction progress standards; approving construction progress based on the audit result; applying computer Vision algorithms to perform AI-based analysis of construction photos Within the construction data; conducting compliance veriﬁcation on the analyzed data; automatically triggering payment through smart contracts upon veriﬁcation that construction progress meets standards; and storing the construction audit data on a blockchain.

title_en: Dynamic verification method and system for card transactions
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and systems for payment card transactions, where a Card Verification Value (CVV) or Card Verification Code (CVC) is generated dynamically as part of a tokenized session.

title_en: Method and system for controlling access to a temporarily open location
abstract_en: :The present invention relates to a system and a method of controlling access to a temporarily open location, for example a property for sale. In particular the invention relates to a system and method arranged to utilize optical codes, such as a QR-code and location data, such as GPS data and to provide links relating to the QR-code to different sites or functions depending on GPS data and at least one further object related condition. The further condition may for example be a timeframe, a positive identification or a certain security clarification.

title_en: Train set washing management method
abstract_en: The train sets washing management method is implemented by connecting the control system controlling the process of washing and hygienic maintenance of the internal equipment of the train set with the control system of the stable hall washer controlling the process of washing the exterior of the train set.

title_en: Matching system of game nature and buyer’s suitability
abstract_en: A matching system of game nature and buyer's suitability, which includes a word analysis unit, a graphic conversion unit, a storage unit, a test unit and a comparison unit, the game seller can input the game name and related brief through an input module in the word analysis unit, check the corresponding words from the string through the word analysis unit, and then transmit the frequency of the word appearance to the specific word scoring module to produce the game score, and convert it into a game radar map through the graphic conversion unit, the game buyer produces a test radar map corresponding to his/her personality through the test, and compares the game radar map with the test radar map through the comparison unit to analyze whether the particular game is suitable for the buyer, so as to help the buyer to choose the most suitable game.

title_en: Maintenance device for service function includes a customer database, a group database, a comparison module, and a maintenance module
abstract_en: The maintenance device for the service function of the present invention mainly includes a customer database, a group database, a comparison module, and a maintenance module. According to the address group in the group attribute of the group and the contact address or the group to which the customer belongs in the customer attribute of the customer, the comparison module finds out the customer whose conditions meet each other, and uses the maintenance module to proceed the operations of Add, Delete or Modify the available service functions in the available service function list in the group database to determine the relative available service function list for the customer group.

title_en: Verification method and system determines the current operator is not one of himself and herself when the difference between the operation data to be verified and the touch event characteristic data is greater than the preset threshold
abstract_en: A verification system includes a touch unit and a processing unit electrically connected to the touch unit. The touch unit senses an operation history to be verified including a plurality of touch events to be verified. The processing unit determines whether or not the difference between the operation data to be verified and the touch event characteristic data is greater than a preset threshold according to the operation data to be verified and a touch event characteristic data. When the processing unit determines that the difference between the operation data to be verified and the touch event characteristic data is greater than the preset threshold, the processing unit generates a notification indicating that the current operator is not one of himself and herself.

title_en: Indoor space modeling for air purification
abstract_en: A method includes receiving, from one or more sensors, first sensor data associated with an indoor space and generating, based on the first sensor data, a computation fluid dynamic (CFD) model of the indoor space. The method further includes determining, based on the CFD model, configuration data for one or more air purification systems and causing, based on the configuration data, the one or more air purification systems to provide air purification operations in the indoor space.

title_en: System and method for intelligently monitoring waste cleaning in which a camera carries out video recording in each operation process and retrieves an image from the video for recognition to identify if an abnormal situation occurs
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system and a method for intelligently monitoring waste cleaning, comprising a plurality of operation devices and operation processes. Firstly, a transportation device is loaded with wastes to implement a transportation operation and is then moved into a processing station to carry out a processing operation on the wastes, wherein a camera and a sensor for detecting an abnormal situation are arranged in each of the operation devices or on an operation path of each of the operation devices. The camera carries out video recording in each of the operation processes and retrieves an image from the video so recorded for recognition in order to determine if an abnormal situation occurs in each of the operation processes; or retrieval of the image for recognition is triggered by the sensor for detecting an abnormal situation in order to identify if there is really an abnormal situation occurring.

title_en: Lottery redemption reservation system
abstract_en: A lottery redemption reservation system includes a redemption server, a mobile device and a POS. The consumer can use the mobile device to select a physical store to claim the lottery, make a reservation on the redemption server and obtain a reservation number. When the consumer goes to the physical store to claim the lottery, the consumer could provide the reservation number and documents required. After the POS sends the reservation number to the redemption server and receives a confirmation, the lottery is redeemed. In addition, after confirming that the lottery is available for redemption, the redemption server could provide additional discounts in response to the reservation. Therefore, it could enhance the consumer to claim the lottery in a physical store.

title_en: A method for providing item delivery information and apparatus for the same
abstract_en: Provided is a method for providing delivery information of an item, and the method includes obtaining information on an order including information on an item and a delivery location from a terminal of customer, receiving delivery completion information on the item from a delivery person terminal, and transmitting time taken for delivery obtained based on the delivery completion information and a first message identified based on reference delivery time to the terminal of the customer.

title_en: Membership consumption feedback system
abstract_en: The present invention is a membership consumption feedback system, which includes a processing module and a storage module. At least one member account, at least one store account and a platform account are stored in the storage module. The processing module generates a plurality of nodes connected in sequence according to the preset node generation rules to form a pyramid structure. When a member consumes, the processing module converts the member's consumption record into consumption points and saves them back to the member's account. When the consumption points are accumulated to the preset value, it constitutes a member node and fills in the pyramid structure. When the sub-pyramid structure formed by each member node is filled to a specific number of layers, the processing module generates the first system reward and deposits it back to the platform account, and converts it into the corresponding system points. When the accumulation of system points reaches the preset value, the corresponding system nodes are generated and filled in the pyramid structure. Therefore, each member node is bound to generate different numbers of system nodes in the future, which ensures the continuous growth of the pyramid structure and maintain the continuous operation of the present invention.

title_en: Contactless intelligent automatic vending system and method allowing users to remotely operate an intelligent automatic vending machine without touching the screen of the intelligent automatic vending machine throughout the entire process, thereby reducing the risk of viral or bacterial infections
abstract_en: A contactless intelligent automatic vending system which comprises an intelligent automatic vending machine, a client-end mobile device, and a platform server. The intelligent automatic vending machine is coupled to the platform server. A camera scans a two-dimensional barcode to enable the client-end mobile device to be coupled to the platform server. The client-end mobile device opens a general user webpage, selects product information, makes payment and generates purchase information, and the purchase information is transmitted to the intelligent automatic vending machine via the platform server, whereupon the intelligent automatic vending machine dispenses products and opens the door. The client-end mobile device opens an administrator interface, selects management information, and generates management commands, the management commands are transmitted to the intelligent automatic vending machine via the platform server, and the intelligent automatic vending machine executes management tasks. Accordingly, users do not need to touch the screen of the intelligent automatic vending machine throughout the entire process.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing data and non-transitory computer-readable recording medium
abstract_en: A method for providing data in an electronic device is disclosed. Specifically, the method for providing data may comprise the steps of: receiving a data generation-related request from a device; on the basis of the request, identifying a data schema which includes a plurality of data fields and a plurality of value types corresponding to the plurality of data fields; on the basis of the data schema, generating first data which includes a plurality of first values corresponding to the plurality of value types; and providing the first data to the device.

title_en: Customer relationship level change analysis device comprising a database, an analysis module, a calculation module, and a transmission module
abstract_en: The invention provides a customer relationship level change analysis device, comprising a database, an analysis module, a calculation module, and a transmission module. The database is configured to store object location information and object information for multiple objects. The analysis module is configured to receive a user-selected object and obtain an area range where the user-selected object is located based on the object's location information. Based on multiple bidding records within that area range, the device further applies semantic sentiment analysis technology or facial emotion recognition technology to analyze the original relationship level data corresponding to the customer code and detect that the customer is in a special condition and generate a relationship level rating chart. Finally, the transmission module allows a user's device to display the relationship level rating chart.

title_en: Method and system for estimating power consumption and time consumption of electric assisted bicycle
abstract_en: A method and a system for estimating power consumption and time consumption of electric assisted bicycle are provided. The method including the following steps. A start location and a destination location are received. A planned route is generated according to the starting location and the destination location. A riding time consumed by the electric assisted bicycle to travel the planned route is estimated according to route information of the planned route and riding habit information of a rider. A power consumption consumed by the electric assisted bicycle to travel the planned route is estimated according to the riding time, the route information and the riding habit information. The riding time and the power consumption associated with a first riding mode are displayed through a user operation interface.

title_en: Carton recycling apparatus with functionality of bonus redeeming and goods access system including the same
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a carton recycling apparatus with functionality of bonus redeeming, which comprises an accommodation body, a host electronic device, a user interface, a paper material processing device, a goods providing channel, and a digital weighing scale. According to the present invention, a user can decide to start a carton recycling procedure by operating the user interface. Moreover, after a flattened cardboard is fed into the paper material processing device so as to be processed to a wastepaper, a weight value of the wastepaper is measured by the digital weighing scale. As a result, after receiving the weight value from the digital weighing scale, the host electronic device converts the weight value to bonus points. In practical application, user is able to exchange the bonus points for at least one substantial reward (e.g., commodity or digital currency), and can also accumulate the bonus points in a personal bonus point pool. Therefore, this carton recycling apparatus carries out the automation of carton recycling bonus redeeming, thereby enhancing the recycling efficiency and user engagement.

title_en: System and method for priority based management of autonomous vehicle fleet
abstract_en: An automated storage and retrieval system includes a storage array, a plurality of bots, and a controller. The controller is connected to each bot to assign a series of tasks, or goals, to each bot. The controller has a bot route planner that has a multi-agent path finding algorithm resolver that determines, for each bot route effecting at least one task, or goal, occurrence and type of a conflict between bots performing the series of tasks, or goals. From the determination of occurrence and type of conflict, the multi-agent path finding algorithm resolver resolves each conflict free bot route, that determines the bot route respectively for each bot performing the at least one task, or goal, based on bot priority and precedence constraint between route legs describing, at least in part, the respective bot route of a common bot performing the at least one task, or goal.

title_en: Supply chain carbon inventory management system including a supplier database, a project database, a pre-processing device, an invitation device, and a carbon inventory calculation device
abstract_en: A supply chain carbon inventory management system includes a supplier database, a project database, a pre-processing device, an invitation device, and a carbon inventory calculation device. The supplier database stores a plurality of supplier data; the project database stores a master project and a plurality of inventory projects; the pre-processing device selects multiple supplier data from the supplier database to form a plurality of associated supplier data; the invitation device sends an invitation message to the communication accounts of each associated supplier data; after receiving a corresponding reply message, the invitation device sets the corresponding inventory project in the project database as an associated inventory project, and the invitation device associates each associated inventory project with the master project; the carbon inventory calculation device calculates the individual carbon emission amount of each associated inventory project and the total carbon emission amount.

title_en: Method and system for automatically establishing group meeting through context awareness
abstract_en:
The present invention is a method and system for automatically establishing a group conference through context awareness. The system includes a context aware group conference service management server, a database, an application server, and a media server. The system automatically establishes a group meeting according to sensing information of the sensing device or information of the instant information source, so that the members of the group meeting can gather for discussion the event at the first time. The system can actively release 
new sensing information of the sensing device or information of the instant information source in the group meeting, so that members of the group meeting can update the event status in real time.

title_en: Business data course management system and method thereof
abstract_en: A business data course management system and a business data course management method are provided. The electronic device sends a first calling information corresponding to a first application programming interface (API) to a business data process management server. The business data process management server loads a corresponding first extraction rule according to the first API identifier corresponding to the first API, so as to extract a first upstream business data type information, a first upstream business data identifier, a first downstream business data type information and a first downstream business data identifier from the first calling information according to a first extraction rule. The business data process management server creates a first upstream business data record and a first downstream business data record.

title_en: Method for establishing robust prediction model, prediction system and prediction system for alzheimer's disease
abstract_en:
A method for establishing robust prediction model is adapted for solving the problem that the conventional prediction model cannot generate stable and credible results with missing data. The method of the present invention includes the following steps: obtaining pre-established single-modality standard models respectively based on each type of modalities from samples; extracting modality sets each having the same modality types from the samples to establish corresponding multi-modalities standard models; extracting multiple 
combinations of the modality sets from the samples having complete modalities to be training data, wherein the multiple combinations of the modality sets can be classified into single-modality, multi-modalities and complete-modalities; inputting said training data into a to-be-trained prediction model, and modifying the prediction model by said single-modality standard models and said multi-modalities standard models to obtain a well-trained prediction model.

title_en: Maintenance service recommendation method and electronic apparatus thereof and recording media
abstract_en: A maintenance service recommendation method and electronic apparatus thereof are provided. Relevant data of a fault machine is input into a probability graph model through an interactive interface, and a recommended factor is obtained. A search is performed in the knowledge graph to pick up multiple selected categories related to the recommendation factor among multiple variable categories. Based on the importance of each selected category, a hierarchical structure diagram is established and displayed on the interactive interface.

title_en: Support system for improving production efficiency
abstract_en: To output useful indicators for improving the production efficiency of production equipment and support the improvement: the support system 20 for improving production efficiency calculates the cycle time and others based on the detection result of the operating state of the production equipment 10, and displays a graph representing the time sequence change. The cycle time is displayed in a state where the inconsistency can be visually recognized. Also, in the graph, the top and second paragraphs display information indicating the production number, which is the most important variable in production management, and the following two paragraphs (paragraph 4 and 5) display information indicating the operating state of the production equipment connected to the production number. Then, the operating state of the production equipment is displayed between the two. By displaying these indicators in a graph, it is easy to visually recognize how to improve the cycle time, which can effectively support the improvement of production efficiency.

title_en: Method for calculating and analyzing carbon emissions of vehicles
abstract_en:
This invention discloses a method for calculating and analyzing carbon 
emissions of vehicles. A computing device executes the method, which includes the following steps: first, receiving multiple initial Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) location points for a first vehicle; based on a road map; removing at least one abnormal GNSS location point from the initial GNSS location points to create a series of corrected GNSS location points; using these corrected GNSS location points to calculate multiple corrected road segments and multiple corrected speeds; finally, using these multiple corrected speeds to calculate the vehicle's carbon emissions over multiple instances.

title_en: Digital financial cross-industry system
abstract_en: A digital financial cross-industry system, including a cloud human resources system and a bank terminal. The cloud human resources system is configured to provide a salary transfer file of an enterprise; the bank terminal is connected to the cloud human resources system. The cloud human resources system sends the salary transfer file to the bank through an automated process. After the bank terminal converts the salary transfer file and executes a salary transfer process, the bank terminal sends a salary transfer result message to the cloud human resources system.

title_en: Cross-border collection batch refund system
abstract_en: The cross-border collection batch refund system provided by this new creation can execute batch refunds by setting specific time points, so that the refund process can still be carried out during non-business hours. The cross-border payment collection batch refund system not only saves manpower, but also allows buyers to obtain the refund amount in the shortest time to retain flexible cash flow.

title_en: System and method for providing location-based data on a wireless portable device
abstract_en: There is provided a wireless portable device for providing location-based data to a user in a defined geographical area including a plurality of points of interest, the wireless portable device comprising a wireless transmitter, a wireless receiver, and a display. The wireless transmitter can transmit location information to a wireless server over a wireless network. The wireless receiver can receive location-based data relating to a point of interest from the wireless server periodically and automatically, based on the location of the wireless portable device. By optimizing map routes and schedules using the location-based data and user preferences including wish lists, the wireless portable device can provide helpful recommendations via the display, enabling the user to plan an efficient schedule of activities in the defined geographical area optimized by walking distance, queue wait times, booking and arriving at reserved events, and/or by other user preferences.

title_en: Electronic commerce transaction authentication based on a vehicle travel route data
abstract_en: A device and method in a vehicle control unit for providing electronic commerce transaction authentication are provided. Upon receiving an electronic commerce transaction request relating to a transaction source, the vehicle control unit authenticates the transaction source against a vehicle travel route parameter by comparing the source location data with the vehicle travel route parameter. When the source location data compares favorably with the vehicle travel route parameter, an electronic commerce authentication is generated in response to the request, and transmitted.

title_en: Managed notification system
abstract_en: A managed notification system compares image(s) and/or indicia relating to the image(s) and where there is a match selectively provides a notification of the same.

title_en: System and method for tracking product stock in a store shelf
abstract_en: A system and method for tracking and annotating products in a store shelf is disclosed. The method includes receiving a signal feed from a group of sensors including at least one depth sensor, determining an area of interest in the shelf, determining a polygonal representation of at least one product present in the area of interest, and assigning a unique polygonal profile to at least one product, and/or storing the unique profile in a database. Such The unique polygonal profile may include a unique ID obtained from a group of attributes. The unique profile may include at least a unique position and a unique centroid. The group of sensors may further include video cameras, thermal, and chemical sensors.

title_en: Building performance assessment system and method
abstract_en: A virtual data acquisition component generates a building performance model having a plurality of predicted building performance metrics. A physical data acquisition component obtains a plurality of trended building performance metrics. An integrated interface receives the building performance model from the virtual data acquisition component having the plurality of predicted building performance metrics and the plurality of physical building performance metrics from the physical data acquisition component. The integrated interface enables the comparison of the predicted building performance consumption metrics with the trended building performance metrics to identify performance gaps.

title_en: Method for determining an efficiency of resources of a plant for producing beverage containers
abstract_en: A method of determining the resource efficiency of a plant for the production of drinks containers, wherein the plant has at least one resource-consuming part, wherein the part of the plant is operated at least for a time in a first operative state (B 1 ) in which a product is produced and the part of the plant has a first resource consumption (V 1 ) in this operative state (B 1 ), and wherein the part of the plant is operated at least for a time in a second operative state (B 2 ) and has a second resource consumption (V 1 ) in this second operative state (B 2 ), wherein at least one first resource consumption (V 1 ) capable of being allocated to the first operative state (B 1 ) and at least one second resource consumption (V 2 ) capable of being allocated to the second operative state (B 2 ) determined and the resource consumption (V 1 , V 2 ) is allocated to the operative states (B 1 , B 2 ). According to the invention a value characteristic of the resource efficiency of the part of the plant is determined while taking into consideration the first resource consumption (V 1 ) and the second resource consumption (V 2 ).

title_en: Assessment and advice on nutrition and endurance
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a new integrated, holistic approach to empower older adults to enhance their quality of life and independence through a personalized lifestyle and nutrition program. This is achieved by measuring the physical status of the adults with respect to endurance/functionality. In addition, their nutritional status is assessed. Based on those assessments recommendations are provided with respect to particular exercise programs and nutrients that support the functions of the body. These methods can be implemented as a software program and executed on computer systems.

title_en: Methods and systems for integrating virtual content into an immersive virtual reality world based on real-world scenery
abstract_en: An exemplary virtual reality media system assigns a plurality of display parameters to a three-dimensional (“3D”) virtual object that is to be integrated into an immersive virtual reality world. The plurality of display parameters define a time period during which the 3D virtual object is viewable within the world to a user experiencing the world, as well as a location, an orientation, and a size of the 3D virtual object as these appear to the user during the time period. The system integrates the 3D virtual object into the world in accordance with the display parameters and dynamically changes a display parameter during the time period to change the location, orientation, and/or size of the 3D virtual object. The system further integrates content into the world by presenting the content on the 3D virtual object while the display parameter is dynamically changing. Corresponding methods and systems are also disclosed.

title_en: Learning user interface apparatus, computer program product, and method
abstract_en: Provided herein are method, apparatus, and computer program products for facilitating a learning user interface. The interface may be presented as a plurality of dynamic icons representing a plurality of items. The interface may further be facilitated by receiving a profile identifier and by accessing, via a processor, profile data associated with the profile identifier. The interface may be facilitated by determining, via the processor, a visual bias for at least one of the dynamic icons relative to another of the dynamic icons based on the profile data and may be facilitated by applying the visual bias, via the interface, to the at least one of the dynamic icons. Multiple interfaces may be applied to the same or different screens.

title_en: Radio tag reading device and method
abstract_en: A radio tag reading device includes a placement table, an antenna, a reader, a sensor, and a controller. The antenna is configured to communicate with wireless tags within a communication range covering a placement region of the placement table. The reader is configured to output commodity information based on a signal received by the antenna from wireless tags. The sensor is configured to detect a user near the placement region of the placement table. The controller is configured to start a reading operation by activating the reader and causing the antenna to start emitting radio waves upon the sensor detecting the user near the placement region.

title_en: Functional verification process and universal platform for high-volume reverse logistics of CPE devices
abstract_en: A customer premise equipment (CPE) device may be functionally verified using a universal platform to simulate operating conditions of an environment in which the CPE is intended to operate. Functional verification may be performed for an operational use of a CPE device in an environment similar to that used by customers of a service provider. Functional verification may be applied to a variety of devices using a verification platform that can support various types of CPE devices, various models of CPE devices, and various operational configurations used by an operator.

title_en: Video record receipt system and method of use
abstract_en: Methods and systems for authenticated video acquisition and dissemination are disclosed. A temporally continuous video is acquired and sent to a server. Metadata and authentication information is combined with the video. The video, incorporating metadata and authentication information is provided from a first party to a second party by a third party that provides authentication of the video. Embodiments can be used to generate a video receipt for purposes of creating evidence of shipment of a package to an intended recipient.

title_en: Modifying a sound source data based on a sound profile
abstract_en: In embodiments of the present invention improved capabilities are described for a computer-based method for modifying a sound source, including accessing, by an acoustic processing facility including at least one processor, a multi-dimensional sound profile of an acoustic environment, wherein the multi-dimensional sound profile comprises a time-based sound reflection sequence for the acoustic environment; and modifying, by the acoustic processing facility, a sound source data based on the multi-dimensional sound profile to generate a modified sound data.

title_en: Using cloud-based data for industrial automation system training
abstract_en: A cloud-based performance enhancement service captures and collects data relating to interactions of users with industrial automation systems of multiple industrial customers for storage and analysis on a cloud platform. The service employs a performance enhancement component that analyzes the data to facilitate determining correlations between certain user interactions and favorable performance of an industrial automation system, determining user interactions that are less favorable or unsafe, determining alternative actions that a user can take to achieve a same or similar preferred operational result, generating recommendations relating to the alternative actions, determining or designing components or techniques that can automate a preferred user action, determining improved user assignments in connection with the industrial automation system, and/or generating training modules or presentations based on preferred user actions that can be used to train users to more efficiently interact with an industrial automation system to achieve improved system performance.

title_en: Systems and methods generating electronic tokens in response to user location
abstract_en: A system, including: a non-transitory memory; and one or more hardware processors coupled to the non-transitory memory and configured to read instructions from the non-transitory memory to cause the system to perform operations including: determining a first physical location of a user; comparing the first physical location to data indicative of network availability; and in response to comparing the first physical location to data indicative of network availability, generating a first electronic token and a second electronic token for a mobile computing device associated with the user.

title_en: Simultaneous voice and data content driven commercial data platform
abstract_en: Methods and systems are disclosed that facilitate a commercial data platform that enhances the interaction between a dialer and receiver during a voice call by simultaneously delivering and tracking data content that promotes ongoing commerce and interactions between these parties. One such system includes first and second interaction managers on a dialer device and a receiver device that transmit first and second sets of interaction data to a database during a call. A server obtains receiver content data from the database using the receiver identifier, transmits the receiver content data to the dialer device, obtains dialer content data from the database using the dialer identifier, transmits the dialer content data to the receiver device, and stores data from both the first set of ID and the second set of ID in the database in association with both the receiver identifier and the dialer identifier.

title_en: Cross-category item associations using machine learning
abstract_en: A machine learning engine may be used to identify items in a second item category that have a visual appearance similar to the visual appearance of a first item selected from a first item category. Image data and text data associated with a large number of items from different item categories may be processed and used by an association model created by a machine learning engine. The association model may extract item attributes from the image data and text data of the first item. The machine learning engine may determine weights for parameter types, and the weights may calibrate the influence of the respective parameter types on the search results. The association model may be deployed to identify items from different item categories that have a visual appearance similar to the first item. The association model may be updated over time by the machine learning engine as data correlations evolve.

title_en: Methods, systems, and articles of manufacture for fingerprinting signatures and enhanced signature capturing for charge card transactions on mobile communication devices
abstract_en: A method and a system for fingerprinting signatures and enhanced signature capturing for charge card transactions on mobile communication devices identify and transform a signature into a normalized representation such as a bytestream including coordinate data and combine the normalized representation with some transaction information into combined data. The combined data is further transformed into fixed length data stored for further analyses or uses. Upon the receipt of a dispute, the stored representation(s) of the signature and some of the stored transaction information of the transaction in dispute may be transformed into a first fixed length data. The first fixed length data may be further compared with the stored fixed length data obtained at the time of the transaction to resolve the dispute. The representations of signatures of multiple transactions may be used to determine whether these multiple transactions belong to the same category or to different categories.

title_en: Industrial mats having cost effective core structures
abstract_en: An inventory of industrial mats having different core or internal constructions that are not visible because of the inclusion of side, end, upper and lower components which hide the core or internal construction from view, wherein each mat has an electronic device that indicates what is present in the hidden core or internal construction of the mat, with the electronic device including a processor, storage, and wireless communications circuitry that is configured to transmit identification, location, usage or physical property information of the mats over a wireless telecommunications network. Also, a method for providing an identification of mat properties or usage for an inventory of mats by viewing the information stored on the electronic device or by retrieving over a wireless telecommunications network identification, location, usage or physical property information of the mats from the storage of the electronic device.

title_en: Personal food database
abstract_en: A Personal Food Database (PFD) that resides on a consumer's mobile device is presented. The PFD maintains an inventory that keeps track of amount of available food items. The mobile device operating the PFD has sensors for measuring the activities or biometric data of the user. The PFD uses the sensor data to assess the nutrition need of the user and to recommend recipes accordingly.

title_en: Information processing device, method for controlling information processing device, program, and web server
abstract_en: Display control means ( 52 ) of an information processing device ( 1 ) displays, on a screen, respective input forms of plurality of disclosure items relating to a health condition of a policyholder. Receiving means ( 58 ) receives input of the disclosure statement in each of the input forms by the user. First input control means ( 62 ) inputs the disclosure statement into the input form in which the user has input the disclosure statement. In a case where the user inputs the disclosure statement into one of the input forms of the plurality of disclosure items, second input control means ( 66 ) inputs, into the input form, the disclosure statement that is input into the input form of another disclosure item associated with the disclosure item.

title_en: Contact management suppression rules system
abstract_en: A contact management suppression rules system is described. A centralized enterprise database stores suppression rules of an enterprise, where each suppression rule includes logic to prevent communication of marketing content to contacts satisfying parameters of the respective suppression rule.
