The prediction model construction unit 213 performs logistics regression analysis using as factors the feature values extracted from the blood of the subject infected person, and using as the objective variable whether or not the subject infected person developed severe disease as a result of infection with the virus, and thereby constructs a prediction model for making a prediction relating to development of severe disease. The prediction execution unit 214 makes a prediction relating to development of severe disease in a prediction-subject infected person on the basis of the prediction model and feature values extracted from the blood of the prediction-subject infected person.

title_en: Management and optimization of freight delivery vehicle fleets
abstract_en: A method for optimizing operation of a fleet of vehicles includes providing an optimization network including a plurality of nodes and a plurality of connections therebetween. The nodes define all potential destinations in the network for freight delivery or pickup. The connections define all potential sequences of nodes traversable over the network. The method determines a pre-optimization simulation matrix including a plurality of sets of energy expenditures for traversing respective ones of each of the connections. Each of the plurality of sets of energy expenditures accounts for permutations of a plurality of different vehicle powertrains present in a fleet of vehicles. The method performs an optimization using the pre-calculated simulation matrix, fleet information indicating locations and energy states of a plurality of vehicles in the vehicle fleet, mission information indicating a pickup or delivery destination for a plurality of items of freight, and a fleet optimization objective.

title_en: Stowage assistance device, stowage assistance system, stowage assistance method, and recording medium
abstract_en: A stowage assistance device (106) comprises a situation analysis unit (113) that obtains the difference between a stowage plan for stowing a plurality of loads (102) into a stowage space (101) and a stowage situation that is the situation of the stowage space (101) actually stowed with some or all of the plurality of loads (102), and an output control unit (119) that causes a first output unit (107) to output the difference.

title_en: Method for creating a three-dimensional soil model for a site
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for creating a three-dimensional soil model for a site, more particularly a building site, wherein data regarding a layout plan of the site is acquired, data regarding a plurality of exploratory drilling operations, which have been carried out at the site at specific exploration points and for each of which a layer structure of the soil, with individual layers and their layer thickness, has been determined, is acquired, the individual exploration points are recorded in the acquired layout plan of the site, and wherein, by means of a computer unit, the individual layers are analyzed for each exploratory drill hole and are each assigned to a common soil layer, a layer thickness profile of the individual soil layers within the site is interpolated in accordance with the location of the individual exploratory drill holes relative to each other and thus the three-dimensional soil model for the site is created by the computer unit.

title_en: System and method for feature management
abstract_en: A system for controlling the features of a device, and in particular, controlling the features based on a variety of triggers, both internal and external, such as, for example, but not limited to, safety, user actions, and economics. With respect to internal triggers, the system can enable the device to shut down its features when certain types of behaviors or environmental parameters are detected. With respect to external triggers, the system can enable the device features to be controlled externally based on pre-established or dynamically-determined parameters. With respect to safety triggers, the system can determine if a device is currently in a specific state, and if so, determine what controls are appropriate in the specific state.

title_en: Chemical product passport for emission data
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for generating a chemical product passport, the apparatus comprising: one or more computing nodes; and one or more computer-readable media having thereon computer-executable instructions that are structured such that, when executed by the one or more computing nodes, cause the apparatus to perform the following steps: receiving a request to provide a decentral identifier associated with emission data and a data owner, in response to the request, generating the chemical product passport including the decentral identifier and data related to the emission data; providing the chemical product passport for access by a data consuming service controlled by a data providing service associated with the data owner.

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: This information processing device 4 has: an image acquisition unit 431 for acquiring an analysis subject image representing a space to be analyzed; an image analysis unit 432 for analyzing the analysis subject image and thereby identifying a texture and a hue in association with each of a plurality of regions in the analysis subject image; a storage unit 42 for storing first analysis data in which a position in a reference space image, a combination of a hue and a texture at said position, and a viewer emotion about the reference space image are associated with each other; an emotion identification unit 433 for identifying a viewing emotion of the viewer of the analysis subject space on the basis of the position of each identified region, a position in the reference space image for which the degree of correlation with the combination of the hue and texture corresponding to each region is greater than or equal to a threshold value, and the combination of the hue and texture at said position, these data being derived from the first analysis data; and an output unit 434 for outputting the viewing emotion associated with the analysis subject image.

title_en: User authentication and data encryption systems and methods
abstract_en: Systems and methods for authenticating a request to initiate an electronic transaction and systems and encrypting data relating to executed electronic transactions are provided. Such systems and methods include receiving an electronic request signal, retrieving verified data associated with a user account, extracting verification data, and comparing the verification data against the verified data to determine whether the electronic request signal is authentic or fraudulent. Furthermore, when the electronic request signal is determined as authentic, such systems and methods include executing the secured electronic transaction, converting a digital image into a digital text string, cryptographically hashing the digital text string to output a secret key, digitally encrypting transaction data using the secret key, and registering the transaction data as encrypted with one or more databases.

title_en: Accident emergency processing method, apparatus and system for hazardous chemical substance vehicle
abstract_en: Provided are an accident emergency processing method, apparatus and system for a hazardous chemical substance vehicle based on the Internet of Things. The method comprises: obtaining video monitoring data from a video monitoring device at a preset location; determining, on the basis of the video monitoring data, whether a hazardous chemical substance vehicle to which an accident occurs exists; and if the hazardous chemical substance vehicle to which the accident occurs exists, starting scene linkage processing, wherein the scene linkage processing comprises controlling an accident processing device to execute an accident processing action and notification processing, the scene linkage processing is based on a pre-configured scene linkage rule, and the scene linkage rule defines a total triggering condition for starting the scene linkage processing for the video monitoring device, and defines the modes that the accident processing device executes the accident processing action and the notification processing.

title_en: System and method of displaying and on-demand minting of nfts across multiple blockchains
abstract_en: An apparatus has a processor and a network interface circuit connected to the processor to provide connectivity to networked machines. A memory is connected to the processor. The memory stores instructions executed by the processor to establish a first network connection to a first proprietary block chain to obtain first non-fungible token (NFT) attributes associated with a first public key. A second network connection is created to a second proprietary block chain to obtain second NFT attributes associated with a second public key. A third network connection with a client machine supplies the first NFT attributes and the second NFT attributes.

title_en: System and method for managing supply chain and retail finance
abstract_en: A system for managing supply chain finance is disclosed. A finance request receiving module (110) receives one or more invoices corresponding to one or more supplied goods or one or more provided services from a supplier, receives a request for process of raising funds from a buyer. A financier seeking module (120) identifies a financier for financing the funds to the buyer. A supply chain financing module (130) generates a perpetual contract between the buyer and the financier for financing the funds, enables the financier in financing the funds with one or more currencies to the buyer for paying the supplier for each of the one or more supplied goods or the one or more provided services, enable the buyer to repay the funds to the financier with interest using the one or more currencies based on the perpetual contract generated for managing the supply chain finance.

title_en: Digital smart label for shipper with data logger
abstract_en: A system for monitoring shipping of a shipping container. The system includes one or more sensors. The one or more sensors are positioned on or within the shipping container. The one or more sensors are configured to measure or detect at least one parameter associated with the shipping container. The system further includes an electronic device. The electronic device is in communication with the one or more sensors. The electronic device is configured to receive, store, and transmit the at least one parameter from the one or more sensors. The system further includes a web portal. The web portal is in communication with the electronic device. The web portal is configured to receive the at least one parameter from the electronic device and display the at least one parameter on a user interface.

title_en: Online auction method, device, apparatus, and medium
abstract_en: Provided in the embodiments of the present disclosure are an online auction method, a device, an apparatus, and a medium. In the method, encryption information from a verification device for an auction event is received at a participation device for the auction event. The participation device transmits to a management device for the auction event verification information associated with a given price for the auction event. The participation device receives a first signature and a verification information set from the management device. The verification information set at least comprises an association relationship between the participation device and the verification information. The first signature is generated by the verification device in respect of the verification information set. The participation device verifies an auction process of the auction event on the basis of the first signature, the verification information set and the encryption information. In this way, the participation device can verify the auction process on the basis of the signature that is determined by the verification device on the basis of the verification information set, thus avoiding various cheating behaviors in the auction process.

title_en: Systems and methods of providing rewards to users based on activities performed by the users using applications
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method of providing rewards to users based on activities performed by the users using applications. Moreover, the method may include receiving, using a communication device, a request from a user device associated with a user. Accordingly, the method may include analyzing, using the processing device, the one or more activity data using one or more machine learning models. Furthermore, the method may include determining, using the processing device, a number of points for the one or more activities based on the sweat equity of the one or more activities using one or more criteria. Moreover, the method may include retrieving, using a storage device, a user account associated with the user. Accordingly, the method may include updating, using the processing device, the user account based on the determining of the number of points.

title_en: System and method for authoring high quality renderings and generating manufacturing output of custom products
abstract_en: In some embodiments, a method for authoring high quality renderings and generating manufacturing output of custom products comprises: upon receiving a test physical product manufactured for an interactive digital design: determining whether one or more differences between the test physical product and the interactive digital design exceed one or more thresholds; in response to determining that one or more differences between the test physical product and the interactive digital design exceed one or more thresholds: automatically generating markup definition data indicating the differences; transmitting the markup definition data to a manufacturing entity to cause the manufacturing entity to manufacture a physical product that corresponds to the interactive digital design; upon receiving the physical product from the manufacturing entity: taking a plurality of photographs depicting the physical product; generating, based on the plurality of photographs, a composite image file that captures one or more components of the physical product.

title_en: Sale assistance device, sale assistance method, and recording medium
abstract_en: The present invention enables a commuter ticket to be purchased more rapidly with respect to an application for the purchase of the commuter ticket while omitting visual confirmation for a student commuter certificate by a train operating company. According to the present invention, a registration unit (11) registers the content of the application for the commuter ticket, an issuance unit (12) issues application identification information for identifying the application, an acquisition unit (13) acquires an approval from a commuting destination pertaining to the content of the application, and a purchase reception unit (14) receives the purchase of the commuter ticket by using application identification information, after the approval is obtained from the commuting destination.

title_en: Information processing system, information processing device, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: [Problem] To enable streamlining of the delivery of parcels. [Solution] This information processing system comprises a communication unit for notifying a service provider terminal, used by a candidate service provider, of recruitment of a service provider who will be responsible for at least one of: temporary reception, outside a mobile body used for mixed transportation of passenger and freight, of parcels being delivered by the mobile body; transfer of parcels to a delivery person or to a service provider in the mobile body; loading of parcels into the mobile body; transfer of parcels in the mobile body; temporary reception of parcels in the mobile body; or temporary reception of parcels from the delivery person or the service provider in the mobile body.

title_en: Financial transaction user interface
abstract_en: A user device is configured to display a user interface including a price chart and a plurality of user interface elements. Each user interface element is associated with an investment product of a plurality of the investment products. Each user interface element of the plurality of user interface elements includes a bar having a gradient and at least one tick mark positioned on the bar. The user interface enables a user to select a first user interface element of the plurality of user interface elements, position the first user interface element on the price chart, and position the at least one tick mark. A server computer receives an identifier of the first user interface, a first position of the first user interface element on a horizontal axis of the price chart, wherein the horizontal axis represents time, and constructs a corresponding proposed financial transaction.

title_en: Method for determining mining value of alaskite-type uranium ore
abstract_en: The present application relates to a method for analyzing a geological body by means of physical and chemical properties of the geological body, and in particular, to a method for determining the mining value of alaskite-type uranium ore. The method comprises: determining the average uranium grade value, uranium occurrence state, average uranium recovery rate and uranium stripping ratio of alaskite-type uranium ore in an exploration area, wherein the average uranium recovery rate is a ratio between the recovery amount of uranium after hydrometallurgy and the total amount of uranium, and the uranium stripping ratio is a ratio between the amount of rock needing to be stripped in the mining process and the amount of uranium ore; and determining the mining value of the alaskite-type uranium ore in the exploration area, wherein the mining value of the alaskite-type uranium ore is determined on the basis of one or more of the average uranium grade value, the uranium occurrence state, the average uranium recovery rate, and the uranium stripping ratio. The method provided by embodiments of the present application can accurately and intuitively evaluate the mining value of alaskite-type uranium ore, so that the waste of time, cost, energy, and the like caused by blind mining can be avoided.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based fraud and risk management methods and systems for acquirers
abstract_en: Methods and server systems for computing fraud risk scores for various merchants associated with an acquirer described herein. The method performed by a server system includes accessing merchant-related transaction data including merchant-related transaction indicators associated with a merchant from a transaction database. Method includes generating a merchant-related transaction features based on the merchant-related indicators. Method includes generating via risk prediction models, for a payment transaction with the merchant, merchant health and compliance risk scores, merchant terminal risk scores, merchant chargeback risk scores, and merchant activity risk scores based on the merchant-related transaction features. Method includes facilitating transmission of a notification message to an acquirer server associated with the merchant. The notification message includes the merchant health and compliance risk scores, the merchant terminal risk scores, the merchant chargeback risk scores, and the merchant activity risk scores.

title_en: Battery manufacturing method and battery manufacturing system
abstract_en: A battery manufacturing method according to the present disclosure may comprise the steps of: generating a virtual ID corresponding to a battery cell; shifting the virtual ID according to the progress of a step for the battery cell; matching and storing the shifted virtual ID and step data generated for the battery cell; extracting a cell ID for the battery cell; and matching the step data matched with the virtual ID corresponding to the cell ID with the cell ID and transmitting the matched step data to a higher control system.

title_en: Equipment control system and equipment control method
abstract_en: An equipment control system (10) comprises: an output unit (45) that outputs display screen information to an operation terminal (30), said display screen information being for displaying, on the operation terminal (30), a selection screen in which an object relating to equipment (70) positioned within a facility (90) has been superimposed on a floor map image of the interior of the facility (90); a control unit (46) that controls the equipment (70) on the basis of a control request transmitted by the operation terminal (30) in accordance with a selection operation of the object by a user; and a storage unit (43) that stores authority information for setting the control authority of the user with regard to the equipment (70). In the selection screen, the object is superimposed in accordance with the control authority of the user as set according to the authority information.

title_en: Dynamic mobile geofencing
abstract_en: A method includes receiving location data for a movable object, the location data specifying geographic locations of the movable object over time; defining dimensions of a virtual boundary in real-world physical space based on the geographic locations of the movable object over time and configuration parameters for the virtual boundary; sending data indicative of the virtual boundary in real-world physical space to trigger delivery of content to mobile computing devices within the virtual boundary; and actively adjusting the configuration parameters for the virtual boundary in response to a number of the mobile computing devices within a region while continuing to receive the location data for the movable object, define the dimensions of the virtual boundary, and send the virtual boundary to trigger delivery of content.

title_en: Augmented reality social media platform, systems, and methods related thereto
abstract_en: Augmented reality social media platforms and methods of managing the same in which a real-world defined area is virtually mapped to include a plurality of leasable virtual subdivisions each corresponding to a real-world subdivision of the real-world defined area. A platform may assign a virtual leasehold corresponding to a virtual subdivision of a plurality of leasable virtual subdivisions to a user of the platform. In one aspect the ability to assign a virtual leasehold to a user is based on the user's affiliation or non-affiliation with a real -world organization controlling the corresponding real-world defined area. In another aspect a virtual leasehold may be reassigned to a different virtual subdivision and/or a real-world offering associated with a virtual leasehold may be reallocated to a different virtual leasehold.

title_en: Web service system, management server, and method for providing web service
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to provide a web service system and a method for providing a web service with which advertising effects can be measured efficiently without the use of third-party cookies, and with which a load on an advertiser server is also small.　A web service system 100 comprises a proxy server 3 which allows a user terminal 101 that has accessed an advertiser web page on the basis of a guidance URL guiding the user terminal to the advertiser web page to access the advertiser web page, and a management server 1 for providing an input form by means of an API to the user terminal 101 accessing the advertiser web page via the proxy server 3, wherein the domain of the addresses of the advertiser web page and the input form are the same.

title_en: Terminal, control method for terminal, storage medium, and system
abstract_en: Provided is a terminal that contributes to making it possible to accurately determine whether a service provider will provide a service to a user. The terminal comprises a calculation means and a transmission means. The calculation means calculates a reliability score that indicates the reliability of a user and is for determining whether a service provider will provide a service to the user. The transmission means transmits the calculated reliability score to a business operator terminal of the service provider.

title_en: Agent system, data processing device, data processing method, and data processing program
abstract_en: This agent system includes: an emotion determination unit that determines an emotion of a user or an emotion of an agent; and an interaction processing unit that outputs content of an utterance of the agent for interacting with the user in a mode that accords with the emotion determined by the emotion determination unit.

title_en: Information processing system, method, and program
abstract_en: Provided are an information processing system, a method, and a program that facilitate exhibition of an NFT. An information processing system 100 displays an image, receives a selection operation performed by a user on the displayed image, creates a token for the image corresponding to the selection operation, stores the token in a distributed data storage system 5, and exhibits the stored token in a predetermined marketplace. In addition, the information processing system 100 automatically performs, without receiving an operation from the user, the processing for creating a token for the image corresponding to the selection operation, storing the token in the distributed data storage system 5, and exhibiting the token in the predetermined marketplace.

title_en: System and method for automated updating of object related content in response to determining that a relevant event has occurred
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system (100), the system comprising a set (110) of electronic display devices (ESL), each electronic display device of the set being configured to display content relating to a particular object associated with the respective electronic display device; a server (120), the server being connected to a communication network and configured to receive event relevant data from an external data source; a controller (130) configured to communicate with the server via the communication network and to communicate with the set of electronic display devices; and an event determining unit (140) configured to determine, based on the event relevant data, that an event has occurred that is relevant to one or more objects associated with one or more respective electronic display devices of the set, wherein the controller is configured to communicate a respective update message to each of said one or more respective electronic display devices of the set, and wherein the electronic display devices of the set are configured to display updated content in response to receiving said update message from the controller. Furthermore, a method is disclosed.

title_en: Process to automatically select products on sale on online sites
abstract_en: The invention concerns a process for automatically selecting products for sale on online sites, where the aforementioned process includes: - a selection phase of products belonging to a product category of interest; - a refinement phase of this selection of products, where this refinement phase includes the choice only of products with positive reviews; - a phase of presentation on the screen of the products chosen in the previous phase of perfecting the product selection.

title_en: Label management system, label management method, and program
abstract_en: This label management system enables product management using labels, the system comprising a code printing device, an information reading device, and a database. On the printing surface of a label, label information used for individually identifying the label is printed using an electronic watermark. The code printing device prints, onto the printing surface of the label, a code of product information used for individually identifying a product to which the label is attached. For each label, the information reading device reads the label information and the product information from the electronic watermark and the code that are printed on the printing surface of the label. For each label, the label information and the product information read by the information reading device are stored in the database in a state of being associated with each other.

title_en: Server device, server device control method, and storage medium
abstract_en: Provided is a server device that improves convenience for users who desire delivery of luggage, and allows business operators that provide luggage delivery services to operate services without anxiety. This server device is provided with an acquisition means and a destination control means. The acquisition means acquires, from an entrant who checked luggage with an airline company at the time of departure, a credential landing permit issued to the entrant as verifiable credentials (VCs), and entrant information. The entrant information involves information about at least the entrant's name and place of stay among the information entered by the entrant into an online service that allows the entrant to submit information necessary for immigration procedures in advance. If an electronic signature attached to the credential landing permit is successfully verified, the destination control means generates luggage destination information on the basis of the information about the name and the place of stay included in the entrant information. The luggage destination information is information for sending the entrant's luggage that has been checked with the airline company to the entrant's place of stay. The destination control means outputs the generated luggage destination information.

title_en: Enabling presentation of credentials
abstract_en: It is provided a method being performed by an auxiliary device (2) configured to communicate with a host device (1) comprising a first secure element, the auxiliary device (2) comprising a bistable display (63), a second secure element (66) and a user input device (69). The method comprises: receiving (42) credential data for a plurality of credentials over an interface (10) being implemented over a physical connection between the host device (1) and the auxiliary device (2); storing (43) the credential data in the second secure element (66); releasing (44) a mechanical connection with the host device (1); receiving (45) user input via the at least one user input device (69) to select one of the plurality of credentials; and presenting (46) a representation of the selected one of the plurality of credentials, based on the credential data, on the bistable display (63).

title_en: Intelligent operation maintenance method and system for fingerprint access control
abstract_en: Provided in the present invention are an intelligent operation maintenance method and system for fingerprint access control. The intelligent operation maintenance method for fingerprint access control comprises: collecting in real time data information of fingerprint recognition of fingerprint access control within each operation maintenance monitoring time period; at an ending moment of each operation maintenance monitoring time period, using the data information of fingerprint recognition to acquire an operation quality evaluation factor corresponding to the operation maintenance monitoring time period; when the operation quality evaluation factor corresponding to the current operation maintenance monitoring time period is lower than a preset factor threshold, using the operation quality evaluation factor corresponding to each operation maintenance monitoring time period to acquire the current operation quality evaluation parameter of the fingerprint access control; and when the operation quality evaluation parameter is lower than a preset evaluation parameter threshold, sending to a worker terminal a prompt for performing operation maintenance on the fingerprint access control. The system comprises modules corresponding to the steps of the method.

title_en: Server device, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: A server device (110), which is a server device in an aircraft (1), is provided with: a processing unit (111); and a non-transitory first recording medium (113) storing data. The processing unit (111) receives an inquiry from a terminal device in the aircraft (1), and uses the data recorded in the first recording medium (113) to determine whether or not it is possible to answer the inquiry. When it is determined that it is not possible to answer the inquiry, the processing unit (111) accesses a resource located outside the server device (110), generates answer information by using the resource, and transmits the answer information to the terminal device, thereby performing the abovementioned answer.

title_en: Power prediction method and system for wind farm, and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to a power prediction method and system for a wind farm, and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: setting a wind farm turbine site in a wind farm to collect the wind speed of an area where a wind turbine is located, and to collect other meteorological data in the wind farm; on the basis of collected data, reconstructing airflow distribution within the range of the wind farm; on the basis of the reconstructed airflow distribution within the range of the wind farm, predicting future airflow distribution of the wind farm; selecting a turbine site point, and selecting from the predicted future airflow distribution a predicted wind speed value corresponding to the turbine site point; and converting the predicted wind speed value corresponding to the turbine site point into a power prediction value. Compared with the prior art, the present application can effectively predict the power change of wind farms within 1-15 minutes, so as to bring significant safety and economic benefits to countries and regions having weaker power grids as well as to scenarios where wind farms directly supply power to load sides, and can effectively position and track wind flow propagation motion trajectories without accumulating a large amount of historical data.

title_en: Measure generation system, measure generation method, and measure generation program
abstract_en: The present invention provides a measure generation system, a measure generation method and a measure generation program capable of creating a measure in response to a problem. This measure generation system includes: a business information reception means for receiving business information expressing a target business situation; an objective reception means for receiving, as character information, an objective for the target business which is set by a user; a measure information generation means for searching for relevant information in a prescribed network on the basis of a comparison between the business information and the objective, and generating measure information according to the search results; and an output means for outputting the measure information to a user.

title_en: Cost per scent system and method
abstract_en: An interactive content monetization system and method allows the various sense hotspots in the interactive content to be monetized by the interactive system and the content provider.

title_en: Method of management for course, and electronic device performing method
abstract_en: A method of management for a course, and an electronic device performing the method are disclosed. The electronic device according to various embodiments comprises at least one processor and a memory, which is electrically connected to the at least one processor and stores an instructions executed by the at least one processor, wherein, when the instructions are executed, the at least one processor enables the electronic device to receive location information about a user in an area from at least one terminal, and generate, on the basis of the location information, a heat map related to lawn damage applied to the area.

title_en: System, presentation method, and presentation program
abstract_en: An agent system according to the present disclosure comprises a control unit that performs a presentation corresponding to a specified target on the basis of information pertaining to the sensed state of a user. The control unit performs a plurality of presentations corresponding to the specified target in ascending order of fluctuations in the state of the user.

title_en: Method, recording medium, and device for providing content page
abstract_en: A method for providing a content page and a device therefor are provided. A method, according to one embodiment of the present disclosure, which is executed by an electronic device, may comprise the steps of: identifying a room pool including one or more content rooms providing a group viewing function of a content service, wherein the content room is a virtual space set so that a plurality of users using the content service can simultaneously view content published in the content service; determining a target content room to be displayed on a user terminal of a target user from the room pool on the basis of a preference of the target user; determining a display position of the target content room; and transmitting a content page generated so as to include the target content room on the basis of the display position to the user terminal of the target user.

title_en: Traceability management server, traceability management method, and non-transitory computer-readable recording medium
abstract_en: This traceability management server is equipped with a traceability data generating unit that associates a plurality of second unit amount IDs that identify each of a plurality of second unit amount credits obtained by subdividing each of a plurality of first unit amount credits into second unit amounts smaller than the first unit amounts with each of a plurality of first unit amount IDs that identify each first unit amount credit, and associates a creation source ID that identifies a creation source that has created an individual credit with some of the second unit amount IDs that identify each of some of the second unit amount credits having a total amount equal to each individual credit, to thereby generate traceability data in which a set of a plurality of second unit amount IDs and one or more creation source IDs are associated with each of one or more first unit amount IDs.

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: This information processing device comprises a management unit that manages information indicating that an authorized subject having authority to make an assessment before execution of countermeasures based on an assessment rule has approved the assessment rule. The management unit outputs the information to a data storage unit that stores records relating to countermeasures determined on the basis of the assessment rule.

title_en: Server for providing information about charging zone, and operating method thereof
abstract_en: According to an embodiment disclosed in the present document, a server may comprise: an acquisition unit for acquiring use reference information from chargers of a charging zone and at least some objects to be charged corresponding to the chargers; a determination unit for determining, on the basis of the use reference information, whether the objects to be charged use the charging zone; and a generation unit for generating charging zone state information on the basis of the result of determining whether the charging zone is used.

title_en: Multi-purpose pick carts for use at product storage facilities
abstract_en: A cart, for transporting a plurality of items at a product storage facility, is provided. The cart includes: a frame; wheels mounted to and supporting the frame; at least one support member mounted to the frame and configured to support ambient-temperature items thereon; a refrigerator compartment mounted to at least one of the frame and the at least one support member and configured to store chilled items therein; and a freezer compartment mounted to at least one of the frame and the at least one support member and configured to store frozen items therein.

title_en: Distributed storage and authentication system
abstract_en: An authorized computing device receives indications of data actions taken end users on a user platform. Each data action is selected from a group comprising an edit action, a create action, or a delete action. The authorized computing device collects the data actions to form a batch of data actions. The batch of data actions include data actions that have occurred within a range of time. The authorized computing device generates a Merkle tree corresponding to the batch of data actions. Each leaf of the Merkle tree is associated with a respective data action in the batch of data actions. The authorized computing device published a root node of the Merkle tree to a smart contract associated with the user platform on a blockchain. The root node of the Merkle tree is used to verify individual data actions in the batch of data actions.

title_en: Factory area abnormal data monitoring system based on integrated energy operation and maintenance
abstract_en: A factory area abnormal data monitoring system based on integrated energy operation and maintenance. The present invention relates to the technical field of abnormality monitoring. Disclosed is a factory area abnormal data monitoring system based on integrated energy operation and maintenance, the system comprising a plurality of production devices. The monitoring system further comprises a monitoring module, a maintenance information module, and an analysis module, wherein the monitoring module monitors each production device, and acquires and stores actual production data; the maintenance information module stores maintenance data of each production device; and then the analysis module performs analysis on the basis of the actual production data and the maintenance data, so as to determine whether the production device is faulty, and when a determination result indicates that the production device is faulty, the analysis module acquires a fault state index of each faulty production device according to a preset rule, and performs maintenance sorting on the faulty device on the basis of the fault state index, such that when a plurality of production devices are abnormal, an administrator can perform maintenance on the basis of fault evaluation values and according to a maintenance sequence, and preferentially arrange for the repair of a production device having smaller faults.

title_en: A system for producing clean hydrogen and clean hydrogen derived products using water electrolysis and time correlated renewable power
abstract_en: A system for producing clean hydrogen and clean hydrogen derived products using water electrolysis and time correlated renewable power whereby the operation of the electrolysis is optimized for using time correlated renewable power amongst other factors. The system includes a hydrogen production unit that uses an electrolyzer to produce hydrogen from water and electricity, where the electricity is delivered via a connection to the electrical grid and/or behind the meter renewables and whereby a control unit manages the production of hydrogen based on the attributes of the renewable power, including time correlation and other factors. The hydrogen produced from time correlated renewables may be used directly to decarbonize industrial, transportation, or other applications or the hydrogen may be used to produce hydrogen derived products such as ammonia, methanol, transportation fuels (such as sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), diesel, gasoline), LPG, chemicals, or other low carbon products that use hydrogen as an input for the production process.

title_en: E-commerce systems including cross-selling and e-commerce for social media
abstract_en: An e-commerce system and associated methods are provided to facilitate the cross-selling of products and services across virtual and physical stores, as well as through social media platforms. The system typically includes a store manager that allows a store owner to manage the characteristics of an e-commerce store, and a machine learning system trained to identify combinations of products that are likely to sell well together. A recommendation engine, including a store parser, inventory analysis logic, and recommendation logic, utilizes the machine learning system to generate recommendations for additional products to add to the e-commerce store based on a set of products available from external e-commerce stores and the store's current inventory. An optional product browser enables the store owner to review and select products from the generated recommendations. Methods for managing an e-commerce store and adding products to a social media feed are also disclosed, leveraging the machine learning system to enhance sales and customer engagement by recommending products based on store characteristics, social media content and customer interactions.

title_en: Personalized productivity assistant system
abstract_en: A Productivity Assistant System (PAS) is described that uses specially-trained ML models (e.g., artificial neural networks (ANNs)) to predict a next action to be performed for a sequence of interactions made by a user with one or more applications or services. The predicted action is customized to that user or to a group of users to which the user belongs. Techniques are described for training and using one or more such machine learning models.

title_en: Customer service system with parallel artificial intelligence and augmented reality
abstract_en: In example implementations, a method for executing an AI assistant to generate a solution to an issue for a customer service request is provided. The method, executed by a processor, includes receiving a customer service request from a customer, placing the customer service request in a queue, activating an artificial intelligence (AI) assistant while the customer service request is in the queue to collect information associated with the customer and an issue with a product purchased from the enterprise by the customer, executing the AI assistant to generate a solution to the issue, providing the solution to the issue generated by the AI assistant to the customer while the customer service request is in the queue, and routing the customer service request based on whether the solution solved the issue.

title_en: Module comprising antenna and RF element, and base station including same
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to: a communication technique for converging an IoT technology with a 5G communication system for supporting a higher data transfer rate beyond a 4G system; and a system therefor. The present disclosure can be applied to intelligent services (for example, a smart home, a smart building, a smart city, a smart car or connected car, health care, digital education, retail business, security and safety-related service, etc.) on the basis of a 5G communication technology and an IoT-related technology. An antenna module according to the present invention may comprise: a first substrate layer comprising at least one laminated substrate; an antenna coupled to the top surface of the first substrate layer; a second substrate layer coupled at the top surface thereof to the bottom surface of the first substrate layer and comprising at least one laminated substrate; and a radio frequency (RF) element coupled to the bottom surface of the second substrate layer.

title_en: Device for sequencing
abstract_en: Example devices include a cis well associated with a cis electrode, a trans well associated with a trans electrode, and a field effect transistor (FET) positioned between the cis well and the trans well. Examples of the field effect transistor (FET) include a fluidic system defined therein. The fluidic system includes a first cavity facing the cis well, a second cavity fluidically connected to the trans well, and a through via extending through the field effect transistor from the first cavity. A first nanoscale opening fluidically connects the cis well and the first cavity, the first nanoscale opening having an inner diameter. A second nanoscale opening fluidically connects the through via and the second cavity, the second nanoscale opening having an inner diameter. The second nanoscale opening inner diameter is larger than the first nanoscale opening inner diameter.

title_en: A method for forming a film of a perovskit-like material
abstract_en:
To improve the quality of semiconductor films, to reduce the culling of 
finished products, the parameters of which do not meet the established 
requirements in the method of forming a semiconductor film of a 
perovskite-like material, a layer of a perovskite-like material or a 
precursor of a perovskite-like material of the predefined thickness is 
deposited on the substrate, followed by a halogen layer until 
liquefaction of the layer, then the halogen is gradually removed from 
the substrate until it is completely removed, ensuring the gradual 
crystallization of the perovskite-like material on a substrate to form 
perovskite-like material grains larger than perovskite-like material 
grains of the original film.

title_en: Solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The present application relates to the technical field of photovoltaics. Provided are a solar cell and a photovoltaic module. The solar cell comprises a silicon substrate and a passivation and anti-reflection layer located on the silicon substrate, wherein a textured structure is provided on a surface of the silicon substrate, and the textured structure comprises a plurality of pyramid-like structures; each pyramid-like structure comprises a conical surface and a conical top, the conical surface of each pyramid-like structure comprises a first conical sub-surface, which is far away from the conical top, and a second conical sub-surface, and in the conical surface of each pyramid-like structure, the first conical sub-surface and the second conical sub-surface have different surface morphologies; and the passivation and anti-reflection layer comprises a first part located on the first conical sub-surface and a second part located on the second conical sub-surface, and in the passivation and anti-reflection layer, the thickness of the first part is greater than the thickness of the second part in the same direction close to the conical top. The present application can ensure that an excellent passivation effect is achieved at each position, and reduces waste, increases the absorption of light, and has a good light-trapping effect, thereby increasing a short-circuit current and improving the photoelectric conversion efficiency.

title_en: Pillars as stops for precise chip-to-chip separation
abstract_en: A stacked device including a first substrate that includes a quantum information processing device, a second substrate bonded to the first substrate, and multiple bump bonds and at least one pillar between the first substrate and the second substrate. Each bump bond of the multiple bump bonds provides an electrical connection between the first substrate and the second substrate. At least one pillar defines a separation distance between a first surface of the first substrate and a first surface of the second substrate. A cross-sectional area of each pillar is greater than a cross-sectional area of each bump bond of the multiple bump bonds, where the cross-sectional area of each pillar and of each bump bond is defined along a plane parallel to the first surface of the first substrate or to the first surface of the second substrate.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing a voltage
abstract_en: A method for generating a voltage waveform (VS1(t), VF1(t)) comprises:- providing an optical signal (CLB1), which comprises one or more sequences of optical pulses (OPAT1,OPAT2), - distributing the optical pulses (OPAT1) via optical waveguides (CWG1,CWG2) to a plurality of optical-to-electrical converter units (OEU1, OEU2),- using the optical-to-electrical converter units (OEU1, OEU2) to convert the optical pulses (OPAT1,OPAT2) into electric driving current pulses (EPAT1), - generating voltage pulses (V1(t),V2(t)) by driving Josephson junctions (JJ1) with the electric driving current pulses (EPAT1).

title_en: Composite substrate, preparation method thereof and epitaxial wafer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite substrate, which comprises a silicon substrate layer and a sapphire substrate layer for growing an epitaxial layer; the sapphire substrate layer is bonded to the silicon substrate layer. The composite substrate is formed by integrating the sapphire substrate layer and the silicon substrate layer by adopting a bonding process, and can be used for growing a high-quality epitaxial layer (such as a high-quality gallium nitride layer) on the sapphire substrate layer, so that an electric device with excellent performance can be manufactured, and meanwhile, the silicon substrate layer of the composite substrate can meet the requirements of a large-size main stream production line and is compatible with the existing silicon substrate process; thereby effectively reducing the cost of the power device. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the composite substrate and an epitaxial wafer.

title_en: Organic light emitting diode display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic light emitting diode display device. The organic light emitting diode display device includes a substrate, a pixel structure, and a wiring pattern. The substrate includes a plurality of pixel regions each having a sub-pixel region and a transparent region. The pixel structure is disposed in a sub-pixel region on the substrate. The wiring pattern is disposed in the transparent region and the sub-pixel region on the substrate, and is electrically connected to the pixel structure. The wiring pattern extends in a first direction from the transparent region to the sub-pixel region, and has at least one opening in the transparent region.

title_en: Evaluation method and method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: The present invention easily evaluates the feedback capacitance of a semiconductor element. Provided is an evaluation method for evaluating a feedback capacitance of a semiconductor element, the evaluation method including: a characteristic obtaining step of obtaining a 1 st characteristic relating to the feedback capacitance and a 2 nd characteristic relating to the feedback capacitance; and an evaluation phase for evaluating the feedback capacitance based on the 1 st characteristic and the 2 nd characteristic. The 1 st characteristic may be a characteristic corresponding to a withstand voltage of the semiconductor element, and the 2 nd characteristic may be an on-resistance of the semiconductor element. In the evaluation phase, the feedback capacitance may be evaluated based on a ratio of the 1 st characteristic and the 2 nd characteristic.

title_en: Method for producing semiconductor wafers for multifunctional products
abstract_en: Aspects of the present disclosure provide a method for semiconductor wafer fabrication. The method includes using a subset of lower level masks in a set of masks to form a plurality of modular units of a lower level circuit structure on a semiconductor wafer. The set of masks includes a subset of the lower level masks and includes at least a first subset of the upper level masks and a second subset of the upper level masks. A first subset of the upper level mask defines intra-cell interconnects. A second subset of the upper level mask defines both intra-cell and inter-cell interconnects. The method also includes selecting at least one of the first subset of upper level masks and the second subset of upper level masks based on a combined requirement of a final Integrated Circuit (IC) product and using the selected subset of upper level masks to form upper level structures on the semiconductor wafer.

title_en: Methods and structures for forming and improving solder joint thickness and flatness control features for solar cells
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for connecting a plurality of solar cells and an improved interconnect. The method comprises the following steps: aligning an interconnect to a plurality of solar cells having pads, wherein the interconnect has a body and protrusions extending therefrom, and wherein each of the protrusions has a downward recess such that the protrusion is positioned over the pad in the middle of a solar cell; and pinning the interconnect on a working surface by pressing a pressing pin against the body of the interconnect such that a lower surface of the interconnect protrusion remains parallel to an upper surface of the pad and the recess of each of the protrusions flatly contacts the pad. The method may also include a cantilevered tab extending downwardly from the body to provide a controlled spring force between the tab lower surface and the pad upper surface.

title_en: Power semiconductor module comprising a switching device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power semiconductor module including a switching device. The power semiconductor module comprises a switching device having a substrate, a power semiconductor component and a connection device, wherein the connection device has a first main surface and a second main surface, which face the substrate, and a conductive foil, wherein the second main surface faces away from the substrate, wherein the switching device is internally connected to a suitable circuit system by means of the connection device, wherein the pressure device has a pressure body and a pressure element protruding from the pressure body in the direction of the power semiconductor component, wherein the pressure element presses onto a portion of the second main surface of the connection device and is arranged above a surface of the power semiconductor component facing away from the substrate, aligned in the normal direction of the substrate, wherein the pressure element is formed by an elastic housing in the interior of which a phase change material is arranged.

title_en: Semiconductor package
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor package, comprising: a first semiconductor chip including a through silicon via in the first semiconductor chip and a first trench portion in an upper portion of the first semiconductor chip; a second semiconductor chip on an upper surface of the first semiconductor chip and electrically connected to the first semiconductor chip via a through silicon via of the first semiconductor chip; and an insulating bonding layer between the first semiconductor chip and the second semiconductor chip. The insulating bonding layer fills the first trench portion.

title_en: Gallium nitride monolithic integration power converter on sapphire
abstract_en: A half-bridge circuit, comprising: a sapphire substrate; a gallium nitride upper switch on the sapphire substrate; a gallium nitride lower switch on the sapphire substrate and coupled to the gallium nitride upper switch; a first conductor coupled to the upper switch; a second conductor coupled to the lower switch; and a capacitor. A portion of the first conductor and a portion of the second conductor lie on a plane that is perpendicular to and separated by a height from the upper switch and the lower switch; the capacitor is connected between the portion of the first conductor and the portion of the second conductor.

title_en: Photosensitive pixel structure with improved light absorption and photosensitive implant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a light sensitive pixel structure (10) comprising a substrate (15) having a front surface and a back surface, wherein at least one photodiode (12, 12') is arranged on one of the surfaces of the substrate (15). A first material layer (30) is at least partially disposed on the rear surface of the substrate (15), wherein the first material layer (30) comprises a reflective layer so as to enhance reflectivity at the rear surface of the substrate. Furthermore, the invention relates to an array (1) and an implant comprising such a light sensitive pixel structure (10), and to a method of producing a pixel structure (10).

title_en: Silicon wafer cleaning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon wafer cleaning method which comprises the steps of front cleaning, texturing, post cleaning, acid washing, cleaning and drying. According to the invention, the mixed solution of hydrogen peroxide, ammonia water and deionized water is added before acid washing, so that metal ions of the silicon wafer can be removed more effectively, organic cost and particles on the surface of the silicon wafer can be cleaned, and the surface contamination of the silicon wafer is reduced (the cleaning mode removes the particles on the surface of the silicon wafer through alkaline oxidation, and can oxidize and remove organic matters and metal contamination on the surface), so that the silicon wafer is cleaned more cleanly, and the conversion efficiency of 0.03-0.05% of the cell is improved.

title_en: Display apparatus
abstract_en: There is provided a display device including: a substrate having a curved region between a first region and a second region; an inorganic insulating layer disposed on the substrate, the inorganic insulating layer having an opening or a trench corresponding to the bending region; a wiring unit extending to the second region through the bending region, the wiring unit being disposed on the inorganic insulating layer and having at least a portion thereof overlapped with the opening or the trench; and an organic material layer between the inorganic insulating layer and the wiring unit, the organic material layer being configured to fill the opening or the trench, wherein the wiring unit includes a first wiring and a second wiring adjacent to each other, and a width of the opening or the trench overlapping the first wiring is different from a width of the opening or the trench overlapping the second wiring.

title_en: Manufacturing method for improving encapsulation positioning precision of two-piece type frame
abstract_en: A manufacturing method for improving packaging positioning accuracy of two-piece type frames comprises the following steps of a, positioning a lower frame (15), b, coating a proper amount of soldering paste on a carrying platform of the lower frame (15), c, attaching a chip to the lower frame (15), d, coating a proper amount of soldering paste on a carrying platform of an upper frame (14), e, covering the upper frame (14) on the lower frame (15), f, performing high-temperature welding on the upper frame and the lower frame, g, encapsulating with resin, h, cutting ribs and forming. In the resin encapsulation step, the upper and lower positioning holes are not equal in diameter, so that further expansion of dislocation between the frame and the encapsulation mould is avoided, the positioning precision between the frame and the encapsulation mould in the resin encapsulation step is effectively improved, damage to the frame caused by the mould in the encapsulation step is effectively avoided, high-precision product appearance control is realized, and the problem that the left and right lengths of pins of a product are inconsistent due to large positioning deviation in the rib cutting and forming step is avoided.

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides a substrate processing apparatus capable of controlling uniformity among surfaces. A substrate processing apparatus according to one embodiment includes: an inner tube for accommodating a plurality of substrates; an outer tube surrounding the inner tube; a movable wall provided to be movable inside the inner tube or between the inner tube and the outer tube; a gas supply member configured to supply a process gas to the substrate; and an exhaust member configured to exhaust the process gas supplied to the substrate, wherein a 1 st opening is formed in a side wall of the inner tube, and a 2 nd opening is formed in the movable wall, and the exhaust member exhausts the process gas supplied to the substrate through the 1 st opening and the 2 nd opening.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a plurality of semiconductor chips
abstract_en: The present invention provides a semiconductor device, which is provided with a plurality of stacked semiconductor chips (11) and a control part (12), wherein each semiconductor chip (11) is provided with: a plurality of signal processing units (17, 18) that can be connected to each other; a plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15) that can be connected to each other; a connection state changing unit (13) that can change the connection state between the plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15) in accordance with an instruction from the control unit (12); and a plurality of non-contact communication units (16) connected to the plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15), respectively, wherein each non-contact communication unit (16) of each semiconductor chip (11) is capable of performing non-contact communication with the non-contact communication unit (16) of any one or more other semiconductor chips (11) in the stacking direction, and wherein the connection state changing unit (13) of each semiconductor chip (11) changes the connection state between the plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15) in accordance with an instruction from the control unit (12), thereby changing the connection state between the plurality of signal processing units (17, 18).

title_en: Carrier for a device, device and method for manufacturing a carrier or a device
abstract_en: A carrier (10) and an optoelectronic component (100) having a carrier (10) are proposed, wherein the carrier (10) has a molding (5), at least one via (41, 42) and a plurality of reinforcing fibers (52), wherein the molding (5) is formed from an electrically insulating molding material (53), the via (41, 42) is formed from an electrically conductive material, and the reinforcing fibers (52) bring about a mechanical connection between the molding (5) and the via (41, 42) by: the reinforcing fibers (52) are each arranged locally in the molded body (5) and locally in the through-openings (41, 42). Furthermore, a method for producing a carrier or a component having such a carrier is proposed.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: A trench (16) is formed on the first main surface side of the silicon carbide semiconductor substrate, an n-type silicon carbide epitaxial growth layer (2) is deposited on the first main surface side of the silicon carbide semiconductor substrate, and an n-type high concentration region (5) is provided on the surface of the n-type silicon carbide epitaxial growth layer. In addition, a first p-type base region (3) and a second p-type base region are selectively provided on the surface of the n-type silicon carbide epitaxial growth layer (2) + Base region (4), second p + The base region (4) is formed at the bottom of the trench (16). In addition, the depth of the n-type high concentration region (5) is deeper than the first p-type base region (3) and the second p-type base region + The depth of the type base region (4) is deep. Thus, the electric field strength of the gate insulating film at the bottom of the trench can be relaxed by a simple method, and the on-resistance can be reduced while the withstand voltage of the active portion is ensured.

title_en: Buffer table for unloading printing machine
abstract_en: The invention aims to solve the technical problem of providing a buffer table for unloading a printing machine, which can improve the production continuity of the printing machine, improve the production efficiency and reduce the production cost. The automatic feeding and discharging device comprises a frame (3) positioned at the front end of a feeding and discharging machine (2) of a printing machine (1), wherein a cover plate (4) is arranged at the top of the frame (3), and two exhaust openings (5) are formed in the cover plate (4); four sides of the upper part of the frame (3) are provided with baffle plates (6), wherein the baffle plates (6) positioned on the front side and the rear side are respectively provided with a feed inlet (7) and a discharge outlet (8), the feed inlet (7) corresponds to the discharge end of the printing machine (1), and the discharge outlet (8) corresponds to the feed end of the blanking machine (2); a driving mechanism for driving the silicon wafer storage rack (9) to slide up and down is arranged on the frame (3) below the silicon wafer storage rack (9); the inner side of the baffle plate (6) provided with the feed inlet (7) is provided with a receiving and feeding mechanism for receiving and sending out silicon wafers.

title_en: Organic light emitting display
abstract_en: An organic light emitting display having a mirror function is disclosed. The light blocking reflection layer formed in all regions except the light emitting region provided with the light emitting device formed therein prevents light from entering the channel region of the active layer and reflects external light when the light emitting device is not operated, so that the organic light emitting display can stably implement a mirror function.

title_en: Ultra-high modulus and etch selectivity boron-carbon hard mask film
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate generally to integrated circuit fabrication. More specifically, embodiments described herein provide techniques for depositing boron-carbon films on substrates. In one embodiment, a method of processing a substrate is provided. The method includes flowing a hydrocarbon-containing gas mixture to a processing volume having a processing chamber within which a substrate is positioned, wherein the substrate is heated to a substrate temperature of about 400 ℃ to about 700 ℃; flowing a boron-containing gas mixture to a processing volume; and generating an RF plasma within the processing volume to deposit a boron-carbon film on the heated substrate, wherein the boron-carbon film has a modulus of elasticity of about 200GPa to about 400GPa and a stress of about-100 MPa to about 100 MPa.

title_en: Wide-frequency spectrum optical sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a wide spectrum optical sensor. The invention discloses an optical sensor, which comprises a semiconductor substrate; a first light absorption region formed in the semiconductor substrate, the first light absorption region configured to absorb photons in a first wavelength range and generate photo-carriers from the absorbed photons; a second light absorption region formed on the first light absorption region, the second light absorption region configured to absorb photons in a second wavelength range and to generate photo-carriers from the absorbed photons; and a sensor control signal coupled to the second light absorption region, the sensor control signal configured to provide at least a first control level and a second control level.

title_en: Method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method of manufacturing a semiconductor device, the method comprising: providing a semiconductor substrate, wherein the semiconductor substrate comprises an NMOS region and a PMOS region, gate structures are formed on the NMOS region and the PMOS region, and a gate hard mask layer is formed at the top of each gate structure; forming a first gap wall layer covering the grid structure, wherein the first gap wall layer is provided with an opening exposing the grid hard mask layer; forming a second gap wall layer covering the grid hard mask layer and the first gap wall layer; etching the second gap wall layer and the first gap wall layer in the PMOS area to form a gap wall structure on the side wall of the gate structure in the PMOS area; forming embedded germanium-silicon structures in the semiconductor substrate on two sides of the grid structure of the PMOS region; and removing the second gap wall layer and the grid hard mask layer. According to the method provided by the invention, the photoetching and etching processes of the first spacer layer in the NMOS area can be omitted.

title_en: Resin composition, sheet-shaped molded article thereof, light-emitting device using same, and method for producing same
abstract_en: A resin composition containing at least the following components (A) to (C) and having excellent heat resistance and adhesiveness at the time of adhesion, and a sheet-like molded product thereof can be provided. (A) A reactive silicone resin in which 90% or more of organic groups bonded to silicon atoms are methyl groups; (B) a curing catalyst; (C) and a non-reactive silicone resin in which 90% or more of the organic groups bonded to silicon atoms are methyl groups.

title_en: Chamber wall heating for millisecond anneal systems
abstract_en: Systems and methods for reducing contamination on a mirror disposed on a chamber wall in a millisecond anneal system are provided. In one example embodiment, the mirror may be heated by one or more of the following: (1) heating a fluid in a closed fluid system to adjust the temperature of the mirror; (2) a cartridge electric heater or heater strip attached to the mirror; and/or (3) using lighting in the room.

title_en: Light emitting device
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide a light-emitting device capable of effectively suppressing cracks in a cladding member or the like. The light emitting device includes: a substrate having a first pad and a second pad on an upper surface thereof; a first light emitting element mounted as a flip chip on the first pad; a second light emitting element mounted as a flip chip on the second pad; and a light-reflective coating member that coats a side surface of the first light-emitting element, a side surface of the second light-emitting element, and an upper surface of the substrate, wherein a recess is provided in the coating member between the first light-emitting element and the second light-emitting element, and a bottom surface of the recess is disposed in the substrate.

title_en: Super junction device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super junction device, wherein a protective ring oxide film exposes a charge flowing area, completely covers a transition area and completely or mostly covers a terminal area, and the protective ring oxide film is arranged to realize the complete injection of a JFET area and a source area, so that the JFET area can be overlapped with each P-type well and the doping concentration of the surface of the corresponding P-type well is reduced, thereby increasing the whole doping concentration of the P-type well under the condition of maintaining the threshold voltage of the device unchanged and improving the avalanche current tolerance of the device. The invention also discloses a manufacturing method of the super junction device. The invention can improve the dosage of P-type trap implantation and keep the threshold voltage of the device unchanged, thereby improving the avalanche tolerance of the charge flowing region and the transition region, and improving the performance of the device; the number of times of photoetching process can be reduced, the performance and reliability of the device can be maintained, the manufacturing cost can be reduced, and the production period can be shortened.

title_en: Method for manufacturing semiconductor chip
abstract_en: A semiconductor chip is obtained by laminating a plurality of semiconductor chips each having a substrate, a conductive portion formed on the substrate, and a micro-bump formed on the conductive portion. The semiconductor device is provided with a heating step of flowing a reducing gas into a space in which the semiconductor chip is arranged in an inert atmosphere and heating the semiconductor chip at a temperature equal to or higher than the melting point of the micro-bumps, wherein in the heating step, a pressure-applying member is placed on the micro-bumps.

title_en: Printed circuit board and electronic component package including the same
abstract_en: Embodiments provide a printed circuit board and an electronic component package including the same, the printed circuit board including: a data line layer; a ground layer disposed on the data line layer; a power line layer disposed on the ground layer; and insulating layers respectively disposed between the data line layer and the ground layer and between the ground layer and the power line layer, wherein the ground layer includes a common ground portion and a chassis ground portion electrically insulated from the common ground portion.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method of forming the same
abstract_en: A semiconductor device and a method of forming the same, wherein the method comprises: providing a semiconductor substrate; forming a fin structure on the surface of the semiconductor substrate, wherein the method for forming the fin structure comprises the following steps: forming a first fin part on the surface of a semiconductor substrate, wherein the first fin part comprises a penetration-preventing area, and the penetration-preventing area is positioned in the bottom area of a fin part structure; an insulating layer is formed in at least a portion of the anti-punch through region. The method improves the performance of the semiconductor device.

title_en: LED wafer and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an LED wafer, which comprises a sapphire substrate, a buffer layer arranged on the surface of the sapphire substrate, an undoped GaN layer arranged on the buffer layer, an N-type GaN layer arranged on the undoped GaN layer, an active layer arranged on the N-type GaN layer, an electron blocking layer arranged on the active layer, a P-type GaN layer arranged on the electron blocking layer and a heat conducting layer arranged on the back of the sapphire substrate, wherein the heat conducting layer is made of AlN, siC, si, DLC, gaN, inN or graphene, and the tolerance temperature of the heat conducting layer is 2000 ℃. Correspondingly, the invention further provides a manufacturing method of the LED wafer. According to the invention, the heat conduction layer is formed on the back surface of the sapphire substrate, so that the sapphire substrate is heated uniformly, and the epitaxial quality is improved.

title_en: Voltage suppressor and preparation method thereof
