abstract_en: The invention discloses a voltage suppressor, which comprises: the epitaxial wafer comprises a substrate of a first conductivity type, a first epitaxial layer of the first conductivity type formed on the substrate, a second epitaxial layer of the second conductivity type formed on the first epitaxial layer, an implantation region of the second conductivity type extending downwards into the first epitaxial layer from the upper surface of the first epitaxial layer, a dielectric layer formed on the upper surface of the second epitaxial layer, two first insulating layers penetrating through the second epitaxial layer downwards from the upper surface of the second epitaxial layer and connected with the implantation region, a first buried layer of the first conductivity type and a second buried layer of the first conductivity type arranged between the two first insulating layers. The preparation method of the voltage suppressor is also disclosed. The bidirectional protection can be carried out, the device area is small, and the cost is low.

title_en: Semiconductor device module
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a semiconductor device module, which comprises: a semiconductor device having an upper surface electrode and a lower surface electrode; a substrate bonded to a lower surface electrode of the semiconductor device; a heat sink on which the substrate is mounted; a lead electrode through which a main current of the semiconductor device flows; an insulating case configured to surround the substrate; and a holder which is provided in a beam shape in the insulating case and holds the lead electrode, one end of the lead electrode is soldered to the upper surface electrode of the semiconductor device, and the other end side is inserted into the wall surface of the insulating case, and the holder is engaged with one end of the lead electrode so as to restrict the movement of the lead electrode.

title_en: Display substrate box aligning device and display substrate box aligning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a display substrate box aligning device and a display substrate box aligning system, and belongs to the technical field of display. The display substrate aligning device of the present invention includes: a first carrying unit including a plurality of first support columns for supporting a first substrate; the first adjusting unit is used for adjusting the first supporting columns according to the curvature of the first substrate so that supporting surfaces formed by the first supporting columns are matched with the first substrate; the second bearing unit is arranged opposite to the first bearing unit and is used for bearing a second substrate to be aligned with the first substrate; and the control unit is used for controlling the second bearing unit and the first supporting column to generate relative motion so as to enable the first substrate and the second substrate to be aligned with each other.

title_en: Short-distance communication high-speed photodiode chip and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-distance communication high-speed photodiode chip and a manufacturing method thereof, and the technical scheme of the invention adopts an undoped GaAs substrate, and an epitaxial functional layer which is lattice matched with the undoped GaAs substrate is formed on the undoped GaAs substrate, so that a photodiode chip with the receiving rate of 10Gbps can receive 850nm optical signals within a range of less than 1 km, and the photodiode chip with the receiving rate of 10Gbps can receive 850nm optical signals within a range of less than 1 km.

title_en: Fingerprint sensor and forming method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fingerprint sensor and a forming method thereof, wherein the forming method comprises the following steps: providing a substrate, wherein the substrate comprises a plurality of pixel areas; forming a sensing medium structure on the substrate pixel region, wherein the sensing medium structure is provided with a sensing connection structure; forming electrode plates on the surfaces of the sensing medium structure and the sensing connection structure; bulging the electrode plate to form a plurality of bulges on the surface of the electrode plate; and forming an insulating medium structure on the electrode plate after the bulging treatment. In the working process of the fingerprint sensor, a finger is in contact with the insulating medium structure, and the finger, the insulating medium structure and the electrode plate form a capacitor. The area of the surface of the electrode plate can be increased through the protrusions, so that the capacitance of the capacitor is increased, and the sensitivity of the fingerprint sensor can be increased.

title_en: Organic EL panel control device, light source device, organic EL panel control method, program, and recording medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an organic EL panel control device, a light source device, an organic EL panel control method, a program, and a recording medium. The present invention aims to provide an organic EL panel control apparatus, a light source apparatus, and an organic EL panel control method capable of suppressing fluctuation (variation) in the color temperature of white light of an organic EL panel to be controlled. This organic EL panel control device is characterized by having luminance control means that controls the luminance of organic EL elements other than the organic EL element serving as a reference, which is the luminance of the organic EL element having the shortest luminance lifetime, so that the color temperature of white light formed by additive color mixing of the emission colors of a plurality of organic EL elements of different emission colors in the organic EL panel to be controlled becomes the same as a preset color temperature.

title_en: Hybrid photovoltaic cell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel hybrid photovoltaic cell and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: forming a plurality of first grooves and second grooves which are arranged in parallel and are arranged at intervals on the upper surface and the lower surface of an N-type silicon wafer, wherein the first grooves are partially overlapped with the corresponding second grooves in the vertical direction; forming a silicon nanowire array on the upper surface of the N-type silicon wafer, the bottom surface and the side surface of the first groove; forming an N-type heavily-doped phosphorus diffusion region in each second groove on the lower surface of the N-type silicon wafer; forming a compact P3HT layer, a composite conductive layer and a front gate electrode on the upper surface of the N-type silicon wafer; and preparing a back electrode on the lower surface of the N-type silicon wafer.

title_en: Composition for LED light conversion
abstract_en: Systems and methods for providing multiple light channels to form a blended white light output that utilizes a receptor luminophoric medium to modify light provided by a light emitting diode. The predetermined blend of luminescent materials within the luminophoric medium provides a predetermined spectral power distribution in the white light output.

title_en: Method for manufacturing semiconductor device and image sensor device
abstract_en: Embodiments of the invention provide a method of fabricating a semiconductor device and an image sensor device. The method comprises the following steps: forming a first trench in the first photoresist layer using a first photomask having a first pattern to expose a first surface of the substrate; introducing ions into the exposed first surface via the first trench to form a first isolation region in the substrate; removing the first photoresist layer; forming a second trench in the second photoresist layer using a second photomask having a second pattern to expose a second surface of the substrate, the second pattern being diagonally offset by half the mask pitch with respect to the first pattern; introducing ions into the exposed second surface through the second trench to form a second isolation region in the substrate, the first isolation region and the second isolation region being alternately disposed in the substrate and defining a pixel region between the first isolation region and the second isolation region; and removing the second photoresist layer.

title_en: Cutting tool supply device
abstract_en: Provided is a cutting tool supply device capable of sufficiently storing a replaceable cutting tool and appropriately supplying the cutting tool to a cutting device having a tool replacement unit. The cutting tool supply device includes: a cutting tool storage box storing a plurality of cutting tools; a conveying unit for conveying the cutting tool out of the cutting tool storage box and conveying the cutting tool to the cutting device; a delivery unit that delivers the cutting tool conveyed by the conveyance unit to a tool replacement unit of the cutting device; and a control unit. The control unit appropriately selects the cutting tool required by the cutting device and conveys the cutting tool to the cutting device through the conveying unit.

title_en: Substrate supporting device
abstract_en: A substrate support apparatus (300) for cleaning a backside of a substrate (107) is disclosed. The substrate support apparatus (300) includes a hollow shaft (319) and a rotating shaft (303). The rotating shaft (303) is disposed in the hollow shaft (319), a space is provided between an outer wall of the rotating shaft (303) and an inner wall of the hollow shaft (319), and a wall (322) and a groove (324) are provided on the outer wall of the rotating shaft (303) to prevent particles in the space from entering a gas groove (325) formed on the hollow shaft (319) and supplying a gas to a front surface of the substrate (107), thereby preventing the particles from contaminating the front surface of the substrate (107), and improving the quality of the semiconductor device.

title_en: Electroluminescent display device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an electroluminescent display device and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides an electroluminescent display device, which utilizes a composition material P-type Bi of a functional rod 2 Te 3 The Seebeck effect absorbs and utilizes the heat of the TFT layer and converts the heat into electric energy, thereby effectively reducing the heat of the TFT layer, reducing the aging of circuits and organic materials and prolonging the service life of the electroluminescent display device; on the other hand, the P-type Bi2Te3 material of the functional rod has a work function of 5.3eV, the HOMO level of the electroluminescent layer material is 5-6eV, and the P-type Bi is used as the constituent material of the functional rod under the driving of the thermoelectric force 2 Te 3 The majority carriers (holes) in the electroluminescent layer are injected into the electroluminescent layer, so that the carrier concentration in the electroluminescent layer is improved, and the luminous brightness of the electroluminescent display device can be further improved.

title_en: LED wafer with vertical structure and stripping method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an LED wafer with a vertical structure, which comprises a sapphire substrate; the light-emitting structure is arranged on the sapphire substrate and further comprises a channel groove, wherein the channel groove is etched to the first semiconductor layer, and the width of the channel groove is 10-100 mu m; an insulating layer disposed on the sidewall of the trench; the first metal layer is arranged in the channel groove and is connected with the first semiconductor layer; a second metal layer disposed on the first metal layer; a third metal layer disposed on the second metal layer and the current spreading layer; and a solder layer disposed on the silicon substrate, wherein the solder layer is co-formed with the third metal layer to form an integral body for connecting the silicon substrate to the light emitting structure. Correspondingly, the invention also provides a stripping method. According to the LED wafer with the vertical structure, the yield of the peeled substrate is improved and the production cost is reduced through the mutual matching of the channel groove, the first metal layer and the second metal layer.

title_en: Automatic source production line of scribbling of silicon chip
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic silicon wafer source coating production line which comprises a boron coating device, a first drying furnace, a phosphorus coating device, a second drying furnace and a powder spraying unit, wherein a first transfer manipulator is arranged between the boron coating device and the first drying furnace, between the first drying furnace and the phosphorus coating device, between the phosphorus coating device and the second drying furnace and between the second drying furnace and the powder spraying unit, and a silicon wafer overturning mechanism is arranged at one end of the downstream of the first drying furnace. The automatic silicon wafer source coating production line is high in automation degree, a plurality of processes of the silicon wafer source coating are automatically carried out, a large number of special personnel are not required to be equipped for manual operation, the error rate is low, the coating efficiency is high, the coating is uniform, and the product qualification rate is high.

title_en: Flexible gate tube device based on hafnium-titanium-oxygen composite film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible gate tube device based on a hafnium-titanium-oxygen composite film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the gate tube device sequentially comprises a flexible substrate, a bottom electrode, a functional layer and a top electrode from bottom to top, wherein:the functional layer material is a hafnium titanium oxide composite film; the flexible substrate is any one of polyethylene naphthalate, polyethylene terephthalate and polyimide; the bottom electrode is preferably ITO; the functional layer is formed by mixing a binary transition metal oxide HfO  2  、TiO  2  Co-sputtering to obtain; the top electrode is made of Pt metal. The invention prepares each layer of film by magnetron sputtering, photoetching, stripping and other techniques. The invention has the advantages that: the preparation at room temperature has simple process and low cost; the dispersion of the threshold voltage and the holding voltage of the gate tube is low; the flexibility and bending resistance are excellent. The flexible gate tube device can be used for solving the problem of crosstalk current after three-dimensional integration of the resistive random access memory, and has strong development potential and application prospect.

title_en: Apparatus and method for operating ferroelectric memory including ferroelectric memory
abstract_en: The present disclosure includes ferroelectric memories and devices and methods for operating ferroelectric memories. An example device includes a capacitor having a first plate, a second plate, and a ferroelectric dielectric material. The device further includes a first digit line and a first select component configured to couple the first plate to the first digit line, and also includes a second digit line and a second select component configured to couple the second plate to the second digit line.

title_en: Top gate type thin film transistor substrate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A top gate type thin film transistor substrate comprises a substrate, a light shielding layer, a metal oxide layer arranged on the light shielding layer, a buffer layer, a semiconductor film layer arranged on the buffer layer and a dielectric layer arranged on the buffer layer. The dielectric layer is provided with two through holes communicated with the semiconductor film layer through patterning. The contact hole is arranged on the metal oxide layer and penetrates through the dielectric layer and the buffer layer. The bottom of the contact hole is close to the metal oxide layer, and a metal contact block is formed through a conductor process. The source electrode and the drain electrode are respectively arranged on the two through holes, wherein the source electrode extends into the contact hole and is connected with the metal contact block.

title_en: Display panel and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A display panel comprises an array substrate, a passivation layer arranged on the array substrate, a reflecting layer arranged on the passivation layer, and a plurality of light emitting elements arranged on the array substrate. The passivation layer has a plurality of passivation layer openings and exposes the array substrate. The reflective layer has a plurality of first openings. The top surface of the light emitting element and the top surface of the reflective layer are located at substantially the same level. A method for manufacturing a display panel is also provided.

title_en: Movable body apparatus, moving method, exposure apparatus, exposure method, flat panel display manufacturing method, and device manufacturing method
abstract_en: A moving body device of the present invention includes a substrate holder (32) capable of holding a substrate (P) and moving in X-axis and Y-axis directions, a Y coarse movement stage (24) capable of moving in Y-axis direction, a 1 st measurement system for acquiring position information of the substrate holder (32) by heads (74X, 74Y) provided on the substrate holder (32) and a scale (72) provided on the Y coarse movement stage (24), a 2 nd measurement system for acquiring position information of the Y coarse movement stage (24) by heads (80X, 80Y) provided on the Y coarse movement stage (24) and a scale (78), and a control system for controlling the position of the substrate holder (32) based on the position information acquired by the 1 st and 2 nd measurement systems, wherein the 1 st measurement system irradiates a measuring beam while moving the heads (74X, 74Y) relative to the scale (72) in X-axis direction, and the 2 nd measurement system irradiates the measuring beam while moving the heads (80X, 74Y) relative to the scale (72), 80Y) is moved in the Y-axis direction with respect to the scale (78) and a measuring beam is irradiated.

title_en: Chip stack three-dimensional packaging structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a chip stack three-dimensional packaging structure and a manufacturing method thereof. The package structure includes: a die stack comprising a first die and an underlying die directly joined in a gapless manner; the first chip and the bottom chip are respectively provided with a first test pad and a first through hole, and a bottom test pad and a bottom through hole, wherein a first bearing pad and a bottom bearing pad are respectively formed at one end of the first through hole and one end of the bottom through hole, and the bottom through hole penetrates through the bottom test pad and is communicated to the first bearing pad, so that the bottom chip is electrically connected with the first chip. The manufacturing method comprises the following steps: forming a test pad on the surface of the wafer, testing the wafer by using the test pad, and directly bonding the wafer meeting the yield reference value; forming a through hole and a bearing pad to form electrical connection between the wafers; and cutting the substrate into a single body to form a chip stack three-dimensional packaging structure. According to the invention, the wafers are directly jointed, so that the signal transmission distance between the chips is shortened, and the packaging size is reduced; the yield is tested before the wafers are jointed, the low-yield wafers are prevented from being stacked, and the cost is saved.

title_en: display device
abstract_en: A display device. Provided is a display device capable of preventing deterioration of a light emitting layer and improving reliability by removing moisture generated in an organic light emitting display. The display device includes: a TFT array substrate at which an organic light emitting diode is formed; a color filter array substrate facing the TFT array substrate and including a black matrix; and a getter layer disposed between the TFT array substrate and the color filter array substrate and including a getter pattern overlapping the black matrix.

title_en: Compound semiconductor device
abstract_en: Semiconductor layers (2, 3) are formed on a substrate (1). A gate electrode (4), a source electrode (5), and a drain electrode (6) are formed on the semiconductor layer (3). A strongly correlated electron system material (12) is connected between the gate electrode (4) and the source electrode (5).

title_en: Vertical structure micro light emitting diode, display device, electronic device and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro light-emitting diode with a vertical structure, a display device, electronic equipment and a manufacturing method. The vertical structure micro light emitting diode includes: a bottom electrode bonded on the display substrate; a first type doped region disposed over the bottom electrode; a second type doped region disposed over the first type doped region; and a side contact electrode covering at least a portion of the outer periphery of the second type doped region.

title_en: IGBT with fully depletable n-channel region and p-channel region
abstract_en: The invention discloses an IGBT with an n-channel region and a p-channel region which can be completely depleted. A power semiconductor device has a semiconductor body coupled to first and second load terminal structures, the semiconductor body being configured to conduct a load current during an on-state of the device and having a drift region. The power semiconductor device includes a plurality of cells, each cell having: a first mesa in the first cell portion, the first mesa comprising: a first port region, and a first channel region, the first mesa exhibiting a total extension in a lateral direction of less than 100 nm, and a second mesa in a second cell portion, the second mesa comprising: a second port region, and a second channel region. The trench structure includes a control electrode structure configured to control load current by inversion or accumulation. A guiding region of the second conductivity type is located below the second channel region and is displaced from the first and second channel regions.

title_en: Nucleation layer for III-nitride structure growth
abstract_en: Described herein are nucleation layers for the growth of group III nitride structures and methods for growing the nucleation layers. A semiconductor may include a silicon substrate and a nucleation layer over the silicon substrate. The nucleation layer may include silicon and a deep level dopant. The semiconductor may include a group III nitride layer formed over the nucleation layer. At least one of the silicon substrate and the nucleation layer may comprise an ionized contaminant. Furthermore, the concentration of the deep level dopant is at least as high as the concentration of the ionized contaminant.

title_en: Light emitting diode
abstract_en: The invention provides a light emitting diode. The light emitting diode includes: a transparent substrate having a first surface, a second surface, and side surfaces; a first conductive type semiconductor layer on the first surface of the transparent substrate; a second conductive type semiconductor layer on the first conductive type semiconductor layer; an active layer located between the first conductivity type semiconductor layer and the second conductivity type semiconductor layer; a first pad electrically connected to the first conductive type semiconductor layer; and a second pad electrically connected to the second conductive type semiconductor layer. Further, light generated by the active layer is emitted outside the transparent substrate through the second surface of the transparent substrate, and the light emitting diode has a beam angle of at least 140 degrees in at least one axial direction. Accordingly, a light emitting diode suitable for a backlight unit or a surface illumination device may be provided.

title_en: Pixel arrangement structure and related device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pixel arrangement structure and a related device, wherein in the pixel arrangement structure: the first sub-pixel is positioned at the center position and four vertex angle positions of the first virtual rectangle; the second sub-pixel is positioned at the side center of the first virtual rectangle; the third sub-pixel is positioned in the second virtual rectangle, and the third sub-pixel is asymmetric at least in one diagonal direction of the second virtual rectangle in which the third sub-pixel is positioned; wherein the second virtual rectangle is formed by two second sub-pixels located at two adjacent sides of the first virtual rectangle and two adjacent first sub-pixels thereof as vertex angles. Compared with the existing pixel arrangement structure, the pixel arrangement mode can enable the first sub-pixel, the second sub-pixel and the third sub-pixel to be closely arranged under the same process condition, so that the area of a single sub-pixel is increased as much as possible under the condition that the minimum sub-pixel interval is met, the driving current of a display device is reduced, and the service life of the display device is prolonged.

title_en: Organic light emitting display device
abstract_en: Provided is an organic light emitting display device including: a substrate having a display area in which a plurality of pixels including organic light emitting diodes are arranged and a peripheral area surrounding the display area; a pad disposed on the substrate in the peripheral region; a first conductive pattern disposed on one side of the display area in the peripheral area and electrically connected to the pad; a second conductive pattern disposed on the substrate in the peripheral region and on an opposite side of the first conductive pattern, the display region being interposed between the first conductive pattern and the second conductive pattern; a first connection electrode disposed on and electrically connected to the first conductive pattern in the peripheral region; and a second connection electrode disposed on and electrically connected to the second conductive pattern in the peripheral region, wherein cathode electrodes of the organic light emitting diodes are disposed on and electrically connected to the first and second connection electrodes.

title_en: Boron heterocyclic compound, display panel, and display device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of OLED and provides a boron heterocyclic compound which has a structure shown in a formula (I); wherein, L is any one of a single bond, substituted or unsubstituted phenyl, substituted or unsubstituted naphthyl and substituted or unsubstituted anthryl; d is mainly selected from carbazolyl and derivative groups thereof, acridinyl and derivative groups thereof, diarylamine and derivative groups thereof. The boron heterocyclic compound is connected with an acceptor group through a boron heterocyclic SP3 hybridized connecting part, so that the conjugation length can be shortened, the energy level can be improved, and the molecular thermodynamic stability can be improved. Meanwhile, the short-axis conjugation weakens the charge transfer in the molecule, and narrows the luminescence spectrum to a certain extent. The compound can be used as a TADF material, and because the TADF material has bipolarity, the TADF material can be used as a light-emitting layer to greatly improve the injection and the transmission of two carriers, thereby reducing the voltage of a device. The luminescent layer of the luminescent device containing the compound does not contain precious metal, so that the cost can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a semiconductor device having a plurality of semiconductor chips
abstract_en: Provided is a semiconductor device including: a substrate having a first region and a second region; a first trench located in the first region; and a first PMOS transistor and a second PMOS transistor, respectively located in the first region and the second region. The first transistor includes a first gate insulating layer, a first TiN layer on and in contact with the first gate insulating layer, and a first gate electrode on and in contact with the first TiN layer. The second transistor includes a second gate insulating layer, a second TiN layer on and in contact with the second gate insulating layer, and a first TiAlC layer on and in contact with the second TiN layer. The first gate insulating layer, the first TiN layer, and the first gate electrode are located within the first trench. The first gate electrode does not include aluminum. The threshold voltage of the first transistor is smaller than the threshold voltage of the second transistor.

title_en: Method of manufacturing display device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of manufacturing a display device, the method including providing a substrate including a first stepped portion, forming a metal layer on the substrate and the first stepped portion, forming an organic layer pattern on the metal layer at a position corresponding to a sidewall of the stepped portion, forming a photosensitive layer on the metal layer and the organic layer pattern, patterning the photosensitive layer to form a photosensitive layer pattern adjacent to the organic layer pattern, and forming a metal line by removing an exposed portion of the organic layer pattern and the metal layer through an etching process using the photosensitive layer pattern as a mask.

title_en: Barrier layer structure of flexible solar cell and assembly and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a barrier layer structure of a flexible solar cell and a flexible solar cell module and a preparation method of the barrier layer structure. The barrier structure includes: a flexible metal substrate; the impurity blocking layer is arranged on the flexible metal substrate; the back electrode layer is arranged on the impurity blocking layer; the impurity blocking layer comprises a conductive blocking layer and an insulating blocking layer which are arranged in a laminated mode, a conductive channel is arranged in the insulating blocking layer, and the conductive channel is used for electrically communicating the flexible metal substrate and the back electrode layer. The blocking structure can effectively reduce the diffusion of impurity elements such as Fe and Cr in the substrate and the impurity elements in the metal blocking layer to the CIGS absorption layer, and obtains better adhesion; meanwhile, an ordered current transmission channel is formed on the insulating barrier layer, and the conductive barrier layer is not lost, so that the preparation of the external connection type flexible CIGS solar module is facilitated. In addition, the preparation method is simple in process.

title_en: Switch, preparation method thereof and display panel
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a switch comprising: the first substrate base plate and the bearing structure are oppositely arranged, one side, facing the bearing structure, of the first substrate base plate is provided with an accommodating groove, an electric deformation structure, a first conductive pattern and a second conductive pattern are arranged in the accommodating groove, the first conductive pattern and the second conductive pattern are oppositely arranged, the electric deformation structure is located on one side, back to the second conductive pattern, of the first conductive pattern, the first conductive pattern and the electric deformation structure are fixed and insulated, and the surface of one side, facing the first substrate base plate, of the bearing structure is fixed with the surface of the second conductive pattern and the surface of one side, facing the first substrate base plate, of the bearing structure; the electrostrictive structure is used for responding to the control of the loaded electric field and performing telescopic deformation along the direction perpendicular to the plane where the first conductive pattern is located so as to drive the first conductive pattern to perform corresponding movement, thereby controlling the first conductive pattern to be in contact with or separated from the second conductive pattern. The disclosure also provides a switch preparation method and a display panel.

title_en: Surface gold film patterning method based on semiconductor multi-step deep etching
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductors, and particularly relates to a surface gold film patterning method based on semiconductor multi-step deep etching. The method solves the problems of low efficiency, high difficulty and poor effect of removing the gold film on the etching structure in the prior art, adopts the prior deposition of the gold film and completes the graphical formation of the gold film, and then utilizes the patterned gold film as a photoetching masking layer material to complete the multi-step deep etching formation so as to realize the preparation of the excellent graphical structure of the gold film on the multi-step deep substrate, thereby ensuring good product quality, enriching the process path design of the gold film graphical and expanding the application field of the complex gold film graphical.

title_en: Organic light-emitting diode device and compound for charge generation layer included therein
abstract_en: Disclosed are an organic light emitting diode device and a compound for a charge generation layer included in the device, the organic light emitting diode device including: a first electrode; a second electrode disposed opposite to the first electrode; m light emitting units (m is an integer of 2 or more) disposed between the first electrode and the second electrode and including at least one light emitting layer; and m-1 charge generation layers each interposed between two adjacent light emitting units of the m light emitting units; wherein at least one of the m-1 charge generating layers comprises a compound for the charge generating layer, the compound comprising a boron-containing compound bonded to a metal halide by a single electron sigma bond.

title_en: Filter member and air conditioning apparatus
abstract_en: The invention is characterized in that: the piezoelectric element is provided with a plurality of piezoelectric fibers which generate electric charges by expansion and contraction, wherein a 1 st main surface (21) and a 2 nd main surface (22) which is positioned on the opposite side of the 1 st main surface (21) are formed, and a plurality of 1 st piezoelectric fibers (31) which generate negative charges by expansion and contraction are arranged at least on the 1 st main surface (21) side.

title_en: Method for stamping single IC chip in fake chip by laser cutting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for stamping a single IC chip in a dummy chip by utilizing laser cutting, which is used for stamping different IC contents on a wafer and comprises the following steps: s1: carrying out laser cutting on the wafer, and respectively cutting 4 or more single IC placing holes on the left side and the right side of the wafer; s2: discarding 8 or more ICs cut off from the wafer, and sticking an adhesive tape on the back of the wafer to manufacture a stamping jig of a single IC; s3: skipping a substrate needing different laser stamping processes over a stamping station, completely fitting the substrate on a stamping jig, cutting off the IC hole positions of the stamping jig, and then putting the stamping jig for a single IC into the substrate, so that 8 or more single ICs with the same content can be stamped at most once.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a display panel and a display device, wherein a packaging layer of the display panel at least comprises a first organic layer and a first inorganic layer which are arranged in a stacking way, the cross section of the contact surface of the first organic layer and the first inorganic layer is an arc in a corresponding electronic element arrangement area, the arc is positioned on a lighting path of an electronic element, and the center of the arc is positioned on one side of the first inorganic layer; the contact surface of part of the film layer is arranged to be an arc in the electronic element arrangement area, so that part of light rays blocked by the sub-pixel light-emitting unit can pass through a lighting path of the electronic element through refraction of the arc to reach the lighting unit, and the light extraction efficiency of the electronic element to light is improved.

title_en: Storage device and capacitive energy storage device
abstract_en: Capacitive Energy Storage Devices (CESDs) and methods of making and using CESDs are disclosed. The CESD includes an array of electrodes with a space between the electrodes. The dielectric material occupies the space between the electrodes; regions of dielectric material located between adjacent electrodes define capacitive elements. The disclosed CESD may be used as an energy storage device and/or a memory storage device.

title_en: OLED bipolar main body material and application thereof in device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a structure shown in a general formula I; in the general formula I, E represents O, S or Se atom; r 1 、R 2 、R 3 、R 4 Each independently represents an aromatic group or H atom with electron-withdrawing property containing n benzene rings and/or aromatic heterocyclic rings; and n represents an integer of 1-5. The material provided by the invention is a bipolar host material taking chiral spirofluorene molecules as a main body, the thermal stability of the host material is improved by changing the conjugation length of the material, the glass transition temperature of the material is improved, the bipolar material is favorable for injecting and transmitting holes and electrons, and a bipolar compound usually comprises an electron donating unit and an electron accepting unit; the material has good thermal stability and morphology stability so as to ensure the stability of the device; the material has HOMO and LUMO energy levels matched with the materials of the adjacent layers so as to reduce the charge injection energy barrier and the driving voltage of the device; have a higher triplet energy level than the dopant emitter to avoid energy return.

title_en: Flexible substrate, display substrate and display panel
abstract_en: The application relates to a flexible substrate, a display substrate and a display panel. A flexible substrate comprising: a first protective film; a flexible layer; the sacrificial layer is arranged between the first protective film and the flexible layer and is provided with a first surface and a second surface which are arranged oppositely; the first adhesive is used for adhering the second surface of the sacrificial layer and the flexible layer, and the viscosity coefficient is smaller than a first threshold value; and the second adhesive is used for adhering the first surface of the sacrificial layer and the first protective film, the viscosity coefficient is larger than a second threshold value, and the second threshold value is larger than the first threshold value. In the process of manufacturing the display panel by using the flexible substrate, when the rigid substrate is peeled, the sacrificial layer and the flexible layer are torn off, and the molecular chains of the flexible layer are not required to be broken by using laser, so that the manufacturing difficulty of the display panel is reduced. And the stripping is thorough, which is beneficial to the improvement of the yield of the product.

title_en: Condensed cyclic compound and organic light-emitting device including the same
abstract_en: Provided are condensed-cyclic compounds and organic light-emitting devices including the same. When the condensed-cyclic compound is used as an emission layer material in a device, the device can have excellent driving voltage, efficiency, and color purity. The organic light-emitting device including the condensed cyclic compound may have a low driving voltage, excellent efficiency, and long life.

title_en: Thin film transistor and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The application provides a thin film transistor and a preparation method thereof. The substrate is sequentially provided with an active layer, a plurality of first metal units, a grid insulating layer, a grid layer, a flat layer, a source electrode and a drain electrode. The source electrode is electrically connected with the first metal unit, and the drain electrode is electrically connected with the first metal unit. The active layer is divided into a first region and a second region. The first region of the active layer has an oxygen vacancy density greater than the oxygen vacancy density of the second region of the active layer. The thin film transistor and the preparation method thereof improve the electron mobility of the device, and further improve the performance of the device.

title_en: Radiation detection and method of manufacturing a radiation detector
abstract_en: A radiation detector having a plurality of pixels is provided. A corresponding one of the plurality of pixels includes: a thin film transistor on the substrate base plate; an interlayer dielectric layer located on a side of the thin film transistor remote from the substrate base plate; a sensing electrode and a bias electrode, which are positioned at one side of the interlayer dielectric layer far away from the substrate base plate, wherein the sensing electrode penetrates through the interlayer dielectric layer to be electrically connected to the thin film transistor; a passivation layer on a side of the sensing electrode and the bias electrode remote from the interlayer dielectric layer, wherein the passivation layer includes a first portion and a second portion; and a radiation detection layer located on a side of the passivation layer remote from the substrate. The first portion and the second portion form a substantially planar contact surface.

title_en: Method and device for producing a wire connection and component arrangement having a wire connection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for producing a wire connection between a first contact surface and at least one further contact surface (42), in which method or device a contact end of a wire is positioned in a contact position relative to the first contact surface by means of a wire guiding tool, and then a mechanical, electrically conductive connection between the first contact surface and the contact end is formed by means of a first solder connection (38), and then the wire guiding tool is moved to the further contact surface (42) to form a wire section and a further mechanical, electrically conductive connection is formed between the wire section end (45) and the further contact surface (42) by means of a further solder connection (48). The invention further relates to a component arrangement having a plurality of electronic components, in particular in the form of chips.

title_en: Light-emitting element
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light-emitting element, which comprises a substrate, a semiconductor lamination layer, a first electrode pad and a second electrode pad, wherein the substrate comprises an upper surface, a first side surface and a second side surface, the first side surface and the second side surface of the substrate are respectively connected to two opposite sides of the upper surface of the substrate, the semiconductor lamination layer is arranged on the upper surface of the substrate and comprises a first semiconductor layer, a second semiconductor layer and an active layer, the active layer is arranged between the first semiconductor layer and the second semiconductor layer, the first electrode pad is adjacent to a first side of the light-emitting element, the second electrode pad is adjacent to a second side of the light-emitting element, the first side and the second side of the light-emitting element are positioned on different sides or opposite sides of the light-emitting element in a top view, the first semiconductor layer close to the first side comprises a first side wall which is directly connected with the first side surface of the substrate, and the first semiconductor layer close to the second side comprises a second side wall which is separated from the second side surface of the substrate by a distance.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent element
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an organic electroluminescent element comprising a first electrode, a second electrode and at least one organic film between the first electrode and the second electrode, the organic film comprising a light-emitting layer comprising compounds represented by chemical formulas 1 and 2, wherein N is an integer of 0 to 3, m, r and o are the same or different from each other and are an integer of 0 to 4, Y is B, N or the like, X is 1 And X 2 Identical to or different from each other, selected from O, S, etc., R 1 ～R 4 Same or different from each other, selected from hydrogen, deuterium, etc., L 1 Selected from a single bond, an arylene group having 5 to 30 carbon atoms, etc., ar 1 ～Ar 2 Are the same or different from each other and are selected from cycloalkyl groups having 3 to 30 carbon atoms and the like, R 5 ～R 13 Equal to or different from each other, selected from hydrogen, deuterium, etc., R 1 ～R 13 、L 1 、Ar 1 And Ar 2 The substituent(s) is substituted with a substituent selected from hydrogen, deuterium and the like, and when the substituent(s) is plural, they are the same as or different from each other. The organic electroluminescent element of the present invention is excellent in efficiency, color characteristics and life.

title_en: Sparse tooth bracket based on high-precision assembly and convenient to replace single tooth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thinning gear bracket convenient for single-tooth replacement and based on high-precision assembly, which solves the problems that the damage of individual supporting teeth of the existing mechanism requires the whole replacement of the bracket and the assembly precision of the bracket is low. The silicon wafer inserting device is characterized in that long-strip-shaped grooves (17) are formed in the middle upper portion of the front side face of a carrier tooth bottom frame plate (16) at equal intervals along the vertical direction, threaded counter bores (18) are formed in the front side face of the carrier tooth bottom frame plate (16) below the long-strip-shaped grooves (17), a silicon wafer inserting U-shaped groove (20) is formed in the top end of each long-strip-shaped carrier tooth (19), top thread holes (25) for fixing the long-strip-shaped carrier teeth are formed in the upper portion of a carrier tooth fixing cover plate (23) at equal intervals, the lower ends of the long-strip-shaped carrier teeth (19) are movably inserted into the long-strip-shaped grooves (17) in the carrier tooth bottom frame plate (16), and the carrier tooth fixing cover plate. The replacement is convenient when a single tooth of the supporting tooth is damaged.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a display panel and a display device. The display panel comprises a first display area and a second display area, wherein the second display area is reused as a light sensation element setting area, and the second display area comprises a plurality of non-light-transmitting areas and light-transmitting areas; the light transmission regions comprise a first light transmission region and a second light transmission region; the non-light-transmitting areas and the first light-transmitting areas are arranged at intervals in the first direction, and the lengths of the first light-transmitting areas and the adjacent non-light-transmitting areas in the second direction are the same; the non-light-transmitting areas and the second light-transmitting areas are arranged at intervals in the second direction, and the length of the second light-transmitting area in the first direction is equal to the sum of the lengths of a non-light-transmitting area adjacent to the second light-transmitting area and a first light-transmitting area in the first direction; the first direction and the second direction intersect. According to the technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention, the screen occupation ratio of the display panel is improved under the condition that sufficient light of the light sensing elements under the screen is ensured, and the comprehensive screen display effect is realized.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a display device. The flat section (50) has: a 1 st side (S1) extending in a 1 st direction (D1); a 2 nd side (S2) extending in a 2 nd direction (D2) crossing the 1 st direction (D1); and a corner edge (CS) located between the 1 st edge (S1) and the 2 nd edge (S2) and having a tangent intersecting both the 1 st edge (S1) and the 2 nd edge (S2). The inclined part (52) has: a 1 st portion (P1) bent from the 1 st side (S1) within an obtuse angle range; a 2 nd portion (P2) bent from the 2 nd side (S2) within an obtuse angle range; and a 3 rd portion (P3) bent from the corner edge (CS) within an obtuse angle range. The flexible display panel (10) has, in a flat state when unfolded, a cutout (C) that expands at intervals in a direction away from the flat portion (50) between the 1 st portion (P1) and the 2 nd portion (P2). The flexible display panel (10) has Opposite Sides (OS) of the cutout (C) adjacent to each other in a bent state.

title_en: Three-dimensional memory device and method of forming the same
abstract_en: Embodiments of a three-dimensional (3D) memory device and methods of forming the same are disclosed. In an example, a 3D memory device includes a substrate, a gate electrode having a double-sided staircase shape over the substrate, a blocking layer on the gate electrode, a plurality of discrete charge-trapping layers each extending laterally on the blocking layer, a tunneling layer on the plurality of charge-trapping layers, and a plurality of discrete channel layers each extending laterally on the tunneling layer. The plurality of charge trapping layers are respectively arranged corresponding to the steps of the double-sided ladder shape of the gate electrode. The plurality of channel layers are respectively arranged corresponding to the steps of the double-sided ladder shape.

title_en: Switching element, variable resistance memory device, and method of manufacturing switching element
abstract_en: A switching element, a variable resistance memory device, and a method of manufacturing the switching element are provided. The switching element includes a lower barrier electrode on a substrate, a switching pattern on the lower barrier electrode, and an upper barrier electrode on the switching pattern. The lower barrier electrode includes a first lower barrier electrode layer and a second lower barrier electrode layer interposed between the first lower barrier electrode layer and the switching pattern, the second lower barrier electrode layer having a density different from that of the first lower barrier electrode layer.

title_en: Semiconductor device, electronic apparatus, and method of manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: Provided are a semiconductor device, an electronic apparatus, and a method for manufacturing a semiconductor device, in which influence caused by RTN is reduced regardless of the shape of a gate electrode. [ solution ] A semiconductor device is provided with: a substrate having an element region including a source region and a drain region, wherein a channel region exists between the source region and the drain region, and an element separation region is provided at least on both sides with respect to a direction orthogonal to a direction in which the source region, the channel region, and the drain region are provided; a gate insulating film provided on the element region of the substrate at least from one side to the other side of the element separation region; and a gate electrode provided on the gate insulating film. The gate insulating film includes impurities. The impurity concentration in the boundary region including the boundary between the element region and the element separation region is different from the impurity concentration in the central region of the gate insulating film.

title_en: Heating device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a heating device and a control method thereof, wherein the heating device comprises: the air suction and blowing assembly is used for enabling the substrate to be suspended on the heating plate and comprises a plurality of air suction holes, a plurality of air blowing holes, an air suction pipeline and an air blowing pipeline; the air blowing component is connected with the air blowing pipeline; the air blowing component is used for introducing air with set temperature into the air blowing pipeline; at least one temperature sensor for detecting a temperature of a gas within the process chamber; and the temperature regulator is used for regulating the temperature of the gas introduced into the gas blowing part according to the temperature detected by the temperature sensor so as to keep the temperature in the process chamber constant. The heating device and the control method thereof can improve the heating effect and the product yield.

title_en: Method for roughening surface of light-emitting device and light-emitting device
abstract_en: A method for roughening the surface of a light-emitting device and the light-emitting device belong to the field of semiconductors. The surface roughening method comprises the following steps: preparing a first epitaxial layer grown in a three-dimensional island shape on the light emitting structure (S202 b); a discontinuous second epitaxial layer is prepared on the first epitaxial layer (S202 c). The surface roughening method is simple and convenient, the efficiency is improved, the surface of the epitaxial layer is not required to be further processed by adopting additional processes such as wet etching, photonic crystals and the like besides the epitaxial growth process, and the surface roughening method can be realized by one process in the same reaction equipment.

title_en: Heating curing equipment for installing battery pack radiating support
abstract_en: The application provides a heating and curing equipment for installing battery pack heat dissipation support, through set up conveying mechanism and heating and curing module in the frame, will wait to paste fixed battery pack through conveying mechanism and carry to the solidification station, the heating and curing module promotes heating block extrusion heat dissipation support through first cylinder so that the glue between heat dissipation support and the panel exhausts, and heat the heat dissipation support and make the thermosetting of adding water, thereby it is fixed to accomplish the pasting of heat dissipation support on the panel. Furthermore, this application is used for installing battery pack heat dissipation support's heating curing equipment can replace the manual work to paste fixedly, can accomplish automatically under control system's control that the pasting of heat dissipation support is fixed, and degree of automation is high, need not more artifical the participation, and production efficiency is high, can guarantee pressure size and the heating temperature to heat dissipation support through the heating curing module, and then avoids because reasons such as the atress is inhomogeneous cause the not up to standard problem of bonding strength.

title_en: Iridium-matched electroluminescent material, preparation method thereof and electroluminescent device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an iridium-matched electroluminescent material which is characterized by comprising the following structural formula: the preparation method comprises the following steps: under the protection of nitrogen, the compound A and iridium trichloride trihydrate are heated to react to generate B, then the B and silver trifluoromethanesulfonate are reacted to generate C, and finally the C and the compound D are reacted to obtain the compound. The invention also discloses an organic electroluminescent device containing iridium and electroluminescent materials, which comprises: the electroluminescent device comprises a first electrode, a second electrode, one or more organic layers arranged between the first electrode and the second electrode, wherein the organic layers comprise iridium matched with electroluminescent materials. According to the invention, through selecting the combination of specific heterocyclic ligands and adjusting the wavelength of the compound, the obtained iridium-matched electroluminescent material is used for an organic electroluminescent device, so that the luminous efficiency of the device is improved, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Three-dimensional semiconductor memory device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A three-dimensional semiconductor memory device and a method of manufacturing the same are disclosed. A three-dimensional semiconductor memory device may be provided, including a substrate including a cell array region and a connection region, an electrode structure including a plurality of electrodes and a plurality of dielectric layers alternately stacked on the substrate, the electrode structure having a stepped portion on the connection region, an etch stop structure on the stepped portion of the electrode structure, and a plurality of contact plugs on the connection region, the contact plugs penetrating the etch stop structure and being connected to corresponding pad portions of the electrodes, respectively. The etch stop structure may include an etch stop pattern and a horizontal dielectric layer having a uniform thickness and covering top and bottom surfaces of the etch stop pattern.

title_en: Chip packaging method and chip packaging structure
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a chip packaging method and a chip packaging structure, and relates to the technical field of semiconductors. According to the chip packaging method and the chip packaging structure provided by the embodiment of the invention, the boss and the metal column are arranged on the substrate, and the metal pad of the chip is attached to the boss of the substrate by using the colloid, so that on one hand, the problem of chip subfissure is avoided by using the height difference between the boss and the substrate to form the cavity structure at the bottom of the chip, and on the other hand, the metal column is communicated with the circuit of the chip, and on the other hand, the cavity structure is sealed by using the adhesiveness between the colloid and the metal pad, so that the sealing property of the cavity structure is improved.

title_en: Wafer cleaning machine is used in physiotherapy equipment production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wafer cleaning machine for production of a physiotherapy instrument, which structurally comprises casters, a case, a drain pipe, a case cover, a cleaning mechanism and a control panel, wherein the casters are arranged at the lower end of the case; the cleaning mechanism comprises an outer box body, an ultrasonic transducer, an inner edge protection structure, a cleaning cavity, an auxiliary cleaning structure and a rotating wheel, wherein the ultrasonic transducer is embedded in the inner side of the outer box body, the inner edge protection structure is embedded in the inner side of the outer box body, the cleaning cavity is arranged in the inner edge protection structure, and the lower end of the auxiliary cleaning structure is embedded in the inner side of the outer box body.

title_en: SiC power semiconductor device with integrated Schottky junction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SiC power semiconductor device with an integrated Schottky junction. Embodiments of SiC devices and corresponding methods of fabrication are provided. In some embodiments, the SiC device has a screening region at the bottom of some gate trenches and a nonlinear junction formed with the SiC material at the bottom of other gate trenches. In other embodiments, the SiC device has a shield region at the bottom of the gate trench and arranged in rows extending in a direction transverse to the longitudinal extension of the trench. In yet other embodiments, the SiC device has a screening region and a nonlinear junction, and wherein the screening region is arranged in rows extending in a direction transverse to a longitudinal extension of the trench.

title_en: Method for forming light emitting element pattern and display device
abstract_en: A method for forming a light emitting element pattern and a display device are provided. A method for forming a light emitting element pattern according to an embodiment of the inventive concept includes forming a pattern layer having an opening on a target material, forming a light emitting element pattern on the target material corresponding to the opening, and removing the pattern layer. Here, the pattern layers include a first pattern layer disposed on the target material, a second pattern layer disposed on the first pattern layer, and a third pattern layer disposed on the second pattern layer. The second pattern layer has an undercut portion recessed from an edge of the third pattern layer.

title_en: Light-transmitting cover plate, optical sensor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A light-transmitting cover plate, an optical sensor and a manufacturing method thereof belong to the field of sensors. By selecting to form the cutting path in the glass and not completely solidify on the surface. Therefore, the glass cover plate for packaging the optical sensor can be conveniently manufactured, so that the process cost for manufacturing the package of the optical sensor is lower, the requirement on equipment is low, and the yield of the obtained product is improved.

title_en: Anthracene-based deep blue light organic electroluminescent material with high efficiency and low roll-off
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anthracene-based deep blue light organic electroluminescent material which is characterized by having a general structure shown in the following formula I; wherein D is an electron donating group; a is an electron withdrawing group; m and n are the number of bridging groups respectively, and the selected values are independently selected from 0 or 1. According to the invention, through controlling the internal structure of the general formula, especially through optimizing and regulating electron-donating and electron-withdrawing units and bridging groups, the anthracene-based deep blue light organic electroluminescent material with high efficiency and low roll-off is obtained; the anthracene-based deep blue light organic electroluminescent materials can be particularly applied to undoped organic electroluminescent devices, so that the deep blue light organic electroluminescent devices with high efficiency and low roll-off are obtained.

title_en: Quantum dot light-emitting diode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of display, and particularly relates to a quantum dot light-emitting diode and a preparation method thereof. The quantum dot light-emitting diode comprises an anode, a cathode and a quantum dot light-emitting layer, wherein the quantum dot light-emitting layer is positioned between the anode and the cathode, an electron transmission layer is arranged between the cathode and the quantum dot light-emitting layer, the electron transmission layer is made of n-type metal oxide, a material layer consisting of carbonate positive salt is arranged on the surface, close to the cathode, of the electron transmission layer, and the carbonate positive salt and the n-type metal oxide have the same metal elements. The device has good luminous efficiency and service life.

title_en: Preparation method of gallium oxide epitaxial material with low-density oxygen vacancy defects
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a gallium oxide epitaxial material with low-density oxygen vacancy defects, which comprises the following steps of firstly, putting a metal gallium source into a quartz boat, and putting the quartz boat into a double-temperature-zone quartz tube type furnace inner temperature zone 1; then the cleaned and dried substrate is placed on a substrate holder, and the substrate holder carrying the substrate slice is placed in a temperature zone 2 in the quartz tube furnace; vacuumizing the reaction cavity, wherein the pressure of the cavity is 1pa after vacuumizing; introducing inert gas serving as carrier gas into the quartz reaction chamber; simultaneously heating a quartz boat loaded with a metal gallium source in a temperature zone 1 in the heat pipe furnace and a substrate in the temperature zone 2; the method comprises the steps of setting the temperature rise time to enable the working temperature of the temperature area 1 and the working temperature of the temperature area 2 to reach the correspondingly set temperatures at the same time, opening the oxygen gas circuit, enabling inert gas to carry oxygen into the quartz reaction tube, depositing a gallium oxide film on a substrate, and completing preparation of the gallium oxide film.

title_en: Display substrate and display device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a display substrate and a display device, and belongs to the technical field of display. The display substrate comprises a substrate, a first substrate, a second substrate and a third substrate, wherein the substrate is provided with a mounting area, a transition area surrounding the mounting area and a display area surrounding the transition area; the installation area, the transition area and the display area respectively comprise sub-pixel areas; the sub-pixel areas in the transition area at least comprise a first type sub-pixel area and a second type sub-pixel area; the sub-pixel areas in the installation area at least comprise a third type sub-pixel area; a pixel circuit positioned on the substrate is arranged in the first-type sub-pixel area; the pixel circuit comprises a driving sub-circuit and a light emitting device; a driving sub-circuit positioned on the substrate is arranged in the second type sub-pixel area; a light emitting device positioned on the substrate is arranged in the third type sub-pixel area; the light-emitting device in the third sub-pixel area of the mounting area is connected with the driving sub-circuit in the second sub-pixel area of the transition area through a signal connecting line; the signal connecting lines and the driving sub-circuits connected with different light-emitting devices are different; at least part of the signal connecting lines are overlapped in the orthographic projection on the substrate.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent device and monoamine compound for organic electroluminescent device
abstract_en: One or more embodiments provide an organic electroluminescent device and a monoamine compound for an organic electroluminescent device. The organic electroluminescent device includes a first electrode, a hole transport region on the first electrode, an emission layer on the hole transport region, an electron transport region on the emission layer, and a second electrode on the electron transport region, wherein the hole transport region includes a monoamine compound represented by formula 1, thereby exhibiting high emission efficiency, formula 1 Wherein Ar  1 、Ar 2 、L、R 1 , "m" and "n" are as defined in the specification.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The application provides a display device, which comprises a display substrate, a main circuit board, a first connecting circuit board and a second connecting circuit board. The display substrate includes a base layer, an insulating layer, a first signal line, a second signal line, a first pad, and a second pad, wherein the insulating layer is on the base layer, the first signal line is on the base layer, the second signal line is on the base layer, the first pad is exposed from the insulating layer and connected to the first signal line, and the second pad is connected to a side surface of the second signal line and disposed on a side surface and a bottom surface of the base layer. The first connection circuit board electrically connects the first pad and the main circuit board, and the second connection circuit board electrically connects the second pad and the main circuit board.

title_en: Active layer material, preparation method of active layer material and transistor
abstract_en: The application provides an active layer material, a preparation method of the active layer and a transistor, wherein the active layer material has a structural formula Due to the complexation in the active layer material, the active layer material has better film-forming property and regular molecular arrangement mode, the active layer prepared from the active layer material is applied to a transistor, the prepared active layer is not easy to aggregate, and the thickness of the film layer is uniform.

title_en: Fine wiring forming method using laser chemical vapor deposition
abstract_en: Disclosed is a fine wiring forming method including: a step of supplying a source gas including a plurality of metal elements by Laser Chemical Vapor Deposition (LCVD) while forming an alloy wiring including the plurality of metal elements on a substrate; and a step of performing laser heat treatment on a region including the alloy wiring. According to the method for forming the fine wiring, the fine wiring is formed by LCVD for the first time, the high thickness is grown in a narrow width in a short time by depositing alloy to achieve good film quality, the film quality defects in the fine wiring are repaired by subsequent laser heat treatment, the tissue density and the film quality are improved, the uniformity and the conductivity stability of the film quality can be improved, the irradiation width, the power intensity and the irradiation mode are regulated, and the line width of the fine wiring can be reduced to below 2 mu m while the patterns are gathered in the process of partial melting.

title_en: Compound for introducing cyclic amide structure to organic electroluminescent device and application
abstract_en: A compound for introducing a cyclic amide structure to an organic electroluminescent device and an application thereof are disclosed, wherein the compound is represented by the following general formula (I): wherein L is 1 And L 3 The same or different, are respectively and independently selected from single bond and C 6 ～C 30 An aromatic hydrocarbon group; ar, R 1 And R 2 Each independently selected from hydrogen, halogen and substituted or unsubstituted C 6 ～C 30 An aromatic hydrocarbon group, or a substituted or unsubstituted C 2 ～C 30 A heteroaryl group; r 1 And R 2 The same or different; p is an integer of 0 to 6; q is an integer of 0 to 5; n is an integer of 0 to 4. The stable and efficient electronic transmission material prepared by the invention has the advantages of reducing the lighting and working voltage of the device, improving the efficiency of the device, prolonging the service life of the device and having important practical application value.

title_en: Component carrier comprising dielectric structures having different physical properties
abstract_en: The invention relates to a component carrier (1), to a device comprising the component carrier and a further component carrier, and to a method for producing a component carrier. The component carrier includes: a stack (2) with at least one electrically conductive layer structure and a plurality of electrically insulating layer structures (4A, 4B, 7), and a component (3) embedded in the stack (2). The plurality of electrically insulating layer structures (4A, 4B, 7) comprises a first dielectric structure (4A) and a second dielectric structure (4B) that differ in at least one physical property.

title_en: Forward-mounted high-voltage LED chip set, LED light source for plant light supplement and illumination equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a front-mounted high-voltage LED chip set, an LED light source for plant light supplement and illumination equipment, wherein the LED light source for plant light supplement comprises a substrate, a high-voltage LED chip set and a rubber powder layer; a glue powder layer covers the upper part of the LED wafer; the LED wafer is fixed on the substrate through the adhesive powder layer; by controlling the weight ratio and the thickness of the transparent adhesive medium and the red fluorescent particles of the adhesive powder layer, the ratio of the number of red light photons to the number of blue light photons emitted by the LED light source for plant light supplement in unit time is 65-95: 5-35. The LED light source for plant light supplement has high working voltage, the working voltage of a packaged finished product is easy to approach to commercial power, the efficiency of a driving power supply is improved, and the line loss of the LED light source for plant light supplement in finished product application is obviously lower than that of a lamp manufactured by the traditional DCLED packaged light source due to low working current; meanwhile, the LED light source for plant light supplement reduces the die bonding and bonding number of the chip, and is beneficial to reducing the packaging cost.

title_en: Grating type plane incidence type optical detector
abstract_en: The application discloses a grating type plane incidence type optical detector, which comprises: a substrate; the grating active layer is arranged on the substrate and comprises a plurality of grating bulges; a doped layer is formed on the substrate near the upper surface layer of the grating active layer, the doped layer comprises a plurality of P-type doped electrodes and N-type doped electrodes which are alternately arranged, and an undoped silicon region is arranged between the adjacent P-type doped electrodes and N-type doped electrodes; the grating protrusion covers the undoped silicon region, one side of the P-type doped electrode and one side of the N-type doped electrode at two sides of the undoped silicon region. The application adopts the design of the optical grating type enhanced absorption layer and the silicon layer contact electrode, realizes the optical coupling mode of surface incidence, avoids the problem that the waveguide type optical detector is limited by an optical coupler, realizes the high-sensitivity optical detector with high speed, low dark current, low loss and insensitive polarization, and has a larger light receiving angle.

title_en: Electrostatic chuck
abstract_en: The electrostatic chuck is provided with: a ceramic dielectric substrate having a 1 st and a 2 nd main surfaces; a base plate; a 1 st electrode layer provided inside the ceramic dielectric substrate and connected to a high-frequency power supply; and a 2 nd electrode layer provided inside the ceramic dielectric substrate and connected to the power source for adsorption, wherein the 1 st electrode layer is provided between the 1 st main surface and the 2 nd main surface in the Z-axis direction, the size of the 1 st electrode layer in the Z-axis direction is larger than the size of the 2 nd electrode layer in the Z-axis direction, the 2 nd electrode layer is provided between the 1 st electrode layer and the 1 st main surface in the Z-axis direction, the 1 st electrode layer has a 1 st surface on the 1 st main surface side and a 2 nd surface on the opposite side to the 1 st surface, power is supplied from the 2 nd surface side, the 1 st electrode layer contains a 1 st part containing a ceramic component and a metal component, and the concentration of the ceramic component on the 1 st part is higher than the average concentration of the ceramic component of the 1 st electrode layer.

title_en: Memory device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A memory device and a manufacturing method thereof are provided, wherein the memory device comprises a first electrode, a resistance transformation layer, a cover layer, a protection layer and a second electrode. The resistance transition layer is arranged above the first electrode. The cover layer is arranged above the resistance transition layer, wherein the bottom surface of the cover layer is smaller than the top surface of the resistance transition layer. The protection layer is disposed above the resistance transformation layer and surrounds the cap layer. At least a portion of the second electrode is disposed over the cap layer and covers the protective layer. The invention can prevent the cover layer from being damaged by the subsequent manufacturing process by arranging the protective layer surrounding the cover layer on the memory device, thereby improving the reliability of the memory device and increasing the manufacturing process allowance.

title_en: Polarizing plate and circularly polarizing plate
abstract_en: The polarizing plate is provided with a substrate and a polarizing plate, wherein the polarizing plate is provided with a polarizing layer in which a dichroic dye is aligned and which has a thickness of 5 [ mu ] m or less, and wherein the polarizing plate has an absorbance (A1) in the absorption axis direction of 0.3 to 1.5 at a wavelength of 380 to 760nm and an absorbance (A2) in the transmission axis direction of 0.001 to 0.15.

title_en: Process for realizing three-step polishing of large-size silicon wafer for MEMS (micro-electromechanical systems) on single polishing machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a process for realizing three-step polishing of a large-size silicon wafer for MEMS (micro-electromechanical systems), which is implemented on a single polishing machine, and comprises three steps of coarse polishing, middle polishing and fine polishing, wherein the same polishing cloth is used in each polishing step, polishing solutions with different proportions and concentrations are used in different polishing steps, and the corresponding effect of each polishing step is realized by matching and adjusting all process parameters among the polishing steps.
