The total thickness variation of the wafer polished in this way can be maintained to a level of 2 μm or less, and the flatness can be maintained to a level of 0.5 μm or less, effectively improving the processing efficiency.

title_en: Shielded gate power MOSFET with floating electrode and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shielded gate power MOSFET device with a floating electrode and a manufacturing method thereof, belongs to the technical field of power semiconductor devices, and solves the problems of larger transfer capacitance and smaller breakdown voltage in the prior art. A shielded gate power MOSFET device having a floating electrode, comprising a plurality of periodically arranged cells, each of said cells comprising a shielding electrode, a floating electrode, and a trench gate electrode; the shielding electrode is positioned in the middle of the groove; the floating electrodes are positioned on two sides of the shielding electrode and are arranged in the grooves; the trench gate electrode is positioned at the top of the trench; the shielding electrode, the floating electrode, the trench gate electrode and the inner side surface of the trench are isolated from each other by an isolating dielectric layer. The breakdown voltage of the device is improved, and the figure of merit of the device is improved.

title_en: Light-emitting diode forming die
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light-emitting diode forming die, which comprises a base, a first supporting rod, a forming mechanism for forming a diode and a material injection mechanism for feeding materials into the forming mechanism, wherein the first supporting rod is vertically arranged on the base, the forming mechanism is arranged on the first supporting rod, the first support rod is provided with a first mounting plate and a second mounting plate which are horizontally arranged, the first mounting plate is positioned below the second mounting plate, the first mounting plate is provided with two mounting plates which are arranged in parallel, when the forming shell on the forming component I is matched with the forming shell on the forming component II, the clamp clamps the two electrodes and places the two electrodes in the groove of the forming shell, the gun head of the material injection gun extends into the groove of the forming shell to inject materials into the forming shell, after the diode is formed, and the first conveying belt and the second conveying belt move, and the forming shell on the first forming assembly is separated from the forming shell on the second forming assembly.

title_en: Microfluidic device for the continuous ejection of a fluid and associated manufacturing process
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to microfluidic devices for continuous ejection of fluids and related manufacturing processes. A micro-fluidic device for continuous ejection of fluid, comprising: a semiconductor body laterally defining a chamber; forming an intermediate structure of membranes, each membrane defining on top a corresponding chamber; and a nozzle body covering the intermediate structure. For each chamber, the apparatus comprises: a corresponding piezoelectric actuator; a supply passage passing through the intermediate structure and communicating with the chamber; and a nozzle passing through the nozzle body and communicating with the supply passage. Each actuator may be controlled to: i) Operating in a rest condition so that the pressure of the fluid inside the corresponding chamber is equal to: so that the fluid passes through the supply channel and is ejected from the nozzle in a continuous stream; ii) operating in an active condition in which it causes deformation of the corresponding membrane and consequent variation of the pressure of the fluid, thus causing temporary interruption of the continuous flow.

title_en: Three-dimensional fan-out type packaging structure with multiple stacked chips and packaging method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional fan-out type packaging structure of a multi-chip stack and a packaging method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductor packaging. The second packaging body is stacked above the first packaging body and is in telecommunication connection through the rewiring metal layer II (6), the chip I (4) is connected with the chip II (8) through the metal pins (44) and the rewiring metal layer II (6) in sequence, and/or the chip I (4) conducts electric signals downwards through the metal pins (44), the rewiring metal layer II (6), the metal interconnection columns (53) and the rewiring metal layer I (3) in sequence. The packaging structure solves the problem that the existing three-dimensional fan-out type packaging structure cannot be applied to the ultrahigh-density multi-chip module.

title_en: Display device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display device and a manufacturing method thereof, the display device is provided with a display area and a non-display area arranged at the peripheral side of the display area, the display device comprises: the display panel comprises an array substrate, wherein the array substrate comprises a first surface and a second surface which are sequentially arranged along the light emergent direction of the display panel; the driving unit is positioned in a non-display area of the array substrate; the middle frame assembly comprises a supporting plate and a connecting glue layer which are connected with each other, the supporting plate is positioned on the side where the first surface of the array substrate is located, and the connecting glue layer is connected between the supporting plate and the first surface of the array substrate; the heat conduction assembly is thermally connected with the driving unit and comprises a first heat transfer piece, and the first heat transfer piece is located between the first surface of the array substrate and the connecting glue layer. The display device provided by the invention can heat the connection adhesive layer, improves the buffer performance of the connection adhesive layer in various environments, and improves the stability and the display effect of the display panel in various environments.

title_en: Terminal structure of semiconductor device and insulated gate bipolar transistor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a terminal structure of a semiconductor device and an insulated gate bipolar transistor. The terminal structure of the semiconductor device includes: a main junction, a field limiting ring and a stop ring; the field limiting ring is positioned between the main junction and the stop ring; a drift layer, said main junction, said field limiting ring and said cut-off ring sharing said drift layer; the main junction comprises a first diffusion region and a second diffusion region which are positioned at the top of the drift layer, the first diffusion region is positioned at one end, far away from the field limiting ring, of the second diffusion region, and the depth of the first diffusion region is smaller than that of the second diffusion region; the main junction further includes at least one first trench located within the first diffusion region; the first groove is used for driving a part of current paths in the main junction to flow longitudinally. The invention can improve the breakdown voltage of the device and ensure the reliability of the terminal structure of the device.

title_en: Multichannel DDS chip substrate packaging structure and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel DDS chip substrate packaging structure and a multichannel DDS chip substrate packaging method, wherein the wiring of multichannel differential pair signals, the layout of power supply ground planes, the arrangement of bonding fingers and leading-out terminals are designed, the differential pairs of each channel adopt an arc-shaped wiring and non-parallel wiring mode, the power supply ground planes are laid on the lower layer and the lower layer of the differential pair in the horizontal direction, the power supply ground planes of each channel are mutually independent and keep a certain isolation distance, the crosstalk and the coupling between the power supply ground planes of each channel are reduced, the signal loss of a multichannel DDS chip is obviously reduced, and the isolation between transmission channels is improved. The method aims to solve the technical problems that in the prior art, the attenuation of multi-channel DDS chip signals is more and more serious, and the isolation between transmission channels is lower and more.

title_en: Organic spin valve device based on two-dimensional metal organic framework thin film material and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic spin valve device based on a two-dimensional metal organic framework thin film material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a strip-shaped lanthanum strontium manganese oxygen bottom electrode on a substrate by a magnetron sputtering method to obtain the substrate with the strip-shaped lanthanum strontium manganese oxygen bottom electrode; (2) immersing the substrate in the step (1) into an aminosilane solution for reaction, taking out, washing and drying; (3) dissolving copper salt, nickel salt or cobalt salt to prepare solution A, and preparing organic ligand to prepare solution B; (4) sequentially soaking the product obtained in the step (2) in the solution A and the solution B; (5) drying; and (4) evaporating a layer of metal cobalt film as a top electrode on the upper surface of the product obtained in the step (5) through a strip-shaped mask plate, and evaporating a gold film as a protective layer to obtain the composite material. The method disclosed by the invention can effectively solve the problems that the two-dimensional metal organic framework material is difficult to dissolve and form a film, is simple, low in cost and low in requirement on equipment, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Display panel, manufacturing method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display panel, a manufacturing method and a display device. The display panel includes: a substrate having a display region and a non-display region; a planarization layer covering the display region and the non-display region of the substrate; the organic light-emitting element is positioned in the display area and positioned on one side, far away from the substrate, of the planarization layer; packaging structure, parcel organic light emitting component, packaging structure include the first inorganic layer, organic layer and the inorganic layer of second that stack gradually the setting, and first inorganic layer and the inorganic layer of second extend to the non-display area in, and first inorganic layer is close to the planarization layer setting, and display panel satisfies at least one of following condition: a third inorganic layer in the non-display region and between the planarization layer and the first inorganic layer; the part of the planarization layer, which is positioned in the non-display area, is provided with a groove, and the groove is filled with a tough water-oxygen blocking material. Therefore, the problem of poor lateral packaging effect can be effectively solved, the packaging effect is improved, the service life of the display panel is prolonged, and the optical effect of the display area is guaranteed.

title_en: Battery pack production equipment and battery pack production method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery pack production device and a battery pack production method, wherein the battery pack production device comprises: the device comprises a battery string component grabbing device, a bus bar bearing device, a welding device and a transparent bearing plate; the battery string component grabbing device is used for grabbing the battery string components; the bus bar bearing device comprises a first bus bar bearing platform, a middle bus bar bearing platform and a second bus bar bearing platform, end bus bars are respectively borne and then are moved to a welding station, and the battery string assembly grabbing device moves the battery string assembly above the bus bar bearing device, so that welding strips of the battery string assembly respectively correspond to the end bus bars on the first bus bar bearing platform, the middle bus bar bearing platform and the second bus bar bearing platform; the welding device is used for welding the welding strip of the battery string component with the end bus bar below the welding strip; the battery string grabbing device places the welded battery string assembly on the transparent bearing plate. The technical scheme provided by the invention can improve the production efficiency of the battery pack.

title_en: Heat-resistant pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet for semiconductor device production
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a heat-resistant pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet for semiconductor device production. The heat-resistant pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet for semiconductor device production of the present invention comprises: a substrate layer; and a first adhesive layer disposed on one side of the substrate layer, wherein the ratio of 180 DEG peel adhesion N2 to a stainless steel plate after the first adhesive layer is heated at 100 to 150 ℃, preferably 130 ℃ for 3 to 10 minutes to 180 DEG peel adhesion N1 to the stainless steel plate at 20 to 25 ℃, preferably 23 ℃, is N2/N1 & lt 2, preferably N2/N1 & lt 1.5. The heat-resistant pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet for semiconductor device production of the present invention can be gently peeled after use without causing adhesive residue to the encapsulating resin and the chip after encapsulation when used for temporarily fixing the chip in a method for producing a substrate-less semiconductor package without using a metal lead frame.

title_en: Insulating structure of high electron mobility transistor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an insulating structure of a high electron mobility transistor (high electron mobility transistor, HEMT) and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the insulating structure of the high electron mobility transistor comprises a gallium nitride layer, an aluminum gallium nitride layer, a groove, an insulating layer and a passivation layer, wherein the gallium nitride layer is arranged on the gallium nitride layer, the groove is arranged in the gallium nitride layer and the aluminum gallium nitride layer, the insulating layer is arranged in the groove, a top surface of the insulating layer is aligned with a top surface of the aluminum gallium nitride layer, and the passivation layer is arranged on the aluminum gallium nitride layer and the insulating layer.

title_en: Dual gate conductor transistor and related methods
abstract_en: A lateral double-diffused metal oxide semiconductor (LDMOS) transistor includes a silicon semiconductor structure and a vertical gate. The vertical gate includes: a first gate conductor and a second gate conductor each extending into the silicon semiconductor structure in a thickness direction from a first outer surface of the silicon semiconductor structure, (b) a first isolation dielectric layer isolating the first gate conductor from the second gate conductor within the vertical gate, and (c) a gate dielectric layer isolating each of the first gate conductor and the second gate conductor from the silicon semiconductor structure.

title_en: Mask plate and mask plate assembly
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mask plate and mask plate subassembly, this mask plate includes: an etched region, a bonding region, an opening region and a non-etched region. The etching area comprises a first end and a second end which are opposite to each other; a bonding region at the first and second ends of the etch region; the opening area is at least formed at the first end or the second end of the etching area and is positioned on one side, away from the etching area, of the welding area, and the opening area comprises a plurality of first openings; and the non-etching area is positioned at the first end and the second end of the etching area and is positioned at one side of the opening area, which deviates from the etching area. The mask plate improves the wrinkle condition of an etching area, and reduces the conditions of vapor deposition shadow and color mixing.

title_en: Mechanical arm for transmitting wafer and wafer cleaning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical arm for transmitting a wafer and a wafer cleaning device. The first arm and the second arm are connected to the bottom of the base body. The first arm and the second arm are arranged oppositely and used for clamping a plurality of wafers arranged along one direction. The first nozzle is arranged on the first arm or the base body, and the second nozzle is arranged on the second arm or the base body. The mechanical arm and the wafer cleaning device have the function of preventing the wafer from being dried prematurely.

title_en: Lateral diffusion metal oxide semiconductor device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lateral diffusion metal oxide semiconductor device and a manufacturing method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a substrate with a first groove on the surface; forming an isolation structure; forming field plate dielectric structures on two sides of the first groove, forming a drain region in the substrate, wherein at least part of the drain region is covered by the field plate dielectric structures; forming a source region in the substrate at the middle position of the first trench; and forming a grid on the surface of the field plate dielectric structure, wherein the grid extends downwards to the surface of the substrate at the bottom of the second groove along the field plate dielectric structure. The field plate dielectric structure is formed by etching the isolation structure in the first groove, is compatible with the traditional shallow groove isolation process, does not increase extra field plate forming steps, and has the advantages that a source-drain current path is close to a straight line along the bottom of the first groove when the device is conducted, so that the current path between a source electrode region and a drain electrode region is effectively shortened when the device is conducted, the current crowding problem does not exist, and the on-resistance of the device is reduced.

title_en: Semiconductor package with flexible interconnect
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to semiconductor packages with flexible interconnects. A cavity type semiconductor package having a substrate and a lid is disclosed. The semiconductor package includes a first semiconductor die coupled to a substrate; and a layer of flexible material on a surface of the cover. The traces are located on the layer of flexible material. The cover is coupled to the substrate with a layer of flexible material and traces between the cover and the substrate. The second semiconductor die is coupled to the flexible material layer and the traces on the cap. The cap also includes an aperture to expose the second semiconductor die to an ambient environment. The layer of flexible material absorbs stress caused by the different coefficients of thermal expansion of the lid and the substrate during operational cycles of the package to reduce the likelihood of the lid separating from the substrate.

title_en: Thyristor surge suppressor with low capacitance and low residual voltage and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thyristor surge suppressor with low capacitance and low residual voltage characteristics, which comprises a P-type silicon chip, and the manufacturing method mainly comprises the following steps: p-type substrate preparation-oxide layer growth-N + Area photoetching, prediffusion redistribution-P in P type substrate + Area photoetching, prediffusion redistribution-N-BASE area prediffusion redistribution in P type substrate-N-BASE area N ++ Lithography, diffusion-P in N-BASE region ++ Photoetching, diffusion, photoetching and etching of chip edge grooves, passivation of grooves, photoetching and etching of contact holes, metal coating, photoetching, etching, alloying, annealing and the like. According to the invention, the thyristor surge suppressor with low capacitance and low residual voltage characteristics is designed through the optimization of an internal electric field.

title_en: Lead frame levelling collimation loading attachment
abstract_en: A lead frame leveling and aligning feeder, comprising: the conveying mechanisms are uniformly arranged at intervals, and the supporting mechanisms are arranged between the adjacent conveying mechanisms; the conveying mechanism comprises a lower roller and an upper roller which are arranged in pairs at intervals; supporting mechanism, including fixed brace table, remove the brace table, it is equipped with a carriage release lever and a guide bar to remove the brace table bottom surface, fixed brace table runs through and is equipped with a pair of guide channel, guide bar sliding fit is in guide channel, fixed brace table bottom surface rotates and is provided with adjusting gear, adjusting gear and an adjusting motor output shaft, a carriage release lever side is equipped with tooth portion, the carriage release lever that both sides removed the brace table meshes in tooth portion both sides through tooth portion respectively, fixed brace table is equipped with the direction stopper, it is equipped with at least one guide roller to remove the brace table. Copper sheet conveying is carried out on the copper foil coil after cutting, assembly line type leveling collimation is achieved, feeding is carried out on a stamping die after leveling, adaptability adjustment can be carried out according to the width and the thickness of the copper sheet, and the practicability is high.

title_en: Temperature self-measurement and control operational amplifier chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature self-measurement and control operational amplifier chip, which comprises an upper radiating plate, a packaging chip and a lower supporting component, wherein the packaging chip comprises an upper cover plate and a lower protection frame, an inner cavity of the lower protection frame is filled with a packaging body, the inner cavity of the packaging body is connected with the chip in a gluing way, the surface of the chip is connected with heat conduction paste in a gluing way, the surface of the heat conduction paste is attached to the bottom of the upper cover plate, and a heat conduction groove is formed in the surface of the upper cover plate; the invention relates to the technical field of operational amplifier chips. This temperature is from fortune of observing and controling and is put chip, when using, prop up encapsulation chip through lower supporting component, prevent encapsulation chip direct with the contact of PCB board, effectively isolated thermal input, through the contact between last heating panel and the upper cover plate, go out the heat transfer that the chip during operation produced, effectually give off the heat, the bottom prevents heat input, the top is with heat effluvium, can effectively prevent encapsulation chip temperature too high.

title_en: Wire bonding device
abstract_en: The invention comprises the following steps: an ultrasonic horn (14) to which two ultrasonic vibrations are input and which can vibrate a welding pin (15) attached to the tip thereof in the Y direction and the X direction at different frequencies; and a control unit (50) that adjusts the magnitude of each of the two ultrasonic vibrations, wherein the Y direction is the direction in which the ultrasonic horn (14) extends, and wherein the control unit (50) adjusts the ratio (DeltaY/DeltaX) of the amplitudes of the welding pin (15) in the Y direction and the X direction by adjusting the magnitude of each of the two ultrasonic vibrations. Thus, the deterioration of the bonding quality between the bonding wire and the lead is suppressed.

title_en: Integrated CMOS source drain formation with advanced control
abstract_en: A finFET device includes doped source and/or drain extensions disposed between a gate spacer of the finFET and a body semiconductor portion of a semiconductor substrate on which the n-doped or p-doped source or drain extensions are disposed. Doped source or drain extensions are formed in the cavities formed adjacent to the gate spacers by a Selective Epitaxial Growth (SEG) process. After the cavity is formed, Advanced Process Control (APC) (i.e., integrated metrology) is used to determine the recess distance without exposing the substrate to an oxidizing ambient. The isotropic etch process, metrology, and selective epitaxial growth may be performed in the same platform.

title_en: Mask plate and manufacturing method of three-dimensional memory
abstract_en: The invention provides a mask plate and a manufacturing method of a three-dimensional memory. The alignment pattern in the mask plate comprises a plurality of alignment units which are arranged at intervals along a first direction, and the minimum distance between every two adjacent alignment units is H 1 Each alignment unit is composed of a plurality of alignment regions arranged at intervals along the second direction, and the minimum distance between adjacent alignment regions is H 2 ，H 1 Greater than H 2 Each alignment area has a first length in a first direction and a second length in a second direction, a ratio of the first length to the second length is greater than 1, and the first direction and the second direction areAn included angle is formed between the two directions. On the premise of aligning patterns with the same size, the aligning areas in the same line in the aligning unit in the traditional mask plate can be communicated, and the size of the aligning areas is expanded, so that the aligning holes formed by the mask plate can be filled with enough conductive materials, aligning signals in the subsequent photoetching process are ensured, and the aligning effect is improved.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor structure and a preparation method thereof, which are applied to the technical field of semiconductors. In the preparation method of the semiconductor structure, under the condition that the floating gate layer is shielded by the hard mask layer, the shallow trench isolation structure is subjected to ion implantation and annealing treatment, so that impurity ions implanted into the shallow trench isolation structure are diffused into the floating gate layer, namely, the concentration of the doped ions gathered at the lower end of the floating gate layer is reduced while the floating gate layer is doped, the increase of crystal grains of polycrystalline silicon of the floating gate layer is inhibited, the reduction of the number of energy valleys contained in the interface of the floating gate layer and the tunneling oxide layer is avoided, the operation time of a storage unit in the erasing operation is finally reduced, and the erasing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Packaging structure of light-emitting device
abstract_en: The application relates to a packaging structure of a light-emitting device. The packaging structure comprises: the light-emitting module comprises a heat-conducting substrate, a first circuit, a light-emitting chip and a light-reflecting module; the first circuit is fixedly arranged on the heat conducting substrate, the light emitting chip is fixedly arranged on the first circuit, and the light emitting chip is electrically connected with the first circuit; the light reflection module is all fixedly arranged on the first circuit and used for reflecting light signals emitted by the light emitting chip along a first direction, particularly enabling the light signals emitted by the side face of the light emitting chip to be gathered along the first direction, wherein the first direction is the light emitting direction of the light emitting device. The scheme that this application provided can realize good light reflectivity and thermal diffusivity simultaneously.

title_en: Vertical memory device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The vertical memory device includes a channel extending vertically over the substrate. The charge storage structure is disposed on a sidewall of the channel. The gate electrodes are vertically spaced apart from each other and surround the charge storage structure. The first insulating pattern includes an air gap between gate electrodes. The charge storage structure includes a tunnel insulating layer, a charge trapping pattern, and a first blocking pattern that are sequentially stacked horizontally. The charge storage structure includes charge trapping patterns vertically spaced apart from each other. Each of the charge trapping patterns horizontally faces one of the gate electrodes. The length of the outer sidewall of each of the charge trapping patterns facing the first blocking pattern in the first direction is smaller than the length of the inner sidewall thereof facing the tunnel insulating layer in the first direction.

title_en: Thin-layer SOI-LDMOS device with in-vivo conductive channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thin-layer SOI-LDMOS device with an internal conductive channel, belonging to the technical field of semiconductor power devices. On the basis of a traditional thin-layer SOI-LDMOS device, a surface grid is transferred into a buried oxide layer to form an internal grid, and an internal conductive channel is formed on the lower surface of a P-body. Meanwhile, silicon dioxide is etched and filled in a drift region of the device, and the device has the following advantages: when conducting in forward direction, the control ability of internal gate voltage to current is greatly improved, and transconductance g of the device mMAX Compared with a traditional device and a traditional super junction device, the doped concentration of the drift region can be improved by respectively improving 298.7% and 87.1%, and further etching and filling silicon dioxide in the drift region, so that the specific on-resistance of the device is reduced, and finally the Baliga excellent value FOM of the device is improved.

title_en: Method for improving growth quality of silicon carbide epitaxial film
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for improving the growth quality of a silicon carbide epitaxial film, which comprises the steps of cleaning a substrate and placing the substrate on a small disc in a reaction chamber; vacuumizing the reaction chamber, introducing hydrogen, and performing constant-temperature etching; changing the pressure and the temperature of the reaction chamber in a linear gradual change mode within 20-100 s, and simultaneously introducing a carbon source and a silicon source, wherein the molar ratio of C/Si is gradually changed from 0 to 0.80-1.10; changing the flow of a carbon source and the flow of a silicon source within 20-100 s by adopting a linear gradual change mode, and keeping the C/Si molar ratio unchanged; and (3) changing the temperature, the pressure, the carbon source flow and the silicon source flow to a target condition in a linear gradual change mode within 20-100 s, and growing the epitaxial film to the target thickness. The method for improving the growth quality of the silicon carbide epitaxial film can obviously reduce the crystal defects of the epitaxial film, and has the advantages of simple process control, strong operability and better application prospect.

title_en: Diffusion process method of high-compactness oxide layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of solar cell production. A diffusion process method of a high-compactness oxide layer comprises the following steps of pre-oxidation, first-step deposition, first-step propulsion, second-step deposition, second-step propulsion, third-step deposition, third-step propulsion and post-oxidation. Through pre-oxidation and multiple distributed deposition propulsion, the PN junction depth is effectively improved, the dead layer is reduced, and the recombination is reduced; through post-oxidation, the low temperature and high concentration are used for deposition, so that the thickness of an oxide layer is increased, the phosphorus source cannot be further diffused into a cell, and the difficulty in controlling a diffused semi-finished product is reduced.

title_en: Method for removing colloid
abstract_en: A method for removing colloids, comprising the steps of: providing a body to be separated, wherein the body to be separated comprises a first connecting body and a second connecting body, and the first connecting body and the second connecting body are fixedly connected through the colloid, wherein the first connecting body and/or the second connecting body contain gold elements, and the colloid contains epoxy resin; and mixing the body to be separated with nitric acid to obtain the separated first connector and second connector. The colloid removing method provided by the invention is simple and convenient, the using amount of nitric acid is small, and the first connecting body and the second connecting body in the body to be separated are separated in a short time, so that the separation purpose is achieved; meanwhile, the separated first connector and the second connector cannot be corroded by nitric acid, and the complete appearance can be still maintained, so that the observation is facilitated.

title_en: Preparation method of flexible gallium arsenide solar cell for space
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a flexible gallium arsenide solar cell for space, which comprises the following steps: evaporating a lower electrode on the back of the epitaxial wafer, photoetching a slotted region on a light receiving surface, preparing an insulating layer on the insulating region, photoetching upper and lower electrode welding spots, and evaporating an upper electrode; and then evaporating an antireflection film, photoetching a welding spot area, removing the antireflection film in the welding spot area, and finally scribing to obtain the flexible gallium arsenide solar cell for the space. The invention has the advantages that the problem of short circuit of the flexible gallium arsenide solar cell during welding is effectively solved, and if the welding process adopts a ground common conductive adhesive bonding process, the reliability of the cell welding is far lower than that of fusion welding resistance.

title_en: Nitrogen-containing compound, electronic component, and electronic device
abstract_en: The present application relates to a nitrogen-containing compound, an electronic component containing the nitrogen-containing compound, and an electronic device containing the electronic component. The nitrogen-containing compound is combined with an adamantyl group and a bistriarylamine structure to form a core structure, the whole molecule forms a large conjugated system, meanwhile, the molecular rigidity is increased, and the thermal stability is obviously improved. When the nitrogen-containing compound of the present application is applied to an electronic component, the light emission efficiency or the power generation efficiency of the electronic component can be improved, and the life can be prolonged.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device includes a substrate and a light sensing unit disposed on the substrate. The photosensitive unit comprises a photodiode, a dielectric layer and a second electrode. Arranged on the substrate and including a side wall and an upper surface. The dielectric layer is disposed on the substrate and on the sidewall of the photodiode, and contacts the first portion of the upper surface of the photodiode. And a second electrode including a first conductive layer and a second conductive layer, the first conductive layer being disposed on a second portion of the upper surface of the photodiode, the second conductive layer being disposed on the dielectric layer and the first conductive layer. The first portion of the photodiode upper surface surrounds the second portion.

title_en: Conductive plate for display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a conductive plate for display equipment, which comprises a plurality of electrode connection area rows, a plurality of first conductive circuits, a plurality of second conductive circuits and a plurality of first transparent electric insulation layers, wherein the electrode connection area rows, the first conductive circuits, the second conductive circuits and the first transparent electric insulation layers are arranged on an electric insulation substrate. The second conductive lines are separated by respective electrode connection region rows each provided with a plurality of electrode connection regions electrically isolated from each other, and one end of any one of the second conductive lines between two adjacent electrode connection region rows is electrically connected to a single electrode contact in an electrode connection region. Each first transparent electric insulation layer is arranged between the second conductive wires which are electrically connected to the electrode connecting areas in the first section and the second section of the same electrode connecting area row respectively. At least part of the second conductive lines electrically connected to the electrode connecting areas in the second section and the first section of the same electrode connecting area row are correspondingly overlapped in the display direction of the display device.

title_en: Organic photoelectric device and display device
abstract_en: The application provides an organic photoelectric device and a display device. An organic optoelectronic device and a display device including the same are disclosed. The organic photoelectric device includes an anode and a cathode opposite to each other, a light emitting layer between the anode and the cathode, a hole transporting layer between the anode and the light emitting layer, and a hole transporting auxiliary layer between the light emitting layer and the hole transporting layer, wherein the light emitting layer includes a composition including a first compound represented by chemical formula 1 and a second compound represented by chemical formula 2, and the hole transporting auxiliary layer includes a third compound represented by chemical formula 3. The detailed descriptions of chemical formulas 1 to 3 are the same as those described in the specification.

title_en: High-resolution microdisplay defect repairing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for repairing defects of a high-resolution micro-display, which specifically comprises the following steps: s1, defining the brightness threshold of the bright spot, and positioning the coordinate of the bright spot in the micro display; and S2, guiding the bright spot coordinates into the focused particle beam equipment, and performing defect repair on the pixels corresponding to the bright spot coordinates by the focused particle beam equipment. The invention automatically positions the defect coordinate by using the automatic point screen and the optical test equipment, the FIB equipment automatically positions according to the defect coordinate, and the FIB directly deposits the shielding layer or firstly cuts and then deposits the protective layer, thereby realizing the automatic positioning and automatic repair of the defect, solving the problems of poor laser repair precision and incapability of repairing the micro-display and simultaneously avoiding the problems of adjacent pixel failure and packaging failure caused by the laser repair heat effect.

title_en: Semiconductor vertical IGBT based on longitudinal Schottky tunneling emitter junction and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor vertical IGBT based on a longitudinal Schottky tunneling emitter junction and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: the device comprises a P + substrate layer (1), an n + buffer layer (2), an n-drift layer (3), two emitting electrodes (4), a gate dielectric layer (5), a grid electrode (6), two metal thickening layers (7), a passivation layer (8) and a collector electrode (9). The invention simplifies the process manufacturing process of the IGBT power device, enables the IGBT power device to realize the function of the device without a P-type base region, improves the breakdown voltage of the device and reduces the on-resistance of the device, thereby improving the high output power performance of the device.

title_en: Sheet for forming resin film and composite sheet for forming resin film
abstract_en: The invention provides a resin film forming sheet with excellent re-peeling performance and a composite sheet for forming resin film, which has a structure formed by directly laminating the resin film forming sheet and a support, wherein the resin film forming sheet is a sheet which is pasted on a silicon wafer and is used for forming the resin film on the silicon wafer, and the surface roughness (Ra) of the surface (alpha) of the sheet on the side to be pasted with the silicon wafer is more than 40 nm.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: A semiconductor structure and a forming method thereof are provided, wherein the forming method comprises the following steps: providing a substrate, wherein the substrate comprises a substrate and a fin part positioned on the substrate, and the direction vertical to the extending direction of the fin part is transverse; forming an isolation material layer covering partial side walls of the fin portion on the substrate, wherein the fin portion exposed by the isolation material layer is a top fin portion; forming a protective layer on the side wall of the top fin part; removing the isolation material layer with partial thickness to form an isolation layer, wherein the fin part covered by the isolation layer is a bottom fin part; thinning the side walls of the fin parts exposed out of the protective layer and the isolation layer along the transverse direction to form neck fin parts; and forming a grid structure, wherein the grid structure covers part of the top wall and part of the side wall of the top fin part and the neck fin part. According to the embodiment of the invention, the neck fin part obtained by thinning treatment has smaller transverse size, and the bottom of the grid structure covers the neck fin part, so that the bottom of the grid structure has stronger control capability on the neck fin part, and the improvement of the electrical property of the semiconductor structure is facilitated.

title_en: FRD device with high heat dissipation performance and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an FRD device with high heat dissipation and a manufacturing process thereof, wherein the FRD device comprises the following steps: the LED chip comprises a diode chip and a shell, wherein a bottom plate is fixed inside the shell, pins extend from the diode chip, the pins extend out of the shell, the pins are fixed on the bottom plate, the shell is provided with a light-transmitting plate, and the light-transmitting plate is positioned above the diode chip; the shell is provided with a heat dissipation device communicated with the inside of the shell and the outside. The invention aims to provide an FRD device with high heat dissipation efficiency and stable performance.

title_en: Vertical metal ceramic packaging shell, device and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vertical metal ceramic packaging shell, a packaging device and a preparation method, wherein the vertical metal ceramic packaging shell comprises: the structure of the lower packaging shell is symmetrical to that of the upper packaging shell, and the cover plate is symmetrical to that of the upper packaging shell; wherein, lower encapsulation shell includes: a lower ceramic substrate and lower metal interconnection columns penetrating the upper and lower surfaces of the lower ceramic substrate; a first metal side wall is arranged in a first area of the upper surface of the lower ceramic substrate in an enclosing mode, and a second metal side wall extends outwards from one side of the first metal side wall of the mounting chip; the end faces of the first metal side wall and the second metal side wall are used as symmetrical surfaces for welding the lower packaging shell and the upper packaging shell, and the cover plate is used for sealing the chip sealing cavity. The vertical cermet package device includes: and welding the packaged chip in a chip accommodating cavity in the vertical metal ceramic packaging shell, and then welding the cover plate to form an airtight packaging device. The micro-channel is electroplated in the packaging shell to serve as a heat dissipation channel, so that the packaging requirement of the high-frequency TR module is met.

title_en: Semiconductor processing equipment
abstract_en: A semiconductor processing apparatus includes a lower chamber defining a receiving area and a first receiving recess; an upper cavity disposed above the lower cavity and defining a second recess projectably aligned with the first recess and configured to form a sealed connection with the lower cavity to form a chamber enclosed area at the receiving area; and a gasket member configured to be disposed between the lower cavity and the upper cavity. The washer member includes: a conductive member assembled to laterally surround the receiving area and fitted into the lower cavity and the upper cavity, respectively; and a resilient member protruding from the conductive member and extending toward the receiving region, the resilient member being configured to be compressed by the lower cavity and the upper cavity to seal the chamber enclosed region.

title_en: Power semiconductor module and composite module
abstract_en: The unevenness of current distribution among a plurality of power semiconductor chips is suppressed. The power semiconductor module includes: a module main body (103); a plurality of power semiconductor chips (1001) disposed on the upper surface of the module main body; and a peripheral structure (104A) which surrounds a part of the periphery of the module main body portion in a plan view, is an insulating ferromagnetic body, and is configured such that the plurality of power semiconductor chips are arranged in the vertical and horizontal directions in the plan view, and at least 1 power semiconductor chip is arranged so as to be surrounded by another power semiconductor chip.

title_en: Multi-chip module
abstract_en: A multi-chip module includes a substrate; a central lead frame and a plurality of peripheral lead frames on the substrate, the peripheral lead frames being located on at least one side of the central lead frame; the multilayer circuit board comprises at least three routing layers, a plurality of independent passive devices are pasted on the top layer surface of the multilayer circuit board, and the multilayer circuit board is pasted on a part of the central lead frame and at least a part of the peripheral lead frame. According to the technical scheme, the arrangement of passive devices by using bonding wires is avoided, the use of the bonding wires leading out of a multilayer circuit board to a peripheral lead frame is avoided, the number of the bonding wires in the multi-chip module is reduced, the influence of plastic package used in the packaging of the multi-chip module on the bonding wires is reduced, the influence of the plastic package on the electrical property of the multi-chip module is further reduced, and the problem that the multi-chip module fails due to overlarge plastic package influence is avoided.

title_en: System and method for managing liquid supply
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for managing a supply of liquid, comprising: the liquid level sensor comprises an air pressure regulator, a first liquid container, a second liquid container comprising a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet, a first liquid container, a first pipeline, a second pipeline, a liquid inlet sensor and a liquid outlet sensor, wherein the first liquid container is connected with the liquid inlet, the liquid outlet is connected with the second pipeline of the air pressure regulator, and the liquid inlet sensor is connected with the liquid outlet.

title_en: Green ceramic lamination device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green ceramic lamination device and a method, the method comprises the steps of placing green ceramic chips with positioning holes at four corners on a bearing table with positioning pins at four corners, adsorbing the green ceramic chips on the bearing table by adopting vacuum for demolding, then placing the demolded green ceramic chips on a collecting table with positioning pins at four corners by adopting a vacuum chuck, and spraying adhesive glue by utilizing the chuck for lamination. When the polyester film is removed by laminating, in order to ensure that the green ceramic chip is not damaged, the vacuum adsorption is utilized during film uncovering to firmly adsorb the green ceramic chip on the chip bearing platform, so that the front and back of the green ceramic chip are uniformly stressed, and the purposes of no deformation and no damage of the green ceramic chip are achieved.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device is provided. The display device includes a display panel having a front surface and a rear surface opposite to the front surface and including a plurality of display pads arranged on the front surface and arranged in one direction, a flexible printed circuit connected to the display pads and bent toward the rear surface of the display panel along a dummy bending axis extending in one direction, and a shielding member arranged on the flexible printed circuit, wherein the flexible printed circuit includes a first bending region adjacent to the display pads and a second bending region adjacent to the rear surface of the display panel based on an intersection with a dummy line extending from the bending axis in an intersecting direction intersecting the one direction, and the shielding member covers the second bending region.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device includes (i) a substrate having a first region, a second region, and a bending region between the first region and the second region, wherein the substrate is bent along a bending axis in the bending region, the substrate includes a thin portion at an edge portion of the bending region, and the thin portion extends from the second region to the first region and has a thickness smaller than a thickness of the substrate at a center of the bending region; and (ii) an inorganic insulating layer over the substrate, wherein the inorganic insulating layer exposes the thin portion in the bending region.

title_en: Radiation imaging apparatus
abstract_en: A radiation imaging apparatus according to one embodiment includes: a radiation detection panel; a base substrate having a support surface that supports the radiation detection panel; and a frame body which houses the radiation detection panel and the base substrate, the frame body having a top wall and a bottom wall, the base substrate having a protruding portion protruding outward from the radiation detection panel as viewed from a direction orthogonal to the support surface, a1 st extending portion provided on the support surface of the protruding portion, a 2 nd extending portion provided on a back surface of the protruding portion and disposed at a position facing the 1 st extending portion across the protruding portion, the base substrate being supported on the top wall via the 1 st extending portion and on the bottom wall via the 2 nd extending portion.

title_en: Wafer thickness detection mechanism and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wafer thickness detection mechanism and a wafer thickness detection method, wherein the wafer thickness detection mechanism comprises an L-shaped base, an x-axis adjustment mechanism, a y-axis adjustment mechanism, a wafer placement platform, an upper measuring head fine adjustment mechanism and a lower measuring head fine adjustment mechanism, wherein the L-shaped base is composed of a bottom plate and a side plate, the x-axis adjustment mechanism is arranged on the bottom plate, the upper part of the y-axis adjustment mechanism is connected with the wafer placement platform through a platform connecting block, the upper measuring head fine adjustment mechanism and the lower measuring head fine adjustment mechanism are respectively fixed on a measuring head fixing plate through an upper connecting block and a lower connecting block, the measuring head fixing plate is fixed on the side plate, the wafer placement platform is arranged between the upper measuring head fine adjustment mechanism and the lower measuring head fine adjustment mechanism, and the upper measuring head fine adjustment mechanism and the lower measuring head fine adjustment mechanism can carry out xyz theta four-axis fine adjustment. The invention uses the xyz theta four-axis fine adjustment platform, is matched with an adjustable Z axis, and uses the precise hand wheel to move the lead screw for the wafer placement platform, so that the whole structure is compact, and the convenience of measurement adjustment, measurement precision and convenience of carrying at any time are ensured.

title_en: Sucking and carrying device for optical module chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sucking and carrying device of an optical module chip, which structurally comprises a lifting seat, wherein a lifting table capable of moving up and down and a driving piece for driving the lifting table to move up and down are arranged on the lifting seat, the structure also comprises a floating rod, a movable groove penetrating up and down is arranged on the lifting table, the floating rod can vertically float up and down and is arranged in the movable groove, a sucker is arranged at the bottom of the floating rod, an adjusting piece for adaptively adjusting the up and down position of the floating rod is arranged at the top of the floating rod, a measuring piece for measuring the up and down floating distance of the floating rod is arranged in the movable groove, and a controller is arranged on the driving piece and is electrically connected with the measuring piece.

title_en: Heat exchanger
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heat exchanger (1) having a base body (2) which is thermally connected to a carbon nanostructure-based fiber (CNB), in particular a Carbon Nanotube (CNT). At least one gas channel (3) is provided, which is at least partially formed by the matrix (2), wherein the carbon nanostructure-based fibers (CNB) extend at least partially in the gas channel (3).

title_en: CPU and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a Central Processing Unit (CPU) and a manufacturing method thereof. Wherein the CPU comprises: the first semiconductor structure comprises at least one core, first-level to N-1-th-level buffers connected with the core in a signal mode, and a first bonding layer comprising a first conductive contact; wherein N is equal to three or four; a second semiconductor structure including an N-th level buffer and a second bonding layer including a second conductive contact; the N-level buffer comprises a three-dimensional phase change memory; the three-dimensional phase change memory comprises a plurality of memory cells; the memory cell includes: the first electrode layer, the gating layer, the second electrode layer, the phase change memory layer and the third electrode layer are sequentially stacked; a bonding layer located between the first semiconductor structure and the second semiconductor structure; wherein the first conductive contact is electrically connected with the second conductive contact at the bonding layer.

title_en: Light emitting diode and preparation method thereof, display panel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a light emitting diode and a preparation method thereof, and a display panel and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the light-emitting diode comprises the following steps: providing a substrate; forming an anode layer on a substrate; sequentially forming at least three nano luminescent layers with different colors and hole transport layers corresponding to the nano luminescent layers on the anode layer; the step of forming the nano-luminescent layer and the hole transport layer corresponding to the nano-luminescent layer comprises the following steps: sequentially arranging a hole transport material and a nano luminescent material on the anode layer; light irradiates a partial region of the nano luminescent material, passes through the nano luminescent material and is incident to a corresponding region of the hole transport material, and the hole transport material incident by the light generates photochemical reaction to generate a polarity change material with different polarities from the hole transport material; cleaning the hole transport material by using a solvent with the same polarity as the hole transport material, and simultaneously removing the nano luminescent material positioned on the hole transport material to obtain a hole transport layer and a nano luminescent layer; a cathode layer is formed.

title_en: Lifting device, positioning equipment and chamber equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a lifting device for lifting an object relative to a reference, a displacement apparatus and a chamber apparatus, the lifting device comprising: a support table formed with a receiving hole by which the object is held; a motor fixed to the support table or the reference object; and at least one pair of lift assemblies. Each lifting assembly comprises: a nut fixed to the reference object; and a lead screw vertically coupled between the nut and the support table. The upper end of the lead screw and the motor are in driving connection with each other through a transmission mechanism which is in synchronous transmission between the upper end of the lead screw and the motor, the transmission mechanism is in the form of a belt transmission mechanism or a chain transmission mechanism, and a lead screw and nut pair is formed between the lower part of the lead screw and the nut; and the lifting device further comprises at least one locking assembly which is arranged to be respectively coupled with the lead screws of at least one pair of lifting assemblies and is configured to allow only one-way rotation of the lead screws.

title_en: Display module and display device
abstract_en: Disclosed are a display module and a display apparatus, the display module including: a flexible display screen; the supporting layer is positioned on the non-display side of the flexible display screen; the supporting layer comprises a first supporting part and a second supporting part positioned on at least one side of the first supporting part, and the elastic modulus of the first supporting part is smaller than that of the second supporting part; the tensioning piece comprises a first connecting part and a second connecting part which are connected with each other, the first connecting part is positioned on one side, away from the flexible display screen, of the first supporting part, and the second connecting part is positioned on one side, away from the flexible display screen, of the second supporting part; the elastic modulus of the first connecting portion is greater than that of the second connecting portion.

title_en: Driving back plate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driving back plate and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the driving back plate comprises a substrate, a lower metal layer with salient points and a micro-structural layer, wherein the lower metal layer with the salient points is arranged on the substrate and is used for butting an LED chip; the microstructure layer is arranged on the substrate and is attached to the side wall of the lower metal layer of the salient point; the upper surface of the micro-structure layer is higher than the upper surface of the lower metal layer of the salient point. When the driving back plate is installed, the LED chip is in butt joint with the lower metal layer of the salient point, the electrode of the LED chip and the lower metal layer of the salient point are wrapped by the micro-structural layer in the bonding process, the flowing of bonding metal in a molten state is limited, and the short circuit problem on the driving back plate is reduced.

title_en: Integration structure and integration method of detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated structure of a detector and a method thereof. An integration method of a detector comprises the following steps: manufacturing a reading circuit structure on a first substrate, and then forming a first dielectric layer on the surface of the reading circuit structure to obtain a substrate A; sequentially forming a germanium buffer layer, a stacked intrinsic layer, a P-type doped germanium layer and a second dielectric layer on the surface of the second substrate from bottom to top to obtain a substrate B; wherein the stacking intrinsic layer is formed by Ge layer and Ge 1‑x M x The layers are alternately and repeatedly stacked for n times, and M is Si or Sn; bonding the substrate A and the substrate B; removing the second substrate and the germanium buffer layer after bonding, then forming an N-type doped germanium layer on the surface of the stacked intrinsic layer, and then manufacturing a detector structure; read-out circuit structure and detectorThe structures are interconnected. The substrate of the detector which is not manufactured is bonded in the substrate of the reading circuit structure, so that the integration process is simplified, the integration level is improved, and the problem that the detector cannot be accurately aligned is solved.

title_en: Manufacturing method of electronic device
abstract_en: The invention provides a manufacturing method of an electronic device, which comprises the steps of providing a conductive carrier plate, wherein at least one electronic element is arranged on the conductive carrier plate, picking up the at least one electronic element, setting the conductive carrier plate to have a grounding voltage at least in the step of picking up the electronic element, and transferring the electronic element to a target substrate.

title_en: Mask, silicon-based OLED display panel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a mask, a silicon-based OLED display panel and a preparation method thereof, wherein the mask comprises a mask body, the mask body comprises an opening area, the opening area comprises a plurality of openings, and the openings are formed by adopting a laser drilling process. The size of the opening formed by adopting the laser drilling process is smaller, a light-emitting layer meeting the size of a light-emitting device in the silicon-based OLED display panel can be formed by utilizing a mask, and then light-emitting layers with different colors can be formed after the light-emitting layer is prepared by adopting the mask, so that the silicon-based OLED display panel does not need to be provided with a filter layer, and the transmittance of the silicon-based OLED display panel is improved; correspondingly, the light-emitting device in the silicon-based OLED display panel can ensure normal color display without too high light-emitting brightness, and further the power consumption of the silicon-based OLED display panel is reduced.

title_en: Dry etching machine and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dry etching, in particular to a dry etching machine and a using method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: the sealed passageway, the right side at sealed passageway top is run through and is provided with continuous feedway, the left side of sealed passageway is provided with surface cleaning equipment, conveyer belt top equidistance fixedly connected with conveyer of sealed passageway, conveyer's top equidistance fixedly connected with placement machine constructs, both sides equidistance fixedly connected with conveying axle equalling around the conveyer inner wall, the conveying axle with conveyer's bottom overlap joint, square mouth has been seted up at sealed passageway top. The gas generated by the process gas device is conveyed into the plurality of inner cavities of the plasma isolation plates through the conveying pipe, and the two plasma isolation plates are oppositely discharged, so that the gas between the two plasma isolation plates forms a plasma cluster, the number of electron losing can be increased, and the etching quality and efficiency are further increased.

title_en: Display substrate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a display substrate and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the display substrate comprises a source electrode and a drain electrode which are positioned on the substrate, a first interlayer dielectric layer which covers the source electrode and the drain electrode, a first conductor layer which is positioned on the first interlayer dielectric layer, the source electrode and the drain electrode, a first grid electrode insulating layer which is positioned on the first conductor layer, and a first grid electrode layer which is positioned on the first grid electrode insulating layer. The first interlayer dielectric layer is provided with openings above the source electrode and the drain electrode respectively, so that the first conductor layer can be connected with the source electrode and the drain electrode through the openings. The first conductor layer is used as an active layer and is connected with the source electrode and the drain electrode to be used as a lead of the source drain electrode, so that the source drain electrode lead does not need to be additionally formed, and the structure is simple. In addition, compared with the holes of the buffer layer and the interlayer dielectric layer in the existing structure, the holes of the first interlayer dielectric layer are reduced in depth, so that the process difficulty can be reduced.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the semiconductor structure comprises the following steps: providing a wafer group, wherein the wafer group comprises a first wafer to an Nth wafer, and N is an integer greater than or equal to 3; embedding a kth barrier layer in a partial area of the front surface of the kth wafer, wherein k is an integer which is more than or equal to 3 and less than or equal to N; embedding a first barrier layer in a partial region of the back surface of the first wafer; form the kth 2 After the barrier layer, bonding the k-th layer 2 Front surface and k-th surface of wafer 1 Back side of wafer, k 2 ‑k 1 ＝1，k 2 Is an integer of 3 or more and N or less; bonding the back surface of the first wafer and the front surface of the second wafer after the first barrier layer is formed; and etching the first wafer to the Nth wafer from the front surface of the first wafer by taking the first barrier layer, the third barrier layer and the Nth barrier layer as masks so as to form multi-step grooves in the first wafer to the Nth wafer. The bottom of the multi-step groove is smooth and has good appearanceAnd the precision is higher.

title_en: System on chip with ferroelectric random access memory and tunable capacitor
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a system-on-chip with ferroelectric random access memory and tunable capacitor. A semiconductor device includes a substrate, a first dielectric layer over the substrate, a memory cell over the substrate in a first region of the semiconductor device, wherein the memory cell includes a first ferroelectric structure in the first dielectric layer, wherein the first ferroelectric structure includes a first bottom electrode, a first top electrode, and a first ferroelectric layer interposed therebetween, and a tunable capacitor over the substrate in a second region of the semiconductor device, wherein the tunable capacitor includes a second ferroelectric structure, wherein the second ferroelectric structure includes a second bottom electrode, a second top electrode, and a second ferroelectric layer interposed therebetween, wherein at least a portion of the second ferroelectric structure is located in the first dielectric layer.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a semiconductor structure and a method of fabricating the same, the semiconductor structure including a first element in a substrate. The semiconductor structure includes a gap fill layer. The first portion of the gap fill layer covers the first element. The first portion of the gap fill layer has tapered sidewalls. The first portion of the substrate separates the first portion of the gap fill layer from the first element.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises an optical component area and a conventional display area; the substrate comprises a plurality of pixels, each pixel comprises a light-emitting device and a pixel driving circuit which are electrically connected; the light emitting device includes a first light emitting device and a second light emitting device; the conventional display area is provided with a first light-emitting device; the optical component area is provided with a second light emitting device; the optical component region includes a first optical component region and a second optical component region; the first optical member region includes a first light-transmitting region and a plurality of first light-shielding regions; the first light-shielding region covers at least one second light-emitting device; the second optical component area comprises a second light-transmitting area and a plurality of second light-shielding areas; the second light-shielding region covers at least one second light-emitting device; the first light-shielding area and the second light-shielding area have no parallel edges. The technical scheme provided by the invention can enhance the imaging effect of the photosensitive element area of the display panel.

title_en: Laser processing apparatus and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a laser processing device and a control method thereof, which can simply carry out laser processing of a wafer with high precision. The laser processing device is provided with: a detection control unit for detecting the positions of a plurality of planned dividing lines of the wafer; a laser processing control unit that executes laser processing based on a position detection result of the line to divide obtained by the detection control unit and positional relationship information of the first optical axis and the second optical axis; an imaging control unit which causes the infrared imaging optical system to perform imaging of a second captured image of the planned dividing lines in a state in which the infrared imaging optical system is focused on another surface of the wafer on the opposite side of the one surface; a calculation unit that calculates a positional deviation between a theoretical value and an actually measured value of a formation position of the modified region based on the positional relationship information and the second captured image; and a correction unit that corrects the positional relationship information based on the calculation result of the calculation unit, wherein the laser processing apparatus forms the modified region within a focusing range of the infrared imaging optical system in a state where the modified region is focused on the other surface in the thickness direction of the wafer.

title_en: Cleaning apparatus, cleaning method, and drying chamber for cleaning wafer carrier
abstract_en: A cleaning apparatus, method and drying chamber for cleaning a wafer carrier holding wafers as part of a semiconductor manufacturing process are provided. The cleaning apparatus includes a wet chamber containing a wafer carrier to be washed and a reservoir in fluid communication with the wet chamber. The reservoir stores a cleaning liquid for the wafer carrier introduced into the wet chamber during a washing operation, and the dry chamber is spaced apart from the wet chamber. The drying chamber accommodates the wafer carrier after washing the wafer carrier in the wet chamber and holds the wafer carrier during a drying operation. A transfer system transfers the wafer carrier between the wet chamber and the dry chamber during the cleaning process.

title_en: Stripping system and stripping method
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a system and method for stripping a pair of bonded wafers. In some embodiments, the stripping system comprises: a wafer chuck having a predetermined maximum lateral dimension and configured to rotate the pair of bonded wafers attached to a top surface of the wafer chuck; a pair of circular plate separating blades including a first separating blade and a second separating blade, the first separating blade and the second separating blade being arranged at edges of the pair of bonded wafers in a diametrical opposition to each other, wherein the first separating blade and the second separating blade are interposed between a first wafer and a second wafer of the pair of bonded wafers; and at least two sliders configured to pull the second wafer upward to peel the second wafer from the first wafer.

title_en: High-power protection system and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-power protection circuit and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-power protection circuit comprises a PIN amplitude limiter, a low-noise amplifier and a silicon substrate, wherein the output end of the PIN amplitude limiter is connected with the input end of the low-noise amplifier through a grounded coplanar waveguide; the input end of the PIN amplitude limiter and the output end of the low-noise amplifier form a GSG structure through the grounded coplanar waveguide, and signals enter the low-noise amplifier through the amplitude limiter; the PIN amplitude limiter and the low-noise amplifier are arranged in the silicon-based groove, a layer of BCB is coated to serve as a medium, and a metal layer is manufactured on the BCB to form an electrical connection structure and an input-output structure. The protection module packaged by the invention has small size and excellent signal transmission performance, and can effectively improve the protection capability of the low-noise amplifier on high-power microwaves. The BCB embedding and packaging process is adopted, so that the length of a lead is reduced, and the insertion loss of the protection module is reduced. By placing a PIN limiter at the input of the low noise amplifier, the damage threshold of the low noise amplifier can be raised.

title_en: Method for electrostatic discharge protection, electrostatic discharge circuit and integrated circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for electrostatic discharge protection, an electrostatic discharge circuit and an integrated circuit. According to an embodiment, a method for electrostatic discharge protection includes dividing a voltage between a plurality of circuit nodes using a voltage divider circuit to form a divided voltage, compensating for a temperature dependence of the divided voltage to form a temperature compensated divided voltage, monitoring the voltage between the plurality of circuit nodes using a transient detection circuit to form a transient detection signal, and activating a clamp circuit coupled between the plurality of circuit nodes based on the temperature compensated divided voltage and based on the transient detection signal.

title_en: Ferroelectric memory and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a ferroelectric memory and a method for manufacturing the same, the ferroelectric memory includes: a substrate; a first conductive layer disposed on the substrate; a patterned oxide layer disposed on the first conductive layer and the substrate to expose a portion of the first conductive layer; a second conductive layer disposed on the exposed first conductive layer and the patterned oxide layer; an antiferroelectric layer disposed on the exposed first conductive layer and the second conductive layer; a ferroelectric layer arranged on the second conductive layer and positioned on the antiferroelectric layer; a conductive oxide layer arranged between the antiferroelectric layers; and a third conductive layer disposed between the conductive oxide layer and the ferroelectric layer.

title_en: Base assembly, MOCVD device comprising base assembly and control method for leading out upper base from MOCVD device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a susceptor assembly and an MOCVD apparatus including the same, which reduces temperature deviation on a supporting surface by a double-layered structure of an upper susceptor and a lower susceptor. A base assembly according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a susceptor having a supporting surface for supporting a substrate while being in contact with the substrate; and a lower base supporting the upper base, the upper base and the lower base being coated with substances of different kinds from each other. According to the susceptor assembly and the MOCVD apparatus including the same of the present invention, by reducing temperature unevenness on a supporting surface supporting a substrate, a thin film having more uniform characteristics can be grown on the substrate, and a high yield can be obtained in manufacturing a device using the substrate grown by the MOCVD process.

title_en: Process chamber of semiconductor process equipment and semiconductor process equipment
