abstract_en: The invention provides a process chamber of semiconductor process equipment and the semiconductor process equipment, wherein a bearing part for bearing a wafer is arranged in the process chamber, a baffle ring assembly is arranged on the bearing part, the baffle ring assembly and the bearing part are matched to form a blowing gas channel capable of guiding gas to the edge of the wafer, the baffle ring assembly comprises a first ring body, a second ring body and a buffer part, the first ring body is arranged around the bearing part, a gap is formed between the first ring body and the bearing part, a positioning groove is arranged on the first ring body, a positioning part is arranged at the bottom of the second ring body, the positioning part is detachably inserted with the positioning groove, the second ring body shields the gap to form the blowing gas channel, and the buffer part is arranged between the positioning part and the surface opposite to the positioning groove and used for buffering the opposite acting force between the positioning part and the positioning groove. The technical scheme provided by the invention can avoid the damage of the baffle ring assembly and improve the stability and safety of the equipment.

title_en: Preparation method of anti-aging high-adhesion high-temperature sintered conductive silver paste
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an anti-aging high-adhesion high-temperature sintered conductive silver paste, which comprises the following steps: adding an organic solvent into a reactor, sequentially adding a flatting agent, a surfactant, a defoaming agent and a thickening agent under stirring, heating, and continuously stirring until the organic solvent is dissolved to obtain an organic carrier; placing an organic carrier in a stirring dispersion machine, adding glass powder and a functional additive, stirring, then adding a nano silver wire, and stirring to obtain the anti-aging high-adhesion high-temperature sintered conductive silver paste; according to the invention, the nano silver wire is added into the conductive paste, and the prepared conductive paste can improve the electrical property of the battery piece, and the welding tension and the aging welding tension of the battery piece are obviously improved.

title_en: Semiconductor device, method for manufacturing semiconductor device, and power conversion device
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor device capable of ensuring a space distance from a terminal part and realizing miniaturization of a narrow pitch corresponding to terminal arrangement. A semiconductor device is provided with: a semiconductor element (1); a metal member (3) having a mounting portion (3 a) on the upper surface of which the semiconductor element (1) is mounted, and a plurality of terminal portions (3 e) provided above the mounting portion (3 a) and juxtaposed at a distance from each other and having a bent portion (3 d) at one end, the plurality of terminal portions (3 e) being bent toward the upper surface side of the mounting portion (3 a) at the respective bent portions (3 d); and a sealing member (4) which is provided above the bent portion (3 d) at a position inside the inner surface of the plurality of terminal portions (3 e), is provided below the bent portion (3 d), is in contact with the lower portion of the bent portion (3 d), and is provided outside the bent portion (3 d), and seals the semiconductor element (1) integrally with the metal member (3), wherein the plurality of terminal portions (3 e) are exposed from the side surface of the sealing member, and the side surface of the sealing member between the plurality of terminal portions (3 e) is flat.

title_en: Flexible thermoelectric module and thermoelectric device comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flexible thermoelectric module, and more particularly, to a flexible thermoelectric module used in a curved shape. A flexible thermoelectric module used in a curved shape according to the present invention includes a plate-shaped substrate provided to be deformable into a curved shape, a plurality of thermoelectric elements including an N-type semiconductor and a P-type semiconductor arranged to form a two-dimensional array on the substrate, and a plurality of electrodes connecting the N-type semiconductor and the P-type semiconductor, wherein the plurality of thermoelectric elements form a thermoelectric wire including thermoelectric elements which are continuously connected through the electrodes and form a wire, wherein an extending direction of the thermoelectric wire may be closer to a direction perpendicular to the bending direction than a bending direction for deforming into the curved shape.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a semiconductor structure and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the semiconductor structure comprises: a substrate comprising a conductive structure; the lower electrode layer consists of a plurality of discrete U-shaped conductive grooves, and the U-shaped conductive grooves are electrically connected with the conductive structure; the dielectric layer covers the top surface, the outer wall surface, the inner wall surface and the inner bottom surface of the U-shaped conductive groove; the upper electrode layer, the intermetallic compound layer and the doped semiconductor layer are sequentially arranged on the surface of the dielectric layer, and the intermetallic compound layer contains doped elements of the doped semiconductor layer. The embodiment of the invention is beneficial to improving the electrical property of the semiconductor structure.

title_en: Display screen, display module and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a display screen, a display module and terminal equipment, wherein the display screen comprises a light-emitting layer and a driving circuit layer; the lighting layer comprises at least two display units, lighting windows are arranged on the positions, opposite to the display units, of the driving circuit layer, so that at least two cameras in the under-screen camera module acquire information to be shot through the lighting windows; the driving circuit layer is provided with at least two driving units corresponding to the at least two display units one by one, and the driving units comprise a first driving circuit and a second driving circuit; the first driving circuit and the second driving circuit on each driving unit are respectively positioned at two sides of the lighting window, and the arrangement direction of at least two driving units is consistent with the arrangement direction of at least two display units. The display screen can be used for shortening the distance between at least two cameras in the terminal equipment, and the shooting effect of the terminal equipment is improved.

title_en: Light-emitting diode micro display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light-emitting diode micro display device which comprises a circuit substrate, a plurality of micro light-emitting elements, an insulating layer and a common electrode layer. The circuit substrate is provided with a plurality of conductive patterns. The micro light-emitting elements are connected with the circuit substrate and arranged corresponding to the conductive patterns, each micro light-emitting element is provided with a bottom surface, a top surface and a side wall, the bottom surface is connected with the corresponding conductive pattern, and the side wall is provided with a first side wall part adjacent to the circuit substrate and a second side wall part connected with the first side wall part. The insulating layer is arranged on the circuit substrate and covers the first side wall portion. The common electrode layer is arranged on the circuit substrate, covers the insulating layer, is electrically connected with the micro light-emitting elements, contacts the second side wall part and exposes the top surface of each micro light-emitting element.

title_en: Non-fullerene electron acceptor material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-fullerene electron acceptor material and a preparation method and application thereof, the material takes an electron-donating structure as a central core unit, a five-membered fused ring as an arm unit, and the end group is blocked by electron-withdrawing groups such as 3- (dicyanomethylene) indolone and derivatives thereof, so as to obtain the star-shaped non-fullerene electron acceptor material. The material not only keeps the advantages of a linear non-fullerene electron acceptor material, but also has high electron mobility and isotropic charge transmission characteristics of the fullerene electron acceptor material, and the multi-dimensional geometrical structure of the material is favorable for intramolecular charge transfer, so that the energy gap is reduced and the absorption range is enlarged. And the star-shaped multi-dimensional structure can effectively inhibit excessive aggregation and is beneficial to exciton dissociation. The material can be used as an electron acceptor material of an active layer and widely applied to the preparation of organic solar cells, and can obtain excellent material film stability and excellent photoelectric conversion characteristics.

title_en: Wafer class product electroplates unloading equipment of going up
abstract_en: The invention discloses electroplating feeding and discharging equipment for wafer products, which comprises a workbench, a wafer box loading device, a wafer robot, a wafer calibrator, a turnover manipulator, an installation and disassembly mechanism, an electroplating hanger and a wafer jig, wherein the wafer box loading device is arranged on the workbench; the wafer robot, the wafer calibrator, the turnover manipulator and the mounting and dismounting mechanism are all arranged on the workbench, and the electroplating hanger is arranged on the mounting and dismounting mechanism; the wafer box loading device, the wafer calibrator and the overturning manipulator are positioned in the operating range of a wafer taking arm of the wafer robot; the mounting and dismounting mechanism is positioned in the operation range of the turnover manipulator, the wafer products and the wafer jig are locked and attached to the electroplating hanger during the feeding operation, and the wafer products and the wafer jig are unlocked and taken down from the electroplating hanger during the discharging operation. The automatic feeding and discharging device can realize automatic feeding and discharging operation of products, and is more flexible in equipment operation and control and high in efficiency.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A structure of a semiconductor device having a passivation layer on an active region of a FET device and a method of manufacturing the semiconductor device are disclosed. The semiconductor device includes a substrate, first and second source/drain (S/D) regions disposed on the substrate, a channel region of a nanostructure disposed between the first and second S/D regions, a passivation layer, and a Nanoplatelet (NS) structure surrounding the channel region of the nanostructure. Each S/D region has a stack of first and second semiconductor layers arranged in an alternating configuration and an epitaxial region disposed on the stack of first and second semiconductor layers. A first portion of the passivation layer is disposed between the epitaxial region and the stack of first and second semiconductor layers, and a second portion of the passivation layer is disposed on a sidewall of the channel region of the nanostructure. Embodiments of the present invention also relate to a semiconductor device and a method of manufacturing the same.

title_en: Condensed ring organic compound and organic electroluminescent device using same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a condensed ring organic compound and an organic light-emitting device using the same, which are applied to the field of organic photoelectricity. Wherein X is selected from CR or N, L is independently selected from a single bond, a substituted or unsubstituted aryl group, a substituted or unsubstituted heteroaryl group, R is independently selected from hydrogen, a deuterium atom, a C1-C12 alkyl group, a C1-C8 alkoxy group, a C2-C8 substituted or unsubstituted alkenyl group, a C2-C8 substituted or unsubstituted alkynyl group, a substituted or unsubstituted C6-C60 aryl group, a substituted or unsubstituted C2-C60 heteroaryl group, A1, A2 and Ar are independently selected from a substituted or unsubstituted C6-C60 aryl group, a substituted or unsubstituted C2-C60 heteroaryl group, and N is an integer of 0 to 7. The organic compound can effectively promote the injection and transmission of electrons, balance the transmission of holes and electrons in the photoelectric device, and effectively improve the efficiency and service life of the device.

title_en: Active temperature-regulating packaging method for high-power integrated circuit semiconductor or module
abstract_en: The invention provides an active cooling design packaging method for a high-power integrated circuit semiconductor or module. The wafer with large heat productivity is placed on the composite packaging shell or frame with high heat conductivity, and the composite packaging shell or frame contains the semiconductor refrigerating sheet.

title_en: Wearable display device
abstract_en: A wearable display apparatus according to one or more embodiments of the present invention includes: a substrate; a first sensing unit on the substrate; and a display unit disposed on the first sensing unit and including a light emitting element emitting first light to a front side to display an image and emitting second light to a rear side facing the substrate, the first sensing unit being configured to measure a bio-signal generated from a body of a user using the second light reflected from the body of the user.

title_en: Quantum well layer preparation method, LED epitaxial layer and LED chip
abstract_en: The invention relates to a quantum well layer preparation method, an LED epitaxial layer and an LED chip. The preparation of the quantum well layer is divided into two stages, and in the first stage growth process, a first barrier layer and a first potential well layer are alternately grown for n times of cycles. In the second growth stage, the compressive stress relieving intermediate layer is inserted into the second barrier layer and the second potential well layer, and the second barrier layer, the compressive stress relieving intermediate layer and the second potential well layer are grown in an alternating cycle for m times. The intermediate layer is relieved through the compressive stress, the compressive stress in the quantum well layer can be effectively relieved, the piezoelectric polarization effect is reduced, the overlapping of electron hole wave functions is improved, the electron holes are effectively limited in the quantum well, the hole distribution uniformity is improved, and the electron hole recombination efficiency is further improved. Therefore, based on the quantum well layer preparation method, the internal quantum efficiency of the LED chip can be effectively improved, the luminous brightness of the LED chip based on the quantum well layer is increased, the efficiency attenuation under large current is reduced, and the quality of the LED chip is enhanced.

title_en: Display panel, preparation method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a display panel, a preparation method thereof and a display device, wherein an organic functional layer positioned between an anode and a light-emitting layer in the display panel generally comprises a hole-transporting substance, the hole-transporting substance is in a hole-rich state under the normal condition, and the hole-transporting substance can be combined with M element to form a covalent bond, so that partial holes and electrons counteract each other, and the hole-transporting capability of the organic functional layer is weakened. Based on this, in the present application, by setting a larger concentration of M element in the second region where the organic functional layer overlaps the spacer region of the pixel defining layer, the hole transporting capability of the organic functional layer in the second region is deteriorated, so that the capability of lateral movement of holes between adjacent light emitting elements is weakened, and the phenomenon that the light emitting elements are abnormally lightened due to lateral carrier migration is avoided, thereby improving the display effect of the display panel.

title_en: Semiconductor memory device and method for manufacturing semiconductor memory device
abstract_en: A semiconductor memory device of the present invention includes: a laminate in which a plurality of insulating layers and a plurality of gate electrode layers are alternately laminated in a 1 st direction; a semiconductor layer extending in a 1 st direction; a 1 st charge storage layer which is provided between the semiconductor layer and the 1 st gate electrode layer and contains silicon and nitrogen; a 2 nd charge storage layer provided between the semiconductor layer and the 2 nd gate electrode layer, sandwiching the 1 st insulating layer between the 1 st charge storage layer and the 2 nd gate electrode layer, separated from the 1 st charge storage layer, and containing silicon and nitrogen; a 1 st insulating film provided between the semiconductor layer and the 1 st charge storage layer, between the semiconductor layer and the 2 nd charge storage layer, and between the semiconductor layer and the 1 st insulating layer; a 2 nd insulating film provided between the 1 st insulating film and the 1 st charge storage layer, between the 1 st insulating film and the 2 nd charge storage layer, and between the 1 st insulating film and the 1 st insulating layer; and a 2 nd insulating layer provided between the 1 st charge storage layer and the 1 st gate electrode layer.

title_en: Synthetic quartz glass substrate with antireflection film, window material, cover for optical element package, and light irradiation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a synthetic quartz glass substrate with an antireflection film, a window material, a cover for optical element packaging, an optical element packaging and a light irradiation device. A synthetic quartz glass substrate with an antireflection film, comprising: a synthetic quartz glass substrate; and an antireflection film formed on a principal surface of the synthetic quartz glass substrate, wherein the antireflection film is formed on the principal surface of the synthetic quartz glass substrate by JIS R3257: 1999 has a contact angle of 5 degrees or less as measured by the sessile drop method, and the antireflection film comprises Al-containing films laminated in this order on the main surface of a synthetic quartz glass substrate 2 O 3 First layer of (2), containing HfO 2 A second layer ofContaining MgF 2 Or SiO 2 The third layer of (2).

title_en: Doping segregation Schottky manufacturing method for reducing FinFET contact resistance
abstract_en: A method of doped segregation schottky fabrication to reduce FinFET contact resistance, comprising the steps of: providing a semiconductor layer with a plurality of pseudo gate structures; each pseudo gate structure is provided with a hard mask layer, and side walls are arranged on two sides of each pseudo gate structure; forming a doped segregation Schottky structure, wherein the step of depositing a first interlayer dielectric is included; respectively etching the PMOS area and the NMOS area to form a cavity, implanting silicon germanium into the cavity of the PMOS area, and implanting silicon phosphide into the cavity of the NMOS area; opening a pseudo gate structure polycrystalline silicon layer to form an HKMG gate structure; depositing a second interlayer dielectric; and step five, etching to form a contact groove, growing a silicide layer, and depositing contact metal.

title_en: Capacitor array forming method and semiconductor structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a forming method of a capacitor array and a semiconductor structure, wherein the forming method of the capacitor array comprises the following steps: providing a substrate, wherein the substrate comprises an array area and a non-array area, a base layer and a dielectric layer are formed in the substrate, and a first barrier layer is formed between the base layer and the dielectric layer; forming a first array defining layer and a second array defining layer on the surface of the dielectric layer, the first array defining layer and the second array defining layer corresponding to the array region and the non-array region, respectively; forming a pattern transfer layer on the surfaces of the first array definition layer and the second array definition layer; patterning the dielectric layer and the second array definition layer by using the pattern transfer layer as a mask to form a capacitor array in the array region; the remaining second array-defining layer is removed.

title_en: Miniaturized large-load driving circuit, solid-state relay and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a miniaturized heavy-load drive circuit, a solid-state relay and a manufacturing method thereof.A drive control circuit is formed by a light-emitting diode D1 and a photovoltaic V1 and is isolated by light; the triode Q1, the capacitor C1, the switch diode D4 and the switch diode D5 form an amplifying charging circuit; the switch diode D3 and the photovoltaic V1 form a bleeder circuit; the MOS chips V2 and V3 form a switch circuit, the switch circuit is manufactured by adopting a micro-assembly process, the components are adhered by epoxy conductive adhesive, the components are interconnected by adopting a bonding process, and finally, the switch circuit is packaged by adopting a parallel sealing and welding process. The invention provides a miniaturized driving circuit with a large load, a solid-state relay and a manufacturing method thereof.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: A semiconductor structure and a method of forming the same, comprising: a substrate; the first dielectric layer, the first grid structure and the plurality of second grid structures are positioned on the substrate, and a first source-drain doping layer is arranged in the substrate between the adjacent first grid structure and second grid structure; the first conductive structure is positioned in the first dielectric layer on the first source-drain doping layer; a second dielectric layer on the first dielectric layer; a conductive layer opening in the second dielectric layer; and forming a conductive layer in the conductive layer opening and an isolation layer on the conductive layer. The conducting layer can be covered by being located on the isolating layer, so that short circuit between the conducting layer and other device structures is effectively reduced. In addition, a certain height difference is formed between the conductive layer and the source-drain plug or the gate plug formed later, so that parasitic capacitance generated between the conductive layer and the gate plug or the source-drain plug is reduced.

title_en: Semiconductor light emitting device
abstract_en: A semiconductor device having high bondability and high airtightness, and having high reliability and high environmental resistance is provided. The semiconductor light emitting device has: a semiconductor light emitting element; a substrate on which a semiconductor light emitting element is mounted and which has a substrate bonding surface covered with a substrate metal layer; and a translucent cap having a window portion through which the radiation light of the semiconductor light emitting element is transmitted, and a flange having a flange joint surface whose inner edge is circular, the translucent cap having a space for accommodating the semiconductor light emitting element and being hermetically joined to the substrate, a surface of the flange joint surface being a metal layer, the flange joint surface having a flat portion and a pressing ring, the pressing ring being an annular projection projecting from the flat portion and concentric with the circular inner edge, the substrate metal layer and a top portion of the pressing ring being joined together by a joining member with a certain interval therebetween.

title_en: Phase change memory, control method and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a phase change memory, a control method and a manufacturing method thereof. The phase change memory includes: a word line, a phase change memory cell and a first bit line which are sequentially stacked from bottom to top; the phase-change memory cell comprises a phase-change memory layer; the phase change memory cell is perpendicular to the word line and the first bit line; n second bit lines, each of which is parallel to the first bit line and surrounds the phase change memory layer; wherein n is a positive integer.

title_en: High-linearity HEMT device based on planar nanowire channel and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-linearity HEMT device based on a planar nanowire channel and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-linearity HEMT device comprises: a substrate layer; a buffer layer on the substrate layer; a source electrode positioned at one end of the buffer layer; a drain electrode positioned at the other end of the buffer layer; the barrier layer is positioned on the buffer layer and between the source electrode and the drain electrode, wherein the barrier layer is provided with a plurality of nanowire structures which are arranged at intervals along the width direction of the grid and are formed by ion implantation, and the nanowire structures and the non-implanted region have different grid control capacities so as to form different threshold voltages; and the gate electrode is positioned on the barrier layer and positioned on the nanowire structures. According to the embodiment, the nanowire structures which are arranged at intervals along the gate width direction are formed through ion implantation, and different threshold voltages can be formed, so that devices are connected in parallel according to specific structural parameters, multi-threshold coupling of the devices can be realized, the devices are gradually opened along the gate width direction, and the linearity of the devices is improved.

title_en: Solar cell and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar cell and a manufacturing method thereof, relates to the technical field of solar cells, and aims to increase the contact area between a lower electrode of the solar cell and an N-type silicon wafer while ensuring that a surrounding plating diffusion layer is completely removed, form good back contact and improve the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the solar cell. The manufacturing method comprises the steps of carrying out boron diffusion treatment on one surface of an N-type silicon wafer in the first direction, forming a diffusion layer and a borosilicate glass layer which are sequentially stacked on one surface of the N-type silicon wafer in the first direction, and sequentially forming a winding plating diffusion layer and a winding borosilicate glass layer which are stacked on one surface of the side surface of the N-type silicon wafer in the second direction. Sequentially removing the coiled borosilicate glass layer and the coiled diffusion layer, and carrying out texturing treatment on one surface of the N-type silicon wafer in the second direction to form a textured structure on one surface of the N-type silicon wafer in the second direction. And carrying out top planarization treatment on the suede structure to obtain a convex structure with a flat top on one surface of the N-type silicon wafer in the second direction.

title_en: Protective sheet for semiconductor processing and method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: The invention provides a protective sheet for semiconductor processing, which comprises a base material, an intermediate layer on the base material and an adhesive layer in this order, wherein the product of the tensile storage modulus of the base material and the thickness of the base material is 8.0 x 10 5 N/m or less, and a residual stress of the intermediate layer after being held at 65 ℃ for 300 seconds is 10000Pa or less.

title_en: Device, system and method for monitoring a flow direction and method for producing a flow direction sensor
abstract_en: An apparatus and method for determining one or more fluid flow properties of a fluid in a conduit is disclosed. The apparatus includes a substrate including a barrier, a first flow sensor coupled to the substrate, and a second flow sensor coupled to the substrate. The first flow sensor is located at a first sensor distance from the first blocking surface and the second flow sensor is located at a second sensor distance from the second blocking surface. The first sensor distance is substantially equal to the second sensor distance. In operation, the first flow sensor generates a first sensor signal and the second flow sensor generates a second sensor signal. Determining a flow direction of the fluid by comparing the first sensor signal to the second sensor signal.

title_en: Plate stack heat exchanger
abstract_en: The concentration of thermal stress in the plate-stacked heat exchanger in the vicinity of the flow rate limiting portion is relaxed, and fatigue failure caused by the concentration is prevented. The flow rate limiting portion is also provided with an opening portion similar to the flow path, so that the rigidity difference with the flow path portion is reduced.

title_en: Junction barrier schottky device with heterojunction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a junction barrier Schottky device with a heterojunction, which relates to the field of Schottky devices, wherein a variable doping region with a second doping type is formed on the surface of a semiconductor epitaxial layer with a first doping type, a polycrystalline silicon layer with the second doping type penetrating through the surface of the variable doping region to the bottom is arranged in the variable doping region, when the junction barrier Schottky device is forward biased, current flows through the heterojunction formed by the polycrystalline silicon layer and the contact interface between the external variable doping region and the semiconductor epitaxial layer and the heterojunction formed by the contact interface between an anode metal layer and the semiconductor epitaxial layer, and the current density is relatively larger.

title_en: Photovoltaic cell, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the field of solar energy, and provides a photovoltaic cell, a preparation method thereof and a photovoltaic module, wherein the photovoltaic cell comprises: a substrate; the emitter located on one side surface of the substrate includes: at least two first doped regions spaced apart from each other; the second doping regions are positioned between the adjacent first doping regions, and gaps are formed between the second doping regions and the adjacent two first doping regions; the transition region is positioned in the gap, the first doping region, the transition region and the second doping region have the same doping elements, and the concentration of the doping elements in the first doping region is smaller than that in the second doping region; the contact part of the transition region and the second doping region is a reference surface, the concentration of the doping elements in the transition region increases along with the decrease of the distance between the transition region and the reference surface, and the ratio of the width of the second doping region to the width of the transition region is 3 along the direction vertical to the reference surface: 1-1: 1. the embodiment of the application is at least beneficial to improving the transmission efficiency of the current carriers in the emitter.

title_en: Manufacturing device and method for artificial muscle wrapped and twisted by sheath material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of preparation and application of artificial muscle type flexible drivers, and particularly relates to a device and a method for manufacturing artificial muscle coated and twisted by a sheath material. The invention realizes two work steps of twisting the sheath-core artificial muscle and wrapping sheath materials by controlling the coordinated operation of three groups of motors, and realizes the automatic manufacture of the sheath-core artificial muscle. The invention simplifies the preparation process of the sheath-core artificial muscle, improves the manufacturing efficiency of the sheath-core artificial muscle and simultaneously realizes the controllability of the parameters of the sheath-core artificial muscle. The invention is expected to promote the automatic production of sheath-core artificial muscles and sheath-core structural materials.

title_en: Method for measuring device parameters
abstract_en: For example, the method for measuring the device parameters includes: a step of repeatedly measuring a gate-source voltage (or a gate-emitter voltage) of the switching element in a switching transient state thereof while switching an external gate resistance of the switching element among m resistance values (where m is an integer of 3 or more); and a step of deriving the internal gate resistance Rgin or the plateau voltage Vp of the switching element by performing fitting of an equation vgs (k) ═ rg (k)/(rg (k) + Rgin) × Vp while expressing the internal gate resistance and the plateau voltage of the switching element with Rgin and Vp, respectively, and using m resistance values of the external gate resistance and m voltage values of the corresponding gate-source voltage (or gate-emitter voltage) as rg (k) and vgs (k), respectively (where k is 1, 2 … m).

title_en: Array substrate, manufacturing method thereof and display panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an array substrate, a manufacturing method thereof and a display panel, wherein the array substrate comprises: a substrate; a first metal layer disposed on the substrate, the first metal layer including a source electrode; the first insulating layer covers the source electrode, and a through hole is formed in the position, corresponding to the source electrode, of the first insulating layer; a first transparent conductive layer disposed on the first insulating layer, the first transparent conductive layer including a pixel electrode; a second metal layer arranged on the first insulating layer and the pixel electrode, wherein the second metal layer comprises a drain electrode; the semiconductor layer is arranged on the drain electrode and is filled in the through hole to electrically connect the source electrode and the drain electrode; a second insulating layer covering the pixel electrode and the semiconductor layer; a gate electrode disposed on the second insulating layer; a third insulating layer covering the gate electrode; and a second transparent conductive layer disposed on the third insulating layer, the second transparent conductive layer including a common electrode. The array substrate provided by the invention not only reduces the power consumption, but also avoids the influence on the conductivity of the semiconductor layer after light irradiates the semiconductor layer.

title_en: NOR type memory device, method of manufacturing the same, and electronic apparatus including the same
abstract_en: A NOR-type memory device, a method of manufacturing the same, and an electronic apparatus including the same are disclosed. According to an embodiment, the NOR memory device may include: a memory device layer including first and second source/drain regions and a first channel region between the first and second source/drain regions; a first gate stack vertically extending to pass through the memory device layer, including a first gate conductor layer and a memory function layer disposed between the first gate conductor layer and the memory device layer, defining a memory cell where the first gate stack intersects the memory device layer; a select device layer on the memory device layer including third and fourth source/drain regions and a second channel region between the third and fourth source/drain regions; a second gate stack disposed over the first gate stack, extending vertically to pass through the select device layer; and a connection portion electrically connecting the third source/drain region to the first gate conductor layer.

title_en: Double CCT automobile front lamp
abstract_en: Described herein is a dual CCT automotive headlamp (100) comprising: at least one first LED (101) configured to emit light of a first color; at least one second LED (102) configured to emit light of a second color different from the first color; a light mixing arrangement (103) arranged to receive and mix light from the at least one first LED (101) and the at least one second LED (102) and to emit the mixed light. The dual CCT automobile headlight may provide not only uniform light of the first color and uniform light of the second color, but also uniform light of mixed colors.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and method for forming semiconductor structure
abstract_en: A semiconductor structure and a method of forming a semiconductor structure, wherein the method comprises: providing a substrate; forming a first electrode material layer on the surface of the substrate; forming a plurality of magnetic tunnel junctions which are separated from each other on the surface of the first electrode material layer, and forming a second electrode layer on the top surface of each magnetic tunnel junction; forming side walls on the side wall surfaces of the magnetic tunnel junction and the second electrode layer; and after the side walls are formed, removing the first electrode material layer exposed on the surface of the substrate to form a first electrode layer. Thus, the performance of the semiconductor structure is improved.

title_en: Object positioner, method for correcting the shape of an object, lithographic apparatus, object inspection apparatus, device manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention provides an object locator comprising: an object support having an object support surface configured to engage at least a portion of an object, the object support surface having a support surface temperature; a thermal device configured to provide a first object temperature to at least a portion of the object, the first object temperature differing from the support surface temperature by a first predetermined temperature difference.

title_en: Laminated solar cell
abstract_en: The application discloses a stacked solar cell. The laminated solar cell includes: the light absorption layer group comprises an excitation layer, a first electron transport layer group arranged on the first side face of the excitation layer, a first hole transport layer group arranged on the second side face of the excitation layer, and a heterojunction layer group, wherein the first side face of the heterojunction layer group is a second electron transport layer and is in contact with the first hole transport layer group, and the second side face of the heterojunction layer group is a second hole transport layer. The heterojunction layer group plays an amplification role in the number of hole-electron pairs generated by excitation of the light absorption layer group, so that the efficiency of the laminated solar cell is greatly improved.

title_en: Temperature control unit
abstract_en: The temperature control unit (1) is provided with a heat medium inlet (2) for introducing a heat medium from the outside, a temperature control mechanism (3) for allowing the heat medium from the heat medium inlet (2) to pass through, and a heat medium outlet (4) for discharging the heat medium from the temperature control mechanism (3) to the outside, wherein the temperature control mechanism (3) is provided with a metal porous body and a housing (5) for housing the metal porous body, and the housing (5) is configured such that at least one main surface faces the outside of the temperature control mechanism (3) and the inside of the main surface is in contact with the metal porous body, thereby performing heat exchange between the metal porous body and the outside, and a heat medium diffusion region (10) is provided between the heat medium inlet (2) and the metal porous body.

title_en: Method of forming a microelectronic device, related microelectronic device and electronic system
abstract_en: The present application relates to methods of forming microelectronic devices and related microelectronic devices and electronic systems. A method of forming a microelectronic device includes forming a microelectronic device structure comprising: a base structure; a doped semiconductive structure comprising a first portion overlying the base structure and a second portion extending vertically from the first portion into the base structure; a stack overlying the doped semiconducting structure; a cell pillar structure extending vertically through the stacked structure to the doped semiconductive structure; and a digit line structure vertically overlying the stack structure. Additional microelectronic device structures are formed that include control logic devices. The microelectronic device structure is attached to additional microelectronic device structures to form a microelectronic device structure assembly. The carrier structure and the second portion of the doped semiconductive structure are removed. Then, a first portion of the doped semiconductive structure is patterned to form at least one source structure coupled to the cell pillar structure. Devices and systems are also described.

title_en: HEMT device based on grid field plate and double-source field plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a HEMT device based on a grid field plate and a double-source field plate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: performing ion implantation on the first substrate to form a second substrate; forming a bonding interlayer on the second substrate, and reacting beta-Ga 2 O 3 Transferring to the bonding interlayer to form a heterojunction substrate; growing a buffer layer on the heterojunction substrate; sequentially growing a secondary barrier layer, a first doping layer, a first heterojunction layer, a quantum well layer, a second heterojunction layer, a second doping layer and a primary barrier layer on the buffer layer; performing ion implantation on two sides of the upper surface of the main barrier layer to form a source electrode ohmic contact region and a drain electrode ohmic contact region; forming a source electrode and a drain electrode; growing an oxide layer and a first dielectric layer on the upper surface of the main barrier layer; forming a gate on the first dielectric layer, and forming a gate on the gateA gate field plate; etching two sides of the first dielectric layer; growing a first source field on the source; and growing a second dielectric layer on the first dielectric layer, etching the second dielectric layer, and growing a second source field plate.

title_en: Self-aligned front-end charge trapping flash memory cell and capacitor design for integrated high density scaling devices
abstract_en: Embodiments disclosed herein include semiconductor devices and methods of forming such devices. In an embodiment, the semiconductor device includes: a substrate and a transistor on the substrate. In an embodiment, a transistor includes: a first gate electrode, wherein the first gate electrode is part of an array of first gate electrodes having a first pitch. In an embodiment, the first gate electrode has a first average grain size. In an embodiment, the semiconductor device further comprises a component unit on the substrate. In an embodiment, the component unit comprises: a second gate electrode, wherein the second gate electrode is part of an array of second gate electrodes having a second pitch that is greater than the first pitch. In an embodiment, the second gate electrode has a second average grain size greater than the first average grain size.

title_en: Single photon avalanche diode device, image sensing device and laser radar system
abstract_en: The application discloses a single photon avalanche diode device, an image sensing device and a laser radar system, wherein the single photon avalanche diode device comprises a first semiconductor region, a second semiconductor region, a micro lens and a reflector array, the second semiconductor region covers the first semiconductor region, and the micro lens covers the second semiconductor region. The second semiconductor region includes a first isolation structure, a second isolation structure, and an absorption region; the second isolation structure is aligned in a first direction relative to the first isolation structure; the absorption region covers the first semiconductor region. The reflector array comprises a first reflector group and a second reflector group, and the first reflector group and the second reflector group comprise a plurality of reflectors; the first reflector group is located in the first semiconductor region, and the first reflector group is located between the second reflector group and the absorption region. The single photon avalanche diode device performance can be effectively improved, and the detection performance of the SPAD sensor is improved.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: A semiconductor structure and a method of forming the same, wherein the method comprises: forming source and drain openings in fin structures at two sides of the pseudo gate structure; forming a dielectric layer and a plurality of openings in the dielectric layer on the substrate and in the source and drain openings, wherein the openings expose the top surface of the fin structure along the extending direction of the pseudo gate structure, and the dielectric layer is arranged between the adjacent openings corresponding to the adjacent fin structures; and forming a source-drain doping layer in the opening. The dielectric layer serves as a space for limiting the source-drain doped layers, so that bridging between the source-drain doped layers in adjacent fin structures cannot occur, and the performance of the formed semiconductor structure is improved.

title_en: Method for adjusting temperature of mounting table, inspection apparatus, and mounting table
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for controlling the temperature of a mounting table on which a substrate can be mounted, the method comprising the steps of: performing feedback control for adjusting an operation amount of the heater in a center-most region among the plurality of regions on the substrate mounting surface so as to set a temperature; and a feedback control for adjusting an operation amount of the heater in an outer region of the plurality of regions of the substrate mounting surface so that a temperature difference between the outer region and a region adjacent to a radially inner side of the outer region becomes a predetermined value.

title_en: Silicon terminal diamond field effect transistor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a silicon terminal diamond field effect transistor and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of field effect transistor devices, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of forming a hydrogen terminal on the upper surface of a diamond substrate; forming a source electrode and a drain electrode on an upper surface of the hydrogen terminal; forming a passivation dielectric layer on the upper surface of the source electrode, the upper surface of the drain electrode and the upper surface of a hydrogen terminal between the source electrode and the drain electrode; removing a portion of the passivation dielectric layer between the source and drain electrodes such that a corresponding portion of the hydrogen termination isThe upper surface is exposed; forming SiO on the upper surfaces of the rest passivation dielectric layers and the exposed upper surfaces of the hydrogen terminals 2 A dielectric layer, which is used for obtaining a silicon terminal corresponding to the exposed part of the hydrogen terminal; in SiO 2 And forming a grid electrode on the upper surface of the dielectric layer corresponding to the silicon terminal. By the arrangement, the silicon terminal diamond can be obtained, the normally-off diamond field effect transistor can be realized, the lower interface state density and the higher medium quality can be realized, and the direct current and radio frequency performance is good.

title_en: Optically transparent actuator
abstract_en: The electroactive ceramics that can be incorporated into the transparent optical element have an average grain size of less than 200nm, a relative density of at least 99%, and a transmission of at least 50% in the visible spectrum while maintaining a d of at least 20pC/N 33 The value is obtained. The optical properties of the electroactive ceramic layer, including transmittance, haze, and clarity, may be substantially unchanged during actuation of the optical element by application of a voltage.

title_en: Low-content PbO modified glass powder for Topcon solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A low-content PbO modified glass powder for a Topcon solar battery and a preparation method thereof relate to a glass powder and a preparation method thereof. The invention aims to solve the problem that the lead-free glass powder used for silver grid lines on the surface of the existing Topcon battery is relatively weak in etching capability of a silicon wafer and relatively large in contact resistance, so that the metallization process of the lead-free glass powder is relatively weak. A low-content PbO modified glass powder for a Topcon solar battery is lead-free glass powder, and the outer surface of the lead-free glass powder is coated with PbO. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a mixed solution; and secondly, coating. The invention gives consideration to the concept of green and environment-friendly development, reduces the use of lead content, improves the etching capability of lead-free glass powder to silicon wafers, reduces the contact resistance of silver-silicon interfaces and promotes the formation of better metallization contact. The invention can obtain the low-content PbO modified glass powder for the Topcon solar cell.

title_en: Miniature light-emitting component
abstract_en: The present invention provides a micro light emitting module, comprising: the substrate is provided with a first plate surface and a second plate surface which are positioned on two opposite sides; at least one micro-device disposed above the substrate and having a top surface remote from the substrate and a bottom surface opposite to the top surface, and a peripheral surface connecting the periphery of the top surface and the periphery of the bottom surface; at least one retaining wall, configured on the first plate surface of the substrate, having an upper surface far away from the substrate, and at least part of the upper surface of the retaining wall is higher than the bottom surface of part of the microelement, and the periphery of the microelement is configured with at least one retaining wall from the top view direction, wherein the top view direction is the normal direction of the horizontal plane where the substrate is located; and at least one fixing structure configured on the first plate surface of the substrate, the fixing structure comprising: at least one connecting part, which is configured on the first plate surface of the substrate and is connected to at least one edge of the micro-element.

title_en: Method for dicing semiconductor wafer and semiconductor device manufactured by the method
abstract_en: A method for forming a semiconductor device from a semiconductor wafer includes dicing a first surface of the semiconductor wafer to form a first region extending partially through the semiconductor wafer, and the first region having a bottom. The method further includes directing a laser beam at the semiconductor wafer such that the laser beam is focused between the first surface and the second surface within the semiconductor wafer, and the laser beam further cuts the semiconductor wafer by material ablation to form a second region aligned with the first region. A resulting semiconductor device is also disclosed.

title_en: Method for detecting welding between welding wire and welding position on wire welding machine
abstract_en: A method of determining a weld condition between a wire and at least one weld location of a workpiece is provided. The method includes the steps of (a) welding a portion of a wire to a welding location of a workpiece with a welding tool of a wire bonding machine, (b) determining a motion profile of the welding tool for determining whether the portion of the wire is welded to the welding location, the motion profile configured to cause the wire to break during the motion profile if the portion of the wire is not welded to the welding location, and (c) moving the welding tool along the motion profile to determine whether the portion of the wire is welded to the welding location. Other methods of determining a weld condition between a wire and at least one weld location of a workpiece are also provided.

title_en: Light emitting device and display apparatus including the same
abstract_en: The application provides a light emitting device and a display device. The light emitting device includes: the LED packaging structure comprises a substrate, wherein a plurality of hemispherical initial LED packaging bodies arranged in an array mode are arranged on the surface of the substrate; the light steering layer is arranged on the initial LED packaging body, the surface of one side, far away from the substrate, of the light steering layer has a flat effect, and the light steering layer enables light rays emitted by the initial LED packaging body during working to be deflected towards the normal side; the light conversion layer is arranged on one side of the light turning layer, which is far away from the substrate, and is parallel to the substrate; wherein the maximum light-emitting angle of each initial LED package is less than 90 DEG Ratio of d to h Theta is an included angle between the widest outgoing light ray and a normal line, d is a horizontal distance between center points of the LEDs contained in any two adjacent initial LED packaging bodies, h is a shortest distance between the upper surface of the LEDs contained in the initial LED packaging bodies and the lower surface of the light conversion layer, a is a set value representing the brightness uniformity of the light-emitting device, and a is more than 0.6 and less than or equal to 1.

title_en: Light emitting device and electronic apparatus including the same
abstract_en: The present application relates to a light emitting device including a first electrode, a second electrode facing the first electrode, and an intermediate layer disposed between the first electrode and the second electrode and including an emission layer. The intermediate layer includes a first compound represented by formula 1 of the specification, a second compound represented by formula 2 of the specification, and a third compound that is a blue phosphorescent compound. The present application also relates to an electronic device including the light emitting device.

title_en: OLED screen and terminal equipment with same
abstract_en: The application discloses an OLED screen and terminal equipment with the same, wherein the OLED screen comprises a light emitting layer and a polaroid, a light passing hole comprises a first light passing hole formed in the light emitting layer, a first through hole is formed in the polaroid, the first through hole is opposite to the first light passing hole, the first through hole is partially located in the light passing hole, the diameter of the first light passing hole is smaller than that of the first through hole, the light emitting layer comprises a pixel layer arranged around the first light passing hole, the pixel layer comprises an exposure part, the projection of the exposure part along the axial direction of the light passing hole is located in the first through hole, the side surface of the exposure part facing the first through hole is provided with a non-light-transmitting first metal wiring part, and one side, facing the first through hole, of each metal wiring in the first metal wiring part is covered with a first shading layer. The OLED screen and the terminal equipment with the OLED screen not only enable the light-passing hole in the display device to have a good display effect, but also enable the diameter of the opening to be smaller than 2.98mm, and improve the screen occupation ratio of the terminal equipment.

title_en: Method for removing silicon wafer reverse layer after phosphorus diffusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for removing a reverse layer of a silicon wafer after phosphorus diffusion, belonging to the technical field of silicon wafer production. In the invention, the alkali liquor corrosion is adopted to replace the original sand blasting technology to remove the phosphorus diffusion reverse layer on the surface of the silicon wafer, the alkali liquor corrosion can effectively reduce the mechanical damage to the surface of the silicon wafer in the removing process, the phenomena of corner defect, fracture and dark damage are avoided, and the diffusion time is increased in the subsequent boron diffusion step to improve the boron diffusion depth and improve the product quality.

title_en: Microchannel device for heat dissipation of high-power semiconductor chip and processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electronic component shell production and encapsulation, in particular to a micro-channel device for heat dissipation of a high-power semiconductor chip and a processing method thereof. The micro-channel device comprises a radiating inner core formed by staggered arrangement of a plurality of radiating fins and blocking pieces arranged at the front end and the rear end of the radiating inner core, wherein the radiating fins are hexagonal and comprise two adjacent right angles and six inner obtuse angles, hollowed-out grooves are formed in the radiating fins, a water channel is formed in the radiating chip through the hollowed-out grooves, and the micro-channel device further comprises grooves arranged at the bottom, water inlet holes and water outlet holes which are communicated with the water channel. The microchannel device provided by the invention can avoid the problem that the root strength of the internal radiating fin is insufficient and is easy to break to influence the whole heat dissipation and cause the chip failure caused by the fact that the radiating channel in the traditional radiating device is used with large-pressure cold medium flow.

title_en: LED epitaxial structure, manufacturing method thereof and LED device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an LED epitaxial structure. The LED epitaxial structure comprises: the light emitting diode comprises an n-type limiting layer, an n-type waveguide layer, a light emitting layer, a p-type waveguide layer and a p-type limiting layer which are sequentially stacked, wherein the p-type waveguide layer comprises a first p-type waveguide sub-layer, an electron blocking layer and a second p-type waveguide sub-layer which are sequentially stacked, the first p-type waveguide sub-layer is adjacent to the light emitting layer compared with the second p-type waveguide sub-layer, and the electron blocking layer comprises at least one layer of Al  y  Ga  1‑y  An oxide layer of As. The invention also relates to an LED device and a manufacturing method of the LED epitaxial structure. The LED epitaxial structure provided by the invention comprises the wide forbidden band Al  y  Ga  1‑y  The electron blocking layer of the As oxide layer ensures that the energy level difference between the electron blocking layer and the light emitting layer is larger, thus effectively improving the electron blocking effect and the light emitting efficiency of the LED device.

title_en: Chain type wafer cleaning and drying robot complete machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wafer cleaning and drying, and discloses a chain type wafer cleaning and drying robot complete machine which comprises a support, a first cross rod and a second cross rod, wherein the first cross rod and the second cross rod are fixedly arranged on the support, a chain wheel is rotatably connected to the second cross rod, a special-shaped chain wheel is rotatably arranged on the first cross rod, a chain is rotatably connected to the special-shaped chain wheel and the chain wheel, a clamping mechanism is connected to the chain, and the clamping mechanism comprises a rotary table and a suspension ball which are used for clamping wafers. According to the invention, the clamping mechanism rotates clockwise, so that the wafer rotates to pass through the cleaning tank, the air blowing assembly is arranged in the cleaning tank, and the wafer is dried, so that a plurality of wafers are cleaned and dried together, the efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the cleaned and dried wafer can be easily taken down and clamped, the working efficiency is effectively increased, the wafer is effectively prevented from being scratched, and the qualified rate of the wafer is higher.

title_en: Film coating equipment for producing solar panel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar panel production, and discloses film coating equipment for solar panel production, which comprises a device bottom shell, wherein a film coating and gluing mechanism and a cleaning mechanism are arranged at the top of the device bottom shell; the film coating and gluing mechanism comprises a fixed box body, an electric slide rail, an electric slide block, a fixed frame shell, a fixed rod, a film coating roller, a glue brushing roller, a first pipeline, a glue pump, a second pipeline, a transverse pipe, a spray head, a motor protective cover, a first motor shaft, a threaded rod, a movable shell and a bearing; the top of the bottom shell of the device is connected with a fixed box body through bolts, and the top end of the inside of the fixed box body is connected with an electric sliding rail through bolts. According to the utility model, the fixing rod is provided with the film coating roller, the glue brushing roller and the glue pump on the fixing frame shell, so that the glue brushing roller can be used for brushing glue on the solar panel firstly, the solar panel can be directly moved for coating after the glue brushing is finished, the glue brushing mechanism and the film coating mechanism are combined together, and the glue coating by using other equipment is omitted.

title_en: Environment-friendly diffusion source for solar cell
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly diffusion source for a solar cell, which belongs to the field of semiconductors and comprises a solvent, a silicon oxide nanosphere precursor source, an impurity source and an additive, wherein the solvent is absolute ethyl alcohol or isopropyl alcohol, the silicon oxide nanosphere precursor source is any one of methyl triethoxysilane, methyl trimethoxysilane and n-silane ethyl ester, the impurity source is a diffused boron source or a diffused phosphorus source, and the additive is any one of ammonia water, ammonia gas and liquid ammonia.

title_en: Memory and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a memory and a preparation method of the memory, wherein the memory comprises a first fin part and a second fin part which are positioned on a substrate; a dielectric layer covering the top of the first fin portion and exposed by the isolation structure; and the work function layers on the side walls of the first fin parts facing the second fin parts are provided with second thicknesses, and the first thicknesses are larger than the second thicknesses. According to the invention, the thickness of the work function layer on the opposite side walls of the two first fin parts is increased, so that the threshold voltage in the opposite area of the first fin parts is larger than the threshold voltage in the area of the first fin parts facing the second fin parts, and the number of diffusible electrons in the channel region between the two first fin parts is smaller, thereby reducing signal interference between the adjacent first fin parts and improving the stability of the memory.

title_en: Capacitance distribution based on system impedance
abstract_en: The application relates to capacitive division based on system impedance. Methods, systems, and devices for system impedance based capacitance allocation are described. The memory device may include a first voltage rail for distributing a first supply voltage to the array of memory cells. The memory device may be coupled with circuitry using pads of the memory device; for example, the memory device may be coupled with other circuitry within a package or board. The memory device may determine an impedance associated with the circuit and may couple one or more capacitors with the first voltage rail based on the impedance. The memory device can include a second voltage rail for distributing a second supply voltage to the array of memory cells. The memory device may compare performance of first and second voltage rails and couple one or more capacitors with the first voltage rail or the second voltage rail based on the comparison.

title_en: Method of manufacturing a semiconductor device and structure and semiconductor structure
abstract_en: A method of manufacturing a semiconductor device includes: receiving a device substrate; forming an interconnect structure on the front side of the device substrate; and etching a recess into the back side of the device substrate until a portion of the interconnect structure is exposed. The recess has a recess depth, and an edge of the recess is defined by a sidewall of the device substrate. A conductive bond pad is formed in the recess, and the first plurality of layers covers the conductive bond pad, extends along the sidewall of the device substrate, and covers the backside of the device substrate. The first plurality of layers collectively have a first overall thickness that is less than the depth of the groove. A first chemical mechanical planarization is performed to remove portions of the first plurality of layers such that remaining portions of the first plurality of layers cover the conductive bond pads. Embodiments of the invention also relate to methods of manufacturing semiconductor structures and to semiconductor structures.

title_en: Wafer scribing machine for computer mainboard processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer component processing, and discloses a wafer scribing machine for computer mainboard processing, which comprises a grinding wheel, wherein water cavities are respectively and fixedly arranged on two sides of the grinding wheel, a circulation hole is formed in the grinding wheel, the circulation hole horizontally penetrates through the grinding wheel, the water cavities on the two sides of the grinding wheel are mutually communicated through the circulation hole, a jet hole is formed in the cavity wall of the water cavity, and the jet hole is communicated with the water cavities. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the jet hole, water sprayed out of the jet hole is fully and continuously contacted with the wheel blade of the grinding wheel, so that the phenomenon that water flow sprayed out of an original device is only contacted with a certain area of the wheel blade of the grinding wheel for cooling is avoided, and thus the cooling effect is reduced.

title_en: Arrangement method of LED crystal grains and finished square piece
abstract_en: The application discloses an arrangement method of LED crystal grains and a finished square piece, wherein the arrangement method comprises the following steps: setting a coordinate document, wherein the coordinate document comprises virtual coordinate information; setting a graphic document, wherein the graphic document comprises origin information and moving distance information; combining the coordinate document and the graphic document to obtain an arrangement graphic document; obtaining an arrangement coordinate document according to the coordinate document and the arrangement graphic document; and arranging the LED crystal grains according to the arrangement coordinate document, wherein the arranged LED crystal grains are finished product crystal grains, and the finished product crystal grains are arranged into a circular pattern. The utilization rate of the finished product square film obtained by the arrangement method is greatly improved, and the cost of the blue film, the equipment cost and the labor cost are effectively reduced.

title_en: Application of potassium salt containing large-size strong coordination organic anion in perovskite solar cell
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of potassium salt containing large-size strong coordination organic anions in a perovskite solar cell, belonging to the technical field of perovskite preparation. The invention uses large-size strong coordination organic anion potassium salt which contains carboxyl and sulfonic group and can generate strong coordination with uncoordinated lead ions to prepare the perovskite solar cell. Because of the sulfonic acid functional group and the carboxyl functional group of the large-size strong coordination organic anion can be combined with the uncoordinated lead ion Pb  2+  And/or the halogen vacancies are subjected to strong coordination interaction, so that the perovskite solar cell is firmly anchored in the perovskite solar cell crystal boundary, the crystal boundary ion migration and the crystal boundary defect passivation are synergistically inhibited, the perovskite solar cell is effectively inhibited from being subjected to phase separation, the carrier mobility is obviously increased, the carrier life of the perovskite thin film is prolonged, and meanwhile, the non-radiative recombination of the carriers at the interface is greatly reduced, so that the power conversion efficiency and the long-term stability of the perovskite solar cell are improved, and the effective method for efficiently stabilizing the perovskite solar cell is provided.

title_en: TVS chip and glass passivation method and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A TVS chip and a glass passivation method and a manufacturing method thereof are provided, wherein the glass passivation method comprises the following steps: coating, namely coating glass slurry on the surface of the groove by a knife scraping method; a baking step, baking at a first preset temperature to volatilize the liquid adhesive; a pre-sintering step, namely performing pre-sintering at a second preset temperature after the baking step is finished, and thermally decomposing the solid adhesive; and sintering, namely sintering at a third preset temperature after the pre-sintering step is finished, and sintering the glass powder to obtain the glass passivation layer. Because before sintering, the liquid adhesive is baked and volatilized in a low-temperature baking mode, in the process, due to the capillary phenomenon, the glass slurry flows upwards along the side wall of the groove, the dried glass slurry at the bottom of the groove becomes thin, and the glass slurry in the PN junction area of the side wall of the groove becomes thick. Therefore, the glass passivation process adopting the one-time knife scraping method can ensure that the thickness of the glass passivation layer on the side wall of the groove meets the requirement, save the cost of glass powder and improve the coating efficiency.

title_en: Light emitting device and electronic apparatus including the same
abstract_en: The present application relates to a light emitting device including a first electrode, a second electrode facing the first electrode, and an intermediate layer between the first electrode and the second electrode and including an emission layer. The emission layer may include a hole transport host, an electron transport host, a sensitizer, and a delayed fluorescence dopant. The hole transporting host and the electron transporting host may form an exciplex. The sensitizer may comprise an organometallic compound. The delayed fluorescence dopant may not include a metal atom, and the exciplex may satisfy a specific equation.

title_en: Synchronous rectifier based on Field Effect Transistor (FET) for analog diode
abstract_en: The invention provides a Field Effect Transistor (FET) based synchronous rectifier for an analog diode comprising a first terminal (20) and a second terminal (30), a first FET (M1) and a second FET (M2), wherein the second FET (M2) is adapted to control the operation of the first FET (M1) to thereby allow unidirectional current flow when both terminals (20, 30) are connected to an external circuit, and wherein the FET based synchronous rectifier comprises a fully integrated single chip device (10) adapted to analog diodes.

title_en: Display panel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses display panel and preparation method of display panel, display panel includes substrate, anode layer, test pad, barrier layer, luminescent layer and cathode layer, wherein, the barrier layer is undercut structure, when adopting the method of whole face evaporation plating to form the cathode layer like this, can break naturally at barrier layer department cathode layer to isolated cathode layer and test pad electric connection, also need not use the expensive and not high evaporation plating mask version of precision of cost.

title_en: Hole buffer material, preparation method thereof and OLED device
abstract_en: The application discloses a hole buffer material, a preparation method thereof and an OLED device. The hole buffer material comprises vanadium pentoxide and graphene oxide, wherein the weight ratio of the vanadium pentoxide to the graphene oxide is 3:1 to 3; the hole buffer layer material is a layered composite material and comprises graphene oxide nano sheets and vanadium pentoxide nano belts. The hole buffer material adopts a vanadium pentoxide and graphene oxide composite material, has a multi-stage structure, and is formed by mutually supporting graphene oxide nano sheets and ultrathin vanadium pentoxide nano belts; the graphene can also improve the conductivity of the material and can effectively improve the current efficiency of the OLED device.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The application provides a display panel and a display device, relates to the technical field of display, and aims to solve the technical problem that the touch effect of the display panel with a touch layer is not good. The display panel comprises a cathode layer, a touch layer and a shielding layer; the display panel is provided with a plurality of non-display areas, the touch layer is positioned on one side of the light-emitting surface of the cathode layer, which is close to the display panel, and the shielding layer is positioned on one side of the light-emitting surface of the cathode layer, which is far away from the display panel; the cathode layer in the non-display area is provided with a vacant area, the orthographic projection of the touch layer on the cathode layer is positioned in the vacant area, and the orthographic projection of the shielding layer on the cathode layer covers the orthographic projection of the touch layer on the cathode layer. The touch control precision and the sensitivity of the touch control layer can be effectively improved, the touch control effect is improved, and the use performance of the display panel and the display device is optimized.

title_en: Semiconductor device and semiconductor memory device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a semiconductor device and a semiconductor memory device. The semiconductor device of the embodiment includes: a substrate; a 1 st electrode; a 2 nd electrode, wherein a 1 st electrode is arranged between the substrate and the 2 nd electrode; an oxide semiconductor layer which is provided between the 1 st electrode and the 2 nd electrode, is In contact with the 1 st electrode, contains zinc (Zn) and at least one 1 st element selected from the group consisting of indium (In), gallium (Ga), silicon (Si), aluminum (Al), and tin (Sn), and has a chemical composition different from that of the 1 st electrode and the 2 nd electrode; a conductive layer which is provided between the oxide semiconductor layer and the 2 nd electrode, is In contact with the 2 nd electrode, contains at least one 2 nd element selected from the group consisting of indium (In), gallium (Ga), silicon (Si), aluminum (Al), tin (Sn), zinc (Zn), and titanium (Ti), and oxygen (O), and has a chemical composition different from that of the 1 st electrode, the 2 nd electrode, and the oxide semiconductor layer; a gate electrode; and a gate insulating layer disposed between the oxide semiconductor layer and the gate electrode.

title_en: TOPCon battery main grid silver paste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to TOPCon battery main grid silver paste which comprises 78-85wt% of mixed silver powder, 1-5wt% of main glass powder Pb-Si-Ti-Zn oxide, 0.1-2wt% of auxiliary glass powder Bi-Si-Mn-Cu oxide, 8-20wt% of organic carrier and 0.5-5wt% of organic auxiliary agent, wherein the mixed silver powder is a mixture of spherical silver powder A, spheroidal silver powder B and nano silver powder C, the fineness of the main grid silver paste is less than 8 mu m, and the viscosity of the main grid silver paste at a rotating speed of 5rmp is 90-150Pa & S/25 ℃. The main grid silver paste has a wider sintering window and higher photoelectric conversion efficiency, and can simultaneously meet the requirements of TOPCon battery front and back main grid electrodes.

title_en: NOR type semiconductor memory device and manufacturing method thereof
