abstract_en: The present invention provides a NOR type semiconductor memory device and a method of manufacturing the same, wherein the semiconductor memory device includes: a two-dimensional semiconductor memory structure (PUC) on the peripheral circuit; a contact layer over the two-dimensional semiconductor memory structure. According to the scheme, the two-dimensional semiconductor storage structure is combined with the PUC technology to form a three-dimensional NOR gate semiconductor memory device (3D NOR Flash memory), so that the consumption of the PUC circuit to the space amount of a chip is reduced, the space utilization rate of the NOR gate Flash memory device is improved, the storage density is improved, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Three-dimensional memory and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a three-dimensional memory and a method of fabricating the same. The method may include: forming an etch stop layer and a sacrificial layer adjacent to each other in a direction parallel to a substrate on the substrate; forming a laminated structure on the etching stop layer and the sacrificial layer; forming a channel structure penetrating through the laminated structure to the sacrificial layer; removing the substrate and the sacrificial layer to expose an end portion of the channel structure; removing a portion of the functional layer of the channel structure to expose the channel layer of the channel structure; and forming an extraction structure in contact with the channel layer. According to the preparation method of the three-dimensional memory, the problem of electric leakage caused by etching of the virtual channel in the preparation process can be avoided, and the electrical performance and the product yield of the three-dimensional memory are improved.

title_en: High-efficiency perovskite solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency perovskite solar cell and a preparation method thereof, wherein formamidinopyridine (3,4APX) C  6 H 8 XN 3  (X=I, br and Cl) is used as an additive to prepare perovskite precursor liquid, and a high-quality perovskite film is prepared by regulating and controlling precursor liquid solute components, so that the high-efficiency stable perovskite solar cell is obtained, and a new thought and a new method are provided for promoting the perovskite solar cell to be applied to business. Therefore, by regulating and controlling the components of the precursor liquid, an additive with excellent performance is searched for to obtain the high-standard perovskite precursor liquid, and a solution method is used for preparing a high-quality perovskite film so as to greatly improve the efficiency of the perovskite solar cell.

title_en: Method, apparatus and system for wafer grounding
abstract_en: Systems and methods for wafer grounding and wafer grounding position adjustment are disclosed. The first method may include: receiving a first value of an electrical characteristic associated with a wafer grounded by an electrical signal; determining a first control parameter using at least the first value; and controlling a characteristic of the electrical signal using the first control parameter and the first value. The second method for adjusting the ground position of the wafer may include: terminating the electrical connection between the wafer and at least one ground pin contacting the wafer; adjusting the relative position between the wafer and the grounding pin; and restoring the electrical connection between the ground pin and the wafer. The third method may include: causing the ground pin to penetrate a coating on the wafer by impact; and establishing an electrical connection between the ground pin and the wafer.

title_en: Semiconductor wafer transfer and turnover integrated processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semiconductor wafer transfer and turnover integrated processing device, which comprises: the wafer loading device comprises a machine cabinet, a wafer loading port and a wafer loading device, wherein a taking and placing opening is formed in one side of the machine cabinet, the wafer loading port is formed in the machine cabinet and is used for positioning and loading at least one group of unloaded wafer storage boxes and one group of full-load wafer storage boxes; location recognition mechanism, location recognition mechanism includes: the transfer supporting component, the positioning edge-searching module and the scanning reading module; the turnover mechanism is borne in the cabinet and used for clamping the wafer and turning the wafer 180 degrees; and the bearing is carried in the machine cabinet to transfer the mechanical arm. The wafer is taken and put to tilting mechanism department to transfer the manipulator after location discernment is accomplished, and tilting mechanism turns over 180 after pressing from both sides the wafer tight, and the manipulator that shifts afterwards takes out the wafer from tilting mechanism once more and places in the unloaded wafer storage box, repeats above-mentioned action and can overturn in proper order all wafers and transmit in the unloaded wafer storage box, realizes the automatic transmission and the upset of wafer.

title_en: OLED display panel and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses OLED display panel and electronic equipment. The OLED display panel comprises a display main body and a first organic packaging layer, wherein the display main body is provided with a display area and a non-display area arranged on the periphery of the display area; the first organic packaging layer is arranged on the display main body and comprises a first organic packaging part, the first organic packaging part is located in the non-display area, and the first organic packaging part comprises a water absorbent. The edge packaging effect of the OLED display panel is improved.

title_en: Solar spectrum wavelength conversion material and solar cell comprising same
abstract_en: Provided are a solar spectrum wavelength conversion material having improved efficiency and a solar cell including the same. According to one embodiment of the present invention, there is provided a solar spectrum wavelength converting material comprising an aluminum hydroxide precursor anchored with 1-pyrene carboxylic acid. The solar spectrum wavelength converting material further includes an aromatic ring compound or a derivative including the same.

title_en: Preparation method of columnar electrode structure of perovskite solar cell
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a columnar electrode structure of a perovskite solar cell, which comprises the following steps: firstly, etching off a metal material outside a reserved position on the surface of a plane metal to obtain an initial columnar electrode structure; depositing a first carrier transmission layer on the surface of the initial columnar electrode structure to obtain a columnar electrode structure; the method comprises the steps of preparing an initial columnar electrode structure by using a laser etching method, and depositing a first carrier transmission layer by using a surface deposition method to obtain a columnar electrode structure; the method can process the position beneficial to depositing the carrier transmission layer on the surface of the fine electrode core layer, and finally prepare the columnar electrode structure, so that the prepared perovskite battery has higher photoelectric conversion efficiency.

title_en: Display panel, manufacturing method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a display panel, a manufacturing method thereof and a display device, wherein ambient light can be collected through a hollow part of a light conducting layer, and after the ambient light is totally reflected at an interface between a second refraction layer and a first refraction layer and an interface between the second refraction layer and a third refraction layer, the ambient light is led out to a photosensitive element through a light leading-out opening. Therefore, the invention can achieve the purpose of flexibly setting the placement position of the photosensitive element only by optimizing the position of the light guide outlet of the light conduction layer.

title_en: Memory system packaging structure and manufacturing method
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a memory system package structure and a method of manufacturing the same. The memory system packaging structure comprises at least one memory chip molding assembly, a memory controller, a molding layer for encapsulating the memory chip molding assembly and the memory controller and a rewiring layer, wherein each memory chip molding assembly comprises a plurality of stacked memory dies, a molding layer for encapsulating the memory dies and one or more conductive posts, the conductive posts extend from the first end through the molding layer so that second ends of the conductive posts can be arranged on and in physical contact with and electrically connected with a first surface of the rewiring layer, and an extraction pad is arranged on the first surface of the rewiring layer through which the memory controller is arranged and electrically connected with the rewiring layer.

title_en: Redundancy scheme for multi-chip stacking apparatus
abstract_en: Some examples described herein relate to redundancy in multi-chip stacked devices. Examples described herein are multi-chip devices. The multi-chip device includes a chip stack including vertically stacked chips. Adjacent chips are directly connected together. Each of the two or more chips includes a processing integrated circuit. The chip stack may be configured to run a functional subset of the processing integrated circuit of the two or more chips when any portion of the processing integrated circuit is defective.

title_en: Column type photovoltaic module and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a column type photovoltaic module and manufacturing method thereof, wherein, the column type photovoltaic module includes: a column, the column comprising: endotheca and overcoat, overcoat cover are established on the endotheca, and the overcoat includes: a cavity is arranged between the euphotic layer and the inner sleeve; a photovoltaic cell assembly, the photovoltaic cell assembly comprising: at least one battery slot cluster, at least one battery slot cluster set gradually in the cavity along the circumference of endotheca, and the sensitive surface of battery slot cluster is towards the euphotic layer, and this application compares the advantage that has with relevant technique: through the setting of cavity, make the narrow piece cluster of battery still can stably set up between endotheca and overcoat under the condition that does not use the lamination mode, realize photovoltaic module's columnar structure to effectively reduced holistic processing degree of difficulty when satisfying the user demand, guarantee photovoltaic module's wide application.

title_en: Method for manufacturing SiC substrate
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to provide a novel technique for manufacturing a SiC substrate, which can reduce material loss when removing a strained layer. The present invention is a method for manufacturing a SiC substrate (30), including: and a strain layer thinning step (S1) for thinning the strain layer (12) by moving the strain layer (12) of the SiC substrate body (10) to the front surface side. In this way, by including the strain layer thinning step (S1) of moving (concentrating) the strain layer (12) to the surface side, the material loss (L) at the time of removing the strain layer (12) can be reduced.

title_en: Anti-adhesion and insufficient-welding flip-chip welding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flip-chip welding method for preventing adhesion and cold joint, which is used for welding a chip on a substrate, wherein the welding surface of the chip is provided with a plurality of first welding spots, the substrate is provided with a welding pad area corresponding to the welding surface, the welding pad area is provided with a plurality of second welding spots corresponding to the first welding spots, and the flip-chip welding method comprises the steps of coating tin paste on the plurality of second welding spots; placing at least three support members which are not on the same straight line at a second welding point positioned at the edge of the pad area, wherein each support member is positioned at a second welding point; heating the pad area to melt the solder paste into solder balls, and melting the supporting pieces into the solder balls; placing the chip on the substrate, and enabling the welding surface to face the pad area; heating the substrate and/or the chip and pressing the chip towards the substrate to melt the solder balls and weld the solder balls with the corresponding first welding points; the support is abutted against the chip and the substrate to limit the distance between the chip and the substrate. The technical scheme of the invention can solve the problem that flip chip bonding is easy to generate insufficient solder and adhesion.

title_en: Semiconductor device having three-dimensional cell structure and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present application relates to a semiconductor device and a method of manufacturing the same. A semiconductor device according to one aspect of the present disclosure includes a substrate, a plurality of word line structures disposed over the substrate to be spaced apart from each other in a first direction perpendicular to a surface of the substrate. Each of the plurality of word line structures extends in a second direction parallel to the substrate surface. In addition, the semiconductor device includes: a switching layer disposed on the substrate to contact side surfaces of the plurality of word line structures; and a bit line structure disposed on the substrate to extend in the first direction and contact a surface of the switching layer. The switching layer is configured to perform a threshold switching operation and has a variable, programmable threshold voltage.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent compound and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an organic electroluminescent compound and application thereof, wherein the structure of the organic electroluminescent compound is shown as a formula I: l, L therein 1 、L 2 Independently selected from any one of single bond, substituted or unsubstituted arylene of C6-C30 and substituted or unsubstituted heteroarylene of C3-C30; ar (Ar) 1 、Ar 2 Independently selected from any one of hydrogen, deuterium, halogen, cyano, substituted or unsubstituted C1-C30 alkyl, substituted or unsubstituted C3-C30 cycloalkyl, substituted or unsubstituted C6-C60 aryl and substituted or unsubstituted C3-C60 heteroaryl.The organic electroluminescent device made of the organic electroluminescent compound provided by the invention has the characteristics of high current efficiency and long service life.

title_en: Wafer conveying module and method for conveying pre-conveyed wafer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wafer transmission module in a semiconductor manufacturing machine, in particular to a semiconductor integrated circuit manufacturing machine, which is characterized in that two groups of transmitters/receivers are additionally arranged on the side wall of the wafer transmission module to monitor the advancing position of an elevator, two groups of transmitters/receivers are additionally arranged on the side wall of the wafer transmission module to monitor the position of a transmission arm, and signals received by the receivers are transmitted to a control system, so that the control system can judge whether the transmission arm can acquire a pre-transmitted wafer according to the advancing position of the elevator and the position of the transmission arm, and the problem of wafer scratch caused by the position deviation of the elevator or the position deviation of the transmission arm can be prevented.

title_en: Semiconductor packaging structure
abstract_en: Provided is a semiconductor package structure including: a semiconductor package; a substrate; solder balls disposed between the semiconductor package and the substrate; and a semiconductor thermoelectric element including at least one pair of thermocouples, and the pair of thermocouples including one P-type semiconductor and one N-type semiconductor, wherein the semiconductor thermoelectric element is disposed between the semiconductor package and the substrate, and is applied with a voltage through the substrate.

title_en: Display with optical edge sensor
abstract_en: The display may have an array of light emitting pixels that display an image in an active area of the display. The light emitting pixels may be visible light pixels such as red, green and blue thin film organic light emitting diode pixels. The display may also have a border region extending along a peripheral edge of the active area. The boundary region may be free of pixels displaying image light, and the active region may be free of photodetectors. A non-optical touch sensor, such as a capacitive touch sensor, may overlap the active area to collect touch input from the active area. The non-optical touch sensor may not overlap any portion of the border region. In this boundary region, an optical sensor formed of an infrared light emitting pixel and an infrared light sensing pixel or other optical sensing circuit may be used as an optical touch sensor.

title_en: Temperature control device and method for conveying chamber
abstract_en: The invention relates to a temperature control device and a temperature control method for a transfer chamber, relates to the technical field of semiconductor equipment manufacturing, and is used for solving the problem that when wafers enter the next process due to different temperatures of the wafers in the processes, the current temperature of the wafers can cause negative influence on the next process to a certain extent. The device comprises: the device comprises a moving component, a control component and a temperature control component; the moving assembly is arranged in the conveying chamber and used for bearing the wafer; the temperature control assembly is arranged at the bottom of the conveying chamber and comprises a cooling area assembly and a heating area assembly; the control assembly is used for detecting the surface temperature of the wafer and the process to be executed corresponding to the wafer; controlling the moving assembly to move the wafer to a preset position according to the surface temperature of the wafer and the process to be executed corresponding to the wafer, and generating a corresponding temperature control instruction; and after the wafer reaches the preset position, controlling the temperature control assembly to execute the temperature control instruction. The technical scheme provided by the invention can improve the overall efficiency of the process.

title_en: Alignment method for interconnection structural member of photovoltaic module and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a contraposition method for an interconnection structural member of a photovoltaic assembly and the photovoltaic assembly, wherein the contraposition method comprises the following steps: identifying actual locations of transitions of a plurality of interconnected structures; judging the position difference value of the actual position of the transition section of each interconnected structural member and the theoretical position of the transition section; when the absolute value of the position difference is not zero, pushing the transition section of the corresponding interconnected structural member to a theoretical position; judging whether the absolute value of the position difference value of the transition section of at least one interconnected structural member is larger than or equal to a preset protection value; if so, cutting one end of the light reflecting sections of the plurality of interconnected structural members, which is far away from the transition section; and if not, not cutting the plurality of interconnected structural parts. According to the alignment method for the interconnection structural members of the photovoltaic module, the cutting times of the interconnection structural members can be effectively reduced, the risk of hidden cracking of the battery pieces is reduced, and the interconnection structural members are more convenient to clean.

title_en: Quantum dot light emitting diode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantum dot light-emitting diode and a preparation method thereof, wherein the quantum dot light-emitting diode comprises a quantum dot layer; the quantum dot device comprises a quantum dot layer, an anion polymer layer and an electron transport layer, wherein the anion polymer layer is formed on the surface of the quantum dot layer, and the electron transport layer is formed on the surface of the anion polymer layer. In the quantum dot layer of the quantum dot light-emitting diode, the surface contacted with the electron transmission layer is coordinated to be an anionic polymer, and the rest area of the quantum dot layer still remains as an original ligand. According to the principle of homogeneous charge repulsion and heterogeneous charge attraction, when the surface ligand of the equivalent quantum dot layer close to one side of the electron transport layer is replaced by an anionic polymer, the electron injection identical to the charge of the functional group of the anionic polymer can be blocked to a certain extent, so that the effective recombination of carriers in the whole quantum dot layer is facilitated, and the device performance is improved.

title_en: Semiconductor epitaxial structure, preparation method thereof and semiconductor device
abstract_en: The application relates to a semiconductor epitaxial structure, a preparation method thereof and a semiconductor device, wherein the method comprises a substrate and an epitaxial multilayer structure, the epitaxial multilayer structure comprises a nucleation layer, and the nucleation layer is formed on the substrate; wherein the nucleation layer is doped with iron and silicon. According to the epitaxial multi-layer structure, the nucleation layer is arranged in the epitaxial multi-layer structure, and the thermal mismatch and the lattice mismatch between the epitaxial layer and the substrate are effectively relieved by the nucleation layer formed on the substrate, so that the deformation of an epitaxial wafer caused by the thermal mismatch and the lattice mismatch in the epitaxial growth process is avoided, the uniformity of the epitaxial layer is improved, the crystal quality of the epitaxial layer is improved, and the yield of epitaxial products is improved while the cost of the products is reduced; and by controlling proper doping of silicon and iron in the nucleation layer, the current collapse of the device is effectively reduced, and the performance and reliability of the device are improved.

title_en: Mask assembly and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A mask assembly and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The mask assembly includes a mask frame defining a first opening at a center and including an outer frame surrounding the first opening and defining at least one recess, a mask body disposed corresponding to the first opening, defining a plurality of second openings having an area smaller than the first opening in a plane, a first sub-mask disposed at an upper portion of the mask body, defining a plurality of third openings having an area smaller than the second openings in a plane in an entire surface, and formed using a metal substance, a second sub-mask disposed at an upper portion of the first sub-mask, defining a plurality of fourth openings having an area smaller than the third openings in a plane in an entire surface, and formed using a polymer substance, and a solder portion disposed at an upper portion of the second sub-mask in an interior of the at least one recess, whereby a low-weight large-sized mask assembly can be provided.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display panel and a display device, wherein the orthographic projection of each effective light-emitting area on a substrate and the orthographic projection of a signal wire on the substrate have a first overlapping area, and the shape of the first overlapping area is nonlinear, so that light emitted from the effective light-emitting area can form light interference through the signal wire in the first overlapping area. Accordingly, when the display panel is applied to a 3D display device, moire can be improved and a display effect can be improved.

title_en: Gallium nitride light-emitting diode epitaxial wafer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gallium nitride light-emitting diode epitaxial wafer and a preparation method thereof, wherein an aluminum nitride film buffer layer, an undoped gallium nitride layer and an undoped aluminum gallium nitride layer are sequentially grown on a substrate; the method comprises the steps of growing a first heavily doped N-type gallium nitride layer on an undoped aluminum gallium nitride layer, coarsening and carrying out edge treatment on the first heavily doped N-type gallium nitride layer, increasing the light emergent angle and releasing the stress in the first heavily doped N-type gallium nitride layer, growing a silicon dioxide layer on the first heavily doped N-type gallium nitride layer, carrying out graphical etching on the silicon dioxide layer and exposing the surface of the first heavily doped N-type gallium nitride layer, and growing a second heavily doped N-type gallium nitride layer on the first heavily doped N-type gallium nitride layer and the silicon dioxide layer by utilizing the non-conductive characteristic of the silicon dioxide layer.

title_en: Gluing module, semiconductor manufacturing equipment and wafer cleaning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a gluing module, semiconductor manufacturing equipment and a wafer cleaning method, which relate to the technical field of semiconductors and comprise a base, wherein a telescopic supporting component is arranged on the base and comprises at least three vacuum suction pipes; the rotating unit is arranged on the base and provided with a vacuum chuck; a coating unit mounted on the base and disposed opposite to the rotating unit; the cleaning unit comprises a driving assembly and a cleaning piece, and the cleaning piece is movably assembled on the coating unit through the driving assembly and used for cleaning the wafer. In the technical scheme, the coating unit is provided with the cleaning unit which can be used for cleaning the wafer, so that the cleaning unit can be used for cleaning the back of the wafer by selecting proper intermittent time in the process of coating the wafer by using the coating unit, the pollution of the wafer is effectively reduced, and the yield is improved.

title_en: Apparatus for treating substrate
abstract_en: The present inventive concept provides a substrate processing apparatus. The substrate processing apparatus includes a first processing part that performs liquid processing on a plurality of substrates in a batch processing method, and a second processing part that processes the substrates processed at the first processing part and performs liquid processing or drying processing on a single substrate in a single processing method.

title_en: Ink separating device and substrate processing system having the same
abstract_en: The invention provides an ink separating device for separating normal ink and bad ink by measuring the sedimentation velocity of ink particles and a substrate processing system with the same. The ink separating device includes: a settling velocity measuring section that measures a settling velocity of the ink solution supplied to the ink jet head unit; and a control unit that determines the ink solution as any one of normal ink and defective ink based on a settling speed of the ink solution, wherein if the ink solution is determined as normal ink, the ink is supplied to the inkjet head unit, and if the ink solution is determined as defective ink, the ink is discarded.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses display panel and display device, display panel include sub-pixel district and with the supplementary negative pole district that sub-pixel district interval set up, display panel includes: a substrate; an electrode layer disposed on the substrate, including an auxiliary cathode layer located within the auxiliary cathode region; a first organic layer disposed on the substrate and the electrode layer; a cathode layer disposed on the first organic layer; the first organic layer comprises a first organic sub-portion arranged on the auxiliary cathode layer and a second organic sub-portion arranged at an interval with the first organic sub-portion and adjacent to the side surface of the auxiliary cathode layer, and the cathode layer is arranged on the first organic sub-portion and the second organic sub-portion and electrically connected with the side surface of the auxiliary cathode layer, so that the phenomenon of uneven display of the display panel is effectively improved.

title_en: Derivative of oxygen-containing heterocyclic compound, light-emitting device, and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present disclosure provides a derivative of an oxygen-containing heterocyclic compound, a light emitting device, and a display device, the derivative of the oxygen-containing heterocyclic compound having a structure represented by general formula I: wherein R1-R4 are respectively and independently selected from hydrogen, deuterium, halogen, cyano, nitro, C1-C40 alkyl, C2-C40 alkenyl, C2-C40 alkynyl, C3-C40 cycloalkyl, C3-C40 heterocycloalkyl, C6-C60 aryl, C5-C60 heteroaryl, C1-C40 alkylAlkoxy, aryloxy of C6-C60, alkylsilyl of C3-C40, arylsilyl of C6-C60, alkylboron of C1-C40, arylboron of C6-C60, arylphosphinylene of C6-C60, mono-or diarylphosphino of C6-C60, and arylamino of C6-C60.

title_en: Conductive via structure for improving far-end crosstalk
abstract_en: A semiconductor structure, comprising: a substrate having a plurality of conductive layers and a plurality of insulating layers alternately stacked along a vertical direction of the substrate; a first conductive via structure extending from a top conductive layer of the plurality of conductive layers to a bottom conductive layer of the plurality of conductive layers and comprising a first capacitive structure extending in a first conductive layer of the plurality of conductive layers; a second conductive via structure extending from the top conductive layer to the bottom conductive layer and comprising a second capacitive structure extending in the first conductive layer; and a third capacitive structure extending in the first or second of the plurality of conductive layers, the third capacitive structure forming a first mutual capacitance with the first capacitive structure and a second mutual capacitance with the second capacitive structure.

title_en: Light color conversion structure, light emitting unit and manufacturing method of light emitting unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a light color conversion structure, a light emitting unit and a manufacturing method of the light emitting unit, wherein the light color conversion structure is provided with two first substrates which are positioned at the opposite sides of a color conversion layer, and the first substrates are used for blocking moisture and dust, so that a color conversion material in the color conversion layer can be well protected, and the service life is prolonged; the first substrate is provided with black light resistance parts, each black light resistance part surrounds at least one light transmission part, the black light resistance parts are opposite to the black area of the black matrix, the through holes in the black matrix are opposite to the light transmission parts in the first substrate, and color crosstalk can be effectively avoided by utilizing the black light resistance parts and the black matrix.

title_en: Edge terminal of semiconductor power device, manufacturing method of edge terminal and semiconductor power device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an edge terminal of a semiconductor power device, a manufacturing method thereof and the semiconductor power device, wherein the edge terminal comprises N floating field limiting rings, the floating field limiting rings encircle a main junction area of the semiconductor power device, the junction depths of 1 st to N-th floating field limiting rings are the same as the junction depths of the main junction area, the junction depth of n+i-th floating field limiting rings is larger than the junction depth of N-th floating field limiting rings, the junction depths of the floating field limiting rings are gradually increased from n+1-th floating field limiting rings, N, N and i are positive integers, and n+i is more than or equal to 2 and less than or equal to N. According to the edge terminal, the junction depth and the doping distribution of the floating field limiting ring are optimized, the curvature radius of the floating field limiting ring is increased, the electric field distribution uniformity and the electric field distribution area of the terminal area are improved, and further the terminal efficiency and the blocking voltage are improved.

title_en: Aluminum alloy 6061, production method thereof and gas distribution plate
abstract_en: The invention provides an aluminum alloy 6061, a production method thereof and a gas distribution plate, wherein the production method comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing an aluminum ingot and an aluminum-copper intermediate alloy ingot, and performing first melting to obtain a first melt; (2) Adding a magnesium ingot and an aluminum-silicon intermediate alloy ingot into the first melting material, and heating for second melting to obtain a second melting material; (3) And the second melt is subjected to casting, annealing, rolling, solid solution and aging treatment in sequence to obtain the aluminum alloy 6061. According to the invention, the aluminum-copper alloy ingot and the aluminum-silicon alloy ingot are adopted for smelting, and the smelting sequence is optimized, so that the problem that the structure segregation is easy to generate in the common aluminum alloy 6061 material is solved, the corrosion resistance of the prepared aluminum alloy 6061 is obviously improved, the aluminum alloy 6061 can be used as a gas distribution plate in a semiconductor part, and the application prospect is wide.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises at least two spliced light-emitting units which are spliced together, each spliced light-emitting unit comprises a bearing substrate, a plurality of light-emitting elements, a plurality of first connecting wires and a plurality of second connecting wires, a first signal wire and a second signal wire are respectively arranged on the first side surface and the second side surface of the bearing substrate of each spliced light-emitting unit, the first signal wire is electrically connected with the first connecting wires, the second signal wire is electrically connected with the second connecting wires, a first input signal is input into the light-emitting elements sequentially through the first signal wire and the first connecting wires, and a second input signal is input into the light-emitting elements sequentially through the second signal wire and the second connecting wires. Compared with the prior art, the invention increases the input paths of the first input signal and the second input signal, and improves the problems of brightness difference and uniformity deterioration caused by signal voltage drop.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a display device, and since a storage capacitor and an active pattern disposed on a sub-pixel are arranged by using an active layer in which a semiconductor layer and a conductive layer are stacked, an area of the storage capacitor may be efficiently increased, and a method of using an area overlapping a contact hole located on the active pattern as an area of the storage capacitor may be provided. Further, since it is easy to adjust the position of the contact hole, by not providing the contact hole on the region adjacent to the driving transistor, the size of the driving transistor can be increased, and the aperture ratio of the sub-pixel can be improved.

title_en: Display panel, preparation method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The application provides a display panel, a preparation method thereof and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises a substrate, an insulating retaining wall and an LED chip, wherein the substrate is provided with a plurality of metal contact electrodes which are arranged at intervals, the insulating retaining wall is arranged on the substrate and between two adjacent metal contact electrodes, the LED chip is arranged on the substrate and is provided with a first electrode and a second electrode, the first electrode and the second electrode are respectively arranged corresponding to the two adjacent metal contact electrodes, and the first electrode and the second electrode are welded and fixed with the metal contact electrodes through welding materials. According to the display panel provided by the embodiment of the application, the insulating retaining wall is arranged between the two adjacent metal contact electrodes to isolate conductive media such as welding materials, so that the welding materials coated on the two adjacent metal contact electrodes can be prevented from contacting each other in the process of preparing the display panel, the conduction short circuit of the two adjacent metal contact electrodes is avoided, and the structural stability of the display panel is improved.

title_en: Semitransparent all-inorganic perovskite/organic laminated solar cell based on selective light filtering design and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a laminated solar cell, which comprises a conductive substrate, an electron transport layer, an all-inorganic perovskite layer, an intermediate composite layer, an organic active layer, a hole transport layer and a metal electrode layer which are sequentially arranged. The design of the laminated solar cell semitransparent laminate realizes selective filtering design while improving cell efficiency, can tunably absorb light in an ultraviolet region and an infrared region which are invisible to human eyes, and transmits visible light with good response to human eye vision, so that cost is effectively reduced, PCE is improved, good human eye comfort is kept, and excellent and stable power generation, energy conservation and privacy protection performances are provided. The laminated solar cell based on the selective light filtering design has good color rendering characteristic, can be used as photovoltaic glass for shielding sunlight and protecting privacy, and further can be widely applied to the aesthetic application fields of BIPV, curtain walls, aviation, automobile intelligent windows and the like.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent element
abstract_en: The invention provides an organic electroluminescent element. The organic electroluminescent element comprises a hole transport region, a light emitting layer and an electron transport region arranged in sequence from an anode to a cathode, wherein the hole transport region contains a compound represented by a general formula A, and the electron transport region contains compounds B and Ar 1 And Ar 2 Are identical or different and are each independently unsubstituted C 6 ‑C 30 The device efficiency is obviously improved.

title_en: Ion implantation process and apparatus using gallium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present application relate to ion implantation processes and apparatus using gallium. An ion source apparatus for ion implantation is described, comprising: an ion source cavity; and a consumable structure in or associated with the ion source cavity, wherein the consumable structure includes a solid dopant source material susceptible to reacting with a reactant gas to release dopant in gaseous form to the ion source cavity, wherein the solid dopant source material comprises gallium nitride, gallium oxide, or a combination thereof, any of which may be isotopically enriched with respect to a gallium isotope.

title_en: Preparation method of special ceramic and product thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of special ceramic and a product thereof. The ceramic comprises SrBi  8  Ti  7‑x‑y  Nb  x  W  y  O  27  And alumina, wherein x=0.02 to 0.05, y=0.02 to 0.05; the alumina is relative to SrBi  8  Ti  7‑x‑y  Nb  x  W  y  O  27  The amount of (2) is 10-20%. And the piezoelectric constant d of the prepared special ceramic  33  21.5-26.2 pC/N,2P  r  ＝4.14～4.43μC/cm  2  ；d  33  Can still maintain 19.7-25.6 pC/N after being treated at 400 ℃; thus by reacting SrBi  8  Ti  7  O  27  The ceramic modification can effectively improve the piezoelectric performance and the ferroelectric performance, and is an ideal material for the field of photoelectric multifunctional materials.

title_en: Gas supply method, substrate processing method, and gas supply apparatus
abstract_en: In the present invention, the 1 st supply step is performed to mix the 2 nd gas with the 1 st gas as a carrier gas of the 2 nd gas generated by vaporizing the material, and supply the mixed gas of the 1 st gas and the 2 nd gas to the processing object such as the substrate (cleaning removal). Next, a 2 nd supply step (evaporation drying) of supplying the heated 1 st gas to the processing object is performed. This enables the foreign matter on the treatment target to be effectively cleaned and removed.

title_en: Capacitor structure, DRAM and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a capacitor structure, a DRAM and a manufacturing method thereof. A capacitor structure is a cylindrical structure and comprises a lower electrode, an upper electrode and a capacitor dielectric film for isolating the lower electrode from the upper electrode; at least one of the lower electrode and the upper electrode includes a plasma-treated metal nitride layer, and the plasma-treated metal nitride layer is plasma-treated on a side in contact with the dielectric film. The invention can improve the smoothness of the electrode, reduce the tensile stress of the electrode, effectively reduce the electric leakage problem of the capacitor and is suitable for manufacturing devices with more miniaturized sizes.

title_en: Polycyclic aromatic compound and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The polycyclic aromatic compound with a large conjugated parent nucleus structure ensures that the compound has stronger oscillator strength, narrows an emission spectrum, has electroluminescent performance with high color purity and can obtain a high-efficiency luminescent device. Heterogeneous elements such as boron, oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur and the like are introduced into the polycyclic aromatic compound to ensure that the polycyclic aromatic compound has a large energy gap Eg and a lower triplet state energy level T 1 The compound of the invention can be used for preparing blue light devices with high color purity.

title_en: Plasma-resistant member, component for plasma processing apparatus, and plasma processing apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a plasma-resistant member in which a surface exposed to plasma is formed of {100} plane single crystal Yttrium Aluminum Garnet (YAG), and a component for a plasma processing apparatus and a plasma processing apparatus using the plasma-resistant member. At least the most plasma-resistant surface is formed of single-crystal YAG having {100} planes, when a plurality of surfaces are exposed to plasma.

title_en: Color exterior wall element with composite pane structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to an exterior wall element (1) comprising a colored transparent or translucent first pane (2) and a mechanically supporting transparent second pane (3), which are firmly connected to each other by means of an intermediate layer (13), wherein the first pane (2) has a front surface (4) arranged on the light entrance side and has an opposite rear surface (5), wherein at least one surface (4, 5) selected from the front and rear surfaces has at least one structured area (8, 8 '), wherein at least one optical interference layer (9, 9 ') is arranged on at least one surface (4, 5) selected from the front and rear surfaces for reflecting light in a predetermined wavelength range, wherein the at least one structured area (8, 8 ') has the following features: -a plane perpendicular to the first pane (2), a height profile comprising peaks and valleys, wherein the average height difference between the peaks and the valleys is at least 2 micrometers; -at least 50% of the structured zone consists of sections inclined with respect to the plane of the first pane (2), wherein at least 20% of the sections are inclined with respect to the plane of the first pane (2) An oblique angle in the range of more than 0 ° to a maximum of 15 °, at least 30% of the sections having an oblique angle in the range of more than 15 ° to a maximum of 45 °, wherein-each of the sections is flat and the section area is at least 1 μm  2  Wherein each of the segments has an average roughness of less than 15% of the layer thickness of the at least one optical interference layer.

title_en: Array substrate, manufacturing method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The application provides an array substrate, a manufacturing method of the array substrate and a display device. Wherein, the array substrate includes first base plate and the first metal function layer that forms on first base plate, and first base plate is provided with open area and non-open area, and first metal function layer includes the grid of transistor, and the grid is located non-open area, and the array substrate still includes: the transparent conducting layer comprises a buffering conducting part and an alignment electrode part which are arranged on the same layer, the buffering conducting part is arranged between the grid and the first substrate and is in contact with the grid, the adhesion force between the buffering conducting part and the first substrate and the adhesion force between the buffering conducting part and the grid are both larger than the adhesion force between the grid and the first substrate in direct contact, the alignment electrode part is at least partially positioned in the opening area, and the alignment electrode part is used for providing an alignment electric field. The technical scheme of this application can improve the fastness of metal membranous layer to reduce droing of metal membranous layer.

title_en: P-type island and super junction structure-based hybrid PIN Schottky diode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed PIN Schottky diode based on a P-type island and super junction structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the diode sequentially comprises the following components from bottom to top: cathode, n  +  ‑Ga  2  O  3  Substrate layer, n  ‑  ‑Ga  2  O  3  A drift layer, an anode, wherein n  ‑  ‑Ga  2  O  3  A plurality of heavily doped P-type islands are arranged on the contact surface of the drift layer and the anode; a plurality of lightly doped P-type regions corresponding to the n-type regions under the heavily doped P-type island  ‑  ‑Ga  2  O  3  The drift layer forms a super junction structure;and the heavily doped P-type island and the lightly doped P-type region are made of gallium nitride materials. The hybrid PIN Schottky diode based on the P-type island and the super-junction structure adopts a plurality of heavily doped P-type island structures, the lightly doped P-type region is introduced below the heavily doped P-type island structures to form the super-junction structure, electrons below the Schottky contact region are exhausted, reverse leakage current of the device is reduced, breakdown voltage of the device is increased, and meanwhile, P-type GaN is used as materials of the heavily doped P-type island and the lightly doped P-type region to avoid P-type Ga  2  O  3  The preparation is difficult.

title_en: Superconducting switch
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a superconducting switch. The switch comprises two parallel branches of superconducting material in the form of a loop and a magnetic field generator which generates a time-varying magnetic field through the loop in a direction substantially parallel to the axis of the loop. The magnetic field generator is selectively activated and deactivated to switch the electrical switch between a low resistance state and a higher resistance state. In the low resistance state, no magnetic field passes through the loop, and a transmission current flows through the loop. In the higher resistance state, a shielding current is induced by the magnetic field of the loop such that the sum of the transmission current and the shielding current is approximately equal to the critical current or greater than the critical current of the superconducting material. The switch may be used in a rectifier or a fault current limiter, for example.

title_en: Semiconductor device package
abstract_en: A semiconductor device package includes a first semiconductor device structure having a first substrate, two first devices disposed on the first substrate, a first interconnect structure disposed over the first substrate and the two first devices, and a first thermal feature disposed through the first substrate and the first interconnect structure. The semiconductor device package also includes a second semiconductor device structure disposed over the first semiconductor device structure having a second interconnect structure disposed over the first interconnect structure, a second substrate disposed over the second interconnect structure, two second devices disposed between the second substrate and the second interconnect structure, and a second heat conducting feature disposed through the second substrate and the second interconnect structure. The second heat conducting feature is in contact with the first heat conducting feature.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a plurality of transistors
abstract_en: One embodiment discloses a semiconductor device, including: a semiconductor structure including a first conductive semiconductor layer, a second conductive semiconductor layer, and an active layer disposed between the first conductive semiconductor layer and the second conductive semiconductor layer and including a plurality of first recesses and second recesses, the plurality of first recesses being disposed by penetrating the second conductive semiconductor layer and the active layer up to a partial region of the first conductive semiconductor layer, the second recesses being disposed between the plurality of first recesses; a plurality of first electrodes disposed within the plurality of first recesses and electrically connected to the first conductive semiconductor layer; a plurality of second electrodes electrically connected to the second conductive semiconductor layer; and a reflective layer disposed within the second recess, wherein a sum of an area of the plurality of first recesses and an area of the second recess is 60% or less of a maximum area in a first direction of the semiconductor structure, the areas of the plurality of first recesses and the area of the second recess are areas formed on a lower surface of the semiconductor structure, and the first direction is perpendicular to a thickness direction of the semiconductor structure.

title_en: Display device and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: A display device with high luminance is provided. The pixel includes a light emitting device, a first transistor, a second transistor, a third transistor, a fourth transistor, a first capacitor, and a second capacitor. One electrode of the light emitting device is electrically connected to one of a source and a drain of the first transistor. A gate of the first transistor is electrically connected to one electrode of the first capacitor and one of a source and a drain of the second transistor. The other of the source and the drain of the first transistor is electrically connected to one electrode of the second capacitor. One electrode of the second capacitor is electrically connected to a first wiring having a function of supplying a first potential. The other electrode of the second capacitor is electrically connected to the other electrode of the first capacitor, one of a source and a drain of the third transistor, and one of a source and a drain of the fourth transistor.

title_en: Micro LED light projection chip and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Micro LED light projection chip and a manufacturing method thereof.A one-piece lens is manufactured on one surface of a substrate of a wafer, which is far away from a metal electrode, according to a preset array pattern based on the substrate, so that the chip can integrate the lens without using an additional lens or an optical component; the wafer is cut to obtain an integrated chip, and the integrated chip with high integration level, high pixel density and small volume can be obtained through a plurality of sub-pixels on the integrated chip; each pixel on the chip corresponds to the driving substrate, so that the effects of adjustable resolution and pixel free partition can be realized through the driving design.

title_en: Method for manufacturing fast recovery diode chip
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a manufacturing method of a fast recovery diode chip, and relates to the technical field of semiconductors. The manufacturing method of the fast recovery diode chip comprises the steps of carrying out phosphorus doping on the back surfaces of a first wafer and a second wafer, wherein the first wafer and the second wafer are N-type silicon single wafers, carrying out silicon bonding on the first wafer and the second wafer after phosphorus doping, forming an N+ region and a buffer layer with gradient concentration through diffusion on the back surface of the first wafer, forming a plane terminal protection structure on the front surface of the first wafer, grinding the second wafer, and carrying out metallization on the back surface of the first wafer. The method creatively uses a silicon-silicon bonding process, uses the silicon single crystal wafer to replace the epitaxial wafer successfully, the performance of the produced fast recovery product basically reaches the performance of an epitaxial plane diode product, the production cost of the fast recovery product is greatly reduced, and the method is suitable for economic mass production.

title_en: Manufacturing method of light-emitting diode and light-emitting diode
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for manufacturing a light emitting diode and a light emitting diode, the method comprising: forming an epitaxial layer on a first substrate, wherein the epitaxial layer comprises a first semiconductor layer, a multi-quantum well layer and a second semiconductor layer which are sequentially stacked, and the doping types of the first semiconductor layer and the second semiconductor layer are opposite to each other; electrochemically activating the second semiconductor layer in an electrochemical solution; forming a first electrode electrically connected to the first semiconductor layer; and forming a second electrode electrically connected to the second semiconductor layer. According to the manufacturing method of the light-emitting diode provided by the invention, after the epitaxial layer is formed, the second semiconductor layer is subjected to electrochemical activation so as to improve the hole concentration of the second semiconductor layer, reduce the hydrogen concentration and further improve the electro-optic efficiency of the light-emitting diode.

title_en: Sensor housing and method for casting an open receiving space of a sensor housing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sensor housing (1, 1A) having an open receiving space (3, 3A) with a surrounding edge (10, 10A) as a creepage barrier at an open end, wherein the receiving space (3, 3A) is filled with a casting material (16), wherein the solidified casting material (16) forms a surface that is concave with respect to the surrounding edge (10, 10A), and to a method for casting the open receiving space (3, 3A) of such a sensor housing (1, 1A). The circumferential edge (10, 10A) has an outwardly inclined slope (12) which allows a temporary overfilling of the receiving space (3, 3A) during the casting process to form a stable convex casting material surface (16A).

title_en: Thin packaging connection structure
abstract_en: The invention is a thin packaging and connecting structure, which comprises: a first thin plate part, which has two sides, wherein one side is partially or completely jointed with the adjacent joint part; an adhesive part located between the first sheet part and the second sheet part, wherein the adhesive part is at least one of epoxy resin, silicone resin, polyester, polyurethane, nano-silicon and nano-titanium adhesive, and the thickness of the adhesive part is 0.5 to 100 μm; and a second sheet portion having two sides, wherein one side is partially or completely joined adjacent to the joining portion; the first sheet portion, the bonding portion and the second sheet portion are combined to form a thin package bonding structure, and the thickness of the thin package bonding structure is less than or equal to 200 microns.

title_en: Epitaxial wafer, semiconductor device, and method for manufacturing epitaxial wafer
abstract_en: An epitaxial wafer according to the present disclosure includes: a substrate; a buffer layer containing a crystal represented by the composition formula Al  x Ga y In z  N (x+y+z=1, y > 0) and disposed on the substrate; a back barrier layer containing a crystal represented by a composition Al  x Ga y In z  N (x+y+z=1, y > 0, z > 0) and disposed on the buffer layer; a channel layer containing a crystal represented by the composition formula Al  x Ga y In z  N (x+y+z=1, y > 0) and disposed on the back barrier layer; and an electron supply layer containing a crystal represented by the composition formula Al  x Ga y In z  N (x+y+z=1, x > 0) and disposed on the channel layer. The epitaxial wafer is characterized in that the channel layer is composed of a channel layer upper layer on the electron supply layer side and a channel layer lower layer on the back barrier layer side, the concentration of C in the channel layer lower layer is higher than that in the channel layer upper layer, and the channel layer lower layer contains Si.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a plurality of semiconductor chips
abstract_en: Embodiments provide a semiconductor device capable of suppressing warpage. A semiconductor device according to an embodiment includes a first semiconductor layer, a first metal layer, a bonding layer, a second metal layer, and a second semiconductor layer. The first metal layer is disposed on and in contact with the first semiconductor layer. The bonding layer is provided over and in contact with the first metal layer and is electrically conductive. The second metal layer is disposed over and in contact with the bonding layer. The second semiconductor layer is provided over and in contact with the second metal layer, and is provided with at least a part of a semiconductor element.

title_en: Method for manufacturing air bridge in millimeter wave integrated circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for manufacturing an air bridge in a millimeter wave integrated circuit, which belongs to the technical field of semiconductor devices and specifically comprises the following steps: confirming the minimum size of ground excavation gaps on two sides of the air bridge and the minimum size of a square hole excavated on the bridge floor of the air bridge based on the parasitic capacitance control requirement; the parasitic capacitance of the air bridge is transformed in two ways to obtain an air bridge model; analyzing the stress condition of the air bridge based on an air bridge model to obtain an analysis result; and if the air bridge is in an unstable state, reducing the sizes of the ground excavation notches on the two sides of the air bridge and the air bridge floor excavation square hole by adopting a first size threshold value, and taking the reduced sizes as a final air bridge manufacturing scheme, thereby comprehensively considering the stress condition and the parasitic capacitance and further improving the reliability of the semiconductor device.

title_en: Photoelectric conversion apparatus
abstract_en: Disclosed is a photoelectric conversion device. A photoelectric conversion apparatus including a pixel array including a first pixel and a second pixel is provided. The first pixel includes a photoelectric conversion unit including a first semiconductor region of a first conductivity type as a charge accumulation layer and photoelectrically converts incident light to generate a signal corresponding to the incident light, and the second pixel includes a second semiconductor region of the first conductivity type and a transistor including a gate and a first main electrode formed of a third semiconductor region connected to the second semiconductor region.

title_en: GaN film grown on Si substrate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a GaN film growing on a Si substrate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the GaN film growing on the Si substrate at least comprises the Si substrate, and a transition layer, a GaN buffer layer, a GaN channel layer and a barrier layer which are sequentially epitaxially grown on the Si substrate; the GaN buffer layer comprises a first GaN layer and a second GaN layer, and the first GaN layer, the second GaN layer and the GaN channel layer are epitaxially grown and deposited step by step under a first condition, a second condition and a third condition respectively; growing a first GaN layer as a stress maintaining layer through an extremely low V/III ratio, so that the first GaN layer can introduce enough compressive stress to balance subsequent thermal stress and improve the bending deformation resistance of the film layer; the second GaN layer with high impedance is grown under a lower V/III ratio, so that the C doping concentration can be effectively improved, the voltage withstanding capability of the GaN film is improved, and the overall voltage withstanding effect of the power device is improved.

title_en: Optical laminate, polarizing plate, and image display device
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical laminate, a polarizing plate and an image display device, wherein the optical laminate has excellent adhesion between 2 optically anisotropic layers, and the optically anisotropic layers are A plates or layers formed by fixing a twisted liquid crystal phase. The optical laminate of the present invention comprises: a1 st optically anisotropic layer formed using a1 st liquid crystal compound; a2 nd optically anisotropic layer formed using a2 nd liquid crystal compound; and a mixed layer disposed between the 1 st optically anisotropic layer and the 2 nd optically anisotropic layer and containing a component derived from the 1 st liquid crystal compound and a component derived from the 2 nd liquid crystal compound, wherein the 1 st optically anisotropic layer is a C plate, the 2 nd optically anisotropic layer is an a plate or a layer formed by fixing a twisted-oriented liquid crystal phase, the mixed layer further contains a photo-oriented compound, and the predetermined requirements are satisfied when analyzing the components in the depth direction of the optical laminate by a time-of-flight type secondary ion mass spectrometry while irradiating the optical laminate with an ion beam from the surface on the 1 st optically anisotropic layer side toward the 2 nd optically anisotropic layer side.

title_en: Transparent dual-waveband variable-working-mode ultraviolet detector based on graphene/p-GaN/AlGaN heterojunction
abstract_en: A graphene/p-GaN/AlGaN heterojunction based transparent dual-waveband variable-working-mode ultraviolet detector and a preparation method thereof relate to the technical field of photoelectricity. The detector is a mesa structure based on p-GaN/AlGaN crystal, and is arranged below the mesa and on n  +  Multilayer metal Ti/Al/Ni/Au on the surface of the AlGaN material is a lower electrode, the upper part of the table top and the upper surface of the p-GaN material are annular SiOx/SiNx passivation layers, and graphene covers the surface of the p-GaN material and the annular layerThe surface of the passivation layer is provided with an upper electrode, and the annular Gr/Au layer on the surface of the graphene on the annular passivation layer is provided with an upper electrode lead metal layer. The preparation method of the detector comprises the steps of forming a p-GaN/AlGaN mesa structure, forming a Ti/Al/Ni/Au multilayer metal electrode layer, growing a ring-shaped light-transmitting SiOx/SiNx passivation layer, transferring a graphene material and depositing a ring-shaped light-transmitting lead metal layer. The detector can work in a front and back irradiation mode to carry out solar blind and visible blind double-waveband detection, and the working mode can be changed along with the change of bias voltage applied on the detector so as to switch from a light guide mode to a photovoltaic mode.

title_en: Gas mixing device for oxidation process and treatment equipment
abstract_en: A gas mixing device and processing equipment for an oxidation process relate to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing, and comprise a gas mixer, a first pipeline provided with a first MFC and a second MFC, a second pipeline provided with a third MFC and a third pipeline provided with a pressure controller, wherein the gas mixer is connected with a processing chamber through the first pipeline, the joint of the second pipeline and the first pipeline is positioned between the first MFC and the second MFC, and the joint of the third pipeline and the first pipeline is positioned between the second MFC and the processing chamber; the mixed gas with the first preset proportion is mixed with the first component gas under the control of the first MFC under the control of the third MFC to form a processing gas with a second preset proportion, one part of the processing gas is discharged through the third pipeline under the shunting of the pressure controller, and the other part of the processing gas flows to the processing chamber under the control of the second MFC. The gas mixing device can regulate and control the mixing proportion and the flow rate before the mixed gas is introduced into the processing chamber.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent element
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an organic electroluminescent element. The organic electroluminescent element comprises an anode, a cathode, a hole injection layer, a hole transport layer, a light-emitting layer and an electron transport layer, wherein the electron transport layer comprises a quinoxaline-triazine compound and a bistriazine compound, the quinoxaline-triazine compound is any one of compounds represented by a chemical formula A1 or A2, and the bistriazine compound is represented by a chemical formula B: the quinoxaline-triazine compound of formula A1 or A2 contributes to the improvement of the lifetime of the organic electroluminescent device, and the bistriazine compound of formula B1 or B contributes to the reduction of the driving voltage of the organic electroluminescent device and the improvement of the device efficiency. By mixing the quinoxaline-triazine compound and the bis-triazine compound, the advantages of the quinoxaline-triazine compound and the bis-triazine compound are comprehensively utilized, and the disadvantages of the quinoxaline-triazine compound and the bis-triazine compound on the organic electroluminescent device are alleviated, so that the organic electroluminescent device with high efficiency, long service life and low driving voltage is obtained.

title_en: Positive photosensitive resin composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-temperature-curable positive photosensitive resin composition, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials. The low-temperature curing positive photosensitive resin composition comprises, by mass, 100 parts of phenolic hydroxyl group-containing polyamide resin, 3-40 parts of a photoacid generator, 1-20 parts of a reactive benzocyclobutene compound, 0.1-30 parts of a thermal acid generator, 3-40 parts of a cross-linking agent, 0.1-40 parts of an adhesion promoter, and 100-1000 parts of an organic solvent, wherein the reactive benzocyclobutene compound is a dibenzocyclobutene compound with a specific imide structure or a dibenzocyclobutene compound containing saturated alkane and unsaturated hydrocarbon structures. The resin composition solution has excellent positive ultraviolet photoetching process performance, can be cured at the temperature of 250 ℃ and below, and the formed cured resin film has the characteristics of low dielectric constant, low dielectric loss, excellent heat resistance, low water absorption, high toughness, high cohesiveness, excellent photosensitivity and the like, and is suitable for the use requirements of high-frequency high-speed signal transmission circuits.

title_en: Etching a substrate using ALE and selective deposition
abstract_en: The invention relates to etching substrates using ALE and selective deposition. Methods and apparatus for processing substrates of carbonaceous material using atomic layer etching and selective deposition are provided. The method includes exposing carbonaceous material on the substrate to an oxidizing agent and igniting a first plasma at a first bias power to modify the surface of the substrate and exposing the modified surface to an inert plasma at a second bias power to remove the modified surface. The method also involves selectively depositing a second carbonaceous material onto the substrate. ALE and selective deposition can be performed without breaking vacuum.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The application provides a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises a display area and a non-display area, the display area comprises a first display area and a second display area, the first display area is provided with a plurality of first data lines and a plurality of first connecting lines, the second display area is provided with a plurality of second data lines and a plurality of second connecting lines, the first data lines, the first connecting lines, the second data lines and the second connecting lines extend along a first direction, the extending lengths of the first data lines, the first connecting lines, the second data lines and the second connecting lines are equal to the width of the display area along the first direction, the display area is provided with a plurality of third connecting lines, the extending lengths of the third connecting lines are equal to the width of the display area along the second direction, the third connecting lines comprise a first sub connecting line and a second sub connecting line, and the second data lines are connected through the first sub connecting lines, and the second connecting lines and the first data lines are connected through the second sub connecting lines. The display panel provided by the application has a good display effect.

title_en: Chip demoulding device
abstract_en: A chip demoulding device belongs to the field of chip preparation and comprises a placing unit and a screening mechanism. The placing unit comprises a rotating mechanism, a fixing mechanism is connected to the rotating mechanism, and a top support mechanism is arranged on the fixing mechanism. Screening mechanism includes the bottom plate, has seted up the groove of stepping down on the bottom plate, installs the box on the bottom plate, and the demoulding component is installed to the box upper end, is equipped with the screening component in the box, and the screening component connection has reciprocating mechanism, is connected with actuating mechanism on the reciprocating mechanism. The chip, namely the demoulding operation of crystal grains is conveniently carried out, and the stable fixation of the wafer disc and the adhesive film can be carried out during demoulding so as to avoid influencing the demoulding effect.

title_en: Applicator for cryoanesthesia and analgesia
abstract_en: The present application relates to an applicator for cryoanesthesia and analgesia. A hand-held cryoanesthesia or analgesia device for cooling a target area of a dermal membrane, a mucous membrane, and a mucocutaneous tissue having an elongated body and a thermoelectric cooling system disposed within the elongated body. The thermoelectric cooling system is configured to physically contact and thermally couple the target area of the dermal membrane, the mucosal membrane, and the mucosal skin region tissue to induce cryoanesthesia or analgesia. The thermoelectric cooling system includes a thermally conductive cooling tip, a thermally conductive cooling energy concentrator thermally coupled to the cooling tip, at least one peltier cell module thermally coupled to the thermally conductive cooling energy concentrator, a heat sink thermally coupled to the at least one peltier cell module, a power source, at least one thermal sensor, and a controller operable to output control signals to the peltier cell module to maintain a predetermined temperature.

title_en: Fluorene derivative and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic electroluminescent materials, in particular to a fluorene derivative and application thereof in an organic electroluminescent element. The fluorene derivative hasHas a spiro five-membered heterocyclic structure; when the fluorene derivative is applied to an organic electroluminescent element, the driving voltage can be obviously reduced, the luminous efficiency can be improved, and the service life can be prolonged.

title_en: Photosensitive resin composition, photoresist comprising the same, display device comprising the same, and low-temperature curing method of photosensitive resin composition
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a photosensitive resin composition, a photoresist, a display device, and a method of curing the photosensitive resin composition at a low temperature.

title_en: PMUT device containing bipolar piezoelectric structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a PMUT device containing a bipolar piezoelectric structure, which comprises the steps of 1) providing a first substrate, forming a bottom electrode layer on the surface of the substrate, 2) forming a piezoelectric layer comprising a first polar piezoelectric layer and a second polar piezoelectric layer which are formed in sequence, 3) depositing a first passivation layer and a top electrode layer in sequence, and patterning the top electrode layer, 4) forming a first through hole, depositing a supporting layer, 5) etching the supporting layer to form a first opening and a second opening, 6) providing a second substrate, turning over the structure, bonding the second substrate with the supporting layer, forming a cavity through the first opening, and removing the first substrate. The preparation method adopts two electrical connection modes, and in the PMUT device obtained by the preparation method, the piezoelectric layer is a single-layer bipolar membrane, has the characteristic of no transition area, can maximize the effective working area, and in addition, the preparation process is simple, the number of open pores is small, the wiring area is small, and the array density of the PMUT is greatly improved.

title_en: Laser annealing device for perovskite photovoltaic and application method of laser annealing device
abstract_en: The application provides a laser annealing device for perovskite photovoltaic samples and a using method thereof, wherein the laser annealing device comprises the following components: the device comprises a visible light laser used for laser ranging and laser annealing, a vibrating mirror used for laser beam shaping, an infrared temperature sensor used for temperature monitoring, a camera used for monitoring samples, a filter placed in front of the camera and used for filtering laser wavelengths, a storage rack used for placing samples, a guide rail used for moving in a horizontal plane, a motor used for driving the guide rail, and a control circuit used for controlling movement or work of the components such as the laser, the temperature detector, the camera, the motor and the like. In the laser annealing process, the temperature sensor and the camera are used for monitoring the temperature and the color change of the surface of the perovskite photovoltaic sample in the laser annealing process in real time, so that the perovskite photovoltaic obtained by the laser annealing device has higher photoelectric conversion efficiency compared with the existing annealing device.

title_en: Spinel red fluorescent powder for plant cultivation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses spinel red fluorescent powder for plant cultivation, which has a chemical general formula of Zn  1‑x  Li  2x  Ga  2‑y  Cr  y  O  4  ，0.01≤x≤0.10，0<y is less than or equal to 0.05. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the spinel red fluorescent powder for plant cultivation, which comprises the following steps: in spinel composition Zn  1‑x  Li  2x  Ga  2‑y  Cr  y  O  4  Stoichiometric ratio of (3) ZnO and Li  2  CO  3  、Ga  2  O  3  、Cr  2  O  3  And NH  4  Cl powder; carrying out dry ball milling on the powder for 2-5 hours; ceramic placed in a crucible and placed in a microwave muffleThe center of the backing plate is provided with active carbon around the crucible; heating to 800-1400 deg.c and maintaining for 5-35 min; and cooling to room temperature to obtain the spinel red fluorescent powder for plant cultivation.
