The invention has better matching property with near ultraviolet/blue light LED chips.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor device and a method of manufacturing the same, the method of manufacturing the semiconductor device including: providing a substrate, wherein a through hole is formed in the substrate; forming a first insulating layer on the inner surface of the through hole; forming a first metal layer on the surface of the first insulating layer in the through hole by adopting an electrochemical plating process; and filling a second insulating layer in the through hole, wherein a hollow hole is formed in the second insulating layer. According to the technical scheme, the through hole with the overlarge width can be filled, so that the semiconductor device has high through-current capacity, and meanwhile, the process difficulty and the manufacturing cost for filling the through hole can be greatly reduced.

title_en: A excessive gluey clean-up equipment for integrated circuit encapsulation product
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of cleaning equipment, and particularly discloses glue overflow cleaning equipment for an integrated circuit packaging product, which comprises a box body, a partition plate, a carrying platform, a swing arm, a water pipe and a water tank, wherein the box body is provided with a plurality of partition plates; the partition board is fixedly connected in the box body, an operation opening for putting in and taking out packaged products is formed between the top of the box body and the partition board, the platform deck is rotatably connected to the surface of the partition board, the swing arm is located on one side of the platform deck, and the swing arm is rotatably connected to the partition board; the water pipe is fixedly connected to the swing arm, the water tank is arranged in the box body, a water pumping piece for pumping water in the water tank into the water pipe is arranged between the water pipe and the water tank, and when the swing arm rotates, the water outlet end of the water pipe is sprayed towards the carrying platform; a driving mechanism for driving the carrying platform to continuously rotate and driving the swing arm to swing in a reciprocating mode is arranged in the box body, and a clamping mechanism for clamping a packaged product is arranged on the carrying platform. This application has the effect of effectively clearing up remaining excessive glue and piece on the integrated circuit encapsulation product.

title_en: Stacked semiconductor device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a stacked semiconductor device. The stacked semiconductor device includes a plurality of stacked semiconductor dies electrically connected to each other, a first power line electrically connected to a lowermost semiconductor die among the stacked semiconductor dies, a second power line formed over an uppermost semiconductor die among the stacked semiconductor dies, and an external connection line electrically connecting the first power line and the second power line.

title_en: Method for manufacturing trench in semiconductor substrate and semiconductor device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for manufacturing a trench in a semiconductor substrate and a semiconductor device. The method comprises the following steps: providing a semiconductor substrate; forming a hard mask layer on a semiconductor substrate, forming a photoresist pattern on the hard mask layer, performing exposure development to etch the hard mask layer and the semiconductor substrate so as to form a trench in the semiconductor substrate, wherein an included angle between a side surface and a bottom surface of the trench is greater than 90 degrees, and removing the photoresist pattern; irradiating the trench with a laser beam such that a portion of the semiconductor material in the semiconductor substrate that is no more than a first distance from a side surface or a bottom surface of the trench melts; and cooling the semiconductor substrate such that the side surfaces and/or the bottom surface of the trench are reshaped to have a lower surface roughness than before being irradiated by the laser beam.

title_en: Silicon carbide wafer cleaning detection method capable of improving aging efficiency
abstract_en: A SiC wafer cleaning and detecting method capable of improving aging efficiency relates to the technical field of SiC wafer processing and cleaning detection, can classify the wafer grades in time, reduces liquid medicine consumption, labor and power, and effectively saves cost. The silicon carbide wafer cleaning detection method capable of improving the aging efficiency comprises the following steps: surface decontamination and cleaning: removing various organic matters and inorganic matters on the surface of the wafer, removing residual liquid medicine and particles on the surface, and finally removing metal ions on the surface; primary screening: performing degradation treatment on macroscopically unqualified broken edges and/or hexagonal holes without entering the next link; RCA conventional cleaning: soaking and cleaning with SC1 cleaning solution at 30-80 ℃, washing with deionized water, soaking and cleaning with SC2 cleaning solution at 65-85 ℃, and washing with deionized water; and (3) defect detection: carrying out parameter index detection on flatness, roughness and surface defects; secondary screening: if the product is qualified, the product is a superior product, and if the product is not qualified, the product is degraded into an unqualified product.

title_en: Silicon carbide power device with concentration gradient epitaxial layer structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon carbide power device with a concentration gradient epitaxial layer structure, which comprises: the method comprises the following steps: the N-type substrate is used for forming an active region and a terminal region, the Schottky contact anode layer is formed on the N-type substrate, the ohmic contact cathode layer is formed on the Schottky contact anode layer, the epitaxial layer is formed on the ohmic contact cathode layer, the oxide layer is formed on the epitaxial layer, the surface terminal layer is formed on the surface terminal layer, and the P-type doped layer is formed on the P-type doped layer; the terminal region is positioned at the periphery of the active region; the ohmic contact cathode layer is arranged below the N-type substrate, and the epitaxial layer is arranged above the N-type substrate; the surface terminal layer is arranged at the top end of the interior of the epitaxial layer, the Schottky contact anode layer and the oxide layer are arranged above the epitaxial layer, and the oxide layer is arranged on two sides of the Schottky contact anode layer; the P-type doping layer is arranged at the top end of the inner part of the first epitaxial layer part corresponding to the active region; the N-type concentration in the epitaxial layer is gradually reduced from the first epitaxial layer part to the second epitaxial layer part corresponding to the terminal region. The invention can improve the avalanche resistance of the device.

title_en: Photoelectric detector chip, distance sensor and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a photoelectric detector chip, a distance sensor and an electronic device. The photoelectric detector chip comprises a first electrode, a substrate, a light absorption layer, a top layer, a second electrode and a filter layer; the substrate is arranged on one side of the first electrode; the light absorption layer is arranged on one side of the substrate, which is far away from the first electrode; the top layer is arranged on one side, away from the substrate, of the light absorption layer; the second electrode is in contact with the top layer and is arranged on one side, away from the light absorption layer, of the top layer; the filter layer is arranged on one side, away from the substrate, of the light absorption layer and is positioned on one side, close to the top layer, of the second electrode, and the filter layer is used for filtering signals with the wavelength smaller than 1300nm and transmitting detection signals with the wavelength larger than or equal to 1300nm to the light absorption layer.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: Semiconductor structures and methods of fabricating the same are provided. The semiconductor structure includes a substrate and first and second nanostructures formed over the substrate. The semiconductor structure further includes a gate structure including a first portion wrapping around the first nanostructure and a second portion wrapping around the second nanostructure. The semiconductor structure further includes a dielectric member sandwiched between the first portion and the second portion of the gate structure. Further, the dielectric component includes a bottom portion and a top portion above the bottom portion, and the top portion of the dielectric component includes a shell layer and a core portion surrounded by the shell layer.

title_en: Circuit module
abstract_en: The invention provides a circuit module capable of inhibiting contact between solder and bonding adhesive. The circuit module includes a substrate module having an upper main surface with a normal extending in the vertical direction, an electronic component disposed on the substrate module, and a bonding adhesive for fixing the electronic component on the upper main surface, wherein the electronic component includes a1 st electrode, the substrate module includes a 2 nd electrode disposed on the right side of the bonding adhesive, the 1 st electrode is electrically connected to the 2 nd electrode via solder, a1 st recess having a shape recessed downward and having a bottom is provided on the upper main surface, the upper end of the 2 nd electrode is disposed on the upper side of the bottom, the 1 st recess has a1 st region overlapping the 2 nd electrode when viewed in the left-right direction of the 1 st electrode, and a portion forming the 1 st recess is made of the same material as a portion forming the upper main surface.

title_en: Low-voltage capacitor overvoltage protection device chip and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage capacitor overvoltage protection device chip and a production method thereof, and the chip comprises a protection device body, wherein an upper hollow plate is arranged at the top of the protection device body, a lower hollow plate is arranged at the bottom of the protection device body, the protection device body comprises an inner core plate, pins are welded on the outer walls of two sides of the inner core plate, an encapsulation body is arranged outside the inner core plate, an upper installation groove is formed in the outer wall of the top of the encapsulation body, the upper hollow plate is positioned inside the upper installation groove, an upper heat conduction layer is arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the upper hollow plate, and heat dissipation plates which are uniformly distributed are integrally formed on the outer wall of the top of the upper hollow plate. According to the invention, the upper hollow plate with the vacuum cavity is arranged on the protection device body, and pure water is injected into the upper hollow plate, so that the protection device body can evaporate the pure water during working, and then the evaporated pure water is condensed and liquefied on the capillary tube layer at the top, so that the low-voltage capacitor overvoltage protection device chip has better heat dissipation performance during use.

title_en: Two-dimensional transition metal chalcogenide and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-dimensional transition metal chalcogenide and preparation and application thereof, which utilizes chalcogenide simple substance and transition metal simple substance as target sources, and carries out vapor deposition on a substrate by molecular beam epitaxy technology and combining the strategies of fractional evaporation and post-evaporation, thereby obtaining the high-quality large-size two-dimensional transition metal chalcogenide film material. Compared with the prior art, the film prepared by the invention has the appearance of a few-layer plane structure, a multilayer nanorod structure or a multilayer nanotube structure, the whole method is simple and efficient, the product quality is high, and the film has a huge application prospect in the fields of high-performance micro-nano devices, field effect transistors, photoelectric detection, integrated circuits and the like.

title_en: Glass substrate and non-contact photovoltaic cell preparation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a glass substrate and non-contact photovoltaic cell preparation equipment, wherein the glass substrate is provided with a front surface and a back surface which are oppositely arranged, the front surface is provided with a groove, the groove is used for filling slurry required by the preparation of a photovoltaic cell, and the width of the groove is not less than 3um; the depth of the groove is not less than 5um and not more than 200um. The glass substrate provided by the technical scheme of the invention can improve the performance of the photovoltaic cell and can reduce the cost of laser transfer printing.

title_en: Chip mass transfer method, chip substrate and positioning plate
abstract_en: The invention provides a chip mass transfer method which comprises the following steps of placing chips in liquid, solidifying the liquid wrapping the chips to form spheres, wrapping a chip to be transferred in each sphere, placing the spheres on a target substrate, enabling each hole on the target substrate to fall on the spheres wrapping the chips, removing solid substances except the chips in the spheres, and enabling the chips to fall in the holes on the target substrate, so that the chips are enveloped by the holes on the target substrate. The solid substances in the spheres are removed, the chips are arranged in the holes of the target substrate, whether the complete transfer is finished or not can be quickly obtained through detection of the solidified or gelled liquid, and the untransferred parts are timely repaired at fixed points, so that the transfer speed and yield of the mass transfer technology are improved.

title_en: Whole mould degumming machine based on semiconductor package
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of a degumming machine, in particular to a full-mold degumming machine based on semiconductor packaging, which comprises a conveyor, wherein the top of the conveyor is fixedly connected with a collecting hopper, the top of the conveyor is fixedly connected with a sliding support, the top of the sliding support is fixedly connected with an electric push rod in a penetrating way, the inner wall of the sliding support is connected with a sliding plate in a sliding way, and an output shaft of the electric push rod is fixedly connected with the sliding plate; it can carry power through spur rack and gear to the conveyer to reciprocate to drive the slide through electric putter, makes its shift position advance the accuracy more, presses the semiconductor through the clamp plate, has replaced the manual work, makes the semiconductor more firm, then drives the cutting knife through the motor and rotates, reciprocating motion when can driving the cutting knife simultaneously and rotate, the cutting of being convenient for, through the settlement of connecting plate, be convenient for lead to the semiconductor of equidimension not, application scope has been improved greatly.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and method for forming capacitor structure
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a semiconductor structure and a method for forming a capacitor structure, the method comprises the steps of providing a first substrate, sequentially comprising a bottom supporting layer, a first sacrificial layer and a mask layer, wherein the first sacrificial layer is provided with a lower electrode penetrating through the bottom supporting layer, the surface of the lower electrode is flush with the mask layer and is connected with a capacitor contact pad in the bottom supporting layer, etching the first sacrificial layer to a preset first thickness to form a second sacrificial layer, and forming an intermediate supporting layer and a top supporting layer on the second sacrificial layer to form the capacitor structure.

title_en: Method for manufacturing semiconductor structure
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method of a semiconductor structure, which comprises the following steps: providing a substrate; sequentially forming a first etching barrier layer, a first dielectric layer, a second etching barrier layer and a second dielectric layer on the surface of the substrate; forming a first photoresist layer and defining a through hole pattern; forming a through hole; filling a bottom anti-reflection layer in the through hole; carrying out back etching to enable the height of the bottom anti-reflection layer to be lower than the depth of the through hole; forming a second photoresist layer, and forming a groove pattern in the second photoresist layer, wherein the groove pattern is positioned right above the through hole, and the size of the groove pattern is larger than that of the through hole; forming a groove, wherein the groove is positioned at the upper part of the through hole and stops at the second etching barrier layer; removing the residual bottom anti-reflection layer, the first etching barrier layer and the second etching barrier layer in the through hole to form a funnel structure with a groove formed at the upper part of the through hole; and filling the interconnecting metal layer in the funnel structure. The method and the device are beneficial to improving the filling of the interconnection metal and improving the performance of the device.

title_en: Semiconductor package injection mold, injection molding device and semiconductor package injection molding method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chip packaging, in particular to a semiconductor packaging injection mold, a semiconductor packaging injection device and a semiconductor packaging injection method, wherein the semiconductor packaging injection mold comprises a bottom mold and a top mold, the upper surface of the bottom mold is used for being attached to the lower surface of a substrate to be formed with a semiconductor packaging structure, the top die is matched with the bottom die, the top die is provided with a plastic package cavity, the plastic package cavity faces the upper surface of the substrate and is used for accommodating a plastic package layer formed on the upper surface of the substrate, the bottom die is provided with a through hole penetrating through the bottom die at a position corresponding to the substrate, and the through hole is used for being connected with an external pressure source. When the plastic sealing layer is formed by the injection transfer molding process, the pressure on the lower surface of the substrate generated by the pressure source is utilized to balance the pressure on the upper surface of the substrate during transfer molding, so that the stress on the substrate is reduced, and the substrate cannot warp.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a display panel and a display device, the display panel includes: the device layer comprises a first transistor positioned in the first display area and a second transistor positioned in the second display area, wherein the first transistor comprises a first gate electrode, and the second transistor comprises a second gate electrode; the light-emitting layer is arranged on one side of the device layer in the thickness direction in a stacked mode and comprises a plurality of first sub-pixels distributed in the first display area and second sub-pixels distributed in the second display area, the first sub-pixels comprise first electrodes electrically connected with the first transistors, the second sub-pixels comprise second electrodes electrically connected with the second transistors, and at least part of orthographic projection of the first electrodes is overlapped with orthographic projection of the first gate electrodes in the thickness direction to form a first overlapping area; and the shielding layer is arranged between the layer structure where the first gate electrode is located and the layer structure where the first electrode is located, and the shielding layer covers the first overlapping area. The invention can meet the display requirement, has good brightness uniformity and ensures the display effect.

title_en: Semiconductor module
abstract_en: The semiconductor module of the present invention includes: a semiconductor switching element; and a stress application unit that is provided on one or both of a first surface and a second surface opposite to the first surface of the semiconductor switching element, has a linear expansion coefficient larger than that of a main material of the semiconductor switching element, and has a thickness larger than that of the semiconductor switching element, wherein the stress application unit generates a compressive stress or a tensile stress in the semiconductor switching element by thermal contraction or thermal expansion of the stress application unit accompanying temperature change, and the threshold voltage at which the semiconductor switching element is turned on decreases as the magnitude of the compressive stress or the tensile stress of the semiconductor switching element increases.

title_en: Axial diode autosegregation equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of diodes, in particular to an automatic axial diode separating device which comprises a diode, a feeder, a separating mechanism and a collector, wherein the separating mechanism comprises a transmission mechanism, a separating assembly and a shaking assembly; the feeding device is of a cavity structure with an upward opening, and one side of the feeding device, which is positioned on the separating mechanism, is provided with a strip-shaped through hole through which the diode can transversely pass; the transmission mechanism is horizontally arranged on one side of the feeder, and the other end of the transmission mechanism is positioned on one side of the collector; the separating component is arranged on the central line of the transmission mechanism, one end of the separating component is arranged above the transmission mechanism, and the other end of the separating component is positioned above the collector; the shaking assemblies are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the transmission mechanism, the diode automatic separation function is realized through the material loading device, the transmission mechanism and the separation assembly, the separation is accurate, the diodes can automatically slide down one by one through the material loading device to be loaded, and the labor cost is saved.

title_en: Organic-inorganic quantum dot mixed infrared up-conversion device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photoelectric detectors, in particular to an organic-inorganic quantum dot mixed infrared up-conversion device and a preparation method thereof, wherein the mixed infrared up-conversion device comprises an organic infrared detector, an intermediate connecting layer and an inorganic quantum dot light-emitting diode; the organic infrared detector sequentially comprises an anode substrate, a hole blocking layer and an infrared organic layer, wherein the intermediate connecting layer is arranged above the infrared organic layer, the material of the intermediate connecting layer is NiO  x , and the inorganic quantum dot light emitting diode is arranged above the intermediate connecting layer and sequentially comprises a hole transport layer, an inorganic quantum dot light emitting layer, an electron transport layer and a cathode. The invention provides an effective method for preparing a solution processing infrared up-conversion device, which can reduce the preparation cost of the device, comprehensively improve the performance of the infrared up-conversion device and obtain the excellent performances of low driving voltage, high contrast, high luminous quality and the like.

title_en: Dicing die-bonding integrated film, die-bonding film, and method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cutting crystal grain joint integrated film. The dicing die-bonding integrated film includes: a dicing tape having a base material and a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer disposed on the base material; and a die bonding film disposed on the pressure-sensitive adhesive layer of the dicing tape. The die-bonding film contains silver-containing particles having an oxide layer on the surface thereof and a flux. The content of the silver-containing particles is 75% by mass or more based on the total amount of the die-bonding film.

title_en: Display device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A display device and a method of manufacturing the display device. The display device includes: a substrate layer; a pixel defining layer on the base layer and including an upper surface furthest from the base layer; an opening in the pixel defining layer; a first electrode between the base layer and the pixel defining layer; a protective layer between the pixel defining layer and the first electrode; a functional layer on the first electrode in the opening; an auxiliary electrode on the upper surface of the pixel defining layer; and a second electrode facing the base layer, the pixel defining layer, the functional layer, and the auxiliary electrode being interposed between the second electrode and the base layer, wherein the first electrode is exposed to the outside of the pixel defining layer and the protective layer at the opening in the pixel defining layer.

title_en: Yellow semitransparent fluorescent glass ceramic and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to yellow semitransparent fluorescent glass ceramics and a preparation method thereof, wherein the glass ceramics comprises the following components in percentage by weight: k  2  O 3～9%，MgO 3～6%，Al  2  O  3   13～16%，Y  2  O  3   10～16%，Ga  2  O  3   3～12%，CeO  2   1～3%，ZrO  2   2～5%，GeO  2   3～6%，SiO  2  41 to 49 percent. Firstly, weighing and uniformly mixing the microcrystalline glass raw materials according to the weight percentage, and then melting, forming and thermally treating to obtain the yellow semitransparent fluorescent microcrystalline glass. The main crystal phase prepared by the invention is Y  3  Al  2.1  Ga  2.9  O  12  The crystal fluorescent glass ceramics not only keeps the excellent luminescence property of the fluorescent material, but also endows the fluorescent material with good thermophysical property, ensures that the fluorescent conversion material has stable conversion luminescence capability under long-term high-power laser irradiation, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: One-way low-voltage low-capacitance TVS structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unidirectional low-voltage low-capacitance TVS structure, which belongs to the field of surge protection devices and comprises a substrate, a first epitaxial layer, a second epitaxial layer, a NBL (N-type boron nitride) region, a PBL (P-type boron nitride) region, a P + region, an N + region, an isolation groove, a metal layer, a passivation layer and a hole dielectric layer; the first epitaxial layer is positioned on the substrate, and the second epitaxial layer is positioned on the first epitaxial layer; the NBL region and the PBL region are both positioned in the first epitaxial layer; the P + region and the N + region are positioned on the inner top surface of the second epitaxial layer and are connected through a metal layer; the isolation groove penetrates through the second epitaxial layer and the first epitaxial layer to reach the substrate layer; the hole dielectric layer is positioned on the outer surface of the second epitaxial layer, and openings are formed in the P + region and the N + region so as to be connected through the metal layer; the passivation layer covers the exposed hole dielectric layer and part of the metal layer. According to the invention, through the design research on the longitudinal structure, the low-voltage TVS device and the low-capacitance diode are integrated, so that the overall performance is obviously improved.

title_en: Multi-channel single-item inflation device, control method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-channel single-item inflation device, a control method and a storage medium, wherein the device comprises: the device comprises a frame, an inflation module and a control device, wherein the inflation modules are respectively arranged on the frame, each inflation module comprises a feeding assembly and an inflation cavity with an opening at one side, each feeding assembly comprises a driving device, a sealing cover plate for sealing the opening of the inflation cavity and a feeding bracket for supporting a product to be inflated, the driving device is connected with the sealing cover plate, the feeding bracket is arranged on one side of the sealing cover plate, which is close to the inflation cavity, an air pipe is arranged in the inflation cavity, the air pipe is connected with an air control valve, the air control valve is respectively connected with an air pump and an inflation pump, and each control button corresponds to each inflation module; the control device is respectively connected with the control button, the driving device and the gas control valve, so that the control module responds to the control button to control the corresponding inflation module to perform independent timing inflation treatment on the product to be inflated.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a semiconductor device and a method of manufacturing the same. The electrical fuse element has a first portion, a second portion arranged at one end of the first portion, and a third portion arranged at the other end of the first portion. The resistor element is arranged separately from the electric fuse element. The material of each of the electric fuse element and the resistor element has silicon metal or nickel chromium. The electric fuse element and the resistor element are arranged in an upper layer of the first wiring and a lower layer of the second wiring. The wiring width of the second portion and the wiring width of the third portion are larger than the wiring width of the first portion.

title_en: Display panel and film thickness measuring method and structure thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a display panel and a film thickness measuring method and a measuring structure thereof, wherein the display panel comprises a glass substrate, a film layer and a measuring mark; the film layer is arranged on the glass substrate; the measuring mark is arranged on the glass substrate, the cross section area of the measuring mark is reduced along with the increase of the distance between the cross section and the glass substrate, and the measuring mark is used for measuring the thickness of the film layer according to the size data of the measuring mark exposed on the film layer. The display panel of this application is through setting up the mark of measurationing on glass substrate, measures the rete thickness, and the measurement mode does not receive the influence of rete compactness, guarantees the accuracy and the homogeneity of rete thickness, guarantees display panel's precision.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: A semiconductor structure and a forming method thereof are provided, wherein the method comprises the steps of forming a first auxiliary gate structure in a first leading-out region, forming a source doping region in an active region and on a body region around each main gate structure, forming a first groove in the first auxiliary gate structure after the source doping region is formed, forming a second groove in the source doping region and the body region between adjacent main gate structures and extending along a second direction, implanting first doping ions into an epitaxial layer below the first groove and the second groove to form a first implantation region at the bottom of the body region between adjacent main gate structures and at the bottom of the first auxiliary gate structure, forming a first conductive plug and a first conductive layer located on the first conductive plug in the first groove after the first implantation region is formed, and forming a second conductive plug and a second conductive layer located on the second conductive plug in the second groove, thereby improving the performance of the device and being beneficial to saving the manufacturing cost.

title_en: Forming method of shallow trench isolation structure and forming method of semiconductor device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for forming a shallow trench isolation structure and a method for forming a semiconductor device, wherein a substrate is provided, the substrate comprises a first area and a second area, a first dielectric layer, a first hard mask layer and a second hard mask layer are sequentially formed on the substrate, and the materials of the first hard mask layer and the second hard mask layer are different; forming a first opening in the first region by etching by taking the second hard mask layer as a mask, forming a protective layer in the first opening and on the second hard mask layer, and forming a second opening in the second region by taking the protective layer as a mask, wherein the second opening penetrates through the second hard mask layer and the first hard mask layer, and the depth of the second opening is smaller than that of the first opening; removing the second hard mask layer; and etching the substrate below the first opening by taking the first hard mask layer as a mask to form a first groove, and etching the substrate below the second opening to form a second groove to form a flatter wafer surface.

title_en: Conjugated organic molecule, photoactive layer material, ternary organic solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a conjugated organic molecule, a photoactive layer material, a ternary organic solar cell and a preparation method thereof, wherein the conjugated organic molecule adopts dithienobenzothiadiazole as a central electron-withdrawing unit, introduces a condensed ring thiophene unit as a pi bridge, and adopts rhodanine or a cyanoacetate derivative as a terminal group unit, and belongs to A-pi-A' -pi-A conjugated organic molecules. The molecules have good absorption in the visible light region, can form good absorption complementation with the low band gap receptor material, and are favorable for obtaining high short-circuit current. The conjugated organic molecule serving as a third component material can be matched with the energy levels of a polymer donor material PM6 and a non-fullerene acceptor material Y6, and can be applied to an organic ternary solar cell, so that the performance of the organic solar cell can be remarkably improved, and the photovoltaic efficiency of the solar cell exceeds 17%.

title_en: Micro light-emitting diode display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro light-emitting diode display device which comprises a carrier plate, a first light-emitting unit, a first transparent substrate, a second light-emitting unit and a color separation filter layer. The first light-emitting unit is arranged on the carrier plate and is used for emitting first color light. The first transparent substrate is on the first light emitting unit. The second light-emitting unit is arranged on the first transparent substrate and is used for emitting second color light. The color separation filter layer is arranged between the first light-emitting unit and the first transparent substrate, and is used for allowing the first color light to pass through and blocking the second color light.

title_en: Lamp for heating and heating device provided with same
abstract_en: The invention provides a lamp for heating which can make a wafer rise to a required temperature in a short time and uniformly, and a heating device with the lamp. A heating lamp (100) is provided with a metal heat-dissipating substrate (102), an insulating layer (104) disposed on the heat-dissipating substrate (102), a plurality of wiring patterns (106) disposed on the insulating layer (104), a plurality of light source elements (108) disposed on the plurality of wiring patterns (106), a bonding material (109) for electrically bonding the wiring patterns (106) and the light source elements (108), and a metal wiring (110) for electrically connecting adjacent light source elements (108).

title_en: Apparatus for thermal management of pedestals and chambers
abstract_en: The apparatus can reduce not only unwanted radiant heat loss from a pedestal of a substrate processing system, but also radiant heat transfer to other components within a chamber of the substrate processing system.

title_en: Packaging substrate structure embedded with efficient heat dissipation component and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic manufacturing, and particularly provides a packaging substrate structure embedded with a high-efficiency heat dissipation component and a manufacturing method thereof, which are used for solving the heat dissipation problem of a chip or a high-power device. The micro-channel can be designed on the front side and the back side of the chip package at the same time, and the phase change of the composite phase-change material consisting of the expanded graphite, the paraffin and the crystal water absorbs the heat accumulated by the chip during high-strength work so as to prolong the service life of the chip, effectively reduce the packaging risk and reduce the manufacturing cost; the composite phase-change material is externally connected with the metal-based heat dissipation substrate, and the chip is cooled by the steps of absorbing heat, transferring heat and dissipating heat, so that the pain of heat dissipation of the chip in the electronic industry is overcome; in addition, the preparation process of the composite phase change material is mature and simple, and the cost of the raw materials is low. Therefore, compared with the existing micro-channel heat dissipation technology, the process flow is simpler, the application environment is more comprehensive, and the defects of the existing traditional refrigeration technology can be overcome.

title_en: Memory device
abstract_en: The invention proposes a memory comprising a plurality of one-time-programmable memory cells, each one-time-programmable memory cell comprising a memory film (30). In one embodiment, the memory film (30) includes an OTS (Ovonic threshold switch) film (30A) and an antifuse film (30B). In another embodiment, the memory film (30) comprises a layer of OTS film (30A), the first switching voltage V of the OTS film (30A)  form  Greater than the subsequent flip voltage V  th  . The memory is a three-dimensional one-time programming memory and comprises a three-dimensional transverse one-time programming memory and a three-dimensional longitudinal one-time programming memory.

title_en: High-temperature piezoelectric ceramic material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature piezoelectric ceramic material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of high-temperature piezoelectric ceramic materials. The invention provides a high-temperature piezoelectric ceramic material, which is a samarium oxide doped lead ytterbium niobate-lead titanate piezoelectric ceramic material, and the prepared material has high Curie temperature and further improved piezoelectric performance by doping Sm  2 O 3  in a lead ytterbium niobate-lead titanate binary system, and meanwhile, compared with the existing ceramic, the piezoelectric performance of the ceramic at high temperature is more excellent. The invention provides a preparation method of a high-temperature piezoelectric ceramic material, which can avoid the occurrence of a second phase of ceramic, successfully realize stable sintering of a PYN-PT based material, and has uniform particle size and high density. The preparation method has the advantages of simple process, low sintering temperature, low cost, suitability for large-scale industrial production and wide application prospect in the fields of high-temperature piezoelectric materials and devices.

title_en: Epitaxial structure generation method of Mini LED with high ESD
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of LED chips, in particular to a method for generating an epitaxial structure of a high-ESD Mini LED, which comprises the following steps of S2, growing a first static electricity discharge layer on a multi-quantum well active region layer, growing a second static electricity discharge layer on the first static electricity discharge layer, and growing a third static electricity discharge layer on the second static electricity discharge layer, wherein the Mg doping concentration of the second static electricity discharge layer is 1.1-5E+16atom/cm  3 , the Mg doping concentration of the first static electricity discharge layer is 1.1-5 times that of the third static electricity discharge layer, and the Mg doping concentration of the second static electricity discharge layer is 0.1-2% that of the first static electricity discharge layer.

title_en: Plasma processing method and plasma processing system
abstract_en: The invention provides a plasma processing method and a plasma processing system, which can properly pre-coat the surface of the component in the chamber before the plasma processing. The plasma processing method comprises the following steps: a step (a) of forming a first protective film on a surface of a member in a chamber by using a first process gas containing a halogen-free precursor gas; and (b) performing plasma processing on the processing object carried into the chamber by using plasma of a second processing gas after the first protective film is formed on the surface of the member.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method of forming the same
abstract_en: The device includes a substrate, first and second gate structures, first and second hybrid fins, and first and second sidewalls. The first gate structure is positioned over and surrounds the first nanostructured vertical stack. A second gate structure is over and surrounds the second nanostructured vertical stack. The second gate structure and the first gate structure extend along a first direction and are laterally spaced apart from each other in a second direction, the second direction being substantially perpendicular to the first direction. The first hybrid fin extends through and under the first and second gate structures, extending along the second direction. The second hybrid fin is located between the first gate structure and the second gate structure. The second hybrid fin has: a first sidewall adjacent the first gate structure; and a second sidewall adjacent to the second gate structure. Embodiments of the present application also relate to semiconductor devices and methods of forming the same.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: A semiconductor structure and a forming method thereof are provided, wherein the forming method comprises the steps of forming a substrate, forming a power rail region, forming a first isolation film, forming a second isolation film, forming a buried power rail in the power rail opening, forming a side wall on the side wall of the first fin and the side wall of the second fin after the first fin and the second fin are formed, forming a first patterning layer on the substrate, forming a first opening exposing the power rail region in the first patterning layer, etching the substrate by taking the first patterning layer as a mask, forming a power rail opening in the substrate, forming the isolation film on the inner wall of the power rail opening, and forming the buried power rail in the power rail opening after the isolation film is formed, wherein the width of the buried power rail in the first region is larger than that of the buried power rail in the second region. Thus, the performance of the formed semiconductor structure is improved and the process window of the forming process is increased.

title_en: Acrylate chip adhesive and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an acrylate chip adhesive and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of adhesives. The acrylate chip adhesive provided by the invention comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 4 to 20 percent of acrylate oligomer; 2 to 20 percent of acrylate monomer; 4 to 40 percent of silane coupling agent; 0.5 to 2 percent of initiator; 0.01 to 0.8 percent of polymerization inhibitor; 40 to 85 percent of inorganic filler. According to the acrylate adhesive provided by the invention, a scheme that a large amount of silane coupling agents replace diluents is adopted, the adhesive strength of the acrylate adhesive to the interface is effectively improved through the infiltration and chemical coupling effects of the coupling agents to the interface, and the acrylate adhesive suitable for large chips can be suitable for the bonding of chips with smaller sizes. Meanwhile, the invention combines the acrylic monomer, the acrylic oligomer and the coupling agent in an optimized proportion, and the cured colloid has better flexibility and higher bonding strength to the interface.

title_en: Method for manufacturing electronic device
abstract_en: The invention provides a manufacturing method of an electronic device, which comprises the steps of providing a first substrate, wherein the first substrate comprises a circuit layer and an electronic element arranged on the circuit layer. The manufacturing method further comprises the steps of providing a second substrate, attaching the first substrate and the second substrate to form an electronic module, cutting the electronic module, forming a circuit on a first surface exposed after the electronic module is cut and a second surface of the electronic module, wherein the first surface is adjacent to the second surface, the circuit is electrically connected to the circuit layer, a driving element is arranged on the second surface of the electronic module, and the driving element is electrically connected to the circuit.

title_en: Solar cell interconnection structure and solar cell module
abstract_en: The application discloses a solar cell interconnection structure and a solar cell module. The solar cell interconnection structure comprises a Printed Circuit Board (PCB) and a solar cell module, wherein the PCB comprises a substrate, conductive patterns, interconnection pads and conductive holes are arranged on the front surface of the substrate, the conductive pads are arranged on the back surface of the substrate, and the conductive pads are connected with the conductive patterns and the interconnection pads on the front surface of the substrate through wires and the conductive holes; at least one solar cell unit comprising an upper electrode and a lower electrode, wherein the lower electrode is connected with the conductive pattern on the printed circuit board, and the upper electrode is connected with the interconnection pad on the printed circuit board; the solar cell module is formed by connecting a group of solar cell units in series and parallel through interconnection lines on a printed circuit board, and the conductive welding disc on the back surface of the substrate forms an external positive electrode and an external negative electrode of the group of solar cell module. The solar cell interconnection structure and the solar cell module solve the problems of complicated procedures, low yield, poor reliability and the like of interconnection and packaging of ultrathin and small-size solar cells.

title_en: Optical path control member and display device including the same
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, an optical path control member includes a first substrate, a first electrode disposed over the first substrate, a second substrate disposed over the first substrate, a second electrode disposed under the second substrate, and a light conversion unit disposed between the first electrode and the second electrode, wherein the light conversion unit includes a resin composition, wherein the resin composition includes an oligomer, a monomer, a photoinitiator, and an additive, wherein the molecular weight of the monomer is 600g/mol or less.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display panel and a display device. The display panel comprises a first transistor and a second transistor which are electrically connected, wherein the first transistor comprises a first active part formed by low-temperature polycrystalline silicon material, the second transistor comprises a second grid electrode and a second active part formed by metal oxide material, the display panel further comprises a substrate, the first active part is arranged on the substrate, the second active part is positioned on one side of the first active part far away from the substrate, the second grid electrode is positioned on one side of the second active part far away from the first active part, and the orthographic projection of the second active part on the substrate and the orthographic projection of the first active part on the substrate at least partially overlap. The invention can improve the space utilization rate and resolution of the display panel.

title_en: In-situ interconnected sensing and storing integrated device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-situ interconnected sensing and storing integrated device and a preparation method thereof. The in-situ interconnected sense and compute integrated device comprises: a substrate formed with first groove structures arranged at intervals; the nerve morphology device comprises a bottom electrode, a functional layer and a top electrode, wherein the bottom electrode, the functional layer and the top electrode are sequentially formed in a first groove structure, and a first isolation layer is formed on the top electrode of the nerve morphology device and is provided with a plurality of through holes which are distributed at intervals; a second isolation layer formed on the substrate surface between the first groove structures; a bottom electrode of the sensor device filling the through hole and covering a surface of the substrate between the first isolation layer and the second isolation layer; the second groove structures are arranged at intervals and are formed on the bottom electrode of the sensing device, and the positions of the second groove structures correspond to the positions of the through holes; the functional layer of the sensing device is formed at the bottom and the side wall of the second groove structure; and a top electrode of the photoelectric sensor, which is formed on the functional layer of the sensing device and fills the second groove structure.

title_en: Quick fixed light Fu Biankuang
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fast fixed photovoltaic frame, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic frames. The invention comprises four sections, four corner connecting pieces and four fasteners, wherein the sections comprise an upper plate body and a lower plate body, a rear plate body and a vertical plate are respectively arranged at the rear side and the middle part between the upper plate body and the lower plate body, a cavity between the vertical plate and the rear plate body forms a corner code area, the corner connecting pieces comprise square seat plates, corner code rods are respectively arranged at two adjacent side edges of each square seat plate, and the four sections are distributed in a rectangular shape. According to the invention, the corner connector area of the profile is arranged at the outer side of the assembly installation area, the installation point of the corner connector can be arranged on the upper surface or the lower surface of the profile, the novel corner connector is designed for positioning and connecting the end parts of the two profiles, the two profiles are connected in an interference connection mode through the arrangement of the preset holes and the novel fasteners, and the subsequent automatic assembly is facilitated under the condition that the stability can be maintained, so that the assembly efficiency is improved.

title_en: Semiconductor packaging device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a semiconductor package apparatus and a method of manufacturing the same, the semiconductor package apparatus including: a first circuit layer having a first surface; the second circuit layer is arranged on the first surface and is provided with a first inclined part; the first electronic element is provided with an active surface arranged on the first inclined part, and a non-active surface is provided with a first reflecting layer; the second electronic element is arranged on the first surface adjacent to the first electronic element; the third electronic element is arranged on the second circuit layer and corresponds to the first reflecting layer; the light outputted by the second electronic element can be reflected to the third electronic element through the first reflecting layer.

title_en: Solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a solar cell and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaics. The solar cell comprises a silicon wafer substrate layer, a boron doped silicon layer positioned on the front surface of the silicon wafer substrate layer, a tunneling oxide layer and a phosphorus doped polycrystalline silicon carbide layer which are positioned on the back surface of the silicon wafer substrate layer in sequence. Wherein the phosphorus doped polycrystalline silicon carbide layer is doped with oxygen atoms. The solar cell provided by the application is beneficial to avoiding the explosion phenomenon of the polycrystalline structure layer in the solar cell, enhancing the passivation performance of the solar cell, improving the silver paste corrosion resistance of the polycrystalline structure layer, effectively reducing the metal penetration of the back surface of the solar cell and the metal recombination in the solar cell, and further effectively improving the photoelectric conversion efficiency, the open-circuit voltage and the short-circuit current of the solar cell.

title_en: Composite glass powder, solar cell front silver paste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electronic materials, in particular to H01B1/22, in particular to G01N1/28, and more particularly relates to composite glass powder, solar cell front silver paste and a preparation method thereof. The composite glass powder for the high-open-pressure PERC solar cell front silver paste comprises vanadium-phosphorus-barium system glass powder and lead-tellurium system glass powder. The invention relates to a composite glass powder for high-open-pressure PERC solar cell front silver paste, which comprises vanadium-phosphorus-barium system glass powder and lead-tellurium system glass powder, wherein the two glass systems have the function complementation function, the lead-tellurium system glass powder has a good corrosion function on an antireflection film on the surface of a crystalline silicon cell, the vanadium-phosphorus-barium system glass powder mainly plays a role of buffering corrosion, the softening point of the lead-tellurium system glass powder is lower (350-415 ℃), silver grains form a conductive channel after the SiNx film layer is corroded at first along with the rising of sintering temperature, the softening point of the vanadium-phosphorus-barium system glass powder is higher (386-458 ℃), the glass powder reacts with the SiNx film layer relatively inert, and the silver grains are prevented from penetrating through an emitter in the conductive channel.

title_en: Selective deposition of materials comprising silicon and oxygen using plasma
abstract_en: Methods and vapor deposition assemblies for selectively depositing a material comprising silicon and oxygen on a first surface of a substrate relative to a second surface of the substrate by a cyclical deposition process are disclosed. The method includes providing a substrate into a reaction chamber, providing a metal or metalloid catalyst into the reaction chamber in a gas phase, providing a silicon precursor comprising an alkoxysilane compound into the reaction chamber in a gas phase, and providing a plasma into the reaction chamber to form a reactive species for forming a material comprising silicon and oxygen on a first surface. The method may include, for example, sub-cycles for adjusting the proportions of the material components.

title_en: Yellow-green light LED epitaxial wafer, preparation method thereof and yellow-green light LED
abstract_en: The invention discloses a yellow-green LED epitaxial wafer and a preparation method thereof, and a yellow-green LED, and relates to the field of semiconductor photoelectric devices. The light-emitting diode (LED) epitaxial wafer comprises a substrate, a buffer layer, a U-GaN layer, an N-GaN layer, a multiple quantum well layer, an electron blocking layer and a P-GaN layer, wherein the buffer layer, the U-GaN layer, the N-GaN layer, the multiple quantum well layer and the P-GaN layer are laminated on the substrate; the first multiple quantum well layer is of a periodic structure, and each period comprises In  2  SSe layer, in  x  Ga  1‑x  The N layer and the first GaN layer, and x is 0.2-0.35; the second multiple quantum well layer has a periodic structure, and each period comprises In laminated In sequence  y  Ga  1‑y  The N layer and the second GaN layer, and y is 0.1-0.2. By implementing the invention, the luminous efficiency can be improved, and the working voltage is not obviously improved.

title_en: Organic light emitting display device
abstract_en: An organic light emitting display device is provided, which includes a sub-pixel including a light emitting region, a planarization layer overlapping the light emitting region, the planarization layer including a plurality of light extraction patterns having a plurality of protrusions and a plurality of recesses, a light control pattern alternately disposed in the recesses of the plurality of light extraction patterns, and a light emitting element disposed over the plurality of light extraction patterns and the light control pattern.

title_en: Thin film transistor, thin film transistor array substrate and thin film transistor manufacturing method
abstract_en: The application provides a thin film transistor which comprises a grid electrode, an insulating layer and an active layer, wherein the insulating layer is arranged on one side of the grid electrode, the active layer is arranged on one side of the insulating layer, which is far away from the grid electrode, the active layer comprises an annealing layer and an amorphous silicon layer, the annealing layer is arranged on one side of the insulating layer, which is far away from the grid electrode, the amorphous silicon layer is arranged on one side of the annealing layer, which is far away from the insulating layer, and the annealing layer is made of amorphous silicon material through excimer laser annealing. The application also provides a thin film transistor array substrate and a thin film transistor manufacturing method.

title_en: Near infrared luminescent material, preparation method thereof and LED light source containing luminescent material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near infrared luminescent material, a preparation method thereof and an LED light source comprising the luminescent material, wherein the chemical composition of the luminescent material is represented by a chemical formula A  a  B  b  P  x  O  y  :zCr  3+  Wherein the A element is selected from one or more of Li, na, K, rb, cs, mg, ca, sr and Ba; the B element is one or more selected from Al, ga, sc, in, fe, mn, ti, zr, V and rare earth elements, cr  3+  For luminescence center ion, 0.01at.% is less than or equal to z is less than or equal to 100at.%, and a, b, x and y are the simplest stoichiometric numbers of elements, and 0 is less than or equal to a<5，0<b<4，0<x<20，0<y<30. The near infrared luminescent material has higher luminescence stability and luminescence quantum yield.

title_en: Flexible electronic device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible electronic device and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the flexible electronic device comprises an ionization-conductive layer, a flexible substrate, an element layer and a back film. The conductive ionization layer has opposite first and second edges. The flexible substrate is arranged on the conductive ionization layer. The active region of the flexible substrate is located on the conductive ionization layer. At least a portion of the first edge of the flexible substrate is substantially aligned with at least a portion of the first edge of the conductive ionization layer. The active element region of the element layer is located on the active region of the flexible substrate. The pad region of the element layer is located on the first peripheral region of the flexible substrate. The back film is arranged on the bottom surface of the ionization type layer.

title_en: Electrostatic discharge protection structure
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrostatic discharge protection structure. The electrostatic discharge protection structure comprises a substrate, a source electrode region, a drain electrode region, a grid electrode structure, a floating first doped region, a second doped region and a drain electrode region, wherein the substrate is provided with a first conductivity type, the source electrode region and the drain electrode region are provided with a second conductivity type opposite to the first conductivity type and are arranged in the substrate at intervals, the grid electrode structure is arranged on the substrate between the source electrode region and the drain electrode region, the floating first doped region is provided with the first conductivity type and is arranged in the substrate on one side, far away from the grid electrode structure, of the drain electrode region, the doping concentration of the first doped region is larger than that of the substrate, the source electrode region and the grid electrode structure are electrically connected to a first potential end together, and the drain electrode region is electrically connected to a second potential end. The addition of the first doped region can reduce the avalanche breakdown voltage of the collector junction of the parasitic NPN transistor of the electrostatic discharge protection structure, and is beneficial to reducing the trigger voltage of the electrostatic discharge protection structure.

title_en: Trench gate type IGBT
abstract_en: The invention relates to a trench gate type IGBT. The trench gate type IGBT at least comprises a first type trench and a P type doped deep junction region. A second type of groove is additionally arranged between the first type of groove and the P type doped deep junction region. The second type of trench is used for slowing down or isolating the charging of the first type of trench by the P-type doped deep junction region. According to the invention, under the condition that a small amount of delay is added in the IGBT starting stage, the power consumption is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the switching controllability of an IGBT device is improved. Because the IGBT device is generally a high-power device, it is an important technical means to reduce the power consumption of the IGBT greatly under the condition that the delay time is ensured to be increased within an acceptable range. The improvement of the switching controllability of the IGBT device can also avoid the false start of the IGBT device, and meanwhile, the problem of switching oscillation of the IGBT under certain conditions is avoided.

title_en: Blind pixel suppression structure for line indium gallium arsenic detector and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blind pixel suppression structure for a line-array InGaAs detector and an implementation method. The detector is of a back irradiation structure, N rows of m columns of photosensitive element diffusion holes are designed, wherein 1<n is less than or equal to 3, m is more than or equal to 512, the protection ring diffusion holes encircle the outer ring of the photosensitive region, each photosensitive element independently leads out a P electrode, and the protection ring P region and the device N region are combined and led out through extension electrodes. The realization method is that N rows of x m columns of photosensitive element diffusion holes and guard ring diffusion holes are synchronously obtained on an epitaxial material of an N-InP/I-InGaAs/N-InP structure through photoetching and etching, P type doping is synchronously carried out, an extension electrode covers a P electrode hole of the guard ring and an N electrode groove of a device, and photo-generated carriers generated by the guard ring under illumination are led out through the N electrode. The invention has the advantages that: according to the structure, n rows of pixels are used as one row of pixels for application, each pixel is independently led out, zero blind pixel application can be realized as long as n pixels in the same column have one normal photosensitive element, and the yield of the detector is improved by n times.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: A display panel and a display device are provided. The display panel includes: a support substrate including a display region in which a plurality of pixel regions are arranged, and a non-display region surrounding the display region; a package substrate facing one surface of the support substrate; a light emitting array disposed on the one surface of the support substrate; a phase adjustment layer disposed on the light emitting array and changing a phase of light; a reflective light absorbing layer disposed on the phase adjustment layer and absorbing at least a portion of the light reflected by the light emitting array; a sealing layer disposed in the non-display region between the support substrate and the package substrate; and a black matrix layer disposed on a surface of the package substrate opposite to the support substrate and corresponding to a non-light-emitting region that is a boundary between the plurality of pixel regions.

title_en: Y-axis double-stroke mechanism and wafer carrying device
abstract_en: The application provides a Y axle double stroke mechanism and wafer handling device relates to semiconductor field technical field. The mechanism comprises: the device comprises a substrate, a Y-axis electric cylinder, a telescopic assembly, a conveying assembly and a Y-axis sucker; the Y-axis electric cylinder is fixed on the base plate, the telescopic component is connected to the Y-axis electric cylinder in a sliding way, and the Y-axis electric cylinder is used for pushing the telescopic component to advance or retreat; one end of the conveying component is fixedly connected with the substrate, the other end of the conveying component is fixedly connected with the Y-axis sucker, and the conveying component is movably arranged on the telescopic component through a fixed piece on the telescopic component; the Y-axis sucker is slidably arranged on the telescopic component; wherein, the transmission assembly, the telescopic assembly and the Y-axis sucker form a movable pulley motion model. The mechanism expands the pushing distance of the Y-axis electric cylinder by 2 times based on a movable pulley motion model formed by the conveying assembly, the telescopic assembly and the Y-axis sucker, realizes double-stroke telescopic operation, and solves the problem that the conventional device cannot smoothly convey wafers in a narrow space range.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a semiconductor layer having a plurality of semiconductor layers
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a semiconductor device. The semiconductor device includes a plurality of first line structures extending in a first direction, each of the plurality of first line structures including a first pinned layer exhibiting magnetization in a fixed magnetization direction; a plurality of second wire structures spaced apart from the first wire structures and extending in a second direction intersecting the first direction; a plurality of first free layers each exhibiting magnetization having a variable magnetization direction, the first free layers overlapping intersection regions of the first and second line structures between the first and second line structures, respectively; and a first tunnel barrier layer interposed between the first line structure and the first free layer.

title_en: Semiconductor device and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: In a semiconductor device having a novel structure including a memory cell having a ferroelectric capacitor, a first transistor (500A), a second transistor (500B), a first capacitor (600A), a second capacitor (600B), and a wiring (401) are included. The first transistor is electrically connected to the first capacitor. The second transistor is electrically connected to the second capacitor. The wiring is located below the first transistor and the second transistor and is electrically connected to the first transistor or the second transistor. The first capacitor and the second capacitor each include a ferroelectric layer (630). The first capacitor and the second capacitor are arranged on the same plane. The first capacitor and the second capacitor may also have regions overlapping each other. It is preferable that both the first transistor and the second transistor include an oxide semiconductor in a channel. The ferroelectric layer preferably comprises one or more elements selected from hafnium, zirconium and group III-V elements.

title_en: TO packaging structure and carrier
abstract_en: A TO packaging structure and a carrier belong TO the technical field of photoelectric communication, wherein the TO packaging structure comprises a chassis, a round table is arranged at the upper end of the chassis, a pair of key-shaped holes are formed in the round table, the key-shaped holes penetrate through the chassis, and an insulator is arranged in the key-shaped holes; a first signal pin, a second signal pin, a third signal pin and a fourth signal pin are sequentially arranged on one insulator; the other insulator is provided with a fifth signal pin, a sixth signal pin, a seventh signal pin and an eighth signal pin in sequence; a semiconductor refrigerator is arranged on the round table; the upper end of the semiconductor refrigerator is provided with a heat sink, and the upper end of the heat sink is divided into an area A, an area B, an area C and an area D; the heat sink is provided with an A capacitor, a backlight chip, an electroabsorption modulator, a 45-degree prism, a resistor, a B capacitor, a thermistor chip and a cushion block. TO packaging structure has advantages such as interference resistance, radiating effect are excellent. In addition, a carrier for conveniently carrying out welding and pasting operations is also provided.

title_en: Perovskite single crystal film based on LIPSS, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a perovskite single crystal film based on LIPSS, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of perovskite photodetectors. The preparation method comprises the steps of utilizing vertically polarized femtosecond laser double pulse induction to process a surface periodic structure on the surface of a pretreated base material, dropwise adding perovskite precursor solution, covering a PDMS substrate, lightly pressing, heating, and utilizing vertically polarized femtosecond laser double pulse induction to process the surface periodic structure to prepare the LIPSS-based perovskite single crystal film. The photoelectric device prepared by the perovskite single crystal film has more excellent photoelectric performance, simple process and low cost, and solves the problems of poor light absorption effect, low quantum efficiency and low responsivity of the existing perovskite thin film.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device is provided. The display device includes: a first electrode extending in a first direction; a second electrode spaced apart from the first electrode in a second direction; a pixel including a sub-pixel in which light emitting elements provided on the first electrode and the second electrode are provided; and a first scanning line provided in the pixel and extending in the first direction, wherein the plurality of sub-pixels includes a first sub-pixel in which a portion of the first scanning line is provided, and a second sub-pixel adjacent to the first sub-pixel in the second direction, and the first scanning line is provided so as not to overlap with a first electrode provided in the first sub-pixel.

title_en: Compound and organic electroluminescent device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compound and an organic electroluminescent device, and relates to the technical field of organic electroluminescent. Compared with the branched alkyl commonly used at present, the cyclic structure has better thermal stability and chemical stability. Good thermal and chemical stability improves the stability and lifetime of the device. Meanwhile, compared with the methyl commonly used at present, the ring structure has better electron donating effect, so that the electron cloud density and the hole mobility of material molecules are improved, and the luminous efficiency of the device is further improved.

title_en: Metal lead frame suitable for side patch transmitting tube and forming process thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of diodes and provides a metal lead frame suitable for a side patch transmitting tube, which comprises a frame body, a mounting patch, electrode pins and a locating piece; the frame body is integrally connected with the frame, and a plurality of placing openings for placing the mounting patches and positioning holes corresponding to the placing openings are formed in the frame body; the electrode pins are connected to the frame body and extend into the corresponding placement openings; the mounting patch is connected with the electrode pin, and the joint of the veneer of the mounting patch and the electrode pin is in a bending shape; the locating plate is connected with the frame body and is positioned at the placement opening, and the locating plate corresponds to the location of the locating hole. This application has accurate stamping forming's effect. In addition, a molding process is also provided.

title_en: Patterning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a patterning method which comprises the steps of providing a substrate, forming a first mandrel pattern, forming first side walls, forming a third isolation layer filling gaps of the first side walls, forming a third mandrel isolation pattern, forming a second mandrel pattern, forming second side walls, forming a fourth isolation layer filling gaps between the second side walls, removing the second side walls to form a fourth mandrel isolation pattern, and taking the fourth mandrel isolation pattern as a mask pattern. In the invention, the third isolation layer is used for filling the two sides of the first side wall so as to eliminate the height difference of the first isolation layer, the fourth isolation layer is used for filling the two sides of the second side wall so as to eliminate the height difference of the second isolation layer, thereby being convenient for forming mask patterns with better morphology and reducing the process debugging difficulty during patterning.

title_en: Semiconductor light-emitting element and light-emitting device
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor light-emitting element and a light-emitting device, wherein the semiconductor light-emitting element comprises a semiconductor lamination layer, the semiconductor lamination layer comprises an undoped aluminum gallium nitride layer, an N-type semiconductor layer, a light-emitting layer and a P-type semiconductor layer, wherein the undoped aluminum gallium nitride layer and the N-type semiconductor layer are provided with a plurality of AlGaN layers, the Al content and the variation trend of the Al content in each AlGaN layer are different, and the thicknesses of the layers are also different. The semiconductor lamination with low dislocation density can be obtained through the structure collocation, so that the light-emitting efficiency of the semiconductor light-emitting element is improved; in addition, the semiconductor light-emitting element further comprises an AlNO buffer layer, the AlNO buffer layer is matched with the semiconductor lamination and the multi-layer AlGaN layer is matched, so that lattice mismatch among the semiconductor light-emitting elements and stress generated by thermal deformation difference can be reduced, the warping problem of the epitaxial wafer is improved, cracks of the epitaxial wafer are improved, and the using effect of the core particle is guaranteed.

title_en: Semiconductor package
abstract_en: Disclosed is a semiconductor package including: a first die having a central region and a peripheral region surrounding the central region; a plurality of through electrodes penetrating the first die; a plurality of first pads at a top surface of the first die and coupled to the through electrodes; a second die on the first die; a plurality of second pads at a bottom surface of the second die, the bottom surface of the second die facing the top surface of the first die; a plurality of connection terminals connecting the first pad to the second pad; and a dielectric layer filling a space between the first die and the second die and surrounding the connection terminal.
