The first width of each first pad on the central region may be greater than the second width of each first pad on the peripheral region. Each of the connection terminals may include a protrusion at a side surface thereof, the protrusion protruding beyond a side surface of the corresponding first pad and a side surface of the corresponding second pad. The protrusion may protrude in a direction away from the center of the first die. The protruding distance of the protruding portion may increase in a direction from the center of the first die toward the outside of the first die.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device is provided. The display device includes: a plurality of pixels including a first region and a second region; a first electrode and a second electrode disposed in the first region; a plurality of light emitting elements disposed between the first electrode and the second electrode in the first region; a first insulating layer disposed on the first region and the second region; and a second insulating layer disposed on the first insulating layer, wherein the first insulating layer includes at least one first opening disposed in the second region, the second insulating layer includes at least one second opening overlapping the first opening, and a width of the first opening in the first direction is greater than a width of the second opening in the first direction.

title_en: Photoetching mark alignment method for silicon carbide superjunction structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductors, and discloses a method for aligning photoetching marks of a silicon carbide superjunction structure, which specifically comprises the following steps: step S1, preparing a photomask, and forming a first mark pattern and a device mark pattern on the photomask; s2, forming a first marking hole and a device groove on the surface of the silicon carbide semiconductor; step S3, carrying out epitaxial backfill on the silicon carbide semiconductor, filling up the device groove, and enabling the inside of the first marking hole to be hollow; s4, performing chemical mechanical polishing and leveling on the epitaxial film to expose the first marking holes; and S5, forming a complete super-junction silicon carbide MOSFET device at the device groove position on the silicon carbide semiconductor. The method is simple and easy to process, and can realize the accurate alignment of the photoetching marks.

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus and substrate processing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a substrate processing apparatus and a substrate processing method. The substrate processing method comprises the following steps: obtaining substrate information; selecting any one of the liquid replacement step and the concentration adjustment step; a 1 st treatment liquid adjustment step of discharging at least a part of the treatment liquid in the treatment tank from the treatment tank when the treatment liquid in the treatment tank does not satisfy a specific condition in the case where the liquid replacement step is selected in the selection step, and supplying sulfuric acid and hydrogen peroxide water to the treatment tank; a 2 nd treatment liquid adjustment step of adjusting the concentration of the treatment liquid in the treatment tank while circulating the treatment liquid in the treatment tank through a pipe connected to the treatment tank when the concentration adjustment step is selected in the selection step; and immersing the substrate in the processing liquid in the processing tank while circulating the processing liquid in the processing tank adjusted in the 1 st processing liquid adjusting step or the 2 nd processing liquid adjusting step through a pipe connected to the processing tank.

title_en: Method for removing Pt impurities by wet method
abstract_en: The application provides a method for removing Pt impurities by a wet method, and relates to the technical field of semiconductor processes. The wet method for removing Pt impurities comprises the following steps: s1, H is  2  SO  4  The solution was heated to 150℃and then reacted with H  2  O  2  Mixing to form SPM solution, and heating to 180 ℃; s2, mixing O  3  Mixing with water to form an aqueous ozone solution; s3, mixing the ozone water solution and the SPM solution at 180 ℃ to form mixed liquid medicine at 220 ℃; s4, spraying the mixed liquid medicine on the surface of the silicon wafer in a pressurizing mode for cleaning, and then flushing with deionized water, so that Pt removal efficiency is improved, and on the premise of high removal efficiency, the processing time is saved, the liquid medicine consumption is saved, and the semiconductor preparation process is optimized.

title_en: Semiconductor package and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A semiconductor package and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The semiconductor package includes: an interposer; a system-in-chip die stack bonded to the top surface of the interposer, the system-in-chip die stack comprising two or more dies bonded together; and a plurality of dies bonded to the top surface of the interposer. In a first direction, a first lateral distance between a first boundary of the system-integrated wafer die stack and a boundary of an adjacent wafer of the plurality of wafers is greater than a first threshold distance.

title_en: Semiconductor packaging substrate structure and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductors, in particular to a semiconductor packaging substrate structure and a manufacturing process thereof; including base plate, the wafer, many wires, a plurality of pad, a plurality of pin and encapsulation subassembly, encapsulation subassembly includes the box body, the apron, many guide bars, many support and hold the spring, many pull rods and the spacing arc piece of polylith, base plate and box body looks adaptation, the apron sets up in the top of box body, a plurality of spacing chambeies of box body, every spacing arc piece sets up respectively in the spacing intracavity that corresponds, every both ends that support the spring respectively with box body and the spacing arc piece fixed connection that corresponds, every pull rod respectively with the spacing arc piece fixed connection that corresponds, many guide bars all with apron fixed connection, every guide bar all has the fixed orifices, through the setting of above-mentioned structure, it is convenient for encapsulate the semiconductor to have realized, the connected mode is simple, do benefit to the installation and the dismantlement of semiconductor.

title_en: Rubberizing method and rubberizing device for battery strings
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic production of photovoltaic modules, and provides a rubberizing method and a rubberizing device of a battery string, wherein the rubberizing method comprises the following steps: s1: pulling out the lower adhesive tape group and the welding tape group; s2: cutting the lower adhesive tape group, adhering the lower adhesive tape group to the welding tape group from bottom to top, and cutting the welding tape group; s3: sticking the lower adhesive tape group to the bottom of the battery piece; s4: all the battery pieces downstream of the battery pieces are moved downstream by one battery piece station; s5: moving the battery piece, the welding belt group and the lower adhesive belt group to a battery piece station downstream; after moving, using the upper adhesive tape group to paste the battery piece and the welding tape group on the next battery piece station; s6: and repeating S1 to S5 until all the battery pieces are placed. The invention can paste the welding strips on the upper and lower surfaces of the battery piece at the same time, and can be applied to continuous production of battery strings.

title_en: Wafer film sticking and mounting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wafer film sticking machine, which comprises an iron ring conveying line, and an iron ring feeding device, a wafer feeding device, a film sticking device and a film cutting device which are sequentially arranged along the iron ring conveying line; the iron ring feeding device is used for placing an iron ring on the iron ring conveying line, conveying the iron ring along the iron ring conveying line, and forming a hollow-out part in the center of the iron ring; placing a wafer at the hollowed-out part of the iron ring of the way by the wafer feeding device; the film pasting device is provided with a film material roll and a film pasting roller, wherein a release paper is wound on the film material roll, an expansion film is pasted on one side of the release paper, the expansion film is wound on the film pasting roller after being released from the film material roll along with the release paper, the expansion film on the film pasting roller is positioned on the outer side of the release paper, the film pasting roller is tightly attached to the iron ring conveying line so as to roll along with the displacement of the iron ring and the wafer when the iron ring and the wafer on the iron ring conveying line pass through, the expansion film is pasted on the iron ring and the wafer, and the film cutting device is used for cutting the expansion film between the adjacent iron rings on the iron ring conveying line. The invention realizes that the wafer and the iron ring are automatically adhered on one expansion film.

title_en: Heterojunction bipolar transistor structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: A heterojunction bipolar transistor structure and a forming method thereof relate to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing, and the structure comprises: a substrate; a current collecting layer, a base layer and an emission layer on the substrate; an emitter electrode on the emitter layer; a collector electrode on the collector layer; the base electrode comprises a plurality of finger parts which are respectively and electrically connected with the base layer; a passivation structure exposing a portion of the top surface of the emitter electrode, a portion of the top surface of the collector electrode, and a portion of the top surface of the finger between adjacent emitter layers; and the interconnection metal layers are respectively electrically connected with the emitter electrode, the finger part and the collector electrode. By omitting the end part of the base electrode, the base layer does not need to provide a placement position for the end part of the base electrode, the area of the base layer can be effectively reduced, and the area of a PN junction formed between the base layer and the current collecting layer is further reduced. The part which is used for providing placement for the end part of the base electrode and cannot contribute current is removed from the base layer, so that the utilization efficiency of the device structure can be effectively improved.

title_en: Double-doped layer TOPCon battery structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-doped layer TOPCon battery structure and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of battery processing and preparation. The double-doped TOPCon battery structure comprises a monocrystalline silicon piece, a diffusion layer, a passivation layer, a front antireflection layer, a front metal electrode, a tunneling layer, a doped polycrystalline silicon layer, a back antireflection layer and a back metal electrode, wherein the diffusion layer, the passivation layer, the front antireflection layer and the front metal electrode are sequentially arranged on the front side of the monocrystalline silicon piece, the tunneling layer, the doped polycrystalline silicon layer, the back antireflection layer and the back metal electrode are sequentially arranged on the back side of the monocrystalline silicon piece, and the doped layer comprises a first diffusion doped layer positioned on the front side of the silicon piece and a second epitaxial doped layer positioned between the first diffusion doped layer and the front metal electrode. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, can ensure the thickness of the P-type doped layer of the metal contact region, effectively shield the recombination of the metal region, reduce the contact resistance of the metal region, reduce the doping concentration and junction depth of the non-metal region, reduce the Auger recombination and parasitic light absorption of the non-metal region, and effectively improve the conversion efficiency of TOPCon batteries.

title_en: Photovoltaic cell interconnection press and series welding machine
abstract_en: The application provides a photovoltaic cell interconnection press and a stringer, wherein the photovoltaic cell interconnection press comprises a press plate and a plurality of groups of positioning press pins, each group of positioning press pins is used for pressing a welding strip, the press plate is made of a light-transmitting material, and the lower surface of the press plate is provided with a plurality of mounting areas for mounting the positioning press pins; each group of positioning press needles are arranged in the corresponding installation area, and the heat conductivity of the positioning press needles is higher than that of the pressing plate. The application can improve the uniformity of the heating temperature of the battery piece and the stability of the size of the pressing tool, reduce the welding energy consumption and enhance the alignment effect of the welding strip in the welding process.

title_en: Integrated forming manufacturing method of TGV adapter plate
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for integrally forming a TGV adapter plate, which comprises the following steps: a first step of: forming a groove in a substrate; and a second step of: performing glass reflow in the grooves to at least partially fill the grooves with glass; and a third step of: manufacturing a carrier plate with metal columns formed on the surface, carrying the carrier plate by using a die head to press the metal columns into the grooves, and filling gaps among the metal columns with glass liquid in the grooves; fourth step: separating the mold from the carrier plate; fifth step: separating the carrier plate from the metal column; sixth step: exposing the upper surface of the metal post; seventh step: back grinding is performed on the substrate to expose the back of the metal pillars, thereby obtaining a TGV interposer. In the method for integrally forming and manufacturing the TGV adapter plate, an integrally formed preparation method is adopted, so that the production efficiency is improved; the glass column is well molded and is not easy to damage; can prepare the empty holes with the required aperture according to the requirement; and good bonding of the glass and the copper pillars is achieved.

title_en: Boron-containing organic compound and organic electroluminescent device prepared from same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boron-containing organic compound and an organic electroluminescent device prepared from the same, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductors. The structure of the organic compound is shown as a general formula (1), the compound has narrow half-peak width and high fluorescence quantum yield, and can be used as green light doping material of a luminescent layer of an organic electroluminescent device, thereby improving the luminescent color purity and efficiency of the device.

title_en: Mask prealignment control system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mask prealignment control system and a method, comprising the following steps: a rough adjusting light source and a fine adjusting light source, wherein the two light sources respectively emit collimated light beams with different light spot sizes, and the collimated light beams form coaxial light beams through a beam combining optical element and pass through a mask pre-alignment optical machine unit; the mask pre-alignment optical machine unit comprises a mask pre-alignment optical path, a mask plate, a mask position adjustment movement unit and a beam shaping lens group; a multi-electrode thermoelectric film position analysis unit which irradiates the multi-electrode thermoelectric film according to light beams with different spot sizes and positions to generate hot electron diffusion so as to form vectors composed of voltage values on a plurality of electrodes to calculate the spot positions; and the signal processing and control unit is used for calculating the light spot position, controlling the light source and the mask position adjusting and moving unit and realizing the control of rough adjustment and fine adjustment. The invention adopts coarse adjustment and fine adjustment modes and the intelligent positioning method of the multi-electrode large-area thermoelectric film position, thereby greatly improving the yield of the photoetching machine.

title_en: Compounds of formula (I)
abstract_en: A compound of formula (I): EAG-EDG-EAG (I) wherein EDG is an electron donating group of formula (II), each EAG is independently an electron accepting group of formula (III) (II) (III), each X is independently O or S; each Y is independently O, S, se, NR  8  Or C (R)  9  )  2  Wherein R is  8  And R is  9  Independently at each occurrence selected from H or a substituent; ar (Ar)  3  And Ar is a group  4  Independently at each occurrence a mono-or polycyclic aromatic or heteroaromatic group; r is R  1  And R is  2  Independently at each occurrence a substituent; r is R  3  ‑R  6  Each independently is H or a substituent; z is Z  1  Is a direct bond, or Z  1  And substituent R  4  Together form Ar  1  Wherein Ar is  1  Is a monocyclic or polycyclic aromatic or heteroaromatic group; z is Z  2  Is a direct bond, and is a direct bond,or Z is  2  And substituent R  5  Together form Ar  2  Wherein Ar is  2  Is a monocyclic or polycyclic aromatic or heteroaromatic group; p is 0, 1, 2 or 3; q is 0, 1, 2 or 3; r is R  10  Each occurrence is H or a substituent; -represents the connection location of the EDG; and R is  7  At each occurrence is H or a substituent, provided that at least one R  7  Is CN. The compounds of formula (I) may be used as electron acceptors in bulk heterojunction layers of organic light-responsive devices.

title_en: Device and method for preparing perovskite thin film and perovskite solar cell module
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for preparing a perovskite film and a perovskite solar cell module, and relates to the technical field of perovskite solar cells. The invention adds a heating component to the sample cabin based on the air suction and ventilation method, and compensates the problem that the temperature in the sample cabin is reduced at the moment of vacuum suction to cause the solvent to be difficult to volatilize effectively and quickly so as to remain, so that the perovskite liquid film reduces the air pressure of the residual solvent under the actions of multiple factors of air suction, ventilation and heating, the solvent is volatilized quickly and removed, the solvent residue is reduced, and the buried interface is reducedAnd the uniformity and the photoelectric property of the film are improved. The device and the method can prepare uniform, compact and nonporous perovskite thin films with large area and high quality. The perovskite solar cell module formed by the perovskite film is efficient and stable, and the quasi-steady state efficiency of the module is up to 22.4 percent (aperture area is 26.02 cm)  2  ) The world record value of the current authentication efficiency is obtained.

title_en: MEMS dry etching method and equipment and MEMS device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of micro-electro-mechanical systems, and discloses a MEMS dry etching method, equipment and an MEMS device. The method comprises the following steps: providing a wafer, wherein the wafer is provided with an adsorption surface and an etching surface, and the adsorption surface and the etching surface are a group of opposite surfaces; manufacturing an adsorption structure on the adsorption surface by using a prefabricated mask plate; the adsorption structure is matched with the lifting column pattern of the electrostatic chuck or is matched with the chuck printing pattern generated by the adsorption surface during electrostatic adsorption; controlling a lifting column of the electrostatic chuck to be in butt joint with the adsorption structure, and controlling the electrostatic chuck to adsorb the adsorption structure after the lifting column retracts to the electrostatic chuck; and performing MEMS dry etching on the etching surface. The application solves the problem of the defect of the sucker print generated on the surface of the wafer due to uneven adsorption force of the electrostatic sucker.

title_en: Window and display device including the same
abstract_en: Embodiments provide a window and a display device including the same, the window including: a base layer; a first layer disposed on the base layer; a second layer arranged on the first layerApplying; and a third layer disposed on the second layer. The second layer comprises silicon dioxide (SiO) such as fused silica  2  ) Fluorine-doped fused silica, magnesium fluoride (MgF)  2  ) Calcium fluoride (CaF)  2  ) Aluminum fluoride (AlF)  3  ) Yttrium Fluoride (YF)  3  ) Ytterbium fluoride (YbF)  3  ) Alumina (Al)  2  O  3  ) Magnesium oxide (MgO), or any combination thereof, and the second layer has a refractive index in the range of about 1.3 to about 1.6 at a wavelength of about 550 nm.

title_en: Preparation method of flexible perovskite battery
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method of a flexible perovskite battery, which improves the flatness of a flexible substrate in the film pasting process in the preparation process of the flexible perovskite battery in an electrostatic adsorption mode, thereby improving the process stability in the production process of the flexible perovskite battery and further improving the safety performance of the flexible perovskite battery and the yield of battery products; and no chemical is introduced in the preparation process, so that chemical residues are avoided, no intermediate treatment is needed in the repeated use process of the rigid substrate, and the production efficiency of the flexible perovskite battery is further improved.

title_en: SiC MOSFET device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SiC MOSFET device and a manufacturing method thereof, and relates to the technical field of semiconductor devices. The invention intermittently rotates a first conveying flat belt with a plurality of substrate grooves formed on the surface according to an array form; a plurality of substrate grooves are formed in the top end of the first conveying flat belt, the substrate grooves on the surface of the first conveying flat belt intermittently rotating below are fed through a substrate feeding cavity above, and an insulating resin substrate is put into each substrate groove on the surface of the first conveying flat belt intermittently rotating in the substrate feeding cavity.

title_en: Precise force position output device
abstract_en: The application provides a precise force position output device, and relates to the technical field of precise equipment manufacturing. The device comprises a coarse movement unit, a damping unit and a micro movement unit; the coarse movement unit comprises a coarse movement motor and a transmission sliding table, and the transmission sliding table is in transmission connection with the coarse movement motor; the damping unit comprises a first connecting piece, a second connecting piece and an elastic connecting component, and the first connecting piece is fixedly connected with the transmission sliding table; the second connecting piece is fixedly connected with the output shaft; the elastic connecting component is arranged between the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece, and the rigidity of the elastic connecting component is adjustable; the micro-motion unit comprises a micro-motion motor, and the motion precision of the micro-motion motor is higher than that of the coarse motor; the micro motor is fixedly arranged on the second connecting piece, and the rotor of the micro motor is fixedly connected with the output shaft. The device has the advantages of larger pressurizing and moving range and higher output precision, can meet the application requirements in the fields of semiconductor packaging and the like, and is suitable for processes such as flip-chip bonding and the like.

title_en: display device
abstract_en: The present application relates to a display device. The display device includes a base layer. The circuit layer is disposed on the base layer and includes at least one insulating layer and at least one transistor. The element layer is disposed on the circuit layer and includes a light emitting element and a light sensing element. The circuit layer further includes a data line connected to the light emitting element and a readout line connected to the light sensing element. The sense line outputs a sense signal in a sense section of the display device. The sense line receives a reference voltage in a non-sensing section of the display device.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a semiconductor device having a plurality of semiconductor chips
abstract_en: The present invention provides a semiconductor device, comprising: a plurality of trench portions provided on the semiconductor substrate; a mesa portion provided between the plurality of trench portions on the semiconductor substrate; and a front metal layer provided above the semiconductor substrate, the plurality of trench portions having: a gate trench portion having a gate conductive portion and a gate insulating film; and a dummy trench portion having a dummy conductive portion and a dummy insulating film, the front metal layer having: an upper side region in contact with an upper surface of the mesa portion adjacent to the dummy trench portion; and a buried region buried in the semiconductor substrate and in contact with the side wall of the mesa portion and the dummy conductive portion.

title_en: Multiple host materials, organic electroluminescent compounds, and organic electroluminescent device comprising the same
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to various host materials, organic electroluminescent compounds, and organic electroluminescent devices including the same. By including the organic electroluminescent compounds according to the present disclosure as an organic electroluminescent material, or by including a specific combination of the compounds according to the present disclosure as various host materials, an organic electroluminescent device having improved driving voltage and/or luminous efficiency can be produced.

title_en: Epoxy plastic package material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an epoxy plastic package material, which comprises the following components: an epoxy resin (A), an epoxy compound (B), a phenolic resin (C), an inorganic filler (D), a curing accelerator (E) and a silane coupling agent (F); wherein the epoxy compound (B) is an epoxy compound having a dicyclopentadiene alicyclic structure, a triazine ring structure or a sulfone group. The invention introduces the epoxy compound containing dicyclopentadiene alicyclic structure, triazine ring structure and/or sulfonyl structure into the epoxy molding compound to improveT  g  Simultaneously reducing dielectric constant and dielectric loss. In addition, the epoxy plastic packaging material provided by the invention also has good continuous formability and mechanical properties, and meets the use requirements.

title_en: Bulk tungsten ICP deep etching method, etching gas and preparation method of micromachining die
abstract_en: Bulk tungsten ICP etching method, etching gas and preparation method of micromachining die, wherein the bulk tungsten etching gas comprises SF (sulfur hexafluoride) chink  6  、O  2  And C  4  F  8  SF of each component in the bulk tungsten etching gas  6  /O  2  /C  4  F  8  The ratio of (2) is 4:1:3.O (O)  2  The addition of the metal oxide film can enhance the physical auxiliary effect on the substrate bombardment, remove the passivation layer on the surface, expose more substrate surfaces to be etched, and enable free radicals to react with the exposed substrate surfaces, which is also one reason for improving the surface quality; o (O)  2  The substrate is bombarded to generate sputtering action of the material to be etched, and a certain etching rate is increased; o (O)  2  Bombarding the surface of the substrate to increase the activity of molecules of substances and promote chemical reaction; o (O)  2  The ionization product is combined with SFx+, so that recombination of free radicals F and SFx+ is avoided, the density of the free radicals F is increased, and the chemical reaction is increased; by adjusting SF  6  、O  2  And C  4  F  8  The ratio of the two can simultaneously achieve the aim of improving the etchingThe etching rate and the etching selection ratio are improved, and the application prospect is wide.

title_en: Integrated stretchable piezoelectric film, sensor and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated stretchable piezoelectric film, a sensor and a preparation method thereof, wherein the sensor comprises an elastic composite framework with a sponge porous structure and a composite piezoelectric phase loaded in pores of the elastic composite framework; wherein the volume percentage of the elastic composite skeleton with the sponge porous structure is 5-11%, and the volume percentage of the composite piezoelectric phase is 89-95%. The components of the invention are almost piezoelectric active materials, so that almost no piezoelectric active ingredient is sacrificed in the composite material, and the piezoelectric performance and electromechanical coupling performance of the stretchable piezoelectric film can be effectively improved. The invention can be used as a core element of a stretchable sensor, and effectively improves the conversion efficiency between mechanical energy and electric energy.

title_en: Chip huge transfer equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chip huge transfer device, which relates to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing, and comprises a base and a supporting beam, wherein the supporting beam is fixedly arranged above the base, a first installation part and a second installation part which are all arranged in an extending manner along the X-axis direction are formed on the supporting beam, a wafer-puncturing mechanism is movably installed on the first installation part and can reciprocate along the X-axis direction, a wafer conveying mechanism is movably installed on the second installation part, the wafer conveying mechanism can reciprocate between a wafer-puncturing station and a wafer transfer station along the X-axis direction, a substrate conveying mechanism is installed on the base, and the substrate conveying mechanism can reciprocate between the wafer-puncturing station and a substrate taking station along the Y-axis direction. By arranging only one supporting beam on the base and integrally mounting the crystal-piercing mechanism and the wafer conveying mechanism on the supporting beam, the structure of the equipment is simplified, and the compactness and the integrity among the mechanisms are improved.

title_en: Direct bonded LED array and application
abstract_en: The application provides a direct-bonded LED array and application. An exemplary method of fabricating an LED structure includes coplanar electrical contacts for p-and n-type semiconductors of the LED structure on a planar bonding interface surface of the LED structure. Coplanar electrical contacts that planarize the bonding interface surface are directly bonded to electrical contacts of the drive circuit of the LED structure. In a wafer level process, micro-LED structures are fabricated on a first wafer, including coplanar electrical contacts for p-and n-type semiconductors of the LED structures on a planar bonding interface surface of the wafer. At least coplanar electrical contacts of the planar bonding interface are directly bonded to electrical contacts of the CMOS drive circuitry on the second wafer. The method provides a transparent and flexible micro-LED array display, each micro-LED structure having an illumination area of about the pixel size of the high resolution video display or an illumination area of about the minimum controllable element size of an image displayed on the high resolution video display.

title_en: Programmable control UV-Mask device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a programmable control UV-Mask device and a preparation method thereof, the device comprises an upper quartz platform for receiving a display panel, a plurality of black magnetic moving blocks and a carrier for supporting the upper quartz platform, wherein the upper quartz platform is arranged opposite to the carrier, a cavity is reserved between the upper quartz platform and the carrier, the black magnetic moving blocks are arranged in the cavity, the black magnetic moving blocks slide on the top of the carrier, the upper quartz platform and the carrier are provided with sealing rings for sealing the cavity, and the bottom of the carrier is provided with a magnetic distribution mechanism for controlling the black magnetic moving blocks to slide on the surface of the carrier. The UV-Mask device with programmable control is used for replacing a traditional single UV-Mask, so that the function of the UV-Mask can be flexibly programmed, adverse effects of ultraviolet light on an OLED device and an IGZO device can be effectively prevented, the UV-Mask can be replaced under the condition that a manufacturing environment is not damaged, and unnecessary manufacturing time can be saved.

title_en: Semiconductor structure, preparation method thereof and semiconductor packaging structure
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a semiconductor structure, a preparation method thereof and a semiconductor packaging structure, and relates to the technical field of semiconductors, and the semiconductor structure is used for solving the technical problem of poor contact between a conductive bump and a bonding pad of a packaging substrate.

title_en: Solar energy utilization device
abstract_en: A solar energy utilization device comprises a liquid condensing device (100), a light energy utilization device (200) and a reflection groove (300), wherein the light energy utilization device (200) is provided with a first light energy utilization part (210) and a second light energy utilization part (220), the light receiving surface of the liquid condensing device (100) is larger than the width of the first light energy utilization part (210) and/or the second light energy utilization part (220), and more sunlight can be received. The transparent liquid (130) is filled in the liquid condensing device (100), and solar light can be transmitted into the transparent liquid (130) from the light-transmitting cavity wall of the liquid condensing device (100) and forms a total reflection phenomenon. The reflective trough (300) can reflect sunlight transmitted through the liquid condensing device (100) back into the liquid condensing device (100) or onto the light energy utilization device (200). Under the combined action of the total reflection phenomenon and the reflection groove (300), more sunlight can be converged on the light energy utilization device (200), and the condensation efficiency is improved. Meanwhile, the liquid condensing device (100) is of an axisymmetric structure or a rotary structure, and can adapt to larger angular deflection of sunlight or enlarge the area of a light receiving surface, so that the liquid condensing device can be used for improving the light condensing ratio or adapting to the deflection of the sunlight in the east-west direction.

title_en: Method for producing a through-silicon-via structure and through-silicon-via structure
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method of a silicon perforation structure and the silicon perforation structure, which relate to the technical field of silicon perforation. And sequentially forming a first metal layer and a second metal layer on the surface of the first protective layer, grinding or etching the back surface of the substrate to the accommodating groove, and finally forming a solder ball on the back surface of the substrate. Compared with the prior art, in the grinding process, the second arc-shaped structure is firstly ground, so that the stress around the second metal layer at the bottom during grinding can be effectively reduced, and the problem of stress layering of the metal column and the inner wall in the prior art is avoided. Or directly adopts etching means to avoid grinding, so that the problem of stress delamination between the metal column and the inner wall in the prior art can be avoided, and the transmission performance of the second metal layer is ensured.

title_en: Ion cleaning process, coating preparation method and coating
abstract_en: The application relates to an ion cleaning process, a coating preparation method and a coating, wherein the coating is prepared by adopting the coating preparation method, and the coating preparation method comprises the step of carrying out ion cleaning on a substrate by adopting the ion cleaning process. The ion cleaning process comprises the following steps: loading a substrate on a workpiece holder and placing the substrate and the workpiece holder in a cleaning chamber; vacuumizing the cleaning cavity; heating the substrate; pulse etching: introducing inert gas into the cleaning cavity, and applying pulse bias voltage on the workpiece frame so as to enable the inert gas and the base material to be subjected to glow discharge; ion etching: introducing inert gas into the cleaning cavity, and applying bias voltage and an electromagnetic field; wherein the pulse etching is alternately performed with the ion etching. The application improves the cleaning effect of the base material, and simultaneously has simpler process and lower cost.

title_en: Wafer-level chip size packaging method and structure
abstract_en: A wafer-level chip size packaging method and structure, wherein the method comprises the following steps: providing a wafer, wherein the wafer comprises a device area and a plurality of marking areas, the device area is internally provided with a plurality of chip areas, and the surface of each chip area is provided with a welding plate; forming a first insulating layer, wherein the first insulating layer is internally provided with a first opening exposing the surface of the welding plate; forming a first electroplating seed layer in the first opening and on the first insulating layer on the chip area, and forming a first auxiliary electroplating seed layer on the first insulating layer on the mark area; a first metal layer is formed on the first plating seed layer, and a first auxiliary metal layer is formed on the first auxiliary plating seed layer. The first auxiliary electroplating seed layer is utilized to disperse current in the first electroplating process, so that the thickness of the first metal layer on the chip area in the device area adjacent to the mark area is reduced, the gap between the second metal layer and the screen plate is effectively increased, the contact between the screen plate and the second metal layer is reduced, and the process risk of fracturing the chip area is further caused.

title_en: Superconducting bump joint
abstract_en: Superconducting bump joints are disclosed. The present disclosure provides an apparatus (100), the apparatus (100) comprising: a first chip (104), the first chip (104) comprising a first circuit element (112), a first interconnect pad (116) in electrical contact (118) with the first circuit element, and a barrier layer (120) on the first interconnect pad; a superconducting bump bond (106) on the barrier layer; and a second chip (102), the second chip (102) being joined to the first chip by the superconducting bump bond, the second chip having a first quantum circuit element (108), wherein the superconducting bump bond provides an electrical connection between the first circuit element and the first quantum circuit element.

title_en: Enhancement mode HEMT device of heterogeneous pn junction grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enhanced HEMT device of a heterogeneous pn junction grid, which comprises a substrate, a buffer layer, a channel layer and a barrier layer, wherein the buffer layer, the channel layer and the barrier layer are sequentially laminated on the substrate; the gate electrode includes a p-type semiconductor layer and an n-type semiconductor layer sequentially stacked on the barrier layer, the p-type semiconductor layer and the n-type semiconductor layer forming a hetero pn junction. According to the invention, the heterogeneous pn junction grid electrode is formed, so that the voltage resistance of the grid electrode is improved, and the grid leakage current is reduced.

title_en: Manufacturing method of electronic device for reducing substrate warpage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of an electronic device for reducing substrate warpage, which comprises the steps of providing a substrate, providing an intermediate layer on the substrate, and providing an insulating layer on the intermediate layer. The substrate includes an active region and a peripheral region, wherein the peripheral region is adjacent to the active region, and a ratio of a range of the active region to an area of the substrate surface is between 75% and 92%. The insulating layer comprises a first surface and at least one bevel edge. The first surface of the insulating layer is correspondingly arranged in the active region, the at least one bevel edge is correspondingly arranged in the peripheral region, and a first angle is formed between the at least one bevel edge and the surface of the substrate.

title_en: MOS transistor capable of reducing tunneling leakage current
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MOS transistor capable of reducing tunneling leakage current, which comprises a main body and a metal outer reinforcement sleeve, wherein a G grid is arranged at the middle position of the top end inside the main body. According to the invention, the first pins and the like are arranged, so that when the transistor product is used, on one hand, the first pins connected with the G grid electrode, the S source electrode and the D drain electrode are arranged on the main body, and the two substrate electrodes are additionally arranged on the substrate part of the main body and the second pins are led out, so that an N-channel enhanced MOS transistor is formed on the main body, forward voltage is added between the drain electrode and the source electrode, tunneling leakage current can be reduced, and on the other hand, the second doping region and the first doping region are arranged on the main body, and the doping position is comprehensively fixed through the arrangement of the two-stage doping region structure, so that the performance of the MOS transistor is more stable, and the leakage current phenomenon of the MOS transistor is reduced.

title_en: Single-chip perovskite light-emitting diode with multicolor luminous center for co-electroluminescence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-chip perovskite light-emitting diode with multicolor luminous centers for co-electroluminescence. The invention uses standard red, green and blue perovskite luminophors as luminescent layers respectively to form independent multicolor luminescent centers, and then uses a multi-layer structure intermediate connecting layer to connect each luminescent center in series to form a single-chip cascade device with two-color or three-color luminescent centers, wherein the ICL layer is composed of N-type and P-type semiconductors. Under the drive of external forward voltage, charge generation interfaces in the intermediate connecting layer generate carriers, the carriers are transmitted through the carrier transmission layer and distributed to different luminous centers, the carriers are combined with injected carriers from the electrodes to emit light, and finally, the common electroluminescence of the different luminous centers is realized.

title_en: Silicon rod detection system and detection method
abstract_en: The application discloses a silicon rod detecting system and a detecting method, wherein the system comprises a frame, a supporting rotating device, a triaxial linear motion module, a detecting device and a control module. The silicon rod detection system integrates the detection function of three dimensions (size, defect and electrical property) of the silicon rod, can automatically detect the silicon rod in all dimensions and angles, segments and rates the silicon rod after comprehensively analyzing various detection results, avoids human errors caused by segment rating of the silicon rod by detection workers according to few detection indexes and experiences, and improves the segment rating precision of the silicon rod. When the subsequent scribing and cutting process is guided, the scribing position precision is higher, the quality level of the cut silicon rod section is more stable, the back cutting of the silicon rod can be greatly reduced or even avoided, and the production efficiency is improved; in addition, the problem of overlong or too short cutting of the silicon rod caused by inaccurate scribing can be avoided, and the waste of silicon rod materials is reduced.

title_en: Double-sided brushing device for wafer processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wafer brushing, in particular to a double-sided brushing device for wafer processing, which comprises a base, wherein the upper end surface of the base is fixedly connected with a supporting frame, and the double-sided brushing device further comprises: the limiting mechanism is arranged on the base to limit the position of the wafer; the brushing mechanism is arranged on the support frame to clean the surface of the wafer; in the scheme, the wafer is driven to rotate through the characteristics of the wafer-shaped appearance, the two rotating working surfaces of the wafer are simultaneously cleaned through the brushing mechanism, and finally the cleaning water on the surface is thrown away through the rotation of the wafer, so that the wafer is brushed on the two surfaces of the wafer efficiently and sufficiently.

title_en: Substrate supporting module and substrate processing apparatus including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a substrate support module and a substrate processing apparatus including the same. The invention discloses a substrate support module for supporting a substrate, comprising: a bottom plate; a first substrate support section including a first substrate support plate movable on the base plate and a plurality of first substrate support pins arranged on the first substrate support plate; a second substrate support section including a second substrate support plate movable on the base plate and a plurality of second substrate support pins arranged on the second substrate support plate; a driving part for independently moving the first substrate supporting part and the second substrate supporting part; wherein the first substrate support pins and the second substrate support pins are aligned with each other when the first substrate support plate and the second substrate support plate are adjacent.

title_en: Semiconductor package of camera module
abstract_en: A semiconductor package, which is a wafer-level chip-scale package type semiconductor package having a plurality of terminals, wherein the semiconductor package has a planar appearance of an elongated rectangular shape, the plurality of terminals are configured of 2 columns arranged along a short side direction of the semiconductor package, and each of the terminals includes a circular main body portion and a convex portion of a shape protruding outward from the main body portion.

title_en: Electrostatic protection circuit and semiconductor chip
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses an electrostatic protection circuit and semiconductor chip, the electrostatic protection circuit connects first voltage end and second voltage end, the electrostatic protection circuit includes: a first detection circuit, a control circuit and a bleeder transistor connected between the first voltage terminal and the second voltage terminal; the first detection circuit outputs a first detection signal to the control circuit within a first preset time period when electrostatic charges appear on the first voltage end; the control circuit drives the bleeder transistor to bleeder static charge under the control of the first detection signal; the electrostatic protection circuit further comprises a turn-off circuit connected between the first voltage end and the second voltage end, wherein the output end of the turn-off circuit is connected with the control end of the bleeder transistor and is used for outputting a control signal after a second preset time period of electrostatic charge appears on the first voltage end so as to turn off the bleeder transistor; the second preset time period is longer than or equal to the first preset time period.

title_en: Substrate transfer system and method of using the same
abstract_en: Systems and methods related to a transfer chamber for an electronic device processing system are disclosed herein. The transfer chamber includes a magnetically levitated platform having: a magnetically levitated track disposed along the length of the transport chamber and configured to generate a magnetic field above the track. The transfer chamber also includes: the magnetic levitation track is disposed along the width of the transport chamber such that the plane of the transverse track intersects the plane of the longitudinal track at a junction. The transverse rail is configured to generate a magnetic field above or below the rail. The platform further comprises: at least one substrate carrier is configured to move along the longitudinal track and the transverse track. The substrate carrier is also configured to rotate at the interface.

title_en: Dicing equipment for semiconductor wafer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semiconductor wafer dicing device which comprises a lathe bed part, a processing assembly, an image recognition system and a processing platform device, wherein the lathe bed part is provided with the processing platform device, the upper end of the lathe bed part is connected with the processing assembly, and the processing assembly is connected with the image recognition system. The invention solves the problems of low precision, large positioning precision error, inaccurate height measurement, spindle shaft vibration and the like of the conventional cutting equipment.

title_en: Light-emitting diode chip, manufacturing method thereof and display panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light emitting diode chip, a manufacturing method thereof and a display panel. The light emitting diode chip comprises a first light emitting unit, a second light emitting unit and a first isolation structure arranged between the first light emitting unit and the second light emitting unit; the first light emitting unit comprises a first N-type semiconductor layer, a first light emitting layer and a first P-type semiconductor layer which are stacked; the second light emitting unit comprises a second N-type semiconductor layer, a second light emitting layer and a second P-type semiconductor layer which are stacked; the first isolation structure comprises a first isolation N-type semiconductor layer and a first isolation P-type semiconductor layer which are stacked; the first isolated P-type semiconductor layer is disposed on the first N-type semiconductor layer, and the second P-type semiconductor layer is disposed on the first isolated N-type semiconductor layer. The light emission control of the light emitting diode chip can be improved. Meanwhile, the number of bonding processes can be reduced, and the yield of the display panel is improved.

title_en: Light-emitting diode packaging structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light-emitting diode packaging structure, and relates to the technical field of light-emitting diodes. The invention comprises a base, wherein an inner core is arranged at the top of the base, pins of the inner core penetrate through the base, an inner transparent diaphragm and a circular epoxy resin lens are arranged at the top of the base, the inner transparent diaphragm is sleeved on the outer side of the inner core, the circular epoxy resin lens is sleeved on the outer side of the inner transparent diaphragm, a liquid inlet pipe and an air inlet pipe are arranged at the bottom of the base, cooling liquid is filled between the inner transparent diaphragm and the circular epoxy resin lens, oblique edges are arranged at the bottoms of the inner transparent diaphragm and the circular epoxy resin lens, and a puncture needle is connected to the top of the base in a sliding mode. According to the invention, the packaging position of the puncture needle is thinner, the round epoxy resin lens can be detached from the base only by pushing the puncture needle in the later stage, the maintenance can be carried out on the internal semiconductor element, and the glue dispensing packaging is carried out again after the maintenance is finished, so that the use cost is low.

title_en: Copper alloy material with excellent punching performance and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nonferrous metal materials, and particularly relates to a copper alloy material with excellent punching performance, and a preparation method and application thereof. The copper alloy comprises the following components: 1.5 to 3.5 weight percent of Ni, 0.8 to 1.2 weight percent of Co, 0.3 to 0.7 weight percent of Si, and the balance of Cu and unavoidable impurities; the longitudinal section texture of the copper alloy comprises the following components in percentage by area: the Brass texture, the Copper texture and the S texture=85-90%, the Cube texture is less than 10%, and the rest is other textures. The average grain size of the copper alloy material disclosed by the invention is 30-100 mu m, the grain size variance value is less than 200, the yield ratio of the alloy is 0.7-1, the strength-plastic product of the alloy is more than or equal to 2.0GPa%, and the copper alloy material has good punching performance.

title_en: Detection equipment and detection method of high-performance sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection device and a detection method of a high-performance sensor, which are applied to the field of sensor detection, wherein a jig plate has a turnover automatic discharging function, and is matched with the design of an embedded groove, so that a wiring terminal can fall off from the embedded groove by utilizing self gravity after the photoelectric sensor falls off in the jig.

title_en: Light double-sided photovoltaic power generation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light double-sided photovoltaic power generation device, which comprises: the double-glass assembly is provided with a first through hole; the surrounding frame is arranged outside the double-glass assembly in a surrounding mode and comprises a frame section bar, the frame section bar is an assembly groove, a second through hole is formed in the assembly groove, and the second through hole is communicated with the first through hole; and the curing connecting piece is formed by curing a liquid material and comprises connecting columns filled in the first through holes and the second through holes. In this two-sided photovoltaic power generation device of light, the assembly groove structure is selected for use to the frame section bar to reduce production material quantity, thereby weight reduction, convenient transportation installation, simultaneously, through first through-hole and second through-hole intercommunication, conveniently pour into curable liquid into with solidification form the spliced pole with two glass subassembly and frame section bar fixed connection, the spliced pole can pass through the bolt, conveniently with device fixed mounting on the photovoltaic support.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a preparation method of a semiconductor structure, which comprises the following steps: providing a substrate; forming a first doped region and a second doped region in a substrate; forming a first grid electrode and a second grid electrode on the substrate, wherein the first grid electrode is overlapped with the first doping region, the second grid electrode is overlapped with the second doping region, the first grid electrode extends along a first direction, the second grid electrode extends along a second direction, and the first direction is perpendicular to the second direction; and performing ion implantation on the first doped region and the second doped region, forming a first implanted region in the first doped region, and forming a second implanted region in the second doped region, wherein the doping concentration of the first implanted region is smaller than that of the second implanted region. The semiconductor structure utilizes the vertical layout of the first grid electrode and the second grid electrode, the doping concentration of the formed first injection region is smaller than that of the second injection region formed in the corresponding region of the second grid electrode in the same step, and further, the on-state current of the formed transistor is different, and the stability of the semiconductor structure is improved.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The application provides a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises a first display area and a second display area, the light transmittance of the first display is larger than that of the second display area, and the display panel further comprises a substrate, an inorganic insulating layer, an organic insulating layer and a light-emitting layer which are arranged in a laminated mode; the inorganic insulating layer includes a first inorganic insulating sub-layer having a refractive index less than that of the substrate and less than that of the organic insulating layer. This application stacks the mechanism through setting up the rete that the refracting index is different to improve the light transmissivity, and then improve display panel's imaging.

title_en: Light-emitting panel, preparation method thereof and light-emitting device
abstract_en: A light emitting panel comprising: a display area (AA) and a peripheral area (BB) located on at least one side of the display area (AA). The display area (AA) is provided with at least one light-emitting element (10). The light-emitting element (10) comprises: a first electrode (101), a second electrode (102), and an organic light-emitting layer (103) disposed between the first electrode (101) and the second electrode (102). In a direction perpendicular to the light emitting panel, the light emitting panel includes at least: a substrate (200), and a first conductive layer (21) and a second conductive layer (22) on the substrate (200). The first conductive layer (21) comprises at least one first signal trace (11). The second conductive layer (22) includes a first electrode (101) of the light emitting element (10). The first conductive layer (21) is in direct contact with the second conductive layer (22), and the first electrode (101) of the light emitting element (10) is connected to the first signal wiring (11).

title_en: Chemical vapor deposition preparation of two-dimensional Bi 3 O 2.5 Se 2 Method for forming semiconductor thin film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing two-dimensional Bi by chemical vapor deposition  3  O  2.5  Se  2  A method for preparing a semiconductor film belongs to the field of two-dimensional semiconductor materials. The method comprises the following steps: adopting Se sources (simple substance Se powder) and different Bi sources (bismuth subcarbonate, bismuth citrate, bismuth simple substance, bismuth acetate, bismuth nitrate and bismuth hydroxide) as precursors, sequentially placing the two precursors at the center of a tube furnace, taking argon as carrier gas, and completing chemical vapor deposition on a mica substrate under the assistance of trace oxygen or hydrogen to obtain the novel ultrathin Bi  3  O  2.5  Se  2  A semiconductor thin film. The synthesis method is simple, reliable and economic, and can obtain high-quality two-dimensional Bi with controllable thickness  3  O  2.5  Se  2  The single crystal has larger band gap (about 1.2 eV), ultrahigh electron mobility and excellent air stability, can be used for preparing high-performance transistor devices, photoelectric devices, photovoltaic devices, synaptic transistor devices and the like, and has important research and application values in the field of microelectronic devices.

title_en: Multi-junction solar cell structure
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-junction solar cell structure comprising a substrate and a plurality of subcells stacked on the substrate, the plurality of subcells comprising InGaAs subcells comprising In disposed In a direction away from the substrate  j  GaAs base region and In  j  GaAs emitter and In  j  GaAs base region and In  j  Multiple quantum well structure between GaAs emission regions, the multiple quantum well structure including In alternately laminated  x  GaAs potential well layer and In  k  GaAsP  y  A barrier layer formed by forming a film on In  j  GaAs base region and In  j  The undoped layer is arranged on at least one side of the whole multi-quantum well structure between the GaAs emitting areas, so that In can be reduced  j  GaAs base region and In  j  Doping atoms in at least one of the GaAs emission regions are diffused into the multi-quantum well structure, so that the light absorption effect of the multi-quantum well structure is improved.

title_en: Fluorescent powder, optical anti-counterfeiting method, LED lamp and application thereof in plant growth illumination
abstract_en: The invention provides fluorescent powder, an optical anti-counterfeiting method, an LED lamp and application thereof in plant growth illumination, wherein the chemical formula is Mg  2‑2x  La  8  (SiO  4  )  6  O  2  :2xEu  2+/3+  。Mg  2‑2x  La  8  (SiO  4  )  6  O  2  :2xEu  2+/3+  The anti-counterfeiting pattern has three excitation wavelengths, so that light with the three excitation wavelengths is allowed to irradiate the anti-counterfeiting pattern respectively, verification results are obtained respectively, and the authenticity of the anti-counterfeiting pattern can be ensured only when the three verification results are successful, so that the counterfeiting difficulty of the anti-counterfeiting pattern is greatly increased, and the authenticity and reliability of the anti-counterfeiting pattern are improved. By Mg  2‑2x  La  8  (SiO  4  )  6  O  2  :2xEu  2+/3+  The prepared LED lamp can emit illumination required by plant growth, so that photosynthesis of plants is promoted at night, and the LED lamp can be widely applied to the field of crop growth.

title_en: Solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a solar cell and a preparation method thereof. The first transparent conductive layer is arranged on one side of the backlight surface of the substrate; the anti-reflection layer is arranged on one side of the first transparent conducting layer, which is away from the substrate; the bus layer is arranged on one side of the antireflection layer, which is away from the first transparent conductive layer, and is provided with a convex block protruding towards one side of the first transparent conductive layer along the thickness direction of the solar cell, and the convex block passes through the antireflection layer and is electrically contacted with the first transparent conductive layer. The back light surface of the solar cell in the application does not need to be additionally provided with the grid line which is connected with the first transparent conducting layer and is prepared by silver paste, the processing technology of the back surface of the whole cell is simpler, mass production is easy, the dosage of the silver paste can be reduced, the manufacturing cost of the whole solar cell is lower, the optical loss of the whole cell is smaller, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Organic compound containing boron and nitrogen and application thereof in organic electroluminescent device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boron-nitrogen-containing organic compound and application thereof in an organic electroluminescent device, wherein the structure of the boron-nitrogen-containing organic compound is shown as a general formula 1. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, through specific molecular structure design, X in the framework shown in the general formula 1  1  ～X  6  At least two of the points are nitrogen atoms, namely, the nitrogen atoms are introduced in meta positions of the boron atoms, and the nitrogen atoms have stronger electron withdrawing capability compared with carbon atoms, so that the electron withdrawing capability of the boron atoms can be enhanced, the electron distribution of the boron atoms is reduced, and the boron-nitrogen-containing material is enhancedThe rate of converting triplet state excitons of organic compound molecules into singlet state excitons shortens the service life of the triplet state excitons, and further can improve the luminous efficiency and the service life of the organic electroluminescent device; meanwhile, the emission wavelength of triplet excitons can be shifted to a short wavelength, and deep blue light emission of organic electroluminescence can be realized.

title_en: Amorphous gallium oxide nano-sheet, UV-Vis-NIR wide-spectrum photoelectric detector and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention provides an amorphous gallium oxide nano-sheet, a preparation method thereof and a UV-Vis-NIR wide-spectrum photoelectric detector. The amorphous gallium oxide nano-sheet prepared by the method is nano-sheet with the size of about a few micrometers and the thickness of about 10-40 nm. The amorphous gallium oxide nano-sheet is an amorphous nano-sheet with low duty ratio tetrahedral center Ga, and has the performance advantages of wide spectrum absorption and spin polarization. The amorphous gallium oxide nano-sheet, the conductive silicon chip and the graphene are assembled into the photoelectric detector with the vertical structure, and a pair of back-to-back rectifying junctions formed by the Schottky junctions and the p-n junctions in series connection are formed, so that the photoelectric detector has lower dark current. The photodetector with a vertical structure based on the amorphous gallium oxide shows excellent UV-Vis-NIR broad spectrum photodetection performance.

title_en: Semiconductor package
abstract_en: A semiconductor package is provided. The semiconductor package includes: a redistribution line structure including a plurality of redistribution line patterns; a first semiconductor chip and a second semiconductor chip on the redistribution line structure and spaced apart from each other; a bridge structure between the first semiconductor chip, the second semiconductor chip, and the redistribution line structure, and including a plurality of connection wiring patterns configured to electrically connect the first semiconductor chip to the second semiconductor chip; and a molding layer surrounding the sidewalls of the bridge structures and filled between the first semiconductor chip, the second semiconductor chip, and the redistribution line structure, and between the first semiconductor chip and the second semiconductor chip, wherein a lowermost surface of the plurality of connection wiring patterns is above an uppermost surface of the plurality of redistribution line patterns.

title_en: Conformal deposition of silicon carbide films using heterogeneous precursor interactions
abstract_en: The doped or undoped silicon carbide film may be deposited using a remote plasma Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) technique. One or more silicon-containing precursors are provided to a reaction chamber. Radical species, such as hydrogen, are provided in a substantially low energy or ground state and interact with one or more silicon-containing precursors to deposit a silicon carbide film. The co-reactant may be flowed with one or more silicon-containing precursors, where the co-reactant may be a deposition additive or a non-deposition additive to improve step coverage of the silicon carbide film.

title_en: Resin composition for sealing semiconductor and semiconductor device
abstract_en: The resin composition for sealing a semiconductor comprises an epoxy resin (A), a curing agent (B) comprising a phenolic resin (B1) and an active ester resin (B2), and a curing accelerator (C), wherein the active ester resin (B2) has a structure represented by the general formula (1), and the curing accelerator (C) contains 1 or more than 2 selected from tetraphenylphosphonium-4, 4' -sulfonyldiphenolate, tetraphenylphosphonium bis (naphthalene-2, 3-dioxy) phenylsilicate and 4-hydroxy-2- (triphenylphosphonium) phenolate.

title_en: Anti-disassembling chip and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of semiconductors and discloses an anti-disassembly chip which comprises a substrate, a wafer and an anti-disassembly component. The front surface of the substrate is provided with a plurality of first pins; the chip is provided with a tamper-proof signal pin and is arranged on the front surface of the substrate; the anti-disassembly component comprises a plurality of leads, a plurality of first pins are connected in series through the plurality of leads to form a series circuit, and part of the leads are provided with an anti-disassembly protection layer above the wafer; the first end of the serial circuit is used for supplying power, and the anti-dismantling signal pins are connected in series to the serial circuit; or the first end of the serial circuit is used for supplying power, and the second end of the serial circuit is led out to the edge of the substrate so as to be led out to the outside of the chip and used for being connected with an external anti-disassembly component. Therefore, the corresponding anti-disassembly structure is arranged inside the chip, so that the safety of the chip can be further improved. The application also discloses electronic equipment.

title_en: Memory system, semiconductor device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: Aspects of the present disclosure provide a semiconductor device. The semiconductor device includes a stacked body of conductive layers and insulating layers alternately stacked in a first direction. The stack of conductive layers and insulating layers has a first face and a second face in a first direction. The semiconductor device includes a semiconductor layer on a first side of the stack of conductive and insulating layers; and a first isolation structure extending in a first direction through the semiconductor layer and a subset of the stack of conductive and insulating layers. A subset of the stack of conductive layers and insulating layers includes a first conductive layer. The first isolation structure separates a first portion of the first conductive layer from a second portion of the first conductive layer.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: A display panel and a display device relate to the technical field of display. The display area of the display panel comprises a main display area and a secondary display area, the drive backboard of the display panel comprises a substrate, a plurality of pixel circuits and a first power bus connected with a second electrode, and a first electrode is connected with a pixel circuit. The driving backboard comprises a substrate and a plurality of circuit units, wherein the circuit units comprise two pixel circuits distributed along the row direction, the light emitting device comprises a first electrode, a light emitting layer and a second electrode, one first electrode is connected with one pixel circuit, the line group comprises two data lines distributed along the row direction, the two data lines of one line group are respectively connected with two columns of pixel circuits of one column of circuit unit, each data line comprises a plurality of first data lines and second data lines, the first data lines extend from a main display area to an extraction area, the second data lines are positioned in a secondary display area, the power lines extend from the display area to the extraction area along the column direction, and the two columns of pixel circuits of one column of circuit unit are connected with one power line.

title_en: HEMT device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a HEMT device and a manufacturing method thereof, the device comprises a semiconductor layer, at least one grid structure, a first insulating layer, a point-shaped drain electrode contact through hole, an annular source electrode contact through hole, a drain electrode ohmic contact metal layer and a source electrode ohmic contact metal layer, wherein the grid structure is divided into a grid converging region, four grid ring regions and four connecting regions, the four grid ring regions are uniformly distributed around the grid converging region, and each grid ring region is connected with the grid converging region through a connected region. In the invention, the gate control unit adopts an annular cell structure, so that a small series resistance of the source and the drain can be realized, and the optimization of the area occupation ratio of the active region can be realized by matching with a double-layer interconnection technology, thereby effectively improving the current density of the device. In addition, the four gate control units are uniformly distributed around one gate bus area, and the four-in-one functional unit is more flexible and changeable compared with an interdigital structure when the device is integrally laid out, so that the efficiency of layout design is improved.

title_en: Semiconductor module
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor module, which comprises a semiconductor device and a bus bar. The semiconductor device includes an insulating substrate, a conductive member, a plurality of switching elements, a first input terminal, and a second input terminal. The insulating substrate has a main surface and a rear surface facing opposite sides to each other in the thickness direction. The conductive member is disposed on the main surface. The plurality of switching elements are joined to the conductive member in a conductive state. The first input terminal has a first terminal portion and is joined to the conductive member in a conductive state. The second input terminal has a second terminal portion overlapping the first terminal portion as viewed in the thickness direction and is conductive with the plurality of switching elements. The second input terminal is disposed apart from both the first input terminal and the conductive member in the thickness direction. The bus bar includes a first supply terminal and a second supply terminal. The first supply terminal is connected to the first terminal portion in a conductive state. The second supply terminal is connected to the second terminal portion in a conductive state.

title_en: Method for improving isolated line process window in dense isolated line transition region
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving an isolated line process window in a dense and isolated line transition region, which is used for obtaining a pattern of a target correction region, wherein the pattern of the target correction region comprises the following steps: at least one isolated line, at least one group of dense lines which are close to the isolated line and end parts are head-to-head, the length between the end parts of the dense lines is not more than the length of the isolated line, and a transition area exists from the dense line to the isolated line; acquiring a first corrected graph of the target graph, and judging whether a process window of the corrected isolated line accords with a preset value or not; if so, taking the first correction pattern as a final correction pattern of the target pattern; if not, extending the line ends of the first correction patterns of the dense lines to obtain final correction patterns with the second correction patterns as target patterns, wherein the exposed outline of each second correction pattern on the wafer approaches to the target pattern. The invention can solve the problems of small process window and easy wire breakage of isolated lines in the transition region.

title_en: Method for preparing perovskite battery fullerene electron transport layer and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a method for preparing a perovskite battery fullerene electron transport layer and application thereof, wherein the perovskite battery comprises a substrate and a perovskite layer formed on the substrate, and the method comprises the following steps: evaporating fullerene materials on the perovskite layer to form a fullerene contact film layer; cooling the substrate after forming the fullerene contact film layer; the method can reduce the distance between the substrate and the evaporation source, improve the utilization rate of the fullerene material, cool the substrate after the fullerene contact film is formed, and solve the problem of poor film quality caused by thermal effect generated by the reduction of the distance between the substrate after the fullerene contact film is formed and the evaporation source.

title_en: Self-powered human body thermal radiation detection photoelectric detection device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-powered human body thermal radiation detection photoelectric detection device and a preparation method thereof.
