The method comprises the following steps: si is selected as a substrate; VO deposition using radio frequency magnetron sputtering technique  2  A semiconductor thin film; at VO  2  Depositing an ITO top electrode layer on the surface of the film; spin-coating an In electrode on the back of the Si substrate; based on the photo-thermal electric effect of high-efficiency energy conversion, the device has obvious self-driven optical response to 355nm-1550nm wavelength range and has excellent capability of detecting human body heat radiation. The photoelectric detection device has the advantages of wide spectral response, high response speed, good period stability and the like; the preparation process is simple, nontoxic and pollution-free, has higher product quality, is suitable for large-scale industrial production, and has great application prospect in the field of high-performance photoelectric detection devices.

title_en: Light emitting device and electronic apparatus including the same
abstract_en: The present application relates to a light emitting device and a display apparatus including the same. The light emitting device includes a first electrode, a second electrode facing the first electrode, an emission layer between the first electrode and the second electrode, and an electron transport region between the emission layer and the second electrode, wherein the electron transport region includes an electron injection layer including a first material and a second material each independently including an alkali metal, an alkaline earth metal, a transition metal, a post-transition metal, a lanthanide metal, or a combination thereof, the second material does not include Mg, the first material and the second material are different from each other, and a surface energy of the second material is greater than a surface energy of the first material.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent compound, organic electroluminescent material containing double bodies and organic electroluminescent device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic electroluminescent materials, and provides an organic electroluminescent compound, a double-body-containing organic electroluminescent material and an organic electroluminescent device, wherein the double-body-containing organic electroluminescent material comprises an organic electroluminescent compound LA and an organic electroluminescent compound LB, the mass ratio of LA to LB is 1:99-99:1, and the structural general formulas of LA and LB are shown in the specification. The invention not only obviously reduces the driving voltage, but also obviously improves the current efficiency and the service life of the light-emitting device made by specific heterocyclic combination and specific position deuteration.

title_en: MoxSiyNzOw film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides MoxSiyNzOw films, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of precision optical elements. The preparation method of MoxSiyNzOw film provided by the invention comprises the following steps: and adopting a Mo target and a Si target, and alternately sputtering a Mo layer and a Si layer on the substrate by utilizing a reactive magnetron sputtering technology to obtain the MoxSiyNzOw film. The invention utilizes reactive magnetron sputtering to plate an ultrathin Mo/Si multilayer film and utilizes mutual diffusion among film layers to obtain MoxSiyNzOw film.

title_en: Preparation method of soft and fast recovery FRD diode chip
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soft fast recovery diode chips, in particular to a preparation method of a soft fast recovery FRD diode chip, which comprises a diffusion process and a GPP process and is characterized in that the diffusion process comprises the following steps: step one, diffusion pretreatment; step two, phosphorus expansion treatment: performing diffusion treatment on the N surface of the silicon wafer treated in the first step, performing primary diffusion by adopting low-concentration phosphor paper, and performing secondary diffusion by adopting normal-concentration phosphor paper; step three, blowing sand once; step four, boron expansion treatment; step five, secondary sand blowing: and when the diffusion process is completed, the chip manufactured by the silicon chip can obtain higher reverse breakdown voltage under the condition that the forward voltage is not remarkably increased, the newly added base region N is higher than the impurity concentration of the original base region N  ‑  by adopting a double-base region diffusion process, and when reverse bias voltage is applied, the time for extracting carriers is prolonged, namely the tb value is increased, the softness factor S value is increased to about 0.65, and the softness of the diode is effectively improved.

title_en: VDMOS structure with low on-resistance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power semiconductor devices, in particular to a VDMOS structure with low on resistance, which comprises a drain electrode, a substrate, a drift region, a base region, a source region, a contact region, a grid electrode, a grid oxide layer and a source electrode, wherein a doped region is arranged in the drift region, the components of the doped region are the same as those of the source region, and the doped region is positioned under the grid oxide layer and is in close contact with the grid oxide layer; the thickness of the gate oxide layer between the gate and the doped region is positively correlated with the concentration of the doping impurities of the doped region. When the VDMOS works, carriers in the doped region can supplement carriers in the channel region to reduce the carrier concentration difference between the channel region and the neck region, so that the effect of reducing the on-resistance of the device is achieved, and the thickness of a gate oxide layer between the gate and the doped region is increased, so that the breakdown voltage can be kept unchanged, and the safety of the VDMOS in application is ensured.

title_en: Thermal conductivity-based thermal test chip and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thermal conductivity-based thermal test chip and a preparation method thereof, wherein the thermal conductivity-based thermal test chip comprises a pretreatment substrate, the pretreatment substrate comprises a substrate, a plurality of P-type areas are distributed in the substrate at intervals, N-type areas are arranged in the P-type areas positioned in a central area, two P+ ohmic contacts arranged at intervals are arranged in each P-type area, and two N+ ohmic contacts arranged at intervals are arranged in the N-type areas; a first metal layer and silicon dioxide are arranged on the pretreatment substrate at intervals, a second metal layer is arranged on the silicon dioxide, a silicon nitride layer and a third metal layer are arranged on the second metal layer, a plurality of lower injection grooves are formed in the back surface of the pretreatment substrate, the bottoms of the lower injection grooves are communicated with the corresponding second metal layer, polysilicon is arranged in the lower injection grooves, and the notch of each lower injection groove is covered with a fourth metal layer; thermal conductivity testing of Thermal Interface Materials (TIMs) is performed through the structural design of thermal conductivity-based thermal test chips to simulate a real environment.

title_en: Pixel structure and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a pixel structure and a display device, and belongs to the technical field of display. The pixel structure comprises a substrate, a first conductive layer, a first insulating layer, a second conductive layer, a second insulating layer and a light-emitting element; the substrate, the first conductive layer, the first insulating layer, the second conductive layer and the second insulating layer are sequentially stacked and arranged; the first conductive layer comprises a driving circuit and a grounding circuit; the second conductive layer comprises a light-emitting element bonding pad and a control bonding pad, the orthographic projection position of the light-emitting element bonding pad is opposite to the orthographic projection position of the driving circuit along the thickness direction of the substrate, the light-emitting element bonding pad is respectively and electrically connected with the driving circuit and the control bonding pad, and the control bonding pad is electrically connected with the grounding circuit; the second insulating layer is provided with an opening, at least one part of the light-emitting element is positioned in the opening, and the light-emitting element is electrically connected with the light-emitting element bonding pad. By adopting the method and the device, the possibility of corrosion and the corrosion degree of the pixel structure are reduced, so that the reliability of the pixel structure is improved.

title_en: Double-end perovskite crystal silicon laminated battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-end perovskite crystal silicon laminated cell and a preparation method thereof, which are applied to the technical field of perovskite solar cells and comprise a perovskite crystal silicon laminated cell and a near infrared light conversion layer; the perovskite crystal silicon laminated cell comprises a laminated cell piece, wherein the laminated cell piece comprises a perovskite cell structure for absorbing visible light and a crystal silicon cell structure for absorbing near infrared light; the surface of the light incidence side of the perovskite crystal silicon laminated cell is provided with a near infrared light conversion layer, and the near infrared light conversion layer is a down conversion film. Short waves in sunlight are converted into long waves through the near infrared light conversion layer, so that the problem of current mismatch caused by the double-end perovskite crystal silicon laminated battery under the illumination condition of high visible light ratio is solved, and the double-end perovskite crystal silicon laminated battery has high performance.

title_en: Back contact solar cell, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the field of photovoltaics, and provides a back contact solar cell, a preparation method thereof and a photovoltaic module, wherein the back contact solar cell comprises a substrate, a first doping region, a second doping region and a spacing region; the semiconductor device comprises a first doped semiconductor layer positioned on a corresponding first doped region, a second doped semiconductor layer positioned on a corresponding second doped region, a conductive layer positioned on a partial region of a spacing region and having a second doped element with a conductivity type different from that of the first doped element, a passivation layer covering the first doped semiconductor layer, the second doped semiconductor layer, the conductive layer and the spacing region, a first electrode in electrical contact with the first doped semiconductor layer, and a second electrode in electrical contact with the second doped semiconductor layer.

title_en: Resin Sheet
abstract_en: The invention provides a resin sheet which ensures the adhesion of a thermo-compression bonding film and a protective film in a peelable degree and prevents an adhesive from transferring from the thermo-compression bonding film or the protective film to a processed object. The resin sheet has a thermocompression bonding film thermocompression bonded to a work, wherein the resin sheet has: a resin thermocompression bonding film having one surface thermocompression bonded to a workpiece; and a resin protective film having an inner surface facing the one surface, the protective film being detachably attached to the thermocompression bonding film to protect the one surface, wherein at least one of the one surface and the inner surface is provided with an attaching portion for attaching the thermocompression bonding film to the protective film, and the attaching portion is arranged in a region which does not overlap with a predetermined region of the one surface to be thermocompression bonded to the workpiece in a plan view.

title_en: GaN device laser transfer method based on resonance absorption layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GaN device laser transfer method based on a resonance absorption layer, belonging to the technical field of semiconductor photoelectricity; the method comprises the following steps: growing a resonance absorbing layer on a substrate wafer; the resonance absorption layer is an InGaN layer doped with In to regulate the band gap, so as to form ternary In  x Ga 1‑x  N; growing a GaN film on the resonance absorption layer to form an epitaxial wafer; manufacturing a GaN device on the epitaxial wafer to form a ground wafer; inverting the ground wafer, placing the target substrate under the ground wafer, and generating resonance absorption when the femtosecond laser irradiates the resonance absorption layer so as to release shock waves to realize the transfer of the GaN device; and bonding the GaN device with the target substrate. The invention can reduce the damage to the device in the transfer process, simplify the transfer step and further improve the transfer yield and efficiency.

title_en: Light emitting device and display apparatus
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a light emitting device and a display device, and belongs to the technical field of display. The light emitting device of the present disclosure includes a first electrode, a second electrode, and at least one light emitting layer disposed between the first electrode and the second electrode; the light-emitting layer comprises a host material, a first doping material and a second doping material which are doped together; the first doping material is a phosphorescent material, and the second doping material is a fluorescent material; the horizontal emission dipole ratio of the first doping material is 80% -100%; Θ// =p/(p+p≡), where Θ// represents the horizontal emission dipole ratio of the first dopant material, p// represents the horizontal emission dipole moment of the first dopant material, and p+.t represents the vertical emission dipole moment of the first dopant material.

title_en: Compound and organic light emitting device comprising the same
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a compound of chemical formula 1 and an organic light emitting device including the same.

title_en: Lateral diffusion metal oxide semiconductor device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to a lateral diffusion metal oxide semiconductor device and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: providing a substrate, wherein the substrate comprises a first drift region of a first conductivity type and a body region of a second conductivity type; forming a first gate structure and a first blocking structure, wherein the first gate structure is formed over a portion of the body region and a portion of the first drift region, the body region further comprising a first region not covered by the first gate structure, the first drift region further comprising a second region not covered by the first gate structure, the first blocking structure being formed over the second region of the first drift region; an ion implantation process is performed, part of ions are implanted into the first region of the body region to form a body region contact region of the second conductivity type, and part of ions are implanted into the second region of the first drift region after passing through the first blocking structure to form a first doped region of the second conductivity type. Thus, the breakdown voltage of the device can be remarkably improved, and the process is simplified.

title_en: Three-dimensional integrated structure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a three-dimensional integrated structure. In the three-dimensional integrated structure, a first semiconductor device is bonded with a second semiconductor device so that a first dummy bonding pad is bonded with an opposite second dummy bonding pad, and a heat radiation shielding layer is provided in at least a partial region of a bonding interface formed by bonding the first semiconductor device and the second semiconductor device, wherein the heat radiation shielding layer comprises at least two first dummy bonding pads electrically connected with each other. The heat radiation shielding layer can improve the heat radiation capability of the three-dimensional integrated structure, reduce electromagnetic interference between different metal layers in the three-dimensional integrated structure, and utilize the first virtual bonding pad to construct the heat radiation shielding layer, so that the performance of the three-dimensional integrated structure is improved under the condition of not increasing cost and process complexity.

title_en: Display substrate and display device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a display substrate and a display device. The display substrate comprises a driving circuit layer, a first scanning line and a second scanning line; the driving circuit layer comprises pixel units distributed in an array, each pixel unit comprises a plurality of sub-pixels, at least one sub-pixel comprises a pixel driving circuit, the pixel driving circuit comprises a first transistor and a second transistor, an active pattern of the first transistor comprises a first channel region, an active pattern of the second transistor comprises a second channel region, the first channel region is located at one side of a first scanning line far away from the second scanning line, and the second channel region is located at one side of a second scanning line far away from the first scanning line.

title_en: Semiconductor process chamber
abstract_en: The present application relates to a semiconductor process chamber. The semiconductor process chamber comprises a cavity, a gas pumping ring, a lining and a shielding component, wherein: the gas pumping ring and the lining are arranged in the cavity, a gas pumping channel is formed between the gas pumping ring and the lining, and the lining encloses a process area for process treatment; be provided with a plurality of first through-holes on the inside lining, shelter from the part setting on the inside lining, the part that a plurality of first through-holes were not sheltered from by the part and form the gas pocket, and the gas pocket is used for communicating bleed passageway and technology area, and the position of shielding the part for the setting up of inside lining is adjustable, through adjusting the position of shielding the part to adjust the size and/or the position of gas pocket. According to the technical scheme of the application, the method can meet the requirements of various processes on the air holes, does not need to replace the inner lining because of switching process types and the like, is beneficial to enlarging a process adjusting window, does not need to additionally manufacture a large number of experimental pieces, and therefore, the cost is obviously reduced.

title_en: Display device and repairing method of display device
abstract_en: A display device and a repair method of the display device are disclosed. The display device includes: a substrate; a plurality of subpixels on the substrate; and a data line and a common voltage line disposed on each of the plurality of sub-pixels, wherein at least one sub-pixel of the plurality of sub-pixels includes: a thin film transistor; a first light emitting element; a second light emitting element, wherein the second light emitting element and the first light emitting element are adjacent to each other and are spaced apart from each other; a first electrode connecting the first and second light emitting elements to the common voltage line; and a second electrode connecting the first light emitting element and the second light emitting element to a drain electrode of the thin film transistor, wherein the drain electrode is connected to the data line.

title_en: Thin film transistor, preparation method thereof and display panel
abstract_en: The application provides a thin film transistor, a preparation method thereof and a display panel, wherein the thin film transistor comprises: a substrate; a first metal layer including a gate electrode on the substrate; a second metal layer including a source electrode and a drain electrode, which is positioned on the first metal layer; an active layer located at one side of the grid electrode; the third metal layer is positioned on one side of the active layer, close to the grid electrode, and the fourth metal layer is positioned between the active layer and the third metal layer; the material of the active layer comprises metal oxide, the metal oxide comprises indium element, the material of the third metal layer comprises first metal, the reducibility of the first metal is larger than that of the metal indium, and the fourth metal layer comprises the metal indium. The thin film transistor, the preparation method thereof and the display panel provided by the application can effectively improve the mobility of the thin film transistor.

title_en: TO-46 packaging automatic bonding fixing clamp and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates TO the field of electronic packaging equipment, in particular TO an automatic TO-46 packaging bonding fixing clamp and a using method thereof, wherein the automatic TO-46 packaging bonding fixing clamp comprises a main body, a product placing groove is formed in the upper surface of the main body, and the product placing groove is used for placing TO-46 packaging products TO be bonded; the fixing device comprises a sliding block, a push rod and an elastic piece which are coaxially arranged, wherein the sliding block is arranged in the main body in a sliding way, one end of the sliding block is connected with the push rod, and the other end of the sliding block is connected with the elastic piece; the top of the sliding block extends out of the upper surface of the main body and is fixedly provided with a baffle plate, and the baffle plate is contacted with a shell of the TO-46 packaged product TO be bonded; the product standing groove is the rectangular groove, and the length axis of product standing groove is parallel with the slip axis of slider, and during the unoperated, the elastic component is in the extension state of relaxing, and the slider is located the one end that is close to the product standing groove under the effect of elastic component, and the separation blade covers in product standing groove top completely. According TO the invention, by pushing the push rod, the baffle plate on the main body moves back and forth, so that the TO-46 packaged product TO be bonded is fixed.

title_en: Mold release adhesive for semiconductor packaging mold and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cleaning of semiconductor packaging molds, in particular to a release adhesive for a semiconductor packaging mold and a preparation method thereof, wherein the release adhesive comprises the following components in parts by mass: 100 parts of blending sizing material, 30-35 parts of swelling mold cleaning agent, 18-24 parts of organic fluorine emulsion, 22-28 parts of reinforcing filler and 1.5-5 parts of cross-linking agent; the demolding adhesive and the preparation method thereof, wherein the tearing strength and the tensile strength of the blended adhesive can be improved through the cross-linking agent and the reinforcing filler, and the problem that the demolding adhesive breaks and falls off during mold cleaning can be avoided; simultaneously, the swelling mold cleaning agent used in combination can improve the swelling of dirt such as residual materials in the mold, thereby being convenient for improving the adsorption performance of the dirt; the organic fluorine emulsion is used as a lubricating component, and aims to reduce acting force between the demolding adhesive and the packaging mold, further reduce the risk of adhesive breakage and falling, and improve the mold cleaning effect and efficiency.

title_en: Grain stripping method by using ejection means and air pressure control means
abstract_en: The invention provides a grain stripping method by combining an ejection means with an air pressure control means, which comprises the following steps: the periphery of the target block of the peripheral negative pressure adsorption bearing film; the pushing piece pushes the crystal grain to rise through the target block so that the periphery of the crystal grain is separated from the periphery of the target block; the center negative pressure adsorbs the center of the target block, so that the center of the target block is separated from the center of the crystal grain; the center negative pressure is switched into the center positive pressure, and the center positive pressure blows the center of the target block, so that the center of the target block contacts the center of the crystal grain; and the center positive pressure continuously blows the center of the target block, so that the center of the target block continuously pushes the crystal grains to rise, and the crystal grains are gradually separated from the target block from the periphery to the center of the crystal grains. Therefore, the method can reduce the influence of the viscosity of the bearing film on the crystal grains, shorten the stripping time and avoid the problem of stress concentration.

title_en: High-fluidity polyvinyl acetal resin for photovoltaic, preparation method thereof and application thereof in photovoltaic packaging film
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic materials, and relates to a high-fluidity polyvinyl acetal resin for photovoltaic, which has the following structural formula:  Wherein, a+b+2c is more than or equal to 1400 and less than or equal to 2600; wherein, a/(a+b+2c) is less than or equal to 0.15 and less than or equal to 0.28; wherein b/(a+b+2c) is less than or equal to 0.05 and less than or equal to 0.2; wherein, the ratio of (a+b+2c) to (c) is more than or equal to 0.6 and less than or equal to 2 c/(a+b+2c) is more than or equal to 0.85; wherein n is more than or equal to 2 and less than or equal to 9; wherein, in the polyvinyl acetal structure unit c, the value of n is not unique, and more than two values of n are simultaneously present in the polyvinyl acetal structure; wherein, at least one of the values of n is 2-4, and at least one of the values of n is 5-9. The invention also provides a preparation method of the resin and application of the resin in a photovoltaic packaging film. The high-fluidity polyvinyl acetal resin for the photovoltaic, the production method thereof and the photovoltaic polyvinyl acetal packaging film with high volume resistivity produced by using the resin solve the contradiction problem of processability and insulativity of the existing polyvinyl acetal packaging film.

title_en: Etching apparatus and etching method
abstract_en: Provided are an etching apparatus and an etching method capable of suppressing a decrease in etching rate. The etching device (10) is configured to etch a silicon-containing film by supplying fluorine-containing gas and plasma to the silicon-containing film provided on a substrate. The etching device (10) is provided with: a discharge tube (24A) for irradiating microwaves; and a mixed gas supply unit (21) for supplying the mixed gas to the discharge tube (24A). The discharge tube (24A) is configured to generate a plasma of the mixed gas. The mixed gas contains hydrogen atoms, nitrogen atoms and oxygen atoms, and the discharge tube (24A) is composed mainly of aluminum oxide.

title_en: Ionic liquid and preparation method thereof, perovskite solar cell and preparation method thereof, and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of batteries, and provides an ionic liquid and a preparation method thereof, a perovskite solar cell and a preparation method thereof, and a photovoltaic module, wherein the ionic liquid comprises Wherein R  1  comprises an alkyl chain; r  2  includes at least one of-COOH, -B (OH)  2 、-PO(OH) 2 、-CF 3 、-NH 2 、-SO 3  H; ar comprises an aromatic heterocyclic ring containing a substituent. Therefore, the ionic liquid is added into the perovskite layer, so that the long-term stability of the perovskite layer can be improved, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the perovskite solar cell can be improved.

title_en: Solar cell
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of photovoltaics, and provides a solar cell, wherein at least one surface of the solar cell comprises a plurality of repeated areas, each repeated area comprises a plurality of PNG units, each PNG unit comprises an N area, a P area and a G area, at least any two PNG units are respectively a first unit and a second unit, and the first unit and the second unit meet at least one of the following conditions: the widths of the P areas are different; the widths of the N areas are different; the width of the G region is not the same. The width difference of the N area and the P area is adjusted, so that the light absorption range and the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the solar cell can be improved, the light energy resource is utilized to the greatest extent, and the collection probability of the photo-generated current is greatly increased while the productivity is not influenced; and the efficiency change ratio of the battery to the component and the yield of the battery piece and the component are improved.

title_en: Organic compound, OLED (organic light-emitting diode) with organic compound and organic light-emitting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic photoelectric material preparation, in particular to an organic compound, an OLED (organic light emitting diode) with the compound and an organic light emitting device. The organic compound has good thermal stability, excellent luminous efficiency and better purity; meanwhile, the organic compound provided by the invention is used as a light-emitting auxiliary material to be combined with a limited electron transport material, so that the organic light-emitting device can effectively have lower driving voltage and maintain the stability of the voltage, the light-emitting efficiency is improved, the service life is obviously prolonged, and the organic light-emitting device has good application prospect.

title_en: High-refractive-index PID-resistant EVA adhesive film for photovoltaic packaging material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of photovoltaic materials. The invention relates to a high-refractive-index PID-resistant EVA adhesive film for a photovoltaic packaging material, which is prepared from 100 parts of EVA resin, 0.8-1.2 parts of cross-linking agent, 1.0-1.5 parts of auxiliary cross-linking agent, 2.0-5.0 parts of high-refractive-index PID-resistant auxiliary agent, 0.1-0.2 parts of antioxidant, 0.05-0.1 part of light stabilizer and 0.3-0.5 part of coupling agent serving as raw materials through self-made high-refractive-index PID-resistant formula optimization design, extruding and casting into a film by an extruder. The EVA adhesive film effectively solves the problems that the low refractive index of the EVA adhesive film commonly used at present causes light energy loss so as to influence photoelectric conversion efficiency and the free acetic acid is generated by decomposition in the outdoor use process, and the free acetic acid further promotes the decomposition of EVA and the generated PID phenomenon so as to influence the service life of the material.

title_en: Wafer rotating mechanism of automatic mounting device for wafer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wafer rotating mechanism of an automatic wafer mounting device, which comprises a flat plate, wherein the upper end surface of the flat plate is fixedly connected with a wafer rotating mechanism, a wafer grabbing mechanism and a graphite disc moving mechanism; the wafer grabbing mechanism is suitable for grabbing the wafer on the wafer rotating mechanism onto the graphite disc of the graphite disc moving mechanism. The wafer grabbing mechanism grabs the wafer on the wafer rotating mechanism onto the graphite disc of the graphite disc moving mechanism, so that the automation of production is realized, the production speed is improved, and the effect of manpower and material resources is saved.

title_en: Preparation method of silicon carbide power device, silicon carbide power device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a silicon carbide power device, the silicon carbide power device and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductors. The method comprises the following steps: providing a silicon carbide layer; forming a first mask layer on the silicon carbide layer, the first mask layer including at least one first implantation window; and forming a second mask layer on one surface of the first mask layer, which is away from the silicon carbide layer, wherein the second mask layer is provided with a second implantation window along the periphery Xiang Xingcheng of the inner wall of the first implantation window, the second implantation window is used for carrying out ion implantation of the silicon carbide layer, and the melting point of the second mask layer is higher than the ion implantation temperature. The method can more accurately control the position and the size of the second implantation window, can better control the quantity and the position of ions implanted into the silicon carbide layer, and the second implantation window formed by the second mask layer can be suitable for a high-temperature environment of the ion implantation silicon carbide layer, so that the second implantation window and the silicon carbide power device have higher stability, and the yield of the silicon carbide power device is improved.

title_en: Display substrate, manufacturing method and display device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a display substrate, a manufacturing method and a display device. The display substrate comprises a driving circuit arranged on the substrate, and the driving circuit comprises a first node control circuit; the first node control circuit includes a first transistor and a second transistor; the grid electrode of the first transistor is electrically connected with the first control end, the first electrode of the first transistor is electrically connected with the first voltage end, and the second electrode of the first transistor is electrically connected with the first node; the grid electrode of the second transistor is electrically connected with the second control end, the first electrode of the second transistor is electrically connected with the first node, and the second electrode of the second transistor is electrically connected with the second voltage end; the display substrate further comprises a first connecting structure arranged on the substrate; the first transistor is connected with a part of the first connection structure; and/or the second transistor is connected with a portion of the second connection structure. The conversion between the bidirectional scanning driving circuit and the unidirectional scanning driving circuit can be realized by only adding two masks.

title_en: Compound and organic light-emitting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel organic electroluminescent material, which skillfully combines deuteration modification and alkyl substitution through careful design of a molecular structure, thereby realizing cooperative promotion of various excellent performances. The introduction of deuterium improves the chemical stability and the thermal stability of the material, thereby greatly improving the stability and the service life of devices, and the deuteration at a special position has the economical efficiency while improving the performance. The R  1  position group on the fluorene unit is subjected to deuteration, so that the triplet state energy level of the material can be improved, reverse transfer of energy is avoided, and the luminous efficiency of the device is improved. The deuterium alkyl substitution can optimize the energy level structure of the material and promote carrier injection and transmission, so that the luminous efficiency and voltage of the device are effectively improved. The special linking mode of the compound strengthens the anisotropy of the material while improving the hole mobility, improves the transverse resistance of the material and effectively avoids the problem of light color crosstalk of a client.

title_en: Ejector, chip mounting machine and chip mounting method
abstract_en: The application relates to a ejector, a chip mounting machine and a chip mounting method, wherein the ejector comprises the following components: a base; the ejector pin is arranged on the seat body in a lifting manner; the thimble cap is arranged on the base body in a lifting manner, an avoidance hole and an air hole are formed in the thimble cap, the avoidance hole and the air hole penetrate through the top side of the thimble cap, and the thimble penetrates through the avoidance hole; and a negative pressure generator communicated with the air hole; the lifting movement of the thimble cap and the lifting movement of the thimble are mutually independent. According to the ejector, the ejector pin cap is lowered to enable the bulge to descend under the condition that the ejector pin cap absorbs the blue film, so that the chip mounting machine does not need to wait for the bulge to naturally recover, the position of a chip adjacent to the ejector pin can be identified through the image sensor, the mounting of each chip is rapidly and sequentially completed, and the chip mounting efficiency of the chip mounting machine can be improved.

title_en: Method and system for adjusting parameters of generating equipment based on wafer detection data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a generating equipment parameter adjusting method and system based on wafer detection data, and relates to the technical field of nanoimprint wafers. The adjusting method comprises the following steps: acquiring and processing detection data: and acquiring equipment parameters and product data in the detection process, wherein the product data comprises real-time detection data in production, comprehensive detection data after production, position data of the product on a wafer and imprinting sequence data. The method for adjusting the quality of the product comprises the steps of real-time detection data and comprehensive detection data, and combining a feedback mechanism, wherein the feedback mechanism can realize the adjustment of the parameters of the next process equipment, the adjustment of the parameters of the process equipment when the product is produced in the next batch, and the correction of the coining real-time detection data in the coining process, thereby realizing the accurate adjustment of the parameters of the equipment.

title_en: Resistive random access memory and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resistive random access memory and an operation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of microelectronics and integrated circuits. According to the invention, by designing the first electrode-first resistive layer-middle layer-second resistive layer-second electrode structure and combining the special design and operation method of each layer of material, the second resistive layer is used as a series resistor to apply current limiting or optimize the current limiting effect in the Forming (Forming) operation of the first resistive layer, so that the possibility of failure of the resistive random access memory is reduced, the subsequent use process of the resistive random access memory is prevented from being negatively influenced, the problem of reduced equivalent switching ratio caused by the series resistor is greatly improved, and no additional area overhead is introduced.

title_en: Enhancement of EUV underlayer effects using diffusion barriers
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to patterned structures (and methods and apparatus for forming such structures) comprising: a substrate having a partially fabricated semiconductor device film stack; a radiation sensitive imaging layer over the substrate; an underlying layer underlying the radiation sensitive imaging layer, the underlying layer comprising an unstable species; a hard mask located below the underlying layer; and a diffusion barrier layer located between the underlying layer and the hard mask layer, the diffusion barrier layer comprising a diffusion barrier material that reduces diffusion of the unstable species from the underlying layer into the hard mask layer. In various embodiments, the reduced diffusion of the unstable species from the underlying layer down into the hard mask layer results in relatively more diffusion of the unstable species from the underlying layer up into the radiation sensitive imaging layer. The increased diffusion into the radiation-sensitive imaging layer may advantageously increase the radiation absorption and/or patterning properties of the radiation-sensitive imaging layer.

title_en: Stacked wafer deep silicon through hole forming method and semiconductor device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of semiconductor manufacturing, and in particular, to a method for forming a deep through silicon via of a stacked wafer and a semiconductor device. The method comprises the following steps: depositing a dielectric film layer on a substrate, and transferring an etching pattern to the dielectric film layer through a photoetching process to serve as a hard mask layer; etching the hard mask layer on the first wafer substrate according to the etching pattern, so as to form a Through Silicon Via (TSV) and a TSV blind hole; depositing and generating a linear oxide layer inside the TSV through an oxidation deposition process, and filling and forming a supporting layer with the surface kept smooth and consistent with the surface of the dielectric film layer on the linear oxide layer; performing metal wire interconnection, and manufacturing blind holes and/or bonding pads for hybrid bonding to form a first wafer; mixing and bonding the first wafer and a second wafer except the first wafer so as to form a stacked wafer; and performing Cu CMP process to form TSVs for exporting the electric signals of the stacked wafers. By utilizing the invention, the process window for manufacturing the semiconductor device is obviously increased, and the process difficulty is obviously reduced.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: An Integrated Circuit (IC) structure includes a bottom level IC die and one or more top level IC dies. A first side of the one or more top level IC dies is bonded to the bottom IC die. The support substrate is coupled to a second side of the one or more top level IC dies. A plurality of conductive Through Substrate Vias (TSVs) each extend vertically through the support substrate. The metal cap structure is disposed over the support substrate. The metal cap structure is thermally coupled to the conductive TSV. Embodiments of the present application also relate to semiconductor structures and methods of forming the same.

title_en: Ultrasonic spraying laser protection liquid for lamp chip, preparation method, application and spraying method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bump chip ultrasonic spraying laser protection liquid, a preparation method, application and a spraying laser cutting protection method using the same, wherein the protection liquid comprises water-soluble resin, an ultraviolet absorbent, an organic solvent, an auxiliary agent and ultrapure water, wherein by adopting the water-soluble resin with lower viscosity and excellent water solubility, uniform and comprehensive coverage of wafer and bump surfaces can be realized on the premise of low resin content and low dosage, and by using a specific auxiliary agent, the spreading of atomized liquid drops on the wafer surfaces is very favorable, the good contact between molecules of wafer and film layers can be promoted, the adhesion of the film layers on the wafer is further improved, and the film layers have good synergistic effect with polyester. Therefore, the protective liquid is particularly suitable for laser cutting protection of ultrasonic spraying of the lamp chip and has profound significance in the fields of semiconductor chip processing and packaging.

title_en: Double-sided packaging method and double-sided packaging structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-sided packaging method and a double-sided packaging structure. The double-sided packaging method comprises the following steps: providing a middle plastic package structure, wherein the middle plastic package structure comprises a substrate, and the back surface of the substrate is provided with a conductive column; mounting a back side electronic component on the back side of the substrate; a resin film is attached to the back surface of the substrate, and the resin film covers at least the side walls of the back surface electronic component and the side walls of the conductive posts, and the end surfaces of the conductive posts, which are far from the substrate, are exposed from the resin film. Therefore, the packaging process can be simplified, and the difficulty and cost of the packaging process can be reduced. The double-sided packaging structure can be manufactured by the double-sided packaging method.

title_en: Novel self-repairing self-cleaning photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel self-repairing self-cleaning photovoltaic module, which comprises a metal outer frame, wherein toughened glass, a polyethylene-polyvinyl acetate copolymer adhesive film, a photovoltaic cell piece, a polyethylene-polyvinyl acetate copolymer adhesive film and a backboard film are sequentially arranged in the metal outer frame from top to bottom, and a hyperbranched PDMS composite self-repairing self-cleaning superhydrophobic coating is physically deposited on the toughened glass. According to the self-cleaning super-hydrophobic coating, the super-hydrophobic characteristic of the super-branched PDMS composite self-repairing self-cleaning super-hydrophobic coating physically deposited on the toughened glass is utilized, the self-cleaning of the photovoltaic module can be realized by fully utilizing an external water source, and no additional mechanical equipment is needed for dust removal operation; in addition, the hyperbranched PDMS coating can repair cracks on the surface of the coating by irradiation of sunlight and heat generated by the photovoltaic module working, so that the service life of the superhydrophobic coating is greatly prolonged, and the operation cost of the traditional photovoltaic panel is reduced.

title_en: Substrate processing method and substrate processing system
abstract_en: A liquid film formed of a liquid containing ultra-fine bubbles is formed on a surface of a substrate held in a substantially horizontal posture, a processing fluid in a non-supercritical state is introduced into a chamber accommodating the substrate on which the liquid film is formed, the processing fluid is pressurized to bring the processing fluid into a supercritical state, the liquid on the surface of the substrate is replaced with the processing fluid, the pressure in the chamber is reduced, and the processing fluid in the supercritical state is vaporized and discharged outside the chamber. In the technique of treating a substrate with a treatment fluid in a supercritical state in a chamber, liquid can be satisfactorily replaced with the treatment fluid before the treatment fluid becomes in the supercritical state.

title_en: PMOS triggered bidirectional SCR device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PMOS triggered bidirectional SCR device, which comprises a P substrate and a deep N well, wherein an oxide layer is arranged on the upper surface of a second N well, the right side of a second P+ injection region and the left side of a third P+ injection region on the deep N well, the oxide layer is connected with a power supply VDD, the first P+ injection region and the second N+ injection region are commonly connected with a signal input output end IO of a circuit, and the second N+ injection region and the fourth P+ injection region are commonly grounded to VSS; the semiconductor device also comprises a diode Dio and a PMOS transistor Mp0, wherein the anode of the diode Dio is connected with the IO, and the cathode of the diode Dio is connected with the oxide layer; the source and substrate of the PMOS transistor Mp0 are connected with VDD, the gate of the PMOS transistor Mp0 is connected with VSS, and the drain of the PMOS transistor Mp0 is connected with an oxide layer. The invention belongs to the technical field of integrated circuit electrostatic discharge protection, and provides PTBSCR devices which can normally work in both positive and negative ESD discharge modes.

title_en: Light-emitting diode chip and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a light emitting diode chip and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of electronic devices. The light emitting diode chip includes: the epitaxial layer, the current blocking layer, the electrode and the electrode wire; the current blocking layer is positioned on one surface of the epitaxial layer; the electrode and the electrode wire are positioned on one surface of the current blocking layer, which is opposite to the epitaxial layer, the first end of the electrode wire is connected with the electrode, the second end of the electrode wire extends away from the electrode, and the width of the electrode wire gradually decreases along the extending direction of the electrode wire. The LED chip and the LED chip can effectively improve the light effect of the LED chip.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent material and organic electroluminescent device containing double-main-body material
abstract_en: The invention provides an organic electroluminescent material and an organic electroluminescent device containing a double-main-body material, wherein the structural general formula of the organic electroluminescent main-body material is shown as a general formula 1, and the compound of the general formula 1 has good stereoregularity, avoids aggregation quenching effect caused by stacking structural planes in the process of structure evaporation, and prolongs the service life; meanwhile, the structure with stronger three-dimensional regularity effectively reduces the evaporation temperature, ensures the thermal stability of the material in the evaporation process, and prolongs the service life of the material. The organic electroluminescent device of the invention disperses triplet excitons on two main bodies by using a double main body material, reduces triplet state-triplet state annihilation, reduces the driving voltage of the organic electroluminescent device, and can improve the luminous efficiency and the service life of the device.

title_en: Power device packaging structure and packaging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power device packaging structure and a packaging method, wherein a communication structure grows between a third rewiring layer and a first rewiring layer so as to connect an electric signal led out from an HEMT chip and/or a MOSFET chip to the third rewiring layer to the first rewiring layer, thereby changing a lead connection mode adopted in the traditional packaging method, greatly reducing the occupation of the internal space of the packaging structure and being beneficial to the high integration of a plurality of pairs of power devices in the same packaging structure with limited size; each electrode of the chip is interconnected with the copper rewiring layer through the copper column, so that parasitic inductance is reduced; the device performance is improved. By constructing independent heat dissipation channels for the two chip pairs and controlling the two chip pairs to work alternately, the total heat power is distributed on the two GaN chips evenly, and the heat generated by the two GaN chips is transferred to the back bonding pad along the self so as to realize simultaneous heat dissipation, thereby greatly reducing the packaging thermal resistance of the device.

title_en: Silicate near-infrared fluorescent material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicate near infrared fluorescent material and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of near infrared fluorescent materials, wherein the chemical formula of the silicate near infrared fluorescent material is Ba  9‑x Sr x Sc 1.98 Cr 0.02 Si 6 O 24 , wherein x is more than or equal to 2 and less than or equal to 8, and the preparation method of the silicate near infrared fluorescent material comprises the steps of weighing raw materials according to the molar ratio of each element in the raw materials according to the chemical formula of Ba  9‑   x Sr x Sc 1.98 Cr 0.02 Si 6 O 24 ; the weighed raw materials are added with absolute ethyl alcohol as a dispersing agent and fully ground until alcohol volatilizes to obtain uniform white powder, the ground white powder is calcined, cooled and cooled to obtain the silicate near infrared fluorescent material, and the silicate near infrared fluorescent material can be used for a broadband near infrared fluorescent conversion type LED device and has the advantages of high luminous intensity, wide coverage wavelength range, simple and easy preparation method, good physical and chemical stability, ideal fluorescent service life, greenness, no pollution and wide application range.

title_en: Amorphous copper oxide/platinum/gallium oxide-based heterogeneous double-Schottky junction solar blind ultraviolet detector and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar blind ultraviolet detector structure based on amorphous copper oxide/platinum/gallium oxide heterogeneous double Schottky junction and a preparation method thereof, wherein the solar blind ultraviolet detector structure comprises a c-plane sapphire substrate, a Ga  2 O 3  film, a Pt metal film layer, an amorphous CuO film and a Ti/Au electrode pair from bottom to top. The preparation method adopts a pulse laser deposition method: preparing a Ga  2 O 3  film on a c-Al  2 O 3  substrate by adopting a PLD method, performing ion sputtering on the Ga  2 O 3  film to form a discontinuous Pt film layer, performing PLD deposition on an amorphous CuO film at a lower temperature to form a CuO/Pt/Ga  2 O 3  double heterogeneous Schottky junction, and finally plating a Ti/Au electrode on the film surface. According to the invention, the discontinuous Pt film layer is inserted in the middle of the CuO/Ga  2 O 3  heterojunction, and the Schottky barrier at the heterojunction interface of the CuO/Pt and the Pt/Ga  2 O 3  is utilized, so that the dark current of the device is greatly reduced, and the light absorption of the device is improved.

title_en: Memory and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a memory and a manufacturing method thereof. In the invention, in the subsequent process, the bottom electrode of the memory cell directly uses the metal layer which is deposited and planarized to form the first contact structure, thereby not only simplifying the process flow, but also improving the influence of the contact structure joint on the yield, increasing the density of the memory cell and reducing the risk of leakage between the memory cells. Furthermore, the bottom electrode of the memory cell and the first contact structure are made of metal tungsten, so that the polarization charge quantity can be improved, and the operation efficiency and reliability of the device can be optimized and improved; meanwhile, in the memory cell etching process, the etching selectivity of the metal tungsten is larger than that of the titanium nitride, so that the memory cell etching process has a larger process window.

title_en: Semiconductor structure, preparation method of semiconductor structure and semiconductor device
abstract_en: The application provides a semiconductor structure, a preparation method of the semiconductor structure and a semiconductor device, wherein the semiconductor structure comprises the following components: a substrate; the first epitaxial layer is positioned on the surface of the substrate and comprises an epitaxial layer body and a groove, and the groove is positioned in the epitaxial layer body; and the second epitaxial layer is at least positioned in part of the groove, and the doping type of the second epitaxial layer is different from that of the first epitaxial layer. The application solves the problem that the doping concentration distribution of a doped region formed by ion implantation of the SIC diode in the prior art is uneven, so that the high voltage resistance of the device is weaker.

title_en: Silicon carbide semiconductor device and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: Provided are a silicon carbide semiconductor device and a method for manufacturing the same, wherein the degree of freedom in device design is suppressed from being reduced. The device is provided with: a first silicon carbide layer comprising silicon carbide of 4H structure; a second silicon carbide layer which is laminated on the upper surface of the first silicon carbide layer and contains silicon carbide of a 3C structure; a drift layer of a first conductivity type provided on the first silicon carbide layer; a base region of the second conductivity type provided on the upper surface side of the drift layer in the first silicon carbide layer; a main region of the first conductivity type having a source extension region and a source contact region, the lower surface of the source extension region being in contact with the base region, the source extension region being disposed on the first silicon carbide layer, the lower surface of the source contact region being in contact with the source extension region, and the source contact region being disposed on the second silicon carbide layer; a gate insulating film provided inside the trench penetrating the main region and the base region; a gate electrode buried inside the trench with a gate insulating film interposed therebetween; and a main electrode which is disposed in contact with the source contact region.

title_en: Display with extended color gamut coverage and low blue emission
abstract_en: A display including red, green, blue and fourth sub-pixels including dark cyan or saturated green pixels, and an LED light source. Also provided is a liquid crystal display device including the phosphor containing U  6+ . Applications for displays include televisions, mobile telephones, and computer displays. The invention relates to a display with extended color gamut coverage and low blue emission.

title_en: Memory, preparation method thereof and layout structure
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a memory, a method of manufacturing the same, and a layout structure including a plurality of target patterns and slit patterns, the plurality of target patterns being arranged in rows at intervals along a first direction and being arranged in columns at intervals along a second direction intersecting the first direction; the slit patterns are positioned among the target patterns, and at least one slit pattern extends along the second direction; the slit patterns are at least positioned in the area between the two target patterns distributed along the first direction, and the length of the slit patterns in the first direction is not smaller than the size of the target patterns in the first direction, so that the situation that the target patterns are damaged or damaged due to the preparation of the slit patterns can be at least avoided.

title_en: Cleaning method of silicon carbide substrate polishing solution by using strong oxidant
abstract_en: The invention provides a cleaning method of a strong oxidant commonly used for a silicon carbide substrate polishing solution, which belongs to the technical field of wafer strong oxidant cleaning and comprises the following steps: removing particles and residual MnO  4   2‑  ions on the surface of the wafer; removing residual Mn  2+  and Na  + /K +  ions on the surface of the wafer; etching an oxide layer on the surface of the wafer; and drying the surface of the wafer. According to the cleaning method of the strong oxidant for the silicon carbide substrate polishing solution, provided by the invention, the MnO  4   2‑ 、Mn 2+  and Na  + /K +  ions generated by the decomposition of permanganate are gradually and directionally cleaned while the residual particles on the surface of the wafer are removed, and new impurity ions are not introduced, so that the polished wafer can be effectively cleaned.

title_en: Metal gate device and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a metal gate device and a manufacturing method thereof, comprising the following steps: forming a first polysilicon gate in the device region, forming a second polysilicon gate in the input/output region, wherein the pattern density of the second polysilicon gate is greater than that of the first polysilicon gate, and a dielectric layer is formed between adjacent polysilicon gates; forming a mask layer covering the second polysilicon gate; removing the first polysilicon gate to form an opening, forming a metal gate material layer in the opening, and forming the metal gate material layer above the dielectric layer; and removing the metal gate material layer above the dielectric layer by adopting a chemical mechanical polishing method, wherein the metal gate material layer positioned in the opening forms a metal gate. According to the invention, by changing the material of the high-pattern-density grid electrode, the low-pattern-density grid electrode adopts the metal grid electrode, the high-pattern-density grid electrode adopts the polysilicon grid electrode, the grinding rate of the grinding liquid on the polysilicon is low when the metal grid material layer is ground, the thickness difference of the high-pattern-density grid electrode is reduced, and the electrical stability of the device is improved.

title_en: Power stage, manufacturing method thereof, voltage regulation module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a power stage, a manufacturing method thereof, a voltage regulation module and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of power devices, wherein the power stage comprises: a PCB; the first electrode of the low-side transistor is connected with the second electrode of the high-side transistor through a first wiring in the first wiring layer, a first via penetrating through the insulating layer and a second wiring in the second wiring layer; a first encapsulation layer covering the low-side transistor; a second encapsulation layer covering the high-side transistor; an exposed first rewiring layer for receiving an input signal, comprising a first rewiring part, covering a part of a first side surface of the first packaging layer; a second rewiring portion covering a portion of the second side surface of the first encapsulation layer; a third re-wiring portion covering a portion of a third side surface of the second encapsulation layer; a fourth re-wiring portion covering a portion of a fourth side surface of the second encapsulation layer; and a fifth re-wiring part covering a portion of the second encapsulation layer away from the surface of the PCB. The power stage has good heat dissipation effect and is beneficial to reducing resistance.

title_en: HBC battery, battery pack and photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of photovoltaics, and provides an HBC battery, a battery pack and a photovoltaic system, wherein the HBC battery comprises silicon: the backlight device comprises a substrate, a first substrate, a second substrate, a first substrate and a second substrate, wherein the substrate is provided with a backlight surface and a light-directing surface which are oppositely arranged; the first region comprises an amorphous silicon layer, the second region comprises a polycrystalline silicon layer, the amorphous silicon layer and the polycrystalline silicon layer are different in type, and the extinction coefficient of the amorphous silicon layer is larger than that of the polycrystalline silicon layer. The polycrystalline silicon layer has relatively higher compactness, so that the polycrystalline silicon layer has relatively higher electrode slurry etching resistance, manufactured electrodes are prevented from penetrating through the polycrystalline silicon layer, the matching property between the polycrystalline silicon layer and the electrode slurry is improved, the polycrystalline silicon layer is ensured to have higher field passivation effect, the carrier recombination rate at one side of a backlight surface is reduced, and the working performance of the solar cell is improved.

title_en: Metal thin layer structure for surface bonding and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal thin layer structure for surface bonding and a preparation method thereof, wherein the metal thin layer comprises two WTI mixed metal layers and three Au metal layers; the metal thin layer is prepared by magnetron sputtering, electroplating and other processes. Compared with the prior art, the metal thin layer structure is adopted as the upper electrode plate of the capacitor, so that the capacitor has higher adhesiveness and high bonding tensile strength, and meanwhile, the capacitor can still maintain excellent performance after being subjected to a high-strength reliability test.

title_en: Nanoscale visible light emitting diode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nanoscale visible light emitting diode and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of growing a III nitride semiconductor epitaxial layer on a substrate; depositing a first etching mask layer on the III-nitride semiconductor epitaxial layer, preparing an adhesive layer with periodical arrangement patterns on the first etching mask layer, forming a patterned second etching mask layer on the first etching mask layer, etching the first etching mask layer to form a patterned first etching mask layer, etching the III-nitride semiconductor epitaxial layer to form a patterned III-nitride semiconductor nano-pillar array template, and growing an LED structure on the III-nitride semiconductor nano-pillar array template to obtain the nanoscale visible light emitting diode. The method can partially relax the strong compressive strain of the active region grown on the nano-pillar array template, increase the incorporation of In the In-containing quantum confinement layer, realize long-wavelength luminescence, improve the radiation recombination efficiency and increase the luminescence intensity.

title_en: IC carrier plate carrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses an IC carrier, which can be compatible with horizontal (F) placement/arc (R) placement of IC carrier plates through the matching arrangement of a carrier body, at least two supporting limiting pieces and at least two limiting pieces, wherein F-shaped or R-shaped IC carrier plates can be placed on the front side and the back side of the carrier body, carrier parts in two shapes can be shared, the mounting modes are the same, accessories are not required to be increased or decreased, the F/R carrier can be quickly switched, carriers in two shapes are not required to be prepared, the cost is effectively saved, the IC carrier can be stacked, each carrier can be placed with 50PCS+IC carrier plates, the frequency of carrier replacement is reduced, the carrying frequency is reduced, and the production capacity is greatly improved.

title_en: Flower basket structure of monocrystalline silicon heterojunction solar cell slice
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of solar cells, in particular to a flower basket structure of a monocrystalline silicon heterojunction solar cell slice, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper end surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of struts, the upper end of each strut is fixedly connected with a top plate, one side of the upper end surface of each top plate is fixedly connected with a handle, both sides of the lower end surface of each top plate are slidably connected with a bearing plate, one side of each bearing plate is provided with a plurality of clamping teeth, and each top plate is provided with an adjustable multidirectional limiting mechanism for keeping a silicon slice taken off from the clamping teeth tidy.

title_en: Novel nano-wall (NWaFET) Integrated Circuit (IC) basic structure
abstract_en: The novel nano-wall IC basic structure provided herein relates to the fields of microelectronic technology and integrated circuits. By embedding silicon dioxide in the inner part far away from the surface of the channel, the DIBL effect is effectively restrained, and leakage current is reduced.

title_en: High frequency module and communication device
abstract_en: In a high frequency module for transmitting 2 transmission signals capable of simultaneous communication, the heat dissipation of 2 transmission filters is improved. The high-frequency module (1) is provided with a mounting substrate (4), a first elastic wave filter, a second elastic wave filter, a resin layer, and a shielding electrode. The second elastic wave filter is disposed on the first elastic wave filter, and the first elastic wave filter is disposed on the main surface (41) of the mounting substrate (4). The resin layer covers at least a portion of the first elastic wave filter and at least a portion of the second elastic wave filter. The shielding electrode covers at least a portion of the resin layer. The first elastic wave filter and the second elastic wave filter both support transmission. The signal passing through the first elastic wave filter and the signal passing through the second elastic wave filter can communicate simultaneously. The main surface of the second elastic wave filter on the opposite side to the first elastic wave filter side is in contact with the shielding electrode. The ground electrode of the mounting substrate (4) is connected to the functional electrode of the first elastic wave filter.

title_en: Solar cell structure
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a solar battery structure. The solar cell structure comprises a substrate, a fine grid, an insulating layer and a conductive layer, wherein the fine grid is positioned on one side of the substrate and comprises a first fine grid and a second fine grid which extend along a second direction and are alternately arranged at intervals, the first fine grid and the second fine grid penetrate through a plurality of first areas and a plurality of second areas, the insulating layer comprises a first insulating structure and a second insulating structure, the first insulating structure is positioned in the first areas and is positioned on one side of the first fine grid far away from the substrate, the second insulating structure is positioned in the second areas and is positioned on one side of the second fine grid far away from the substrate, the conductive layer comprises a first conductive structure and a second conductive structure which are alternately arranged, the first conductive structure is positioned in the first areas, the first conductive structure covers the first insulating structure and is positioned between the second fine grid and the substrate, the second conductive structure is positioned in the second areas, and the second conductive structure covers the second insulating structure and is positioned between the first fine grid and the substrate.

title_en: Back contact battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a back contact battery and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of providing a silicon substrate, wherein the silicon substrate is provided with a front surface and a back surface which are opposite, growing a tunneling oxide layer on the back surface of the silicon substrate, and depositing a first silicon layer on the tunneling oxide layer; placing a silicon substrate deposited with a first silicon layer in diffusion equipment, crystallizing the first silicon layer, doping boron on the surface of the first silicon layer after the crystallization treatment is finished to form a p+ emitter, growing an oxide layer on the surface of the p+ emitter, and precipitating redundant boron atoms from the first silicon layer.

title_en: Semiconductor package having multiple types of conductive elements
abstract_en: The application discloses a semiconductor package. The semiconductor package includes a package substrate having a front side and a back side, the package substrate including a plurality of sets of front side conductive patterns formed on the front side, and a plurality of sets of interconnect structures electrically coupled to the plurality of sets of front side conductive patterns, respectively, a plurality of electronic components mounted on the front side of the package substrate and electrically coupled to the plurality of sets of front side conductive patterns through the plurality of sets of front side conductive elements, respectively, the plurality of sets of conductive components including at least a set of first type conductive elements connected to a first electronic component of the plurality of electronic components and a set of second type conductive elements connected to a second electronic component of the plurality of electronic components, and the first type conductive elements having a higher thermal conductivity than the second type conductive elements and a higher power consumption than the second electronic components.

title_en: Array substrate, display panel and display device
abstract_en: An array substrate comprises a substrate and a plurality of pixel driving circuit groups arranged on the substrate, wherein the plurality of pixel driving circuit groups are arranged in an array manner along a first direction and a second direction. Wherein each of the plurality of pixel driving circuit groups includes two pixel driving circuits arranged along a first direction. The array substrate further comprises a first conductive layer and a second conductive layer, the pixel driving circuit comprises a capacitor, the capacitor comprises a first polar plate and a second polar plate, the first polar plate is located on the first conductive layer, the second polar plate is located on the second conductive layer, a first connection pattern is connected between the second polar plates of the two pixel driving circuits in the pixel driving circuit group, and the first connection pattern is located on the second conductive layer. The size of the first connecting pattern in the second direction is smaller than that of the second polar plate in the second direction.

title_en: Display module and display device
abstract_en: The application provides a display module and a display device, wherein the display module comprises a screen body, a flip-chip film substrate, packaging glue and an adsorption structure, the screen body comprises a display area and a non-display area, the non-display area comprises a bonding area, the bonding area is provided with a first bonding pad, the flip-chip film substrate is positioned on one side of the screen body, a second bonding pad is arranged on one side, close to the screen body, of the flip-chip film substrate, at least part of the second bonding pad is connected with the first bonding pad, the packaging glue is connected between the screen body and the flip-chip film substrate, the adsorption structure is arranged between the screen body and the flip-chip film substrate, and the orthographic projection of the adsorption structure on the flip-chip film substrate is positioned between the orthographic projection of the first bonding pad on the flip-chip film substrate and the orthographic projection of the packaging glue on the flip-chip film substrate. The display module adsorbs the water vapor entering from the gap of the packaging adhesive through the adsorption structure, so that the water vapor is prevented from invading into the second bonding pad to cause corrosion reaction, and the problem of display dark lines caused by short circuit of the second bonding pad is solved.

title_en: Groove type silicon carbide irradiation detector embedded with super junction and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grooved silicon carbide irradiation detector embedded with super junction and a preparation method thereof, relating to the technical field of microelectronics, A plurality of grooves are formed in the first doping type epitaxial layer at intervals, regions with doping types different from those of the sensitive regions are formed in the inner walls of the grooves, and super junctions with doping types different from those of the sensitive regions and located below the grooves are arranged in the sensitive regions with single doping type in the PiN structure. Due to the fact that the super junction and the doped region on the inner wall of the groove are introduced, the width of a depletion region of the sensitive region is increased, an electric field in the depletion region can enable electron hole pairs generated by irradiation to be collected better, and therefore charge collection efficiency of the detector is improved.

title_en: Solar cell, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The application provides a solar cell, a preparation method thereof and a photovoltaic module.
