The solar cell comprises a substrate, a first tunneling oxide layer, a first phosphorus doping layer, a second tunneling oxide layer, a third phosphorus doping layer and a third tunneling oxide layer, wherein the first tunneling oxide layer is located on one side surface of the substrate, the first phosphorus doping layer is located on one side surface of the first tunneling oxide layer, the second tunneling oxide layer is located on one side surface of the second tunneling oxide layer, the second phosphorus doping layer is located on one side surface of the second tunneling oxide layer, the third tunneling oxide layer is located on one side surface of the third tunneling oxide layer, the phosphorus doping concentration of the third tunneling oxide layer is smaller than that of the second phosphorus doping layer, and the phosphorus doping concentration of the second phosphorus doping layer is smaller than that of the third phosphorus doping layer. The solar cell has a good passivation effect.

title_en: Chip transfer equipment, chip transfer method and magnetic attraction type die bonding pen
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a chip transfer apparatus including a drive chain loop passing through one or more pick-up locations and one or more placement locations, a drive gear mated with the drive chain loop, and a plurality of pick-up portions secured to the drive chain loop, wherein the drive gear is configured to drive the drive chain loop such that the pick-up portions reach the pick-up locations and the placement locations, the pick-up portions being configured to pick up chips at the pick-up locations and place chips at the placement locations. The disclosure also provides a chip transfer method and a magnetic attraction type die bonding pen.

title_en: Light emitting diode and light emitting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a light emitting diode and a light emitting device. The light-emitting diode comprises a semiconductor laminated layer, a transparent conductive layer, a protective layer, a second electrode and a protective layer, wherein the semiconductor laminated layer comprises a first semiconductor layer, a light-emitting layer and a second semiconductor layer which are sequentially overlapped from bottom to top, the transparent conductive layer is formed on the second semiconductor layer, the protective layer is formed on the transparent conductive layer, the second electrode is formed on the protective layer and comprises a bonding pad part and an expanding part, the protective layer respectively forms a first opening and a second opening on the bonding pad part and the expanding part of the second electrode, the second electrode is electrically connected with the second semiconductor layer through the first opening and the second opening, and the light-emitting diode is characterized in that the second opening of the protective layer comprises a plurality of first opening parts and a second opening part, the second opening part is formed at the tail end far away from the bonding pad part of the second electrode, and the size of the second opening part is larger than that of the first opening part. According to the invention, the second opening of the protective layer at the second electrode expansion part is subjected to size differentiation design, so that the reliability of the chip is improved.

title_en: Avalanche photodetector and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an avalanche photoelectric detector and a preparation method thereof. The avalanche photoelectric detector comprises an avalanche photoelectric diode and an extraction structure, wherein the avalanche photoelectric diode comprises a first contact layer, a charge layer, a light absorption layer and a second contact layer which are sequentially arranged, the first contact layer and the extraction structure are provided with a first doping type, the charge layer and the light absorption layer are provided with a second doping type, the first doping type is different from the second doping type, the first contact layer, the charge layer, the light absorption layer and the second contact layer form a first electric field together, the extraction structure is positioned on the outer side of the avalanche photoelectric diode along a second direction, the extraction structure and the light absorption layer form a second electric field together, the first direction intersects with the second direction, and the first electric field is not contacted with the second electric field. By introducing the extraction structure outside the electric field region of the original avalanche photodetector, the extraction structure can attract carriers outside, and reduce the diffusion of the carriers into the electric field region to introduce additional diffusion current, thereby reducing the noise of the device.

title_en: Bonding device, bonding method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a bonding device and a bonding method. The bonding device comprises a bonding head, a heat radiation light source and a first chuck, wherein the bonding head is used for adsorbing a piece to be bonded and bonding the piece to be bonded to a first wafer to be bonded, the heat radiation light source is used for providing light for heating the first wafer, and the first chuck is used for carrying the first wafer and allowing the light to pass through the first chuck to irradiate and heat the first wafer so as to compensate a scaling error between the piece to be bonded and the first wafer.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent element, organic electroluminescent device, electronic apparatus, light-emitting body, solar cell, and photosensor
abstract_en: An organic electroluminescent element (1) having an anode (3), a cathode (4), and a light-emitting region (5) disposed between the anode (3) and the cathode (4), wherein the light-emitting region (5) includes a first sensitization layer (51) and a first light-emitting layer (52), the first sensitization layer (51) contains a first host material and a first sensitization material, the first light-emitting layer (52) contains a second host material and a first light-emitting compound, the first host material and the second host material are different from each other, the first sensitization material and the first light-emitting compound are different from each other, and a difference [ delta ] ST (G1) between a lowest excited singlet energy S  1  (G1) of the first sensitization material and an energy gap T  77K  (G1) at 77[ K ] of the first sensitization material satisfies a formula (number 1), [ delta ] ST (G1) =S  1 (G1)-T 77K  (G1) <0.5eV. (number 1).

title_en: Wafer cutting protection liquid, preparation method and use method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a wafer cutting protection liquid, a preparation method and a use method thereof and application thereof, comprising the following components, by mass, 10-40 parts of water-soluble resin, 40-70 parts of ultrapure water and 5-15 parts of organic solvent, wherein the water-soluble resin is provided with a side chain for ion exchange, the side chain consists of a functional group containing negative charges and first metal ions, the functional group can react with second metal ions, the first metal ions in the side chain are replaced by the second metal ions, and the water-soluble resin is changed from a water-soluble state to a water-insoluble state after being replaced. The cutting protection liquid can form a layer of water-insoluble high-adhesion protection coating on the surface of the wafer, can avoid the pollution caused by particles generated during the cutting of the wafer and particles in the environment falling on the surface of the wafer, and improves the preparation yield of the wafer.

title_en: Apparatus and method for obtaining image using lens array
abstract_en: An image obtaining apparatus includes an image sensor including a microlens and a plurality of adjacent pixels sharing the microlens, and a processor configured to generate a plurality of parallax images having the same parallax based on an input image received from the image sensor, to group first parallax images having similar image characteristics among the plurality of parallax images, to perform at least one image processing operation on the first parallax images, and to generate an output image by combining the first parallax images on which the at least one image processing operation is performed.

title_en: Display device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a display device and a method of manufacturing the display device are provided. The display device includes a base layer including a display region and a peripheral region, a light emitting element disposed in the display region and including a first electrode, a second electrode, and a light emitting part disposed between the first electrode and the second electrode, an electrode breaking member disposed in the peripheral region, and an electrode portion disposed adjacent to the electrode breaking member. The electrode breaking member includes a reverse tapered member and has a shape surrounding an area in a plan view. The reverse taper member includes an inner edge facing the region. The electrode portion includes a first electrode portion disposed in the region and a second electrode portion disposed on an upper surface of the reverse tapered member along the inner edge. The first electrode portion and the second electrode portion are physically spaced apart from each other.

title_en: Method for removing bonding object of AMB copper-clad ceramic plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for removing an AMB copper-clad ceramic plate binder, which comprises the specific steps of S1, selecting aluminum oxide or glass particles as a sand blasting material, carrying out sand blasting treatment, cleaning the AMB copper-clad ceramic plate after sand blasting for removing residues generated in the sand blasting process, S2, closely arranging brush wires and fixing the brush wires on a roll shaft to form a grinding brush, carrying out grinding brush treatment on the AMB copper-clad ceramic plate, S3, carrying out annealing treatment on the AMB copper-clad ceramic plate, S4, etching a copper layer to a brazing layer by using a mixed solution of copper chloride and hydrochloric acid, etching the brazing layer by using an acid etching solution, removing the exposed solder after the AMB copper-clad ceramic plate is etched, S5, and removing a small amount of residual solder by using a chemical method.

title_en: Method for measuring temperature or thermal resistance and monitoring thermal resistance
abstract_en: A method for measuring temperature in a power electronic system comprising at least one Power Unit (PU) comprising at least one semiconductor switch (S) having a plurality of material layers Mi via m material layers, i=1, 2.....m. a stack of m is connected to a die of a heat sink (HS, 5), and wherein the at least one semiconductor switch is thermally connected in parallel with a heat source (10) via a connection layer Mj of the stacked material layers Mi, the method comprising: -providing a limited current in the at least one semiconductor switch (S) when the at least one semiconductor switch (S) is in an open state such that it does not dissipate heat, the limited current being adapted to measure a first temperature T1 of the at least one semiconductor switch using a thermal sensitive parameter of the at least one semiconductor switch in the open state; -calculating the temperature T  Mj  of the connection layer Mj to be equal to said first temperature T1.

title_en: Semiconductor test structure and test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor test structure and a test method thereof. The invention designs the test unit to comprise a first group of transistors and a second group of transistors by simulating the layout structure of the static random access memory, wherein a first interval is arranged between an active region connected to a shared contact structure in the transistors and a grid electrode, and designs a plurality of the test units, wherein the first intervals are gradually increased, and the first transistors and the second transistors in the test unit are respectively subjected to electrical test to obtain the process window parameters of the first interval.

title_en: Chip, chip design method, manufacturing method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a chip, a chip design method, a manufacturing method and a device, relates to the field of integrated circuits, and can improve the utilization rate of a chip main body structure to the chip area while ensuring that a test structure of a three-dimensional integrated chip is arranged. The chip comprises a main body structure and a test structure, wherein the main body structure and the test structure are distributed in a plurality of crystal grains of the chip to be designed, the crystal grains comprise a first crystal grain and a second crystal grain, the first crystal grain and the second crystal grain are used for being stacked and mixed and bonded with each other to form a bonding crystal grain group, the test structure comprises at least two key components, at least one part of elements of the main body structure are arranged at preset positions of the bonding crystal grain group, and at least one part of elements of the main body structure is arranged at preset positions of the bonding crystal grain group, wherein the preset positions comprise at least one part of projection coverage of the at least one key component along a first direction, and a position of which the distance between the edge of the projection coverage of the at least one key component along the first direction or the edge of the projection coverage of the key component is smaller than a preset distance threshold.

title_en: Semiconductor device structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: A semiconductor device structure includes a first electrode overlying a substrate, a node dielectric contacting the first electrode and including a dielectric material having a dielectric constant greater than 30, and a second electrode contacting the node dielectric. A first one of the first electrode and the second electrode includes a first catalytic metal plate in direct contact with the node dielectric and having a first electronegativity that is no greater than an electronegativity of molybdenum. The embodiment of the application also discloses a method for forming the semiconductor device structure.

title_en: Common-source common-gate type common Guan Danhua gallium power device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of semiconductor devices, in particular to a common-source common-gate common-Guan Danhua gallium power device and a preparation method thereof. The common-source common-gate type common Guan Danhua gallium power device comprises a diamond MOSFET and a depletion type GaN JFET which are connected with each other, wherein a first drain electrode, a plurality of first grids and a first source electrode are arranged on the depletion type GaN JFET, the diamond MOSFET is connected with the depletion type GaN JFET through metal, a second drain electrode, a second grid and a second source electrode are arranged on the diamond MOSFET, the first grids are connected in parallel and then connected with the second source electrode in series, and the first source electrode is communicated with the second drain electrode. The application realizes the control of the turn-off of the high-voltage normally-on gallium nitride JFET by using the cascode structure in a smaller space, effectively enhances the heat radiation performance of the device while maintaining the advantages of the gallium nitride material, and improves the electrical performance and the service life of the device.

title_en: Light-transmitting conductive layer and light-transmitting conductive film
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a light-transmitting conductive layer and a light-transmitting conductive film. The light-transmitting conductive layer (1) has a first main surface (2) and a second main surface (3) disposed opposite to the first main surface (2) with a gap therebetween on one surface side in the thickness direction. The light-transmitting conductive layer (1) has a single layer extending in the planar direction. The transparent conductive layer (1) contains a conductive oxide. The conductive oxide contains argon and a rare gas having an atomic number larger than that of argon.

title_en: III-nitride device with single particle irradiation resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a III-nitride device with single particle irradiation resistance. According to the invention, a hole storage layer is introduced between the buffer layer and the channel layer of the epitaxial layer structure, a hole potential well is formed on the energy band structure by the hole storage layer so as to effectively collect the irradiation induced surplus holes in the channel layer, and meanwhile, the extraction electrode and the second source electrode are arranged to respectively collect the irradiation induced surplus holes in the area below the grid electrode and between the grid sources. The extraction electrodes are arranged between grid electrodes which are arranged at intervals in sequence, and the extraction electrodes and the second source electrode are connected with the first source electrode through the metal interconnection layer. The invention can effectively improve the single particle irradiation resistance of the device, and the manufacturing process is compatible with the existing process without introducing complicated process steps.

title_en: Silicon carbide super-junction planar gate transverse MOS device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silicon carbide super-junction planar gate transverse MOS device and a manufacturing method thereof, belonging to the technical field of semiconductor devices. The device sequentially comprises a substrate and an epitaxial layer from bottom to top, wherein a drain electrode region A and a source electrode region A are respectively arranged on two sides of the epitaxial layer, drain electrode metal and source electrode metal are respectively arranged in the drain electrode region A and the source electrode region A, a p column region is arranged in the epitaxial layer, a p well region is arranged in the p column region, a p+ region is arranged in the p well region, a drain electrode region B and a source electrode region B are symmetrically arranged on adjacent sides of the p+ region, a grid oxide layer is arranged in the middle of the epitaxial layer, grid polysilicon is arranged on the upper side of the grid oxide layer, dielectric layers are arranged on the periphery side of the grid polysilicon and the upper side of the p column region, and top layer metal is arranged among the dielectric layers, on the top side of the source electrode metal and the top side of the drain electrode metal. The invention can ensure the withstand voltage of the device and improve the doping concentration of the drift region, thereby realizing higher withstand voltage and lower on-resistance of the device.

title_en: Microfluidic heat dissipation device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a microfluidic heat dissipation device and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the microfluidic heat dissipation device comprises a substrate, a first communication structure, a second communication structure, a first connector and a second connector, wherein the first communication structure is positioned in the substrate and comprises a first flow channel, a second flow channel and a first cavity communicated with the first flow channel and the second flow channel, the second communication structure is positioned in the substrate and is mutually isolated from the first communication structure, the second communication structure comprises a third flow channel, a fourth flow channel and a second cavity communicated with the third flow channel and the fourth flow channel, the first connector and the second connector are positioned on one side of the substrate in the thickness direction of the substrate, the first connector is communicated with the first flow channel, the second connector is communicated with the fourth flow channel, the second flow channel is communicated with a first port of a device to be dissipated, and the third flow channel is communicated with a second port of the device to be dissipated.

title_en: Light detection device
abstract_en: A light detection device includes a substrate including a light detection element, a chip disposed on the substrate, an embedded layer disposed to cover the chip, a seam portion that appears within the embedded layer and extends to a front surface of the embedded layer, and a sealing layer disposed to cover the embedded layer and the seam portion.

title_en: Inductively heatable particles in semiconductor modules
abstract_en: A method of producing a semiconductor module includes providing a power module assembly including a bottom surface portion, a housing surrounding an interior volume above the bottom surface portion, and a power semiconductor die mounted to a power electronics carrier within the interior volume, filling the interior volume with a potting compound, providing inductively heatable particles within the power module assembly, and inductively heating the inductively heatable particles to activate and/or accelerate chemical reactions in the potting compound.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises a pixel driving circuit, the pixel driving circuit comprises a silicon semiconductor transistor, an oxide transistor and a storage capacitor which are electrically connected, the display panel comprises a first active layer, a first grid layer and a second active layer which are sequentially stacked, a grid electrode of the oxide transistor, a grid electrode of the silicon semiconductor transistor and a first polar plate of the storage capacitor are positioned on the first grid layer, an active pattern of the oxide transistor and a second polar plate of the storage capacitor are positioned on the second active layer, and then the first grid layer can be used for forming a bottom grid of the oxide transistor, so that the active pattern of the transistor in the second active layer is prevented from being influenced by light, the photosensitivity and the electrical property of the transistor are improved, the performance of the display panel is improved, and the electrical property of the oxide transistor is improved due to the fact that the distance between the first grid layer and the second active layer is smaller.

title_en: Silicon carbide chip module package of laminated silicon nitride ceramic
abstract_en: The invention provides a silicon carbide chip module package of laminated silicon nitride ceramics, which relates to the technical field of chip package, and comprises two layers of substrates which are arranged in a laminated mode and are provided with an upper copper layer, a silicon nitride ceramic layer and a lower copper layer, wherein the lower substrate comprises an upper copper layer of the lower substrate, an upper bridge upper substrate arranged on the upper bridge copper layer of the lower substrate, and a lower bridge upper substrate arranged on the lower bridge copper layer of the lower substrate, a plurality of silicon carbide chips are electrically connected on the upper bridge copper layer of the lower substrate and the lower bridge copper layer of the lower substrate, and therefore circuit flow of current in space is achieved, and stray inductance is offset.

title_en: Driving backboard, manufacturing method of driving backboard and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a driving backboard, a preparation method of the driving backboard and a display device, wherein the driving backboard comprises a substrate, a light emitting device and a reflecting layer, the substrate comprises a wiring layer, the light emitting device is arranged on one side of the substrate, the reflecting layer and the light emitting device are arranged on the same side of the substrate, the reflecting layer is provided with a through hole, the through hole penetrates through the wiring layer, the light emitting device is electrically connected with the wiring layer through the through hole, and orthographic projection of the light emitting device on a projection plane covers orthographic projection of the through hole on the projection plane, and the projection plane is parallel to the reflecting layer. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the application can effectively improve the reflectivity of the reflecting layer, improve the light efficiency and further improve the overall optical effect of the driving backboard.

title_en: Wafer level packaging process for thin film inductor
abstract_en: One aspect relates to a method of forming an Integrated Circuit (IC) package including forming a Thin Film Inductor (TFI) over a first dummy carrier wafer, attaching an Integrated Circuit (IC) die to and over the TFI, attaching a second dummy carrier wafer to and over the IC die, removing the first dummy carrier wafer from the TFI, attaching at least one solder bump to and under the TFI, and removing the second dummy carrier wafer from the IC die. Another aspect relates to a method of forming an IC package, including forming a first redistribution layer (RDL) over a through-silicon via (TSV), forming a second RDL under the TSV, forming a Thin Film Inductor (TFI) over the first RDL, and attaching at least one Integrated Circuit (IC) die to the second RDL or the TFI.

title_en: Semiconductor device, manufacturing method thereof and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a semiconductor device, a preparation method thereof and electronic equipment, relates to the technical field of semiconductors, and aims to improve reliability of the semiconductor device. The semiconductor device comprises a substrate, an epitaxial layer positioned on one side of the substrate, a channel part and a gate semiconductor layer positioned on one side of the epitaxial layer away from the substrate, a source electrode contact layer positioned on one side of the channel part away from the substrate and a drain electrode positioned on one side of the substrate away from the epitaxial layer. The channel portion includes a first channel sub-portion and a second channel sub-portion connected, the first channel sub-portion being located between the epitaxial layer and the second channel sub-portion. The gate semiconductor layer surrounds the first channel sub-portion. The source contact layer is located on the second channel sub-portion, which separates the source contact layer and the gate semiconductor layer. The drain electrode is positioned on one side of the substrate away from the epitaxial layer. The semiconductor device is applied to a power electronic device.

title_en: Magnetic tunnel junction device, plasma modulator and information storage device
abstract_en: The application provides a magnetic tunnel junction device, a plasma modulator and an information storage device, which comprise a first electrode layer, a second electrode layer and a tunneling barrier layer which are stacked, wherein the first electrode layer is magnetic, the first electrode layer is provided with magnetic moment which is needle-shaped, the first electrode layer is grounded, the second electrode layer is magnetic, the magnetic moment which is provided with the second electrode is configured to be switchable, the second electrode layer is electrically connected with the first electrode layer in a bias way, the first electrode layer and the second electrode layer are vertically crossed and stacked, and the tunneling barrier layer is clamped between crossed areas of the first electrode layer and the second electrode layer.

title_en: Bonding device and bonding method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a bonding device and a bonding method thereof, wherein the bonding device comprises a base, a micro-motion base platform and a vertical motion assembly which are respectively arranged on the base, and further comprises a lower bonding head assembly which is arranged on the micro-motion base platform and comprises a first sucker and a first reference block, an upper bonding head assembly which is arranged on the vertical motion assembly and comprises a second sucker and a second reference block, a profile measuring assembly which comprises a horizontal motion assembly and a profile sensor, wherein the profile sensor carries out profile scanning on the upper bonding head assembly and the lower bonding head assembly, and a visual sensor detects the relative positions of the first reference block and the second reference block. According to the contour characteristics of the lower bonding head assembly and the upper bonding head assembly obtained by scanning of the contour sensor, the first sucker is adjusted through the micro-motion base station, so that horizontal alignment and vertical leveling of the upper chip and the lower chip or the wafer are realized, and the relative positions of the upper chip and the lower chip or the wafer are detected through the visual sensor before bonding, so that bonding precision is ensured.

title_en: Semiconductor discharge tube and power supply circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor discharge tube and a power supply circuit, wherein the semiconductor discharge tube comprises a first part and a second part of a semiconductor body, the first part and the second part comprise a first area, a second area, a third area and a fourth area, the first area and the second area are in the same layer and are arranged at intervals of the third area, the fourth area comprises a plurality of fourth subareas which are arranged at intervals, the fourth area is in contact with the third area, the fourth area is positioned in the vertical projection of the third area, the first area is in contact with the third area, the vertical projection of the first area in the third area is positioned in the third area, the vertical projection of the first area in the fourth area is not overlapped with the fourth subarea, the second area is in contact with the third area, the vertical projection of the second area in the fourth area is not overlapped with the fourth subarea, the first part and the second part are symmetrically arranged, and the vertical projection of the fourth area of the first part in the fourth area in the second part is not overlapped with the fourth area of the second part. The invention can increase the initial conducting area of the device and improve the reliability of the device.

title_en: Vehicle component with integrated photovoltaic element, vehicle comprising same and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: Provided are a vehicle component having an integrated photovoltaic element, a vehicle having the same, and a method of manufacturing the same. A vehicle component having at least one integrated photovoltaic element includes a component body, at least one region of a barrier layer disposed on at least a portion of a surface of the component body, and at least one photovoltaic element disposed over the region of the barrier layer. The coating covers portions of the surface of the component body surrounding the photovoltaic element. A method of manufacturing a vehicle component having at least one integrated photovoltaic element includes applying at least one region of a barrier layer over at least a portion of a surface of the component and applying at least one photovoltaic element over the region of the barrier layer. A protective layer is applied over the surface of the photovoltaic element, the surface of the component is painted, and then the protective layer can be removed to expose the photovoltaic element.

title_en: Organic compound, organic electroluminescent device and electronic device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of organic electroluminescent materials, and provides an organic compound, an organic electroluminescent device comprising the same and an electronic device. The organic compound of the application comprises a mother nucleus structure formed by fusing 7H-benzo [ C ] carbazole and dibenzofuran or dibenzothiophene through pyrrole rings, and when the compound of the application is used as a hole transport type main body material in a mixed main body material, the carrier balance in a light-emitting layer can be improved, the carrier recombination region can be widened, the exciton generation and utilization efficiency can be improved, and the light-emitting efficiency and the service life of a device can be improved.

title_en: Transplanting machine for combining die bonder
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of die bonders, in particular to a transplanter for combining a die bonder, which comprises a main conveying component, wherein a sub-transferring device is arranged at the rear end of the main conveying component, sub-transferring devices are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the sub-transferring device, the sub-transferring device comprises a guide sliding frame, guide rolling balls are uniformly arranged on the upper side and the lower side of an inner cavity of the guide sliding frame, the front end of the guide sliding frame is fixedly connected with a height adjusting frame, and the inner wall of the guide sliding frame is in sliding connection with a sliding frame component. The device can combine single-head die bonder and multi-head die bonder through the mode of establishing ties, and then connect two kinds of die bonders through the mode of establishing ties, after the device is used in the centre of two kinds of die bonders to combine, can realize the circuit board transportation work that single track turned to double track operation, and then still can utilize the single-head die bonder of old equipment under the condition of the multi-head die bonder of mill newly-added equipment, make the mill not only realize efficiency promotion but also further utilize old equipment.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant bidirectional silicon controlled rectifier structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-resistant bidirectional thyristor structure which comprises a P-type epitaxial layer, wherein two first N-type well doped type well regions are formed in the middle of the P-type epitaxial layer, the two first N-type well doped type well regions are arranged between the two first N-type well doped type well regions so as to divide the P-type epitaxial layer into a first epitaxial layer region, a second epitaxial layer region and a third epitaxial layer region, a first P-type high-voltage doped type well region is provided in an injection region on the first epitaxial layer region, a first P-type well doped type well region is provided in an injection region on the first P-type high-voltage doped type well region, a first P-type heavily doped active region and a first N-type heavily doped active region are provided at the top end of the first P-type well doped type well region, and the first P-type heavily doped active region and the first N-type heavily doped active region are arranged in an isolated manner. The ESD release path is adjusted to be deeper by the design of the base region slotting, so that the heat dissipation of the chip is facilitated, and the current release attenuation degree of the chip at high temperature is reduced.

title_en: Aromatic amine compound, composition and organic electroluminescent device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an arylamine compound, a composition and an organic electroluminescent device. The structural general formula of the compound is shown as formula (1):  wherein ring A is selected from the following formula (2) or formula (3):   At least one of R  1w 、R 1x 、R 1y 、R 1z 、R 2 -R 7  is selected from the following formula (4) or formula (5):     The compound has the advantages of low sublimation temperature, low driving voltage, high luminous efficiency, long service life of the device and the like, and can be used as a main material for OLED luminous devices.

title_en: Package structure and method for forming the same
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to semiconductor manufacturing technology, and more particularly, to a package structure and a method for forming the same. The packaging structure comprises a frame, a chip and a connecting structure, wherein the frame comprises a base island and pins positioned on the periphery of the base island, the chip is mounted on the top surface of the base island and comprises a back surface facing the base island and a front surface facing away from the base island, the chip is electrically connected with the pins, the connecting structure comprises a micro-nano metal interconnection layer positioned between the base island and the chip, one end of the micro-nano metal interconnection layer is connected with the top surface of the base island, and the other end of the micro-nano metal interconnection layer is connected with the back surface of the chip. The invention obviously improves the heat radiation performance of the packaging structure, simplifies the manufacturing process of the packaging structure, avoids the problem that voids or layering are easy to generate in the adhesive layer when the adhesive layer is used for connection, and improves the reliability of the packaging structure.

title_en: Solar cell module packaged by silica gel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of solar cell modules, and particularly relates to a solar cell module and a preparation method thereof. The solar cell module packaged by the silica gel comprises a front plate, a silica gel packaging layer, a cell, a silica gel packaging layer and a back plate from top to bottom, wherein the silica gel packaging layer is formed by sequentially stacking, laminating, defoaming and heating and solidifying the silica gel packaging layer between the cell and the front plate and between the cell and the back plate through a silica gel adhesive, and the thickness of the silica gel packaging layer is 0.01-0.1mm. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the problem of insufficient adhesive force of the silica gel is solved by grafting modification and proper raw material selection, and the application of the silica gel on the packaging adhesive film is realized by adopting direct hot-pressing crosslinking after on-site preparation and spraying, so that the production cost is effectively reduced due to the excellent characteristic of the silica gel.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor device and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the manufacturing method of the semiconductor device comprises the steps of providing a substrate; forming a substrate, forming a buffer layer on the substrate, forming a hard mask layer on the buffer layer, forming an opening penetrating through the hard mask layer and the buffer layer, etching back the buffer layer on the side wall of the opening so that the buffer layer on the side wall of the opening is retracted relative to the hard mask layer and the substrate to form an air gap, forming a blocking layer to seal the air gap, and carrying out local thermal oxidation on the substrate on the inner wall of the opening to form a field oxide layer. According to the technical scheme, the bird's beak-shaped transverse extension part formed at the edge of the field oxide layer can be avoided, so that the reduction of the area of the active area surrounded by the field oxide layer is avoided.

title_en: MOSFET device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a MOSFET device and a manufacturing method thereof. The MOSFET device includes an active area and a termination area. The termination region surrounds the periphery of the active region. The MOSFET device comprises a silicon carbide substrate and a silicon carbide epitaxial layer which are stacked. The active region comprises a plurality of grid structures which are arranged at intervals along a first direction and extend along a second direction, wherein the grid structures are arranged on one side of the silicon carbide epitaxial layer, which is far away from the silicon carbide substrate, and the first direction and the second direction are parallel to the silicon carbide substrate, and have preset angles. The terminal region comprises a grid line layer, wherein the grid line layer is arranged on one side of the silicon carbide epitaxial layer, which is far away from the silicon carbide substrate, and the grid line layer is electrically connected with each grid structure.

title_en: Polishing slurry and method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: A polishing slurry and a method of manufacturing a semiconductor device are provided, wherein the polishing slurry includes nano abrasive particles having a Mohs hardness of greater than about 5, and soft particles having a Mohs hardness lower than the nano abrasive particles, and wherein the nano abrasive particles and the soft particles have the same zeta potential sign as each other in the slurry.

title_en: Chip performance detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chip detection and discloses a chip performance detection device which comprises a box body, wherein a conveying device, a detection mechanism and a transfer mechanism are arranged in the box body, the transfer mechanism comprises a grooved wheel, a driving plate and a driving motor, a first shaft is fixedly connected to the bottom of the driving plate, the bottom of the first shaft is connected with the bottom of the box body through a bearing, a driven belt wheel is fixedly connected to the first shaft, a driving belt wheel is arranged at the output end of the driving motor, the driving belt wheel is connected with the driven belt wheel through a belt transmission, a second shaft is fixedly connected to the center of the grooved wheel.

title_en: Method, system, data processing device and computer program for constructing modules
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method (100) for constructing a module (30) which is provided with at least two electronic components (50), comprising the steps of defining (101) a removal pattern which predefines a specific removal path (60) for a component position on at least one wafer (40) on which the components (50) are provided for constructing the module, starting (102) a removal process in which the components (50) are removed from the at least one wafer along the removal path (60), starting (103) a construction process in which the modules (30) are provided with the removed components (50). According to the invention, the extraction path (60) is defined taking into account at least one dependence of the electrical properties of the component (50) and the component position on at least one wafer (40). The invention also relates to a system for constructing modules, and to a corresponding device and computer program for processing data.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a display panel and a display device. The display panel comprises an array substrate, an isolation structure, a light-emitting layer and a touch layer, wherein the isolation structure is arranged on one side of the array substrate and is provided with a light-transmitting opening and an isolation opening, the isolation opening is at least located in the first area, the light-transmitting opening is located in the second area, the light-emitting layer comprises a light-emitting unit arranged in the isolation opening, the touch layer is arranged on one side, away from the array substrate, of the light-emitting layer and is provided with a touch area and a non-touch area, the touch layer comprises a touch electrode arranged in the touch area and a virtual electrode arranged in the non-touch area, the touch electrode and the virtual electrode are arranged in an insulating mode, at least part of the touch area is located in the first area, and at least part of the non-touch area is located in the second area. In the display panel provided by the application, the signals in the array substrate and the touch signals are not easy to cross talk with each other.

title_en: Thermoelectric elastomer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermoelectric elastomer and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of new energy sources of organic thermoelectric materials. In the invention, in the presence of a doping agent and a cross-linking agent, a conjugated polymer and an elastomer material are reacted in a solvent to obtain the thermoelectric elastomer. The thermoelectric elastomer prepared by the invention has the characteristics of high stretching ratio, high strain recovery, high thermoelectric performance, low Young modulus and unique strain enhanced thermoelectric performance, and the thermoelectric integrated module based on the thermoelectric elastomer has excellent skin congruency, can accurately sense the temperature change of a human body, generate electricity by utilizing the skin heat of the human body, and can realize stable voltage output in thousands of stretching-releasing cycles. The preparation method disclosed by the invention has universality and has good application prospects in the fields of organic electronics, wearable electronics, energy recovery and the like.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present application relates to a semiconductor device and a method of manufacturing the semiconductor device. A semiconductor device may include a first gate line, a second gate line, a channel structure extending through the first and second gate lines, first contact plugs extending through the first gate line and connected to front surfaces of the first gate lines, respectively, and second contact plugs extending through the second gate line and connected to rear surfaces of the second gate lines, respectively.

title_en: MSi-based2N4Semiconductor heterojunction with mediated interface regulation and control and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of research and development and application of novel semiconductor devices, in particular to a semiconductor heterojunction based on MSi  2 N 4  mediated interface regulation and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein M is a metal element such as Mo, W and the like. The heterojunction consists of a top metal electrode, a MSi  2 N 4  film insertion layer, a germanium substrate and a bottom metal electrode from top to bottom, wherein the top metal electrode is used as a Schottky contact electrode or an ohmic contact electrode. According to the invention, a silicon-nitrogen compound semiconductor is formed by adjusting metal element components in MSi  2 N 4 , interface regulation and control are mediated by adopting an inserted single-layer two-dimensional semiconductor film MSi  2 N 4 , the Fermi level pinning effect at a p-type germanium interface is relieved, a unique Si-N atomic structure is beneficial to reducing a gap state induced by a metal electrode, an inserted layer has atomic thickness without introducing obvious extra resistance, schottky contact and ohmic contact of p-type germanium are realized by matching with electrodes with different work functions, and the stability and the overall performance of a device are improved.

title_en: Process for improving uniformity of sheet resistance of front boron furnace mouth of TOPcon battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TOPcon battery technology for improving the sheet resistance uniformity of a front boron furnace mouth, which comprises the following steps of furnace tube feeding, vacuumizing, heating, constant temperature, leakage detection, heating, diffusion/deposition, blowing, distributed cooling 1, distributed cooling 2, vacuum breaking and boat discharging. Compared with the prior art, the invention ensures that the paddle temperature, the furnace mouth boron source atmosphere and the environmental difference in process are reduced in a short time by adding the air running process and adding the deposition/diffusion step, thereby improving the STD of the furnace mouth silicon wafer, improving the uniformity of single sheet square resistance, reducing the poor proportion of PL and improving the A-level duty ratio of the solar cell.

title_en: Micro-LED Micro display chip and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a Micro-LED Micro display chip and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of Micro display. The chip comprises a driving panel, a plurality of LED units, and a wavelength conversion layer, wherein the wavelength conversion layer at least comprises a plurality of first wavelength conversion units, the first wavelength conversion units are arranged above the light emitting surface of the LED units, the first wavelength conversion units are provided with first curved surfaces, and the first wavelength conversion units are used for converting first color light emitted by the LED units into second color light and gathering the second color light. In the embodiment of the application, the wavelength conversion layer in the Micro-LED Micro-display chip has two functions at the same time, and specifically comprises the function of converting the first color light emitted by the LED unit into other color light and the function of gathering the converted color light, so that the thickness of the Micro-LED Micro-display chip is thinner and the preparation process is simpler while the display brightness of the Micro-LED Micro-display chip is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of submicron pyramid suede on surface of crystalline silicon
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of crystalline silicon solar cell materials, and particularly discloses a preparation method of submicron pyramid suede on the surface of crystalline silicon. Immersing the silicon wafer into the solution, and preparing the compact submicron pyramid suede at the temperature of 60-80 ℃ for 4-10 minutes. Compared with the conventional submicron suede preparation process, the preparation method of the submicron suede on the surface of the crystalline silicon has the advantages of simple process flow, few steps, short suede preparation time, no need of expensive equipment and low risk of organic pollution.

title_en: Method for improving external quantum efficiency of blue light QLED
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of material science efficiency improvement, and particularly discloses a method for improving the external quantum efficiency of a blue light QLED, which comprises a gradient hole injection structure and a PEDOT-PSSQLED-free structure, wherein the gradient hole injection structure is used for injecting materials by introducing a plurality of gradient holes with gradient energy level distribution between a typical hole transmission layer and a blue quantum dot emission layer, a core layer of the gradient hole injection material is Poly-TPD, the energy level of the highest occupied molecular track of the Poly-TPD is subjected to fine customization through small molecule TCTA, an initial layer of the gradient hole injection structure is a composite layer formed by PEDOT-PSS or TFB and Poly-TPD, and the gradient hole injection structure adopts a gradient hole transmission material of a multi-component mixed system, and forms a composite material with continuous gradient energy distribution by adjusting the proportion and the variety of each component, so that the material can better match the energy level difference between different layers, realize high-efficiency transmission and injection of hole energy, and further improve the performance of the blue light QLED.

title_en: Back contact solar cell, photovoltaic module and photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of solar cells, and provides a back contact solar cell which comprises a silicon wafer, wherein an edge main grid and an intermediate main grid adjacent to the edge main grid are arranged on the back surface of the silicon wafer, a first thin grid line arranged on the edge main grid, and a second thin grid line arranged on the intermediate main grid, wherein the first thin grid line comprises a first edge thin grid and a second edge thin grid, one of the first edge thin grid and the second edge thin grid is an unequal width section, the other one of the first edge thin grid and the second edge thin grid is an equal width section, the width of the equal width section is larger than or equal to that of the second thin grid line, and the average width of the unequal width section is larger than that of the equal width section. According to the invention, the width of the first thin grid line is integrally set to be larger than that of the second thin grid line, so that the carrier collecting capacity of the first thin grid line is improved, the contact resistance or series resistance of the metal grid line and the silicon wafer is reduced, the binding force of the metal grid line and the silicon wafer is improved, and the working efficiency of the battery is improved.

title_en: Gas supply module and substrate processing apparatus including the same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gas supply module for performing substrate processing by gasifying and supplying gas, and a substrate processing device comprising the same, wherein the substrate processing device comprises a process chamber, a gas supply module and a main body part, wherein a processing space is formed inside the process chamber, an introduction port for introducing the process gas is formed, the gas supply module is arranged at the introduction port and is used for supplying the process gas to the processing space through gasifying by ultrasonic waves, the gas supply module comprises an atomization part and a main body part, the atomization part is used for receiving processing liquid from outside and atomizing the processing liquid by ultrasonic waves and spraying the processing liquid, the main body part is arranged between the atomization part and the process chamber, a gasification space communicated with the processing space is formed inside the main body part, and the fluid conveyed by the atomization part is gasified into the process gas and is supplied to the processing space through forming a low-pressure environment in the gasification space.

title_en: Utilizing ionic van der Waals monocrystal Sb4O5Cl2Method for regulating and controlling two-dimensional semiconductor material carrier
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for regulating and controlling carriers of a two-dimensional semiconductor material by utilizing ionic van der Waals monocrystal Sb  4 O 5 Cl 2 , and belongs to the field of preparation of two-dimensional materials. And releasing the stripped single crystal nano-sheet Sb  4 O 5 Cl 2  on a substrate by utilizing a heat release adhesive, spin-coating anisole solution (PPC) of polypropylene carbonate, drying, removing the PPC and the Sb  4 O 5 Cl 2  single crystal nano-sheet by using polydimethylsiloxane, and transferring the Sb  4 O 5 Cl 2  single crystal nano-sheet to a two-dimensional semiconductor material loaded on the substrate by utilizing a fixed point transfer method to serve as a dielectric layer. The vertical migration of Cl ions in the Sb  4 O 5 Cl 2  monocrystal nano sheet is realized under the action of polarized electric fields in different directions, and the ion-electron coupling is realized at the interface of the dielectric layer and the channel of the two-dimensional semiconductor material, so that the regulation and control effect on the carrier concentration of the channel of the two-dimensional semiconductor material is realized.

title_en: Method and device for repairing laminated battery string
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for repairing a laminated battery string, according to the method for repairing the laminated battery string, the first welding strip group and the second welding strip group welded on the defective battery piece are firstly unwelded with the defective battery piece by heating the defective battery piece. And then pressing the first side film strip and the second side film strip on the defective battery piece, and controlling the first side adjacent battery piece and the second side adjacent battery piece to move away from the defective battery piece so that the first side film strip and the second side film strip are separated from the first side adjacent battery piece and the second side adjacent battery piece respectively. And then cutting off the first welding strip group and the second welding strip group, removing the defective battery piece, and welding the replacement battery piece with the first replacement film strip, the second replacement film strip, the first replacement welding strip group and the second replacement welding strip group to the position where the defective battery piece is removed, thereby finishing the repair of the laminated battery string. The method for repairing the laminated battery string realizes automatic repair of the laminated battery string.

title_en: Method for improving accuracy of silver electrode in silicon-based OLED
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of OLED (organic light emitting diode), in particular to a method for improving the accuracy of a silver electrode in a silicon-based OLED. The invention provides a method for improving the accuracy of a silver electrode in a silicon-based OLED, which comprises the following steps of sequentially preparing a first conductive layer, a silver electrode layer and a second conductive layer on the surface of a substrate, sequentially developing and photoetching, and then carrying out dry etching to obtain a patterned silver electrode, removing photoresist on the surface of the patterned silver electrode, and removing silver oxide on the surface of the patterned silver electrode by adopting dilute nitric acid to obtain the OLED, wherein the line width between the silver electrodes in the OLED is less than 0.1 mu m. The method can prepare the silver electrode with high precision and can overcome the problem that the surface of the silver electrode is oxidized.

title_en: Wafer bonding method and application thereof in preparation of composite substrate
abstract_en: The application relates to a wafer bonding method and application thereof in preparation of a composite substrate, and belongs to the technical field of processing of composite substrates. The wafer bonding method comprises the steps of 1) carrying out ion implantation on a piezoelectric wafer to obtain a wafer implantation sheet, wherein the wafer implantation sheet sequentially comprises a film layer, an implantation layer and a residual layer, 2) carrying out separation treatment on the film layer of the wafer implantation sheet and a support substrate, enabling a first bonding surface of the wafer implantation sheet and a second bonding surface of the support substrate to be opposite and aligned, simultaneously carrying out first heating on the wafer implantation sheet and the support substrate, approaching each other and carrying out bonding treatment, 3) applying first pressure on the first bonding surface and the second bonding surface and keeping the first pressure for a period of time, 4) reducing the first pressure to the second pressure and carrying out second heating, 5) carrying out third heating and keeping the temperature for a period of time to separate the film layer from the residual layer, and obtaining the composite substrate. The method can improve the quality and yield of the composite substrate, and has low warpage and small hole number.

title_en: Power device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a power device and a preparation method thereof, wherein the device comprises a substrate, an epitaxial layer, an active region, a variable doping terminal structure and a variable doping terminal structure, the substrate comprises a first surface, the epitaxial layer is arranged on the first surface, the active region is arranged on one side of the epitaxial layer, which is away from the substrate, the variable doping terminal structure is arranged on one side of the epitaxial layer, which is away from the substrate, and comprises a plurality of layers of film layers which are arranged in a stacked manner in a first direction, the first direction is perpendicular to the substrate and points to the direction, which is away from the substrate, the plurality of layers of film layers have different doping concentrations, the length of the plurality of layers of film layers in a second direction is gradually reduced along the first direction, one end of the plurality of layers of film layers in the second direction is provided with a slope structure, the second direction is perpendicular to the first direction, and the active region points to the direction of the slope structure, so that the preparation process of the terminal structure of the power device is complex, the implantation doping depth is limited, and the process control is difficult to realize the designed doping target in the prior art.

title_en: Active matrix substrate, in-cell touch panel and display device
abstract_en: Provided are an active matrix substrate, an In-cell touch panel, and a display device, wherein display unevenness can be prevented and the number of touch detection lines can be increased. The active matrix substrate 1 has a plurality of source lines 14a and a plurality of touch detection lines 30. Each of the plurality of touch detection lines (30) includes a first portion (31) extending along one of the plurality of source lines (14 a) and a second portion (32) disposed at a position not overlapping the plurality of source lines (14 a), and the second portions of adjacent touch detection lines are alternately arranged side by side in a direction extending along the source line (14 a).

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor device and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the semiconductor device comprises a substrate, a plurality of magnetic tunneling junction (magnetic tunneling junction, MTJ) structures and a writing structure. The MTJ structure is disposed over the substrate, and the write structure is disposed over and connected to the plurality of MTJ structures. The write structure includes a plurality of spin-orbit torque (SOT) patterns and a conductive layer. The SOT patterns are separated from each other, and each SOT pattern is arranged on one of the MTJ structures and connected with the MTJ structure. The conductive layer covers the plurality of SOT patterns, is partially disposed on the plurality of SOT patterns in a vertical direction and is partially disposed between the plurality of SOT patterns in a first horizontal direction.

title_en: Read-only memory array, integrated circuit device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A Read Only Memory (ROM) array includes first through fourth rows of four ROM bits positioned on a front side of a semiconductor substrate along respective first through fourth active regions, first through fourth metal lines aligned with the first through fourth active regions in a first direction and located in a first front side metal layer of the semiconductor substrate, and fifth through eighth metal lines aligned with the first through fourth active regions in the first direction and located in a first back side metal layer of the semiconductor substrate. The first to fourth metal lines include one of bit lines or source lines of the ROM array, and the fifth to eighth metal lines include the other of bit lines or source lines of the ROM array. The embodiment of the application also discloses an integrated circuit device and a manufacturing method thereof.

title_en: Deuterated composition containing phenyl naphtyl anthracene compound and phenyl naphtyl anthracene compound
abstract_en: The invention provides a deuterated composition containing a phenyl naphthyl anthracene compound and the phenyl naphthyl anthracene compound. The phenyl naphtyl anthracene compound has a structure shown in the following formula (I). The deuterated composition containing the phenyl naphthlene compound and the phenyl naphthlene compound provided by the invention can be used as a main material of a luminescent layer of an OLED luminescent device, so that the OLED luminescent device has lower driving voltage, higher current efficiency and longer service life.

title_en: Mask frame for evaporation and remanufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A mask frame for evaporation and a remanufacturing method thereof are provided. The mask frame for evaporation includes a first frame portion, a second frame portion on the first frame portion, a third frame portion on the second frame portion, first holes provided in the first frame portion and the second frame portion, and second holes provided in the third frame portion and connected to the first holes.

title_en: PMOS device structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a PMOS device structure and a preparation method thereof. The PMOS device structure comprises a substrate, a preset seed crystal layer, a germanium-silicon seed crystal layer and a germanium-silicon main body layer, wherein a grid structure is formed on the substrate, a source-drain groove is formed on the surface of the substrate on at least one side of the grid structure, the preset seed crystal layer is positioned in the substrate at the bottom of the source-drain groove, the germanium-silicon seed crystal layer is positioned on the side wall and the bottom surface of the source-drain groove, the germanium-silicon main body layer is filled in the source-drain groove on the surface of the germanium-silicon seed crystal layer, and the germanium concentration of the preset seed crystal layer and the germanium concentration of the germanium-silicon seed crystal layer are smaller than those in the germanium-silicon main body layer. The PMOS device structure can optimize the distribution of germanium concentration, reduce dislocation and defects caused by lattice mismatch, and improve the operation speed and response performance of the PM OS device structure.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method of forming the same
abstract_en: A semiconductor device and a method of forming the same are provided. The semiconductor device may include a substrate, a fin structure protruding from the substrate, an isolation region on the substrate and along a sidewall of the fin structure, a nanostructure stack including a first nanostructure located over the fin structure, a gate structure extending between and surrounding the nanostructures of the nanostructure stack, and first and second source/drain regions. The nanostructure stack may be located between the first source/drain region and the second source/drain region. The upper portion of the isolation region may contain a first dopant of a first inert gas element.

title_en: Fusion type carrier transport layer growth method and application
abstract_en: A fusion type carrier transmission layer growth method and application belong to the field of optoelectronic devices. The invention utilizes plasma enhanced chemical deposition (PLASMA ENHANCED CHEMICAL vapour deposition-PECVD) technology to grow nano silicon (oxygen) film (namely nc-Si (O  x ): H), and utilizes magnetron sputtering technology to grow wide-band gap metal Oxide film (such as high work function type Oxide (MoOx, niOx, V  2 O X , etc.), low work function type Oxide (MgO, tiOx, znO, znxSn  1‑x  O, etc.), thereby forming and obtaining the fused [ Oxide/nc-Si (Ox): H ] film carrier transmission layer. The metal oxide film in the invention provides good light transmittance and carrier conductivity, and the composite film can be applied to photoelectric devices, obviously improves the open-circuit voltage of the devices and reduces parasitic absorption of an emitter or a window layer.

title_en: Fast exchange MRAM with aluminum-manganese-germanium free layer combined with chromium diffusion barrier
abstract_en: A Magnetic Tunnel Junction (MTJ) pillar (or array thereof) is disclosed, each having a magnetic free layer (160) (comprising a fast exchange material such as aluminum or a metal such as gallium), a magnetic reference layer (124), and a tunnel barrier layer (150) separating the two magnetic layers. A chromium-containing diffusion barrier layer disposed between the magnetic free layer (160) and the tunnel barrier layer (150) prevents diffusion of aluminum (or gallium) from the magnetic free layer into the tunnel barrier layer of the MTJ pillar. Also disclosed are devices using the fast switching MTJ(s) and methods of fabricating the fast switching MTJ(s). It enables devices with reduced Resistive Areas (RA). The use of AlMnGe alloys to fabricate a magnetic free layer with a tetragonal crystal structure and a lower magnetic moment that supports a higher magnetic orientation exchange speed is provided.

title_en: Mask plate manufacturing method, mask plate and mask assembly
abstract_en: The application provides a manufacturing method of a mask plate, the mask plate and a mask assembly, wherein the manufacturing method of the mask plate comprises the steps of obtaining offset difference data of the mask plate and a substrate in the evaporation process; the method comprises the steps of determining a region to be compensated based on offset difference data between a mask plate and a mask plate substrate, determining compensation amounts respectively corresponding to at least partial openings in at least one mask plate opening group included in the region to be compensated based on the offset difference data between the mask plate and the mask plate substrate, and compensating at least partial openings in at least one mask plate opening group included in the region to be compensated based on the compensation amounts respectively corresponding to at least partial openings in at least one mask plate opening group included in the region to be compensated. In the evaporation process, the openings of the compensated mask plate correspond to the orthographic projections on the substrate and the pixel units one by one, so that the pixel position accuracy of evaporation is improved.

title_en: Light-emitting diode for improving transfer tearing and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a light emitting diode for improving transfer tearing and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of photoelectron manufacturing. The light emitting diode comprises a substrate, a bonding layer, an epitaxial layer and a passivation layer, wherein the bonding layer is positioned on the substrate, the epitaxial layer is positioned on the surface, away from the substrate, of the bonding layer, the side wall of the epitaxial layer is provided with a protruding structure, and the passivation layer is positioned on the surface, away from the substrate, of the epitaxial layer, the side wall of the epitaxial layer and the surface, away from the substrate, of the protruding structure. The embodiment of the disclosure can improve the problem that the passivation layer is torn in the process of stripping the epitaxial layer.

title_en: Display glass, edge covering assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides display glass, an edge covering assembly and a vehicle, wherein the display glass comprises a glass body and a flexible display film layer, the glass body comprises an outer glass plate, a bonding layer and an inner glass plate which are sequentially connected in a laminated mode along the thickness direction of the glass body, the flexible display film layer comprises a flexible substrate with flexibility, a display film and wires, the flexible substrate comprises a first part, the display film comprises a display layer and an electrode layer, the electrode layer and the display film are sequentially connected to the first part in a laminated mode, the wires are stacked on one side, facing away from the display layer, of the first part, the wires penetrate through the flexible substrate and the electrode layer to be electrically connected, the electrode layer is provided with printing patterns, the display film, the wires and the first part of the flexible substrate are embedded in the bonding layer, the display film is positioned between the outer glass plate and the first part, the display layer faces the outer glass plate, the wires enable the electrode layer to form a uniform electric field after being electrified, the display layer can display decorative patterns under the effect of the uniform electric field, and the decorative patterns are consistent with the printing patterns.

title_en: Preparation method of glass core structure capable of being wired
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a wire-capable glass core structure, which relates to the field of chips and comprises the steps of S1, manufacturing a penetrating glass through hole on two glass cores, grooving one glass through hole, S2, plating a seed layer on the glass through hole, S3, manufacturing a corresponding circuit pattern, S4, manufacturing an electroplating circuit in the glass through hole, S5, bonding a first end of the glass core on a piece of carrier glass by using a bonding process, S6, preparing a plurality of rewiring layers at a second end of the glass core, S7, stripping the carrier glass, carrying out chemical mechanical grinding on a first end of a stripped substrate, S8, connecting the first ends of the two glass cores together, preparing a single-sided multilayer rewiring layer by using the glass cores, mixing and bonding the two glass cores, enabling wires to be arranged between the core layers, obtaining double-layer superposition of the rewiring layers, being suitable for a packaging process of a high-layer number of rewiring layers, and enabling the second end of the glass core to be not limited to be a rewiring layer, and being an ABF increasing layer.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted electronic control device
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-vehicle electronic control device, which uses a normal-temperature curable heat-dissipating material with a curing time of 40 hours or less at 15 ℃. The present invention provides a vehicle-mounted electronic control device in which a predetermined heat radiation material is interposed between an electronic component and a heat radiation member, wherein the predetermined heat radiation material is a material based on a silicone resin, and when quantitative analysis is performed on the molar concentration of vinyl structure [ -Si-ch=ch  2  ] and the molar concentration of main chain structure [ -Si-CH  2 CH 2  -Si- ] in the silicone resin using a nuclear magnetic resonance device, the relationship of "[ -Si-ch=ch  2 ]/[-Si-CH 2 CH 2  -Si- ] of 0.85" is satisfied.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a semiconductor element having a plurality of electrodes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor element. The semiconductor device includes a substrate, a first bit line, a first word line, a channel structure, a first dielectric layer, a second dielectric layer, and a trench. The first bit line is arranged on the substrate and extends along a first direction, the first word line is arranged on the first bit line and extends along a second direction perpendicular to the first direction, the channel structure is arranged on the first bit line and penetrates through the first word line, and the trench capacitor is arranged on the first bit line. The channel structure is separated from the first word line by a gate dielectric layer.

title_en: Synthesis and electroluminescent application of phenanthroimidazole- fu -containing blue-light thermal exciton material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blue light thermal exciton material with a molecular structure of phenanthroimidazole- The nucleus is based on structural modification by linking different aromatic ring or aromatic heterocyclic ring containing groups and derivatives thereof, including halo or alkyl substituents thereof. The invention also discloses a blue light thermal exciton luminescence device. The invention utilizes phenanthroimidazole- Length Cheng Gonge of core and modifying group and phenanthroimidazole bipolar transmission and The characteristic of staggered arrangement of nuclear energy levels realizes high luminous efficiency and high exciton utilization rate mainly based on a exciton mechanism, and then the high-efficiency undoped organic light-emitting diode is obtained.

title_en: Flip LED packaging device and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an inverted LED packaging device, which relates to the technical field of semiconductor devices, and comprises the steps of stamping, electroplating and injection molding a coiled strip type metal plate to form a coiled strip type LED bracket; bonding the flip LED chip on the tape type LED bracket through soldering paste to finish die bonding; solder paste is used for connecting a bonding pad of the flip LED chip with a conductive area on the tape-type LED bracket in a reflow soldering mode; the invention can solve the technical problems of low process efficiency in the prior art that the chip type LED bracket is adopted for packaging.

title_en: Display device, display panel and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A display device, a display panel and a method of manufacturing the same.
