The light emitting device of the display panel is arranged on one side of the driving backboard, the light emitting device comprises a first light emitting device, a second light emitting device and a third light emitting device which emit light with different colors, each light emitting device is divided into a plurality of light emitting units distributed along a first direction and a second direction in an array mode, the light emitting units comprise at least one of the second light emitting device and the third light emitting device and the first light emitting device, the orthographic projection area of the first light emitting device on the driving backboard is larger than 4 times of the orthographic projection area of any one of the second light emitting device and the third light emitting device on the driving backboard, the plurality of lens arrays are distributed on one side, far away from the driving backboard, of the light emitting devices, the lenses comprise first lenses overlapped with the first light emitting devices, and the lenses shrink in the direction far away from the driving backboard and are used for converging light rays emitted by the light emitting devices overlapped with the lenses.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a display device. According to one aspect of the present disclosure, a display device includes a cover window, a display panel disposed under the cover window and including a display area provided with a plurality of sub-pixels and an optical area disposed between the plurality of sub-pixels in the display area and having a through hole disposed therein, an adhesive layer disposed under the display panel and including a first adhesive unit disposed to surround the through hole and having conductivity and a second adhesive unit surrounding the first adhesive unit, and a metal plate disposed under the adhesive layer.

title_en: Method for improving film crack after top metal chemical mechanical polishing
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving film cracks after top metal chemical mechanical polishing, which comprises the steps of forming a first lining layer on the surface of a metal layer by adopting an atomic layer deposition technology after etching or depositing the metal layer, forming a second lining layer on the first lining layer, forming an insulating medium layer on the second lining layer, carrying out planarization treatment on the insulating medium layer, and forming a protective covering layer on the planarized surface, wherein the first lining layer is an atomic layer deposited insulating layer with high interface adhesion and compactness. The method can eliminate the defect of film cracks (FILM CRACK), the first lining formed by ALD has strong compactness, can effectively block the corrosion of plasmas in the subsequent process to the metal layer, reduces Plasma Induced Damage (PID), is suitable for copper-aluminum composite layer (Cu+Al) and all-copper redistribution layer (RDL) structures, and covers various terminal packaging scenes.

title_en: Power module
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a power module, which relates to the technical field of integrated circuits, wherein the power module comprises a substrate assembly, a power chip set and a laminated busbar assembly. The substrate assembly is provided with a plurality of functionally independent metal layers. The power chip set is arranged above the substrate assembly and comprises upper bridge power chips and lower bridge power chips, and the electric parameters of the power chips are consistent and are uniformly distributed on the substrate assembly. The laminated busbar assembly is arranged above the power chip group and comprises a positive direct current busbar, a negative direct current busbar and an alternating current busbar, wherein the positive direct current busbar and the negative direct current busbar are parallel and are arranged up and down, and the positive direct current busbar, the negative direct current busbar and the alternating current busbar are respectively electrically connected with the upper bridge power chip, the lower bridge power chip and the metal layer of the substrate assembly. The power module optimizes the layout mode, fully considers the current equalizing effect and the heat dissipation requirement, can ensure the high-efficiency stable operation of the power module, and prolongs the service life of the power module.

title_en: LDMOS device with angle-variable funnel-shaped field oxide structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an LDMOS device with an angle-variable funnel-shaped field oxide structure. According to the invention, the STI side wall angle is regulated and controlled in a segmented manner, an inclined angle structure is introduced at a position close to the high-voltage drift region to form a gradual change field oxygen boundary, so that the transverse expansion and gradient slow release of an electric field at the edge of the drift region can be realized, the electric field concentration effect at the STI corner is obviously weakened, the structural stability of the vertical boundary at the lower part is maintained, and the stress concentration caused by deep groove etching is avoided. Finally, compared with the traditional STI LDMOS structure with a single side wall angle, the STI LDMOS structure can partially improve Breakdown Voltage (BV), simultaneously can remarkably reduce on-resistance (Ron) of a drift region, realize reduction of collision ionization rate at a drain-field oxygen interface, remarkably inhibit Hot Carrier Injection (HCI) effect and prolong the service life of a device.

title_en: Annular array GGNMOS structure and electrostatic discharge protection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ring-shaped array GGNMOS structure and an electrostatic discharge protection device, wherein the GGNMOS structure comprises a substrate, pwell, a plurality of arrays N+, a plurality of first polysilicon gates, a plurality of arrays P+ and a plurality of second polysilicon gates, the Pwell is implanted into the substrate, the arrays N+ are all implanted into the Pwell and are adjacently arranged, a blank implantation area is formed between two adjacent arrays N+, each first polysilicon gate is formed on an isolation area between the annular N+ and a central N+, each array P+ is implanted into the blank implantation area and is isolated from the annular N+ of the array N+, each second polysilicon gate surrounds the array P+, the outer side of each second polysilicon gate is connected with the adjacent first polysilicon gates, and each second polysilicon gate and the corresponding array P+ are annularly surrounded by the adjacent arrays N+. The parasitic series resistance of the NPN base level is uniform, and the problem of nonuniform conduction of the traditional GGNMOS is solved.

title_en: Display panel manufacturing method, display panel and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a preparation method of a display panel, the display panel and a display device. The manufacturing method of the display panel comprises the steps of providing a substrate, forming an isolation structure on the substrate, enclosing the isolation structure into a first opening, forming a light-emitting device material layer corresponding to the first opening in the first opening and outside the first opening, disconnecting the light-emitting device material layer by the first opening and comprising the light-emitting structure material layer and the first electrode material layer which are sequentially formed, forming a packaging part corresponding to the first opening, covering the light-emitting device material layer in the first opening and extending to the light-emitting device material layer on one side, away from the substrate, of the isolation structure through the side wall of the isolation structure, performing first etching on the first electrode material layer outside the first opening, removing the light-emitting structure material layer outside the first opening, and performing second etching on the remaining first electrode material layer outside the first opening. The application can improve the performance of the display product.

title_en: Wafer testing equipment and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides wafer testing equipment and a control method, and relates to the technical field of wafer testing. According to the invention, the heat sink and the tested wafer are respectively grabbed from the heat sink bin and the wafer bin through the grabbing mechanism, and the heat sink and the tested wafer are placed on the bearing platform of the loading and unloading mechanism, so that automatic loading and unloading of the tested wafer and the heat sink are realized. The invention also installs the assembly and disassembly mechanism at the assembly and disassembly mechanism of the wafer test equipment, and the assembly and disassembly mechanism is arranged to connect the sealing component and the cover board component to form a sealed test cavity and separate the sealing component and the cover board component, thereby realizing the automatic installation and the automatic disassembly of the wafer test clamp. In addition, the carrying mechanism is movably arranged to carry the heat sink carrying the tested wafer between the loading and unloading mechanism and the accommodating cavity of the sealing assembly, so that the loading and unloading of the tested wafer are realized, the whole process does not need manual intervention, the full automation can be realized, and the testing efficiency of the tested wafer can be improved.

title_en: Perovskite solar cell based on modified electron transport layer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a perovskite solar cell based on a modified electron transport layer and a preparation method thereof. The perovskite solar cell comprises a conductive substrate layer, an electron transmission layer, a perovskite light absorption layer, a hole transmission layer and a metal electrode layer which are sequentially stacked, wherein the electron transmission layer comprises a cobalt complex and nano TiO  2 , the cobalt complex comprises a neutral NH  3  ligand, the valence state of cobalt in the cobalt complex is +3, and the molar ratio of nano TiO  2  to the cobalt complex is (8-12): 1. According to the invention, a cobalt complex with a specific molar quantity is introduced into the electron transport layer of the perovskite solar cell, so that the energy level arrangement of nano TiO  2  is improved, meanwhile, the nano TiO  2  is interacted with defect sites in a crystal lattice, the defects are passivated, the conductivity of the electron transport layer is improved, the non-radiative recombination at an interface is reduced, and finally the open-circuit voltage and the overall efficiency of the perovskite solar cell are obviously improved.

title_en: Solar cell, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: A solar cell comprises a silicon substrate, a plurality of first passivation contact structures, a spacing groove, a second passivation contact structure and a first electrode, wherein the first passivation contact structures are arranged on the back surface of the silicon substrate and comprise a first tunneling layer and a first doped crystal silicon layer, the spacing groove is arranged between the adjacent first passivation contact structures, a passivation insulating layer is arranged on the side wall of the spacing groove, the second passivation contact structures are arranged in the spacing groove and comprise a second tunneling layer and a second doped crystal silicon layer, the doping types of the second doped crystal silicon layer and the first doped crystal silicon layer are opposite, the first electrode is in contact with the first doped crystal silicon layer, and the second electrode is in contact with the second doped crystal silicon layer. According to the solar cell, the passivation insulating layer is arranged on the side wall of the spacing groove, so that the electric leakage risk between the N region and the P region can be effectively reduced, and the overall efficiency of the solar cell is improved.

title_en: Semiconductor module and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semiconductor module and a vehicle. The reliability of a semiconductor module using a lead wire as a wiring member for connecting an electrode of a semiconductor element and other conductors is improved. The semiconductor module includes a wiring board, a semiconductor element disposed on a conductor pattern of the wiring board and connected to the conductor pattern, and a wiring member electrically connecting an electrode provided on a surface of the semiconductor element opposite to the conductor pattern to another conductor. The wiring member includes a1 st conductor spacer, a 2 nd conductor spacer, and a laminate in which the conductor spacers are connected to each other and a plurality of conductor foils are laminated. The plurality of conductor foils include at least one intermediate conductor foil, and a1 st conductor foil and a 2 nd conductor foil which are laminated with each other with the intermediate conductor foil interposed therebetween, and the intermediate conductor foil has a void forming portion which forms a void between the 1 st conductor foil and the 2 nd conductor foil.

title_en: Cleaning method of thin wafer and semiconductor product
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field related to semiconductor manufacturing, and particularly discloses a cleaning method of a thin wafer and a semiconductor product, wherein the cleaning mode provided by the application mainly aims at the thin wafer with the thickness of 80-140 mu m, adopts a specific first jig and a specific second jig for carrying and supporting, the wafer is subjected to plasma bombardment, twice organic solvent cleaning, first overflow water cleaning, acid cleaning, second overflow water cleaning and drying to obtain the high-quality cleaned wafer, and the semiconductor product prepared from the wafer obtained by the cleaning method is also disclosed. The cleaning method of the wafer improves the traditional cleaning means and drying means, and greatly optimizes the cleaning mode of the wafer, thereby avoiding the use of expensive special equipment, leading the specific process to be simple, efficient and convenient, not only improving the quality of the wafer, but also leading the performance of the manufactured semiconductor product to be stable and reliable.

title_en: Wafer thinning clamp and warping control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wafer thinning clamp which comprises a base, a plurality of adsorption modules and at least three positioning modules, wherein the adsorption modules are symmetrically distributed on the circumference of the base, an adsorption module is also arranged at the center of the base, each adsorption module comprises an air hole plate and two symmetrically distributed springs, the air hole plates are in clearance fit with the base, the springs are arranged to connect the air hole plates with the base, the positioning modules are composed of lead screws, positioning blocks and silica gel movable blocks, the number of the positioning modules is equal and the positioning modules are symmetrically arranged along the circumferential direction of the base, and the lead screws can be synchronously started to push wafers to move until the center of each wafer is aligned with the center of the base up and down. The invention adopts the design of elastic adsorption and combines the arrangement mode of the adsorption modules, so that the dynamic adjustment can be automatically realized when the wafer thinning processing is carried out, and the problems of cracking and edge tilting in the wafer thinning processing are well solved. And the design of the adjustable diameter positioning mechanism is matched, so that the adjustable diameter positioning mechanism can be compatible with wafers of multiple sizes, reduces the replacement frequency and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The application provides a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises an opening area, a transition area arranged at the periphery of the opening area and a display area arranged at the periphery of the transition area, the display panel comprises at least one luminous public layer, a packaging layer and a separator, the packaging layer is arranged on the at least one luminous public layer, the separator is arranged at the transition area, an undercut opening is arranged on the side surface of the separator, the upper edge of the undercut opening is warped upwards, so that the at least one luminous public layer is disconnected at the position of the undercut opening, and therefore, water vapor and oxygen can be prevented from penetrating into the display area through the luminous public layer leaked from the side of the opening area, the packaging effect of the display panel is improved, and the reliability of the display panel can be improved.

title_en: Manufacturing method of stepped shielding gate trench device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a stepped shielding gate trench device, which comprises the following steps of: step one, forming a grid groove. And step two, forming a first shielding dielectric layer. And thirdly, forming a first shielding conductive material layer. And fourthly, performing first back etching to enable the top surface of the first shielding conductive material layer to be lowered to a set position. And fifthly, carrying out first wet etching to thin the first shielding dielectric layer exposed out on the side face of the grid electrode groove, and forming a step structure at the upper and lower connecting positions of the thinned area. And step six, forming a top shielding conductive material layer to completely fill the grid electrode groove. And step seven, performing second etching back to enable the top surface of the top shielding conductive material layer to be lowered to a set position. The step-shaped shielding dielectric layer formed by the invention has simple process and low process cost, and does not need to introduce an extra photomask.

title_en: Device stress isolation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device stress isolation system and a device stress isolation method, which relate to the technical field of stress isolation and comprise the steps of preparing a magnetic topology insulator film on the surface of a device, forming a heterojunction structure through deposition and annealing treatment, verifying the conversion efficiency of converting mechanical stress into spin waves, outputting spin wave energy flow density distribution, integrating the magnetic topology insulator film with a space-time coding metamaterial layer, deploying a sensor array to monitor a magnetic field and temperature in real time, adjusting spin wave paths and coding parameters through cooperative control of multiple physical fields, outputting dynamic traveling wave stiffness field distribution, carrying out iterative updating through an optimization algorithm, dynamically matching the propagation characteristics of the spin waves and the traveling wave stiffness field, outputting the optimized dynamic traveling wave stiffness field calibration parameters, carrying out full-condition vibration test and verifying isolation performance. The invention satisfies the full link performance improvement of device stress isolation through the multi-physical field cooperative control and dynamic optimization mechanism.

title_en: Sheet processing equipment and sheet production line
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of semiconductors and photovoltaics, in particular to sheet processing equipment and a sheet production line, and solves the problems of low process efficiency and poor process effect in the process of processing sheets on carriers in a reaction cavity in the related art. The sheet material processing equipment is provided with at least one processing position and comprises a carrier and processing components, wherein the carrier is provided with a containing cavity, the carrier is provided with a concave which is concave towards the containing cavity at a position between every two adjacent sheet materials, each processing component is provided with at least one processing part, at least part of the processing part can extend into the corresponding concave, so that the processing part passes through the carrier surrounding the concave part to act on the adjacent sheet materials. The sheet material process equipment and the sheet material production line can improve the process efficiency and the process effect on the sheet material.

title_en: Method for improving polarization retention of ferroelectric memory
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for improving polarization maintaining property of a ferroelectric memory, which comprises the steps of epitaxially growing a BiFeO3 film on a beveled substrate, regulating stress by changing film thickness, and realizing charge injection by combining reverse electric field pulse, thereby effectively improving polarization maintaining time. The substrate is specifically a crystal with a bevel angle of 2-5 degrees along the [100 ] direction, the thickness of the film is controlled within the range of 50-300 nm degrees, the pulse parameters of the reverse electric field are amplitude values of-2V to-5V, pulse width is 0.01 ms to 1 s, and the frequency is 1-100 kHz, and a periodic application mode is adopted to inhibit polarization attenuation. The BiFeO3 film is preferably epitaxially grown on the SrTiO3 substrate by adopting a Pulse Laser Deposition (PLD) process, so that an excellent monocrystal structure and stress control effect are obtained. The method is suitable for a high-temperature environment or a flexible substrate ferroelectric memory, and the polarization maintaining performance is obviously improved based on a composite regulation and control mechanism of stress engineering and charge injection, and experiments show that the polarization maintaining time can be improved by more than 50%.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a semiconductor device and a method of manufacturing the same, the method of manufacturing the semiconductor device including forming a first semiconductor structure including forming a stacked structure; the stacked structure comprises a first dielectric layer, a second dielectric layer and a sub-stacked structure which are stacked along a first direction, a plurality of capacitor structures are formed, the capacitor structures penetrate through the stacked structure along the first direction, the size of a part of the capacitor structures, located in the first dielectric layer, along a second direction is larger than that of a part of the capacitor structures, located in the second dielectric layer, along the second direction, and the second direction is perpendicular to the first direction.

title_en: Solar cell, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The application provides a solar cell, a preparation method thereof and a photovoltaic module, wherein the solar cell comprises a substrate, and a hole transport layer, a perovskite layer, an electron transport layer and a first transparent electrode layer which are sequentially laminated on the substrate, wherein the perovskite layer comprises a compound shown in a formula I. In the formula I, R  1 、R 2  is independently selected from electron withdrawing groups, R  3 、R 4  is independently selected from straight-chain or branched-chain alkyl with 8-16 carbon atoms, and n is more than or equal to 6 and less than or equal to 10. The application can passivate interface defects and improve carrier transmission capacity while widening the light absorption range of the perovskite layer, thereby improving the performance of the solar cell.

title_en: Polarizing film and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polarizing film having a cured product layer on at least one surface of a polarizer, wherein the cured product layer is a cured product layer of a curable resin composition containing a specific boron-containing compound and boric acid. The mass ratio of the specific boron-containing compound to boric acid in the curable resin composition is preferably 1:0.1 to 1:30.0. The curable resin composition preferably contains 0.05 to 5% by mass of the compound represented by the general formula (1) and 0.1 to 2% by mass of boric acid. The polarizer preferably contains 10 to 22 mass% of boric acid. When the ratio of boric acid contained in the polarizer is a mass% and the ratio of boric acid contained in the curable resin composition is B mass%, a:b=1:0.001 to 1:0.1 is preferable.

title_en: Photoelectric combined batch detection method and device for LED wafers
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductors, and discloses a photoelectric combined batch detection method and device for an LED wafer, wherein light beams are transmitted to a spatial light modulator for pattern modulation to obtain a compressed sensing coding pattern; focusing the compressed sensing coding pattern on the surface of a wafer to be detected so as to enable the wafer to be detected to generate photoluminescence signals and photo-generated current signals, deriving the photo-generated current signals generated by the wafer to be detected through a flexible conducting layer, collecting the photoluminescence signals generated by the wafer to be detected and the photo-generated current signals derived by the flexible conducting layer, inputting the compressed sensing coding pattern, the collected photoluminescence signals and the photo-generated current signals into a compressed observation model, and obtaining the real photoelectric signals of the wafer to be detected by using a sparse signal reconstruction algorithm. On the premise of not damaging chips, the high-speed, high-flux and photoelectric combined batch detection of the wafer is realized.

title_en: Method for forming semiconductor structure
abstract_en: A method for forming a semiconductor structure includes providing a substrate, forming a raised channel raised structure on the substrate, wherein the channel raised structure comprises a first sacrificial layer containing a first element and a channel laminated layer located on the first sacrificial layer, the channel laminated layer comprises a second sacrificial layer containing a second element and a channel layer located on the second sacrificial layer, the chemical activity of the first element is larger than that of the second element, the first sacrificial layer is removed to form a bottom groove, the chemical activity of the first sacrificial layer is larger than that of the second sacrificial layer, a larger removal selection ratio is formed between the first sacrificial layer and the second sacrificial layer in the process of removing the first sacrificial layer, the damage probability of the second sacrificial layer is reduced, materials corresponding to the bottom isolation structure are not easy to form at positions where the second sacrificial layer is damaged, the difficulty of removing the second sacrificial layer is correspondingly reduced, and the performance of the semiconductor structure is further improved.

title_en: Photoelectric device structure and photoelectric device leakage testing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photoelectric device structure and a photoelectric device leakage testing method, relates to the technical field of semiconductor photoelectricity, and aims to solve the problem of low efficiency of the leakage of a semiconductor photoelectric device in the prior art. The photoelectric device substrate comprises a substrate front surface and a substrate back surface, an active area formed on the substrate front surface, a central area formed on the substrate back surface, at least one first protection ring arranged around the active area, wherein the doping type of the first protection ring is the same as or opposite to that of the active area, the photoelectric device leakage testing method comprises the steps of obtaining basic data of a photoelectric device structure, the basic data at least comprise structure type information of the photoelectric device structure, classifying the photoelectric device structure based on the basic data to obtain different types of photoelectric devices, and testing the different types of photoelectric devices to obtain leakage current data of the different types of photoelectric devices in a preset voltage range.

title_en: Preparation method of surface-reinforced silicon wafer matrix of photovoltaic cell
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic cells, in particular to a preparation method of a surface-reinforced silicon wafer substrate of a photovoltaic cell, which comprises the steps of carrying out surface-reinforced treatment on the silicon wafer substrate twice after texturing, wherein the surface-reinforced treatment is specifically carried out by adopting etching solution A to carry out smooth treatment on surface morphology defects of the silicon wafer substrate in the first surface-reinforced treatment and adopting etching solution B to carry out smooth treatment on surface lattice defects of the silicon wafer substrate in the second surface-reinforced treatment, and the acid etching solution serving as the etching solution B comprises hydrofluoric acid, an oxidant and deionized water, wherein the oxidant is one or a combination of a nitro compound and a nitroso compound. The method has the advantages that the bending fracture strength of the silicon wafer substrate is improved through two times of surface strengthening treatment, and finally the bending fracture strength of the crystalline silicon photovoltaic cell is improved, and the method can be completed without using special equipment, and has the advantages of low production cost and suitability for large-scale production.

title_en: Packaging structure for preventing chip microcracks
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor packaging, in particular to a packaging structure for preventing microcracks of chips, which comprises a substrate, the chips arranged on the substrate, pressure sensors arranged on the substrate and corresponding to the chips, and wireless transmission modules arranged on the substrate, wherein the wireless transmission modules are connected with the pressure sensors and are used for wirelessly transmitting pressure data detected by the pressure sensors. The packaging structure provided by the invention realizes active monitoring of the pressure born by the chip by the pressure sensor, and avoids microcracks generated by the chip due to overlarge stress.

title_en: Dry etching equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dry etching, and particularly discloses dry etching equipment which comprises a frame body and clamping ends fixedly connected to two ends of the frame body, wherein an air extraction ring is fixedly connected to the middle of the frame body, a connecting pipe is fixedly connected to the outer side of the frame body, an inserting pipe is sleeved at the lower end of the connecting pipe, an air extraction assembly is fixedly connected to the lower end of the inserting pipe, an air extraction pipe is fixedly connected to the position, close to the clamping ends, of the frame body, an inner cavity of the air extraction pipe is communicated with an inner cavity of the air extraction ring, an abutting ring is embedded in the frame body, a heat dissipation strip is fixedly connected to the abutting ring, the heat dissipation strip is distributed in the air extraction pipe, an air extraction box is fixedly connected to the bottom of one of the clamping ends, and a dust collection cavity is formed in the air extraction box. When the clamping end in the etching equipment is matched with the abutting ring to place the wafer body to be processed on the processing table, the connecting pipe can absorb dust on the processing table into the air suction box through the dust suction pipe, and the wafer body to be processed can be prevented from being contacted with the dust on the processing table.

title_en: Superconducting resonant cavity, superconducting quantum chip and quantum computing device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a superconducting resonant cavity, a superconducting quantum chip and quantum computing equipment, and belongs to the field of quantum computing. The superconducting resonant cavity comprises a substrate, a central electrode and a grounding electrode, wherein the central electrode and the grounding electrode are positioned on the substrate, the width of the central electrode is a first width, the width of a slit between the central electrode and the grounding electrode is a second width, the sum of the first width and the second width is not larger than a target value, and the first width is larger than the second width. The application reduces the influence of factors such as film thickness fluctuation and etching fluctuation of the superconducting material on the resonance frequency of the superconducting resonant cavity, and reduces the deviation between the actual resonance frequency of the superconducting resonant cavity and the designed resonance frequency, thereby ensuring the resonance frequency of the superconducting resonant cavity to be more accurate and stable.

title_en: Display panel, preparation method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The display panel comprises a substrate, a pixel defining layer and a first packaging layer, wherein the pixel defining layer and the first packaging layer are positioned on the substrate, the first packaging layer is positioned on one side, away from the substrate, of the pixel defining layer, the density of at least part of the pixel defining layer is larger than that of the first packaging layer, or the refractive index of at least part of the pixel defining layer is larger than that of the first packaging layer. In the display panel, the degree of etching of the pixel defining layer can be reduced in the process of etching the first packaging layer by increasing the density of the pixel defining layer, so that the structure below the pixel defining layer is protected, and the yield of the display panel is ensured.

title_en: Carbazole compound and organic electroluminescent device thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbazole compound and an organic electroluminescent device thereof, belonging to the technical field of organic electroluminescent. The carbazole compound provided by the invention has proper triplet energy level, and meanwhile, the compound also has higher thermal stability and good film forming property, and when being used in an organic electroluminescent device, the carbazole compound can effectively improve the luminous efficiency of the device and prolong the service life of the device. The carbazole compound and the organic electroluminescent device thereof have good application effect and industrialization prospect.

title_en: Back gum removing and milling device for photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic panel back glue removing milling device, which belongs to the field of milling devices and comprises an operating platform, a bearing and positioning component and a supporting and positioning component, wherein the operating platform is internally provided with a mounting cavity, and the bearing and positioning component is used for bearing and positioning a photovoltaic panel and is detachably arranged in the mounting cavity of the operating platform. According to the photovoltaic panel back glue removing milling device, through the arranged abutting components, after the whole pressing wheel moves downwards and when the milling wheel moves downwards gradually to mill back glue, the pressing wheel can be pushed to move towards the second plane along the first plane, the spring I pushes the step plate and the toothed plate to move rightwards, the gear I, the gear II and the rotating rod II can be driven to rotate once, and after the pressing wheel moves towards the third plane along the second plane, the rotating rod can be driven to rotate twice continuously, so that the whole back glue processing component is driven to operate.

title_en: High-efficient die bonder of memory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency die bonder for memories, which relates to the technical field of die bonders and comprises a supporting plate, wherein a substrate supporting platform is arranged on the supporting plate, a substrate body is arranged on the substrate supporting platform, a second connecting shaft is arranged on the side surface of the substrate supporting platform, a first connecting shaft is connected onto the second connecting shaft in a rotating mode, a chip supporting platform is fixedly connected onto the side surface of the first connecting shaft, a first guide rod is arranged in the chip supporting platform, a movable plate is fixedly connected onto the first guide rod, a clamping assembly is arranged between the movable plate and the chip supporting platform, a negative pressure assembly and a vacuum chuck are arranged on the movable plate, and a pressing block is fixedly connected onto the substrate supporting platform. The invention solves the problems that the existing die bonder can not fix a plurality of chips and a substrate at one time by turning over the chip supporting structure when the substrate supporting structure is kept motionless, and can not automatically generate negative pressure in the vacuum chuck by utilizing the rotating force before turning over the chip supporting structure.

title_en: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A semiconductor device and a method for manufacturing the same, the semiconductor device comprises a semiconductor substrate, an active region formed in the semiconductor substrate, the active region comprising a source region and a drain region which are arranged at intervals along a first direction, a heavily doped well region of a first doping type formed in the drain region, a plurality of dielectric layers embedded in the heavily doped well region, the heavily doped well region and the dielectric layers forming a first resistance layer, electrostatic discharge current being injected into the drain region through the resistance layer and flowing out of the source region, and a grid formed on the semiconductor substrate, the grid being arranged between the source region and the drain region and extending along a second direction. The invention can effectively prolong the length of the discharging path of the large current, and improve the reliability of the semiconductor device while improving the self-protection capability of the ESD.

title_en: Passivation layer, preparation method thereof, solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a passivation layer, a preparation method thereof, a solar cell and a photovoltaic module, and belongs to the technical field of solar cells. The material of the passivation layer includes a rubidium-containing inorganic compound including at least one of a rubidium-containing haloborate or a rubidium-containing oxyacid salt. The passivation layer provided by the application not only can passivate the interface defect on the perovskite absorption layer, but also can adjust the energy level barrier between the perovskite absorption layer and the electron transmission layer, improve charge transmission, improve the open-circuit voltage and the filling factor of the solar cell device, and further improve the photoelectric conversion performance of the solar cell device.

title_en: Curable resin composition, resin cured film, semiconductor package, and display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a curable resin composition, a resin cured film, a semiconductor package, and a display device. The present invention provides a curable resin composition which can form a resin cured film having excellent adhesion, chemical resistance, heat resistance and transparency with a colored photoresist material or a metal film formed from a (meth) acryloyl group-containing compound and has high hardness, and a semiconductor package and a display device using the resin cured film. The solution of the present invention is a curable resin composition comprising (A) an epoxy compound represented by general formula (1) having an isocyanuric ring and an epoxy group at the terminal, (B) a cyclic silicone compound having at least 2 epoxy groups, and (C) an acid generator, and (G) a solvent, wherein the mass ratio [ (A)/(A) + (B) ] of the mass of the component (A) to the total mass of the component (A) and the component (B) is 0.2 to 0.8, and the mass ratio of the component (A) to the mass of the component (B) is molecular.

title_en: Lift pin assembly, semiconductor processing system, and method of transferring a substrate
abstract_en: A lift pin assembly includes a lift pin body, two or more piezoelectric units, and a lead. The lift pin body includes a contact feature defined on a first end of the lift pin body and a securing feature longitudinally opposite the contact feature. Two or more piezoelectric units are stacked within the lift pin body between the fixed feature and the contact feature. The lead is electrically connected to the plurality of piezoelectric units and extends to an external environment outside the lift pin body to change a length of the lift pin body between a first length and a second length using a voltage applied to the lead. Semiconductor processing systems including lift pin assemblies and substrate transfer methods are also described.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a semiconductor device having a plurality of semiconductor chips
abstract_en: The semiconductor device includes a semiconductor element having a1 st main electrode and a 2 nd main electrode, the 2 nd main electrode being formed on a surface opposite to the 1 st main electrode in a plate thickness direction, a1 st wiring member connected to the 1 st main electrode, a post having a1 st end surface connected to the 2 nd main electrode and a 2 nd end surface opposite to the 1 st end surface in the plate thickness direction, the 2 nd end surface having a rectangular shape having two sides parallel to the 1 st direction and two sides parallel to the 2 nd direction, the 1 st direction being orthogonal to the plate thickness direction, the 2 nd direction being orthogonal to the plate thickness direction and the 1 st direction, the 2 nd wiring member being connected to the 2 nd end surface of the post via solder, the opposite surface facing the post having a connection region connected to the post and a groove surrounding the connection region to accommodate the remaining solder, the groove surrounding only one connection region, the groove being provided to include the post and not overlapping at least one of the 4 sides of the 2 nd end surface of the post when viewed from the plate thickness direction.

title_en: Display substrate and display device
abstract_en: The display substrate comprises pixel units which are arranged on a substrate in an array mode, a first conducting layer, a first flattening layer and a first electrode layer which are sequentially stacked on the substrate, each pixel unit comprises a plurality of sub-pixels, at least part of the sub-pixels in each pixel unit correspond to each of the sub-pixels, the first conducting layer comprises a first conducting part and a spacing part, the first electrode layer comprises a first hollowed-out part and a first electrode part, the front projection of the first hollowed-out part on the substrate and the front projection of the spacing part on the substrate at least partially overlap, and the area of exhaust holes for exhausting can be increased by at least partially overlapping the front projection of the first hollowed-out part on the substrate and the front projection of the spacing part on the substrate, so that the probability of occurrence of dark spots caused by cathode and anode short circuits is reduced, namely, the improvement of the bad dark spots is effectively realized on the premise that mask process steps are not increased.

title_en: Heat dissipation structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a heat dissipation structure, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method of the heat dissipation structure comprises the steps of obtaining a melt for forming a first part, casting a second part and the melt, wherein the second part is not melted, and the heat conductivity of the second part is larger than that of the first part. According to the preparation method of the heat radiation structure, the second part with high heat conductivity is directly inlaid on the first part in the casting process of the first part with low heat conductivity in a casting compound mode, so that the interface bonding rate of the first part and the second part is improved, the formation of a tin welding layer, nickel plating treatment and the like are avoided, the interface thermal resistance is finally reduced, the heat radiation efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the preparation method has the advantages of high yield, high production efficiency, low cost, environmental friendliness and the like.

title_en: Isolation type MOSFET device structure for reducing device leakage and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an isolation type MOSFET device structure for reducing device electric leakage and a preparation method thereof, wherein the device structure comprises a substrate, an epitaxial region, a deep isolation well, an ion implantation well, a source region, a drain region, an isolation region, a body region, a region, source electrode metal, drain electrode metal, isolation region electrode metal, body electrode metal, region electrode metal, a gate oxide layer and a gate electrode; the epitaxial region is positioned on the substrate, the deep isolation well extends from the surface of the epitaxial region to the inside of the epitaxial region, the ion implantation well extends from the surface of the deep isolation well to the inside of the deep isolation well, the source region, the drain region and the body region all extend from the surface of the ion implantation well to the inside of the ion implantation well, the isolation region extends from the surface of the deep isolation well to the inside of the deep isolation well, the region extends from the surface of the epitaxial region to the inside of the epitaxial region, the gate oxide layer is positioned on the ion implantation well, and the gate electrode is positioned on the gate oxide layer. The structure realizes the reduction of the leakage current of the device, so that the breakdown resistance and crosstalk resistance of the device are improved.

title_en: Quasi-two-dimensional perovskite material, perovskite solar cell and preparation process
abstract_en: The invention provides a quasi-two-dimensional perovskite material, a perovskite solar cell and a preparation process, wherein the structural general formula of the quasi-two-dimensional perovskite material is L  2 BX 4 , L  2 BX 4  is obtained by reacting LX with BX  2 , X ions in LX and BX  2  are halogen ions, B ions in BX  2  are divalent cations, the structural general formula of LX is general formulas I-IV provided by the invention, and the quasi-two-dimensional perovskite material provided by the invention has higher stability and excellent photoelectric performance, so that the perovskite solar cell prepared by the quasi-two-dimensional perovskite material has higher stability and excellent photoelectric performance.

title_en: Optical communication module packaging structure and preparation method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an optical communication module packaging structure and a preparation method, and relates to the technical field of semiconductor packaging, wherein the optical communication module packaging structure comprises a packaging substrate, a first groove is formed in the upper surface of the packaging substrate, a first chip is embedded in the first groove, the upper surface of the first chip is flush with the upper surface of the packaging substrate, and the upper surface of the first chip is an active surface; the first packaging structure is arranged on the upper surface of the packaging substrate and the upper surface of the first chip, and is electrically connected with the packaging substrate and the first chip respectively through a plurality of mutually isolated first solders, wherein the first chip is an optical chip, and the second chip is an electric chip. The optical communication module packaging structure and the preparation method provided by the embodiment of the application can reduce the packaging cost under the condition of meeting the short interconnection length between the packaged chips.

title_en: Manufacturing method of battery piece structure
abstract_en: The application relates to a manufacturing method of a battery piece structure. The method comprises the steps of processing a base material to obtain a semi-finished product of the battery piece, coating a photosensitive bag Bian Jiao on the edge of the semi-finished product of the battery piece, coating photoresist on the surface of the semi-finished product of the battery piece to obtain a glued semi-finished product of the battery piece wrapped by a glued layer, performing exposure treatment by using a mask containing a grid line pattern, transferring the grid line pattern to the glued layer, and performing development, electroplating and photoresist removal treatment on the glued semi-finished product to obtain a battery piece structure containing grid lines corresponding to the grid line pattern. By adopting the method, the efficiency of the battery piece can be improved.

title_en: Memristor based on covalent organic framework and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a memristor based on a covalent organic framework, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the memristor comprises a substrate, a semiconductor electrode, a covalent organic framework film and a metal electrode which are sequentially laminated, and the covalent organic framework film is formed by condensing 1,3, 5-tris (4-aminophenyl) benzene and terephthalaldehyde or terephthalaldehyde with an alkyl or alkoxy side chain. The covalent organic framework film has a highly ordered structure and an adjustable porous structure, is simple in preparation process, has uniform film thickness, high flatness and high crystallinity, and adjusts dielectric properties, so that the switching voltage and the cycling stability of the memristor are adjusted, the memristor has stable and repeatable switching properties, has high on/off ratio, low device variability and high flexibility, is further used for preparing the memristor based on COFs, can provide technical support for neuromorphic devices with high efficiency and adjustability and abundant functions, and can be applied to intelligent sensing and autonomous system control fields such as auxiliary driving systems.

title_en: Solar cell, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The application discloses a solar cell, a preparation method thereof and a photovoltaic module, wherein the solar cell comprises a perovskite layer and a passivation layer arranged on the surface of the perovskite layer, the passivation layer comprises a first passivation agent and a second passivation agent, wherein the first passivation agent is halogenated aniline and/or halogenated pyridine amine, and the second passivation agent is halogenated alkyl diammonium. According to the application, through the synergistic cooperation of the first passivating agent and the second passivating agent, the interface defect of the perovskite layer can be reduced better, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the solar cell is improved.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor device and a preparation method of the semiconductor device, wherein the substrate comprises a bottom silicon layer, an oxygen-buried layer and a top silicon layer which are sequentially stacked from bottom to top, the substrate is provided with an active region, a drain region is arranged in the top silicon layer in the active region, two source regions which are positioned at two sides of the drain region along a first direction, the substrate is provided with two terminal regions which are positioned in the top silicon layer, the two terminal regions are respectively positioned at two sides of the active region along a second direction, the second direction is perpendicular to the first direction, a groove isolation ring structure is circumferentially arranged around each terminal region, the groove isolation ring structure penetrates through the top silicon layer, the bottom of the groove isolation ring structure is connected with the oxygen-buried layer, and the material of the groove isolation ring structure is silicon dioxide. Therefore, the semiconductor device has smaller area and higher pressure resistance.

title_en: Wafer prealignment device and prealignment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing, in particular to a wafer prealignment device and a prealignment method, wherein the device comprises a mounting platform, an XY motion platform, a rotating platform, a sucker and an edge detection assembly, the method comprises device correction, coarse scanning and circle center positioning, fine scanning and notch accurate positioning and alignment execution, and the invention eliminates system errors by utilizing online self-correction through cooperation of software and hardware, suppresses random errors and model errors by utilizing a high-order fitting and feature screening algorithm, improves repeated positioning precision of the wafer prealignment device, notch orientation precision and consistency of equipment, and can meet high precision requirements of a wafer transmission system under the prior process.

title_en: Water-cooled heat sink
abstract_en: The application relates to a water-cooled heat dissipating device which comprises a base, a heat absorbing structure, a liquid driving mechanism and a sealing component, wherein the base is provided with an accommodating space, a heat exchange cavity and a first pipe body, a water pipe which is mutually communicated is arranged between the accommodating space and the heat exchange cavity, an annular groove is arranged at the periphery of the water pipe, the heat absorbing structure is connected with the base and is positioned in the heat exchange cavity, the liquid driving mechanism is connected with the base and is positioned in the accommodating space, the driving mechanism comprises a shell and a rotor structure, the shell comprises an accommodating cavity, a second pipe body and a third pipe body, the rotor structure is arranged in the accommodating cavity, the third pipe body is arranged in the annular groove and is communicated with the water pipe, and the sealing component is arranged in the annular groove and is extruded by the third pipe body so that the third pipe body is tightly matched with the water pipe.

title_en: Method for measuring the resistance and capacitance of a thin film during deposition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for manufacturing a chip (40) for depositing thin films, comprising a) forming a plurality of measuring electrodes (2) on a substrate (4) of insulating or semiconductor material, each electrode having a central portion and an edge inclined towards the surface of the substrate (4), b) forming a deposition mask (6), the deposition mask (6) defining a deposition window (8), the mask comprising indentations (10) in the vicinity of the substrate and the window.

title_en: Flexible tin-based perovskite solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a flexible tin-based perovskite solar cell and a preparation method thereof. The flexible tin-based perovskite solar cell comprises a polymer layer, wherein the preparation material of the polymer layer comprises a small molecular compound and at least one polymer of the formula I, and the small molecular compound is selected from any one or a combination of at least two of triethanolamine, lactic acid, sodium sulfite, glycerol, n-butanol, ethylene glycol and butyl tetraol. According to the invention, through the design of the polymer layer, the flexible tin-based perovskite solar cell with excellent performance is prepared through the synergistic effect of the polymer of the formula I and the small molecular compound.

title_en: Wafer ring lifting adsorption mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wafer ring lifting adsorption mechanism, and aims to provide a wafer ring lifting adsorption mechanism which has a simple structure, is matched with a roller through linear contact of a slide block inclined plane in the production and material taking process of an etching machine, adopts a multi-point linkage lifting rotary adsorption table and can realize parallel dynamic adjustment. The wafer lifting device comprises an adjusting assembly and a lifting adsorption assembly, wherein the lifting adsorption assembly comprises a fixed platform, a rotary positioning module, a rotating platform, an adsorption plate, a plurality of groups of side pushing modules and a plurality of groups of jacking modules, the rotary positioning module is arranged on the fixed platform, the rotating platform is connected with the movable end of the rotary positioning module, the plurality of groups of side pushing modules are arranged at the upper end of the fixed platform, and the plurality of groups of side pushing modules are matched with the corresponding jacking modules on the rotating platform and jack the adsorption plate to be matched with wafer ring products. The invention is applied to the technical field of product detection.

title_en: Wafer cutting method for thick metal layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chip packaging, in particular to a wafer cutting method for a thick metal layer. A wafer cutting method for a thick metal layer comprises the following steps of S1, grinding the back surface of a wafer to achieve the required thickness, S2, pasting a film on the back surface of the wafer, installing an iron ring for supporting, S3, carrying out laser grooving on the front surface of the wafer along a cutting channel, S4, cleaning the front surface of the wafer with the laser grooving, S5, moving the cleaned wafer to a workbench of invisible cutting equipment, carrying out invisible cutting on the groove bottom of the front surface of the wafer, carrying out invisible cutting operation on the groove bottom of the groove, forming BHC on the silicon surface of the wafer, S6, carrying out film jumping on the wafer, and S7, cleaning the wafer with the film jumping. Compared with the prior art, the processing method improves the processing capability of wafer cutting, namely, the metal thickness of the thick metal wafer can be processed within the range of 20-80 mu m, and the processing cost is reduced.

title_en: Small molecular material based on condensed ring tertiary butyl pyrene, preparation method thereof and application thereof in OLED
abstract_en: The invention discloses a condensed ring tertiary butyl pyrene-based small molecular material, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in OLED (organic light emitting diode), and belongs to the technical field of organic photoelectric materials. The material is constructed by condensed ring tertiary butyl pyrene, and a novel carbazole condensed ring derivative with a large molecular conjugated structure and high stability is formed by hybridization of pyrene and carbazole, the large conjugated plane structure of the novel carbazole condensed ring derivative can enhance intermolecular stacking property, reduce hole transmission energy barriers and improve hole mobility, the steric hindrance effect of tertiary butyl can prevent excessive aggregation of molecules and reduce charge transmission trap and non-radiation recombination, and the phosphoric acid anchoring group can optimize interface combination with an ITO anode and match the work function of the anode so as to reduce hole injection potential barriers. The material is used as a core component of the OLED hole transport layer, can effectively improve the charge transport efficiency, inhibit material crystallization and interface charge recombination in the operation of the device, remarkably improve the brightness, efficiency and long-term stability of the OLED device, and has great significance for promoting the application of the OLED in the high-end display and illumination field.

title_en: Sintering pressurization module and bonding device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor processing, and discloses a sintering pressurizing module and a bonding device. The sintering pressurizing module comprises a main body frame, at least two movable pressure heads, an expansion guiding unit and a sintering pressurizing module, wherein the at least two movable pressure heads are arranged in the main body frame, each movable pressure head can move along a first direction, the expansion guiding unit comprises a plurality of expansion guiding structures, the periphery of each movable pressure head is provided with the expansion guiding structures, the two expansion guiding structures are respectively arranged on two side walls of the movable pressure heads along a second direction and are in sliding connection with the movable pressure heads, the other two expansion guiding structures are respectively arranged on two side walls of the movable pressure heads along a third direction and are in sliding connection with the movable pressure heads, and the intersection point of a connecting line of the two expansion guiding structures and a connecting line of the other two expansion guiding structures coincides with the symmetrical central axis of the movable pressure heads. The invention can inhibit unordered expansion of the pressure head in the horizontal plane direction and can adapt to sintering surfaces with different height differences on the power module.

title_en: Memory circuitry and method for forming memory circuitry
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to memory circuitry and methods for forming memory circuitry. A method for forming memory circuitry including memory cells includes forming vertically alternating insulating layers and memory cell layers. The memory cells individually include horizontal transistors including gates that include portions of one of a plurality of horizontal conductive access lines that individually electrically couple together a plurality of gates of different ones of the horizontal transistors in the same memory cell level. Access lines extend horizontally from the memory array region into the connection region. Within the same time period and using the same processing steps, digit lines are formed in the memory array region, each directly electrically coupled to a horizontal transistor in a different one of the memory cell levels, and conductive via structures are formed in the connection region, each directly electrically coupled to a respective one of the access lines. Other embodiments are disclosed, including structures.

title_en: Method for forming memory circuitry
abstract_en: A method for forming memory circuitry including a string of memory cells including a string of channel material includes forming a stack including vertically alternating first and second levels. At least in the finished circuitry construction, the first level is conductive and the second level is insulating. A first set of horizontally spaced pairs of strings of channel material extending through the first level and the second level is formed. After forming the first set, a second set of horizontally spaced pairs of strings of channel material extending through the first level and the second level are formed. The pairs in the first set alternate horizontally with the pairs in the second set individually. Other embodiments are disclosed that include structures.

title_en: Low-temperature silver-coated copper slurry and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides low-temperature silver-coated copper paste, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic cell paste. The low-temperature silver-coated copper paste comprises, by mass, 90-93 parts of conductive filler, 2-6 parts of resin, 0.5-2.5 parts of curing agent, 0.01-0.2 parts of accelerator, 3-9 parts of organic solvent and 0.5-2.5 parts of other auxiliary agents, wherein the conductive filler comprises, by mass, 67-87 parts of silver-coated copper powder and 5-27 parts of silver powder. The invention improves the stability of the slurry by optimizing the components and the proportion, reduces the silver consumption and the battery production cost of the battery, and realizes the improvement of the battery performance, and further reduces the production cost while realizing the improvement of the battery performance by further improving the seed layer process.

title_en: Intelligent regulation and control method and device for threshold voltage of gallium nitride power MOSFET
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent voltage regulation and control, and discloses an intelligent threshold voltage regulation and control method and device for a gallium nitride power MOSFET. The method comprises the steps of conducting deep energy level transient spectrum measurement on a silicon nitride charge trapping layer of a gallium nitride power MOSFET to obtain a calibrated trap density, a calibrated energy level depth and a calibrated potential barrier thickness, creating a pulse parameter mapping table, collecting drain current of the gallium nitride power MOSFET, calculating threshold deviation, inquiring the pulse parameter mapping table according to the threshold deviation to obtain a first pulse parameter, conducting temperature compensation on the first pulse parameter to obtain a second pulse parameter, converting the second pulse parameter into a grid injection pulse, applying the grid injection pulse to the charge trapping layer, driving an electron tunneling injection trap to adjust two-dimensional electron gas concentration, and outputting regulated threshold voltage. The invention realizes high-precision stable regulation and control of threshold voltage in a wide working range, and improves the reliability and switching performance of the gallium nitride power MOSFET.

title_en: Econodual-form SIC packaging structure with low parasitic inductance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Econodual-form SIC packaging structure with low parasitic inductance, and relates to the field of xxxx. The SIC packaging structure with the low parasitic inductance in Econodual forms comprises a packaging shell, an AMB silicon nitride ceramic substrate, a multi-layer composite busbar, a SiCMOSFET chip, a parasitic inductance circulation detection unit, a data processing unit and a guarantee execution unit, wherein the AMB silicon nitride ceramic substrate is fixed in the packaging shell, the multi-layer composite busbar is arranged above the AMB silicon nitride ceramic substrate, the SiCMOSFET chip is connected to the AMB silicon nitride ceramic substrate, and the parasitic inductance circulation detection unit is used for circularly collecting main loop parasitic inductance related data. The SIC packaging structure with the Econodual form and low parasitic inductance integrates a parasitic inductance circulation detection unit, and achieves full-working-condition coverage through three complementary detection elements.

title_en: Preparation method of peep-proof display screen, equipment and peep-proof method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a preparation method of a peep-proof display screen, the peep-proof display screen, equipment and a peep-proof method. In the embodiment of the application, a light-transmitting material layer is formed on the light-emitting side of a display module, the display module comprises a substrate and a plurality of pixel units arranged on the substrate in an array mode, the light-transmitting material layer is patterned to form a plurality of light-transmitting island structures arranged on the light-emitting side of the display module in an array mode, the plurality of light-transmitting island structures correspond to the plurality of pixel units one by one, orthographic projections of the light-transmitting island structures on the substrate coincide with orthographic projections of the corresponding pixel units on the substrate, gaps among the plurality of light-transmitting island structures arranged in the array mode are filled with electrochromic materials to form an electrochromic layer, the plurality of light-transmitting island structures are located in the electrochromic layer, and the electrochromic layer changes light transmittance in response to voltage applied to the electrochromic layer. The technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application can realize better peep-proof performance, and the peep-proof structure has small thickness and small influence on display brightness.

title_en: Ultrahigh pressure isolating ring structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrahigh pressure isolating ring structure. The structure includes a laterally diffused metal oxide semiconductor structure and a floating metal field plate formed on a semiconductor substrate. The laterally diffused metal oxide semiconductor structure includes a drift region. The floating metal field plate forms a dielectric layer over the drift region and is electrically isolated from the drift region by the dielectric layer. According to the invention, by arranging the floating metal field plate, the electric field distribution on the surface of the drift region can be homogenized by utilizing the capacitive coupling effect, and the electric field concentration caused by charge accumulation under high-temperature reverse bias stress is restrained, so that the long-term working reliability and service life of the ultra-high voltage isolation ring structure are remarkably improved, and the original breakdown voltage performance of the ultra-high voltage isolation ring structure is not influenced.

title_en: Shallow trench isolation structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a shallow trench isolation structure and a manufacturing method thereof, comprising the steps of providing a substrate, forming an isolation trench in the substrate, forming a dielectric layer on the side wall of the isolation trench, exposing the bottom of the isolation trench, irradiating a treatment beam into the isolation trench along the direction of vertically injecting the isolation trench so as to form carrier charges in the substrate around the isolation trench, gradually increasing the concentration of the carrier charges along the direction close to the bottom of the isolation trench, and forming an isolation layer in the isolation trench so as to form the shallow trench isolation structure comprising the isolation trench and the isolation layer, wherein the forming speed of the isolation layer is positively correlated with the concentration of the carrier charges. The application avoids the advanced sealing of the isolation layer at the top of the isolation trench, thereby reducing or even avoiding the probability of forming hole defects in the isolation layer.

title_en: Arrangement device of ball planting platform of ball planting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an arrangement device of a ball planting platform of a ball planting machine, which comprises a housing, a plurality of arrangement tables, a driving mechanism and a plurality of arrangement units, wherein a plurality of abdicating grooves are formed in the housing, the arrangement tables are arranged at the top of the housing and are used for placing products to be arranged, the driving mechanism is arranged in the housing and provides driving force for movement, the arrangement units are respectively and correspondingly arranged at the outer sides of the arrangement tables, and the arrangement units are connected with the driving mechanism and are used for arranging products on the arrangement tables under the driving of the driving mechanism. The invention uses the linear guide rail to drive the air cylinder to control the whole row of the carrier, and uses the rigid constraint to eliminate the degree of freedom drift. The combination of the air cylinder and the guide rail is utilized, so that the traditional servo system, a high-precision precise sensor and a high-speed visual mechanism are omitted. And the pneumatic system is near zero power consumption when no load, and the energy consumption expenditure is more than vacuum adsorption platform and multiaxis servo scheme.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a semiconductor device having a plurality of semiconductor chips
abstract_en: The base layer (12) is an ion implantation layer, the second base layer (12 b) has a peak position (P2) having the maximum impurity concentration at a depth different from the boundary between the emitter region (17) and the barrier region (16) and the boundary between the emitter region (17) and the barrier region (16), a first conductivity type stabilization layer (19) is formed on the surface layer portion of the second base layer (12 b) of the FWD region (2) together with the contact region (18), and the first electrode (22) is electrically connected to the contact region (18) and the stabilization layer (19) in the FWD region (2).

title_en: Vertical power delivery module including a trans-inductor voltage regulator
abstract_en: The present disclosure is directed to a vertical power delivery module including a trans-inductor voltage regulator. A power module (110) includes a substrate (320) having first and second surfaces and first, second, and third metal interconnects. A semiconductor die (310) on the first surface is coupled to the first metal interconnect. The encapsulation material (338) has a third surface and an opposite fourth surface. The third surface is on the second surface. The primary inductor (Lp) in the encapsulation material has a first lateral segment (362), a first vertical segment (361) extending between a first end of the first lateral segment and the third surface, and a second vertical segment (363) extending from a second end of the first lateral segment to the fourth surface. The secondary inductor (Ls) has a second lateral segment (372), and third and fourth vertical segments (371, 372) extending from ends of the second lateral segment to a third surface. A pair of adjacent third vertical segments are coupled via a second metal interconnect. A pair of adjacent fourth vertical segments are coupled via a third metal interconnect.

title_en: Organic optoelectronic element and display device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an organic optoelectronic element and a display device, the organic optoelectronic element including an anode and a cathode facing each other, a light emitting layer between the anode and the cathode, a hole transporting layer between the anode and the light emitting layer, and a hole transporting auxiliary layer between the light emitting layer and the hole transporting layer, wherein the hole transporting auxiliary layer includes a first hole transporting auxiliary layer adjacent to the hole transporting layer and a second hole transporting auxiliary layer adjacent to the light emitting layer, the first hole transporting auxiliary layer includes a first compound represented by chemical formula 1, and the second hole transporting auxiliary layer includes a second compound represented by chemical formula 2. The detailed descriptions of chemical formula 1 and chemical formula 2 are defined in the specification.

title_en: Light-emitting device including condensed-cyclic compound, electronic apparatus including light-emitting device, and condensed-cyclic compound
abstract_en: The application provides a light emitting device. The light emitting device includes a first electrode, a second electrode opposite to the first electrode, an interlayer between the first electrode and the second electrode, and a condensed ring compound represented by formula 1. In addition, an electronic device including the light-emitting device and a condensed-cyclic compound are provided. 1 (1)

title_en: Epoxy-anhydride composition, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of single-component die bond adhesives for LED chip packaging, in particular to an epoxy-anhydride composition, a preparation method and application thereof. The epoxy-anhydride composition comprises a component A containing epoxy groups, a component B containing anhydride groups, a filler C and an anhydride accelerator D, wherein the epoxy-anhydride composition is completely cured under the conditions of a blade coating thickness of less than or equal to 100 mu m at 120-160 ℃ and 30-120min to obtain the die-bonding adhesive, and compared with the defect that the die-bonding adhesive in the prior art needs to isolate air to keep bright and transparent effects of object colors, the die-bonding adhesive prepared by the invention can complete curing under the condition of having oxygen, namely not isolating air, can still be close to the transparent effects of organic silicon after being aged for 10min at 260 ℃, namely, the visible light transmittance T is more than 90%.

title_en: Display panel and display device
