abstract_en: The application relates to a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises a plurality of mutually independent touch control subareas and a control circuit for controlling the connection states of the plurality of touch control subareas, each touch control subarea in the plurality of touch control subareas is connected with the control circuit, the control circuit is used for controlling each touch control subarea in the plurality of touch control subareas to be connected with each other in a display stage so as to reduce coupling interference of grid signals to each touch control subarea, and each touch control subarea in the plurality of touch control subareas is controlled to be disconnected with each other in the touch control stage so as to provide a touch control function. Therefore, under the condition that the original touch function of the display panel is not affected, in the display stage of the display panel, each touch partition on the display panel is connected by the control circuit, so that the area of the connected touch partition is increased, the coupling interference of a grid signal on the touch partition is reduced, and the purposes of eliminating touch cross stripes of the display panel and improving the display effect are achieved.

title_en: Packaging structure
abstract_en: A packaging structure comprises a substrate, a filling layer, a top layer rerouting layer, a bottom layer rerouting layer and a chip structure, wherein a plurality of conductive plugs are arranged in the substrate, the filling layer is arranged in the substrate, the thermal expansion coefficient of materials of the filling layer is larger than that of materials of the substrate, the top layer rerouting layer and the bottom layer rerouting layer are arranged on the substrate, and the chip structure is connected with the top layer rerouting layer in a bonding mode. By introducing a filling layer with a larger thermal expansion coefficient into the base, the problem of huge shear stress accumulation between the silicon-based material and the printed circuit substrate caused by thermal expansion coefficient mismatch is relieved under the condition of omitting a simplified structure of the traditional packaging substrate, and the reliability of the packaging structure is improved. After the traditional packaging substrate level is canceled, the signal transmission path is greatly shortened, so that interface parasitic effect and high-frequency signal loss are reduced, signal integrity is improved, meanwhile, the simplified architecture reduces dependence on a high-density organic substrate, material cost and process complexity are reduced, and smooth transition from chip to system level connection is realized.

title_en: Composite plate packaging structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite board packaging structure which comprises a first ceramic board, a plurality of conducting columns buried in the first ceramic board, a plurality of bonding pads formed on the outer surface of the first ceramic board, a plurality of layout lines formed on the inner surface of the first ceramic board, a photosensitive type light-resistant wall formed on the inner surface of the first ceramic board, a photosensitive type light-resistant layer bonded to the photosensitive type light-resistant wall, and a second ceramic board bonded to the photosensitive type light-resistant layer. Two ends of each conducting column are respectively connected with one bonding pad and one layout circuit, and the photosensitive photoresist wall surrounds the outer sides of the layout circuits. The photosensitive photoresist layer, the photosensitive photoresist wall and the first ceramic plate jointly form a closed space, and the closed space accommodates a plurality of layout circuits therein. Therefore, the composite board packaging structure can be formed through a heterogeneous integration mode so as to meet the increasingly diverse product requirements.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The application provides a semiconductor device and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of providing a semiconductor substrate, comprising a low-voltage region, a medium-voltage region and a high-voltage region, wherein a first grid electrode is formed on the low-voltage region, a second grid electrode is formed on the medium-voltage region, a third grid electrode is formed on the high-voltage region, a first side wall material layer and a second side wall material layer are sequentially formed, a first mask plate is adopted to carry out a first photoetching process, a first etching process is carried out, the second grid electrode is covered by the reserved second side wall material layer, then a second etching process is carried out, the first side wall material layer is removed, then a second mask plate is adopted to carry out a second photoetching process, a third etching process is carried out, the second side wall material layer and the first side wall material layer on the top surface of the second grid electrode are removed, then a third side wall material layer is formed, and a fourth etching process is carried out, so that the side wall material layer on the second grid electrode is thicker than the adjacent first grid electrode and the third grid electrode, and the GIDL (global leakage) problem of the medium-voltage region is improved.

title_en: Molded direct bond and interconnect stack
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to molded direct bond and interconnect stacks. The die and/or wafer are stacked and bonded in various arrangements including stacks, and may be covered by a molding to facilitate handling, packaging, etc. In various examples, the molded article may more or less cover the stack to facilitate connection with devices in the stack, enhance thermal management, and so forth.

title_en: Method for preparing junction barrier Schottky diode based on chemical mechanical polishing
abstract_en: The application provides a junction barrier Schottky diode preparation method based on chemical mechanical polishing, which belongs to the technical field of Schottky diode preparation and comprises the steps of preparing an anode layer on the epitaxial layer side of a gallium oxide wafer, enabling the surface of the anode layer to be in close contact with a flexible polishing pad, enabling the polishing pad to be extruded into a gap of the anode layer and be in contact with the surface of the epitaxial layer, and polishing the epitaxial layer through polishing liquid along with rotation of the polishing pad, so that a groove corresponding to the gap is formed, and a gallium oxide device is obtained. The application manufactures the groove by a chemical mechanical polishing mode, avoids the problems of more lattice defects on the surface of the groove, large difficulty in controlling the shape and the roughness of the side wall of the groove and easy introduction of impurities and defects, does not influence the performance of the device in the groove forming process, can effectively improve the yield of the junction barrier Schottky diode and reduces the preparation cost of the device.

title_en: Half-bridge unit, phase module, power module, double electric control module and traffic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a half-bridge unit, a phase module, a power module, a double electric control module and traffic equipment. The half-bridge unit comprises a bottom substrate and an upper substrate, wherein the upper substrate is arranged on the upper surface of the bottom substrate in a laminated mode, a plurality of conductive areas are arranged on the upper surface of the bottom substrate, the conductive areas are located outside the projection of the upper substrate on the bottom substrate, and at least one power device is arranged on the conductive areas. The half-bridge unit is used for improving the power integration level of the power module.

title_en: Tin dioxide electron transport layer regulated and controlled by functional group functionalized conjugated organic molecules and application of tin dioxide electron transport layer in front perovskite solar cell
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tin dioxide electron transport layer regulated and controlled by functional group functionalized conjugated organic molecules and application thereof in a front perovskite solar cell, and belongs to the technical field of perovskite solar cells. The invention adopts hydroxyl, carboxyl or amino to functionalize the tetraphenyl embedded dinaphthyl structural unit, the organic molecules can effectively improve the stability and the electron transmission capacity of the SnO  2  -based electron transmission layer through the cooperation between multi-site chemical bonding and pi-pi action, and simultaneously the organic molecules can effectively passivate defects, release interface residual stress and promote perovskite crystallization, thereby improving the efficiency and long-term operation stability of the device. The method improves the stability and the electron transmission capacity of the electron transmission layer through the design of the functional group functionalized conjugated organic molecules, provides a new thought for realizing a perovskite solar cell with high efficiency and stable long-term operation, and lays a solid foundation for large-scale commercial application of perovskite photovoltaic technology.

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor device, which comprises a process chamber and a hydrogen cracking device communicated with the chamber. The hydrogen cracking device comprises a gas supply assembly, a first gas passage and a second gas passage which are sequentially connected. The first air passage is provided with a heating component for heating the hydrogen gas to a cracking temperature to generate hydrogen atoms, and the second air passage is provided with a cooling component for cooling the hydrogen atoms to a target temperature between 300 ℃ and a pre-cleaning temperature. The cooled hydrogen atoms are then transferred to a process chamber at a pre-clean temperature, which performs a pre-clean process on the wafer. The invention utilizes the hydrogen atoms generated by cracking to carry out surface treatment, and can better overcome the influence of the initial state difference of the wafer surface on the reaction rate. The hydrogen atoms can uniformly and stably act on each area of the wafer surface, so that the phenomenon of uneven reaction on the same wafer surface caused by low hydrogen cracking rate is inhibited, and the consistency and repeatability of the pre-cleaning effect among wafers in different batches are improved.

title_en: Bi-doped InSe monocrystal and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of InSe crystals, in particular to a Bi-doped InSe single crystal, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a preparation method of a Bi-doped InSe single crystal, which comprises the following steps of sequentially heating a Bi-doped InSe polycrystalline material rod in a microgravity environment, growing crystals and cooling to obtain the Bi-doped InSe single crystal, wherein the crystal growth is carried out under the condition of applying a rotating magnetic field. The Bi-doped InSe monocrystal prepared by the preparation method has excellent tissue uniformity and lower defect density, and further the corresponding semiconductor device has excellent fatigue resistance and mobility.

title_en: Perovskite solar cell and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a perovskite solar cell in which an electron transport buffer layer having a three-layer structure is introduced between a perovskite light absorbing layer and an electron transport layer, and a method for manufacturing the same.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method of forming the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor device and a forming method thereof, wherein the semiconductor device comprises a high-resistance-value impedance layer, a minimum distance and a random defect, wherein the high-resistance-value impedance layer is arranged between a grid electrode and a first metal structure in the vertical direction, the first metal structure comprises at least one equipotential first metal and at least one non-equipotential first metal, the equipotential first metal and the high-resistance-value impedance layer are equipotential, the non-equipotential first metal and the high-resistance-value impedance layer are not overlapped in the vertical direction, and the minimum distance is arranged between the edge of the high-resistance-value impedance layer and the horizontal direction of the edge of the non-equipotential first metal and is larger than the size of the random defect, and the horizontal direction and the vertical direction are mutually perpendicular.

title_en: Low-voltage etching back contact battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a low-voltage etching back contact battery and a preparation method thereof, which are characterized in that through introducing a twice selective etching process under a low-voltage environment and combining accurate film deposition and doping sequence design, the formation of undercut defects is inhibited from the source, and meanwhile, the surface passivation quality and the carrier selective transmission performance are considered, so that the photoelectric conversion efficiency of a TBC battery is improved, and meanwhile, the production yield and the long-term operation reliability are remarkably improved.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display apparatus according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may include a substrate, a plurality of light emitting devices disposed on the substrate and positioned in a display area, a plurality of column lines electrically connected to a first electrode of each of the plurality of light emitting devices, a plurality of row lines electrically connected to a second electrode of each of the plurality of light emitting devices, an optical driving device disposed on the substrate and positioned in the display area, overlapping the first one of the plurality of row lines, and emitting a specific light of a first wavelength band according to a voltage difference between both ends, and an optical detecting device disposed on the substrate and detecting the specific light reflected from the outside and incident inside.

title_en: LED packaging device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor light emitting, and discloses an LED packaging device which comprises a bracket, an LED light emitting chip, a light-transmitting adhesive layer, a high-reflection adhesive layer and a lens. The LED light-emitting chip is arranged on the bracket and internally provided with a plurality of light scattering particles. The light-transmitting adhesive layer at least covers part of the upper surface of the LED light-emitting chip. The upper surface of the light-transmitting glue layer is diamond-shaped. The high-reflection adhesive layer is arranged on the support and at least covers the side face of the light-transmitting adhesive layer. A lens and a light-transmitting adhesive layer a cavity structure is arranged between the high-reflection adhesive layers. The lens includes a first optical interface and a second optical interface. The first optical interface is set to be a plane or a micro cambered surface, and the second optical interface is set to be a convex cambered surface. The light scattering particles are arranged in the light-transmitting glue layer, and the upper surface of the light-transmitting glue layer is diamond-shaped, so that a diamond-shaped light field with uniform light is realized. Through the setting of lens face formula, make the accurate light angle and the illumination intensity of presetting of realization, satisfy the needs of application scene. The LED packaging device also has the advantages of good spot edge cut-off, small volume and the like.

title_en: Micro light emitting diode, micro light emitting diode device, display and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to various aspects of a μ -LED or μ -LED device for augmented reality or light applications, especially in the automotive field. Here, the μ -LED is characterized by a particularly small size in the range of several micrometers.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a semiconductor structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the semiconductor structure comprises the steps of forming a plurality of grooves in a semiconductor substrate, forming an isolation material layer on one side of the semiconductor substrate, grinding the isolation material layer to remove the isolation material layer between the grooves, etching the ground isolation material layer to remove the isolation material layer in the groove, and simultaneously keeping the isolation material layer in the isolation groove to form a groove isolation structure, forming a plurality of gate structures in an active area, wherein the width difference of the plurality of gate structures is smaller than the channel length difference of a plurality of transistors corresponding to the plurality of gate structures, the plurality of gate structures comprise a first gate structure, and the first gate structure covers and fills the groove. The application can effectively reduce the control difficulty of the technological process and can improve the integration level of the device when a plurality of grid structures are formed simultaneously.

title_en: Antioxidant copper-based chip bonding material for metal connection in semiconductor device
abstract_en: The application provides a copper chip bonding material for packaging third-generation semiconductor devices. The bonding material is made of oxidation-resistant copper paste, and the copper paste is specially designed to minimize oxidation and optimize copper sintering density, so that a compact bond with high shear strength can be formed. The antioxidant copper paste of the application comprises copper metal particles and copper nanoparticles, wherein the copper nanoparticles are specially designed and have a bimodal size distribution. The present application provides a composition that can be applied directly to a metal substrate without prior mixing to simplify the sintering process, yet provides high shear and reliable bond strength.

title_en: Method for improving oxide sidewall quality
abstract_en: An example method of forming a silicon-containing material may include providing a silicon-containing precursor to a processing region of a semiconductor process chamber. A substrate may be received within the processing region of the semiconductor process chamber and include one or more features. The method may include generating a plasma effluent of the silicon-containing precursor in the processing region. The method may include depositing a silicon-containing material over vertically extending portions and horizontally extending portions of the feature. The method includes soaking the deposited silicon-containing material with a second silicon-containing material.

title_en: Nanosheet-resin composite ultraviolet curing perovskite battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nano sheet-resin composite ultraviolet curing perovskite battery and a preparation method thereof. The perovskite solar cell comprises a conductive substrate, a hole transmission layer, a perovskite light absorption layer, a nano sheet-resin composite modification layer, an electron transmission layer and an electrode which are sequentially arranged, wherein the single-layer nano sheet-epoxy acrylate composite modification layer comprises a single-layer nano sheet and epoxy acrylate. According to the invention, the monolayer nano-sheet is blended with the epoxy acrylate for the first time, and an integrated perovskite layer in-situ packaging modification layer with the functions of conductivity, water vapor barrier and mechanical enhancement is formed through an ultraviolet in-situ curing process, so that the 'deposition-packaging' is synchronously completed. The scheme solves the problems of heat/solvent damage and interface stress caused by traditional post-packaging, and remarkably improves the humidity and thermal cycle stability of the device.

title_en: Display panel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of display, and particularly relates to a display panel and a preparation method thereof. The display panel comprises a driving backboard, a light-emitting layer and a shading unit. The light-emitting layer is arranged on the driving backboard and comprises a plurality of light-emitting devices. The light shielding unit is arranged on one side of the light emitting layer, which is away from the driving backboard, and orthographic projection of the light shielding unit on the driving backboard is positioned between adjacent light emitting devices and comprises a reflecting structure and a light shielding layer which are sequentially arranged along the direction away from the light emitting layer. The reflecting structure comprises a reflecting cavity and reflecting surfaces which are obliquely arranged towards the light emitting devices at two sides respectively, and the reflecting cavity is positioned at one side of the reflecting surfaces, which is away from the light emitting layer. The reflecting cavity is used for reflecting light rays for multiple times, wherein one part of the light rays are transmitted through the reflecting surface and then are emitted to the light emitting layer again, and the other part of the light rays are emitted after multiple reflections. According to the application, the shielding light is redirected to the light-emitting side through multiple reflections, so that the light-emitting efficiency is improved, and the light-emitting angle is increased.

title_en: Manufacturing method of shielding gate trench structure and shielding gate trench type MOS device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manufacturing method of a shielded gate trench structure and a shielded gate trench type MOS device, wherein the method comprises the steps of forming a first insulating layer on the inner surface of a trench; forming a first dielectric layer on the inner wall of the trench, forming a second dielectric layer on the inner wall of the trench above the shielding gate, depositing a second dielectric layer in the residual space in the trench after forming the first dielectric layer, etching the second dielectric layer and the first dielectric layer, taking the residual second dielectric layer and the residual first dielectric layer as target dielectric layers after etching, wherein the etching rate of the second dielectric layer is larger than that of the first dielectric layer in the etching process, and forming a grid electrode on the target dielectric layers. The invention can form the grid morphology with the bottom being arc, and avoid the problem of charge concentration at the sharp corner, thereby having larger Vgs.

title_en: Piezoelectric laminate, piezoelectric element, and method for manufacturing piezoelectric laminate
abstract_en: The invention aims to eliminate the influence of crystal structures and lattice matching of a piezoelectric film layer and an electrode layer and improve the crystal orientation of the piezoelectric film layer. A laminate comprising a substrate and a laminate film provided on at least one surface of the substrate, wherein the laminate film comprises, in order from the substrate side, a1 st underlayer, an electrode layer, and a piezoelectric thin film layer, wherein the 1 st underlayer is in contact with the substrate and the electrode layer, and wherein the 1 st underlayer comprises a nitrogen compound containing at least 1 element selected from group IIIB to group VIB elements.

title_en: Battery piece sub-packaging machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery piece subpackaging machine, and relates to the technical field of battery piece subpackaging. The automatic material transferring device comprises a frame body, a base, a connecting frame, a transferring mechanism, an auxiliary mechanism, a pressing plate mechanism and a mechanical arm, wherein the base is arranged on the frame body, the connecting frame is arranged outside the frame body, the transferring mechanism is connected in the connecting frame in a sliding mode and comprises a first movable frame, a first bottom frame and a cover plate, the first bottom frame is arranged on the first movable frame, the cover plate is arranged above the first bottom frame in a lifting mode, the placing mechanism is arranged on the base and comprises a second bottom frame arranged on the base, a limiting seat is arranged on the second bottom frame and provided with a limiting rod, the limiting seat is used for conducting contact limiting on materials when the first bottom frame and the second bottom frame are matched to transfer the materials, the auxiliary mechanism is arranged outside the placing mechanism, the pressing plate mechanism is arranged on the frame body, the mechanical arm is connected on the frame body in a sliding mode, and the bag folding mechanism is arranged below the mechanical arm. The battery piece sub-packaging machine achieves the purpose of improving the service efficiency of equipment.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent element and electronic device
abstract_en: An organic EL element (100) comprises a1 st light-emitting region (51), a1 st hole-transporting region (61), a2 nd light-emitting region (52) and a2 nd hole-transporting region (62), at least one of the 1 st light-emitting region (51) and the 2 nd light-emitting region (52) comprises a1 st light-emitting layer (511,521) and a2 nd light-emitting layer (512,522), the 1 st light-emitting layer (511,521) comprises a1 st host material comprising 1 or more groups selected from groups derived from any one of the ring structures in formulae (H1) - (H4), the triplet energy T  1  (H1) of the 1 st host material and the triplet energy T  1  (H2) of the 2 nd host material in the 2 nd light-emitting layer (512,522) satisfy mathematical formula (1), and at least 1 of the 1 st hole-transporting region (61) and the 2 nd hole-transporting region (62) comprises only the 1 st hole-transporting layer (611, 621) and the 2 nd hole-transporting layer (612, 622). T  1 (H1)＞T 2  (H2.) (formula 1)

title_en: Preparation method of high-sensitivity long-wave infrared superconducting single photon detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-sensitivity long-wave infrared superconducting single photon detector. The acoustic mismatch effect between the superconducting thin film and the substrate is fully utilized and increased, and phonon local enhancement on the superconducting nanowire is realized. The novel design has the effect of increasing the energy utilization rate of the long-wave infrared photon energy on the superconducting nanowire, thereby improving the response sensitivity of the superconducting nanowire to the long-wave infrared photon signal. Compared with the existing designs of reducing the cross section size of the superconducting nanowire, digging holes below the nanowire or increasing a buffer layer and the like, the superconducting nanowire is low in implementation difficulty and high in expansibility.

title_en: Two-dimensional amorphous carbon semiconductor material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-dimensional amorphous carbon semiconductor material and a preparation method thereof. The material is of a two-dimensional lamellar structure, carbon atoms are distributed in a short-range ordered and long-range disordered state, the mass percentage of carbon elements in the material is more than 60%, at least one element selected from hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen and sulfur is doped in the material, the material is of a porous structure, the pore size is 1 nm-50 nm, the thickness is 0.5 nm-100 nm, the transverse size is 0.05 mu m-5000 mu m, the material is an n-type semiconductor, and the band gap is 0.3 eV-4 eV. The preparation method comprises mechanically mixing organic dye and photothermal material, laying on a heat-resistant flat substrate, placing in a reaction container with quartz plate at top, and thermally decomposing the organic dye by laser irradiation under inert atmosphere or vacuum condition. The method does not need a template agent, has simple process and low cost, can realize large-scale production, realizes high-value conversion of low-value organic dye, and has wide application prospect in the fields of semiconductors, photoelectricity, catalysis and the like.

title_en: Super-infiltration three-dimensional hollow soaking liquid cooling module and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super-infiltration three-dimensional hollow soaking liquid cooling module and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of liquid cooling and heat dissipation, and comprising a soaking base, a hollow fin cover and a liquid cooling top cover; the soaking base is characterized in that a first skirt edge is arranged on the periphery of the soaking base, an inner concave surface is formed on the inner side of the first skirt edge and is used for bearing a phase change working medium, the hollow fin cover is provided with an inner concave side and an outer convex side, a second skirt edge is arranged on the periphery of the hollow fin cover, a negative pressure sealing cavity formed by the inner concave side and the inner concave surface of the soaking base is filled with the phase change working medium, a third skirt edge is arranged on the periphery of the liquid cooling top cover, a liquid cooling cavity is formed in the middle of the liquid cooling top cover in a concave mode, a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet are formed, the first skirt edge, the second skirt edge and the third skirt edge are sequentially overlapped and aligned, sealing is achieved through tight adhesion, and the outer convex side of the hollow fin cover and the liquid cooling cavity of the liquid cooling top cover form an open cavity together. The invention can improve the liquid cooling heat dissipation performance and has the advantages of simple structure, mature process, long-acting reliability and the like.

title_en: Conductive paste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The conductive paste provided by the invention comprises conductive metal, lead-free glass powder and an organic adhesive, wherein the conductive metal and the lead-free glass powder form total solid content, the content of the conductive metal in the total solid content is 75-99.8wt%, the content of the lead-free glass powder is 0.2-25wt%, the lead-free glass powder is a Te-Bi oxide system, and the Te-Bi oxide system comprises tellurium oxide and bismuth oxide. Tellurium oxide is used as a glass network forming body, mainly determines the softening point and fluidity of glass, can effectively reduce the melting point of the glass, and endows the glass with good fluidity. Bismuth oxide is used as a network modifier, and can regulate the chemical activity of glass to ensure that the glass is moderately corroded in the sintering process And the passivation layer promotes the formation of silver-silicon ohmic contact. The proportion of the two materials is adjusted in the range, so that the sintering temperature curves of different crystal silicon batteries can be accurately matched, and the process window of the lead-free glass is widened. In addition, the invention also provides a preparation method of the conductive paste.

title_en: High-voltage regulation and control method for photoelectric property of molybdenum diselenide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-voltage regulation and control method for the photoelectric property of molybdenum diselenide. According to the method, a molybdenum diselenide sample is placed in a diamond anvil cell high-pressure cavity, hydrostatic pressure of 0.4-3.9 GPa is applied on the premise that the 2H phase structure is kept stable, the band gap is reduced to 0.77 eV due to lattice contraction, light absorption is enhanced, and the photocurrent is obviously improved. The photocurrent is increased by a factor of 2 compared with the normal pressure at a pressure of 3.9 GPa, and when the pressure exceeds 4.4 GPa, the photoelectric response disappears due to the increase of the dark current. The invention combines in-situ X-ray diffraction, raman spectrum and infrared reflection spectrum in a wide pressure range to represent the structural evolution and optical property change of the material, and photo-current test and first principle calculation, clarifies the mechanism of high-pressure induced photoelectric property enhancement, establishes physical association of pressure-lattice contraction-band gap reduction-photo-current enhancement, and provides a technical foundation for regulating and controlling photoelectric detection materials in a high-pressure environment.

title_en: Miniature light-emitting diode chip with fence-type lead electrode
abstract_en: The invention relates to a miniature light-emitting diode chip with rail-type lead electrodes, which comprises a driving back plate and a functional layer, wherein the functional layer is arranged on the driving back plate and is provided with a plurality of lead electrodes, the lead electrodes are in electric contact with the driving back plate, the lead electrodes comprise rail base parts, the middle parts of the rail base parts are hollowed out and expose the driving back plate, and electrode metal layers are arranged in a manner that the middle parts of the electrode metal layers are sunken relative to the rail base parts, and the middle parts of the electrode metal layers are surrounded by the rail base parts and are used for being connected with leads. The miniature light-emitting diode chip adopts a fence-type lead electrode, the fence structure surrounds the middle area of the electrode metal layer, and the lead electrode can be prevented from overflowing from the connecting end of the lead in a molten state during lead bonding. And the middle area of the electrode metal layer is obviously recessed downwards relative to the fence structure, so that the electrode metal layer is convenient to identify during wire bonding.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent material and device thereof
abstract_en: An organic electroluminescent material and a device thereof are disclosed. The organic electroluminescent material is a compound with a structure shown in a formula 1, can be used as a main body material in an organic electroluminescent device, and can provide better device performance, such as higher current efficiency, higher external quantum efficiency and especially longer device service life. Also disclosed are an organic electroluminescent device, a compound composition and an electronic device comprising the compound.

title_en: Two-dimensional material memristor based on intrinsic sub-nano pore channel confinement and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-dimensional material memristor based on intrinsic sub-nano pore canal confinement and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of semiconductor devices. The active metal layer is arranged on the surface of the bottom electrode layer, and the active metal layer is arranged on the surface of the bottom electrode layer. The innovation core of the invention is that the resistive layer is composed of a two-dimensional material with sub-nanometer pore canals, the porous two-dimensional material layer not only provides a limited rapid channel for migration of metal cations, but also can effectively guide and restrict the forming paths of the conductive filaments. Compared with the traditional memristor, the random path is replaced by the definite ion migration channel, so that the memristor has the advantages of low set voltage, low energy consumption and the like. The memristor prepared by the invention has wide application prospect in a high-density nonvolatile memory and a brain-like nerve morphology computing system.

title_en: Integrated circuit package including dummy die with ground connection
abstract_en: The application discloses an integrated circuit package including a dummy die with ground connection. Microelectronic assemblies, related devices, and methods are disclosed herein. In some embodiments, a microelectronic assembly can include a first layer having first and second conductive pillars through an insulating material, a redistribution layer (RDL) on the first layer having signal conductive paths and ground conductive paths through the dielectric material, wherein the signal conductive paths are electrically coupled to the first conductive pillars and the ground conductive paths are electrically coupled to the second conductive pillars, and a second layer on the RDL having a structural component having a surface facing the RDL, wherein the surface of the structural component includes a conductive reference plane electrically coupled to the ground conductive paths in the RDL, and wherein at least some of the first conductive pillars are within a footprint of the structural component. The structural component may comprise silicon or a Coefficient of Thermal Expansion (CTE) tuned glass.

title_en: Grid resistor structure of power device, power device and preparation method of power module
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power devices, and particularly relates to a power device grid resistor structure, a power device and a power module manufacturing method. According to the invention, the plurality of independent resistor units are arranged on at least one side of the grid PAD, and the two ends of each resistor unit are connected with the resistor PAD and isolated from the grid PAD, so that flexible configuration of the grid resistor is realized. When the power module is manufactured, the final equivalent grid resistance value required by each chip can be accurately calculated according to the individual test data (such as saturation voltage drop, threshold voltage, switching speed, rg and the like) of each chip and the parasitic inductance difference of each parallel chip current path in the module layout, and then the corresponding resistance units are connected between the grid PAD and the grid bus bar in a serial or parallel mode through a bonding process. The design breaks the limitation of fixed grid resistance in the traditional chip, and can carry out personalized grid resistance adjustment aiming at the characteristic of each chip and the specific position of each chip in the module.

title_en: Solar cell, cell string, preparation method of solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of solar cells, in particular to a solar cell, a cell string, a preparation method of the cell string and a photovoltaic module. The semiconductor substrate of the solar cell comprises a first surface and a second surface which are oppositely arranged, wherein the first surface comprises a first area and a second area which are continuously distributed, the first area is of a suede structure, the second area is of a smooth surface, a first grid line electrode is positioned on one side, close to the first surface, of the semiconductor substrate, and orthographic projection of the first grid line electrode on the first surface is at least partially overlapped with the second area. According to the application, at least part of the grid line electrode is arranged on the smooth surface of the battery, so that the problem that the solvent is laterally diffused along the large area of the suede structure to pollute the active area of the battery is avoided.

title_en: Dome lens and guard ring for single photon avalanche diode photodetectors and related methods
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to dome-shaped lenses and guard rings for single photon avalanche diode photodetectors and related methods. A structure includes at least one Single Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD), at least one dome lens located over each SPAD, and a metal guard ring surrounding each SPAD. A front side illuminated SPAD photodetector and method of forming the structure are also provided. The dome-shaped lens increases SPAD efficiency in light detection probability (PDP) and light absorption with a minimum area increase together with the metal guard ring.

title_en: Back contact type battery piece and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a back contact type battery piece and a preparation method, wherein the back contact type battery piece comprises a silicon substrate, and further comprises a first oxidation layer, a first boron doped layer, a second oxidation layer and a second boron doped layer which are sequentially arranged in a first area of the silicon substrate along a direction away from the silicon substrate, and a first tunneling layer, a first phosphorus doped layer, a second tunneling layer and a second phosphorus doped layer which are sequentially arranged in a second area of the silicon substrate along a direction away from the silicon substrate, wherein the doping concentration of the first boron doped layer is larger than the doping concentration of the second boron doped layer, the doping concentration of the first phosphorus doped layer is smaller than the doping concentration of the second phosphorus doped layer, and the thickness of the first phosphorus doped layer is smaller than the thickness of the first boron doped layer. The back contact type battery piece and the preparation method provided by the invention can improve the field effect passivation effect of the back contact type battery piece and reduce the performance difference between different polarity areas of the back contact type battery piece.

title_en: Full-automatic integrated circuit expands membrane device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic integrated circuit film expanding device, which belongs to the field of semiconductor device manufacturing and comprises a machine main body, wherein automatic feeding and discharging modules are arranged on the periphery of the machine main body, an automatic film core removing module is arranged in the machine main body, an inverted crystal expanding module is arranged on one side of the automatic film core removing module, and an automatic film transferring module is arranged above the inverted crystal expanding module. The invention can operate the whole flow from feeding to discharging of the product, realizes the automation, high precision and traceability of the whole wafer film expansion process through modularized units such as automatic feeding, accurate film removal, uniform film expansion, on-line detection, intelligent film transfer, automatic discharging and the like, and obviously improves the efficiency and yield of the previous process of encapsulation.

title_en: Transmission platform and wafer transmission method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a transmission platform and a wafer transmission method, wherein the transmission platform comprises a transmission cavity, a plurality of process cavities, a loading cavity, at least two sets of manipulators, a temporary storage frame and a temporary storage frame, wherein at least one side wall of the transmission cavity is provided with an opening, the process cavities are respectively connected with one side wall of the transmission cavity and are used for accommodating and processing a plurality of wafers at the same time, the loading cavity is connected with one side wall of the transmission cavity, the manipulators are symmetrically arranged at two opposite sides in the transmission cavity and are respectively a first manipulator and a second manipulator, each set of manipulators is provided with a plurality of layers of fingers which are arranged from bottom to top, the temporary storage frame is arranged in the center of the transmission cavity and is positioned between the two sets of manipulators, and the temporary storage frame is provided with a plurality of layers of supports which are arranged from bottom to top. According to the technical scheme, the empty time of the process chamber is greatly shortened through the cooperation of multiple layers of fingers of the manipulator, and the throughput of wafer carrying is greatly improved.

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a substrate processing apparatus. Provided is a technique capable of improving the removal efficiency of a removal object during liquid treatment. The substrate processing apparatus of the present disclosure includes a fluid supply unit, a processing liquid supply unit, and a nozzle. The fluid supply unit supplies a fluid containing steam or water mist of pressurized pure water. The treatment liquid supply unit supplies a treatment liquid containing at least sulfuric acid. The nozzle has a 1 st ejection port, a 2 nd ejection port, and a delivery path. The 1 st ejection port ejects the fluid supplied from the fluid supply portion. The 2 nd discharge port discharges the treatment liquid supplied from the treatment liquid supply unit. The delivery path communicates with the 1 st discharge port and the 2 nd discharge port, and delivers a mixed fluid of the fluid discharged from the 1 st discharge port and the treatment liquid discharged from the 2 nd discharge port. The cross-sectional area of the delivery path is larger than the cross-sectional area of the 1 st discharge port.

title_en: Preparation method of deep trench structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a deep groove structure, which comprises the steps of providing a substrate, forming a shallow groove in the substrate, forming a first silicon oxide layer to fill the shallow groove and be positioned on the substrate, forming a concave on the top surface of the first silicon oxide layer, grinding the first silicon oxide layer to enable the top surface of the first silicon oxide layer to be flush, enabling the first silicon oxide layer to remain on the ground substrate, forming a first polysilicon layer and a first silicon nitride layer to be sequentially stacked on the first silicon oxide layer from bottom to top, etching the first silicon nitride layer, the first polysilicon layer, the first silicon oxide layer in the shallow groove and the substrate to form a deep groove, oxidizing the inner wall of the deep groove to form a second silicon oxide layer on the exposed surfaces of the substrate and the first polysilicon layer on the inner wall of the deep groove, etching to remove the second silicon oxide layer at the bottom of the deep groove, and filling the second polysilicon layer in the deep groove. The invention can reduce the process cost and improve the isolation performance of the deep trench structure.

title_en: Steel plate for BC battery steel plate printing and preparation method thereof, steel plate printing process and BC battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solar cell manufacturing, in particular to a steel plate for BC (binary metal) cell steel plate printing, a preparation method thereof, a steel plate printing process and a BC cell. The steel plate comprises a plurality of ink permeable areas arranged between two adjacent fine grids, the interval between the two adjacent ink permeable areas is non-equidistant, and the non-equidistant interval is 10-30um. This steel sheet can effectively unload the power, has promoted life-span and the printability of steel sheet then, simultaneously, has effectively promoted the collection of electric current, has reduced the overprinting risk simultaneously, has promoted the good efficiency of BC battery.

title_en: Image sensor
abstract_en: An image sensor is provided that includes a substrate, a first pixel including a first floating diffusion region in the substrate, a second pixel including a second floating diffusion region in the substrate, a first pad including a first extension portion extending along a first surface of the first floating diffusion region and contacting the first floating diffusion region, a second extension portion extending into the substrate, and a first connection portion connecting the first extension portion and the second extension portion, a second pad including a third extension portion extending along the first surface of the second floating diffusion region and contacting the second floating diffusion region, a fourth extension portion extending into the substrate, and a second connection portion connecting the third extension portion and the fourth extension portion, and a connection pad between and contacting the first pad and the second pad.

title_en: Cleaning liquid after etching and ashing of semiconductor wafer and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cleaning solution for semiconductor wafer after etching and ashing and application thereof. The cleaning solution after etching and ashing comprises N-methylimidazole, an azole corrosion inhibitor, gallic acid and water. N-methylimidazole is used as a main solvent and a physical corrosion inhibitor, and is cooperated with an azole chemical corrosion inhibitor to realize double protection of copper. Gallic acid has both reduction and chelation functions, and can break down the oxide layer and complex metal ions. The three are cooperated, so that the cleaning liquid can efficiently remove the complex mixed residues after etching and ashing, and simultaneously has extremely low corrosion rate to Cu, al, silicon nitride and other substrate materials, and does not contain environment-friendly limited substances. The invention solves the problems of strong copper corrosion, incomplete cleaning and poor material compatibility of the existing cleaning liquid.

title_en: Apparatus for moving substrate, deposition apparatus and processing system
abstract_en: An apparatus (100) for moving a substrate relative to a processing region of a vacuum chamber (110) has a support body (140) for holding the substrate within the vacuum chamber (110), a motion mechanism (200) coupled to the support body (140) for translating the support body (140) and for moving the support body (140) through an angle (150), wherein a drive assembly (240) of the motion mechanism (200) is positioned outside the vacuum chamber (110). A deposition apparatus and a processing system are also provided.

title_en: Semiconductor chip metal layer structure for diffusion welding and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor chip metal layer structure for diffusion welding and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the structure comprises a semiconductor chip; the semiconductor chip comprises a semiconductor chip, a chip front metal layer substrate positioned on the semiconductor chip, a chip back metal layer substrate positioned under the semiconductor chip, a chip back first metal alloy layer positioned under the chip back metal layer substrate, and a chip back second metal layer positioned under the chip back first metal layer. And the chip back surface first metal layer is used as an intermediate metal transition layer, and the chip back surface second metal layer and the chip back surface third metal layer are used as back surface diffusion welding solder layers. The invention reduces manufacturing cost and simplifies packaging process steps while realizing a diffusion welding process.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a semiconductor device having a plurality of semiconductor chips
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor device, which comprises a substrate, a first well region, a second well region, a third well region, a source electrode contact region, a drain electrode contact region, a gate electrode and a buried layer, wherein the first well region is provided with a first conduction type and is arranged in the substrate, the second well region is provided with the first conduction type and is arranged in the substrate and surrounds the first well region, the third well region is provided with a second conduction type and is arranged in the substrate, is positioned between the first well region and the second well region and surrounds the first well region, the source electrode contact region is arranged in the second well region, the drain electrode contact region is arranged in the first well region, the gate electrode is arranged right above the third well region, the buried layer is provided with a second conduction type and is arranged in the substrate, and the buried layer extends from the right lower side of the third well region to the right lower side of the second well region.

title_en: Method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for manufacturing a semiconductor device. The method comprises the steps of providing a substrate comprising a first device region and a second device region, sequentially forming a first grid material layer, an insulating medium layer and a second grid material layer, forming a second well region by using a mask pattern, etching the second grid material layer and the insulating medium layer of the second device region, forming a first device grid stack and carrying out light doping injection, forming a first side wall structure, forming a second device grid structure by using a photoetching pattern and removing the second grid material layer of the first device region, and forming a second side wall structure and exposing the upper surface of the first grid material layer. According to the invention, the thickening of the side wall structure is realized on the premise of not adding an extra photomask, the breakdown voltage of the high-voltage device is obviously improved, the leakage risk is reduced, and the high-efficiency integration and cost optimization of the high-voltage device and the logic device under the prior process are realized.

title_en: Display substrate and display device
abstract_en: A display substrate and a display device. The display substrate comprises a plurality of sub-pixels, at least one sub-pixel comprises a pixel driving circuit, a data signal line, a first power line and a compensation signal line, the pixel driving circuit at least comprises a third transistor, the third transistor at least comprises a third active layer, the display substrate comprises a first conductive layer and a semiconductor layer in the direction perpendicular to the display substrate, the first conductive layer at least comprises the data signal line, the first power line and the compensation signal line, the semiconductor layer at least comprises a compensation connecting line and the third active layer, the compensation signal line is connected with the compensation connecting line in at least one repeating unit, the compensation connecting line is connected with the third active layer of the plurality of sub-pixels in the repeating unit, the compensation connecting line and the third active layer are provided with connection intersection points, and the distance between the connection intersection points and the first power line is smaller than the distance between the connection intersection points and the data signal line in the first direction.

title_en: LED display device glass substrate, driving substrate, manufacturing method and display
abstract_en: The invention discloses a glass substrate of an LED display device, a driving substrate, a manufacturing method and a display, and relates to LED production equipment; the LED display device glass substrate comprises a glass substrate body, wherein two end faces of the glass substrate body are respectively covered with a wiring film layer, the wiring film layers are provided with transition strip edges, the transition strip edges are arranged in the wiring areas of the wiring film layers, the transition strip edges are positioned at the positions of the intersections of the display areas and the wiring areas of the wiring film layers, and the transition strip edges extend along the positions of the intersections of the display areas and the wiring areas of the wiring film layers, so that the situation that a metal film is plated between the protective film and the intersections of the display areas and the wiring areas of the glass substrate body in a winding manner to cause adjacent wiring short circuits can be avoided. The driving substrate comprises the glass substrate, and the transition edges and the side metal films are integrally etched. The manufacturing method of the LED display device driving substrate can manufacture the driving substrate. The LED display comprises the LED display device driving substrate.

title_en: Display panel, preparation method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The application provides a display panel, a preparation method thereof and a display device, and relates to the technical field of display, wherein the display panel comprises a substrate, a pixel definition layer, an isolation structure and a plurality of light emitting devices, the pixel definition layer is arranged on one side of the substrate, and the pixel definition layer is provided with a plurality of pixel openings; the light-emitting device comprises a substrate, an isolation structure, a plurality of pixel openings, at least part of light-emitting devices, a first electrode and a light-emitting layer, wherein the isolation structure is arranged on one side of the substrate, the isolation structure encloses to form a plurality of isolation openings, the isolation openings are communicated with the corresponding pixel openings, the light-emitting devices are at least partially positioned in the corresponding isolation openings, and the light-emitting devices comprise the first electrode and the light-emitting layer which are sequentially stacked along the direction away from the substrate. The pixel definition layer comprises a connection surface which is close to the first electrode and connected with the first electrode, the pixel definition layer is provided with a first orthographic projection on the substrate, the connection surface is provided with a second orthographic projection on the substrate, and the second orthographic projection is positioned in the first orthographic projection. The display panel provided by the application can improve the service performance of the display device.

title_en: Chip stacking structure, preparation method thereof and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a chip stacking structure, a preparation method thereof and electronic equipment. Relates to the technical field of chip structures. The chip stacking structure comprises a substrate, a first chip, a second chip, an electric connection structure and a heat dissipation structure, wherein the first chip and the second chip are sequentially stacked on the substrate, the electric connection structure is arranged between the first chip and the second chip, the electric connection structure comprises a first substrate and a first conductive through hole penetrating through the first substrate along the thickness direction of the first substrate, the first conductive through hole is electrically connected with the first chip and the second chip, the heat dissipation structure is arranged between the first chip and the second chip, and the heat dissipation structure and the electric connection structure are arranged along the direction parallel to the surface of the substrate, and the heat dissipation structure comprises a second substrate and a runner penetrating through the second substrate. The chip stacking structure can solve the heat dissipation problem and reduce the influence of heat dissipation design on the interconnection density of the chip stacking structure.

title_en: Component for semiconductor manufacturing device
abstract_en: Provided is a component for a semiconductor manufacturing device, which has a wafer carrying surface that is not prone to generate particles even if a wafer slides. A component for a semiconductor manufacturing apparatus includes a ceramic substrate having an upper surface provided with a plurality of protrusions for mounting a wafer, each of the plurality of protrusions having an upper end surface, at least one of the upper end surfaces having a patterned concave-convex shape.

title_en: Self-aligned GaN and MOS heterojunction device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power semiconductors and discloses a self-aligned GaN and MOS heterojunction device which comprises a substrate, a gallium nitride structure and a MOS structure, wherein the gallium nitride structure specifically comprises a buffer layer, a gallium nitride layer, a barrier layer, a gallium nitride source electrode, a gallium nitride grid electrode and a gallium nitride source electrode, the MOS structure specifically comprises a diffusion layer, a well region, a source region, a MOS drain electrode, an oxide layer, a MOS grid electrode and a MOS source electrode, a dielectric wall is deposited between the gallium nitride structure and the MOS structure, and an intermediate layer is covered between the gallium nitride grid electrode and the barrier layer. According to the invention, the gallium nitride structure and the MOS structure are physically and electrically isolated on a single chip by introducing the dielectric wall, and the unique inverted convex gallium nitride grid and the self-aligned intermediate layer design are utilized, so that the complementary advantages and the deep integration of the GaN HEMT and the silicon-based MOSFET are successfully realized, and the performance potential of the GaN material in the aspects of high-frequency and high-efficiency power conversion can be exerted.

title_en: Sintering process and sintering device for battery piece
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of photovoltaic cell processing, in particular to a cell sintering process and a sintering device, which comprise the steps of providing a cell, at least part of the cell is provided with a coating, the coating is provided with a ferromagnetic metal material, a heating element is provided to form a thermal field, the cell is arranged in the thermal field and heated to enable the coating to have fluidity, a magnetic element is provided, the magnetic element comprises a first magnetic element, the first magnetic element is arranged on one side of the cell, which is opposite to the coating, the first magnetic element has magnetism, and the first magnetic element is used for attracting the coating, so that grains in the coating move close to the cell or have a moving trend. The technical problem of lower sintering quality of the battery piece is solved, and the technical effect of improving the sintering quality of the battery piece is achieved.

title_en: Rectifier bridge heat radiation structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rectifier bridge technical field just discloses a rectifier bridge heat radiation structure, the encapsulation box includes box body, first base block and second base block, the inside copper conducting strip that is provided with of box body, the copper conducting strip includes the strip fin of the middle main conducting strip and both sides, the strip fin extends to the box body outside, main conducting strip surface bonds and has two-sided heat conduction insulating silica gel cloth. This rectifier bridge heat radiation structure, through setting up copper conducting strip and two-sided heat conduction insulating silica gel cloth, and paste the main radiating component diode module of rectifier bridge on two-sided heat conduction insulating silica gel cloth, unified encapsulation at last, be favorable to carrying out the heat conduction to the diode module through copper conducting strip and two-sided heat conduction insulating silica gel cloth, and effectively dispel the heat through the bar fin, it is better to compare ordinary rectifier bridge heat dispersion, can break the bar fin at will when the installation simultaneously, avoid influencing other electronic component's installation.

title_en: Testing device for testing power of photovoltaic modules with different angles and different shapes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a testing device for testing the power of photovoltaic modules with different angles and shapes, which comprises a supporting and rotating device, two first fixed modules and two second fixed modules; the first fixing assemblies correspond to the first edges one by one and are used for abutting against the lower end surfaces of the corresponding first edges and the side surfaces of the corresponding first edges; the second fixing assemblies correspond to the second edge portions one by one and are used for abutting against the lower end faces of the corresponding second edge portions and the side faces of the corresponding second edge portions; the first fixing assembly and the second fixing assembly are connected with pressing pieces used for abutting against the upper end faces of the photovoltaic assemblies so as to press the photovoltaic assemblies onto the first fixing assembly and the second fixing assembly. The utility model discloses can simplify test operation, improve efficiency of software testing, can test not unidimensional photovoltaic module to can quick assembly disassembly, improve the security and the convenience of carrying.

title_en: Dark-scene full-color functional image sensor and imaging device thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an image sensor of full-color function of dark scene, include: a pixel array including a plurality of pixels arranged in rows and columns; each group of optical filters is respectively arranged on the pixels, each group of optical filters comprises a plurality of color optical filters with different light responses and a plurality of white optical filters with full-spectrum responses, pixels below the color optical filters are used for collecting color signals of images, and pixels below the white optical filters are used for collecting brightness signals of the images, wherein one color optical filter with light response in each group of optical filters at least corresponds to one white optical filter; and an infrared suppression film disposed between the color filter and the pixel to suppress infrared light from entering the pixel.

title_en: Heat dissipation enhancement mode SMC packaging structure
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the SMC packaging technical field, provides a heat dissipation enhancement type SMC packaging structure, which comprises a colloid, the bottom of the colloid is provided with a lower frame, the inner cavity of the colloid is provided with an upper frame, the left side of the bottom of the upper frame is provided with a welding flux, the welding flux comprises an alloy substrate layer, the bottom of the welding flux is provided with a chip, the joint of the bottom of the chip and the top of the lower frame is provided with a welding layer, the welding layer is a resin adhesive, the bottom of the chip is contacted with the top of the lower frame, the left side of the upper frame penetrates to the left side of the colloid, the advantage of good heat dissipation effect is achieved through the arrangement of the colloid, the lower frame, the upper frame, the welding flux, the chip and the welding layer, the problem that the heat dissipation effect of the existing enhancement type SMC, the problem of enhancement mode SMC packaging structure practicality has been reduced.

title_en: Device for detecting wafer integrity of Centura ACP machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a listen device of centrura ACP board conveying wafer integrality, including laser emitter, laser receiver and the power of being connected with laser emitter and laser receiver, one among laser emitter and the laser receiver is installed the wafer of board bears the weight of the cavity top, and another among laser emitter and the laser receiver is installed the wafer of board bears the weight of the cavity bottom, laser emitter is used for producing a circular shape laser circle or laser ring, laser receiver is used for forming circular or annular response region, laser ring or laser ring with the response region is relative in the ascending position of vertical side, the wafer that the wafer bore the cavity is located laser emitter with between the laser receiver, the laser irradiation of laser emitter transmission is in the edge of wafer. The utility model discloses can carry out real time monitoring to the integrality of wafer in wafer bearing cavity to can effectively avoid wafer broken piece can't be found in the wafer bearing cavity and lead to the board to be forced the condition of shutting down and take place.

title_en: Scraper capable of adjusting blade depth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a scraper of adjustable blade degree of depth, including blade mounting, mould base, blade and clamp bolt, clamp bolt threaded connection blade mounting, mould base body coupling is in blade mounting lower extreme one side, and the middle part of blade mounting and mould base body coupling department sets up the blade and carries out the sword seam gap of crossing that cuts, and the blade butt is equipped with the regulation hole of arranging along the cutting direction on the clamp bolt one side of blade mounting on the blade, and the blade lower extreme passes the blade seam to the clamp bolt fastening. The utility model discloses can adjust moving down the degree of depth of blade and fixed with clamp bolt, realize having improved the accuracy to the skinning of the specific thickness of photovoltaic product, also improve work efficiency.

title_en: High-efficient heat abstractor that large tracts of land UVLED array was used
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency heat dissipation device for a large-area UVLED array, which relates to the technical field of heat dissipation devices and comprises a substrate, the bottom surface of the base plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of ultraviolet light emitting diodes which are distributed in an array manner, the top surface of the base plate is provided with a cooling plate through bolts, the middle part of the upper surface of the cooling plate is fixedly connected with a partition plate, the edges of the periphery of the upper surface of the cooling plate are fixedly connected with side plates, the middle parts of the side plates at the left and right sides of the cooling plate are both fixedly provided with through holes, a cooling top plate is arranged above the cooling plate, the cooling roof passes through the bolt and installs on the sideboard, two water intaking of last fixed surface of cooling roof are arranged, two a plurality of inlet openings have all been seted up to the inner bottom wall of water intaking row, and are a plurality of the inlet opening all run through the cooling roof and with the lower surface parallel and level of cooling roof, two the equal fixedly connected with water pipe in top of water intaking row. The utility model discloses the radiating effect is even, and the radiating effect is good.

title_en: Sintering equipment for battery electrode slurry
abstract_en: The utility model provides a battery electrode paste's sintering equipment relates to solar photovoltaic technical field. The sintering equipment for the battery electrode slurry comprises a drying area, a sintering area and a conveyor belt, wherein the drying area and the sintering area are sequentially arranged along the conveying direction of the conveyor belt. The drying area comprises a plurality of first working temperature areas, the first working temperature areas are sequentially arranged along the conveying direction, the working temperatures of the first working temperature areas are gradually decreased along the conveying direction, meanwhile, the drying area is provided with an air supply mechanism, and the air direction of the air supply mechanism is opposite to the conveying direction. When the temperature of the drying area is set in a descending manner and airflow opposite to the conveying direction exists, the volatilization efficiency of organic matters in the slurry can be improved, the silicon wafer and the electrode can form better ohmic contact in the sintering process of the silicon wafer, the series resistance of the battery piece obtained by sintering is reduced, the filling factor of the battery piece is improved, the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the battery piece can be improved, and the power generation cost of the photovoltaic module is reduced.

title_en: Shingle assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fold tile subassembly. The shingle assembly comprises: at least one cell string, each cell string including a tab at a terminal end, the tab having a first conductive structure on a bottom surface in conductive contact with a positive electrode of a solar cell adjacent the tab and a second conductive structure in conductive contact with a second bus bar. The first bus bar is in conductive contact with the conductive structure on the bottom surface of the solar cell sheet at the head end of each cell string. The utility model discloses can realize that the anodal busbar and the negative pole busbar of shingle assembly all connect on the basal surface of battery cluster to make the top of shingle assembly can't see the busbar, such setting can enough promote the aesthetic property, has avoided the busbar to influence the photic area of battery cluster, has reduced the technology complexity of shingle assembly again.

title_en: Circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model provides a circuit board, include: the core plate is provided with a groove body, and the groove body comprises a plurality of first sub-groove bodies and a plurality of second sub-groove bodies which are positioned below the first sub-groove bodies and correspond to the first sub-groove bodies in position; the chip assembly is arranged in the groove body; the chip assembly comprises a plurality of first chips positioned in the first sub-tank body and a plurality of second chips positioned in the second sub-tank body; each first chip and a second chip corresponding to the first chip are connected in series to form a plurality of chip groups; the plurality of chip groups are connected in parallel, one end of each chip group is connected with the first power signal layer, and the other end of each chip group is connected with the ground plane. Therefore, the plurality of chips are embedded in the circuit board, so that the circuit board is light, thin and small.

title_en: Chip, stacked chip, storage device and electronic device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chip, pile up chip, storage device and electronic equipment, wherein, the chip is as the sub-chip that piles up the chip, the chip includes: the chip comprises an internal interface and an internal circuit, wherein the internal circuit is used for realizing the transceiving function of the chip, the internal interface is used for connecting other sub-chips in the stacked chip, the internal circuit is connected to the internal interface through an electrostatic discharge circuit, and the electrostatic discharge circuit is used for discharging electrostatic charges poured from the internal interface. The electrostatic discharge circuit is connected between an internal circuit and an internal interface of the sub-chip, and when an ESD (Electro-Static discharge) event occurs in the assembling process of the sub-chip, the electrostatic discharge circuit can release electrostatic charges poured from the internal interface, so that the sub-chip can be prevented from being damaged, and the technical problem of poor reliability of the stacked chip in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Circuit board assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circuit board assembly, including chip, circuit board and radiating piece, the chip is located on the circuit board and with the circuit board electricity is connected, be equipped with the through-hole on the circuit board, the at least part of through-hole is located the chip is in the orthographic projection region of circuit board, the radiating piece is including being located the circuit board is kept away from the main part and the connection of one side of chip the grafting portion of main part, grafting portion via the through-hole with the chip contact, it is right with the chip heat dissipation. The utility model discloses a set up the through-hole on the circuit board and provide the heat dissipation way for the chip, the heat-dissipating piece is add grafting portion and is passed the chip contact on through-hole and the circuit board, can be effectively with the heat conduction of the chip that generates heat to the heat-dissipating piece on, the heat in the heat-dissipating piece is through modes such as convection current or radiation again give off to the surrounding environment in, realize the quick radiating effect of chip, promoted the radiating efficiency and the effect of circuit board greatly.

title_en: Saw blade foot cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a saw bit foot cutting device, including mounting bracket, setting at the mount on mounting bracket top, slide at the inside adjustable shelf of mount, through adjusting length adjustment structure mounting at the inside foot structure support of cutting of adjustable shelf, set up the foot structure of cutting to the side of foot structure support, this saw bit foot cutting device: firstly, the spring is used for compressing energy to generate pressure, so that the lower pressing plates on the two sides are matched with the matching plate to tightly press the pins, the two sides of the pins are tightly pressed and fixed by the lower pressing plates, the diode body is not stressed during cutting, the stress damage of the diode body can be effectively avoided, and the cutting quality is improved; secondly, the motor drives the screw rod to rotate, the screw rod drives the pin cutting structure support to slide on the first slide rod, the position of the saw blade is changed, the length of the cut pin is changed accordingly, different pin lengths can be cut through the mode, and the application range is wide.

title_en: Substrate cleaning device
