abstract_en: The utility model provides a substrate cleaning device, including ozone generating device, belt cleaning device, liquid mixing pipeline and efflux pumping installations. The liquid mixing pipeline comprises an inverted U-shaped pipe arranged in the vertical direction, and a first horizontal thin pipe and a second horizontal thin pipe which are connected with two opening ends of the inverted U-shaped pipe respectively and are arranged in the horizontal direction; the jet flow pumping device is arranged on the first horizontal thin pipe and is connected with the cleaning device and the ozone generating device, so that after liquid is output from the cleaning device, mixed gas containing ozone generated by the ozone generating device is mixed with the liquid to form a gas-liquid mixture, and the gas-liquid mixture is conveyed to the cleaning device through the inverted U-shaped pipe and the second horizontal thin pipe; the inverted U-shaped tube has a diameter of 5-15 cm, a length of 5-30 cm in the horizontal direction and a height of 30-120 cm in the vertical direction, so as to ensure that the ozone can be sufficiently dissolved in the liquid before entering the cleaning device.

title_en: Surface-mounted semiconductor device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a SMD semiconductor device, including insulating casing, insulating casing's inboard middle part is equipped with the core, the both sides of core all are equipped with the lead wire, the lead wire is the structure of square, and the part that the outstanding insulating casing surface of lead wire constitutes the pin, the lead wire is located the inboard part of insulating casing and constitutes the paster base island, one side that the paster base island corresponds the core is equipped with compression spring, compression spring's other pot head is established in the guide pin, and the guide pin bushing one end department of keeping away from compression spring is equipped with electrically conductive preforming. The utility model discloses in, restrain and absorb the vibration through compression spring and guide pin bushing, guarantee the good contact of electrically conductive preforming and core, be in effective compression state during the compression spring normality, when not making compression spring permanent damage appear, keep the good contact of compression spring and paster baseland to realize permanent stable switching on.

title_en: Power thyristor protection packaging structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power thyristor protection packaging structure, which comprises a housin, the equal a plurality of group's sleeves of fixedly connected with in upper and lower both ends of casing, the sliding connection that telescopic inside is good has the second baffle, the one end fixedly connected with second slide bar of second baffle, telescopic inside is provided with the third spring, the upper end fixedly connected with connecting plate of second slide bar is located the upper end fixedly connected with second splint of connecting plate are located the lower extreme the first splint of lower extreme fixedly connected with of connecting plate, be provided with first spring between connecting plate and the sleeve, the fixed section of thick bamboo of the upper end fixedly connected with four groups of first splint. The utility model discloses in, through the first spring and the third spring that set up, under the restraint of second baffle, second slide bar, sleeve and connecting plate, can carry out the shock attenuation to power thyristor, can improve power thyristor's shock resistance.

title_en: Novel energy-saving environment-friendly light-emitting diode
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel energy-concerving and environment-protective emitting diode relates to the emitting diode field, because its pin exposes to the emitting diode who exists on the current market when using, very easily receives the damage to reduce electrically conductive efficiency, increase the problem of energy consumption, the following scheme is proposed now, and it includes the diode body, the pin is installed to the bottom of diode body, the heat dissipation case is installed to the bottom of diode body, just the inside of heat dissipation case is provided with the hole, the pin runs through the hole and extends to its bottom, the circumference outer wall of pin is provided with the insulating layer, just the insulating layer is connected with the heat dissipation case, the internally mounted of insulating layer has expanding spring, the bottom of insulating layer is provided with the connecting box, the top that the pin runs through the connecting box extends to inside. This novel energy-concerving and environment-protective emitting diode not only can combine together through fag end net and foam pad and fix article to be convenient for cushion article through spring cooperation telescopic link.

title_en: Two unification lamp pearls and LED display screen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a two unification lamp pearls and LED display screen, fix on the circuit board through ruddiness pin and green glow pin, thereby make ruddiness chip and green glow chip fix on the circuit board, carry out vertical slip in packaging shell through the circuit board, thereby make ruddiness chip and green glow chip carry out vertical slip in packaging shell, and then be convenient for maintain or change ruddiness chip and green glow chip, carry out the water conservancy diversion to the heat that red light chip and green glow chip produced through the guide plate, thereby make the heat that ruddiness chip and green glow chip produced can follow the filter and discharge, and then avoided ruddiness chip and green glow chip to be in high temperature environment for a long time and caused the condition that ruddiness chip and green glow chip damaged.

title_en: Semiconductor memory device with a plurality of memory cells
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semiconductor memory device, which comprises a substrate, an active structure, a shallow trench isolation and a plurality of word lines. The active structure is disposed within the substrate and includes a plurality of first active segments and a plurality of second active segments, each of the first active segments and each of the second active segments extending parallel to each other toward the first direction, the second active segments being disposed outside all of the first active segments. The shallow trench isolation is arranged in the substrate, surrounds the active structure and comprises a plurality of first parts and a plurality of second parts. Word lines extend parallel to each other along a second direction and are disposed within the substrate. At least two of the word lines are interleaved with only the second active segment, or at least one does not cross any second portion. Therefore, the direct conduction between the word line and the bit line can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Wiring board and module
abstract_en: A module (101) is provided with: a substrate (1) having a main surface (1 a); and a conductor post (4) disposed on the main surface (1 a). The conductor column (4) comprises: a conductor column body (4 a); and a protruding portion (4b) that protrudes from the outer periphery of the conductor post body (4a) at a position that is halfway in the height direction of the conductor post body (4 a).

title_en: Film expanding table suitable for die bonder
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of semiconductor equipment, and particularly relates to a film expanding table suitable for a die bonder. The utility model has small volume, can be installed on a die bonder, saves a wafer expander, reduces manual intervention and improves the productivity.

title_en: Diode guide pin clamping and forming system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of diode guide pin production equipment, and particularly relates to a diode guide pin clamping and forming system. The clamping wire device comprises a clamping wire module and a top fork assembly which are oppositely arranged, wherein the opposite surfaces of the two clamping wire modules are respectively provided with a clamping wire groove, the two clamping wire grooves are folded to clamp a lead wire, the clamping wire module comprises a clamping wire die and clamping pieces, the clamping pieces are arranged on the front side of the clamping wire die, one ends of the two clamping pieces are fixed with the clamping wire die, the other ends of the two clamping pieces are oppositely arranged, and the top fork assembly is abutted to the free ends of the two clamping pieces to keep away from one side of the clamping wire die. Used for solving the problem that the annular end is difficult to form under the end head of the guide pin. Utilize the one end of the double-layered line mould and the clamping piece in the double-layered line module to fix, the other end of clamping piece sets up relatively for form the clearance between the free end of clamping piece and the double-layered line mould, utilize this clearance to accomplish the operation that the guide pin is multiform to become round annular end below the end, utilize the top fork subassembly to support the free end of clamping piece simultaneously, when the centre gripping striking, do benefit to secondary feeding mechanism and continue the feed supplement, can the more major diameter of shaping guide pin end.

title_en: Wireless live microphone integrated circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless direct-broadcast microphone integrated circuit board, and particularly relates to the technical field of integrated circuit boards. According to the utility model, the oil tank and the guide pipe are arranged in the heat conducting plate and are connected with one end of the guide pipe through the oil outlet pipe, when the heat conducting plate works, heat can be generated, water in the oil tank flows into the guide pipe through the oil outlet pipe, and then the water in the guide pipe flows into the oil tank through the oil inlet pipe through the micro water pump, so that a water circulation is formed, the heat generated by the heat conducting plate is absorbed, and the problem that the circuit board main body cannot work continuously due to overhigh temperature is avoided.

title_en: Heat conduction packaging structure of solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar cells, in particular to a heat conduction packaging structure of a solar cell and a photovoltaic module. The heat conduction packaging structure of the solar cell comprises: the soaking pipe is arranged in the gap of the cell so as to transmit the heat generated by the cell to the aluminum frame. According to the heat conduction packaging structure of the solar cell, the soaking pipes are arranged at the gaps of the cell pieces, so that heat generated by the cell pieces is transmitted to the aluminum frame by using low-pressure water vapor convection inside the soaking pipes, and further dissipated out in the mode of aluminum frame convection and heat radiation, and therefore the working temperature of the solar cell is reduced, and the power generation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Photovoltaic cell piece and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic cell and a photovoltaic module, wherein the photovoltaic cell comprises a substrate and a silicon wafer, and the silicon wafer and the substrate are integrated; the crystal orientation direction of the silicon wafer is the normal direction of the substrate. The substrate is integrated with the silicon chip, is an integral part of the battery piece, can be cut into any shape and meets the thickness requirement.

title_en: LED module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides an LED module and electronic equipment, wherein the LED module comprises a bowl cup, an LED chip and a fluorescent layer, the LED chip comprises a first chip and a second chip which are arranged in parallel, the internal resistance of the first chip is smaller than that of the second chip, the fluorescent layer comprises a first fluorescent layer and a second fluorescent layer, the first fluorescent layer covers the first chip, the second fluorescent layer covers the first chip and the second chip and fully covers the whole bowl cup, the LED module further comprises a limiting part and a driving module, the limiting part is arranged at the top edge of the bowl cup, and the driving module is arranged in the bowl cup and is close to the bottom edge of the bowl cup. According to the utility model, the chips with different internal resistances are arranged in the same bowl cup, the fluorescent layers are covered on the corresponding chips, the chips are enabled to respectively emit light by arranging a circuit, light sources with different color temperatures are excited, materials are saved, the LED module has the functions of dimming and color mixing, the miniaturization of dimming and color mixing is realized, and excessive circuit design is not needed.

title_en: Waterproof type LED packaging structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of light-emitting diode packaging equipment, and discloses a waterproof light-emitting diode packaging structure which comprises a shell with a hollow interior, wherein an annular groove is formed in a bearing surface of the shell, two through holes are formed in the bottom end of the inner wall of the annular groove, a lantern ring slides on the inner wall of the annular groove, a second spring is arranged at the bottom end of the lantern ring, and two second clamping blocks penetrate through the interior of the lantern ring and slide. According to the utility model, the lantern ring is pressed downwards by the weight of rainwater, the second spring is in a compression state at the moment, so that rainwater falls through a gap between the second fixture block and the lantern ring, the second fixture block is in a wedge shape with a wide top end and a narrow bottom end, so that the rainwater falls into the annular groove, and the rainwater falls into the shell through the perforation.

title_en: Machine table tracing device for series welding machine and series welding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a machine tracing device for a series welding machine and the series welding machine, relates to the technical field of photovoltaic cells and aims to solve the problem that the machine cannot be traced or is inconvenient to trace. The machine tracing device comprises a positioning rod connected with a machine and a marking wheel in rolling contact with the surface of a battery to mark the machine, the marking wheel is connected with the positioning rod in a rotating mode, a marking belt is arranged on the periphery of the marking wheel, the marking belt and the marking wheel are detachably connected, a bulge used for representing machine information is arranged on the marking belt, marking liquid is arranged in the bulge, when the battery moves, the marking wheel rolls on the surface of the battery, the bulge is in surface contact with the battery, the marking liquid in the bulge is coated on the surface of the battery, and the machine information is marked on the battery. The series welding machine comprises the machine tracing device provided by the technical scheme. The machine tracing device provided by the utility model is used for tracing the machine of the series welding machine for manufacturing the photovoltaic cell.

title_en: Display substrate and display device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a display substrate and a display device, relates to the technical field of display, and aims to solve the problem that under the condition of reducing a negative power supply signal, grid leakage of a driving transistor in a sub-pixel driving circuit is increased to influence the display quality of a display product. The sub-pixels in the display substrate include: the first initialization signal line and the second initialization signal line transmit initialization signals with different potentials; the sub-pixel driving circuit in the sub-pixel comprises a driving transistor, a first reset transistor and a second reset transistor; the first electrode of the driving transistor is coupled with the light-emitting element; a first pole of the first reset transistor is coupled with the grid electrode of the driving transistor, and a second pole of the first reset transistor is coupled with the first initialization signal line; a first pole of the second reset transistor is coupled to the light emitting element, and a second pole of the second reset transistor is coupled to the second initialization signal line. The display substrate provided by the utility model is used for displaying.

title_en: Connecting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting structure, which is a square flat package and comprises a semiconductor element, a first pressing sheet, a second pressing sheet and an outer frame; the semiconductor element comprises a first surface and a second surface, the first pressing piece is connected with the semiconductor element through the first surface, and the second pressing piece is connected with the semiconductor element through the second surface; the area of the first pressing sheet is larger than that of the first surface, and the area of the second pressing sheet is larger than that of the second surface; a plurality of connecting ribs are arranged on the periphery of the first pressing piece and the second pressing piece, the semiconductor element, the first pressing piece and the second pressing piece are located in the outer frame, and the outer surfaces of the connecting ribs are exposed on the surface of the outer frame. By reducing the exposed area of the semiconductor element/chip after the plastic package scribing, the tin-climbing phenomenon is reduced and the metal ion migration risk is reduced in the subsequent application.

title_en: Die bonding device for die bonding machine
abstract_en: The application discloses solid brilliant device for solid brilliant machine belongs to the technical field of semiconductor package equipment, and its technical scheme main points include: the die bonder comprises a die bonder body, wherein the die bonder body is provided with a workbench; the die bonder is arranged on the die bonder body; the moving module is arranged between the die bonding mechanism and the workbench and comprises an X-axis driving assembly and a Y-axis driving assembly; the two onboard components are arranged on the workbench; the two wafer disk fixing seats are arranged between the two on-board components; the suction nozzle body is arranged on the die bonding mechanism and provided with a suction end, the suction end is provided with a plurality of suction grooves, and the suction grooves are regularly distributed. The application provides a solid brilliant device, improves solid brilliant precision and solid brilliant effect, and reduces to cause unfavorable phenomena such as fish tail, dirty, foreign matter to the wafer.

title_en: Two-cell packaging Schottky diode
abstract_en: The utility model provides a twin-packaged Schottky diode which comprises a diode main body and a pin, wherein one end of the pin is fixedly inserted in the diode main body, one end of the pin is fixedly sleeved with a convex protective sleeve, one side of the convex protective sleeve is fixedly sleeved on one side of the diode main body, a plurality of reinforcing strips are fixedly installed on the inner side wall of one side of the convex protective sleeve, the reinforcing strips are fixedly inserted in the diode main body, the other end of the pin is movably sleeved with an extension tube, the twin-packaged Schottky diode is reasonable in design, one end of the pin is sleeved with the extension tube which can stretch out and draw back, and the extension tube can extend the pin in the installation process, so that the twin-packaged Schottky diode can be adjusted according to the installation environment, and the adaptability to the installation environment is improved.

title_en: Flexible assembly laminating tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flexible assembly laminating tool, and particularly relates to the field of laminating and edge covering of a photovoltaic flexible assembly. According to the utility model, by arranging the circular groove tool, the problem of dislocation and offset of the flexible assembly can be effectively avoided, the lamination quality of the flexible assembly is ensured, the edge sealing protection effect of the adhesive film overflowing from the flexible assembly can be generated on the adhesive film, the service life of outdoor power generation in the future is prolonged, the use of the edge sealing adhesive tape is reduced, and the production cost is saved.

title_en: Cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cleaning equipment, including cavity, base and focus ring, wherein, the focus ring encircle in the periphery of base is used for will wasing the particle gathering focus ring's inner surrounding region to make when placing the substrate the edge of substrate with the laminating of the interior ring portion of focus ring. The utility model provides an among the cleaning equipment, because the edge of substrate and the laminating of the interior annular portion of focus ring to make the cleaning particle keep off in the outside by the focus ring, and can't invade the back of substrate and contact the back of substrate, and then can protect the back of substrate not damaged, with the integrality of guaranteeing the substrate, the cleaning particle also can not contact the base surface simultaneously, consequently still can protect the base surface not corroded.

title_en: Cascaded LED lamp string circuit board connecting structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of LED circuit layout, and particularly relates to a structure for manufacturing a circuit layout by a cascade type LED lamp string, which comprises the layout of a circuit, the welding of a bonding pad, the size and the arrangement of wire diameter and the like; LED lamp beads are cascaded through three parallel and parallel leads, a line at a VDD end and a middle line are respectively arranged as DI signal input and DI signal output in a cutting or punching fracture mode, and the other line is GND of the lamp beads; through the technical scheme provided by the utility model, the functions of simplifying the wiring packaging process through three-wire drive, saving the production and maintenance cost, improving the light emitting consistency and controlling the flashing mode through external control are realized.

title_en: Semiconductor packaging fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semiconductor packaging and fixing device which comprises a base and a support, wherein a cushion block is arranged on the base, a pressing plate is arranged on the support, and the pressing plate and the base are fixed to enable the support and the cushion block to be fixedly connected. According to the semiconductor packaging and fixing device provided by the utility model, the cushion block and the pressing plate are designed, and the plurality of fixing structures are arranged on the cushion block and the pressing plate to firmly fix the support, so that the phenomenon that the line arc is crushed by the pressing plate due to improper manual placement of the support is avoided, the pressing effect of the support in the push-pull force process is improved, and the accuracy of data is ensured.

title_en: Pin-adjustable surface-mounted diode
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pin-adjustable surface mount diode which comprises a chip and a plastic package shell coated on the outer side of the chip, wherein the lower end of the chip is connected with a first pin, one end of the first pin is positioned on the inner side of the plastic package shell, the other end of the first pin extends to the outer side of the plastic package shell, the upper end of the chip is connected with a conducting strip, the conducting strip and the plastic package shell are integrally formed, the plastic package shell is further provided with a hollow groove, a rotatable second pin is arranged in the hollow groove, one end of the second pin is abutted to the upper end of the conducting strip, the plastic package shell is further provided with a tightening screw, and the second pin and the conducting strip are fixed through the tightening screw. The surface mount diode can adjust the mounting position of the second pin, and is wide in application range.

title_en: LED packaging structure
abstract_en: Disclosed is an LED package structure, including: a substrate; the LED packaging structure comprises a substrate, a plurality of groups of first LED chip groups and a plurality of groups of second LED chip groups, wherein the plurality of groups of first LED chip groups and the plurality of groups of second LED chip groups are positioned on a first surface of the substrate; the first wavelength converter is used for converting light emitted by the first LED chip into cold light, and covers the first LED chip in the first LED chip group; and a second wavelength converter converting light emitted by the second LED chip into warm color light, the second wavelength converter covering the second LED chip in the second LED chip set; the first LED chip group and the second LED chip group are arranged in parallel in a first direction, and the first LED chip group and the second LED chip group are alternately arranged in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction.

title_en: Quantum computer
abstract_en: The application discloses a quantum computer, which is characterized in that a signal generating device, a signal synthesizing device, a signal splitting device, a refrigerating device and a quantum chip are arranged; the signal generating device is positioned outside the refrigerating device and used for generating a frequency regulation initial signal for regulating and controlling the frequency of the qubit on the quantum chip and a quantum state regulation initial signal for regulating and controlling the state of the qubit; the signal synthesis device is positioned outside the refrigerating device and used for synthesizing the received frequency regulation initial signal and the quantum state regulation initial signal into a synthesis signal; the signal splitting device is positioned in the refrigerating device and is used for splitting the synthetic signal into a frequency regulation signal for regulating and controlling the frequency parameter of the qubit and a quantum state regulation signal for regulating and controlling the quantum state of the qubit; the quantum chip is located at the lowest temperature layer of the refrigerating device and executes quantum computation according to the received frequency regulation and control signal and the quantum state regulation and control signal. The method and the device can simplify the quantum measurement and control circuit and provide conditions for the extension of the quantum bit.

title_en: Luminous chip packaging structure capable of changing bonding pad
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a can change luminous chip package structure of pad, the light emitting area of luminous chip bonds on the fluorescence glued membrane, anodal silver glue film and negative pole silver glue film are the anodal pad and the negative pole pad of cladding luminous chip respectively, white silica gel position is close to a side surface of luminous chip on the epoxy glue film, and the cladding is in the periphery of luminous chip, the cladding is filled at anodal silver glue film to the epoxy glue film, negative pole silver glue film and the anodal pad and the negative pole pad periphery of luminous chip, and the surface of epoxy glue film and anodal silver glue film and negative pole silver glue film flushes. The utility model discloses on the basis that does not change current encapsulation size and structure, enlarge positive negative pole pad area and positive negative pole pad interval of packaging body, make it be difficult for appearing the bad phenomenon of welding, not only increased the heat radiating area of packaging body, improved the life of product, can prevent moreover that bonding wire tin cream appears because positive negative pole pad interval undersize is the short circuit phenomenon that the tin cream links together.

title_en: Power device lead frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power device pin frame relates to the relevant technical field of pin frame, including power device, power device's both sides distribution has a plurality of pin, power device's last fixed surface has a plurality of limiting plate, the inside slidable mounting of limiting plate has a set of slider, the bottom of every slider all is connected with a pin, the upper surface of slider rotates there is the support column, the lateral wall of slider slides there is the stripper plate, the center department fixed mounting of limiting plate has the insulation board, power device's lateral wall is located pin department and has seted up the sliding tray, the inside slidable mounting of sliding tray has the sliding block, thereby make the stripper plate can extrude the inner wall of limiting plate, thereby make the pin can fix in appropriate position, and then change the mode that is fixed between traditional pin and the power device, thereby the convenience is to the regulation of pin position, make things convenient for the pin to survey the grafting position of test panel with the circuit and correspond.

title_en: Photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, and discloses a photovoltaic module which comprises a battery string, a packaging adhesive film and a cover plate, wherein the battery string comprises a plurality of battery pieces which are sequentially connected in series; the packaging adhesive film covers the surface of the battery string, the packaging adhesive film comprises a middle part with preset thickness and edge parts distributed on two sides of the middle part along a first direction, the thickness of the two edge parts is larger than that of the middle part, the thickness of each edge part is gradually increased along the direction far away from the middle part, the ratio of the preset thickness to the thickness of the battery piece is 1-4, and the first direction is perpendicular to the thickness direction of the middle part; the cover plate covers the surface of the packaging adhesive film, which is far away from the battery string. The photovoltaic module that this application embodiment provided can improve the bad phenomenon that photovoltaic module local position appears when reducing the grammes per square metre of encapsulation glued membrane.

title_en: Diode mould
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a diode technical field, concretely relates to diode mould, including the bed die, bed die bottom surface four corners department has all set firmly the support, and bed die top surface four corners department has all set firmly the round bar, and the bed die top is equipped with the mould. The utility model discloses a module that the pull pulling is located the lower extreme installation piece is taken out, the module of selecting the die cavity of suitable size inserts the slot respectively inside, the rotation regulation hand wheel is fixed, the diode semi-manufactured goods that will need mould plastics the use after the completion installation are placed respectively inside the die cavity that is located the lower extreme, accomplish the installation back and be connected inlet pipe and outside conveying pipeline, work as mould and bed die compound die, the inlet pipe is moulded plastics, accomplish to mould plastics and take off the diode of accomplishing injection moulding after making the mould rebound after the back. When the diodes of different sizes are processed, the die is more convenient to disassemble and replace, the operation time is effectively shortened, the time and labor are saved, the work and production efficiency are improved, and the using effect is remarkably improved.

title_en: Mirror surface aluminum substrate and LED light source device
abstract_en: The application discloses aluminium base board of mirror surface and LED light source device relates to the illumination field, includes: the circuit board comprises an insulating board with through holes, wherein circuits and front bonding pads are distributed on the front surface of the insulating board; the mirror surface aluminum plate is connected with the back surface of the insulating plate and comprises a first mirror surface aluminum plate block and a second mirror surface aluminum plate block which are separated from each other and have the same thickness; the projection of the through hole on the mirror surface aluminum plate is positioned in the range of the first mirror surface aluminum plate, and the second mirror surface aluminum plate is a back bonding pad. Mirror surface aluminum plate includes first mirror surface aluminum plate and second mirror surface aluminum plate that alternate segregation and thickness equal, second mirror surface aluminum plate is as the back pad of the aluminium base board of mirror surface, therefore, there is not difference in height between the first mirror surface aluminum plate at the aluminium base board back of mirror surface and the back pad, when last chip mounter, back pad and tin cream contact are good, avoid taking place to desolder, and then avoid the light source device to take place to rock, guarantee the precision of paster, promote the yield of light source device.

title_en: High-voltage integrated circuit and intelligent power module
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-voltage integrated circuit, it is including being used for the high-pressure bootstrap circuit of direct output, the bootstrap circuit includes first electric capacity, second electric capacity, third electric capacity, first resistance, second resistance, comparator, smith trigger, NAND gate, phase inverter, first transistor and second transistor. The utility model provides an intelligent power module, which comprises a driving chip, a polyimide layer and a plastic package material, wherein the driving chip comprises a high-voltage integrated circuit provided by the utility model; the plastic packaging material comprises a filler and epoxy resin; the polyimide layer is arranged on the outer surface of the driving chip; the filler is spherical particles and is arranged on one side of the polyimide layer far away from the driving chip; the epoxy resin forms an integrated structure by the drive chip, the polyimide layer and the filler in a plastic package mode. Adopt the utility model discloses technical scheme's reliability is high and the product yield is high.

title_en: P type solar cell, cell module and photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of solar cells, and provides a P-type solar cell, a cell module and a photovoltaic system. The P-type solar cell includes: a P-type silicon wafer; the tunneling oxide layer, the doped polycrystalline silicon layer, the first passivation layer and the first electrode are sequentially stacked on the first surface of the P-type silicon wafer, and the first electrode penetrates through the first passivation layer to be in contact with the doped polycrystalline silicon; the aluminum oxide layer, the second passivation layer and the second electrode are sequentially stacked on the second surface of the P-type silicon wafer, the aluminum oxide layer and the second passivation layer are provided with a slotting region, a boron doping layer is formed in the slotting region, and the second electrode penetrates through the slotting region and contacts with the boron doping layer. In this way, both sides can be made radiation resistant and the laser induced lattice damage repaired.

title_en: Feeding structure for diode light splitting machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a diode feeding equipment technical field, and a pay-off structure for diode beam splitter is disclosed, the upper surface of base is provided with conveying mechanism, conveying mechanism's upper surface left side top fixed mounting has the workbin down, the outside of slide is provided with unloading control mechanism, U type adjusting part is articulated mutually with the lateral wall of slide, the inner chamber top and the bottom of slide are provided with first dog and second dog and first dog and second dog all with U type adjusting part fixed connection respectively, a driving motor passes through link fixed mounting in the below of slide, the unloading control mechanism of setting has avoided controlling blanking volume because of being unable in the unloading in-process, and lead to increasing the problem of the follow-up arrangement degree of difficulty, the conveying mechanism of setting has avoided putting mixed and disorderly because of the diode in transportation process, make and still need arrange it in order, thereby the problem of production efficiency has been influenced.

title_en: Diode component convenient to encapsulate
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the diode subassembly, especially, a diode subassembly convenient to encapsulation to current dismantlement problem, the following scheme is put forward at present, it includes the base, the cavity has all been seted up to the top both sides of base, has seted up the fixed orifices on the top inner wall of cavity, and slidable mounting has the dead lever in the fixed orifices, and the one end of dead lever extends to in the cavity, and outside the other end of dead lever extended to the cavity, the dead lever extended to the outer one end fixed mounting of cavity has the protective housing, has seted up the fixed slot on one side inner wall of cavity, and slidable mounting has the kelly in the fixed slot, and the one end of kelly extends to in the fixed slot, and outside the other end of kelly extended to the fixed slot, the one end fixed mounting that the kelly extended to in the fixed slot has the one end of first spring. The utility model discloses pass through dead lever and base fixed connection with the protective housing, greatly made things convenient for the dismantlement of protective housing, made things convenient for the dismantlement and the maintenance of protective housing simultaneously.

title_en: Locator for semiconductor processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a locator is used in semiconductor processing, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the left side at base top is provided with places the seat, the inside top of placing the seat is provided with the positioning seat, it has adjusting screw to peg graft in the inside both sides of positioning seat, adjusting screw's outside fixedly connected with adjusts the runner, adjusting screw's inboard fixedly connected with locating plate, the inboard of locating plate bonds and has the protection pad. This locator is used in semiconductor processing is through being provided with the regulation runner, the positioning seat, the locating plate, adjusting screw and protection are filled up, during the use, put the product in the groove of positioning seat, the regulation runner of later rotatory both sides, it begins to rotate to drive adjusting screw, along with adjusting screw's rotation alright drive locating plate horizontal migration, it is spacing to it at four corners of product with the locating plate support, the structure is more nimble, the product of applicable multiple specification uses, the scope of using has been improved, it is not enough to solve the flexibility, the more single problem of location structure.

title_en: Etching clamp for solar cell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an sculpture anchor clamps of solar wafer, concretely relates to anchor clamps field, including workstation and the splint of setting around the workstation top, the positive fixedly connected with slipmat in top of workstation, four spacing spouts have been seted up all around at the top of workstation, wherein two the middle part of spacing spout is provided with first threaded rod, two in addition the middle part of spacing spout is provided with the second threaded rod. The utility model discloses at first, controller control step motor through setting up starts and closes, can control splint in proper order and carry out the centre gripping to the battery piece, and convenient control uses, reduces the manpower, improves the result of use to blotter and second limit slider and the extrusion of first limit slider to the spring through setting up, the buffering effect when can further improve the battery piece centre gripping avoids causing the damage because of the too big battery piece that leads to of centre gripping dynamics, improves the result of use.

title_en: Light-transmitting double-sided power generation thin-film solar module
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to building photovoltaic field especially relates to a two-sided electricity generation film solar energy component of printing opacity, including front bezel glass, including being light transmission district and the film battery rete that stripe and crisscross distribution on the front bezel glass, the printing opacity proportion in light transmission district is 20% -60%, film battery rete district is including electrically conductive rete, electrically conductive rete openly is the sensitive surface, and the back is the shady face, transparent nanometer conductive film has been plated on the shady face, the utility model discloses a two-sided film battery, film battery install in facade building and building daylighting top, and facade battery normally generates electricity outside the building, and the light that sees through simultaneously, the film battery back also can absorb light and generate electricity, has reached the purpose that improves photoelectric conversion efficiency.

title_en: LED for network port
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a LED for network port, it includes anodal pin, negative pole pin, the wafer that leads with anodal pin and negative pole pin, the fixed colloid that wraps up in wafer and anodal pin and negative pole pin upper end, anodal pin and negative pole pin all stretch out vertically along the lower terminal surface of colloid, are equipped with the mounting groove on the plastic seat of network port, and set up anodal hole and the negative pole hole that link up the plastic seat lower terminal surface downwards in the mounting groove bottom; the positive electrode pin and the negative electrode pin are inserted into the positive electrode hole and the negative electrode hole from top to bottom, and the lower end face of the colloid is attached to the bottom of the mounting groove; the upper edge of the back end of the colloid is formed with a reflecting inclined plane for reflecting the light generated by the wafer to the front end face of the colloid, so that the front end face of the colloid is used as a light-emitting surface. The utility model discloses the pin need not buckle to LED can not have stress, also can not receive stress damage, and through the light reflection inclined plane with the wafer production reflection of light and/or refraction to the colloid preceding terminal surface, with reinforcing luminous intensity/luminance.

title_en: Multi-quantum well structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multiple quantum well structure. The structure comprises quantum barrier layers and quantum well layers which are alternately arranged, the multi-quantum well structure further comprises at least one of a first stress modulation layer arranged in the quantum barrier layers and a second stress modulation layer arranged in the quantum well layers, and the lattice constants of the first stress modulation layer and the second stress modulation layer are between the quantum well and the quantum barrier layers and used for reducing the internal stress of the multi-quantum well structure. The utility model reduces the internal stress of the multi-quantum well structure, improves the recombination efficiency of the current carrier, and reduces the radiation recombination efficiency drop and the wavelength drift phenomenon; and because the stress of the nitride light-emitting layer is reduced, the uniformity of components and thickness in the nitride light-emitting layer is improved, the method is suitable for a long-wave epitaxial process structure, and the epitaxial growth process window of the nitride light-emitting layer is enlarged.

title_en: Clamping device for semiconductor wafer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a press from both sides and get device for semiconductor wafer relates to wafer processing equipment technical field. The utility model discloses a subassembly is got to base, fixed disk and clamp, the arm subassembly is installed to one side of base. The utility model discloses a driving source operation on the base takes place to deflect in order to drive robotic arm assembly, a plurality of driving source operations of driving robotic arm assembly are in order to change the dwang and adjust the pole and press from both sides the angle of getting between the connecting rod simultaneously, the top until the fixed disk removes the target wafer, restart adjustment motor operation is in order to change the horizontal angle of fixed disk, thereby make fixed disk and target wafer relative level, and then solved to press from both sides and get device self flexibility ratio not high, press from both sides and appear the centre gripping angular discrepancy easily between getting device and the wafer and cause to press from both sides and get failure scheduling problem.

title_en: Bearing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a supporting device, relates to the technical field of auxiliary equipment for producing battery pieces, and is used for reducing abrasion to the battery pieces and improving the yield of the battery pieces. The supporting device comprises a supporting group, the supporting group comprises a supporting seat and a plurality of comb teeth, and the supporting seat is provided with a supporting surface for supporting one side edge of the sheet-shaped workpiece. The broach is cylindric structure, and the one end of broach sets up on the bearing face. The comb teeth are sequentially arranged at intervals, and a gap for placing a single sheet-shaped workpiece is formed between every two adjacent comb teeth, so that one side edge of the sheet-shaped workpiece is contacted with the bearing surface.

title_en: Wafer deflection leveling mechanism and wafer bump strength tester
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wafer deflection leveling mechanism and a wafer bump strength testing machine, wherein the wafer deflection leveling mechanism comprises a machine body platform, a wafer lifting clamp body used for placing a wafer to be leveled, a pressure plate used for leveling the wafer and a pressure plate driving mechanism used for driving the pressure plate to move up and down, wherein the wafer lifting clamp body is arranged on the machine body platform through an XY moving platform, the pressure plate driving mechanism is arranged on the machine body platform and connected with the pressure plate, and the pressure plate is positioned above the wafer lifting clamp body. The wafer can be leveled before the strength test of the wafer bump, so that the strength test effect and efficiency of the wafer bump are improved.

title_en: Solar cell module curing device and solar cell production system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a solar cell module curing device and a solar cell production system, and relates to the technical field of solar cells. The solar cell module curing device comprises a box body, a clamping mechanism, a rotary driving mechanism and a heating module. The clamping mechanism is rotatably arranged in the box body; the rotary driving mechanism is arranged on the box body, is connected with the clamping mechanism and is suitable for driving the clamping mechanism to rotate; the heating component is arranged in the box body. The utility model can solve the problems of uneven heating, uneven curing and influence on the quality of the solar cell module in the curing process of the solar cell module in the prior art, and has the effects of enabling the solar cell module to be heated uniformly, improving the curing uniformity and ensuring the quality of the solar cell module.

title_en: Mounting device for chip surface
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chip processing, in particular to a mounting device for the surface of a chip, which comprises a bedplate, wherein a driving motor is fixedly arranged at the top end of a sleeve disk, a pressing plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of a main shaft of the driving motor, a partition frame is fixedly arranged at the top end of the pressing plate, a left-arranged electric sliding rail and a right-arranged electric sliding rail are respectively and fixedly arranged on a bracket at the top end of the bedplate, a limiting block is fixedly arranged at the top ends of the bottom-arranged electric sliding rail, the left-arranged electric sliding rail and the right-arranged electric sliding rail, a discharging slope, a mounting plate and a welding gun assembly are fixedly arranged at the top end of the bedplate, a sleeve box is fixedly arranged at the front end of the mounting plate, an electric cylinder is fixedly arranged at the inner side of the rear end of the sleeve box, and a flitch is fixedly arranged at the front end of the electric cylinder.

title_en: Integrated MOS transistor packaging structure and battery management system
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an integrated MOS transistor package structure and battery management system. The integrated MOS transistor packaging structure comprises: n MOS transistors respectively comprising a grid electrode, a drain electrode and a source electrode, wherein N is more than 1; the packaging carrier is provided with a grid electrode pin, a source electrode pin and a drain electrode pin, each grid electrode of the N MOS transistors is connected to the grid electrode pin in a wire bonding mode, and each source electrode of the N MOS transistors is connected to the source electrode pin in a wire bonding mode, a copper strip mode or a copper sheet mode; and the printed circuit board is provided with copper-clad areas, the copper-clad areas are connected with the drains of the N MOS transistors, wherein the number of the copper-clad areas is one or more than two, each copper-clad area is connected with the drains of the N MOS transistors, so that the drains of the N MOS transistors are connected through the corresponding copper-clad areas, wherein N is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to N, and the printed circuit board is arranged in the packaging carrier and is used for arranging the N MOS transistors.

title_en: Wafer guide device
abstract_en: A wafer guide apparatus comprising: the guide piece platform comprises a first area and a second area, and a height difference is arranged between the first area and the second area; the carrier plate comprises a first carrier plate and a second carrier plate, the first carrier plate is placed in the first area, the second carrier plate is placed in the second area, and the top surface of the first carrier plate is flush with the top surface of the second carrier plate; and the pushing device is used for pushing the wafer so as to transfer the wafer between the first carrying disc and the second carrying disc. The wafer guide device provided by the utility model can facilitate the transfer of wafers between different carrier plates and reduce the breakage rate of the wafers in the transfer process.

title_en: Wafer cleaning flower basket
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a wafer washs basket of flowers, including basket of flowers main part, layering mounting means and layering, wherein, the basket of flowers main part is provided with the accommodation space of placing the wafer, and the wafer is arranged in the accommodation space in proper order. The layering mounting is arranged on the lateral part of the basket body extending along the arrangement direction of the wafers, and the layering is arranged on the layering mounting and extends along the arrangement direction of the wafers so as to prevent the wafers in the accommodating space from floating upwards. Because the layering installation condition is arranged at the side part extending along the wafer arrangement direction, the technological surface of the wafer placed in the accommodating space is perpendicular to the direction of the layering installation condition, so that the wafer does not need to pass through the position of the layering installation condition in the process of taking and placing the wafer from the accommodating space by a worker, the layering installation condition is ensured not to contact the technological surface of the wafer, and the problem that the layering installation condition scratches the technological surface of the wafer is avoided.

title_en: Portable solar module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar equipment, and discloses a portable solar module, which comprises a power generation layer and a power generation layer, wherein the power generation layer comprises a plurality of sub-power generation units which are arranged in series and/or in parallel; the protection layer comprises a plurality of diodes, and each sub-power generation unit is connected with one diode in parallel; the support frame is used for supporting the power generation layer, the support frame is provided with a plurality of first hollowed-out parts, the sub power generation units are correspondingly accommodated in the first hollowed-out parts one by one, and the diodes are embedded in the support frame. The portable solar module provided by the utility model can still keep continuous and normal output of power when a local area is shielded, and meanwhile, the phenomenon of local overheating and spontaneous combustion can not occur; and the difficulty in mounting and fixing the diode is reduced, the production process is simplified, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Heatable wafer cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heatable wafer cleaning device, which comprises: a station for cleaning the wafer is arranged in the cyclone chamber; a lotion supply unit for conveying a lotion for cleaning the wafer and the cyclone chamber, wherein the output direction of the lotion faces to the station for cleaning the wafer or the inner wall of the cyclone chamber; and the heating unit is at least partially in heat conduction connection with the inner wall surface of the cyclone chamber and is used for melting crystals condensed on the inner wall surface of the cyclone chamber in the cleaning process. Through heating element's setting, to spraying the rotatory crystalline solid that the inner wall surface of whirl room formed of sputtering in-process to reduce the probability of solidifying crystallization, it is more convenient to clean the whirl room, and cleaning effect is better, can avoid crystallization to pollute the wafer moreover, adopts the device to carry out the wafer cleaning and can effectively improve the yields of wafer.

title_en: IGBT chip structure with composite function
abstract_en: The utility model provides an IGBT chip structure with a composite function, and relates to the field of semiconductor device manufacturing. The semiconductor device comprises a semiconductor substrate, wherein a built-in temperature sensor structure is arranged in the semiconductor substrate, the built-in temperature sensor structure comprises a groove, a thermistor structure is arranged in the groove, and a polysilicon gate is arranged above the thermistor structure; the thermistor structure comprises a separate gate polysilicon layer which is independently segmented, and an ultrathin metal layer connected with the separate gate polysilicon layer is arranged above the separate gate polysilicon layer. According to the utility model, the separated gate polycrystalline silicon layers which are independently segmented are arranged in the grooves, and are connected with the ultrathin metal layer to form a thermistor structure, so that the temperature of an IGBT chip (inside) can be monitored in real time; therefore, the problems of low temperature monitoring accuracy and poor sensitivity existing in the existing temperature sensor structure integrated on the IGBT chip are solved; meanwhile, the utility model can reduce the Miller capacitance in the IGBT chip to a certain extent, thereby effectively improving the performance of the chip and ensuring the normal operation of the chip.

title_en: Automatic plug mechanism of electricity survey
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electrical measurement automatic plugging mechanism which is arranged above a connector of a photovoltaic module and comprises a lifting mechanism, a clamping mechanism and a plugging mechanism, wherein the lifting mechanism is arranged above the connector, the clamping mechanism is arranged on the lifting mechanism and is used for clamping the connector, the plugging mechanism is arranged on the lifting mechanism and is opposite to the clamping mechanism, and an electrical measurement probe is arranged on the plugging mechanism and is used for plugging or unplugging the electrical measurement probe into or from the connector. The utility model has the advantages of realizing the automation of electric measurement, improving the operation efficiency, ensuring the electric measurement quality, along with simple structure and convenient operation.

title_en: Micro light-emitting structure and micro light-emitting device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a micro light-emitting structure and a micro light-emitting device. The substrate has two opposite surfaces, and the optical chip is disposed on one of the surfaces of the substrate. The functional module is arranged on the other surface of the substrate far away from the optical chip, and an electric connecting piece is arranged between the two surfaces of the substrate, and the optical chip and the functional module are electrically connected through the electric connecting piece. The optical chip and the functional module are respectively arranged on the two mounting surfaces by arranging an electric connecting piece between the two opposite mounting surfaces of the substrate, and are connected by the electric connecting piece. Compared with the prior art that the optical chip and the functional module are respectively arranged on different substrates, and then the optical chip and the functional module are connected in a flip-chip mode, the utility model has the advantages that the optical chip and the functional module are arranged on the same substrate, the structure of the whole micro light-emitting structure can be simplified, and the micro light-emitting structure is thinner.

title_en: Miniaturized packaging structure of high-power diode
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of diode packaging, and discloses a high-power diode miniaturized packaging structure which comprises a base, a packaging body, an anode pin, a cathode pin and a diode chip. Adopt detachable connection mechanism and diode chip to carry out electric connection, upper and lower adjacent encapsulation body utilizes detachable connection mechanism to connect to and upper and lower adjacent diode chip utilizes detachable connection mechanism to establish ties, and the encapsulation body of lower extreme also can be dismantled with the base through detachable connection mechanism simultaneously, and the diode chip of lower extreme is through dismantling coupling assembling and positive pole pin and negative pole pin electric connection. The utility model can reduce the occupation of plane space while adopting a plurality of diodes to improve the power; the utility model can lead the plurality of packages to be detachably connected, thereby realizing convenient series connection of a plurality of diodes.

title_en: Rotary sealing table for semiconductor process chamber
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary sealing table for a semiconductor process chamber, which comprises the following components: seal assembly, rotary mechanism and Z are to elevating system, seal assembly is including being used for realizing the sealed bellows subassembly of Z and being used for realizing rotary seal's magnetic fluid vacuum seal hollow shaft, the magnetic fluid vacuum seal hollow shaft cup joints on the main shaft and is located between bellows subassembly and the main shaft, the main shaft lower part is connected with rotary mechanism, and this rotary mechanism is including the measurement component that is used for acquireing the rotation number, seal assembly, rotary mechanism all link to each other with Z to elevating system, and this Z is to elevating system including the measurement component that is used for acquireing the lift. The utility model adopts the combination mode of Z-direction sealing by the corrugated pipe component and rotary vacuum sealing by the magnetic fluid, has excellent sealing performance, does not generate chamber leakage phenomenon, and can acquire the rotation quantity and the lifting quantity.

title_en: But pre-curing device, point gum machine and silk screen printing machine of sideslip
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transversely-movable pre-curing device, a dispensing machine and a screen printing machine. The front channel of solidification process is located to the pre-solidification device that can sideslip, and the battery piece carries the portion to carry the solidification process of back channel after the battery piece is pre-solidified through pre-solidification device, and pre-solidification device is used for solidifying the welding strip of battery piece head or afterbody, its characterized in that, pre-solidification device includes curing unit, slide rail and drive module, wherein: the sliding rail is arranged along the conveying direction of the battery piece; the curing part is erected above the battery piece conveying part; the curing part is in sliding connection with the sliding rail, and the driving module is configured to drive the curing part to slide along the sliding rail; the curing portion is configured to cure the solder strip of the battery tab header and/or tail. The pre-curing device is used for curing the welding strips at the head and/or tail of the battery piece in advance, so that the situation that the battery piece is free from cold joint is realized.

title_en: Capping jig
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealing cover jig which comprises a carrier plate, and a limiting plate and a pressing plate which are sequentially stacked on the carrier plate; the carrier plate is provided with an accommodating groove for accommodating the tube shell body; the limiting plate is provided with a limiting hole corresponding to the accommodating groove, and the limiting hole is used for accommodating a pipe shell cover; the pressing plate is used for driving the tube shell cover in the limiting hole to move towards the tube shell body in the accommodating groove so as to fix the tube shell cover and the tube shell body; the capping jig further comprises a force application component, wherein the force application component is used for applying force to the pressing plate so as to tightly press the limiting plate and the pressing plate on the carrier plate. The sealing cover jig provided by the utility model can improve the sealing cover quality and the sealing cover efficiency of the tube shell product.

title_en: OLED packaging structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an OLED packaging structure, which relates to the technical field of packaging structures, and comprises a substrate and a cover plate, wherein the surfaces of the substrate and the cover plate are provided with the packaging structure, the packaging structure comprises a rubber frame, one surface of the rubber frame is fixedly connected with the substrate, the inside of the rubber frame is provided with grooves, the positions of four corners of the rubber frame are provided with rubber leakage openings, one surface of the cover plate is fixedly connected with convex teeth, the size of the shape of the convex teeth is matched with that of the grooves, the grooves are spliced with the convex teeth, the surface of the substrate is fixedly connected with four positioning columns, the positions, corresponding to the positioning columns, of the surface of the cover plate are provided with positioning holes, and the inner walls of the positioning holes are spliced with the positioning columns.

title_en: Clamp for chip of planting column machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of chip processing, in particular to a chip fixture for a planting column machine, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a limit groove is formed in the top of the bottom plate, movable plates are arranged on two sides of the top of the bottom plate, a plurality of uniformly distributed limit notches are formed in one side wall, which is close to each other, of the movable plates on two sides, sliding grooves are formed in four corners of the top of the bottom plate, a screw rod motor is fixedly arranged at one end of an inner cavity of the sliding groove, and a screw rod is fixedly connected to the outer end of a transmission shaft of the screw rod motor. According to the utility model, the screw rod motor drives the screw rod to rotate, so that the screw rod sliding block is driven to move, the movable plates at the two sides can be driven to separate and combine, and the movable plates at the two sides can be utilized to form a limit mechanism of the welding column, so that the welding column is accurately implanted, and meanwhile, the movable plates are separated and combined conveniently and rapidly, so that a chip is conveniently taken out, and the operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Cleaning clamp for chip mounting substrate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cleaning clamps of chip mounting substrates, and particularly discloses a cleaning clamp of a chip mounting substrate, which comprises a box body; the supporting plate is fixedly connected in the box body, and a plurality of clamping grooves which correspond to one another are fixedly connected on the inner wall of the supporting plate and the inner wall of the box body; an air bag is fixedly connected in the clamping groove, a clamping sliding block is fixedly connected on the air bag, and the clamping sliding block is slidably connected in the clamping groove; the extrusion plate is connected in the box body in a sliding way, an extrusion cavity is formed by the extrusion plate, the bottom of the box body and the inner wall of the box body, and a hollow cavity is formed in the extrusion plate; according to the utility model, the extruding plate moves towards the bottom of the box body, and each substrate synchronously slides downwards under the action of the dead weight of the extruding plate until the through hole is communicated with one end opening of the U-shaped hole, and air in the extruding cavity enters each air bag to expand the air bag and push each clamping slide block, so that each clamping slide block can limit and clamp each substrate, and each subsequent substrate can be cleaned fully.

title_en: Heating mechanism of plasma photoresist remover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a heating mechanism of a plasma photoresist remover, which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a heating disc is inserted into the inner side of the mounting frame, a wafer is arranged on the upper side of the heating disc, a mounting assembly is arranged between the mounting frame and the heating disc, a clamping assembly is arranged between the heating disc and the wafer, the mounting assembly comprises a sleeve, a connecting plate is fixedly connected inside the sleeve, a first spring is fixedly connected to one side of the connecting plate, which is close to the mounting frame, a limiting rod is fixedly connected to one end, which is far away from the connecting plate, of the first spring, the limiting rod extends to the inner side of the mounting frame, a first adjusting block is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the limiting rod, the clamping assembly comprises a second spring, and a movable rod is fixedly connected to one end, which is far away from the connecting plate, of the second spring. The heating mechanism of the plasma photoresist remover realizes the rapid installation and disassembly of the heating plate, is convenient for maintenance and improves the practicability.

title_en: Photovoltaic laminated template
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic equipment, in particular to a photovoltaic laminated template, which comprises a template main body and a limiting structure, wherein the limiting structure comprises a clamping groove formed in one side of the upper end of the template main body, a welding slot is formed in the clamping groove, a conductive sheet is inserted into the welding slot, the conductive sheet corresponds to the welding slot in shape, the conductive sheet is electrically connected to two ends of a solar cell strip, and the end part of the conductive sheet is communicated with a terminal and fixed by welding, so that the photovoltaic laminated template has the beneficial effects that: according to the utility model, the welding slot is formed, the conductive sheet can be matched with the end part of the solar cell strip to be connected, then the conductive sheet corresponding to the shape of the welding slot is inserted into the welding slot to be communicated with the wiring terminal and welded and positioned, the conductive sheet is matched with the welding slot, so that the welding operation is more convenient, the conductive sheet can be pre-fixed in the welding slot, and the phenomenon of deviation and shaking and the influence on the welding effect are avoided.

title_en: IGBT module carrier positioning structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an IGBT module carrier positioning structure, which comprises: the substrate is used for bearing the IGBT module, and a plurality of first fixing parts which are arranged in a matrix are formed on the substrate; the first fixing part is used for fixing the first positioning column and the second positioning column; the lower part of the first positioning column is provided with a first connecting part which is used for fixedly connecting with the first fixing part, and the top of the first connecting part is formed into a plane; the second connecting portion is formed at the lower portion of the second positioning column and is used for fixedly connecting the first fixing portion, and the limiting portion is formed at the top of the second connecting portion. According to the utility model, the positioning column is inserted into the first blind hole according to the requirement through the matrix-shaped first blind hole, so that the positioning column is suitable for positioning IGBT modules with various sizes and shapes, the positioning column can be quickly and accurately installed or removed, the production and installation efficiency can be improved, and the production safety can be improved.

title_en: Separation grid assembly and plasma processing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model provides a separation grid assembly and a plasma processing device thereof, comprising a rotatable sprayer and a plasma grid which are overlapped, wherein the sprayer comprises a plurality of first openings which are arranged around the central area of the sprayer and are radially arranged, and a plurality of second openings which are arranged with the first openings in a staggered manner in the circumferential direction in the peripheral area of the first openings. According to the utility model, the rotatable spray head is matched with the plasma grid, and the first openings which are arranged at intervals in the circumferential direction and the second openings which are arranged in the circumferential direction in a staggered manner with the first openings are utilized, so that the air holes in the middle area are selectively exposed through the first openings based on the process requirement, the air holes in the edge area are exposed through the second openings, or the combination of the two, so that the radial distribution of active species on the surface of the substrate is optimized, and the accuracy of pattern transfer and the integrity of device functions under various process operations are ensured.

title_en: High-performance photovoltaic profile machining tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of profile processing tools, and discloses a high-performance photovoltaic profile processing tool which comprises a base, a clamping switching mechanism, a moving mechanism and a guiding mechanism, wherein the clamping switching mechanism is positioned at the upper end of the base, the moving mechanism is positioned in the base, the guiding mechanism is positioned in the base, the clamping switching mechanism comprises a supporting block, a first driving motor, a first transmission shaft, an arc-shaped clamping plate and a plane clamping plate, and the supporting block is movably arranged at the upper end of the base. This high performance photovoltaic section bar processing frock through setting up centre gripping shifter, and the arc grip block can remove along with moving mechanism to can carry out the centre gripping to the tubular high performance photovoltaic section bar of pipe form fixedly, can utilize the plane grip block to carry out the centre gripping to fix to tubular high performance photovoltaic section bar, thereby can make this device can the tubular high performance photovoltaic section bar of centre gripping side, can the tubular high performance photovoltaic section bar of centre gripping pipe again, use the flexibility higher.

title_en: Energy-saving RGB-LED packaging body
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of RGB-LED packaging, in particular to an energy-saving RGB-LED packaging body. The technical proposal comprises: the lamp bead packaging structure comprises a heat radiating plate, a mounting disc and a lamp bead packaging body, wherein two groups of linkage rods are mounted in the mounting disc through reset springs, a moving part is fixedly mounted on the front face of each linkage rod, a lock pin is fixedly mounted on one side of each linkage rod, and the lamp bead packaging body is mounted in the mounting groove through lock pin insertion. According to the utility model, the two groups of moving parts are synchronously pressed to drive the two groups of linkage rods to move relatively, and the relatively moving linkage rods extrude the reset spring to move the lock pin out of the pin hole, so that the unlocking of the lamp bead packaging body is realized, the lamp bead packaging body is convenient to be disassembled by staff for maintenance and replacement, and when the moving parts are loosened, the two groups of linkage rods are driven by the reset force of the reset spring to reset the lock pin to move into the pin hole, so that the lamp bead packaging body is locked rapidly, and the installation efficiency of the lamp bead packaging body is improved.

title_en: Solar cell, photovoltaic module and printing screen
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of photovoltaics, in particular to a solar cell, a photovoltaic module and a printing screen. In the solar cell, the photovoltaic module and the printing screen, the grid line structure of the solar cell at least comprises a main grid line, thin grid lines and connecting lines, each of the plurality of main grid lines is connected with any one of the plurality of thin grid lines through the connecting lines, and the connecting lines which are unevenly distributed are formed by setting the size of the plurality of connecting lines corresponding to at least one main grid line along a first direction to have at least two size specifications, so that the sizes of the plurality of connecting lines corresponding to the main grid line along the first direction are relatively smaller and larger. Therefore, the reliability of the grid line structure is improved, the manufacturing cost is reduced, the shading area of the grid line structure is reduced, and the optical loss of the solar cell is further reduced, so that the power generation efficiency of the solar cell is improved.

title_en: Effective dampproofing waveguide photoelectric detector
abstract_en: The utility model provides an effective dampproof waveguide photoelectric detector, which belongs to the technical field of photoelectric detectors and aims to solve the problems that the conventional waveguide photoelectric detector is easy to cause the damage of chips due to dampness and the service life of the waveguide photoelectric detector is influenced, and the waveguide photoelectric detector comprises a protective shell, a light inlet, a chip, a light guide plate, a guide box, a connector and a rubber plug; the light inlet is formed in the left side of the protective shell; the chip is fixedly connected to the inner side of the protective shell; the light guide plate is fixedly connected to the left side of the protective shell; the guide box is fixedly connected to the inner side of the protective shell; the connecting port is formed on the right side of the protective shell; the rubber plug is fixedly connected to the inner side of the connecting port; the utility model avoids the condition that the chip is damaged by moisture, effectively prolongs the service life of the waveguide photoelectric detector, reduces the maintenance times of the waveguide photoelectric detector, and further reduces the labor intensity of staff.

title_en: Electronic device
