abstract_en: The application provides an electronic device, which comprises a bare chip, a bonding pad and a protective layer, wherein the bare chip comprises a device layer and a first insulating layer, and a first metal wiring structure is arranged in the first insulating layer; the bonding pad is arranged on one side, away from the device layer, of the first insulating layer, and orthographic projection of the bonding pad on the bare chip covers the first metal wiring structure; the protective layer is arranged on one side of the bonding pad, which is away from the bare chip, and is provided with an opening, and the opening exposes a first area of the bonding pad; the electronic device provided by the application has higher space utilization rate, the buffer layer can provide good support for the bonding pad, the probability of the occurrence of a crater effect of the electronic device is reduced, the wiring structure and the electronic element below the bonding pad are protected, and the yield and the working stability of the electronic device are improved.

title_en: Dry etching equipment
abstract_en: The dry etching equipment provided by the embodiment of the disclosure comprises a cavity, a bearing table and a temperature control module, wherein the bearing table is divided into a plurality of bearing units, the temperature control module is adjusted to adjust the temperature corresponding to each bearing unit, so that the reaction rate of photoresist and active plasma on the bearing units is adjusted, the processing rate of photoresist at different positions of a wafer to be processed is changed, and the problem that the uniformity of photoresist removal is poor due to the difference of photoresist thickness on the surface of the wafer to be processed is avoided.

title_en: Layered stripping recovery device for waste photovoltaic modules
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic module recovery, and provides a layered stripping recovery device for a waste photovoltaic module, which comprises the following components: a machine table; the conveying mechanism comprises a first conveying piece and a second conveying piece which are arranged on the machine table, and the first conveying piece is matched with the second conveying piece to convey the waste photovoltaic modules along the recovery direction; the cutter is arranged between the first conveying piece and the second conveying piece, a driving piece is arranged on the machine table, the output end of the driving piece is connected with the cutter, when the waste photovoltaic module is lifted, the cutter moves back and forth relative to the machine table through the driving piece, and when the waste photovoltaic module is peeled, the cutter is fixed relative to the machine table; the preheating piece is arranged on the machine table and is used for heating the waste photovoltaic module before the cutter lifts the waste photovoltaic module. The utility model is convenient for edge starting and layering of the glass plate and the adhesive film, enhances the stripping effect and improves the recovery efficiency.

title_en: Novel IGBT vehicle single-tube power module adopting near-chip end connection technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel IGBT vehicle single-tube power module with a near-chip end connection technology, belonging to the technical field of power modules; the power circuit comprises a shell, wherein the shell comprises a lead frame, and the lead frame comprises a power terminal and a signal terminal; an insulating ceramic substrate comprising a conductive copper layer power circuit etched region and a conductive copper layer signal circuit etched region; the power chip is arranged on the insulating ceramic substrate; the back of the power chip is connected with the conductive copper layer power circuit etching area; the front power electrode of the power chip is connected with a copper foil which is connected with the power circuit etching area or the power terminal of the conductive copper layer; the signal pole of the power chip is connected with the etching area or the signal terminal of the conductive copper layer signal circuit. The beneficial effects of the technical scheme are as follows: the working environment of the power module with high junction temperature is facilitated, the reliability of the power module is improved, the stress of the chip near the chip end is reduced, and the chip is protected.

title_en: Fixed structure of air cylinder of boat carrying grab
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of solar energy production, in particular to a boat carrying grab hand cylinder fixing structure which comprises a mounting plate; the utility model discloses a cylinder operation, including fixed disk, cylinder body, cylinder, fixed disk, support limit structure, cam support structure, support rod and connecting rod, the fixed disk is inside to be fixed with the locating sleeve, the mounting hole has been seted up on the periphery of fixed disk, mounting screw acts on the mounting hole, realizes that the fixed disk assembles on the mounting panel, the periphery of cylinder body is provided with the support limit structure, through setting up the fixed disk, under the effect of locating sleeve, can realize the accurate spacing to the cylinder bottom, avoid the skew of bottom position, be provided with triangle bearing structure in the direction that the cylinder takes place the position offset easily simultaneously, can realize the support fixed to the cylinder under the cooperation of bracing piece and connecting rod, reduce the skew of cylinder operation in-process, can guarantee the stability of cylinder operation.

title_en: Fixing mechanism of aluminum plate presser foot jig
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fixing mechanism of an aluminum plate presser foot jig, which comprises an aluminum plate presser foot jig and a fixing block arranged on the aluminum plate presser foot jig, wherein a yielding groove is formed in the fixing block, a connecting groove is formed in the top surface of the fixing block, two clamping plates with one ends penetrating through the yielding groove and extending to the top of the fixing block are respectively arranged in the yielding groove, a clamping plate is fixedly connected in the yielding groove, and a fixing plate is fixedly connected in the yielding groove and positioned at the back surface of the clamping plate. This fixed establishment of aluminum plate presser foot tool through threaded connection between screw rod and the splint, and convenient drive splint removes, improves the stability at splint top, supports splint bottom through sliding connection between slider and the spout, improves the stability of splint bottom, simultaneously, under the effect of baffle, convenient supports aluminum plate, improves aluminum plate's stability, convenient and practical more.

title_en: Patch auxiliary device for processing Bluetooth headset chip
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of Bluetooth headphones and discloses a patch auxiliary device for processing a Bluetooth headphone chip, which comprises a bottom plate and two supporting legs fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the bottom plate, wherein a patch mechanism and a fixing mechanism are arranged above the bottom plate; the patch mechanism is positioned above the fixing mechanism; the fixing mechanism comprises a fixing part and an adjusting part; the fixed part is positioned behind the adjusting part. Can fix it when carrying out the paster to the chip through being provided with fixed establishment to can be better when the paster is handled, can carry out the back-and-forth adjustment through the grip block, thereby can carry out the centre gripping to the chip of arbitrary size fixedly, and can carry out the buffer protection to it at the fixed in-process of losing the chip centre gripping through being provided with spring and attenuator, avoid the clamping force too big to lead to the chip to take place to damage, can adjust the position of placing the frame through being provided with adjusting part, thereby can be more convenient when taking the chip.

title_en: LED display panel repair system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an LED display panel repairing system, which belongs to the technical field of LED panel repairing; the problems of complex maintenance process, low efficiency and irregular maintenance flow lamp of the conventional LED panel are solved; the automatic production line adopts a belt to carry out transmission, one side of the belt is provided with an AOI detection system, a photoresist removing system, a maintenance system, a detection system and a photoresist supplementing system, and the AOI detection system is arranged at the end head of the belt; the photoresist removing system comprises a heating mechanism and residual photoresist cleaning equipment, wherein the heating mechanism comprises a photoresist removing mechanism for removing photoresist from a failure light source and a solder paste removing mechanism for removing solder paste, the maintenance system comprises a polishing tool, a solder dispensing mechanism and a manipulator for replacing the failure light source, the detection system comprises a detection plate for realizing the lighting test of the light source and an LED aging tester for LED aging test, and the photoresist supplementing system comprises a photoresist dispensing mechanism, a vacuum machine, a film covering mechanism and a pressing mechanism; the utility model is applied to repair of small-spacing or Mini/Micro LED display panels.

title_en: Semiconductor substrate cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a semiconductor substrate cleaning device which comprises a cleaning box, wherein the upper end face of the cleaning box is hinged with a cover plate through a hinge shaft, the upper end face of the cover plate is fixedly provided with a first handle, the rear end face of the cleaning box is provided with a cleaning mechanism, the lower end face of the cleaning box is fixedly provided with two sliding rails, the outer side of a water outlet pipe is hinged with a connecting rod through a hinge seat, the left end face and the right end face of the connecting rod are both fixedly provided with conveying rods, and the outer sides of the two conveying rods are both provided with a plurality of spray heads. This semiconductor substrate belt cleaning device passes through the operation of water pump, and the inside rivers of extraction water tank get into the inside of two conveyer bars to spray out the rivers through a plurality of shower nozzle of both sides and carry out the washing from the top down to the semiconductor substrate, be the ultrasonic wave through setting up the washing case, thereby carry out the inside semiconductor substrate and from interior to outside wasing, thereby make the semiconductor substrate can wash comprehensively, improve abluent quality.

title_en: Negative pressure suction steering device for chip displacement
abstract_en: The utility model provides a negative pressure suction steering device for chip shifting, relates to the technical field of chip manufacturing, and solves the technical problems of low chip shifting accuracy and easiness in chip damage in the prior art. The utility model provides a negative pressure suction steering device for chip displacement, which comprises a cover plate, a base body, a tube shaft, a vertical sliding frame body, a torque output motor, a gear transmission mechanism, a linear motor, a circumferential angle sensor, a frame body vertical displacement sensor and a vertical guide mechanism, wherein the vertical sliding frame body, the torque output motor, the gear transmission mechanism, the linear motor, the circumferential angle sensor and the vertical guide mechanism are arranged in an installation cavity between the cover plate and the base body; the vertical displacement sensor of the frame body can detect the upward or downward moving size of the tube shaft under the drive of the vertical sliding frame body and send out corresponding size signals. The utility model has the advantages of high chip displacement accuracy and high chip manufacturing yield.

title_en: Encapsulation structure of perovskite type solar cell
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of solar cells, relates to a packaging structure of a solar cell, and in particular relates to a packaging structure of a perovskite solar cell. The perovskite solar cell provided by the utility model can effectively seal the transparent conductive film layer and the perovskite functional layer, so that the transparent conductive film layer and the perovskite functional layer are isolated from the external air environment, and air, moisture and the like in the external environment cannot enter between the substrate and the packaging cover plate to influence the transparent conductive film layer and the perovskite functional layer, so that the functional material of the cell is prevented from being decomposed to influence the performance of the cell, the cell can be stably applied for a long time, and the service life and the stability of the cell are improved. The perovskite solar cell has the advantages of simple packaging structure process, low cost, suitability for industrial application and wide application prospect.

title_en: Multi-welding-strip cutting and positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-welding-strip cutting and positioning device, which belongs to the field of solar cell module manufacturing and comprises a combined distance-changing positioning mechanism, a plurality of middle rotary table components and a plurality of cutter components. The multi-welding-strip cutting and positioning device is compact in structure and convenient to control, can realize segmented cutting of a plurality of long welding strips, can accurately realize the spacing positioning of a plurality of groups of short welding strips after cutting, ensures that the short welding strips after cutting and segmentation can be positioned and placed according to preset intervals, provides a basis for taking and placing follow-up short welding strips, ensures the accuracy of combined setting of the welding strips and the battery pieces after cutting, improves the precision and efficiency of manufacturing the battery piece assembly, and reduces the manufacturing cost and the use cost of the solar panel assembly.

title_en: Bonding tool and semiconductor chip packaging equipment thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a bonding tool and semiconductor chip packaging equipment thereof, wherein the bonding tool comprises a bottom plate and a cover plate, the cover plate is configured to be arranged on the bottom plate in a covering mode, a plurality of containing grooves are formed in the bottom plate at intervals, the containing grooves are used for containing objects, a plurality of bonding holes are formed in the cover plate at intervals, each bonding hole comprises a hollow part and a fixing part, the first end of the fixing part is connected with the edge of the bonding hole, the bonding hole is used for corresponding to one containing groove in the bottom plate when the cover plate is arranged on the bottom plate, the fixing part of the bonding hole is used for fixing the objects in the corresponding containing groove of the bonding hole, and bonding efficiency of the objects is improved.

title_en: Chip adsorption device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chip adsorption device which comprises an adsorption seat, wherein an air duct is arranged at the top end of the adsorption seat in a threaded manner, a main sucker and an auxiliary sucker are respectively arranged at the bottom ends of a main air duct and an auxiliary air duct, a base plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the outer side wall of the adsorption seat, a vertical threaded rod is arranged in a penetrating manner in a hole formed in the base plate, a bottom plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the vertical threaded rod, a protection pad is arranged at the bottom surface of the bottom plate, the top end of the vertical threaded rod penetrates through a hole formed in a movable plate, a blocking plate is fixedly arranged in the middle of the vertical threaded rod, a buffer spring is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the blocking plate, and the top end of the buffer spring is fixedly arranged at the bottom surface of the movable plate. This chip adsorption equipment adopts novel structural design, not only can stabilize the absorption to not unidimensional chip, can carry out buffer protection to the chip that moves up because of the atmospheric pressure moreover, and buffer structure's resistance can convenient adjustment simultaneously, is convenient for adsorb the transfer to the stability of different specification chips.

title_en: Novel full-automatic support machine of cutting of LED lamp pearl support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel full-automatic LED lamp bead bracket cutting machine which comprises a machine table, an LED lamp bead bracket storage device, an LED lamp bead bracket feeding device, an LED lamp bead bracket cutting device and an LED lamp bead bracket discharging device, wherein the LED lamp bead bracket storage device, the LED lamp bead bracket feeding device, the LED lamp bead bracket cutting device and the LED lamp bead bracket discharging device are arranged on the machine table, the LED lamp bead bracket feeding device comprises a material taking mechanism, a conveying guide rail mechanism and a feeding manipulator, and the LED lamp bead bracket cutting machine also comprises a first positioning mechanism and a second positioning mechanism, wherein the first positioning mechanism and the second positioning mechanism are used for positioning an LED lamp bead bracket in a positioning groove body of a guide rail groove. The LED lamp bead feeding device is high in automation degree and good in safety, the LED lamp bead support can be accurately positioned in the positioning groove body of the LED lamp bead support feeding device, the feeding manipulator can accurately feed materials, and finally the LED lamp bead support can be accurately cut and processed, and the cutting yield is high.

title_en: Material box detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a material box detection device which comprises a bearing table and a photoelectric sensor, wherein the bearing table is matched with the material box and is used for bearing the material box, the material box is provided with a slide cavity with an opening at the top, the front end of the bearing table is a feeding end, battery pieces conveyed by the feeding end are stacked in the slide cavity one by one, the cavity bottom of the slide cavity is obliquely arranged towards the feeding end, empty slots are oppositely arranged on two sides of the feeding end of the material box, the opening at the top of each empty slot is arranged and communicated with the slide cavity, the photoelectric sensor is oppositely arranged with the empty slots, and the distance between the side wall of the slide cavity close to the feeding end and the photoelectric sensor is not equal to the distance between the side wall of the slide cavity far away from the feeding end and the photoelectric sensor. The material box detection device can timely find the reverse situation of the material box, and reduce the loss of the battery piece.

title_en: Packaging structure
abstract_en: A package structure includes a die structure having memory cells and multiplexers. The package structure includes an intermediate chip structure directly bonded to the die structure by dielectric-to-dielectric bonding and metal-to-metal bonding, and has a sense amplifier and a driving element. The intermediate chip structure has no memory cells. The package structure includes an arithmetic chip structure coupled to the intermediate chip structure and having an arithmetic element.

title_en: Double-sided laser transfer film, slotting die and laser transfer system
abstract_en: The application relates to a double-sided laser transfer film, a slotting die and a laser transfer system, wherein the transfer film is provided with a first surface and a second surface which are opposite, the first surface is provided with a plurality of first grooves, the second surface is provided with a plurality of second grooves, and the first grooves and the second grooves are respectively used for filling slurry. The first surface is provided with a plurality of first grooves, the second surface is provided with a plurality of second grooves, when the solar cell is in actual use, slurry is filled in the first grooves, then the slurry in the first grooves is subjected to laser transfer printing on a cell sheet to form grid lines, slurry is filled in the second grooves, and then the slurry in the second grooves is subjected to laser transfer printing on the cell sheet to form the grid lines. That is, the arrangement of the first groove and the second groove can increase the number of times of use of the transfer film, thereby reducing the cost of the transfer film.

title_en: High-density high-pin SOT packaging device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of packaging processes, in particular to a high-density high-pin SOT packaging device which comprises a lead frame, wherein anti-reflection holes are formed in two sides of the surface of the lead frame, plastic package runner grooves are formed in the surface of the lead frame, a packaging mechanism is arranged on the surface of the lead frame and consists of lead parts and base islands, and a high-efficiency heat dissipation mechanism is arranged on the surface of the lead frame and consists of connecting sheets, heat dissipation components and through holes. The utility model not only reduces the cost and improves the efficiency, but also improves the heat dissipation effect of the packaging device when in use.

title_en: Solar cell backboard and solar cell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar cell backboard and a solar cell, wherein the solar cell backboard comprises a substrate layer, an adhesive layer is arranged on at least one side of the substrate layer, a weather-proof layer is arranged on the other side of the substrate layer, which is far away from the adhesive layer, a reflecting layer is arranged on one side of the adhesive layer, which is far away from the substrate layer, and the reflecting layer sequentially comprises a white grid layer and a black grid layer along the direction, which is far away from the substrate layer. The utility model improves the light utilization rate of the reflecting layer, thereby improving the power generation of the component.

title_en: Automatic uniformity adjusting device of annealing furnace
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic uniformity adjusting device of an annealing furnace, which comprises a temperature adjusting system, a pressure detecting module, a furnace door detecting module, a controller module, a heat conducting medium control valve module, a circulating fan module and a vacuum pump module. According to the utility model, the temperature in the annealing furnace is regulated and controlled at a constant temperature through the temperature acquisition module, the PI D regulation module and the temperature control equipment of the temperature regulation system arranged in the annealing furnace, and the constant temperature setting is finished through the controller module, when a semiconductor material is placed in the annealing furnace, the furnace door detection module detects that the furnace door is closed, the vacuum pump module is opened to vacuumize the annealing furnace, and when the pressure detection module detects that the vacuum state is detected, the controller module releases a heat conducting medium in the annealing furnace through opening the heat conducting medium control valve module, and opens the circulating fan module, so that the heat conducting medium is uniformly blown to the heated semiconductor material.

title_en: Processing equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a processing device, which comprises a cavity, an air inlet pipe component and an air outlet pipe component. The cavity comprises an inner cavity and an outer cavity which are mutually nested, a working cavity is formed in the inner cavity, an interlayer space is formed between the inner cavity and the outer cavity, a heat exchange cavity is formed in the interlayer space, an air inlet pipe assembly is arranged in the cavity and communicated with the heat exchange cavity and used for introducing gas at a first temperature into the heat exchange cavity, an air outlet pipe assembly is arranged in the cavity and communicated with the heat exchange cavity, and gas at a second temperature obtained after heat exchange is discharged out of the heat exchange cavity through the air outlet pipe assembly. According to the application, the inner cavity and the outer cavity are cooled or warmed by introducing gases with different temperatures into the heat exchange cavity, so that the service lives of the inner cavity and the outer cavity are protected, and the temperature regulation efficiency of the working cavity is improved.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic power generation assembly, which comprises a battery piece, wherein a first adhesive film group and a front plate are sequentially arranged on one side, facing light, of the battery piece, a second adhesive film group and a back plate are sequentially arranged on one side, facing backlight, of the battery piece, and the photovoltaic power generation assembly further comprises a first clamping plate and a second clamping plate, wherein the first clamping plate is in clamping connection with the left sides of the front plate, the first adhesive film group, the battery piece, the second adhesive film group and the back plate, the second clamping plate is in clamping connection with the right sides of the front plate, the first adhesive film group, the battery piece, the second adhesive film group and the back plate, an embedded groove is formed in the back side of the back plate, a radiating fin is arranged in the embedded groove, a color film which can be torn off is stuck on the back side of the radiating fin, and a plurality of air holes are formed in the color film; through establish the fin at the rear side of backplate to can dispel the heat to this device, avoid influencing this device's result of use because of this device is heated the too high temperature that causes, and establish the color film that can tear off at the fin rear side, thereby can change the colour as required, more practical convenience.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a semiconductor layer having a plurality of semiconductor layers
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a semiconductor device, which relates to the technical field of semiconductors. The device comprises a substrate, a gate structure, a first epitaxial layer and a first metal silicide layer, wherein the gate structure is arranged on the surface of the substrate in a protruding mode, the gate structure comprises a gate oxide layer, a gate layer and a gate protection layer, the top surface of the gate protection layer is not higher than that of the gate layer, the first epitaxial layer covers the top surface of the gate layer, the upper surface of the first epitaxial layer is a curved surface, the first epitaxial layer is a Si layer, the first metal silicide layer covers the first epitaxial layer in a conformal mode, the upper surface of the first metal silicide layer is a curved surface, and the first metal silicide layer is a CoSi  2  layer. According to the semiconductor device, the first epitaxial layer is formed on the substrate, so that the line width of the device is increased, the line width effect is overcome, the formation quality of the metal silicide layer is improved, and the overall performance of the device is improved.

title_en: Light-emitting module and light-emitting device
abstract_en: The application provides a light-emitting module and a light-emitting device. The light-emitting chip is arranged on the substrate, the fluorescent layer covers the surface of the light-emitting chip, and the colloid covers the surface of the fluorescent layer far away from the light-emitting chip. Compared with the structure of mixing fluorescent powder and colloid in the prior art, the fluorescent layer and the colloid are positioned on different layers and directly cover the surface of the chip, so that the fluorescent layer can directly transfer heat downwards through the chip and the substrate, the temperature of the fluorescent layer during the working of the light-emitting module is reduced, and the temperature of the colloid is further reduced.

title_en: Limiting device of adhesive tape and edge sealing system of photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of production of photovoltaic modules, and particularly relates to a limiting device of an adhesive tape and an edge sealing system of the photovoltaic module, wherein the limiting device comprises an I-shaped grooved wheel and a stop block; the I-shaped grooved pulley is rotatably arranged, an annular groove is formed in the I-shaped grooved pulley along the circumferential direction of the outer circumferential wall of the I-shaped grooved pulley, the annular groove comprises a groove bottom wall and two groove side walls, a stop block is arranged on one radial side of the I-shaped grooved pulley and can extend into the annular groove, a gap for a tape to pass through is reserved between the stop block and the groove bottom wall, and the stop block is matched with the groove bottom wall to limit the tape in the thickness direction of the tape. This stop device utilizes I-shaped sheave and stretches into the dog in the annular groove spacing to the sticky tape, and the two sides groove lateral wall of annular groove can restrict the sticky tape and remove along its width direction, and the clearance between dog and the tank bottom wall can restrict in order to remove along its thickness direction at the sticky tape, and the movable range of sticky tape is less, can effectively improve the problem of sticky tape skew, and then promotes the accuracy that the sticky tape pasted.

title_en: Fixing tape for solar cell and solar cell module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing adhesive tape for a solar cell and a solar cell module, wherein the fixing adhesive tape is connected between two adjacent cell sheets which are arranged at intervals, and comprises the following components: the adhesive tape body is provided with the exhaust recess towards the side of battery piece, and the exhaust recess extends along first direction. According to the fixing adhesive tape disclosed by the embodiment of the utility model, the exhaust groove is formed in the side surface of the adhesive tape body facing the battery piece, when the adhesive tape body is stuck on the battery piece through the pressure-sensitive adhesive layer, in the lamination process of the battery piece and the adhesive tape body, air between the grid line on the battery piece and the adhesive tape body can be exhausted along the exhaust groove in the lamination process, so that the air can be rapidly exhausted, and therefore, the air between the battery piece and the adhesive tape body, particularly between the grid line on the battery piece and the adhesive tape body, is not easy to remain, air bubbles can be reduced, even air bubbles cannot occur, the yield of products can be improved, and the production cost is further reduced.

title_en: Sealing device for metal and glass
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealing device for metal and glass, which belongs to the technical field of glass sealing and particularly comprises a connecting base, wherein at least two connecting frames are arranged on the connecting base, heating heads are arranged on each connecting frame, and all the heating heads are communicated with a fuel supply box. According to the scheme, all heating heads are communicated with the fuel supply box, so that the air outlet quantity of the heating heads is relatively uniform, a workpiece is heated stably, the processing effect is effectively guaranteed, and meanwhile, the size of output flame can be controlled by adjusting the air inlet quantity, and the temperature of the output flame is controlled.

title_en: Packaging structure of silicon carbide power device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a packaging structure of a silicon carbide power device, which belongs to the technical field of device packaging, and the packaging structure and the packaging method of the silicon carbide power device comprise a PCB main body and a shell fixed at the top end of the PCB main body, wherein a DBC substrate is arranged at the bottom end of the PCB main body, a first bonding pad of a PCB bottom layer is embedded and fixed in the central position of the PCB main body, one end of the first bonding pad of the PCB bottom layer is symmetrically provided with a PCB via hole, the other end of the first bonding pad of the PCB bottom layer is respectively provided with a first window of the PCB and a second window of the PCB, and a copper foil of a PCB top layer is arranged above the first bonding pad of the PCB bottom layer. The packaging structure and the packaging method of the silicon carbide power device remarkably improve the performance and the reliability of the silicon carbide power device and simplify the manufacturing process through optimizing layout and material selection.

title_en: TOPCon battery, photovoltaic module and laminated battery
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of solar power generation, and provides a TOPCon battery, a photovoltaic module and a laminated battery, wherein the TOPCon battery comprises a silicon substrate, a tunneling layer, a polycrystalline silicon layer and an aluminum oxide layer, wherein the tunneling layer is arranged on the back surface of the silicon substrate, the polycrystalline silicon layer is arranged on one side surface of the tunneling layer far away from the silicon substrate, the aluminum oxide layer is arranged on one side surface of the polycrystalline silicon layer far away from the tunneling layer, and the aluminum oxide layer is arranged in at least part of the area of the polycrystalline silicon layer. Through the arrangement, the aluminum oxide layer is arranged on at least part of the area of the polycrystalline silicon layer on the back of the battery, so that the anti-reflection effect is improved, and the conversion efficiency of the back of the battery is improved.

title_en: LED luminous array structure and luminous module
abstract_en: The utility model provides an LED light-emitting array structure and a light-emitting module, which comprise a silicon substrate, a metal wiring layer, a bonding pad, a reflecting part, an LED light-emitting unit and fluorescent powder, wherein a plurality of pits are arranged on a first surface of the silicon substrate in an array mode, the metal wiring layer comprises a first metal wiring layer and a second metal wiring layer which respectively cover the bottoms, the side walls and the platforms of two sides of the pits, a preset distance is reserved between the first metal wiring layer and the second metal wiring layer, the bonding pad comprises a first bonding pad and a second bonding pad which are respectively and electrically connected to the first metal wiring layer and the second metal wiring layer and are positioned at the bottoms of the pits, the reflecting part is arranged on one side, far away from the pits, of the metal wiring layer and is not covered with the bonding pad, the LED light-emitting unit is arranged in the pits, and a positive electrode and a negative electrode are respectively and electrically connected with the first bonding pad and the second bonding pad, and the fluorescent powder is filled in the pits to cover the light-emitting surface of the LED light-emitting unit. According to the technical scheme, the light emitting units are arranged in the pits, so that mutual isolation is realized, the reflection part reflects light around as front light, and crosstalk is reduced.

title_en: Semiconductor packaging lead frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of integrated circuits and discloses a semiconductor packaging lead frame which comprises a frame body and a base island, wherein an avoidance hole is formed in the frame body, a plurality of pins are arranged on the inner wall of the avoidance hole, the left end of the base island is connected with the left inner wall of the avoidance hole through at least one elastic connecting bridge, the right end of the base island is connected with the right inner wall of the avoidance hole through at least one elastic connecting bridge, the elastic connecting bridges are in a ladder shape, the frame body is higher than the base island and mutually planar, the base island and the avoidance hole are correspondingly arranged, the cross section of the base island is smaller than the cross section of the avoidance hole, and the base island is used for bearing a semiconductor chip. The left end and the right end of the base island are connected with the frame body through the elastic connecting bridge, the elastic connecting bridge deforms elastically to absorb the pressure of colloid, the base island and the frame body are parallel and PAD is kept flat, the risk of heat dissipation performance reduction caused by glue overflow and glue overflow is reduced, the risk of generating chip dark lines is reduced, and the performance and the reliability of the packaging body are improved.

title_en: Be used for photovoltaic manufacturing industry basket of flowers piece detection device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of solar cell manufacturing, and discloses a flower basket fragment detection device for the photovoltaic manufacturing industry, which comprises a photoelectric module, a controller and an alarm, wherein the photoelectric module comprises a light emitter and a light receiver, the light emitter is arranged on one side of a flower basket and is used for emitting detection light signals, the detection light signals penetrate through the flower basket and are received by the light receiver to obtain light intensity signals, a signal output end of the light receiver is connected with the controller so as to feed the light intensity signals obtained by the light receiver to the controller, and a signal output end of the controller is connected with the alarm and is used for controlling the alarm to work according to the light intensity signals. The application solves the problems of economy and space applicability existing in the existing detection of fragments by using a camera.

title_en: Flower basket depression bar dismounting device
abstract_en: The application relates to a flower basket compression bar dismounting device which comprises a rotating mechanism and a clamping mechanism. The rotation mechanism has a rotation portion. The clamping mechanism comprises a mounting seat and at least two clamping assemblies. The mount pad is connected with the rotation part, and the mount pad is equipped with the mounting hole. The clamping assembly comprises a clamping piece which is rotatably connected to the mounting seat. The clamping piece includes the clamping end, and in all clamping ends all located the mounting hole, all clamping ends set up along the circumference interval of mounting hole, and all clamping ends deviate from the one end of mount pad and enclose to establish and form the clamping hole. When the clamping hole is arranged in the flower basket compression bar, one end of the clamping end, deviating from the mounting seat, can rotate towards the direction close to the rotating part, so that the shape and the size of the clamping hole can be adjusted according to the clamping part of the flower basket compression bar, and even if the position of the clamping part of the flower basket compression bar changes, all the clamping ends can still be matched with the clamping part for clamping the flower basket compression bar.

title_en: Wafer support and semiconductor device with same
abstract_en: The invention provides a wafer support and a semiconductor device with the same, comprising a first support and a second support, the first support and the second support are adjacently arranged, and the height of the first support is larger than that of the second support by H. And a wafer is arranged on the second bracket, bonding wires are connected between the wafer and the first bracket, and the bonding wires are arranged at intervals with the second bracket. There is no wafer on the first support, which belongs to the non-welding wafer support, and there is a wafer on the second support, which belongs to the welding wafer support. The first support is located the top of second support, and the difference in height between first support and the second support is H for first support and second support are located different planes. The bonding wires led out from the wafer are connected to the first support, and due to the fact that the height difference exists between the first support and the second support, a certain distance exists between the bonding wires and the second support, the bonding wires can be prevented from simultaneously contacting the first support and the second support, and the short circuit phenomenon is caused.

title_en: Coating printing equipment and battery piece processing system
abstract_en: The utility model provides coating printing equipment and a battery piece processing system. The coating and printing equipment comprises a coating device for coating and printing the photoresist on the substrate, a vibration device for driving the substrate coated and printed with the photoresist to vibrate and a baking device for baking and curing the photoresist on the substrate, wherein the coating device, the vibration device and the baking device are sequentially arranged along the processing direction of the battery piece. According to the utility model, the vibration device drives the vibration device before baking and curing the photoresist, so that the photoresist is distributed more uniformly on the substrate, the thickness difference of the photoresist after curing is reduced, the width difference of the grooves is reduced when the developing grooves are printed on the photoresist later, the fluctuation difference of the electroplating area of the electroplated surface on the substrate is reduced, the problem of uneven thickness of the grid line at the grooves is effectively solved, meanwhile, the ineffective increase of the shading area is effectively avoided, and the photoelectric conversion rate and the reliability of the battery piece are improved.

title_en: Gallium arsenide wafer transfer device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a gallium arsenide wafer transfer device, wherein clamping grooves for clamping gallium arsenide wafers are formed in the top ends of frame bodies of two brackets, positioning grooves for positioning a fixing device are formed in the top ends of insulating transfer boxes, springs for buffering the bottom plate are arranged at the bottom ends of the bottom plate, and a cover plate assembly for driving the fixing assembly to tightly cover and fix the gallium arsenide wafers is fixedly arranged at the top ends of the fixing assemblies. The positioning blocks on the cover plate are controlled to be clamped into the positioning grooves through the grooves, so that the adjacent gallium arsenide wafers can be blocked by the plurality of partition plates, and meanwhile, the gallium arsenide wafers are tightly covered and sealed by the fixing plates, so that the gallium arsenide wafers are prevented from falling from the bracket and being damaged due to shaking in the transportation process of the gallium arsenide wafers by the insulating transportation box.

title_en: Busbar L type subassembly of bending
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bus bar L-shaped bending assembly, which is sequentially connected with a first feeding mechanism, a first loading positioning mechanism, a second feeding mechanism and a second loading positioning mechanism based on a straight rail arranged on a portal frame, wherein a first driver and a chuck connected with the output end of the first driver are arranged in each feeding mechanism, each loading positioning mechanism is provided with a fixedly-connected carrying platform, a turnover pressing arm is arranged at the side, close to the opposite side edge, of each carrying platform, and an upward pushing and bending mechanism is arranged between the two carrying platforms and driven to lift along the opposite side edge of the two carrying platforms. The bending component can fully automatically complete the L-shaped bending of the pair of bus bars with the preset length, which are mirror images, in the bus bar pasting operation, is convenient for connecting a plurality of bus bars to the same current path or junction box in the subsequent process, does not need to be manually participated in the operation, and greatly improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Material taking adjusting device for chip
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chip taking and adjusting device which comprises an installation base, a taking mechanism, an adjusting mechanism and a wafer moving platform mechanism, wherein a chip is placed on the wafer moving platform mechanism, the taking mechanism comprises a taking rotating motor, a taking arm and a taking head, one end of the taking arm is connected with the taking rotating motor, the other end of the taking arm is connected with the taking head, the taking head is used for obtaining the chip, the chip is moved to the adjusting mechanism from the wafer moving platform mechanism through rotation of the taking head, the adjusting mechanism comprises a transfer platform and an adjusting motor, the transfer platform is used for placing the chip, a rotating shaft of the adjusting motor is connected with the transfer platform, and the transfer platform is driven to rotate through rotation of the adjusting motor, so that the position of the chip is adjusted through rotation of the transfer platform. According to the scheme, the chip can be placed on the transfer platform from the wafer motion platform mechanism according to the accurate position so as to be used for bonding the substrate.

title_en: Intermediate bus bar for battery assembly, battery assembly and photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of solar cells, and provides an intermediate bus bar for a battery assembly, the battery assembly and a photovoltaic system, the first end of the body part of the middle bus bar is connected with a first lead part which is bent towards the first side relative to the body part, and the second lead part is bent relative to the first lead part to be stacked on one side of the first lead part, which is away from the body part. One side of the second lead part is also provided with an extension part. Therefore, through the arrangement of the first lead part, the second lead part and the extension part, the lead structure formed by the first lead part and the second lead part is not located at the most edge of the middle bus bar, so that the risk of short circuit caused by lap joint of the lead structure and an adjacent circuit is reduced, and meanwhile, the edge end part position of the middle bus bar is prevented from tilting in the manufacturing process, and the welding reliability of the welding strip at the edge position and the middle bus bar is ensured.

title_en: Material frame for semiconductor rib cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a material frame for a semiconductor rib cutting machine, which relates to the technical field of material frames of rib cutting machines, and is positioned in the rib cutting machine and used for stacking a plurality of lead frames, wherein the material frame comprises four square column structures and a bottom block, the four square column structures are respectively positioned at four corners of the material frame, four limit assemblies which are in one-to-one correspondence with the square column structures are arranged on the bottom block, the four square column structures are respectively connected with the bottom block in an inserting mode through the corresponding limit assemblies, each limit assembly comprises a plurality of inserting structures, each inserting structure is distributed in an L shape, two adjacent inserting structures positioned in the same limit assembly are equidistant, each square column structure is in an L shape, the L-shaped protruding ends of the square column structures face outwards, the problem that the material frame in the conventional rib cutting machine cannot meet the stable supporting of lead frames of different types, and the material frames of different types need to be replaced and supported for the lead frames of different types is solved, and the low-cost production of semiconductors is realized.

title_en: Grabbing and transferring mechanism of photovoltaic silicon wafer carrier quartz boat
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of new energy, in particular to a grabbing and transferring mechanism of a photovoltaic silicon wafer carrier quartz boat, which mainly comprises a mounting and fixing plate, wherein an adjusting cylinder is arranged at the top end of the mounting and fixing plate, a grabbing plate is connected to the outer side of the mounting and fixing plate, a quartz boat body is arranged at the bottom end of the grabbing plate, a grabbing contact block is arranged at the bottom end of a rotating clamping groove, a toothed plate is arranged at the outer side of the grabbing contact block, and a mounting and adjusting assembly comprises a mounting connecting piece. According to the grabbing and transferring mechanism of the photovoltaic silicon wafer carrier quartz boat, when the grabbing plate is connected with the grabbing contact block, the rotating clamping block is spliced in the rotating clamping groove and then rotates for half a circle, the grabbing plate limits the descending position of the rotating clamping block, then the tooth-shaped plate on the side edge is in butt joint with the butt joint frame, the oblique clamping plate has a limiting effect on the tooth-shaped plate, the grabbing contact block is convenient to install and detach, the replacement maintenance rate is improved, and the service efficiency of equipment is further improved.

title_en: Integrated circuit
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide an integrated circuit comprising a plurality of active components operably coupled to one another to form an integrated circuit, wherein the plurality of active components are disposed over a front surface of a substrate, a plurality of dummy components, each of the plurality of dummy components being disposed laterally immediately above one or more of the active components, wherein the plurality of dummy components are formed over the front surface, an interconnect structure disposed on a back surface of the substrate opposite the front surface of the substrate and carrying a supply voltage, a plurality of first via structures, each of the plurality of first via structures extending vertically through the substrate and disposed laterally within a respective one of the active components or dummy components, and a second via structure extending vertically through the substrate and extending laterally within a respective one of the dummy components, extending laterally along an edge between one of the active components and one of the dummy components, or extending laterally along an edge between the adjacent active components.

title_en: Crystal packaging structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of crystal packaging, in particular to a crystal packaging structure, which comprises a shell with an opening at the top, wherein a cover plate is movably connected at the top of the shell, the shell comprises a protective shell with the opening at the top, a placing box with the opening at the top is arranged in the protective shell, the upper end of the protective shell is connected with the placing box through a connecting plate with an opening, the inner surface of the protective shell below the connecting plate and the outer surface of the placing box form a cooling cavity, the shell with a double-layer structure is arranged, the shell is divided into the placing box and the protective box, when the crystal packaging structure is used, crystals can be placed in the placing box, and the contact area between the placing box and the protective box in the interior is small because the placing box and the protective shell are connected only through the connecting plate at the upper end, so that the crystals in the placing box are not influenced by external temperature change basically.

title_en: Cooling plate for plasma cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of semiconductors, and discloses a cooling disc for ion cleaning equipment. A cooling disc for plasma cleaning equipment comprises a heat conduction lower cover plate, a heat conduction upper cover plate and a D-shaped cooling pipe, wherein the heat conduction upper cover plate is provided with a mounting groove, the cross section of the mounting groove is D-shaped, the heat conduction lower cover plate is fixedly arranged on the heat conduction upper cover plate, an opening of the mounting groove faces the heat conduction lower cover plate, the D-shaped cooling pipe is arranged in the mounting groove, the shape of the D-shaped cooling pipe is matched with that of the mounting groove, and the D-shaped cooling pipe is communicated with an external cooling source. According to the cooling disc for the plasma cleaning equipment, the contact area between the D-shaped cooling pipe and the heat conduction upper cover plate can be increased by the D-shaped cooling pipe in the working process, so that the cooling disc speed for the plasma cleaning equipment can be increased by cooling liquid, wafers placed on the cooling disc are always at a stable temperature in the plasma cleaning process, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Wafer detaching and attaching integrated transfer table
abstract_en: The application discloses a wafer detachment and attachment integrated transfer table which comprises a main body frame, a film attaching vacuum table, a rotating bearing, a rotating handle and a vacuum system. The film pasting vacuum table is positioned at the top of the main body frame, and a vacuum adsorption hole array is arranged on the surface of the film pasting vacuum table; the rotary bearing is arranged in the main body frame and fixedly connected with the bottom of the film pasting vacuum table, the rotary handle is arranged on the film pasting vacuum table, and the vacuum system comprises a vacuum switch which is used for controlling the film pasting vacuum table to release or adsorb wafers. The application can improve the wafer disassembling and film pasting efficiency.

title_en: Suction sheet isolation cleaning device and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a suction sheet isolation cleaning device and a system, and relates to the technical field of semiconductor production. The utility model provides a suction sheet isolation cleaning device which comprises a carrier plate, a suction sheet sucker, an air wall and a connecting mechanism, wherein the carrier plate is movably arranged on the air wall and used for covering a silicon wafer on the carrier plate, the air wall is arranged in a hollow mode and communicated with an external air source, an air blowing port is formed in the bottom of the air wall towards the carrier plate, the connecting mechanism is arranged on the air wall and the suction sheet sucker together, the suction sheet sucker is movably connected with the air wall, the suction sheet sucker and the air wall can move relatively between a first relative position and a second relative position, the suction sheet sucker drives the air wall to move towards the carrier plate at the first relative position, and after the air wall is abutted against the carrier plate, the suction sheet sucker can continue to move towards the silicon wafer to a second relative position with the air wall so as to adsorb the silicon wafer. The utility model can cover the silicon wafer during taking the wafer, and sweep the carrier plate during taking the wafer, thereby improving the process efficiency.

title_en: Silicon substrate, solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a silicon substrate, a solar cell and a photovoltaic module, which relate to the technical field of solar cells and are used for solving the problems that after an initial silicon wafer is subjected to laser thermal cracking, the subsequent solar cell preparation has higher fragmentation rate and more cell performance reduction due to overlarge stress on the edge of the silicon wafer. The silicon substrate comprises a first surface, a second surface and a plurality of side surfaces which are opposite to each other, wherein the side surfaces are connected with the first surface and the second surface, the side surfaces comprise first side surfaces, at least part of the first side surfaces are provided with first protruding parts, one ends of the first protruding parts are close to the first surface, the other ends of the first protruding parts are close to the second surface, and the distance between any point on the first protruding parts and the first side surfaces is increased and then decreased along the direction from the first surface to the second surface.

title_en: Power semiconductor device and package structure
abstract_en: The application relates to a power semiconductor device and a packaging structure, wherein the power semiconductor device comprises a first substrate, a power chip and a tunnel magnetic resistance structure, wherein a plurality of conductive structures are arranged in the first substrate, the power chip is positioned on one side surface of the first substrate and is coupled with the conductive structures, and the tunnel magnetic resistance structure is positioned on one side surface of the first substrate, which is away from the power chip and is coupled with the conductive structures. According to the application, by constructing the unified first substrate platform, the power chips and the tunnel magnetic resistance structures are distributed on the upper side and the lower side of the first substrate in a layered manner, the structure is fixed, and the sensor wiring and supporting structures are not required to be designed for each package independently, so that the design universality is greatly improved.

title_en: Dust-free protection integrated structure for chip packaging
abstract_en: The utility model provides a chip packaging dust-free protection integrated structure which comprises a workbench, wherein a sealing dust-removing assembly is arranged on the workbench and comprises a sealing cover, a sealing base, a circulating pipe, a dust removing box, a dust removing pipe, a limiting frame, a filter element and two axial flow fans, and the sealing base is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the workbench. Compared with the prior art, the utility model successfully realizes the sealing treatment of the packaging environment by configuring the sealed dust removal component, and in addition, fine dust in the packaging environment is effectively filtered by virtue of the fine filtering function of the filter element before the packaging operation, thereby constructing a dust-free packaging environment and ensuring the reliability of chip packaging.

title_en: Solar cell and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a solar cell and a photovoltaic module, wherein the solar cell comprises a silicon substrate, an intrinsic layer, a doped layer and a transparent conductive film layer are respectively and sequentially laminated on two opposite surfaces of the silicon substrate, the surface, deviating from the silicon substrate, of the transparent conductive film layer is a first surface, at least one surface of the solar cell is provided with a groove, the groove is recessed from the first surface to the silicon substrate, penetrates through the transparent conductive film layer and does not penetrate through the doped layer, and the solar cell further comprises a grid line, wherein the grid line is partially arranged in the groove, and the other part of the grid line is in contact with the first surface. According to the utility model, through structural design of the solar cell, autonomous optimization selection of a carrier transmission path is realized, the contact resistance and the series resistance are reduced, the photo-generated current is improved, and the conversion efficiency is improved.

title_en: Packaged product moves and carries equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses packaged product transferring equipment, which belongs to the technical field of packaged product transferring and comprises a rack, wherein a plastic tray feeding module, a transfer tray feeding module, a first tray transplanting module, a second tray transplanting module, a suction and carrying module, a bottom camera module and a defective product collecting module are arranged on the rack, a manual tray is not needed, the carrying efficiency can be improved, accurate product positioning and angle compensation can be realized, damage and dropping of repeated product carrying are reduced, meanwhile, quality detection is carried out on products, and the packaged product transferring equipment is suitable for carrying different products.

title_en: Method of electrochemically processing a substrate and integrated circuit device
abstract_en: A substrate (100) has a front side (101) comprising an electrical circuit (102) and a rear side (103) comprising an exposed zone (104) that faces the electrical circuit (102). In an electrochemical treatment step, an electrical potential is laterally applied at least to the exposed zone (104) of the rear side (103) of the substrate (100), while the exposed zone (104) is in contact with a chemically reactive substance (404). The electrical potential causes a lateral flow of electrical current at least in the exposed zone (104) of the substrate (100). The lateral flow of current and the chemically reactive substance (404) alter the substrate (100) in at least the exposed zone (104).

title_en: Compact three-way doherty amplifier module
abstract_en: Embodiments of a method and a device are disclosed. In an embodiment, a Doherty amplifier module includes a substrate including a mounting surface, and further includes a first amplifier die, a second amplifier die, and a third amplifier die on the mounting surface. The first amplifier die is configured to amplify a first radio frequency (RF) signal along a first signal path, the second amplifier die is configured to amplify a second RF signal along a second signal path, and the third amplifier die is configured to amplify a third RF signal along a third signal path. A side of the first amplifier die including a first output terminal faces a side of the second amplifier die including a second output terminal. The second signal path is parallel to the first signal path, and the third signal path is orthogonal to the first and second signal paths.

title_en: Configurable solar cells
abstract_en: A photovoltaic cell may include a substrate configured as a single light absorption region. The photovoltaic cell may include a plurality of first semiconductor regions arranged on or in the substrate and physically separated from one another. Each first semiconductor region may form one of a plurality of collecting junctions with the single light absorbing region. The photovoltaic cell may include a plurality of second semiconductor regions arranged on or in the substrate and physically separated from one another. Each second semiconductor region forming one of a plurality of high-low junctions with the single light absorbing region. Each of the first semiconductor regions may form at least one separate cell partition with at least one of the second semiconductor regions, thereby forming a plurality of cell partitions on or in the substrate.

title_en: Reducing or eliminating liquid de-gassing
abstract_en: Various embodiments include an exemplary design of an apparatus and related process to reduce or eliminate de-gassing from a liquid precursor during dispensing of the liquid precursor under vacuum. In one embodiment, the apparatus includes a liquid-flow controller configured to be coupled to a liquid-supply vessel containing the liquid precursor, and at least one valve hydraulically coupled downstream of and to the liquid-flow controller by a liquid line. The at least one valve is to be opened and closed to maintain a minimum pressure that is sufficiently high enough to reduce or prevent degassing of the liquid precursor throughout the liquid line. An atomizer is hydraulically coupled downstream of and to the at least one valve. The atomizer can produce droplets of the liquid precursor and is further to be coupled on a downstream side to a vacuum source. Other methods and apparatuses are disclosed.

title_en: Composition containing organic semiconductor, solution for forming organic semiconductor layer, organic semiconductor layer, and organic thin film transistor
abstract_en: Provided are (i) a solution for forming an organic semiconductor layer which solution has an excellent coating property, (ii) an organic semiconductor which is produced with use of the solution and which has high heat resistance, (iii) a layer which contains the organic semiconductor, and (iv) an organic thin film transistor which exhibits high electrical properties. A composition containing: an organic semiconductor; and a polymer (1) having at least one unit selected from the group consisting of units represented by formulae (1-a), (1-b), and (1-c). A composition containing the organic semiconductor, the polymer (1), and an organic solvent can be suitably used as a solution for forming an organic semiconductor layer.

title_en: Light-emitting device, display device comprising same, and method for manufacturing display device
abstract_en: A light emitting device includes a substrate. A light emitting element layer is disposed on the substrate, and includes light emitting elements having a rod shape. A color conversion layer is disposed on the light emitting element layer, and includes color conversion elements having a rod shape. A second alignment direction of the color conversion elements is substantially identical to a first alignment direction of the light emitting elements.

title_en: Heat-dissipating member and manufacturing method for same
abstract_en: Provided is a substantially rectangular and plate-shaped heat dissipation member including a metal-silicon carbide composite containing Al or Mg. Among two main surfaces of the heat dissipation member, one main surface is curved to be convex in an outward direction of the heat dissipation member and the other main surface is curved to be convex in an inward direction of the heat dissipation member. In a curve C of the other main surface in a cross-sectional view of the heat dissipation member showing a cross-section that is substantially perpendicular to the heat dissipation member and passes both middle points of two short sides of the other main surface, when a straight line passing through both endpoints P 1  and P 2  of the curve C is represented by l 1 , a point at which a distance to l 1  on the curve C is maximum is represented by P max , an intersection point between l 1  and a perpendicular drawn from P max  to l 1  is represented by P 3 , a middle point of a line segment P 1 P 3  is represented by P 4 , an intersection point between the curve C and a straight line that passes through P 4  and is perpendicular to l 1  is represented by P mid , a length of the line segment P 1 P 3  is represented by L, a length of a line segment P 3 P max  is represented by H, and a length of a line segment P 4 P mid  is represented by h, (2h/L)/(H/L) is 1.1 or more.

title_en: Semiconductor devices and electronic systems including the same
abstract_en: A semiconductor device includes: a substrate including a memory cell region and a connection region; a plurality of gate lines vertically overlapping each other in the memory cell region of the substrate in a vertical direction, each gate line including a first metal; a stepped connection unit in the connection region and comprising a plurality of conductive pad regions, each conductive pad region including the first metal and integrally connected to a respective gate line of the plurality of gate lines; a plurality of contact structures vertically overlapping the stepped connection unit, each contact structure connected to a respectively corresponding conductive pad region of the plurality of conductive pad regions and including a second metal; and at least one metal silicide layer between at least one contact structure and the respectively corresponding conductive pad region.

title_en: Split-gate trench power mosfet with self-aligned poly-to-poly isolation
abstract_en: A semiconductor substrate (12) has a trench (18) extending from a front surface (14) and including a lower part and an upper part. A first insulation layer (20) lines the lower part of the trench, and a first conductive material (22) in the lower part is insulated from the semiconductor substrate by the first insulating layer to form a field plate electrode of a transistor. A second insulating layer (130) lines sidewalls of the upper part of said trench. A third insulating layer (132) lines a top surface of the first conductive material at a bottom of the upper part of the trench. A second conductive material (32) fills the upper part of the trench. The second conductive material forms a gate electrode of the transistor (100) that is insulated from the semiconductor substrate by the second insulating layer and further insulated from the first conductive material by the third insulating layer.

title_en: Polyester film, laminated film, and use thereof
abstract_en: Provided are a polyester film, a laminated film, and the like for protecting an organic EL module of a foldable display each of which is free of occurrence of a crack at a folding portion thereof, in order to provide a foldable display excellent in mass productivity, and free of a risk of causing distortion in an image displayed at a folding portion thereof after being repeatedly folded. The polyester film for protecting an organic EL module of a foldable display satisfies the following conditions: (1) a refractive index in a bending direction is from 1.590 to 1.620; (2) a refractive index in a folding portion direction is from 1.670 to 1.700; (3) a refractive index in a thickness direction is 1.520 or less; and (4) a density is 1.380 g/cm 3  or more, wherein the bending direction refers to a direction orthogonal to a folding portion of the polyester film at a time when the polyester film is folded.

title_en: Microfluidic device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A microfluidic device comprising: a first substrate (402,502,602,702,802) having a first assembling side (402a,702a, 802a); and a second substrate (404,504,604,704,804) having a second assembling side(404a, 504a, 604a, 804a ) connectable with the first assembling side (402a,702a, 802a) to assemble the first substrate (402,502,602,702,802) and the second substrate (404,504,604,704,804) together. At least one of the first assembling side (402a,702a, 802a) and the second assembling side (404a, 504a, 604a, 804a ) has a fluid chamber channel (406,706,806), and after the first substrate (402,502,602,702,802) and the second substrate (404,504,604,704,804) are connected together, the fluid chamber channel (406,706,806)forms a fluid chamber having a fluid inlet (408,608,708,808)and a fluid outlet(410,510,610,710,810). The at least one of the first assembling side(402a,702a, 802a) and the second assembling side(404a, 504a, 604a, 804a ) having the fluid chamber channel (406,706,806)has an outlet expansion groove (418,518,618,718,818, 818')adjacent to and extending downstream from the fluid outlet (410,510,610,710,810), and wherein at the fluid outlet (410,510,610,710,810), an outer peripheral profile of the outlet expansion groove (418,518,618,718,818, 818') is located outside an outer peripheral profile of the fluid outlet (410,510,610,710,810).

title_en: Thermally conductive silicone gel composition
abstract_en: A thermally conductive silicone gel composition of the present invention includes the following A to F: (A) an organopolysiloxane having two alkenyl groups per molecule; (B) an organohydrogenpolysiloxane having two Si-H groups per molecule; (C) an organohydrogenpolysiloxane having three or more Si-H groups per molecule; (D) at least one compound selected from the group consisting of D1 and D2: (D1) an organopolysiloxane having one alkenyl group per molecule and (D2) an organohydrogenpolysiloxane having one Si-H group per molecule; (E) a platinum catalyst; and (F) a thermally conductive filler in an amount of 100 to 600 vol% with respect to 100 vol% of the total amount of the A to E. The components A to F are cured. With this configuration, the thermally conductive silicone gel composition can reduce oil bleeding, even though the composition is a gel cured product.

title_en: Led filament lamp
abstract_en: There is provided a light emitting diode, LED, filament lamp (100) which provides LED filament lamp light (100'). The LED filament lamp (100) comprises at least one LED filament (101) which has a LED filament length (L) which extends from a first end (1003) to a second end (1004). The at least one LED filament (101) provides LED filament light (101') and comprises an array (102) of a plurality of LEDs (103) and an encapsulant (104). The array (102) of a plurality of LEDs (103) provide LED light (103') and extend along the LED filament length (L). The encapsulant (104) is at least partially enclosing the plurality of LEDs (103). The encapsulant (104) comprises a light scattering material (105). In the direction from the first end (1003) to the second end (1004) at least one of (i) the thickness (TL) of the encapsulant (104), and (ii) the concentration (CL) of the light scattering material (105) in the encapsulant (104), along the LED filament length (L) increases over at least two adjacent first LEDs (106) and decreases over at least two adjacent second LEDs (107) different from the at least two adjacent first LEDs (106), and wherein the thickness (TL) and/or concentration (CL) firstly increases and secondly decreases at least along a portion of the LED filament length (L).

title_en: Method for producing a protective covering for electronic components arranged on a supporting substrate, and apparatus for carrying out the method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a protective covering for electronic components arranged on a supporting substrate, in which method a peripheral dam consisting of a highly viscous dam material is applied to an equipment side of a supporting substrate provided with at least one electronic component, and the area of the equipment side surrounded by the dam and provided with the at least one electronic component is filled by means of a metering device with a low-viscosity filling material until the side of the at least one electronic component facing away from the equipment side is completely covered by the filling material. According to the invention, in the metering device both the dam material and also the filling material are formed from the same material fed to the metering device by energy input. Furthermore, the invention relates to an apparatus for carrying out the above-mentioned method.

title_en: Materials for organic electroluminescent devices
abstract_en: The invention relates to dibenzofuran derivatives which are substituted with electron-poor heteroaryl groups, and to electronic devices, in particular organic electroluminescent devices containing said compounds as triplet matrix materials.

title_en: Thermal compression flip chip bump
abstract_en: A thermal compression flip chip (TCFC) bump may be used for high performance products that benefit from a fine pitch. In one example, a new TCFC bump structure adds a metal pad underneath the TCFC copper pillar bump to cover the exposed aluminum bump pad. This new structure prevents the pad from corroding and reduces mechanical stress to the pad and underlying silicon dielectric layers enabling better quality and reliability and further bump size reduction. For example, a flip chip connection may include a substrate; a metal pad on a contact side of the substrate and a first passivation layer on the contact side of the substrate to protect the metal pad from corrosion.

title_en: Object holder, tool and method of manufacturing an object holder
abstract_en: An object holder configured to support an object, the object holder comprising: a core body comprising a plurality of burls having distal ends in a support plane for supporting the object; and an electrostatic sheet between the burls, the electrostatic sheet comprising an electrode sandwiched between dielectric layers; wherein the electrostatic sheet is bonded to the core body by a bonding material having a thickness of at least 100 nm.

title_en: Vertical pin diode
abstract_en: A diode semiconductor structure is described. In one example, a diode device includes a substrate, a layer of first semiconductor material of a first doping type, a layer of intrinsic semiconductor material, and a layer of second semiconductor material of a second doping type. The diode device also includes a metal contact formed on the layer of first semiconductor material and a metal via formed from a backside of the substrate, through the substrate, and through the layer of first semiconductor material, where the metal via contacts a bottom surface of the metal contact on the layer of first semiconductor material. In this configuration, a direct electrical connection can be achieved between the backside of the substrate and the metal contact on the layer of first semiconductor material without the need for an additional metal connection, such as a metal air bridge, to the metal contact.
