title_en: Reflective optics equipped with a cooling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to reflective optics (1) for transporting, transforming or correcting a light beam (19), in particular of the laser type, characterised in that it comprises a mirror (2) receiving the light beam (19), a primary cooling circuit made up of an intermediate chamber (6) of thermally conductive fluid (7) disposed against the mirror (2) at the rear thereof and a secondary cooling circuit made up of a heat sink (3) disposed against the intermediate chamber (6) of thermally conductive fluid (7), said heat sink (3) being either in the form of a cold mass cooled by convection or conduction, or in the form of a plate made of a material having good thermal conductivity, the heat sink (3) having a size and a shape equivalent to those of said reflective optics.

title_en: Strain relaxation layer
abstract_en: A method of forming a strain relaxation layer in an epitaxial crystalline structure, the method comprising: providing a crystalline template layer comprising a material with a first natural relaxed in-plane lattice parameter; forming a first epitaxial crystalline layer on the crystalline template layer, wherein the first epitaxial crystalline layer has an initial electrical conductivity that is higher than the electrical conductivity of the crystalline template layer; forming a second epitaxial crystalline layer on the first epitaxial crystalline layer, wherein the second epitaxial crystalline layer has an electrical conductivity lower than the initial electrical conductivity of the first epitaxial crystalline layer and comprises a material with a second natural relaxed in-plane lattice parameter that is different to the first natural relaxed in-plane lattice parameter of the crystalline template layer; forming pores in the first epitaxial crystalline layer by electrochemical etching of the first epitaxial crystalline layer to enable strain relaxation in the second epitaxial crystalline layer by plastic deformation of bonds in the first epitaxial crystalline layer and/or at the interface between the first epitaxial crystalline layer and the second epitaxial crystalline layer; and forming one or more channels comprising a conductive material through at least the first epitaxial crystalline layer and the second epitaxial crystalline layer thereby to enable electrical connection to the crystalline template layer through the first epitaxial crystalline layer and the second epitaxial crystalline layer.

title_en: Thermoelectric material, method for proudcing same, and thermoelectric power generation element
abstract_en: Provided is a thermoelectric material which exhibits excellent thermoelectric characteristics at room temperature; a method for producing this thermoelectric material; and a thermoelectric power generation element using this thermoelectric material. In an embodiment of the present invention, a thermoelectric material contains an inorganic compound that contains magnesium (Mg), antimony (Sb) and/or bismuth (Bi), copper (Cu), and if necessary M (M is composed of at least one element that is selected from the group consisting of selenium (Se) and tellurium (Te)); and inorganic compound is represented by Mg a Sb 2-b-c Bi b M c Cu d , wherein a, b, c and d satisfy 3≤a≤3.5, 0≤b≤2, 0≤c≤0.06, 0≤d≤0.1, and (b+1)≤2.

title_en: Iii-nitride thermal management based on aluminum nitride substrates
abstract_en: Techniques, a system, and architecture are disclosed for top side transistor heat dissipation. The heat dissipation is done through single crystal epitaxially grown layer such as AIN. The architecture may include a back side heat sink to increase thermal dissipation as well. The architecture may further include a pseudomorphic channel layer that is lattice matched to the substrate.

title_en: Bonding system and bonding method
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a bonding system and a bonding method. The bonding system includes a bonding assembly, a wafer stage, a first alignment assembly and a second alignment assembly. The wafer stage is configured to drive, according to a first deviation value determined by the first alignment assembly and a second deviation value determined by the second alignment assembly, a carried wafer to move so as to align a second die with a first die. The bonding assembly is configured to bond the first die to the second die. The bonding system further includes a third alignment assembly located at a side of the wafer stage away from the bonding assembly, and configured to determine a third deviation value between positions of the first die and the second die which have been bonded. The bonding assembly is further configured to debond the first die from the second die, in response to that the third deviation value is greater than a preset threshold.

title_en: Piezoelectric actuator
abstract_en: A piezoelectric actuator (1) includes a body portion (10) including a layered piezoelectric element layered in a Y-axis direction of an orthogonal coordinate system XYZ, the body portion (10) extending along a Z-axis direction. The body portion (10) includes a first piezoelectric element (11) that displaces a tip portion (10a) in an X-axis direction, a second piezoelectric element (12) that displaces the tip portion (10a) in the Y-axis direction, and a third piezoelectric element (13) that displaces the tip portion (10a) in the Z-axis direction.

title_en: Method for preparing a josephson junction, apparatus, and device, and superconducting device
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, and devices for Josephson junction preparation includes: obtaining a first pattern structure for generating a first Josephson junction of a first type and a plurality of second pattern structures for generating a plurality of second Josephson junctions of a second type; evaporating a material on the first pattern structure and the plurality of second pattern structures based on a first evaporation direction to generate a first electrode layer for implementing information transmission; forming an insulating layer on the first electrode layer, the insulating layer including a compound corresponding to the material; evaporating the material on the first pattern structure and the plurality of second pattern structures based on a second evaporation direction to generate a second electrode layer for implementing information transmission; and forming the first Josephson junction and the plurality of second Josephson junctions.

title_en: Battery string production apparatus and production method
abstract_en: A solar cell string production equipment includes first and second conveying devices, first and second carrying devices, and a transfer device. The first conveying device has a first continuous conveyor belt, the second conveying device has a second continuous conveyor belt, and the first and second continuous conveyor belts can turn and convey in the vertical direction. Back and front films are laid on the first conveying device. The first conveying device can transport the back film on the first continuous conveyor belt to the second continuous conveyor belt. The transfer device can transport the pressing tool from the terminal of the second continuous conveyor belt to the front film on the first continuous conveyor belt. The second carrying device can transport the pressing tool and front film stacked together to the second continuous conveyor belt. A solar cell string production method is further provided.

title_en: Indolo[3.2.1-jk]carbazole-6-carbonitrile derivatives as blue fluorescent emitters for use in oleds
abstract_en: Indolo[3.2.1-jk]carbazole-6-carbonitrile derivatives of the formula (I) as blue fluorescent emitters in organic electroluminescent devices, more particularly OLEDs.

title_en: Memory cell with a ferroelectric capacitor integrated with a transistor gate
abstract_en: Described herein are ferroelectric (FE) memory cells that include transistors having gates with FE capacitors integrated therein. An example memory cell includes a transistor having a semiconductor channel material, a gate dielectric over the semiconductor material, a first conductor material over the gate dielectric, a FE material over the first conductor material, and a second conductor material over the FE material. The first and second conductor materials form, respectively, first and second capacitor electrodes of a capacitor, where the first and second capacitor electrodes are separated by the FE material (hence, a "FE capacitor"). Separating a FE material from a semiconductor channel material of a transistor with a layer of a gate dielectric and a layer of a first conductor material eliminates the FE-semiconductor interface that may cause endurance issues in some other FE memory cells.

title_en: Tunable led filament
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a color tunable and/or color temperature tunable LED filament (20, 22, 24), said LED filament comprising an elongated carrier (220), said elongated carrier comprising a first major surface (222) and a second major surface (224) arranged opposite to said first major surface, a plurality of LEDs (210) arranged in at least one linear array on said first surface of said elongated carrier, wherein the plurality of LEDs includes LEDs of different colors and/or different color temperatures, a first elongated transparent or substantially transparent layer (230) covering the plurality of LEDs on the first major surface and also at least partly covering said first major surface, and a first elongated light scattering layer (240), arranged to at least partially cover said first transparent or substantially transparent layer.

title_en: Method for measuring etching amount, and measurement system therefor
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a novel technology for measuring an etching amount in heat treatment in which growth and etching proceed simultaneously. The present invention includes: a first substrate thickness measuring step S10 for measuring the thickness 10D of a to-be-heat-treated semiconductor substrate 10; a second substrate thickness measuring step S20 for measuring the thickness 20D of a heat-treated semiconductor substrate 20; a growth layer thickness measuring step S30 for measuring the thickness 21D of a growth layer 21 which has gone through crystal growth by heat treatment; and an etching amount calculating step S40 for calculating the etching amount ED on the basis of the thickness 10D of the to-be-heat-treated semiconductor substrate 10, the thickness 20D of the heat-treated semiconductor substrate 20, and the thickness 21D of the growth layer 21.

title_en: Cleaning composition, method of cleaning metal-containing film and method of manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: Provided are a cleaning composition for removing residues on surfaces, a method of cleaning a metal-containing film by using the same, and a method of manufacturing a semiconductor device by using the same. The cleaning composition comprises a solvent (water), a cleaning accelerator and does not comprise an oxidant.

title_en: Sige:gab source or drain structures with low resistivity
abstract_en: Integrated circuit structures having source or drain structures with low resistivity are described. In an example, integrated circuit structure includes a fin having a lower fin portion and an upper fin portion. A gate stack is over the upper fin portion of the fin, the gate stack having a first side opposite a second side. A first source or drain structure includes an epitaxial structure embedded in the fin at the first side of the gate stack. A second source or drain structure includes an epitaxial structure embedded in the fin at the second side of the gate stack. Each epitaxial structure of the first and second source or drain structures include silicon, germanium, gallium and boron. The first and second source or drain structures have a resistivity less than 2E-9 Ohm cm 2 .

title_en: Methods of fabricating semiconductor device
abstract_en: A method of fabricating a semiconductor device is provided, which includes forming (S11) a photoresist layer on a lower structure to have a first thickness, exposing (S12) a portion of the photoresist layer to form an exposed portion and a non-exposed portion of the photoresist layer, removing (S13) a part of the photoresist layer to form a photoresist layer having a second thickness that smaller than the first thickness, and removing (S14) the exposed portion or the non-exposed portion of the photoresist layer having the second thickness to form a photoresist pattern.

title_en: Self-aligned gate endcap (sage) architectures with gate-all-around devices
abstract_en: Self-aligned gate endcap (SAGE) architectures with gate-all-around devices, and methods of fabricating self-aligned gate endcap (SAGE) architectures with gate-all-around devices, are described. In an example, an integrated circuit structure includes a semiconductor fin above a substrate and having a length in a first direction. A nanowire is over the semiconductor fin. A gate structure is over the nanowire and the semiconductor fin, the gate structure having a first end opposite a second end in a second direction, orthogonal to the first direction. A pair of gate endcap isolation structures is included, where a first of the pair of gate endcap isolation structures is spaced equally from a first side of the semiconductor fin as a second of the pair of gate endcap isolation structures is spaced from a second side of the semiconductor fin.

title_en: Display panel and color film substrate
abstract_en: Disclosed is a display panel, provided with a plurality of repeated pixel units, and at least one pixel unit comprising a first sub-pixel, a second sub-pixel and a third sub-pixel which display different colors. The display panel comprises: a first base substrate, a light-emitting device layer, a color filter layer, a color conversion layer, a touch control function layer and a light adjusting layer. The light-emitting device layer is located on one side of the first base substrate; and the light-emitting device layer comprises a first light-emitting device, a second light-emitting device and a third light-emitting device. The color filter layer is located on the side of the light-emitting device layer away from the first base substrate and at least comprises a first shading pattern, a first color filter and a second color filter. The color conversion layer is located between the light-emitting device layer and the color filter layer, and the color conversion layer comprises a first color conversion pattern, a second color conversion pattern and a light-transmitting pattern. The touch control function layer is located on the side of the color conversion layer away from the first base substrate. The light adjusting layer is located on the side of the touch control function layer away from the first base substrate.

title_en: Leadless pressure sensors
abstract_en: Disclosed are pressure sensors including a die and an application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) mounted on a top surface of a substrate. The pressure sensor can define an inner volume and a bottom opening configured to abut the substrate. The die and ASIC are mounted on the top surface of the substrate within the inner volume. The substrate defines a first aperture therethrough and the die defines a second aperture therethrough in a direction along an axis perpendicular to the substrate, the first aperture and the second aperture being aligned. Metallic barrier(s) disposed on a bottom surface of the substrate, circumferentially about the first aperture, can be at least partially coated with solder mask to reduce or prevent flow of unwanted materials past the metallic barriers and through the first aperture. The substrate can include electrical connection pads on the bottom surface configured to be in communication with a daughter board.

title_en: Hydroxyaminophosphinic acid derivatives
abstract_en:
The present invention relates to hydroxyamino phosphinic acid derivatives of formula I
     
in which the occurring groups and parameters have the meanings defined in claim 1, to a method for their preparation and to their use for the fabrication of self-assembled monolayers (SAM), in particular for the fabrication of switchable SAM for electronic devices. The invention further relates to electronic devices comprising said SAM, preferably in the field of organic electronics, in particular for use in memory, sensors, furthermore in organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), photovoltaics (OPVs), field-effect transistors (OFETs) and Josephson junctions, very particularly in memristive components such as memristive crossbar-arrays.

title_en: Power semiconductor device module
abstract_en: A power module semiconductor device (1) includes: an insulating substrate (10) having a first side, a second side adjacent to the first side, a third side opposite to the first side, and a fourth side opposite to the second side; a first pattern (D(K4)) disposed on a front surface of the insulating substrate (10); first semiconductor chips (Q4) disposed on the first pattern (D(K4)); a negative side power input terminal (N) electrically connected to the first semiconductor chips (Q4), the negative side power input terminal being disposed on the first side of the insulating substrate (10); a first signal terminal (S4,G4,T4) electrically connected to the first semiconductor chips (Q4); a second pattern (D(K1)) disposed on the front surface of the insulating substrate (10); second semiconductor chips (Q1) disposed on the second pattern (D(K1)); a positive side power input terminal (P) electrically connected to the second semiconductor chips (Q1), the positive side power input terminal being disposed on the first side of the insulating substrate (10); a second signal terminal (S1,G1,T1) electrically connected to the second semiconductor chips (Q1); an output terminal (O) electrically connected to the first semiconductor chips (Q4) and the second semiconductor chips (Q1), the output terminal being arranged on the third side of the insulating substrate (10); and a resin layer (12) having a main surface and a side surface and covering the first semiconductor chips (Q4), the second semiconductor chips (Q1), a part of the negative side power input terminal (N), a part of the positive side power input terminal (P), a part of the output terminal (O) and the insulating substrate (10). The negative side power input terminal (N) and the positive side power input terminal (P) are disposed so as to be extended along in a parallel direction with the main surface of the resin layer (12), and the output terminal (P) is disposed so as to be extended along in the parallel direction.

title_en: Method and apparatus for a silicon die preparation including auxetic and electrostatic dissipatative features
abstract_en: The disclosure is directed to a silicon bridge die package, a dicing-die attach film structure and a method for silicon processing including a silicon bridge die package including at least two silicon die incorporating a plurality of integrated circuits, an embedded multi-die interconnect bridge coupled to the at least two silicon die, a dicing-die attach film (DDAF) structure coupled to a silicon wafer, an electro-static discharge (ESD) preventative within the DDAF structure to prevent static charge within the DDAF structure, and an auxetic material disposed within the DDAF structure configured to prevent dicing errors. A method for preparing a silicon die for singulation includes applying an auxetic material with an ESD preventative additive to an organic resin to form a DDAF, combining the DDAF with an acrylic adhesive and a polyolefin base film, and mounting the DDAF to the silicon die.

title_en: Deposition apparatus, method for depositing, method for packaging a die in a chip package
abstract_en: A deposition apparatus (1) for depositing materials (Ma, Mb, ..., Mn) on a target (T) is provided herein. The apparatus is configured to initiate ejection of a material portion from an ejection position of a donor plate (2) at a point in time that a spatial vector defined between the deposition position (p s ) and the ejection position (p e ) corresponds to a movement of the donor plate (2) relative to the target (T). Also a corresponding deposition method is provided.

title_en: Online detection method and system for surface condition of polishing pad
abstract_en: An online detection method and system for the surface condition of a polishing pad. The online detection method comprises the following steps: an optical sensor (1) moving above a polishing pad (2), so as to acquire distance information between the optical sensor (1) and the surface of the polishing pad (2); according to the measured distance information, distinguishing distribution conditions of liquid on the surface of the polishing pad (2), and correspondingly using different correction calculation formulas to calculate a depth value of a trench (21) in the surface of the polishing pad (2); comparing a corrected depth value of the trench (21) in the surface of the polishing pad (2) with a preset threshold value; and determining the depth condition of the trench (21) in the surface of the polishing pad (2), so as to determine whether the polishing pad (2) needs to be replaced.

title_en: Organic molecules for optoelectronic devices
abstract_en: The invention relates to an organic molecule for the use in optoelectronic devices. According to the invention, the organic molecule has a structure of formula I wherein X is O or S; Z is independently selected from the group consisting of a direct bond, CR 3 R 4 , C=CR 3 R 4 , C=O, C=NR 3 , NR 3 , O, SiR 3 R 4 , S, S(O) and S(O) 2 ; and R a , R 3  and R 4  is independently selected from the group consisting of: hydrogen, deuterium, N(R 5 ) 2 , OR 5 , Si(R 5 ) 3 , B(OR 5 ) 2 , B(R 5 ) 2 ,   OSO 2 R 5 , CF 3 , CN, F, Br, I, C 1 -C 40 -alkyl, C 1 -C 40 -alkoxy, C 1 -C 40 -thioalkoxy, C 2 -C 40 -alkenyl, C 2 -C 40 -alkynyl, C 6 -C 60 -aryl, and C 2 -C 57 -heteroaryl.

title_en: Process for fabricating a double semiconductor-on-insulator structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process for fabricating a double semiconductor-on-insulator structure comprising the steps of: - providing a first donor substrate and a handle substrate (1), - forming a weakened zone in said donor substrate so as to delimit a first semiconductor layer to be transferred (2b), - bonding the first donor substrate to the handle substrate (1), a first electrically insulating layer (2a) being at the interface, and detaching at the weakened zone, - treating the surface of the first transferred semiconductor layer (2b) comprising: (E1) a rapid thermal annealing, (E2) a thermal oxidation followed by a deoxidation, (E3) a smoothing heat treatment at a temperature of above 1000°C in a non-oxidizing atmosphere, (E4) chemical-mechanical polishing, - providing a second donor substrate of a second semiconductor layer to be transferred (3b), - transferring said layer (3b), a second electrically insulating layer (3a) being at the interface.

title_en: Integrated circuit, preparation method therefor, three-dimensional integrated circuit and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: Some embodiments of this application provide an integrated circuit and a preparation method thereof, a three-dimensional integrated circuit, and an electronic device, and relate to the field of semiconductor technologies, to improve product reliability of the three-dimensional integrated circuit. The integrated circuit includes a substrate, an electronic component, a wiring layer, a dielectric bonding layer, a connection pattern, and a barrier layer. The electronic component is disposed on the substrate. The wiring layer is disposed on the substrate, and is electrically connected to the electronic component. The wiring layer includes a metal trace. The dielectric bonding layer is disposed on a side that is of the wiring layer and that is away from the substrate. The connection pattern runs through the dielectric bonding layer, and is electrically connected to the metal trace. The connection pattern includes a seed layer and a conductive block that are stacked, and the seed layer is located on a side that is of the conductive block and that is close to the substrate. The barrier layer is disposed between the conductive block and the dielectric bonding layer, and surrounds a side surface of the conductive block. The foregoing integrated circuit can be used to form a three-dimensional integrated circuit through hybrid bonding.

title_en: Light emitting diode package
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a light emitting diode package. Particularly, according to one embodiment of the present disclosure, there may be provided a light emitting diode package (1) including: a light emitting diode chip (100) that generates light of a first color; a wavelength conversion layer (200) disposed above the light emitting diode chip (100), which generates light of a second color by being excited by the light of the first color; a transparent layer (300) disposed above the wavelength conversion layer (200); and a wall portion (400) forming an accommodating space in which the light emitting diode chip (100) and the wavelength conversion layer (200) are accommodated. The wall portion (400) includes an inner surface (401) surrounding the accommodating space, and the transparent layer (300) is connected to the inner surface (401) of the wall portion (400) so that the accommodating space is closed from an outside.

title_en: Heat-emitting substrate and vapor chamber
abstract_en: A heat dissipation substrate includes a housing and a seal body. The housing includes an internal space. The seal body seals the internal space. The housing includes a through-hole and an internal bottom surface. The through-hole communicates with the internal space. The seal body includes a first portion and a second portion. The first portion is positioned at the internal space, and the second portion is positioned at the thorough-hole. The first portion contacts the internal bottom surface. A maximum width of the first portion is larger than a minimum width of the through-hole in a vertical section.

title_en: Three-dimensional memory device with divided drain select gate lines and method for forming the same
abstract_en: A memory device includes a stack structure over a substrate, a channel structure extending in the stack structure, and a dielectric layer over the channel structure. The dielectric layer includes a first material. The memory device may also include a drain-select gate (DSG) cut structure extending through the dielectric layer. The DSG cut structure includes a second material different from the first material.

title_en: Display device comprising semiconductor light-emitting element
abstract_en:
The embodiment relates to a display device including a semiconductor light emitting device. 
     A display device including a semiconductor light emitting device according to the embodiment comprises a substrate, first assembly electrodes and second assembly electrodes spaced apart from each other on the substrate, a first polarity zeta potential insulating layer disposed on the first and second assembly electrodes, an assembly partition having an assembly hole disposed on the first and second assembly electrodes, and a semiconductor light emitting device disposed within the assembly hole, wherein the semiconductor light emitting device may include a metal layer having a second polarity zeta potential.

title_en: Reactor casing assembly
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a casing assembly of a reactor for the epitaxial deposition of semiconductor films on a substrate. The casing assembly comprises an inner and an outer casing made of quartz and connected by at least two flanges made of engineering plastics. The invention also relates to a reaction chamber enclosed by said casing assembly, and a reactor employing at least one of said reaction chambers.

title_en: Capacitor, manufacturing method thereof, and capacitor assembly using the same
abstract_en: A disclosed capacitor may include a body that has through-holes extending from a first surface to a second surface, a first internal electrode disposed on the inner surfaces of the body positioned inside the through-holes, on the first surface of the body, and on the second surface of the body, a dielectric layer disposed on the first internal electrode, a second internal electrode disposed on the dielectric layer, a first external electrode disposed on the first surface and connected to the first internal electrode, and a second external electrode disposed on the second surface and connected to the second internal electrode.

title_en: Semiconductor module arrangement comprising at least one semiconductor element
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semiconductor arrangement (2), in particular a power semiconductor arrangement for a power converter (66), comprising at least one semiconductor element (4), the at least one semiconductor element (4) being arranged in a closed housing (6). In order to improve the recyclability of the semiconductor arrangement (2), it is proposed that the semiconductor element (4) is in direct contact with a coolant flow (42) of an electrically insulating cooling liquid (40), in particular inert liquid.

title_en: Determining a substrate location threshold based on optical properties
abstract_en: A system includes an optical sensor including an emitting element and a receiving element. The optical sensor is configured to detect an optical transmission ratio of a substrate responsive to a substrate support supporting the substrate in an optical path of the first optical sensor. The system further includes a processing device communicatively coupled to the optical sensor. The processing device is configured to determine an optical threshold based on the optical transmission ratio of the substrate. The processing device is further configured to determine a location of the substrate relative to a substrate-handling robot end effector based on sensor data output by a location sensor and the optical threshold.

title_en: Tin carboxylate precursors for metal oxide resist layers and related methods
abstract_en: Tin carboxylate precursors for metal oxide resist layers and related methods are disclosed herein. An example method of fabricating a semiconductor device disclosed herein includes synthesizing a precursor including tin, depositing a metal oxide resist layer on a base material by applying the precursor, the metal oxide resist layer including tin-6 clusters, and patterning the metal oxide resist layer.

title_en: Semiconductor wafer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semiconductor wafer having, in the specified sequence, a substrate having a top side and a bottom side, wherein on the top side a monocrystalline silicon layer is formed, a nucleation layer formed on the top side of the substrate, a first buffer layer formed above the nucleation layer, a stack-type semiconductor buffer layer sequence formed above the first buffer layer and having a top side and a bottom side, wherein the semiconductor buffer layer sequence has at least three partial layer sequences each with at least one buffer partial layer and an intermediate layer, and the intermediate layer is in each case formed on a bottom side of the respective partial layer sequence, and a further intermediate layer is arranged on the top side of the semiconductor buffer layer sequence, the thickness of the buffer partial layer of the partial layer sequence formed on the bottom side of the semiconductor buffer layer sequence is greater than the thickness of the buffer partial layer formed on the top side of the semiconductor buffer layer sequence and on the semiconductor buffer layer sequence, the distance between successive intermediate layers close to the top side is smaller than the distance between two successive intermediate layers close to the bottom side.

title_en: Structures for light-emitting diode packages with multiple light-emitting diode chips
abstract_en: Solid-state lighting devices including light-emitting diodes (LEDs) and more particularly structures for LED packages with multiple LED chips are disclosed. LED package structures include arrangements of one or more of body structures with multiple cavities for LED chips, encapsulants with lenses registered with the multiple cavities, and lead frame structures at least partially within the body structures. Cavities of body structures and/or corresponding lenses are disclosed with certain asymmetries configured to direct highest intensities of LED chip emissions in directions that are offset from cavity centers. Body structures are disclosed with one or more continuously planar surfaces that promote enhanced flexibility in encapsulant and/or lead frame structures and improved resistance to moisture ingress. One or more combinations of cavities and/or lenses asymmetries may be implemented in combination with one or more continuously planar body surfaces.

title_en: Ceramic plate, package, ceramic plate manufacturing method, module, and electric/electronic component
abstract_en: There is provided a ceramic plate including a plating film on at least a part of a surface of a plate-like ceramic member. When the ceramic plate is heated from 25°C to 400°C at a temperature rising rate of 5 °C/min according to a temperature-programmed desorption gas analysis method, a release amount A 250  of hydrogen per unit mass of the ceramic plate at 250°C is 5.0 × 10 -10  A/g or less in terms of a mass spectral intensity based on an ion current value.

title_en: Hybrid panel with a glass substrate
abstract_en: Embodiments disclosed herein include an apparatus that includes a substrate that comprises a glass layer. In an embodiment, a frame is provided around the substrate, and a gap is provided between an edge of the substrate and an interior edge of the frame. In an embodiment, a fill layer is provided in the gap, and the fill layer comprises a dielectric material. In an embodiment, a ring is provided over the fill layer around a perimeter of the substrate. In an embodiment, the ring comprises a metallic material.

title_en: Image sensor for correcting chromatic aberration, camera, and electronic device
abstract_en: Provided are an image sensor for correcting chromatic aberration, a camera, and an electronic device. The image sensor comprises: a color filter layer that includes a plurality of color filters including at least one color channel and disposed on one plane of the image sensor; a microlens layer including a plurality of microlenses disposed on the upper end of the color filters; and a photosensitive element layer including a plurality of photosensitive elements corresponding to the plurality of color filters. The plurality of microlenses may be set to different heights to match the focal lengths of the color channels of light corresponding to the color filters on the basis of data on chromatic aberration according to the color channels of the light. Various other embodiments are possible.

title_en: Integrated circuit interposer including heat exchange fluid chamber and related methods
abstract_en: An interposer  20  for an integrated circuit (IC) device may include an interposer bottom  21  and an interposer top  22  coupled thereto and defining a heat exchange fluid chamber  23  therebetween. The interposer  20  may also include interposer dielectric pillars  24a, 24b  extending within the heat exchange fluid chamber  23  between the interposer bottom  21  and the interposer top  22,  and a heat exchange fluid  25  within the heat exchange fluid chamber. The interposer  20  may also include a wick structure  26  within the heat exchange fluid chamber  23  for moving the heat exchange fluid  25  in a liquid phase into the heat exchange fluid chamber, and electrically conductive through-vias  27  extending within respective ones of the interposer dielectric pillars  24a, 24b  and being exposed on outer surfaces of the interposer bottom  21  and the interposer top  22.

title_en: Electronic device and method for manufacturing electronic device
abstract_en: An electronic device includes a substrate having a recessed portion on a first surface; a first superconducting wiring having a portion in contact with the first surface; a second superconducting wiring intersecting the first superconducting wiring in a plan view above the recessed portion and having a portion in contact with the first surface; an insulating film provided between the first superconducting wiring and the second superconducting wiring; and a first support member provided in the recessed portion and supporting at least one of the first superconducting wiring or the second superconducting wiring, wherein a hollow portion is formed between a region where the first superconducting wiring and the second superconducting wiring intersect in a plan view and a bottom surface of the recessed portion.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A thin film transistor substrate includes a first thin film transistor disposed having a polycrystalline semiconductor layer, a first gate electrode on the polycrystalline semiconductor layer, a first source electrode and a first drain electrode; a first gate insulating layer between the polycrystalline semiconductor layer and the first gate electrode; a second thin film transistor disposed having an oxide semiconductor layer on the first gate electrode, a second gate electrode on the oxide semiconductor layer, a second source electrode and a second drain electrode; an intermediate insulating layer disposed on the first gate electrode and under the oxide semiconductor layer; and a second gate insulating layer on the intermediate insulating layer and under the first source electrode, the first drain electrode and the second gate electrode.

title_en: Circuit structure and method with a resistor for reducing voltage at control node for device
abstract_en: Embodiments of the disclosure provide a circuit structure and method with a resistor for reducing a discharged pad voltage. A structure of the disclosure includes a resistor having a first end connected to a pad and a second end opposite the first end. A trigger circuit is connected between the pad and ground. A discharge circuit is connected between the second end of the resistor and ground. The discharge circuit is connected to an output node of the trigger circuit.

title_en: Quantum device
abstract_en: A quantum device includes one or more qubits. Each of the one or more qubits includes a first conductor, a second conductor, and a Josephson junction element connected between the first conductor and the second conductor, and a capacitance of each of the one or more qubits with respect to ground potential is 10 fF or more and 30 fF or less. The quantum device can be used in, for example, quantum computing.

title_en: Photovoltaic cell and photovoltaic module
abstract_en: A photovoltaic cell includes a silicon substrate (10), a doped region (20) and a first electrode (30). The silicon substrate (10) has a first surface (11) and a second surface (12) opposite to each other. The first surface (11) defines a first region (13) and a second region (14), the doped region (20) is located in the first surface (11) in the first region (13). The first electrode (30) is electrically connected to the doped region (20); and the silicon substrate (10) is provided with a groove (15) in the second region (14). In a thickness direction of the silicon substrate (10), a depth of the groove (15) is in a range of 1.5µm to 3µm.

title_en: Multilayer ferroelectric switching
abstract_en: A device includes a substrate, first and second electrodes supported by the substrate, and a heterostructure supported by the substrate. The heterostructure includes first and second dielectric layers and a ferroelectric III-nitride alloy layer disposed between the first and second dielectric layers, the ferroelectric III-nitride alloy layer including a Group IIIB element. The ferroelectric III-nitride alloy layer is electrically spaced from the first and second electrodes by the first and second dielectric layers, respectively.

title_en: Power module and power conversion device
abstract_en: This application provides a power module and a power conversion device, and relates to the field of electronic technologies. The power module includes a power component, an insulating substrate, a composite substrate, and a heat sink. In a thickness direction of the insulating substrate, the power component, the insulating substrate, the composite substrate, and the heat sink are sequentially disposed. The heat sink includes an accommodation cavity and a mounting hole, and at least a part of the composite substrate is accommodated in the mounting hole and seals the accommodation cavity. The composite substrate includes a first connecting piece and a second connecting piece that are connected. In the thickness direction of the insulating substrate, the first connecting piece is connected to the insulating substrate, a side wall of the second connecting piece is connected to a hole wall of the mounting hole, and a material of the second connecting piece is the same as a material of the heat sink. In a direction perpendicular to the thickness direction of the insulating substrate, a maximum size of the second connecting piece is greater than or equal to a maximum size of the first connecting piece. The power module in this application has higher heat dissipation efficiency, structural stability and performance of the power conversion device are better, assembly is convenient, and costs are low.

title_en: Substrate processing device
abstract_en: A substrate processing apparatus (1) includes a substrate holder that holds a substrate (9) having a peripheral edge portion (93) on which a metal film (96) is provided on the side of a first main surface (91), an electrode unit (5) that includes a first electrode (51) and a second electrode (52) and in which, when etching is performed, the first electrode is located in the vicinity of the peripheral edge portion on the side of the first main surface, and the second electrode is separated from the first electrode and located in the vicinity of the substrate, a processing-liquid filling unit (6) that fills gaps between the substrate and each of the first and second electrodes with a processing liquid (L1), a power source (50) that applies a voltage between the electrodes to allow etching of a portion of the metal film that is located in the vicinity of the first electrode, and a rotation mechanism that rotates the substrate relative to the electrode unit. The first electrode has a side face including an interest region (516) that has repellency to the processing liquid, the interest region facing radially inward and located in the vicinity of the first main surface.

title_en: Near infrared detector
abstract_en: Near infrared photodetector converting optical radiation into electrical signal, operating at room temperature and utilizing photodiode composed of inorganic semiconductor silicon layer and organic layer, as well as metallic aluminum electrodes, which form electrical contacts between the heterojunction and the external electrical circuit and having a layered structure, where the inorganic and organic layers constitute a hybrid heterojunction, which contains an organic semiconductor material belonging to the functionalized indigoid group, with the LUMO energy level below -4 eV. The heterojunction is made of a layer of 6,6- dinitroindigo deposited onto a silicon substrate. It also beneficial to use indigoids with the substituent groups in the aromatic rings belonging to the nitro or cyanide groups.

title_en: Electroluminescent display device
abstract_en: An electroluminescent display device includes a display part DP, an encapsulation unit FSPM disposed over the display part DP and a heat dissipation sheet 160 disposed over the encapsulation unit. The encapsulation unit includes a sealing member comprising first and second adhesive layers 131, 133 with a barrier layer 132 between them, and may also include a reinforcing substrate 140. The adhesives may be polymer adhesive materials and at least the first adhesive layer 131 may comprise a polymer adhesive with metallic particles, for example a nickel powder, functioning both to enhance thermal conduction of heat generated from TFTs and light emitting structures of the substrate 101 and to reduce electromagnetic interference. The barrier layer 32 may comprise a metallic material. The second adhesive layer includes a hole H which may also extend through the reinforcing substrate 140, the barrier layer 132 and first adhesive layer 131. A side surface of the barrier layer 132 may be electrically and thermally connected to the heat dissipation sheet 160 through a conducting paste 172 injected into the hole H and a conductive film 171. The first adhesive layer 131 may further include a hygroscopic inorganic filler.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device comprising a wiring substrate 205 on which a plurality of link wire lines LL are disposed; a plurality of display units TU1, TU2, TU3 including a plurality of light-emitting elements ED and a plurality of signal lines, respectively, wherein the plurality of display units are disposed on the wiring substrate and are spaced apart from each other; a plurality of bonding members BC1, BC2, BC3 disposed between the wiring substrate and the plurality of display units, respectively so as to electrically connect the plurality of link wire lines and the plurality of signal lines to each other, respectively; and a refractive index matching layer IF filling a boundary area between adjacent ones of the plurality of display units, preventing or reducing the recognition of the seam area S by the user. Also, a display device comprising a plurality of sub-pixels with micro-LEDs including inorganic material; and a plurality of transmissive areas adjacent the sub-pixels. Also, a display device comprising first and second display units, each comprising TFTs; a passivation layer disposed on the TFTs; and protective patterns disposed on micro-LED chips.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display has a display area capable surrounded by a bezel, a plurality of subpixels included in the display area, and a plurality of data lines for supplying data signals for image display to the plurality of subpixels. The display area may include a first low density pixel area region OA, for eg an image sensor, capable of transmitting light and a second area NA located outside the first area. The second area may include an upper area above the first area and a lower area under the first area. The data lines for the pixels in the display area include an upper data line DL(G)_U disposed in the upper area, a lower data line DL(G)_D disposed in the lower area, and a bypass line BW1,BW2,BW3 configured to electrically connect the upper data line and the lower data line and bypass the first area.

title_en: Thin film transistor array substrate including oxide semiconductor pattern and display device including the same
abstract_en: A display panel comprising: a substrate comprising an active area AA and a non-active area NA; a driving thin film transistor DT comprising: a first oxide semiconductor pattern 474; a first gate electrode 478; a first source electrode 479S and a first drain electrode 479D; and a first light shielding pattern BSM1, and a switching thin film transistor ST-1 comprising: a second oxide semiconductor pattern 432; a second gate electrode 433; a second source electrode 434S and a second drain electrode 434D; and a second light shielding pattern BSM-2, wherein each light shielding pattern BSM-1,BSM-2 comprises a respective metal pattern BSM-1a,BSM-2a and a respective P-type doped semiconductor material layer BSM-1b,BSM-2b, wherein a thickness of a first insulating layer 445b,c between the first oxide semiconductor pattern 474 and the first light shielding pattern BSM-1 is less than a thickness of an insulating layer 443,444,445a,b,c between the second oxide semiconductor pattern 432 and the second light shielding pattern BSM-2.

title_en: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: To improve the characteristics of a semiconductor device that has a light receiving portion.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device SD1 includes a first semiconductor layer SL1, a second semiconductor layer SL2, a plug, a first wiring WR11, and a second wiring WR12. The first semiconductor layer SL1 includes a first conductive type impurity region. The second semiconductor layer SL2 is formed on the first semiconductor layer SL1 and includes a second conductive type impurity region different from the first conductive type. The plug is electrically connected to the first semiconductor layer SL1. The first wiring WR11 is electrically connected to the first semiconductor layer SL1 via the plug. The second wiring WR12 is electrically connected to the second semiconductor layer SL2 without the plug. The first wiring WR11 and the second wiring WR12 are formed in the same layer as each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Light-emitting device
abstract_en: To provide a display device in which deterioration of display quality is reduced even when the size is reduced by reducing visible light emitted by an infrared light emitting element from leaking light of adjacent pixels.SOLUTION: A light-emitting device according to the present disclosure includes a display element and an infrared light emitting element on an insulating layer, and includes reducing means that reduces light emitted from an infrared light emitting unit in the direction of the display element in a plan view from a direction perpendicular to the insulating layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: To provide an electronic device with improved reliability by suppressing the outflow of a bonding material that bonds electronic elements to a mounting area.SOLUTION: An electronic device A1 includes an electronic element 1 having a main surface 1a and a back surface 1b that are separated from each other in a z-direction, a mounting unit 311 that faces the back surface 1b and on which the electronic element 1 is mounted, and a bonding material 4 that is interposed between the electronic element 1 and the mounting unit 311. The mounting unit 311 includes a recess 314 that has a main surface 311a facing the same direction as the main surface 1a and is depressed in the z-direction from the main surface 311a. The recess 314 overlaps the electronic element 1 when viewed in the z-direction. The bonding material 4 overlaps the recess 314 in an x-direction and is not in contact with the main surface 311a.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Resin composition
abstract_en: To provide a resin composition capable of giving an insulating layer excellent in thermal conductivity and peel strength to a metal layer, and to provide a resin sheet, a circuit board, and a semiconductor chip package using the resin composition.SOLUTION: The resin composition contains: (A) a polymer compound having one or more structures selected from a polybutadiene structure, a polysiloxane structure, a poly(meth)acrylate structure, a polyalkylene structure, a polyalkyleneoxy structure, a polyisoprene structure, a polyisobutylene structure, and a polycarbonate structure in the molecule; (B) an epoxy resin; (C) a thermally conductive filler; and (D) an active ester curing agent.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Optical filter and device using the same
abstract_en: To provide an optical filter capable of achieving both the color shading suppression and ghost suppression of a camera image, which have not been sufficiently achieved by the conventional optical filter, at a high level.SOLUTION: An optical filter includes a base material satisfying the requirements (a), (b), (c) and (g) and satisfies specific requirements: (a) a layer including a compound (A) having the absorption maximum in a region having a wavelength of 650 nm or more and 760 nm or less is included; (b) the absolute value |X1-X2| of a difference between the shortest wavelength (X1) having a transmittance of 10% or less from more than 10% in a region having a wavelength of 650 nm or more and the shortest wavelength (X2) having a transmittance of 10% or more from less than 10% in a region having a wavelength of 650 nm or more is 50 nm or more; (c) each transmittance at wavelengths of 900 nm, 1000 nm and 1100 nm is 65% or less; and (g) a compound (S) having the absorption maximum in a region having a wavelength of 1050 nm or more and 1200 nm or less is included.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Liquid membrane maintaining device and sensor device
abstract_en: To provide a liquid membrane maintaining device and a sensor device that allow high-accuracy detection.SOLUTION: A liquid membrane maintaining device 7 and a sensor device 1 comprise: a liquid supply unit 11 that supplies liquid onto sensor elements 3a, 3b, 3c to form a liquid membrane 9; and a liquid discharge unit 13 that discharges the liquid in the liquid membrane. The sensor elements each include a sensitive membrane, and the liquid supply unit forms the liquid membrane on each of the sensitive membranes of the sensor elements. The liquid supply unit includes a first container that stores the liquid and a thin tube that is in contact with the liquid stored in the first container at one end and arranged on the sensor elements at the other end, and supplies the liquid onto the sensor elements by using a capillary phenomenon caused by the thin tube. The liquid discharge unit includes a space for recovering the liquid discharged from the liquid membrane and a first member 29 that is arranged in the space at one end and arranged on the sensor elements at the other end, and discharges the liquid in the liquid membrane with the first member.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Point source type light-emitting diode and manufacturing method of the same
abstract_en: To provide a point source type light-emitting diode capable of reducing a light emission from a part other than a light discharge window in a light-emitting pattern while simplifying a manufacturing step, and provide a manufacturing method of the same.SOLUTION: A point source type light-emitting diode 100 comprises: a substrate 10; an n-type clad layer 31; a light emission layer 35; a p-type clad layer 37; an n-type current constriction layer 42 having an open part 42A; a p-type contact layer 60 provided onto the n-type current constriction layer; and a p-type electrode 91 having an optical discharge window 92 having the same center as the open part has. A window open width of the optical discharge window has the size of an open width of the open part or larger, and the point source type light-emitting diode further includes: a hydrogen ion injection part 80 over the light emission layer from the p-type contact layer in a thickness direction. The light emission layer includes: a non-injection region 34 having a region width larger than the open width of the optical discharge window with the same center as the optical discharge window; and a hydrogen ion injection region 33 surrounding the non-injection region.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Substrate pedestal module including backside gas delivery tube and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor substrate processing apparatus suitable for high-temperature processing of a semiconductor substrate that is heated to temperatures greater than or equal to about 550°C.SOLUTION: A semiconductor substrate processing apparatus includes: a vacuum chamber; a process gas source in fluid communication with the vacuum chamber; a showerhead module through which process gas supplied from the process gas source to the vacuum chamber passes; and a substrate pedestal module. The substrate pedestal module 320 includes: a platen 205 which is made of ceramic material and has an upper surface 206 that supports a semiconductor substrate thereon during processing; a stem 210 which is made of ceramic material and includes an upper stem flange 215 that supports the platen; and a backside gas tube 250 which is made of ceramic material and located in an interior of the stem. The backside gas tube includes an upper gas tube flange 253 located between a lower surface of the platen and an upper surface of the upper stem flange. The backside gas tube is in fluid communication with at least one backside gas passage 207 of the platen, and configured to supply backside gas to a region below a substrate that is to be supported on the platen during processing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device in which the temperature increase can be suppressed by devising the layout of a channel formation region.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device includes a substrate that is set to have an active region 9 where a function element is formed, a first function element formation region 15 that is formed at a center of the active region, and a peripheral function element formation region that is formed around the first function element formation region in the active region. The first function element formation region has higher on resistance than the peripheral function element formation region. The peripheral function element formation region includes a second function element formation region 16, and a third function element formation region 17 having higher on resistance than the second function element formation region.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 17

title_en: Semiconductor device and semiconductor device manufacturing method
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device for performing high-performance active operation and a semiconductor device manufacturing method that can easily manufacture the semiconductor device.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device (electromagnetic wave detection device) includes a substrate 11, an active element (rectifying element 12) which is formed on the substrate, has a semiconductor layer and a first element end and a second element end, and performs an active operation between the first element end and the second element end, a first electrode (cathode electrode 13) which is formed on the substrate and connected to the first element end of the active element, a second electrode (anode electrode 14) formed on the substrate away from the active element, a support rod 18 which is formed on a region between the active element and the second electrode on the substrate, and made of the same semiconductor material as the semiconductor layer of the active element, and a wiring portion 17 which is supported by the support rod and is bridged and wired between the second element end of the active element and the second electrode while passing through the support rod.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Thermosetting sheet and dicing die bonding film
abstract_en: To provide a thermosetting sheet and a dicing die bonding film which have relatively high heat radiation property after curing.SOLUTION: In a dicing die bonding film 20, a thermosetting sheet 3 includes: thermosetting resin; a volatile component; and conductive particles. In the dicing die bonding film, weight reduction ratio W1 obtained when the thermosetting sheet, under a nitrogen gas flow of 200 mL/min, is heated up from room temperature to 100°C at temperature rising rate of 10°C/min and then maintained at 100°C for 30 minutes is 0.5 mass% or less, and weight reduction ratio W2 obtained when the thermosetting sheet, under the nitrogen gas flow of 200 mL/min, is heated up from 100°C to 200°C at the temperature rising rate of 10°C/min and then maintained at 200°C for 30 minutes is 2 mass% or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Magnetic sensor
abstract_en: To provide a magnetic sensor capable of suppressing change of output due to a stress exerted from the outside.SOLUTION: A magnetic sensor includes a magnetic sensor chip containing a magnetoresistance effect element and a sealing section which seals the magnetic sensor chip integrally. The magnetoresistance effect element includes a free layer having a magnetization direction changeable according to an external magnetic field, and a pinned layer having a fixed magnetization direction. The sealing section includes a first surface and a second surface facing the first surface. The shape of the sealing section in a plan view from the first surface side is almost quadrangle. The quadrangle shape includes a first side and a second side in parallel to each other, and a third side and a fourth side crossing the first side and the second side and in parallel to each other. The magnetization direction of the pinned layer in a plan view from the first surface of the sealing section in a condition where the external magnetic field is not exerted to the magnetoresistance effect element is inclined to an approximation line obtained by a least square method using a plurality of points arbitrarily set on the first side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a technique that, when a resin case housing a semiconductor element is fixed to a heat dissipation component with a bolt, can relieve the stress generated around an attachment hole of the resin case.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device 100 includes a base plate 1, a heat dissipation component 13 disposed on a lower surface of the base plate 1, and a resin case 2 disposed on an upper surface of the base plate 1 and having a rectangular shape in a plan view in which a semiconductor element is housed. The resin case 2 is attached to the heat dissipation component 13 with a bolt 10 in a state where the resin case 2 is disposed on the heat dissipation component 13 through the base plate 1. The resin case 2 includes a concave part 3 that is formed at a corner part and houses a head part of the bolt 10, an attachment hole 4 that is formed below the concave part 3 and has a shaft part of the bolt 10 inserted therethrough, and at least one groove part 6 formed between the attachment hole 4 and a wall part 5 on an inner peripheral side that forms the concave part 3. One end of the groove part 6 reaches an outer peripheral end of the resin case 2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Power module, power conversion device, and method for manufacturing power module
abstract_en: To solve the problem that a member such as a seal member requires high dimensional accuracy.SOLUTION: A resin material 336 is arranged in a first region 421 surrounded by a fin base 440 and an inclination part 343 of a cover member 340, and an outermost periphery heat radiation fin 334 arranged on the outermost peripheral side. The resin material 336 is made to project from the first region 421. Specifically, the resin material 336 is arranged in the first region 421. In a cross section vertical to a coolant flow direction (Y direction), a cross-sectional area of the first region 421 is larger than an average cross-sectional area 423 between adjacent heat radiation fins 331. A cross-sectional area of a second region 422 formed between the resin material 336 arranged in the first region 421 and the outermost periphery heat radiation fin 334 arranged on the outermost peripheral side is smaller than the average cross-sectional area 423 between the heat radiation fins.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Compound
abstract_en: To provide an organic metal complex which has good light emission efficiency and good heat resistance, and exhibits light emission of a short wavelength.SOLUTION: An organic metal complex has central metal and first to fourth ligands coordinated to the central metal. The first ligand has a triazole skeleton, the triazole skeleton has nitrogen bonded to the central metal, the second ligand has an indolo[3,2-b]carbazole skeleton bonded to the 6-position of the central metal or a pyrido[2,3-b:6,5-b']diindole skeleton bonded to the 6-position of the central metal, the third ligand has a benzene skeleton in which the central metal and the carbon are bonded to each other, and the fourth ligand has a pyridine skeleton in which the central metal and the nitrogen are bonded to each other or a benzene skeleton in which the central metal and the carbon are bonded to each other.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Multifunctional room-temperature superconducting device
abstract_en: To make it possible to construct a multifunctional room-temperature superconducting device that is energy-saving, high-powered, compact, and has a conscious function if room-temperature superconductivity with quantum specific charge flow generation and quantum specific charge flow amplification functions, which are similar to those of biological systems in general physical systems is made possible while superconducting materials that can be superconducted at room temperature have not yet been discovered either in nature or in technology and are earnestly wanted, and thus making it possible to apply the multifunctional room-temperature superconducting device to quantum specific load current conversion, low-voltage power transmission and centralized decentralization, energy-saving and high-power generators, motors, electric motors and transporters, cyborg devices with a conscious function, various AI devices, electronic devices, and medical devices that are conventionally not available.SOLUTION: A technical field used in the present invention is the multifunctional room-temperature superconducting device aimed at applying the quantum ratio theory essential to satisfy the biological logic that has not been mentioned in the conventional science, i.e., the biological logic function, the quantum charge, quantum specific charge, quantum specific charge flow and quantum specific charge flow amplification functions, the quantum specific charge flow wave equation, the third law function of thermodynamics, the anti-resistance function, the quantum specific physical law, the quantum specific scientific equation and the consciousness function to general physical systems.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Cooling structure and heat sink
abstract_en: To efficiently and uniformly cool the whole fin structure with simple processing while reducing pressure loss and reducing the size in a cooling structure of a heat sink to which a plurality of heating elements are attached.SOLUTION: A heat sink 1 includes a cooling main body 10 to which a plurality of elements 2 are mounted in parallel. The cooling main body 10 is formed with an inflow passage 11 for a refrigerant, a flow passage 12 for the refrigerant provided from the inflow passage 11, and an outflow passage 13 for the refrigerant provided from the flow passage 12. The flow passage 12 is formed corresponding to an attachment portion of the element 2. A plurality of fin portions 14 are densely erected on one surface of the flow passage 12.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device capable of reducing leakage current of a capacitor and a method for manufacturing the same.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device of the present invention includes a capacitor including a lower electrode, an upper electrode, and a dielectric film between the lower electrode and the upper electrode. The lower electrode includes ABO3, in which A is a first metal element and B is a second metal element having a work function greater than that of the first metal element. The dielectric film contains CDO3, in which C is a third metal element and D is a fourth metal element. The lower electrode has alternating first and second layers, in which the first layer contains the first metal element and oxygen, and the second layer contains the second metal element and oxygen. A first contact surface of the lower electrode in contact with the dielectric film is the second layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Electrical equipment
abstract_en: To provide electrical equipment capable of enhancing heat discharge efficiency of a heating component.SOLUTION: Electrical equipment 1 comprises: a heating component 6; a substrate 4; a heat discharge part 2; and a heat transfer part 8. The substrate 4 includes: a first surface 41; and a second surface 42 opposite to the first surface 41. In the first surface 41, the heating component 6 is arranged. The heat discharge part 2 receives a heat of the heating component 6 from the second surface 42 via the substrate 4. The heat discharge part 2 discharges a heat. The heat transfer part 8 receives a heat from an object part. The heat transfer part 8 gives a heat to the heat discharge part 2. The object part is formed by at least one of the heating component 6 and a conductor 5 formed on the first surface 41 of the substrate 4. A heat capacity of the heat discharge part 2 is larger than that of the heat transfer part 8.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Signal processing circuit and solid state imaging device
abstract_en: To provide a signal processing circuit capable of expanding an output bit and a dynamic range in response to a detection signal amount by using a limited number of counters, and provide a solid state imaging device.SOLUTION: In a signal processing circuit, which is a signal reading circuit of a solid state imaging device comprising a photoelectric conversion unit in which a light reception sensitivity is changed by an application voltage, and comprises: a pulse generation circuit generating a pulse in accordance with a charge amount to be photoelectric-converted; and a counter circuit counting the pulse, the application voltage of the photoelectric conversion unit is controlled in each detection period of the charge amount, and an output bit signal of the counter circuit of each detection period having a different application voltage to obtain an output in which the bit number is expanded more than the bit number of the counter circuit. The application voltage of a first detection period and a second detection period is set so that the charge amount to be photoelectric-converted in response to the same light amount becomes a ratio of a power of two.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Power supply for electrostatic chuck device, electrostatic chuck device, and dechuck control method
abstract_en: To provide a power supply for an electrostatic chuck device, an electrostatic chuck device, and a dechuck control method capable of shortening a time until an object to be held is separated from a holding unit at the time of dechucking.SOLUTION: An electrostatic chuck device 1 includes a voltage application unit 3 that applies a dechuck voltage used for dechucking an object K to a first electrode 5 and a second electrode 6, and the dechuck voltage is constituted by a first AC voltage Va1 applied to the first electrode 5 by a first waveform W1, and a second AC voltage Va2 applied to the second electrode 6 by a second waveform W2 having a phase different from the first waveform W1, and an information output unit is provided that outputs information on timing at which the first waveform W1 and the second waveform W2 intersect, and the voltage application unit 3 stops the application of the dechuck voltage to the first electrode 5 and the second electrode 6 on the basis of the information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Bulk acoustic resonator and filter including the same
abstract_en: To provide a bulk acoustic resonator capable of improving an electromechanical coupling coefficient of a piezoelectric body and preventing abnormal growth of aluminum nitride to which a doping substance contained in a piezoelectric layer constituting a piezoelectric body is added.SOLUTION: The bulk acoustic resonator includes: a substrate; a first electrode disposed above the substrate; a piezoelectric body disposed on the first electrode and including a plurality of piezoelectric layers including aluminum nitride to which a doping substance is added; and a second electrode disposed on the piezoelectric body and opposed to the first electrode with the piezoelectric body interposed therebetween. At least one of the piezoelectric layers relates to a bulk acoustic resonator which is a compression layer formed under compressive stress.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device whose switching loss is reduced.SOLUTION: There is provided a semiconductor device comprising: an emitter region of a first conductivity type that is provided on a front surface of a semiconductor substrate; a first gate trench part and a second gate trench part that are in contact with the emitter region; a first emitter non-contact trench part and a second emitter non-contact trench part that are not in contact with the emitter region; a gate pad for setting the first gate trench part, the second gate trench part, the first emitter non-contact trench part, and the second emitter non-contact trench part to gate potential; and a diode having an anode connected to the gate pad and a cathode connected to the first emitter non-contact trench part and the second emitter non-contact trench part. The first gate trench part, the first emitter non-contact trench part, the second gate trench part, and the second emitter non-contact trench part are aligned adjacently in order.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1B

title_en: Electroluminescent material and element
abstract_en: To provide a series of compounds that can be used as a host material in an organic electroluminescent element, and in which an azamacro ring condensed by indole and pyrrole, and triazine and its similar structure are bonded at a specific position.SOLUTION: Disclosed is an electroluminescent material and an element. In the compounds, an azamacro ring condensed by indole and pyrrole, and triazine and its similar structure are bonded at a specific position, and the compounds can be used as a host material in an electroluminescent element. The novel compounds have significantly reduced vapor deposition temperature and better thermal stability, can effectively reduce energy consumption, are more advantageous for a manufacturing process of the element, effectively improve efficiency of the element, reduce driving voltage of the element, and can provide better performance of the element. title_en: Polarizing plate, liquid crystal display device, and organic electroluminescent display device
abstract_en:

title_en: Wafer, wafer manufacturing method, and device chip manufacturing method
abstract_en: To quickly determine processing conditions for a wafer.SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a wafer from an ingot includes a resistivity measurement step for measuring the resistivity of the ingot at an end face, a peeling layer formation step for forming a peeling layer inside the ingot by irradiating a first laser beam to the ingot by positioning the focal point of the first laser beam of a wavelength that is transmissive to the ingot from the end face at a depth corresponding to the thickness of the wafer to be produced, information printing step for forming letters, numbers, or marks on the end face or inside of the ingot indicating information on the resistivity measured in the resistivity measurement step by irradiating a second laser beam to the ingot by positioning the focal point of the second laser beam in an area of the wafer where no device is to be formed, and a wafer generation step for generating a wafer by splitting the ingot with the peeling layer as a starting point and peeling off the generated wafer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Substrate processing device
abstract_en: To provide a technique of processing a substrate more uniformly with a more simple structure.SOLUTION: A substrate processing device 1 includes a substrate holding unit 2, a processing solution nozzle 4, and a head moving mechanism 30. The substrate holding unit 2, while holding a substrate W, rotates the substrate W around a rotation axial line Q1. The processing solution nozzle 4 discharges a processing solution to a main surface of the substrate W. A plasma generation unit 5 is provided adjacent to the processing solution nozzle 4 in a plan view and is integrally connected to the processing solution nozzle 4. The plasma generation unit 5 includes a unit body 6 forming a gas channel 60, and an electrode group 7 including a plurality of electrodes, and supplies gas having passed an electric field space for plasma formed by the electrode group 7 to the main surface of the substrate W. The head moving mechanism 30 reciprocates the processing solution nozzle 4 and the plasma generation unit 5 integrally in a moving direction D1.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

abstract_en: To provide a technique for improving the sealing performance of an organic EL panel having a through hole in a display area against moisture in the through hole.SOLUTION: A manufacturing method of an organic EL panel having a through hole in a display area includes a step a) of preparing a substrate on which a circuit layer is formed, a step b) of forming a bank with an inclined side surface by a first organic film in a through hole forming region where the through hole is formed, a step c) of depositing a first inorganic film over the entire surface of the substrate, a step d) of removing the first inorganic film covering the top of the bank to expose the first organic film, and a step e) of removing the first organic film and forming an inclined stilt portion by the first inorganic film.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 34

title_en: Substrate processing device and substrate processing method
abstract_en: To provide a technology that is useful for reducing foreign objects in a process liquid discharged to a substrate.SOLUTION: A substrate processing device includes: a discharge part 30 having a nozzle for discharging a process liquid to a substrate; a liquid sending part 60 which sends the process liquid to the discharge part; and a liquid source 51 serving as a supply source which supplies the process liquid to be sent to the discharge part 30 to the liquid sending part 60.
