title_en: Trench MOS type Schottky diode
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a trench MOS type Schottky diode with high breakdown voltage and low loss. 
     SOLUTION: A trench MOS type Schottky diode 1 includes: a first semiconductor layer 10 made of a Ga 2 O 3 -based single crystal; a second semiconductor layer 11 having a trench 12 opening to a surface 17 and made of the Ga 2 O 3 -based single crystal; an anode electrode 13 formed on the surface 17; a cathode electrode 14 formed on a surface of the first semiconductor layer 10; an insulating film 15 covering an inner surface of the trench 12 of the second semiconductor layer 11; and a trench MOS gate 16 embedded in the trench 12 of the second semiconductor layer 11 so as to be covered with the insulating film 15 and being in contact with the anode electrode 13. The second semiconductor layer 11 is composed of a lower layer 11b on a side of the first semiconductor layer and an upper layer 11a on a side of the anode electrode 13 having a higher donor concentration than that of the lower layer 11b, and reverse voltage when a leakage current of 1 μA flows is 600 V or more and 1200 V or less.

title_en: Processing device
abstract_en:

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device capable of having improved reliability.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device in one embodiment includes an element region and a terminal region. The element region includes a first semiconductor region and a second semiconductor region. The first semiconductor region is provided on a first electrode and has a first conductivity type. The second semiconductor region is provided on the first semiconductor region and is electrically connected to a second electrode. The terminal region includes a third semiconductor region, a first diffusion layer, and a second diffusion layer. The third semiconductor region is provided outside the first semiconductor region and has a first conductivity type. The first diffusion layer is provided on a surface of the third semiconductor region, surrounds the element region, and has a second conductivity type. The second diffusion layer is provided on the surface of the third semiconductor region, surrounds the element region, exists outside the first diffusion layer, is deeper than the first diffusion layer, and has the second conductivity type.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a method for manufacturing a semiconductor device capable of lowering a junction temperature and preventing occurrence of an interface failure.SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a semiconductor device in which a semiconductor die and a substrate electrode are joined by a sintered layer comprises a formic acid aqueous solution supply step, a thermal decomposition step, and a sintering step. The formic acid aqueous solution supply step supplies a formic acid aqueous solution to a laminate in which the substrate electrode, a dry sinter layer containing metal particles, and a semiconductor die are laminated in this order and eluting a part of the metal particles into the formic acid aqueous solution. The thermal decomposition step vaporizes and decompresses the formic acid aqueous solution and deposits metal microparticles derived from a metal composition eluted to the formic acid aqueous solution. The sintering step sinters a dry sinter layer containing the metal particles and the metal microparticles derived from the metal composition and joins the semiconductor die and the substrate electrode. Providing the method for manufacturing a semiconductor device allows for lowering a junction temperature and preventing occurrence of an interface failure.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Light-emitting device, lamp, and street light
abstract_en: To provide a light-emitting device, a lamp, and a street light capable of reducing glare.SOLUTION: A light-emitting device includes a light-emitting element having an emission peak wavelength in the range of 400 nm or more and 490 nm or less, and a first phosphor having an emission peak wavelength in the range of 570 nm or more and 680 nm or less, the light-emitting device has a correlated color temperature of 1950K or less, a general color rendering index Ra of 51 or more, and a full width at half maximum of the emission peak with the maximum emission intensity in the emission spectrum of the light emitting device of 110 nm or less, and when the luminance of the light emission of the light-emitting device in the range of 380 nm or more and 780 nm or less in consideration of the human photopic standard ratio luminosity defined by CIE is L, and the first effective radiance of light emitted from the light-emitting device with a wavelength of 380 nm or more and 780 nm or less in consideration of the human photopic standard ratio luminosity and the sensitivity of the human S cone is Ls1, light is emitted in which a first glare index Ls1/L of the first effective radiance Ls1 with respect to the luminance L is 0.493 or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Conductive particle sorting method, circuit connection material, connection structure and manufacturing method therefor, and conductive particle
abstract_en:

     SOLUTION: The present disclosure relates to a conductive particle sorting method. The sorting method comprises: a step for determining whether a metal that constitutes an outermost layer of a conductive particle satisfies the following first condition; and a step for determining whether the conductive particle satisfies the following second condition. A conductive particle that satisfies both the first condition and the second condition is determined to be good. First Condition: electrical conductivity at 20°C is 40×10 6  S/m or less. title_en: Creation method for correlation relationship expression for polishing condition determination, determination method for polishing condition, and manufacturing method for semiconductor wafer
abstract_en: To provide novel means that makes it possible to determine polishing conditions on a semiconductor wafer without making trial and error many times.SOLUTION: There is provided a creation method for correlation relationship expression for polishing condition determination that includes: polishing semiconductor wafers under a plurality of polishing conditions including a plurality of polishing parameters and acquiring, by actual measurement, in-plane polishing quantity distribution information on the semiconductor wafers polished under the plurality of polishing conditions; polishing semiconductor wafers under polishing conditions including a plurality of polishing parameters and acquiring, by actual measurement, polishing-time in-plane temperature distribution information on the semiconductor wafers polished under the plurality of polishing parameters, or generating polishing-time in-plane temperature distribution information on the semiconductor wafer polished under the polishing conditions including the plurality of polishing parameters through heat conduction analysis; creasing a correlation relation expression 1 between in-plane temperature distribution parameters and the plurality of polishing parameters of the semiconductor wafers on the basis of, the polishing time in-plane temperature distribution information; creating a correlation relationship expression 2 between the in-plane temperature distribution parameters and the plurality of polishing parameters of the semiconductor wafers on the basis of, the in-plane polishing quantity distribution information; and creating a correlation relationship expression 3 between the in-plane polishing quantity distribution parameters and the plurality of polishing parameters of semiconductor wafer on the basis of, the correlation relation expression 1 and the correlation relation expression 2, the correlation relation expression 3 being a correlation relationship expression used to determine polishing conditions of actual polishing of semiconductor wafers.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Method of manufacturing silicon carbide semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a method of manufacturing a silicon carbide semiconductor device, the method enabling a non-defective product rate to be improved.SOLUTION: A method of manufacturing a silicon carbide semiconductor device comprises: a first step of forming a semiconductor wafer configured by epitaxially growing an epitaxial layer on a starting substrate made of silicon carbide; a second step of forming a mark on the epitaxial layer; a third step of inspecting the epitaxial layer with a crystal defect inspection device thereby detecting crystal defects of the epitaxial layer; a fourth step of forming predetermined element structure on the semiconductor wafer; a fifth step of dicing the semiconductor wafer thereby individualizing the same into semiconductor chips; then a sixth step of selecting the semiconductor chip in which no crystal defect is detected at the third step, as a non-defective product candidate. At the second step, the mark is arranged in a region other than the inside of a scribe line provided on the semiconductor wafer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Light-emitting element, light-emitting device, electronic apparatus, and illumination device
abstract_en:

title_en: Solar cells for a solar cell array

title_en: Substrate processing system
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To perform excellent etching processing while suppressing a bowing shape. 
     SOLUTION: There is provided a substrate processing system including: an etching device that supplies gas containing carbon fluoride, generates plasma from the gas, and performs etching using plasma on a silicon-containing film on a substrate via a mask on the silicon-containing film; and a film deposition device that differs from the etching device and supplies gas containing carbon to deposit a carbon-containing film on the etched silicon-containing film. title_en: Liquid resin coating device
abstract_en: To provide a liquid resin coating device in which mist-like liquid resin does not roll up from an opening of a housing even when a lid body is opened in a case in which a wafer coated with a protective film is carried out from a spinner table.SOLUTION: A laser processing device includes a rotatable spinner table 32 holding a wafer W, a liquid resin supply nozzle 44 for supplying a liquid resin to an upper surface Wa of the wafer held on the spinner table, a motor 35 that rotates the spinner table, a housing 41 surrounding the spinner table and having exhaust means 42 at a lower part, and control means. title_en: Laminated solid-state imaging device and pixel reset method therefor
abstract_en: To provide a laminated solid-state imaging device that reduces switching noise and obtains a high-quality output by improving nonlinearity of illuminance characteristics, and a pixel reset method therefor.SOLUTION: A laminated solid-state imaging device includes reset potential adjustment means 7a. title_en: Spectrographic monitoring using neural network
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a processing method using an appropriate polishing rate to achieve a substrate layer which has been planarized to a desired flatness or thickness or from which a desired amount of material has been removed, in chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) of a substrate. 
     SOLUTION: A system 100 includes a controller 90 including a neural network 120 having a plurality of input nodes 122 to receive a plurality of component values, an output node 126 to output a characterizing value, and a plurality of hidden nodes 124 connecting the input nodes to the output node. title_en: SiC EPITAXIAL GROWTH DEVICE AND BY-PRODUCT REMOVAL METHOD FOR SiC EPITAXIAL GROWTH DEVICE
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an SiC epitaxial growth device capable of reducing exchange and cleaning frequencies of a valve by making a by-product with SiC epitaxial growth hard to be residual in the valve provided in the middle of a discharge path. 
     SOLUTION: An SiC epitaxial growth device according to an embodiment comprises: a chamber in which a substrate is mounted and which performs epitaxial growth of an SiC film by introducing a process gas containing silicon, carbon and chlorine onto the substrate; a pipe for discharging from the chamber a gas which is produced with the epitaxial growth on the substrate and contains a by-product containing silicon, hydrogen and chlorine; and a valve which is provided in the middle of the pipe and regulates an internal pressure of the chamber and a pressure in the pipe at an upstream side of the valve. The pipe includes the upstream-side pipe or a downstream-side pipe provided at a lower position than the valve in order to discharge the by-product, which is liquefied in the valve by pressure fluctuation in the upstream-side pipe and the downstream-side pipe of the valve, not with the valve but with gravity.

title_en: Group iii-v silicon and heterogeneous integration system used for silicon complementary-metal-oxide-semiconductor integrated circuit
abstract_en: To provide a group III-V silicon and a heterogeneous integration system used for a silicon complementary-metal-oxide-semiconductor integrated circuit.SOLUTION: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of a package including directly bonding a group III-V die to a complementary-metal-oxide-silicon-semiconductor (CMOS) die so as to form a die stack. title_en: Liquid crystal display device

title_en: Plasma etching processing device and upper electrode
abstract_en: To provide a plasma etching processing device in which global tilting can be suppressed, and an upper electrode.SOLUTION: A plasma etching processing device comprises: a plasma etching chamber; a substrate support portion supporting a substrate and an edge ring in the plasma etching chamber; and an upper electrode opposite to the substrate support portion. title_en: Cristal film, laminate structure, electronic device, electronic unit and manufacturing methods thereof
abstract_en: To provide a crystal film composed of an epitaxial film having good adhesion and crystallinity, a laminate structure including the crystal film, an electronic device, an electronic unit, and manufacturing methods by which they can be obtained in an industrially advantageous manner.SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a laminate structure comprises the steps of: forming at least an oxide film on a crystal substrate; subsequently laminating an epitaxial film containing a crystal oxide; and further laminating, on the epitaxial film, a second epitaxial film different from the first epitaxial film in composition directly or through another layer. title_en: Method for manufacturing connection structure, and method for transferring divided adhesive film
abstract_en: To provide a method for manufacturing a connection structure capable of improving productivity even if there exists unevenness on a substrate, and a method for transferring a divided adhesive film.SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a connection structure includes an arrangement step of arranging pieces of an adhesive film on a base material through an elastic resin layer, a transfer step of pushing the base material to a substrate, and transferring the pieces of the adhesive film arranged on the elastic resin layer onto the substrate, and a mounting step of mounting an electronic component on the pieces of the adhesive film transferred onto the substrate, wherein a size of the piece is 200 μm or less, and peeling force of the adhesive film to the elastic resin layer is smaller than peeling force of the adhesive film to the substrate. title_en: Temperature measuring method, semiconductor substrate, and semiconductor device
abstract_en: To highly accurately measure a temperature of a substrate to be processed in a non-contact manner.SOLUTION: A temperature measuring method of an embodiment includes the steps of: irradiating a reflection film formed on a first surface of a substrate with measurement light having a prescribed wavelength; receiving reflected light generated when measurement light is reflected by a reflection film by an optical member; and calculating a temperature of the substrate on the basis of a reflection rate based on the ratio between an intensity of measurement light and an intensity of reflection light.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Ultraviolet beam processing device

abstract_en: To provide a near-infrared absorbing composition high in permeability of near-infrared rays (1,000 nm-1,200 nm) in a specific range, excellent in cut performance of near-infrared rays in a specific range, and excellent in storage stability, viscosity property, and filterability, an optical filter using the same, an infrared camera provided with the optical filter, and an infrared sensor.SOLUTION: A near-infrared absorbing composition includes a compound (A) represented by the following formula, and a binder resin (B), where the compound (A) includes two kinds of compound (A1), and (A2).SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Composition for forming colored layers, optical film, and display device
abstract_en: To provide a composition for forming colored layers that is capable of forming the colored layers durable for extended use, without requiring a gas barrier layer.SOLUTION: A composition for forming colored layers contains a colorant (A), an active energy ray curable resin (B), a photopolymerization initiator (C), a solvent (D), and additives (E). The colorant (A) contains at least one selected from first, second, and third coloring materials. The first coloring material has a maximal-absorption wavelength in a range of 470-530 nm and an absorption-spectrum half-value width of 15-45 nm. The second coloring material has a maximal-absorption wavelength in a range of 560-620 nm and an absorption-spectrum half-value width of 15-55 nm. The third coloring material, in a wavelength range of 380-780 nm, has a lowest-transmittance wavelength in a range of 650-780 nm. The additives (E) include a compound A and a sulfur-based antioxidant, wherein the content of the compound A is 0.01-2 when the content of the sulfur-based antioxidant is taken as 1.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Semiconductor module, semiconductor device, and vehicle
abstract_en: To suppress discharge between a wiring member and a bonding wire in a semiconductor module.SOLUTION: A semiconductor module (1) includes: a semiconductor element (33) disposed on a first surface of a multilayer substrate (2); a plurality of wires (41a to 41h) electrically connecting a conductor plate (23) provided in a second region positioned in a first direction from a first region where the semiconductor element is disposed on the multilayer substrate and a second surface of the semiconductor element opposite to a first surface thereof facing the multilayer substrate; and a wiring member (53) facing the plurality of wires in a second direction, which is different from the first direction, and extending in a direction from the first surface to the second surface of the semiconductor element. As for a wire (41a), among the plurality of wires, in which a distance from a connection part with the semiconductor element when viewed in the second direction to the wiring member is the shortest, a position of an intermediate part between the connection part with the semiconductor element and a connection part with the conductor plate in the second direction is farther from the wiring member than a line segment connecting the two connection parts.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Transfer robot and robot system
abstract_en: To downsize an arm.SOLUTION: A transfer robot comprises a plurality of hands, a plurality of hand driving motors, and one arm. The plurality of hands can hold a transfer object and rotate respectively about one pivot. The plurality of hand driving motors are arranged side by side in such a manner that motor shafts to which the plurality of hands respectively are connected become concentric with respect to the pivot, and as a result, the plurality of hand driving motors directly drive the plurality of hands respectively. One arm incorporates the plurality of hand driving motors.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Light-emitting diode element
abstract_en: To provide a light-emitting diode element enabling the light emission output thereof to be improved..SOLUTION: A light-emitting diode element 1 comprises: a first element portion 50 that has a first semiconductor layer 51 of a first conductivity type, a second semiconductor layer 57 of a second conductivity type, and a first active layer 55; and a second element portion 60 that has a third semiconductor layer 61 of the first conductivity type, a fourth semiconductor layer 65 of the second conductivity type, and a second active layer 63. The first element portion 50 and the second element portion 60 are electrically connected with each other by a tunnel junction portion T. When the first conductivity type is an n-type and the second conductivity type is a p-type, the first element portion 50 has an electronic barrier layer 56 arranged between the first active layer 55 and the tunnel junction portion T. When the first conductivity type is the p-type and the second conductivity type is the n-type, the second element portion 60 has an electronic barrier layer 64 arranged between the second active layer 63 and the tunnel junction portion T. Each of the electronic barrier layers 56 and 64 includes AlGaAsSb or AlInAsSb.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Substrate fixing device and manufacturing method of the substrate fixing device
abstract_en: To improve controllability of a temperature distribution on an adsorption surface.SOLUTION: A substrate fixing device includes: a base plate; a ceramic plate; and a heat conduction member. The ceramic plate is adhered to the base plate via an adhesive agent layer, and adsorbs a substrate by an electrostatic force. The heat conduction member is arranged in an outer peripheral region overlapped with a center region overlapped with a center part of the ceramic plate in a plane view or an outer peripheral part of the ceramic plate in a plan view from at least one of an adhesive surface of the ceramic plate, an adhesive surface of the base plate, and an inner part of the adhesive agent layer, and a heat conduction ratio of the base plate and the ceramic plate to a lamination direction is higher than the heat conduction ratio of a flat surface direction vertical to the lamination direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Substrate treatment apparatus, method for manufacturing semiconductor device, and program
abstract_en: To provide a technology that can improve property of a film formed on a substrate while saving energy utilizing internal heat of a treatment vessel.SOLUTION: A substrate treatment apparatus includes: a treatment vessel for applying treatment to a substrate; a storage container at least partially coming into contact with an outside wall of the treatment vessel and storing a gas to be supplied into the treatment vessel; and a temperature control part for controlling internal temperature of the storage container.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Position adjusting apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a position adjusting apparatus that can accurately perform feedback control using a picked-up image.SOLUTION: A position adjusting apparatus 1 comprises: an arm servo circuit 433 (drive unit) for moving an object; a controller 41 for generating a first control signal for moving the object to a target position; a control signal generation unit 423 for generating a second control signal for moving the object to the target position on the basis of a picked-up image including a current position and the target position of the object; and a switching control unit 424 for selectively supplying one of the first control signal and the second control signal to the arm servo circuit 433 (drive unit).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Manufacturing method of non-volatile switching element
abstract_en: To provide a manufacturing method of a non-volatile switching element which resolves deposition unevenness of a buffer layer material for sputtering film deposition on a bottom electrode and which is excellent in holding characteristic.SOLUTION: A manufacturing method of a non-volatile switching element 100 has a step of forming a first interlayer insulating film 101 on a substrate 110, embedding a bottom electrode 103 in the first interlayer insulating film 101, forming a second interlayer insulating film 102 on the first interlayer insulating film 101, forming an opening 109 exposing a part of the bottom electrode 103 in the first interlayer insulating film 101 and the second interlayer insulating film 102, performing sputter film deposition of a buffer layer 105 in the opening 109, and forming in the buffer layer 105 a solid electrolyte layer 106, a first upper electrode 107, and a second upper electrode 108. In the step of performing sputter film deposition of the buffer layer 105, a ratio of an argon average free process under argon pressure and a distance between a cathod and the opening 109 is set from 2 to 3.5 for performing sputter film deposition.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Wiring substrate, manufacturing method of wiring substrate and manufacturing method of semiconductor device
abstract_en: To suppress damage caused by removing of a metal layer.SOLUTION: A wiring substrate comprises: a metal layer; a resin layer; and a wiring structure. The resin layer is laminated on the metal layer. The wiring structure comprises a wiring layer and an insulation layer that are laminated on the resin layer, and the wiring layer is positioned to contact with the resin layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Laminated Sheet
abstract_en: To provide a laminated sheet which can suppress peeling defects when peeling off an unnecessary part and during handling.SOLUTION: There is provided a laminated sheet in which a first resin substrate and an intermediate layer have a same shape and a same size and are laminated to constitute a laminate part and the first resin substrate has a rectangular outer shape when viewed from a normal direction of a surface of the first resin substrate. The second resin substrate has a larger area than the laminate part and has an extension part extending from the outer edges of the first side, the apex and the second side at a corner part including a vertex where the first side and the second side of the first resin substrate orthogonally intersect. A length of the extension part extending from the first side in the first direction orthogonal to the first side is 5 to 20 mm, a length of the extension part in a direction parallel to the first side from an intersection of the extension part and the first side is 10 to 40 mm, a length of the extension part extending from the second side in the second direction orthogonal to the second side is 5 to 20 mm and a length of the extension part in a direction parallel to the second side from an intersection of the extension part and the second side is 10 to 40 mm.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Impurity introduction method and impurity introduction device
abstract_en: To provide an impurity introduction method and an introduction device capable of introducing an impurity element into a deep position in a semiconductor material such as SiC, in which the thermal diffusion coefficient of the impurity element is very small.SOLUTION: An impurity introduction method includes a first step of forming an impurity source film containing oxidized aluminum on a surface of a doped layer which is an n-type semiconductor material, and a second step of introducing the aluminum into the doped layer by applying a first pulsed laser beam toward the impurity source film to form a p-type impurity-introduced layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Lens part and laminate film
abstract_en: To provide a lens part capable of achieving weight-saving and improved visibility of a VR goggle.SOLUTION: A lens part includes: a reflection type polarization member configured to reflect light emitted from a display element and transmitted through a polarization member and a first λ/4 member; a first lens part arranged between the display element and the reflection type polarization member; a half mirror arranged between the display element and the first lens part and configured to transmit the light emitted from the display element and reflect the light reflected at the reflection type polarization member toward the reflection type polarization member; a second lens part arranged in front of the reflection type polarization member; a second λ/4 member arranged between the half mirror and the reflection type polarization member; and a protective member arranged between the half mirror and the second lens part. The protective member abuts on a space formed between the protective member and at least one of the first lens part and the second lens part, and a maximum value of 5° specular reflectance spectrum is 1.2% or less at wavelength 420-680 nm.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Stacked III-V semiconductor diode
abstract_en: To provide a III-V semiconductor diode.SOLUTION: A stacked III-V semiconductor diode 10 containing GaAs comprises: a high-concentration cathode layer 12, a high-concentration anode layer 16, and a drift region 14 arranged between the cathode layer and the anode layer and having a concentration of 8×1015 cm-3 at maximum. The drift region includes a low-concentration n-type drift layer 14.1 and a low-concentration p-type drift layer 14.2. Each of both drift layers has a layer thickness of at least 5 μm. The cathode layer includes a first section having a doping material concentration of at least 1×1017 cm-3 and a second section arranged between the first section and the drift region. The second section has a layer thickness of at least 1 μm and a doping material concentration transition which increases to the maximum value of the doping material concentration in a first section direction. The maximum value of the doping material concentration is less than or equal to the doping material concentration of the first section.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Semiconductor Device
abstract_en: To suppress increasing of contact resistance while suppressing increasing of on-resistance.SOLUTION: In a second impurity region 17, parts extending from boundary parts 171a and 171b of a first abutting region 171 toward other trench 13 are defined as linear parts 173a and 173b, parts extending from boundary parts 172a and 172b of a second abutting region 172 toward one trench 13 are defined as linear parts 174a and 174b, one angle of two angles θ1 and θ2 between the one trench 13 and two linear parts 173a and 173b connected to the first abutting region is less than 90°. The other angle is less than or equal to 90°. One angle of two angles θ3 and θ4 between the other trench 13 and two linear parts 174a and 174b connected to the second abutting region 172 is less than 90° and the other angle is less than or equal to 90°.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Transfer substrate, electronic device and manufacturing method of transfer substrate
abstract_en: To provide a transfer substrate capable of improving a yield, an electronic device and a manufacturing method of the transfer substrate.SOLUTION: A transfer substrate comprises: a substrate including a first top face; a conductive film which is provided on the substrate and includes a second top face; and a first insulator film which is provided on the substrate and directly in contact with the conductive film and includes a third top face continued to the second top face. The second top face and the third top face are tilted from the first top face in a boundary between the second top face and the third top face.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Light heating device
abstract_en: To provide a light heating device that increases the efficiency of utilization of light emitted from a heating light source.SOLUTION: A light heating device includes: a chamber which accommodates a heating target; a light source unit which emits heating light toward the heating target and which is disposed outside of the chamber; and a light transmitting part for allowing heating light that has been emitted from the light source unit to enter the inside of the chamber. The light source unit includes: a heating light source that emits the heating light; a reflection member that reflects, toward the heating target, some of the heating light which is emitted from the heating light source and which progresses in a direction differing from that of the heating target; and a condensing optical system that decreases the angle of divergence, with respect to the direction in which the heating light source and the chamber face each other, of the heating light that has been emitted from the heating light source toward the heating target.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Water dispersion type adhesive composition, and adhesive sheet for re-peeling
abstract_en: To provide a water dispersion type adhesive composition which is excellent in water resistance, and an adhesive sheet for re-peeling using the water dispersion type adhesive composition.SOLUTION: A water dispersion type adhesive composition contains a water dispersion type acrylic polymer, an active energy ray-curable resin, and a photopolymerization initiator, wherein the active energy ray-curable resin is an emulsion containing a radical polymerizable monomer having four or more functional groups and urethane acrylate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Groove shape measurement method, groove shape measurement device, control method of processing device, and processing device
abstract_en: To provide a groove shape measurement method, a groove shape measurement device, a control method of a processing device, and the processing device which can reduce a processing load of a control device of the processing device and acquire a cross section profile of a processing groove with high accuracy.SOLUTION: A groove shape measurement method includes: a coordinate data acquisition step (Step S1) of acquiring a plurality of pieces of three-dimensional coordinate data (three-dimensional coordinate data group 60) representing the shape of a processing groove 9 formed along a processing feeding direction (X direction) in a processing object (workpiece W) by a processing device (dicing device 10); a projection data generation step (Step S2) of generating two-dimensional projection data 62 on a processing groove 9 obtained by projecting the three-dimensional coordinate data onto a two-dimensional plane (two-dimensional plane 61) perpendicular to the processing feeding direction; and a cross section profile calculation step (Step S3) of calculating a cross section profile 64 of the processing groove 9 on the basis of the two-dimensional projection data 62.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Encapsulating frame and temperature adjustment unit
abstract_en: To realize an encapsulating structure of a Peltier module having sufficient performance depending on use environments.SOLUTION: An encapsulating frame that encapsulates a Peltier module sandwiched between plate-shaped members from above and below comprises: a frame body that encircles the Peltier module; a pair of first ring members that are interposed between the plate-shaped members along the entire circumference encircling the Peltier module at top and bottom surfaces of the frame body, respectively; and one or more continuity members that connects a lead wire of the Peltier module and establishes continuity between the inside and outside of the frame body. The continuity member comprises a pass-through part that passes through the inside and outside the frame body and reaches the outside of the frame body; a blocking part that blocks a passed-through region passed-through by the pass-through part in the frame body; and a second ring member interposed between the blocked surfaces along the entire circumference surrounding the passed-through region inside and/or outside the frame body.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Susceptor
abstract_en: To provide a susceptor which can improve a yield of a semiconductor chip formed by a wafer, in which a chipping (a cracking) hardy occurs, and of which a life is long.SOLUTION: In a susceptor having each pocket (2) mounting a wafer (10), at least one of the pockets (2) comprises: a plurality of support parts (3) that supports the wafer (10); a plurality of contact parts (4) that is contacted to a side surface (10a) of the wafer (10); and a plurality of non-contact parts (5) that is not contacted to the side surface (10a) of the wafer (10). Each contact part (4) and each non-contact part (5) are alternately formed into an inner peripheral wall of each pocket (2). At least two of the support parts (3) are formed onto a line connecting a center (O) of each pocket (2) with each non-contact part (5) when viewed from an upper direction of the susceptor.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Optical detection device and signal processing method
abstract_en: To provide an optical detection device and a signal processing method in which a falling time of an output after pulsed light irradiation is short.SOLUTION: An optical detection device includes: a first photoelectric conversion element configured to output a first output when irradiated with a light pulse; and a second photoelectric conversion element configured to output a second output when irradiated with the light pulse. The optical detection device is configured to combine a first signal caused by the first output with a second signal caused by the second output when the first photoelectric conversion element and the second photoelectric conversion element are irradiated with the same light pulse, in a state where a first condition and a second condition are satisfied. The first condition is a condition that an absolute value of an amount of change until the first signal reaches a peak is different from an absolute value of an amount of change until the second signal reaches a peak, and the second condition is a condition that a sign of the amount of change until the first signal reaches the peak is different from a sign of the amount of change until the second signal reaches the peak.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: To improve the performance of a display device.SOLUTION: A display device DSP1 includes: a terminal TM1 electrically connected to a first electrode of an LED element (inorganic light-emitting diode element) 20; and a terminal TM2 electrically connected to an electrode 20E2 of the LED element 20. In a plan view, the terminal TM1 is disposed at a position overlapping with the LED element 20, and the terminal TM2 is disposed so as to continuously surround the periphery of the LED element 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Semiconductor memory
abstract_en: To reduce lamination defects.SOLUTION: According to the embodiment, a semiconductor memory has a first chip 10 including a plurality of first wiring layers WL spaced and stacked in the first direction, a memory pillar MP extending in the first direction and passing through the plurality of first wiring layers, a second wiring layer BL electrically connected to the memory pillar, a first electrode 108 electrically connected to one of the plurality of first wiring layers and a second electrode 108 electrically connected to the second wiring layer, and a second chip 20 including a third electrode 210 bonded to the first electrode, and a fourth electrode 210 bonded to the second electrode. The length Hmw2 of the first electrode in the first direction is greater than the length Hmc2 of the second electrode in the first direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Deposition of carbon doped silicon oxide
abstract_en: To provide a method for deposition of a carbon doped silicon oxide film.SOLUTION: A method for depositing on a substrate a film comprising silicon and oxygen includes: (a) providing a substrate into a reactor; (b) introducing into the reactor at least one silicon precursor compound selected from the group consisting of formulas A, B and C described herein; (c) purging the reactor with a purge gas; (d) introducing at least one of an oxygen-containing source and a nitrogen-containing source into the reactor; (e) purging the reactor with the purge gas, where the steps (b) through (e) are repeated until a desired thickness of a resulting silicon-containing film is deposited; and (f) treating the resulting silicon-containing film with R3xSi(NR1R2)4-x, where R1-3 are the same as described in the specification, and are preferably methyl or ethyl; and x=1, 2, or 3. The method is practiced at one or more temperatures ranging from about 20°C to 300°C.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Nitride Semiconductor Module
abstract_en: To improve thermal dispersion of a nitride semiconductor module.SOLUTION: A nitride semiconductor module 100 includes a chip 101 including a transistor 51. The chip 101 includes: a semiconductor substrate 12; an electron transit layer formed on the semiconductor substrate 12 and composed of GaN; and an electron supply layer formed on the electron transit layer and composed of GaN. The transistor is composed including a gate electrode, a source electrode, and a drain electrode formed on the electron supply layer. The semiconductor substrate 12 is a GaN substrate having a thickness of 100 μm or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Host material for light-emitting layer, light-emitting element, light-emitting device, illumination device, and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a light-emitting element including a light-emitting material and having high luminous efficiency.SOLUTION: A light-emitting element includes a host material and a guest material. The host material includes a first organic compound and a second organic compound. In the first organic compound, the difference between the singlet excitation energy level and the triplet excitation energy level is more than 0 eV and 0.2 eV or less. One of the first organic compound and the second organic compound has the HOMO level that is more than or equal to the HOMO level of the other of the first organic compound and the second organic compound and the LUMO level that is more than or equal to the LUMO level of the other of the first organic compound and the second organic compound. The first organic compound and the second organic compound form an exciplex.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Semiconductor Device
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device and an electronic system including the same that improve reliability and performance.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device 10 includes a gate stack structure 120 including a first stack structure 120a and a second stack structure 120b that are sequentially stacked, respectively including a plurality of gate electrodes 130, a channel structure CH penetrating the gate stack structure, a plurality of gate contact portions 184 respectively connected to the plurality of gate electrodes in first and second pad regions formed in each stack structure, and a buffer insulating portion 132p formed in the first stack structure including a boundary part of the first stack structure adjacent to the second stack structure in a part where the second pad region is located. The buffer insulating portion includes an inner region, a first region located on one side of the inner region in an extension direction of the plurality of gate electrodes, and a second region located on the other side, and the first and second regions are each longer in the extension direction at an upper portion than at a lower portion, and a difference between the length at the upper portion and the length at the lower portion is larger in the second region than in the first region.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Designed substrate structure for power and rf application
abstract_en: To provide an improved method and system related to epitaxial growth processes and substrate structures.SOLUTION: A substrate structure includes: a polycrystalline ceramic core 110 with a front surface featuring a plurality of voids and containing polycrystalline material; a barrier layer 118 that encapsulates the polycrystalline ceramic core and defines valleys corresponding to a plurality of voids; an adhesive layer 116 that is bonded to a barrier layer above the front surface of the polycrystalline ceramic core and defines a filled region with the valley filled with bonding layer material corresponding to a plurality of voids; a bonding layer 120 bonded to the adhesive layer; and a single crystal silicon layer 125 bonded to the bonding layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Film forming method and film forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a technique preferentially etching a part of an object film with respect to another part of the object film.SOLUTION: A film forming method has the following (A) to (D). (A) A substrate is prepared, the substrate having, in different regions of the surface thereof, a first film and a second film that is formed of a different material from the first film. (B) A film formation inhibitory film for inhibiting the formation of an object film is selectively formed on the surface of the second film with respect to the surface of the first film. (C) The object film is selectively formed on the surface of the first film with respect to the surface of the second film by using the film formation inhibitory film. (D) A part of the object film is preferentially etched with respect to another part of the object film. The (D) includes: (Da) supplying a fluorine-containing gas to the surface of the object film; (Db) supplying an H2O gas to the surface of the object film after the (Da); and (Dc) supplying a plasma-converted gas to the surface of the object film after the (Db).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Semiconductor Module
abstract_en: To suppress temperature rise of an external terminal and a bonding wire.SOLUTION: A semiconductor module includes: a heat radiation plate; a first insulating substrate disposed on one surface of the heat radiation plate and having a semiconductor chip provided thereon; a frame-shaped case surrounding the first insulating substrate; a plurality of external terminals provided across the inside and the outside of the case and electrically connected to the semiconductor chip via a bonding wire; and at least one second insulating substrate disposed between the heat radiation plate and the external terminals and having heat conductivity greater than that of the case. The at least one second insulating substrate and the one surface of the heat radiation plate are bonded to each other by a heat conductive bonding material. Each external terminal and the at least one second insulating substrate are joined to each other by press-fitting.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Laminating device and method
abstract_en: To provide a laminating device that can correct a misalignment in the observational position of an alignment mark of a substrate caused by a curvature of a substrate holder and a method.SOLUTION: A laminating device 100 includes a first stage that holds a first substrate, a second stage 223 that holds a second substrate 213 by curving it so that the second substrate is opposite to the first substrate, an observation unit that observes the position of an alignment mark 218 provided on the surface of the second substrate held on the second stage, and a control unit that controls at least one of the first stage and the second stage on the basis of the location of the alignment mark observed by the observation unit. The control unit controls at least one of the first stage and the second stage on the basis of a misalignment in the observational position of the alignment mark caused by the curvature.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Semiconductor Device
abstract_en: To improve durability of a semiconductor device.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device 100 comprises: a semiconductor element 2 that is mounted onto an insulation substrate 1, and includes an electrode 21 onto a front surface 2a; a bonding wire 3 that is bonded to the electrode 21, and electrically connects the semiconductor element 2; and a first resin material 4 that coats a bonding part 31 of the electrode 21 and the bonding wire 3. The bonding part 31 contains a non-bonding region 32 where the electrode 21 and the bonding wire 3 are not bonded.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Optical laminate, and image display device using the same
abstract_en: To provide an optical laminate that includes a liquid crystal alignment solidified layer, is suppressed in deformation when the liquid crystal alignment solidified layer is transferred during manufacturing, and can be manufactured with high productivity.SOLUTION: An optical laminate according to an embodiment of the present invention has a polarizing plate including a polarizer, and a retardation layer laminated on the polarizing plate via an adhesive layer. The retardation layer includes, in order from the polarizing plate side, a first liquid crystal alignment solidified layer and a second liquid crystal alignment solidified layer. The retardation layer as a whole has a circular polarization function or an elliptical polarization function, and has the relation: Re(450)<Re(550)<Re(650). In an embodiment of the present invention, an adhesive layer has a hardness of 50 MPa or more, an elastic modulus of 800 MPa or more, and an indentation load of 900 μN or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Pressure adjustment method and substrate treatment apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a technology enabling a high-quality substrate treatment by properly adjusting a gap between a rotary table and a gas supply structure.SOLUTION: A substrate treatment apparatus includes: a treatment vessel; a rotary table which is rotatably provided inside the treatment vessel, and on which a plurality of substrates are placed at positions radially spaced from a rotational center; and a gas supply structure that supplies gas to the plurality of substrates placed on the rotary table and is displaceable relative to the rotary table. A pressure adjustment method for the substrate treatment apparatus includes: (A) detecting the pressure in the gap between the rotary table and the gas supply structure using a pressure detection part; and (B) adjusting the gap between the rotary table and the gas supply structure by displacing the gas supply structure based on the pressure detected by the pressure detection part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Light-emitting device
abstract_en: To provide a light-emitting device in which a leakage current of pixels is reduced.SOLUTION: A light-emitting device includes: a light-emitting element; a first transistor and a second transistor provided on a first surface of a silicon substrate; and a third transistor provided in a peripheral circuit that supplies an image signal to the first transistor. Either a source or a drain of the first transistor is connected to a gate electrode of the second transistor. Either a source or a drain of the second transistor is connected to the light-emitting element. The first transistor has Halo implantation layers in diffusion regions of the source and the drain. The Halo implantation layers have a polarity opposite to that of the diffusion regions.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Method for extracting organic solvent
abstract_en: To provide a technology for separating pure water and an organic solvent from a mixed liquid while suppressing a replacement frequency of a separation membrane.SOLUTION: The method for extracting an organic solvent related to the technology disclosed in the present specification includes the steps of: discharging a mixed liquid of water and an organic solvent from a substrate processing apparatus; detecting a cleanliness degree indicating the amount of impurities contained in the mixed liquid; comparing the cleanliness degree with a first threshold value; performing dehydration from the mixed liquid by bringing at least a part of a separation membrane into contact with the mixed liquid and extracting the organic solvent; and reducing impurities in the mixed liquid prior to the dehydration when the cleanliness degree is less than the first threshold value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Polymer compound, electroluminescence element material, liquid composition, and electroluminescence element using the polymer compound
abstract_en: To provide a technology capable of achieving a good balance between durability (particularly emission lifetime) and emission efficiency in electroluminescence elements.SOLUTION: This polymer compound comprises a structural unit (A) represented by formula (1).SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method of semiconductor device
abstract_en: To solve a problem in which bonded semiconductor chips vary in height from one another when a plurality of semiconductor chips is bonded to a wafer, and the electronic components may not be able to exhibit the desired performance when used as electronic components.SOLUTION: A manufacturing method for a semiconductor device includes the steps of preparing a first semiconductor substrate, a second semiconductor substrate having a first semiconductor layer and a second semiconductor layer, and a third semiconductor substrate, a bonding step of bonding the second semiconductor substrate and the third semiconductor substrate to one main surface of the first semiconductor substrate, and a thinning step of removing, after the bonding step, at least the second semiconductor layer of the second semiconductor substrate by wet etching, and an etching rate of an etchant used in the thinning step for the second semiconductor layer is greater than an etching rate for the first semiconductor layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: temperature control device
abstract_en: To provide a temperature control device that can maintain the flatness and parallelism of the mounting surface with high precision over a wide temperature range, while suppressing displacement of the mounting surface due to movement.SOLUTION: A temperature control device includes a mounting portion having a mounting surface on which an object to be temperature-controlled is placed, a bottom portion facing the mounting portion in a first direction, a heat source arranged between the mounting portion and the bottom portion in the first direction and capable of heating and cooling the object to be temperature-controlled via the mounting portion, a support portion provided on the outer periphery of the bottom portion, extending toward the mounting portion in the first direction and supporting the mounting portion, a positioning member arranged between the mounting portion and the bottom portion in the first direction and positioning the center of the mounting portion and the center of the bottom portion such that the mounting portion can swing relative to the bottom portion, and an elastic support portion provided on the support portion that elastically supports the outer periphery of the mounting portion from the outside in a second direction that passes through the center of the mounting portion and intersects an axis extending in the first direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Panel housing container, cleaning system, and cleaning method
abstract_en: To provide a panel housing container, a cleaning system, and a cleaning method capable of improving a cleaning efficiency of an internal space.SOLUTION: A panel housing container 1 includes a container main body 2 having an internal space V in which a plurality of panels are stored in a state of being stacked at intervals in a vertical direction and an opening 2a, and a lid body 3 that closes the opening 2a. The container main body 2 includes a bottom plate 22 that defines a lower end of the internal space V, a rear wall 24 that faces the lid body 3 in a state where the lid body 3 closes the opening 2a and defines a rear end of the internal space V, a first check valve that is attached to an air supply port provided in the bottom plate 22 and prevents a gas from flowing out of the internal space V, a second check valve that is attached to an exhaust port provided in the bottom plate 22 and prevents a gas from flowing into the internal space V, and an air supply valve 34 that is attached to a through hole 3c provided in one of the lid body 3 and the rear wall 24. The air supply valve 34 prevents the gas from flowing out of the internal space V.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: To provide a display device that can reduce brightness and color coordinate fluctuations due to temperature fluctuations.SOLUTION: This specification relates to a display device that can improve optical quality by reducing brightness and color coordinate fluctuations due to temperature fluctuations. The display device includes a first subpixel including a first light-emitting element configured to emit light of a first color and a first driving transistor configured to drive the first light-emitting element, and a second subpixel including a second light-emitting element configured to emit light of a second color and a second driving transistor configured to drive the second light-emitting element, the first driving transistor and the second driving transistor can have a different dummy hole total opening area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vapor growth device and vapor growth method
abstract_en: To provide a vapor growth device and method capable of suppressing deposition of by-products.SOLUTION: A vapor growth device 100 includes: a reaction chamber 10; a holder 15 on which a substrate W can be placed and which is rotatable; a gas introduction unit 11 capable of supplying a first process gas SG1 containing a material gas and a second process gas SG2 not containing the material gas into the reaction chamber; and a control unit 14 that controls supply of the first process gas and the second process gas into the reaction chamber and controls rotation of the holder. The control unit performs control so as to supply the second process gas into the reaction chamber during a first period before forming a film on the substrate, and supply the first process gas and the second process gas into the reaction chamber during a second period in which a film is formed on the substrate after the first period. The control unit also performs control such that a first rotational speed of the holder during the first period is greater than a second rotational speed of the holder during the second period.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Display device and electronic device including the same
abstract_en: To provide a display device in which a circuit configuration of a display panel is simplified, and an electronic device including the same.SOLUTION: In a display device of the present disclosure, a pixel includes a light emitting element connected to a first power line, a first transistor connected between a cathode of the light emitting element and a second power line, a second transistor connected between a second node and a data line, a first capacitor connected between a first node and the second node, and a third transistor connected between a first electrode of the first transistor and the first node. The organic light emitting display may further include a second capacitor coupled between the second node and the first power line, and a fourth transistor configured to initialize the second node in response to a second scan signal during the initialization period.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Flow rate control method and plasma processing apparatus
abstract_en: To improve controllability and to reduce cost by reducing the number of parts.SOLUTION: The controller 119 of the plasma etching processing apparatus 100 controls the flow rate of the cooling water of the coil 107. After the start of the process treatment, the control device 119 controls the flow rate of the cooling water so that the coil temperature does not exceed the rated temperature based on the output set value of the coil 107 in the process treatment. When the coil temperature calculated from the resistance value of the coil 107 reaches a preset target temperature, the control device 119 controls the flow rate of the cooling water so that the coil temperature is maintained at the target temperature. When the power supply of the coil 107 is changed from the ON state to the OFF state, the control device 119 controls the flow rate of the cooling water until a preset necessary cooling time necessary for cooling is exceeded so that the coil temperature becomes equal to or lower than the target temperature.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Source drain formation in gate-all-around transistors
abstract_en: To provide a method of forming a gate-all-around (GAA) device.SOLUTION: A method of manufacturing a semiconductor device includes forming a bottom dielectric isolation (BDI) layer 120 on a substrate 102, depositing a template material in a source/drain trench, etching and crystallizing the template material, and epitaxially growing a source region 130 and a drain region 130. This growth advantageously takes place at the bottom and the sidewalls of the source and drain regions.SELECTED DRAWING: FIG. 2N

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device capable of avoiding the influence of variations in gate resistance of a plurality of gate structures without causing a loss.SOLUTION: The semiconductor device 1 includes a chip 2 having a first main surface 3 including an active region 6, an n-type drift region 9 formed in the chip 2, a p-type body region 41 formed in a surface layer portion of the drift region 9, an n-type source region 42 formed in a surface layer portion of the body region 41, a plurality of gate structures 45 formed to face the body region 41 and forming a channel in the body region 41, an interlayer film 13 covering the plurality of gate structures 45, a gate wiring 25 formed on the interlayer film 13, and a plurality of resistance film portions 81 embedded in the interlayer film 13. The resistive film portion 81 is connected to both the gate structure 45 and the gate wiring 25.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus, method of manufacturing article, substrate processing method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: To provide a substrate processing apparatus capable of sufficiently suppressing the occurrence of temperature unevenness in the substrate surface of a substrate even when the substrate is conveyed at a high speed.SOLUTION: A substrate processing apparatus according to the present invention includes a stage on which a substrate is placed, a transfer unit configured to transfer the substrate from the stage, a measurement unit configured to measure a temperature of the transfer unit, an adjustment unit configured to adjust a temperature of the substrate placed on the stage, and a control unit configured to perform an adjustment step of adjusting the temperature of the substrate placed on the stage to the temperature of the transfer unit measured by the measurement unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Semiconductor device including trench contact structure and manufacturing method
abstract_en: Disclosed is a semiconductor device including a trench contact structure in a silicon carbide semiconductor body. A trench gate structure (102) extends from a first surface (104) into a silicon carbide semiconductor body (106) along a vertical direction (y). A trench contact structure (108) extends from the first surface (104) into the silicon carbide semiconductor body (106) along the vertical direction (y). A source region (130) of a first conductivity type and a body region (110) of a second conductivity type adjoin a first sidewall (112) of the trench gate structure (102). A diode region (114) of the second conductivity type adjoins a second sidewall (116) of the trench gate structure (102) opposite to the first sidewall (112). A shielding region (118) of the second conductivity type adjoins the bottom (120) of the trench contact structure (108), the shielding region (118) being arranged at a lateral distance (ld) to the trench gate structure (102).

title_en: Gatevalve
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gate valve, capable of improving productivity and space utilization, which comprises: a first support; a second support; a central reinforcement stand; a central shaft; a side block; a cylinder body; a first piston; a second piston; a first push flow path; a second push flow path; a first blade; and a second blade.

title_en: METHOD OF MAUFACTURING OF HEXAGONAL BORON NITRIDE (h-BN)/GRAPHENE IN-PLANE HETEROSTRUCTURE
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of a hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN)/graphene two-dimensional composite material which comprises the following steps of: preparing a germanium (Ge) substrate; depositing hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) on a germanium (Ge) substrate by controlling an area; and depositing graphene on a surface of the substrate which does not have hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) by inputting a carbon source to the germanium (Ge) substrate on which the hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) is partially formed.

title_en: Measuring instrument for calibration of semiconductor wafers
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a measurer for teaching of a semiconductor wafer. The measurer comprises: holder shafts (3) installed to be erected on both sides on a support plate (1); stopper shafts (4) installed to be erected on both rear sides of the holder shafts (3); a frame upper plate (7) fixedly installed on upper ends of the holder shafts (3) and the stopper shafts (4); and a control box (C) with a built-in central processing unit (CPU). Therefore, the measurer can precisely, easily and accurately check the operation relationship between an index arm and a wafer in case of teaching.

title_en: Clip bonding apparatus and semiconductor having semiconductor chip bonded clip using the same
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a clip attachment device, a clip attachment method, and a semiconductor package having a semiconductor chip with a clip attached by the method, which can minimize alignment errors and further increase the bonding accuracy of the clip to the semiconductor chip. The clip attachment device includes: a lead frame array, in which lead frames to which one or more semiconductor chips are respectively attached are arranged spaced apart in the X-axis direction and the Y-axis direction; a clip array in which a plurality of clips arranged spaced apart in the X-axis direction and the Y-axis direction and a tie bar connecting the plurality of clips are attached; a punch member including two or more punches for cutting the tie bars to separate the plurality of clips into two or more individual clips, and a punch holder; a die member including two or more die holes for guiding the punching of the punch; and a clip picker member comprising a multi-picker head and a picker holder having a plurality of picker heads, and sequentially attaching two or more individual clips attached to the picker head to the upper surface of the semiconductor chip.

title_en: Multi-Layer Ohmic Contact
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a multi-layer ohmic electrode capable of improving the agglomeration and roughening phenomenon that occurs after a heat treatment process performed for ohmic bonding of an ohmic electrode. An AlGaN/GaN HEMT device includes: a substrate; a first GaN layer formed on the substrate; an AlGaN layer formed on the first GaN layer; a second GaN layer formed on the AlGaN layer; a gate electrode formed on a recessed region from the second GaN layer to the AlGaN layer; and a source electrode and a drain electrode formed on a part of the second GaN layer excluding the recessed region.

title_en: Masking device for packaging tray
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a masking device for a packaging tray and, more specifically, to a masking device for a packaging tray, which enables laser processing of a chip without thermal damage to the packaging tray by installing the masking device on the packaging tray in a state in which the chip mounted on the packaging tray is vertically lifted by a heating block. The present invention may include a mask unit which is installed in a lattice shape on the upper side of a packaging tray to protect the packaging tray from a heat source, wherein mounting units on which chips are mounted are formed on the packaging tray in a plurality of rows and columns.

title_en: Wafer FOUP auto conveying system
abstract_en: An automatic wafer foup transfer system is disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an automatic wafer foup transfer system comprises: a driving bogie driving for automatic transfer of a wafer foup; and a variable mast coupled to the driving bogie in a vertical direction and provided to vary the height or lifting stroke of equipment.

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a substrate processing apparatus capable of efficiently performing a substrate transporting process. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the substrate processing apparatus comprises: a first exposure device and a second exposure device configured to perform exposures on a substrate in different patterns; and a substrate transport device configured to transport the substrate to the first exposure device and the second exposure device and transport the substrate from the first exposure device and the second exposure device. The substrate transport device includes: a first transfer configured to receive and discharge the substrate for the first exposure device; a second transfer configured to receive and discharge the substrate for the second exposure device; a third transfer and a fourth transfer arranged between the first transfer and the second transfer and configured to sequentially transport the substrate to the first transfer and the second transfer; and a multi-level transporter arranged between the third transfer and the fourth transfer and configured to transport a plurality of substrates in at least two levels.

title_en: Wafer processing method
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to form a device chip without reducing quality. A wafer processing method for dividing a wafer formed with a plurality of devices into a plurality of individual device chips includes: a polyolefin sheet providing step of positioning a wafer in an inside of an opening of a frame having the opening for receiving the wafer and providing a polyolefin sheet on a back side or a front side of the wafer and on an outer periphery of the frame; an integrating step of heating the polyolefin sheet to integrate the wafer and the frame through the polyolefin sheet by thermocompression bonding; a dividing step of irradiating the wafer with a laser beam having a transmission wavelength to the wafer along a line to be divided to form a modified layer on the wafer, and dividing the wafer into individual device chips; and a pickup process of applying ultrasonic waves to the polyolefin sheet to push up the device chip and pick up the device chip.

title_en: Organic compound, light-emitting device, light-receiving device, light-emitting apparatus, light-emitting module, electronic device, and lighting device
abstract_en: The present invention provides an organic compound having high heat resistance and a light emitting device with high luminous efficiency and high reliability. The organic compound is represented by chemical formula (G0), wherein any one of R^1-R^13 among R^1-R^13, R^21-R^29, R^31-R^39 and R^41-R^48 represents chemical formula (A); each of the remaining groups represents H, a C1-C6 alkyl group, a C3-C6 cycloalkyl group, or a substituted or non-substituted C6-C13 aryl group; and R^21 and R^22 may be bound to each other to form a spiro-ring.

title_en: Double side semiconductor package and manufacturing method of the same
abstract_en: A double side semiconductor package is disclosed. The double-side semiconductor package according to the present invention comprises: a first semiconductor chip mounted on one surface of a substrate on which a first circuit pattern is formed; a second semiconductor chip mounted on the other surface of the substrate on which a second circuit pattern connected to the first circuit pattern is formed; and a post-type wire disposed on one surface of the substrate, connected to the first circuit pattern, and extended in the longitudinal direction. An objective of the present invention is to provide the double side semiconductor package and a manufacturing method thereof, which can increase productivity, simplify processes and reduce costs.

title_en: Holding surface cleaning apparatus
abstract_en: An objective is to reattach processing scraps shaved from a holding surface, to the holding surface, in regard to a holding cleaning apparatus. To achieve the objective, a holding cleaning apparatus (8) for cleaning a holding surface (300) of a chuck table (30) suctioning and holding a workpiece includes: a cylindrical abrasive stone (80) bringing an outer surface (800) into contact with the holding surface (300); a rotary shaft (81) extended in parallel with the holding surface (300), inserted into a hole (801) in the center of the cylindrical abrasive stone (80), and supporting the cylindrical abrasive stone (80) to be rotatable; a rotation means (82) rotating the cylindrical abrasive stone (80) by rotating the rotary shaft (81); a lifting means bringing the cylindrical abrasive stone (80) into contact with the holding surface (300) or spacing the same apart from the holding surface (300); and a horizontal moving means moving the holding surface (300) and the cylindrical abrasive stone (80) relatively in a horizontal direction parallel with the holding surface (300). The holding cleaning apparatus (8) makes the cylindrical abrasive stone (80) approach the holding surface (300) to bring the outer surface (800) into contact with the holding surface (300) as well as moves the holding surface (300) and the cylindrical abrasive stone (80) relatively to clean the holding surface (300).

title_en: Apparatus for processing substrate
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a device for processing a substrate comprises: a support plate; an antenna having first to n^th turns (an integer greater than n=3) disposed in parallel with one surface of the support plate and wound along in one direction from an inner end; and a distance adjusting part capable of adjusting a separation distance of the first to n^th turns. Therefore, the present invention is capable of improving process uniformity with respect to the substrate.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method of fabricating the same
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a semiconductor element comprises a capacitor including a lower electrode, an upper electrode and a dielectric film between the lower electrode and the upper electrode. The lower electrode comprises ABO_3. A is a first metal element and B is a second metal element having a greater work function than the first metal element. The dielectric film comprises CDO_3. C is a third metal element and D is a fourth metal element. In the lower electrode, first and second layers are alternately repeated, the first layer includes the first metal element and oxygen, and the second layer includes the second metal element and oxygen. A first contact surface of the lower electrode in contact with the dielectric film is the second layer.

title_en: Organic light emitting diode display and manufacturing method of the same
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is an organic light emitting display device including a driving element and a substrate supporting a light emitting element controlled by the driving element. The substrate is made of a material which can be folded or bent, and the substrate has a structure including a first substrate and a second substrate. A functional layer is included between the first substrate and the second substrate. The width of the first substrate is equal to or greater than the width of the second substrate and the functional layer. The width of the second substrate is configured to be equal to or smaller than that of the functional layer, so that when an external force such as folding or bending of the substrate is generated, a peeling phenomenon occurring from the side of the substrate can be minimized.

title_en: Display device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A display device and a manufacturing method thereof are provided. A display device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a fingerprint sensor layer that receives light reflected from an external object; a substrate disposed on the fingerprint sensor layer; an optical pattern layer disposed on the substrate and including a light blocking part and a light transmitting part penetrating the light blocking part in one direction; a first light transmitting layer disposed on the light blocking part and having a first refractive index, a second light transmitting layer disposed on the first light transmitting layer and having a second refractive index different from the first refractive index; and a light emitting element layer disposed on the second light transmitting layer. An object of the present invention is to provide a display device having improved fingerprint recognition performance and improved light transmittance.

title_en: Magnetic domain wall logic element and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is a magnetic domain wall logic element which includes: a non-magnetic layer; and a magnetic layer formed on the non-magnetic layer. The magnetic layer includes a perpendicular magnetic anisotropy region; and a horizontal magnetic anisotropy region adjacent to the vertical magnetic anisotropy region. The magnetic domain wall logic element is operated by in-plane current of the non-magnetic layer. The magnetic domain wall logic element provided in one aspect of the present invention has advantages of implementing a logic element only by moving a domain wall, being driven by current, and having a simple structure. In addition, when the logic element is used, a data processing speed can be improved.

title_en: Door Device with Sealing Function using Air
abstract_en: A door device for a chamber according to the present invention opens/closes an opening of a chamber in a rotation manner through a hinge. The door device for a chamber comprises: a door plate inserted into the opening of the chamber to allow a side thereof to face an outer circumferential surface of the opening; a hinge part rotatably coupling the door plate to the chamber and having an air inlet; and a sealing part accommodated in a groove formed along a side of the door plate and expanding when the air is injected to seal a space between the door plate and the chamber.
