In addition, an air passage is formed between the air inlet of the hinge part and the sealing part to enable the air to flow. Since a method that an air tube is provided on the side of the door plate is used, the sealing condition is not affected by the surface condition of the door and chamber. In addition, since the side of the door plate and the outer peripheral surface of the opening naturally coincide with the rotation by the hinge, a process of moving the door to the closed position can be conveniently and simply performed.

title_en: Electric assembly including heat spreader
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, an electronic assembly includes: a circuit board including a plurality of connection parts having electrical conductivity; a plurality of spaced-apart semiconductor integrated circuits mounted on the circuit board and electrically connected with the plurality of connection parts; a protection layer placed on the semiconductor integrated circuits, substantially surrounding the semiconductor integrated circuits, and having a flat upper side; and a heat spreading copper layer placed on the protection layer, having an average thickness of more or less than about three microns, and having an average particle size of more than about 0.15 microns. The heat spreading copper layer is substantially coextensive with the circuit board with respect to length and width, and the average thickness of the protection layer can be equal to or greater than the height of the plurality of spaced-apart semiconductor integrated circuits. Therefore, the present invention is capable of reducing costs for forming an adhesive layer and enhancing heat spreadability.

title_en: Semiconductor device having resistor
abstract_en: A semiconductor device is disclosed. The semiconductor device comprises: a first pad prepared on one surface of a first chip; a second pad prepared on one side of a second chip stacked on the first chip and bonded to the first pad; a first resistance element prepared on the first chip and connected to the first pad; and a second resistance element prepared on the second chip and connected to the second pad.

title_en: Sensor array and device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sensor array, and a device having the same. According to the sensor array where a plurality of unit elements are arranged, each unit element comprises a pressure sensor, a light emission unit, and a light detection unit. The pressure sensor comprises a resistance change layer comprising a flexible polymer and a conductive nanostructure dispersed in the flexible polymer.

title_en: Hetero-cyclic compound and organic light emitting device comprising the same
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a heterocyclic compound and an organic light emitting device including the same. An exemplary embodiment of the present specification provides a heterocyclic compound represented by chemical formula 1. The heterocyclic compound according to an exemplary embodiment of the present specification can be used as a material of an organic material layer of the organic light emitting device, and by using the same, it is possible to improve efficiency, lower driving voltage and/or improve lifespan characteristics in the organic light emitting device.

title_en: Supercritical fluid exhaust system and method
abstract_en: An object of the embodiment is to provide a supercritical fluid exhaust system capable of controlling a fluid discharge rate of an exhaust line and a method thereof. According to an embodiment, the fluid exhaust system comprises: a chamber in which a supercritical treatment process for the substrate is performed; an exhaust for discharging supercritical fluid from the chamber; a main exhaust line connected to the exhaust; and a pressure control unit installed in the main exhaust line. The pressure control unit may increase exhaust pressure when internal pressure of the chamber falls below set pressure.

title_en: Radio frequency package
abstract_en: A radio frequency package according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a first connection member having a first stacked structure in which at least one first insulating layer and at least one first wiring layer are alternately stacked on each other; a second connection member having a second stacked structure in which at least one second insulating layer and at least one second wiring layer are alternately stacked on each other; a core member including a core insulating layer and disposed between the first and second connecting members; and a first chip antenna disposed to be surrounded by the core insulating layer, wherein the first chip antenna may include: a first insulating layer disposed to be surrounded by the core insulating layer; a patch antenna pattern disposed on an upper surface of the first insulating layer; and a feed via disposed to partially penetrate the first insulating layer by at least a partial thickness of the first insulating layer, providing a feed path for the patch antenna pattern, and electrically connected to the at least one first wiring layer. The present invention can efficiently provide an arrangement space for the chip antenna.

title_en: Management method of substrate processing apparatus and substrate processing system
abstract_en: The present invention can operate a substrate processing apparatus stably for a long term period by managing information upon a removal of a film on a peripheral portion of a substrate. The present invention comprises: a measurement processing process (S103) of measuring a cut width of a film based on an image obtained by imaging, with an imaging unit (270), a peripheral portion of a substrate which is processed based on a substrate processing recipe; a creation process (S602) of creating a management list in which a set value of the cut width of the film, a measurement value of the cut width of the film measured through the measurement processing process and time information at which the measurement result is obtained are correlated; an analysis process (S603, S606) of analyzing a state of the processed substrate based on the created management list; and a notification process (S605, S608, S609) of making a preset notification to a user based on an analysis result obtained through the analysis process.

title_en: Threshold switch based on organolead halide perovskite and the manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a threshold voltage switch device and a manufacturing method thereof, the switch device comprising: a threshold voltage switch layer formed on top of a lower electrode; and an upper electrode formed on top of the threshold voltage switch layer, wherein the threshold voltage switch layer includes an organo-metallic halide having a perovskite crystal structure and an active element with the perovskite crystal structure. The threshold voltage switch device according to the present invention is manufactured via a solution process, which is a low-priced process, and accordingly has price competitiveness compared with high-priced processes such as a gas process and a doping process, which have been commercialized in an existing semiconductor industry. In addition, the problems of existing materials such as high threshold voltage and high process temperature can be solved using organic-inorganic halide perovskite.

title_en: Display Device having Gate Driver
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a display device having a gate driver, whereby it is possible to reduce leakage current and power consumption of a TFT. In the gate driver according to one aspect, each stage includes: an output unit including a pull-up transistor outputting a corresponding clock among a plurality of clocks as a gate signal in response to control of the Q node, and a pull-down transistor that outputs the gate-off voltage as the off-voltage of the gate signal in response to the control of the QB node; a control unit that charges and discharges the Q node and charges and discharges the QB node opposite to the Q node; and a back bias circuit having a back bias node coupled with a capacitance to the Q node and generating and applying a back gate bias voltage to the back bias node during an off period of the Q node. The back bias circuit applies a back gate bias voltage through a back bias node to a light blocking layer of some of the transistors constituting the output unit and the control unit, which are turned off during the off period of the Q node, so that the leakage current of the corresponding transistors can be minimized.

title_en: Method of manufacturing semiconductor device, program and substrate processing apparatus
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing a semiconductor device can form a film with flatness. The method comprises the steps of: (a) forming a first layer on a substrate by performing a first layer forming cycle once or more, wherein the first layer forming cycle includes (a1) supplying a first element-containing gas to the substrate in a process chamber and (a2) supplying a first reducing gas to the substrate a plurality of times, and wherein (a1) and (a2) are sequentially performed; and (b) forming a second layer on the first layer by performing a second layer forming cycle once or more after the step (a), wherein the second layer forming cycle includes (b1) supplying a second element-containing gas to the substrate and (b2) supplying a second reducing gas to the substrate, and wherein (b1) and (b2) are sequentially performed.

title_en: Electrostatic chuck and semiconductor manufacturing device
abstract_en: In accordance with an objective of the present invention, provided are an electrostatic chuck capable of improving the uniformity of in-plane temperature distribution of a workpiece to be treated, and a semiconductor manufacturing apparatus. To achieve the objective, the electrostatic chuck includes a ceramic dielectric substrate, a base plate and a heater part. The heater part has first and second heater elements. The second heater element has a plurality of main zones including a first main zone. The first heater element has a plurality of sub zones. The number of the sub zones is greater than the number of the main zones. The first main zone has a main heater line emitting heat due to a flow of a current, and a first main feeding part feeding a current to the main heater line. The plurality of sub zones have a first sub zone overlapped with the first main zone. The first sub zone has a central area located in the center of the first sub zone, and an outer circumference area located on the outside of the central area. The first main feeding part is formed on a position overlapped with the central area.

title_en: Etching method and plasma processing apparatus
abstract_en: In accordance with an objective of the present invention, provided are an etching method capable of adjusting the width of the bottom of a concave part formed by etching in regard to plasma etching on a silicon containing film, and a plasma treatment apparatus. To achieve the objective, in accordance with one embodiment, the etching method includes the processes of: (a) providing a substrate onto a substrate supporter; (b) adjusting the temperature of the substrate supporter to no more than -20℃; (c) supplying treatment gas including nitrogenous gas, into a chamber; and (d) etching a silicon containing film by using plasma generated from the treatment gas. As the silicon containing film is etched, byproducts containing silicon and nitrogen are attached to a side wall of the concave part. The etching method includes a process (e) of setting at least one etching parameter for at least one among the temperature of the substrate supporter and the flowrate of the nitrogenous gas included in the treatment gas, in order to adjust the width of the bottom of the concave part in accordance with the amount of the attached byproducts, before the processes (b).

title_en: Method of manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: An objective of the resent invention is to improve the reliability of a semiconductor device. To achieve the objective, a MISFET2 is formed on a semiconductor layer SM of an SOI substrate (1) with respect to a circuit area (1A), and a MISFET3 constituting a TEG for a VC test is formed on the semiconductor layer SM of the SOI substrate (1) with respect to a TEG area (1B). An interlayer insulation film L1 is formed, a contact hole is formed on the interlayer insulation film L1, and a plug PG is formed in the contact hole. The plug PG, with respect to the TEG area (1B), includes a plug P2a electrically connected with a semiconductor substrate SB constituting the SOI substrate (1), and both sides of the semiconductor layer SM constituting the SOI substrate (1).

title_en: Substrate processing method and substrate processing system
abstract_en: The present invention can suppress an abnormal shape of a semiconductor pattern. A substrate processing method comprises: a step a) of conveying a substrate including a first film with a concave part formed thereon and a mask into a first chamber; a step b) of setting a temperature of the substrate to 200 ℃ or more; a step c-1) of sucking silicon-containing reaction species on a side wall of the concave part by supplying the silicon-containing reaction species into the first chamber; a step c-2) of forming a second film that is a silicon nitride film on the side wall of the concave part by supplying nitrogen-containing reaction species into the first chamber; a step d) of conveying the substrate into a second chamber; a step e) of setting a temperature of the substrate to 100 ℃ or less; and a step f) of etching a bottom part of the concave part. In addition, the second film has a thickness of 20 nm or less, and a thickness ratio of the bottom part of the concave part to the upper side wall of the concave part is 0.7 or more. The steps a) to f) are executed repeatedly in this order until the ratio of the depth from an opening part of the mask to the bottom part of the concave part with respect to an opening size of the mask becomes 50 or more.

title_en: An electroluminescent compound and an electroluminescent device comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel organic light-emitting compound represented by chemical formula I and can realize light-emitting properties such as low voltage driving and excellent light-emitting efficiency of a device by being employed as a material such as a light-emitting layer, a hole transport layer, an electron transport layer, and an electron blocking layer in an organic light-emitting device and a material for an organic layer such as a light efficiency improvement layer provided in the organic light-emitting device and the organic light-emitting device comprising the same.

title_en: Display device with antenna
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention relate to a display device with an antenna, and more specifically, to a display device with an antenna, which is capable of minimizing a size of a non-display area and improving signal transmission performance by arranging an amplifier on a side different from the side on which the antenna is located. The display device includes: a display panel on which a plurality of subpixels are disposed; an antenna located on the front side of the display panel in the non-display area; an amplifier connected to the antenna and positioned on a side; and a communication circuit connected to the amplifier to transmit and receive signals.

title_en: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method of the semiconductor device
abstract_en: According to the embodiments of the present invention, provided are a semiconductor device with improved operation reliability and a fabricating method of the semiconductor device. According to the present technology, provided is the semiconductor device comprising: a cell laminated body including first cell lamination layers and laminated conductive layers alternately laminated with each other; a cell plug penetrating the cell laminated body; and a cell chip guard surrounding the cell laminated body and the cell plug. The cell chip guard includes a guard semiconductor layer and a guard insulating layer covering a sidewall of the guard semiconductor layer.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent materials and devices
abstract_en: Provided is an organometallic complex comprising a 5-membered heterocyclic ring. A Compound comprises a ligand L_A having a structure of chemical formula I. In addition, provided are formulations comprising the compound. Further, provided are OLEDs and related consumer products using the compound.

title_en: A etching modeling system and a method of manufacturing semiconductor device using the same system
abstract_en: Provided are an etching modeling system and a method for manufacturing a semiconductor device using the etching modeling system. The method for manufacturing a semiconductor device comprises the steps of: receiving layout data including a plurality of pieces of pattern data implemented through first to N^th unique patterns, wherein N is a natural number greater than or equal to two; calculating first to N^th density values of each first to N^th unique patterns from the layout data and calculating first to N^th populations of each first to N^th unique patterns from the layout data; performing sampling by selecting some unique patterns among the first to N^th unique patterns on the basis of the first to N^th density values and the first to N^th populations; and performing etching modeling on sampled patterns of the plurality of pieces of pattern data corresponding to the selected unique patterns. The objective of the present invention is to provide an etching modeling system for sampling actual patterns and performing etching modeling based on the sampling, and thus, the etching modeling system has improved reliability and efficiency.

title_en: Compound for organic electric element, organic electric element using the same, and an electronic device thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides: an organic electric device including a compound represented by chemical formula 1, a first electrode, a second electrode, and an organic material layer between the first electrode and the second electrode; and an electronic apparatus including the organic electric device. By including the compound represented by chemical formula 1 in the organic material layer, it is possible to lower a driving voltage of the organic electric device, and improve luminous efficiency and lifespan of the organic electric device.

title_en: Luminescent nanostrucure and color conversion panel and electronic device including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a color conversion panel including a color conversion layer containing a color conversion region and optionally including a partition and a display device including the same. The color conversion region includes a first region corresponding to a first pixel, and the first region contains a first composite, in which light-emitting nanostructures are dispersed in a matrix. The light-emitting nanostructures include a first semiconductor nanocrystal containing a group III-V compound and a second semiconductor nanocrystal containing a zinc chalcogenide. The group III-V compound includes indium, phosphorus, and optionally zinc, gallium, or zinc and gallium, and the zinc chalcogenide includes zinc, selenium, and sulfur. The light-emitting nanostructures do not include cadmium, and the light-emitting nanostructures further include fluorine, wherein a molar ratio of fluorine to indium is greater than or equal to 0.05 in the light-emitting nanostructures. Accordingly, the light-emitting nanostructures can exhibit increased stability with improved optical properties.

title_en: Manufacturing method for semiconductor device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a manufacturing method for a semiconductor device which suppresses chip cracks and bump connection defects to improve yields and reliability. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the manufacturing method for a semiconductor device comprises: preparing a semiconductor wafer with an electrode; electrically connecting the electrode of the semiconductor wafer and a first semiconductor element formed on a semiconductor chip through a bump; forming a first insulation resin layer in the gap between the semiconductor wafer and the semiconductor chip facing each other after or before the connection between the semiconductor wafer and the semiconductor chip; forming a second insulation resin layer up to the thickness at which the semiconductor chip is buried in the semiconductor wafer; grinding the semiconductor chip and the second insulation resin layer until the semiconductor chip becomes a prescribed thickness; forming a first insulation layer on the semiconductor chip on the second insulation resin layer; forming an opening part exposing the electrode on the first insulation layer and the second insulation resin layer; filling the opening part with a conductive material to form a wire connecting the opening part to the conductive material on the first insulation layer; forming a first terminal electrically connected to the wire; and grinding the semiconductor wafer to a prescribed thickness. Grinding the semiconductor wafer to the prescribed thickness is to grind the semiconductor wafer until reaching a finishing thickness.

title_en: Low-temperature direct growth method of multilayer graphene, pellicle for extreme ultraviolet lithography using the same, and method for manufacturing the pellicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a low-temperature direct growth method of multi-layer graphene used as a core layer of a pellicle for extreme ultraviolet ray exposure, a pellicle for extreme ultraviolet ray exposure using the same, and a manufacturing method thereof. The present invention comprises the steps of: forming an etch stop layer on a silicon substrate; forming a seed layer with at least one material among amorphous boron, BN, BCN, B_4C and Me-X, wherein Me is at least one of Si, Ti, Mo and Zr, and X is at least one of B, C and N; forming a metal catalyst layer on the seed layer; forming an amorphous carbon layer on the metal catalyst layer; and directly growing multi-layer graphene on the seed layer by interlayer exchange between the metal catalyst layer and the amorphous carbon layer through low-temperature heat treatment at 450 to 600℃.

title_en: Logic Gate using Anomalous Hall Effect and Method of operting the same
abstract_en: A logic gate using spin orbit torque is disclosed. Spin orbit torque is generated in a ferromagnetic layer by an input current. An external magnetic field applied in parallel with the input current enhances perpendicular magnetic anisotropy in a specific direction. A gate voltage applied from a gate electrode causes a change in Hall voltage. Through this, a logic gate is implemented.

title_en: Pid generator for cigs thin-film solar cell
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a PID generator for a CIGS thin film solar cell. According to one aspect of the present invention, a PID generator for a CIGS thin film solar cell may be provided. The PID generator includes: a CIGS thin film solar cell; a metal foil configured to surround an area other than a glass substrate constituting a bottom surface in the CIGS thin film solar cell; and a power supply configured to apply a voltage to the CIGS thin film solar cell.

title_en: Support unit, apparatus for treating substrate with the same and method for processing a substrate with the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a substrate treatment apparatus. The substrate treatment apparatus comprises: a housing having a treatment space for treating a substrate; a support unit for supporting the substrate in the processing space; a gas supply unit for supplying process gas into the treatment space; and a plasma source for generating plasma from the process gas. The support unit includes: a dielectric plate on the upper surface of which the substrate is placed; an upper ring which surrounds the circumference of the substrate placed on the dielectric plate; a temperature sensor which measures the temperature of the upper ring; a first lifting member for lifting the upper ring; and a controller. The controller can control the first lifting member so that the height of the upper ring is changed according to the amount of etching of the upper ring calculated based on the temperature of the upper ring measured by the temperature sensor. Therefore, the substrate treatment apparatus can accurately calculate the degree of etching of a focus ring and lift the focus ring according to the calculated degree of etching.

title_en: Circuit board and package substrate having the same
abstract_en: A circuit board according to an embodiment comprises: a first insulating layer comprising an upper surface and a lower surface, and comprising a dented cavity from the upper surface toward the lower surface; and a first circuit pattern disposed in the cavity of the first insulating layer, wherein a center line surface roughness (Ra) of the upper surface of the first insulating layer is different from that of a center line surface roughness (Ra) of the upper surface of the first circuit pattern. Therefore, the present invention is capable of reducing a thickness.

title_en: Adhesive film for wafer back grinding
abstract_en: The present invention provides an adhesive film for grinding the back side of a wafer, which comprises: a multilayer base including an upper base layer and a lower base layer; a first adhesive layer disposed on the upper base layer; and a second adhesive layer interposed between the upper base layer and the lower base layer, wherein the second adhesive layer is formed from an adhesive composition including a light-transmitting adhesive resin and light scattering particles and satisfies the following formula 1, 0.05 <= | A-B | <= 0.2, and the light scattering particle has the refractive index of 1.42 to 1.60. Accordingly, the generation of a residual adhesive in a process of grinding the back side of a wafer can be reduced and inhibited, the adhesive film has excellent buffering effects on the surface of the wafer, and the uniformity in the thickness of the wafer after the process of grinding the back side of a wafer can be enhanced. In formula 1, A is the refractive index of the light-transmitting adhesive resin and B is the refractive index of the light scattering particle.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device comprises: a display panel including first pixels and second pixels provided on a substrate; and a touch sensor provided on the display panel. The touch sensor includes: sensor patterns provided on the display panel; bridge patterns electrically connected to the sensor patterns; a first light-shielding pattern provided on the sensor patterns to correspond to each of the first pixels and including a first opening part corresponding to the light emission area of each of the first pixels; and a second light-shielding pattern placed below the first light-shielding pattern to correspond to each of the first pixels and including a second opening part corresponding to the light emission area. The first light-shielding pattern and the second light-shielding pattern may have the same planar shape on each of the first pixels. Therefore, provided is a display device capable of realizing a private mode more stably.

title_en: Substrate transfer container opener
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a substrate transfer container opener, which is to open and transfer a carrier accommodating a substrate during a semiconductor process. To this end, the substrate transfer container opener, which is to separate a container cover from a container body in a carrier including the container body accommodating a substrate and the container cover for opening and closing the container body, comprises: a transport module arranged upright on the bottom, and including a transport plate in which a transport opening part is opened and a transport door for opening and closing the transport opening part; a bottom support module provided in the transport module on a lower side of the transport opening part; a stage module provided on the bottom support module, and having a container body positioned at a correct position; and a door opening/closing module for lifting and moving the transport door. Therefore, damage to a latch member can be prevented.

title_en: Magnetic memory device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A magnetic memory element according to the present invention may comprise: a substrate; an information storage pattern disposed on the substrate; and a lower part contact plug that connects the substrate and the information storage pattern. The lower part contact plug may comprise: a lower part contact pattern; a lower part barrier pattern extending along a lower surface and a side surface of the lower part contact pattern; and a side surface insulating pattern in contact with an outer surface of the lower part barrier pattern. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing the magnetic memory element with improved reliability.

title_en: Semiconductor processing chamber for improved precursor flow
abstract_en: Exemplary semiconductor processing systems may include a processing chamber, and may include a remote plasma unit coupled to the processing chamber. Exemplary systems may also include an adapter coupled to the remote plasma unit. The adapter may include a first end and a second end opposite the first end. The adapter may define an opening to a central channel at the first end, and the central channel may be characterized by a first cross-sectional surface area. The adapter may define an exit from a second channel at the second end, and the adapter may define a transition between the central channel and the second channel within the adapter between the first end and the second end. The adapter may define a third channel between the transition and the second end of the adapter, and the third channel may be fluidly isolated from the central channel and the second channel.

title_en: A concentric type thermoelectric module and thermal sensing device using of the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a concentric type thermoelectric module capable of absorbing heat from a heat source having a cylindrical body such as a tube or pipe and generating thermoelectric power using the temperature difference with the atmosphere, and a heat sensing device using the same. The present invention relates to a thermoelectric module which is configured to include a thermoelectric semiconductor provided between the first ceramic and the second ceramic and the first and second ceramics and generates electromotive force due to a temperature difference between the first ceramic and the second ceramic to enable power supply, wherein the first and second ceramics are formed so that their outer surfaces are concentric with the center of curvature of the heat source having a predetermined curvature, the first ceramic is formed in a semicircular arc shape corresponding to the outer surface of the heat source, the second ceramic is formed in a semicircular arc shape surrounding the first ceramic on the outside and is spaced apart from the first ceramic by a predetermined distance, and the thermoelectric semiconductor is arranged in a double column with N-type semiconductors and P-type semiconductors alternating with each other along the radius of curvature formed by the space spaced apart from the first ceramic and the second ceramic. The concentric thermoelectric module according to the present invention is concentric with the center of curvature of a heat source having a cylindrical body and is formed to have a contact surface corresponding to the outer surface of the heat source. Therefore, when heat is absorbed from a heat source such as a tube or pipe and thermoelectric power is generated using the temperature difference with the atmosphere, heat loss in the high temperature area can be reduced.

title_en: Organic light emitting display device and organic light emitting display panel
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to an organic light emitting display device and an organic light emitting display panel, and more specifically, comprise: a first signal line placed between a first light emitting area and a second light emitting area and a second signal line away from the first signal line; a first insulating film which is placed on the first signal line and the second signal line and has a first hole corresponding to a space between the first signal line and the second signal line; and a second insulating film placed on the first insulating film. The second insulating film is placed on the first hole of the first insulating film and the space between the first signal line and the second signal line, such that a spacing distance of signal lines can be reduced and accordingly, an area of a light emitting area can be increased. Therefore, the organic light emitting display device and the organic light emitting display panel with improved optical characteristics can be provided.

title_en: Display device and method for fabrication thereof
abstract_en: A display device is provided. The display device comprises: a plurality of pixel electrodes arranged to be spaced apart from each other on a first substrate; a first light emitting element disposed on one pixel electrode of the plurality of pixel electrodes; a common substrate disposed on the first light emitting element and including a hole; and a second light emitting element disposed in the hole and disposed on another pixel electrode among the plurality of pixel electrodes.

title_en: Uv curing apparatus
abstract_en: Disclosed is a UV curing device. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the UV curing device includes: a panel support unit for supporting a panel on which a liquid-curable adhesive layer is laminated; and a UV irradiation unit capable of irradiating UV by selectively controlling opposing direction and opposing position with the liquid-curable adhesive layer. Therefore, the liquid-curable adhesive laminated on the panel can be cured quickly and stably within a short period of time.

title_en: Film forming apparatus, film forming method, and method of manufacturing electronic device
abstract_en: The present invention causes an adsorption plate to more reliably adsorb a substrate while preventing an influence on the substrate. A deposition device performs deposition on a substrate through a mask and comprises: a chamber that maintains the inside in a vacuum state; an adsorption plate that is provided inside the chamber and has an electrode generating an electrostatic force for adsorbing the substrate; voltage control means that controls voltage applied to the electrode; and detection means that detects the state of adsorption of the substrate to the adsorption plate. In voltage control for causing the adsorption plate to adsorb the substrate, the voltage control means gradually increases the voltage applied to the electrode from an initial voltage at the start of the voltage control, and according to detection, by the detection means, of adsorption of the substrate to the adsorption plate, stops the increase of the voltage applied to the electrode.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for fabricating the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a semiconductor device provided with a high-integration memory cell and a manufacturing method therefor, which may improve the reliability of the semiconductor device. The method for manufacturing a semiconductor device according to the present invention may comprise: a step of forming a stack body by stacking a plurality of semiconductor layers and a plurality of etch stopper layers at the upper part of a substrate by turns; a step of etching a first portion of the stack body and then forming a plurality of stairs for stopping at the etch stopper layer; a step etching a second portion of the stack body and then forming a slit; a step of replacing etch stoppers of the stairs with sacrificial insulating layers through the slit; a step of replacing the sacrificial insulating layers with word lines; and a step of forming contact plugs connected to the word lines.

title_en: Display device, method of manufacturing the same and tiled display device including the same
abstract_en: A display device according to one embodiment includes: a first substrate including a first contact hole; a first barrier insulating layer disposed on the first substrate and including a second contact hole overlapping the first contact hole; a capping layer disposed on the first barrier insulating layer, at least a portion of which is disposed within the second contact hole and the first contact hole; a pad electrode disposed on the capping layer; a display layer disposed on the pad electrode; and a flexible film disposed under the first substrate and electrically connected to the pad electrode through the first contact hole and the second contact hole.

title_en: Power Generation Module
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a power generation module that secures a temperature difference between a heating part and a cooling part in a power generating element by minimizing a temperature difference between a heating gas and the heating part of the power generating element and a temperature difference between a cooling gas and the cooling part of the power generating element, respectively. A power generation module, according to one embodiment of the present invention, may comprise: a power generating element having a first electrode and a second electrode at both ends of a pair of an N-type semiconductor element and a P-type semiconductor element so as to generate electricity with a temperature difference between a first electrode side and a second electrode side; a heating part attached to the first electrode of the power generating element and heated by means of a heating gas; and a cooling part attached to the second electrode of the power generating element and cooled by means of a cooling gas, wherein the first electrode and the second electrode may be formed to have an area larger than heat passage areas of the N-type semiconductor element and the P-type semiconductor element.

title_en: Film package
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a film package comprising: a film substrate; a semiconductor chip; a wiring pattern; a protective layer; a thermal conductive resin; and a thermal conductive film. The film substrate includes: a first side and a second side opposite to each other. The semiconductor chip is arranged on the film substrate; and includes: first sides which extend to a first direction to face the first side and the second side, and second sides which extend in a second direction crossing the first direction. The wiring pattern is electrically connected to the semiconductor chip; and includes: an inputting pattern extending in the first side on the film substrate, and an outputting pattern extending in the second side on the film substrate. The protective layer is arranged on the film substrate to cover at least a part of the wiring pattern; and includes: a first opening unit on which the semiconductor chip is arranged, and a second opening unit which is separated from the first opening unit. The thermal conductive resin includes: a first resin which is arranged on the first opening unit; and a second resin which is arranged on the second opening unit to cover the semiconductor chip. The thermal conductive film is arranged on the protective layer; and includes a first penetrating hole for exposing at least a part of the first resin, and a second penetrating hole for exposing at least a part of the second resin. The present invention can improve a heat dissipation feature.

title_en: Apparatus for manufacturing a display device, mask assembly and method for manufacturing a display device
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention discloses a manufacturing device of a display device comprising: a chamber; a mask assembly disposed inside the chamber and comprising a mask sheet wherein a deposition material passes through; and a deposition source disposed inside the chamber and supplying the deposition material, wherein the mask sheet comprises a body part that forms an exterior, one or more opening parts disposed in the body part, and one or more groove parts disposed in the body part, and at least one among the groove parts overlapping an inner surface of at least one among the opening parts. Therefore, the present invention is capable of increasing an efficiency and lifespan of the display device.

title_en: Method of manufacturing the semiconductor device using solution process and semiconductor device manufactured by the method
abstract_en: Disclosed is a manufacturing method of a semiconductor element which comprises: a first step of hydrophilizing a surface of a substrate; a second step of spin-coating an IGZO precursor solution on the hydrophilized surface of the substrate to form an IGZO precursor thin film; a third step of drying and heat-treating the IGZO precursor thin film to form an IGZO semiconductor thin film; and a fourth step of forming a source electrode and a drain electrode that are in contact with the IGZO semiconductor thin film and are spaced apart from each other.

title_en: Display panel
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, disclosed is a display panel which comprises: a substrate including a first corner area adjacent to a main display area and a second corner area outside the first corner area; a first input line disposed in the first corner area; a second input line disposed in the second corner area; a third input line connecting the first input line and the second input line; a first display element disposed in the first corner area and connected to a first pixel circuit and a first pixel path; a second display element disposed in the second corner area and connected to a second pixel circuit and a second pixel path; and a driving circuit disposed in the second corner area, connected to the second input line, and supplying an electrical signal to the first pixel circuit and the second pixel circuit.

title_en: Wafer chuck apparatus with air unit and method of fabricating a semiconductor device using the same
abstract_en: According to some embodiments of the present invention, a wafer chuck device comprises: a support unit made of a metal material and having a disk-shaped upper surface; a disk-shaped wafer chuck having a plurality of vacuum channels therein on the support unit; an air member connecting the support unit and the wafer chuck and connected to an external air pump; a hinge connector connected to the plurality of vacuum channels at the center of a lower portion of the wafer chuck and connected to the vacuum pump through a vacuum suction pipe; and a control unit connected to the vacuum pump, the air pump, and the vacuum suction pipe to control the same.

title_en: Power module for vehicle
abstract_en: According to the present invention, disclosed is a power module for a vehicle, which comprises: an upper substrate and a lower substrate spaced apart from each other in a vertical direction; a semiconductor chip connected to at least one of the upper substrate and the lower substrate; and a spacer made of a metal material including copper, connecting the semiconductor chip and the other substrate or connecting the upper substrate and the lower substrate, and having a plurality of through parts penetrating the inside.

title_en: Display panel and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a display panel comprises: a base layer including a display area and a non-display area; first color light emitting devices, second color light emitting devices, and third color light emitting devices disposed on the base layer and overlapping the display area; a mark disposed on the base layer, overlapping the non-display area, and including a reference mark and a plurality of first group marks aligned with the reference mark in a first direction; and organic patterns for inspection disposed on the base layer, overlapping the non-display area, and disposed to correspond to the plurality of first group marks. A distance between the plurality of first group marks and two adjacent marks among the reference marks is N/4 times a distance between two adjacent first color light emitting devices among the first color light emitting devices in the first direction, wherein N can be a natural number.

title_en: Work polishing apparatus and work polishing method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a work polishing device and a work polishing method capable of pressing every region of a work with an intended pressing force, simply changing the pressing force, and polishing the work in a desired thickness shape corresponding to a purpose. According to the present invention, the work polishing device (10) comprises: a head base unit (20) to which a head shaft (18) capable of vertically moving and rotating is fixed on an upper portion; and a polishing head (12) having a holding member (34) to hold a work (W) on a lower surface thereof, wherein a partition unit (36) capable of vertically moving on an upper surface side of the holding member (34), a first fluid chamber (50) on an inner circumferential side thereof, and a second fluid chamber (56) on an outer circumferential side thereof are provided, the inside of the first fluid chamber (50) and the inside of the second fluid chamber (56) can be individually pressurized or decompressed, and the partition unit (36) can be lowered to a position where the first fluid chamber (50) and the second fluid chamber (56) are partitioned to generate a pressure difference between at least the inside of the first fluid chamber (50) and the inside of the second fluid chamber (56).

title_en: Light emitting element, manufacturing method for light emitting element, and display device including light emitting element
abstract_en: A light emitting device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes: an n-type semiconductor layer including a zinc oxide semiconductor; a p-type semiconductor layer; and an active layer disposed between the n-type semiconductor layer and the p-type semiconductor layer. The active layer includes a quantum well structure including a barrier layer and a well layer including zinc oxide.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device is provided. The display device includes a first display area which includes a plurality of data lines extended in a first direction, a second display area which is arranged on one side of the first display area and includes a plurality of data lines shorter than the data lines of the first display area, a first non-display area which is adjacent to the first display area, and a second non-display area which is adjacent to the second display area and includes a plurality of load matching parts which are connected to the data lines of the second display area and compensate the load capacitance of the data lines of the second display area.

title_en: Semiconductor manufacturing equipment
abstract_en: A semiconductor manufacturing device includes: a main body including a driving unit, a control unit, a pressure control unit, and a bonding head; a head heater having a heat-pressure surface located at the bottom of the bonding head and having a negative pressure path recessed in the heat-pressure surface and a negative pressure hole located in the negative pressure path; and a bonding tool having a first surface facing the heat-pressure surface and in contact with the heat-pressure surface and having a concave groove, and a second surface contacting the semiconductor chip on the opposite side of the first surface and applying heat to it. The groove is connected to the negative pressure path so that the negative pressure supplied to the negative pressure hole is applied to the negative pressure path and the groove together. Through the semiconductor manufacturing device, adhesion between the bonding tool and the head heater can be improved, and detachment of the bonding tool from the head heater can be reduced or prevented.

title_en: Display device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention comprises: a digitizer; an adhesive layer disposed on the digitizer to be in contact with the digitizer; and a substrate disposed on the adhesive layer to be in contact with the adhesive layer. the substrate includes a first substrate having a plurality of first structures including an opening or a groove to be folded around a folding axis extending in a first direction, and including a glass material.

title_en: Ovonic threshold switching device minimizing the current in the cut-off state
abstract_en: The present invention proposes an ovonic threshold switching element having a structure capable of minimizing a current level in a blocked state. the ovonic threshold switching element for minimizing a current level in a blocked state comprises: a first electrode layer; a second electrode layer stacked on the first electrode layer; a third electrode layer stacked on the second electrode layer; a first ots layer positioned between the first electrode layer and the second electrode layer; and a second ots layer positioned between the second electrode layer and the third electrode layer. at least one of the first ots layer and the second ots layer further includes a barrier layer.

title_en: Display apparatus and sensing method using the same
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention provides a display device comprising: a substrate including a sensor area and a display area; a plurality of biosensors arranged on the substrate, wherein the electrical resistance thereof varies when exposed to a target substance; and an organic insulating layer including a plurality of openings to expose the plurality of biosensors to the outside. The display area includes a plurality of first through-hole units and a plurality of display units spaced apart by the plurality of first through-hole units. The sensor area includes a plurality of second through-hole units and a plurality of base units spaced apart by the plurality of second through-hole units.

title_en: Thin film transistor and display apparatus comprising the same
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided are a thin film transistor and a display device including the same. the thin film transistor comprises: a base substrate; a first buffer layer on the base substrate; a second buffer layer on the first buffer layer; an active layer on the second buffer layer; a gate insulating film on the active layer; and a gate electrode on the gate insulating film. the active layer includes a channel unit overlapping the gate electrode. the gate electrode covers a side surface of the channel unit.

title_en: Systems and apparatus for semiconductor equipment
abstract_en: Various implementations of the present technology may provide an apparatus for removing oxygen and moisture from a semiconductor system. The apparatus may be coupled to the wafer handling chamber and may include a blower, a first air purifier, a second air purifier, and a particle filter. The first and second air purifiers may be coupled parallel to each other and downstream from the blower. The particle filter may be coupled downstream from the first and second air purifiers. The wafer handling chamber may include a fan integrated within a lower region of the wafer handling chamber.

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus and control method of the same
abstract_en: A technical idea of the present invention provides a substrate processing device comprising: a substrate processing unit comprising a support member configured to support a substrate, an entrance configured to enable the substrate to enter/exit at one side, and a housing configured to accommodate the substrate; and a first blowing member configured to supply air by forming a descending air current to the substrate processing unit, wherein the first blowing member comprises a fan housing having opened upper part and lower part, a fan disposed inside the fan housing and configured to flow air from the opened upper part to the lower part of the fan housing, a pair of first heaters separate-disposed in a first horizontal direction with the fan interposed therebetween and configured to supply heat, and a pair of second heaters separate-disposed in a second horizontal direction perpendicular to the first horizontal direction with the fan interposed therebetween and configured to supply heat, and further comprises a control part configured to control the heat supply of the first heater and the second heater.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a display device, and more particularly, to a display device capable of maximizing an aperture ratio of a pixel by including a first driving line extending in a first direction in a non-active area and a second driving line extending in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction in an active area and electrically connected to the first driving line in the non-active area.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a first substrate including a display area in which a light emitting element is disposed and a non-display area surrounding the display area; a second substrate disposed on the first substrate and having an end located inside the first substrate; an adhesive layer disposed between the first substrate and the second substrate; and a moisture permeation prevention coating film disposed in contact with the end of the first substrate, the end of the second substrate, and the end of the adhesive layer. the lifespan and reliability of the display device can be improved by minimizing penetration of external moisture and oxygen through a side portion.

title_en: PERPENDICULAR SHAPE ANISOTROPY DESIGN WITH REDUCED Aex
abstract_en: A perpendicular shaped anisotropic magnetic tunnel junction structure includes a reference layer, a nonmagnetic spacer, and a free layer. The reference layer comprises a first surface and a second surface facing the first surface of the reference layer. The nonmagnetic spacer includes a first surface and a second surface, wherein the nonmagnetic spacer is arranged on the second surface of the reference layer. The free layer includes a first surface and a second surface, wherein the first surface of the free layer is on the second surface of the nonmagnetic spacer, and the free layer further includes Aex, which is the exchange energy having the range of 0.5 to 1.0 μerg / cm.

title_en: Iii-nitride semiconductor light emitting device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a group III nitride semiconductor light-emitting device and a method of manufacturing the same. The present invention relates to a group III nitride semiconductor light-emitting device. More specifically, the present invention relates to a group III nitride semiconductor light-emitting device and a method for manufacturing the same, and more specifically, to a group III nitride semiconductor light-emitting device which emits light of two or more different wavelengths including red light, and a method for manufacturing the same. Here, the group III nitride semiconductor is included of the compound made of the Al(x)Ga(y)In(1-x-y)N (0<=x<=1, 0<=y<=1, 0<=x+y<=1). By utilizing the semiconductor light-emitting structure according to the present disclosure, it is possible to overcome the problem of using an InGaN active region containing a large amount of In, and also overcome the problem which occurred during the driving process of the manufactured semiconductor light-emitting device.

title_en: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method of semiconductor device
abstract_en: A semiconductor device includes: a first gate structure including first conductive layers and first insulating layers alternately stacked; a separation insulating layer located in the first gate structure and including a first line part extending in a first direction, first protrusions protruding from the first line part to one side, and second protrusions protruding from the line part to the other side; first memory patterns surrounding the first protrusions, respectively; and first protective patterns located between the first line part and the first memory patterns, respectively.

title_en: Heterocyclic compound, organic light emitting device comprising same and composition for organic layer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a heterocyclic compound represented by chemical formula 1, an organic light emitting device comprising the same, and a composition for an organic material layer. In chemical formula 1, the definition of each substituent is the same as described in the detailed description.

title_en: Semiconductor Device
abstract_en: A semiconductor device according to some embodiments of the concept of the present invention includes: a substrate including an active pattern; a first source/drain pattern and a second source/drain pattern overlapping the active pattern; a separation insulating film between the first source/drain pattern and the second source/drain pattern; and a first gate electrode and a second gate electrode spaced apart from each other with the separation insulating film interposed therebetween. The level of the upper side of the isolation insulating layer highs than the level of the upper side of the level of the upper side of the first gate electrode and the second gate electrode.

title_en: Organic electroluminescent materials and devices
abstract_en: An organometallic compound containing a gold atom as the central metal atom coordinated by a tetradentate ligand comprising at least four monocyclic or fused polycyclic ring systems described herein is provided. A blend comprising such an organometallic compound is also provided. Organic light emitting devices (OLED) and related consumer products utilizing such organometallic compounds are further provided.

title_en: Display device and manufacturing method of display device
abstract_en: Provided are a display device and a manufacturing method of the display device. A method for manufacturing a display device comprises the steps of: applying a first resin to one surface of a mother substrate and curing the same to form a frame including an opening; applying a second resin to the opening of the frame and curing the same to form a protective member; and cutting the mother substrate along a gap between the protective members after removing the frame, wherein the second resin includes a material different from the first resin.

title_en: Image sensor and fabrication method of the same
abstract_en: An image sensor comprises: a first chip and a second chip stacked; and a bonding unit provided between the first chip and the second chip. The first chip includes: a first semiconductor substrate including a first surface and a second surface opposite to the first surface; a photoelectric conversion region provided in the semiconductor substrate; and a first circuit wiring layer disposed on the first surface and adjacent to the photoelectric conversion region. The second chip includes: a second semiconductor substrate including a fourth surface facing the first surface and a third surface opposite to the fourth surface; and a second circuit wiring layer disposed on the fourth surface. The bonding unit includes a diffusion barrier layer for driving diffusion of hydrogen and/or deuterium.

title_en: Polarizing film, circular polarizing plate and method of producing the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a polarizing film that is easily formed into a thin film and has excellent neutral color properties, a polarizer including the polarizing film, and a manufacturing method thereof. A polarizing film, a polarizer including the polarizing film, and a manufacturing method thereof are provided. The polarizing film of the present invention comprises: a polymer formed from a polymerizable liquid crystal compound; at least one dichroic dye (1) having an absorption maximum in the wavelength range of 380 to 550 nm, when dispersed in the polymer and measured for light absorption; and at least two dichroic dyes (2) having absorption maximums in the wavelength range of 550 to 700 nm. The dichroic dye (2) preferably comprises a dichroic dye having absorption in the wavelength range of 550 to 600 nm and a dichroic dye having absorption in the wavelength range of 600 to 700 nm.

title_en: Circuit board and method of fabricating circuit board
abstract_en: The disclosed circuit board comprises: an insulating core layer having a first surface and a second surface facing each other; an insulating auxiliary member of which at least a portion is located on the insulating core layer and of which coefficient of thermal expansion (cte) is different from that of the insulating core layer; a first substrate unit including a first insulating layer located on the first surface and a first circuit wiring buried in the first insulating layer; and a second substrate unit including a second insulating layer located on the second surface and a second circuit wiring buried in the second insulating layer.

title_en: Method for Forming Copper Film
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for forming a copper film on a substrate in a chamber, comprising the steps of: a) spraying a copper-containing precursor on the substrate; b) spraying a first purge gas on the substrate; c) forming plasma using hydrogen (h_2) on the substrate; and d) spraying a mixed gas including a hydrogen-containing gas and a nitrogen-containing gas on the substrate, wherein the step d) continuously sprays the mixed gas while the steps a) to c) are performed.

title_en: Apparatus for manufacturing display device
abstract_en: An apparatus for manufacturing a display device according to an embodiment includes: a substrate; a nozzle including a nozzle hole for spraying a deposition material onto the substrate; a crucible connected to the nozzle and accommodating the deposition material; a reflector disposed on the crucible and including an opening area corresponding to the nozzle; and an angle limiting member connected to the reflector. The angle limiting member may include a first member disposed to face the nozzle, a third member disposed to face the substrate, and a second member disposed between the first member and the third member.

title_en: Display panel and method of manufacturing display panel
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a display panel. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a display panel comprises: a base layer divided into a first area including a display area and a transmissive area and a second area surrounding at least a portion of the first area and having a light transmittance lower than that of the first area; first pixels disposed in the display area and each including sub-pixels and a dummy electrode, wherein the sub-pixels include a pixel circuit including first transistors and a light emitting device connected to the first transistors, respectively, the transistors include a semiconductor pattern unit and a gate electrode overlapping the semiconductor pattern unit, respectively, and the dummy electrode is spaced apart from the semiconductor pattern unit on a plane.

title_en: Methods and apparatus for a susceptor assembly
abstract_en: Various embodiments of the present technology may provide a susceptor assembly. The susceptor assembly may include a susceptor plate and a cap disposed on a surface of the susceptor plate. The cap may have an electrode embedded therein. The susceptor plate may have a heating element embedded therein. The cap may be separated from the susceptor plate by an air gap formed by the plurality of dielectric spacers. The plurality of dielectric spacers may be sized for minimal contact on the cap.

title_en: Display panel and method of repairing the same
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a display panel and a repair method thereof. The display panel comprises: a first sub-pixel including a 1-1 light emitting element and a 1-2 light emitting element; a second sub-pixel including a 2-1 light emitting element and a 2-2 light emitting element; a first cathode line connected to at least one cathode electrode of a cathode electrode of the 1-1 light emitting element and a cathode electrode of the 1-2 light emitting element, and extending toward the second sub-pixel; and a second cathode line connected to at least one of a cathode electrode of the 2-1 light emitting element and a cathode electrode of the 2-2 light emitting element, and extending toward the first sub-pixel.

title_en: Semiconductor package
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a semiconductor package which comprises: a base substrate including a lower surface; a semiconductor chip disposed on the base substrate; and a plurality of connection bumps disposed on the lower surface of the base substrate. The plurality of connection bumps have a first group including connection bumps arranged in a first direction on the lower surface and a second group including connection bumps arranged in a second direction forming a first angle with the first direction. The connection bumps of the first group are misaligned in the first direction, and the connection bumps of the second group are misaligned in the second direction.

title_en: Etchant compositions and methods of manufacturing semiconductor device using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an etching composition and a manufacturing method of a semiconductor element using the same, wherein the etching composition comprises an inorganic acid and a silanol-based compound, the content of the silanol-based compound within the etching composition and the viscosity of the etching composition, by satisfying equation 1, enable sufficient etching selectivity ratio of a nitride film compared to an oxide film to be secured while suppressing abnormal growth even in a high-temperature wet etching process, and processability may be excellent due to low viscosity by not causing efficiency decrease of the etching process or damage of the etching equipment as bubbles are not generated immediately after manufacturing.

title_en: Temperature measurement apparatus for measuring a substrate's temperature
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a temperature measuring device for measuring the temperature of a substrate during a deposition process and, more specifically, to a temperature measuring device comprising: a temperature sensor unit protruding from the upper surface of a chuck for transferring a substrate to measure the temperature of the substrate loaded on the chuck; and an adjustment unit adjusting the height at which the temperature sensor unit protrudes according to the state in which the substrate is loaded on the chuck.

title_en: Heat exchanger device including thermoelectric element
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a heat exchanger comprises: a first plate; a second plate disposed on the first plate; a thermoelectric module disposed on the second plate; a third plate disposed on the thermoelectric module; and a fourth plate disposed on the third plate. The first plate, the second plate, the thermoelectric module, the third plate, and the fourth plate are sequentially stacked in a first direction. The thermoelectric module includes a plurality of thermoelectric elements disposed to be spaced apart from each other. The second plate includes a first surface disposed to face the first plate and a second surface on which the thermoelectric module is disposed. The second surface of the second plate includes a plurality of first regions on which the plurality of thermoelectric elements are disposed and a second region other than the plurality of first regions. An average radius of curvature of a first uneven pattern of the plurality of third regions corresponding to the plurality of first regions on the first surface of the second plate is different from an average radius of curvature of at least a portion of a second uneven pattern of the fourth region corresponding to the second region.

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: Disclosed are a semiconductor thin film and a semiconductor device including the same. The semiconductor device comprises: an amorphous oxide semiconductor layer including a plurality of metal elements including indium (in), wherein the content of indium with respect to the metal elements exceeds 50 at%; a first electrode and a second electrode spaced apart from each other on the oxide semiconductor layer; a gate electrode spaced apart from the oxide semiconductor layer; and a gate insulating layer disposed between the oxide semiconductor layer and the gate electrode.

title_en: Substrate Processing Apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention provides a substrate processing apparatus which does not generate twisting of a pipe in a substrate processing apparatus having a plurality of processing areas. The substrate processing apparatus comprises: a first processing area and a second processing area which are arranged on left and right sides and on which a substrate is arranged to perform processing by a processing liquid from a nozzle; a plurality of nozzles which are connected to a processing liquid supply unit, wait at a standby position between the first processing area and the second processing area, and move to one of the first and second processing areas to supply the processing liquid to the substrate; and a nozzle moving mechanism which is connected to one of the plurality of nozzles to move the nozzle from the standby position to a discharge position. The nozzle moving mechanism includes a first arm which rotates around a central axis and a second arm which is connected to the first arm and rotates in a direction opposite to the rotation direction of the first arm. The second arm includes a mounting unit for connecting the nozzles.

title_en: High-Bandwidth Memory with Bridge-Integrated Logic Die and Package Therefor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a heterogeneous integrated package in which a high bandwidth memory and a process chip using the same are mounted. The heterogeneous integrated package comprises: a package substrate; a logic die located on an upper portion of the package substrate and including an accompanying physical layer for a high bandwidth memory; and a memory package including a process chip located on the logic die and including a physical layer corresponding to the accompanying physical layer and electrically connected via the logic die, and two or more memory dies, wherein the logic die connects the physical layer and the accompanying physical layer without a through electrode and includes high-speed interconnects having a length of 4 mm or less.

title_en: Light emitting device and electronic apparatus including the same
abstract_en: A light emitting device comprises: a first electrode; a second electrode facing the first electrode; and an intermediate layer disposed between the first electrode and the second electrode and including a light emitting layer, wherein the intermediate layer includes m light emitting units, and m - 1 charge generation units disposed between two adjacent light emitting units among the m light emitting units, m is an integer of 2 or more, at least one of the light emitting units includes a first sub-pixel and a second sub-pixel, and the first sub-pixel and the second sub-pixel satisfy the following inequality 1: [Inequality 1] V_on2 - V_on1 <= 0.2 V, wherein a description of the inequality 1 refers to the detailed description of the invention.

title_en: Display device comprising spacer and fabriating method thereof
abstract_en: A display device according to an embodiment of the present specification includes: a thin film transistor disposed on a substrate; a bank disposed on the thin film transistor; and at least two spacers disposed on the bank and having a separation distance at a first position and a separation distance at a second position different from each other.

title_en: Plasma cenerator for exhaust gas pretreatment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a plasma generator for pretreatment of exhaust gas, which can be easily installed on a pipe at the front end of a dradry pump, and can improve ionization of the exhaust gas by simply changing an area in which a plasma reaction occurs according to the pressure of the introduced exhaust gas, thereby preventing a failure of the exhaust gas treatment device and preventing the outflow of the exhaust gas that can destroy the environment. According to the present invention, the decomposition of exhaust gas can be efficiently performed by adding a magnetic according to the pressure of the exhaust gas flowing in through the plasma adjusting unit and adjusting the plasma generation area inside the body by moving the position of the lower electrode block.

title_en: Level shifter and display device including the same
abstract_en: A pixel circuit and a display device including the same according to an embodiment are disclosed. The pixel circuit includes: a first light emitting element; a second light emitting element; a driving element for driving the first and second light emitting elements; a compensation circuit including a capacitor connected to a gate electrode of the driving element; a first switch element connected between the driving element and the first light emitting element; and a second switch element connected between the driving element and the second light emitting element. The compensation circuit includes: a third switch element for applying a reference voltage or a reset voltage to one electrode of the capacitor; a fourth switch element connected between the first light emitting element and an initialization voltage line to which an initialization voltage is applied; and a fifth switch element connected to the second light emitting element and the initialization voltage line.

title_en: Polishing composition, polishing method, and method for manufacturing semiconductor substrate
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides means for reducing scratches on the surface of a polished object (particularly silicon oxide) after polishing. The present disclosure is a polishing composition comprising abrasive grains, an inorganic salt, and an organic onium salt, wherein the organic onium salt comprises at least one of a tetraalkylammonium salt represented by the following formula 1 and a tetraalkylphosphonium salt represented by the following formula 2, and wherein the zeta potential of the abrasive grains in the polishing composition is negative: wherein R^1 to R^8 are each independently an unsubstituted alkyl group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms, and A^- and X^- are each independently a monovalent anion.

title_en: Method of monitoring at least one of an overlay or an alignment between layers of a semiconductor substrate, scanning probe microscopy system and computer program.
abstract_en: The present document relates to a method of monitoring an overlay or alignment between a first and second layer of a semiconductor using a scanning probe microscopy system. The method comprises scanning the substrate surface using a probe tip for obtaining a measurement of a topography of the first and second layer in at least one scanning direction. At least one pattern template is generated Which is matched With the topography of the first layer for determining a first candidate pattern. The first candidate pattern is matched With the measured second topography for obtaining a second candidate pattern to represent the measured topography of the second layer. Feature characteristics of device features are determined from both the first and second candidate pattern, and these are used to calculate one or more overlay parameters or alignment parameters.

title_en: Sensor system
abstract_en: A system includes an image sensor structure and a flow cell. The image sensor structure includes an image layer disposed over a base substrate. A device stack is disposed over the image layer. A bond pad is disposed in the device stack. A passivation stack is disposed over the device stack and the bond pad. An array of nanowells is disposed in a top layer of the passivation stack. A through-silicon via (TSV) is in electrical contact with the bond pad. The TSV extends through the base substrate. A redistribution layer (RDL) is disposed on a bottom surface of the base substrate. The RDL is in electrical contact with the TSV. The flow cell is disposed upon the top layer of the passivation stack to form a flow channel therebetween. The flow channel is disposed over the array of nanowells and the bond pad.

title_en: Molecular computing device based on essentially non-complementary single-stranded nucleic acids with low affinity to each other (options)
abstract_en:
FIELD: molecular computing. 
     SUBSTANCE: group of inventions relates to the field of molecular computing devices. A molecular computing device (options), a method for performing calculations using a device, a pharmaceutical formulation containing devices, as well as the use of a pharmaceutical formulation for regulating gene expression are proposed. The molecular computing device includes a set of single-stranded nucleic acids, wherein the numerical measure of input signals are measures related to input molecules, the numerical measure of output signals are measures related to output molecules, input signals are transformed into output signals as a result of interactions between input molecules and output molecules. In the first option, single-stranded nucleic acids have low affinity of interaction with each other. In the second option, the total concentration of each single-stranded nucleic acid exceeds a value of the dissociation constant of complexes formed by single-stranded nucleic acid and other single-stranded nucleic acids of a set of complexes by no more than 100,000 times. In the third option, interactions between single-stranded nucleic acids are reversible binding of not completely complementary between single-stranded nucleic acids, wherein such acids are used that for any two single-stranded nucleic acids, the length of the longest connected section of their mutual complementarity does not exceed 10 bases.  
     EFFECT: inventions provide fast calculation, solving a wide range of problems, as well as operating with oligonucleotides of various lengths. 
     49 cl, 2 tbl, 23 ex, 13 dwg

title_en: A solar cell module and a solar cell panel
