abstract_en: The present invention relates to a thin film solar cell module (20) comprising a first solar cell (21a) and a second solar cell (21b) disposed on a substrate (1) and connected in series, wherein the first solar cell (21a) comprises a first bottom electrode layer (22a) disposed on the substrate, a first stack (27) disposed on the first bottom electrode layer (22a), and a first top electrode layer disposed on the first stack (27), wherein the first stack (27) is configured to generate electric current when the first stack (27) is illuminated, the second solar cell (21b) comprises a second bottom electrode layer (22b) disposed on the substrate, a second stack (28) disposed on the second bottom electrode layer (22b), and a second top electrode layer disposed on the second stack (28), wherein the second stack (28) is configured to generate electric current when the second stack (28) is illuminated.

title_en: Method for producing semiconductor device, substrate processing apparatus, and program
abstract_en: There is a film formation step that forms a film containing a prescribed element and nitrogen on a substrate by performing a prescribed number of times a cycle that includes: (a) a step for forming a first layer by supplying a raw material gas containing a prescribed element and a halogen element on the substrate heated to a first temperature within a processing chamber; (b) a step for forming a second layer by reforming the first layer by supplying to the substrate within the processing chamber a plasma-excited first reformed gas that contains hydrogen and does not contain nitrogen; and (c) a step for forming a third layer by reforming the second layer by supplying to the substrate within the processing chamber a plasma-excited second reformed gas that contains nitrogen and hydrogen, wherein a supply time TH of the first reformed gas in (b) is made to be longer than a supply time TN of the second reformed gas in (c).

title_en: Through silicon via and redistribution layer
abstract_en: A semiconductor device, which comprises: a silicon substrate having a front surface and a back surface; a metal layer located on said front surface; a through silicon via (TSV) extending through said silicon substrate from said back surface to said front surface, wherein said TSV is connected at one end to said metal layer; and a redistribution layer (RDL), wherein said RDL is embedded in said silicon substrate.

title_en: Chemical-mechanical polishing composition and chemical-mechanical polishing method in which same is used
abstract_en: This chemical-mechanical polishing composition is for polishing a base material and contains an abrasive, hydroxyethyl cellulose having a weight-average molecular weight of 200,000 or lower, a basic component, a surfactant, and an aqueous carrier.

title_en: Doping processes in metal interconnect structures
abstract_en: A metal interconnect structure is doped with zinc, indium, or gallium using top-down doping processes to improve diffusion barrier properties with minimal impact on line resistance. Dopant is introduced prior to metallization or after metallization. Dopant may be introduced by chemical vapor deposition on a liner layer at an elevated temperature prior to metallization, by chemical vapor deposition on a metal feature at an elevated temperature after metallization, or by electroless deposition on a copper feature after metallization. Application of elevated temperatures causes the metal interconnect structure to be doped and form a self-formed barrier layer or strengthen an existing diffusion barrier layer.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for forming the same
abstract_en: A semiconductor device includes: a first multi-gate field effect transistor (FET) disposed over a substrate, the first multi-gate FET including a first active region; and a second multi-gate FET disposed over the first multi-gate FET, the second multi-gate FET including a second active region. The first active region and the second active region are not fully projected in a vertical direction perpendicular to the substrate.

title_en: Light-emitting device and method for manufacturing light-emitting device
abstract_en: A light-emitting device according to one embodiment of the present disclosure is provided with: a semiconductor layered body in which a first light-reflecting layer comprising an arsenic-based semiconductor layer that includes carbon as an impurity, an active layer and a second light-reflecting layer are layered; a first buffer layer that is disposed on the first light-reflecting layer side of the semiconductor layered body, and that comprises a phosphorus-based semiconductor layer with one surface that faces the semiconductor layered body and another surface on the opposite side from the one surface; and a second buffer layer that is disposed at least between the first light-reflecting layer and the first buffer layer, and that includes zinc or magnesium as an impurity.

title_en: Use of a composition consisting of ammonia and an alkanol for avoiding pattern collapse when treating patterned materials with line-space dimensions of 50 nm or below.
abstract_en:
The invention relates to the use of a composition essentially consisting of 0.1 to 3 % by weight ammonia and a C 1 
to C 4 
alkanol for anti-pattern collapse treatment of a substrate comprising patterned material layers having line-space dimensions with a line width of 50 nm or below, aspect ratios of greater or equal 4, or a combination thereof.

title_en: Encapsulation for solar cells and method for encapsulating solar cells
abstract_en: The subject disclosure provides a simple, fast, and high-yield method for encapsulating solar cells. This method can produce an encapsulation of solar cell(s) that is flat, bubble-free, lightweight, and flexible. In addition, it can also reduce equipment and material costs.

title_en: Mapping arrangement mechanism
abstract_en: The present invention provides a mapping arrangement mechanism including a pick-up arm having a suction device. The suction device includes a main cavity structure, a replacement suction nozzle, and a transparent observation window provided on the main cavity structure. One end of the main cavity structure is provided with a vacuum tube connecting outlet, and another end of the main cavity structure is provided with a nozzle port. The replacement suction nozzle is detachably installed on the nozzle port. In the mapping arrangement mechanism, the transparent observation window, and the nozzle port and the replacement suction nozzle collectively constitute an optical observation path, and the optical observation path does not pass through the vacuum tube connecting outlet.

title_en: 3d pitch multiplication
abstract_en: Memory devices and methods of manufacturing memory devices are provided. Described are devices and methods where 3D pitch multiplication decouples high aspect ratio etch width from cell width, creating small cell active area pitch to allow for small DRAM die size.

title_en: Device sealing method, device sealing apparatus, and method for manufacturing semiconductor product
abstract_en: The invention provides a device sealing method, a device sealing apparatus, and a method of manufacturing a semiconductor product, which can seal a device with good precision and enable processing of a workpiece and a sealing material in a sealing process to be easy. The device sealing method is provided with a sealing process in which the LED (11) is sealed by a sealing sheet (S) by applying a pressure higher than atmospheric pressure to a sealing material composite (M) formed by attaching the sealing sheet (S) to the LED mounting surface of the substrate (10) on which the LED (11) is mounted. By adopting the structure, the LED (11) is sealed by using the sealing sheet (S) which has a flat sheet shape in advance. Thus, the flatness of the sealing sheet (S) that seals the LED (11) in a state after the sealing of the LED (11) is completed can be improved. In addition, since a sufficiently large pressing force (V1) can be applied to the sealing sheet (S), the gap between the LEDs (11) can be reliably filled with the sealing sheet (S).

title_en: Anti-sulfurization coating material, cured product thereof, and electronic device
abstract_en: The present invention is an anti-sulfurization coating material, the anti-sulfurization coating material being characterized by: containing (A) a straight-chain organopolysiloxane represented by the following general formula (1), (B) an organohydrogen polysiloxane having two or more silicon-atom-bonded hydrogen atoms in a molecule, (C) one or more substances selected from crystalline silica and talc, (D) a straight-chain organopolysiloxane that has one or more phenyl groups and does not have an alkenyl group and a silicon-atom-bonded hydrogen atom in a molecule, (E) a hydrosilylation catalyst containing a platinum group metal, and (F) cerium oxide; and not containing a metal powder or a metal plating powder. It is thereby possible to provide an anti-sulfurization coating material comprising an addition-curable silicone composition that yields a cured product that does not contain a metal powder or a metal plating powder, that has exceptional durability in a high-temperature environment, and that has anti-sulfurization properties.

title_en: Power conversion circuit and power conversion system
abstract_en: Provided is a power conversion circuit in which radiation noise is reduced. The power conversion circuit is provided with at least a switching element for opening and closing an input voltage via a reactor, and a commutating diode which, by means of a voltage including at least an electromotive force generated from the reactor when the switching element is off, allows for conduction of a current that flows in the direction of the electromotive force. The commutating diode includes a gallium oxide-based Schottky barrier diode.

title_en: Substrate position detection method, drawing method, substrate position detection apparatus and drawing apparatus
abstract_en: The substrate position detection method includes a step (step S11) of holding a substrate having a plurality of substrate elements, each of which is partitioned in a rectangular shape by a grid-like line to be split, a step (step S12) of capturing each of two or more selected substrate elements selected from the plurality of substrate elements and acquiring two or more captured images, and a step (step S13) of obtaining the positions of the two or more selected substrate elements and detecting the positions of the substrate by performing pattern matching using a reference image for each of the two or more captured images. Each of the plurality of substrate elements has a pattern region in which a predetermined pattern is formed inside the outer edge of the substantially rectangular region. The reference image is a set of line segments set on each side of the outer edge of the region except for the corners. As a result, the position of the substrate can be detected easily and accurately.

title_en: System and method for warpage detection in a cmos bonded array
abstract_en: A system and method for warpage detection in a CMOS bonded array includes a conductor positioned between bonded contact pads of first and second wafers. The conductor is connected to a continuity check circuit. If the continuity check circuit detects an interruption in conductivity of the conductor, such interruption is indicative of warpage in the first and/or second wafers. In one implementation, the conductor is a serpentine-shaped structure.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for singulating semiconductor chips
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a semiconductor device and a method for singulating semiconductor chips. A semiconductor device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a plurality of semiconductor chips, which are separated from each other; a first adhesive layer, which is filled in a separation space between the semiconductor chips and is disposed on one side of each semiconductor chip; a first carrier substrate, which is attached to one side of each semiconductor chip through the first adhesive layer; a photosensitive second adhesive layer, which is disposed on other side of each semiconductor chip; and a second carrier substrate, which is attached to the other side of the semiconductor chip through the photosensitive second adhesive layer. The present invention has low viscosity for each semiconductor chip to be cut, and therefore, during the process of performing pick-and-place, the breakage of the thin and thick semiconductor chips can be prevented, and the pick-and-place can be smoothly performed regardless of the thickness of the semiconductor chip.

title_en: Semiconductor devices
abstract_en: A semiconductor device includes a substrate including an isolation layer pattern and an active pattern, a buffer insulation layer pattern on the substrate, a polysilicon structure on the active pattern and the buffer insulation layer pattern, the polysilicon structure contacting a portion of the active pattern, and the polysilicon structure extending in a direction parallel to an upper surface of the substrate, a first diffusion barrier layer pattern on an upper surface of the polysilicon structure, the first diffusion barrier layer pattern including polysilicon doped with at least carbon, a second diffusion barrier layer pattern on the first diffusion barrier layer pattern, the second diffusion barrier layer pattern including at least a metal, and a first metal pattern and a first capping layer pattern stacked on the second diffusion barrier layer pattern.

title_en: Semiconductor devices
abstract_en: Semiconductor devices are provided. The semiconductor devices includes a landing pad on a substrate, a lower electrode on the landing pad and connected to the landing pad, a capacitor dielectric film that is on the lower electrode and includes both a tetragonal crystal system and an orthorhombic crystal system, a first doping layer that is between the lower electrode and the capacitor dielectric film and includes a first metal, and an upper electrode on the capacitor dielectric film.

title_en: Deep trench integration processes and devices
abstract_en: Exemplary methods of forming a semiconductor device may include etching a trench from a first surface of a semiconductor substrate to a first depth within the semiconductor substrate. The trench may be characterized by a first width through the first depth. The methods may include forming a liner along sidewalls of the trench. The methods may include etching the trench to a second depth at least ten times greater than the first depth. The trench may be characterized by a second width through the second depth. The methods may include filling the trench with a dielectric material. A seam formed in the dielectric material may be maintained below the first depth.

title_en: Memory device using pillar-shaped semiconductor element
abstract_en:
In the present invention, a first Si pillar 2a standing in a vertical direction, and a second Si pillar 2b having an outer peripheral line located inside the outer peripheral line of the first Si pillar 2a are provided on a substrate 1. Moreover, a N +  layer 3a connected to a source line SL and a N +  layer 3b connected to a bit line BL which are located at both ends of the first Si pillar 2a and the second Si pillar 2b, a first gate 
insulating layer 4a surrounding the first Si pillar 2a, a first gate conductor layer 5a surrounding the first gate insulating layer 4a and connected to a plate line PL, and a second gate conductor layer 5b surrounding a gate HfO 2  layer 4b surrounding the second Si pillar 2b and connected to a word line WL are provided, wherein voltages applied to the source line SL, the plate line PL, the word line WL, and the bit line BL are controlled to perform a data retaining operation for holding an electric hole group generated by impact ion phenomenon or gate induced drain leakage current inside a channel region 7 of Si pillar 2, and a data erasing operation for removing the electric hole group from the inside of the channel region 7.

title_en: Display apparatus, display module, electronic instrument, and method for producing display apparatus
abstract_en: Provided is a display apparatus exhibiting high definition or high resolution. The present invention has a first light-emitting device, a second light-emitting device, a first insulation layer, a first coloring layer, and a second coloring layer. The first light-emitting device has a first pixel electrode, a first light-emitting layer located over the first pixel electrode, and a common electrode located over the first light-emitting layer. The second light-emitting device has a second pixel electrode, a second light-emitting layer located over the second pixel electrode, and a common electrode located over the second light-emitting layer. The first insulation layer covers the side surfaces of each of the first pixel electrode, the second pixel electrode, the first light-emitting layer, and the second light-emitting layer. The first coloring layer is disposed superimposed on the first light-emitting device. The second coloring layer is disposed superimposed on the second light-emitting device. Each of the first and second light-emitting devices functions to emit white light. The first coloring layer functions to transmit visible light of a different color than the second coloring layer.

title_en: Semiconductor device, method for driving semiconductor device, and electronic device
abstract_en: Provided is a semiconductor device capable of performing authentication in a short period of time. A semiconductor device according to the present invention has a light-emitting device and an imaging device. The imaging device has a low driver circuit, and the low driver circuit has first to m-th latch circuits (m is an integer equal to or larger than 2) and first to m-th register circuits. A first start pulse signal is input to the first latch circuit, and a second start pulse signal is input to the first to m-th latch circuits. Scanning signals output from the first to (m-1)-th register circuits are input to the second to m-th latch circuits, respectively. The first latch circuit has a function for outputting one of the first start pulse signal and the second start pulse signal to the first register circuit on the basis of held data. The second to m-th latch circuits have a function for outputting one of the scanning signal and the second start pulse signal to the second to m-th register circuits on the basis of held data.

title_en: Positive-acting photosensitive resin composition
abstract_en: To obtain a positive-acting photosensitive resin composition which is used for liquid-crystal display elements, organic EL display elements, etc., gives cured films having surfaces with high water repellency and high oil repellency, leaves little residue after patterning even with a high-concentration developing solution, and can form a cured-film image that is reduced in outgassing during high-temperature burning. This positive-acting photosensitive resin composition comprises (A) component, which is a polymer having a liquid-repellent group, (B) component, which is an alkali-soluble resin having an N-hydroxyphenyl group, (C) component, which is a 1,2-quinonediazide compound, (D) component, which is a crosslinking agent, and (E) a solvent.

title_en: Mosfet gate engineerinng with dipole films
abstract_en: A metal gate stack on a substrate comprises: an interfacial layer on the substrate; a high-[kappa] metal oxide layer on the interfacial layer, the high-[kappa] metal oxide layer comprising a dipole region adjacent to the interfacial layer, the dipole region comprising niobium (Nb); a high-[kappa] metal oxide capping layer on the high-[kappa] metal oxide layer; a positive metal-oxide-semiconductor (PMOS) work function material above the high-[kappa] metal oxide capping layer; and a gate electrode above the PMOS work function material. The dipole region is formed by driving Nb species of a Nb-based film into the high-[kappa] metal oxide layer to form a dipole region.

title_en: Memory device using semiconductor element
abstract_en:
The memory device of the present invention comprises, in two ends of a Si pillar 2 standing in the vertical direction on a substrate 1: a N +  layer 3a connecting to a source line SL; a N +  layer 3b connecting to a bit line BL; a N layer 8a connecting to the N +  layer 3a; a N layer 8b connecting to the N +  layer 3b; a first gate insulation layer 4a surrounding the Si pillar 2; a first gate conductor layer 5a surrounding the first gate insulation layer 4a and connecting to a plate line PL; and a second gate conductor layer 
5b surrounding a second gate insulation layer 4b which surrounds the Si pillar 2, and connecting to a word line WL. The memory device controls voltages applied to the source line SL, plate line PL, word line WL and bit line BL to perform: a data holding operation for holding a group of electric holes formed inside a channel region 7 by impact ionization phenomenon or gate induced drain leakage current, and a data erasing operation for removing the group of electric holes from the inside of the channel region 7.

title_en: Processing device and method for producing processed product
abstract_en: The present invention simplifies the device configuration, reduces the footprint, and miniaturizes the storage space of the singulated object to be processed, and includes: processing tables for holding the sealed substrate; a first holding mechanism holding the sealed substrate in order to transport the sealed substrate to the processing table; a processing mechanism cutting and singulating the sealed substrate that is held on the processing table; a storage box in which the sealed substrate singulated by the processing mechanism is dropped and housed; a second holding mechanism holding the product in order to transport the product from the processing tables to the storage box; a moving mechanism for transporting having a common transfer shaft that extends along an arrangement direction of the processing table and the storage box for moving the first holding mechanism and the second holding mechanism; and a moving mechanism for processing moving the processing mechanism respectively on a horizontal plane in a X direction along the transfer shaft and in a Y direction orthogonal to the X direction.

title_en: Ultraviolet-curable composition, resin film, and heat dissipation member
abstract_en: An ultraviolet-curable composition includes the following component (A): a polymerizable compound; and component (B): a filler. In the ultraviolet-curable composition, the cured film (thickness 100 [mu]m) of the ultraviolet-curable composition has an average parallel light transmittance of 40% or more at a wavelength of 380 to 780 nm; the cured film (thickness of 100 [mu]m) of the ultraviolet-curable composition has a thermal conductivity of 0.25 W/m.K or more, which is obtained by the following formula (100); and the viscosity of the ultraviolet-curable composition measured at 25 DEG C using an E-type viscometer is 0.1 Pa.s or more and 1,000 Pa.s or less. Thermal conductivity = density * specific heat * thermal diffusivity (100).

title_en: Wafer placement table
abstract_en: A wafer placement table includes a ceramic base, a cooling base, and a bonding layer. The ceramic base includes an outer peripheral part having an annular focus ring placement surface on an outer peripheral side of a central part having a circular wafer placement surface. The cooling base contains metal. The bonding layer bonds the ceramic base with the cooling base. The outer peripheral part of the ceramic base has a thickness of less than or equal to 1 mm and does not incorporate an electrode.

title_en: Substrate cleaning device, substrate processing device, and maintenance method for substrate cleaning device
abstract_en: A substrate cleaning device (31) comprises a roll cleaning member (61) and a rotary holding unit (100). The rotary holding unit (100) includes a contactless seal portion (140) disposed between a bearing portion (130) and the roll cleaning member (61) and sealing a gap between a shaft portion (110) and a housing portion (120). The contactless seal portion (140) comprises: a rotary portion (150) attached to the shaft portion (110) and having a plurality of protrusions (151) axially spaced apart and formed on a peripheral surface (150a); and a fixed portion (160) attached to the housing portion (120) and surrounding the plurality of protrusions (151), the plurality of protrusions (151) being surrounded by an inner peripheral surface (160a) having a gas supply hole (161) formed therein to supply compressed gas (200) from a position axially inside those protrusions (151) among the plurality of protrusions (151) that are disposed at both end portions axially.

title_en: Sense lines for high-speed application packages
abstract_en: In an aspect, a semiconductor includes a substrate. The substrate includes a column comprising a conductive paste that passes through a plurality of metal layers, a resin sheath surrounding the column, a ground shield surrounding the resin sheath, and a plurality of sense lines. The plurality of sense lines include a first sense line that is connected to the column comprising the conductive paste and a second sense line that is connected to the ground shield. The resin comprises a dielectric material.

title_en: Replacement buried power rail
abstract_en: Embodiments disclosed herein describe a semiconductor structure. The semiconductor structure may include a device region with a first source/drain (S/D) and a second S/D. The semiconductor structure may also include a buried power rail (BPR) under the device region. A critical dimension of the BPR may be larger than a distance between the first S/D and the second S/D. The semiconductor structure may also include a via-contact-to-buried power rail (VBPR) between the BPR and the S/D.

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: An electronic device including a substrate, a first metal pattern, a first insulating pattern, and a second metal pattern. The first metal pattern is disposed on the substrate. The first insulating pattern is disposed on the first metal pattern. The second metal pattern is disposed on the first metal pattern and the first insulating pattern. The second metal pattern includes a first contact portion and a second contact portion, which contact the first metal pattern in a direction of a section view. The first insulating pattern contacts the first metal pattern and the second first metal pattern between the first contact portion and the second contact portion.

title_en: Polishing liquid, polishing liquid set, and substrate polishing method
abstract_en: Provided is a polishing liquid comprising a liquid vehicle, abrasive grains, and a polymer. The polymer has a first molecular chain where functional groups are directly bonded and a second molecular chain branched from the first molecular chain. The functional groups are at least one selected from the group consisting of carboxyl, carboxylate, hydroxyl, sulfo, and sulfonate groups.

title_en: Method for auto-tuning and process performance assessment of chamber control
abstract_en: Embodiments disclosed herein include a method for auto-tuning a system. In an embodiment, the method comprises determining if the system is in a steady state. Thereafter, the method includes exciting the system. In an embodiment, the method comprises storing process feedback measurements from the excited system to provide a set of stored data. In an embodiment, the set of stored data is a subset of all available data generated by the excited system. In an embodiment, the method further comprises determining when the excited system returns to the steady state, and tuning the system using the set of stored data.

title_en: Resin sheet, printed circuit board, semiconductor chip package, and semiconductor device
abstract_en: This resin sheet for forming a solder resist layer comprises a resin composition layer including a resin composition, wherein the resin composition includes (A) a thermosetting resin and (B) an inorganic filler, the specific surface area of the (B) inorganic filler is 3.0 m2/g or more, and the thickness of the resin composition layer is 20-100 [mu]m.

title_en: display device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a display device which has high display quality. This display device comprises: a pixel part; and a dummy pixel part which is arranged outside the pixel part and does not contribute to display. With respect to this display device, the pixel part comprises a plurality of light emitting devices; each of the light emitting devices comprises a pixel electrode, a first layer that comprises a light emitting layer, and a common electrode; first layers of pixels, which are adjacent to each other among a plurality of pixels, are separated from each other by means of a first insulating layer that comprises an inorganic material and a second insulating layer that comprises an organic material; the lateral surface of the first layer has a region that is in contact with the first insulating layer; the second insulating layer is arranged on the first insulating layer so as to be positioned below the common electrode; the dummy pixel part comprises a plurality of dummy light emitting devices; each of the dummy light emitting devices comprises a conductive layer and a second layer; the lateral surface of the second layer has a region that is in contact with the first insulating layer; the second insulating layer is arranged on the first insulating layer; the conductive layer comprises the same material as the pixel electrode; and the second layer comprises the same material as the light emitting layer.

title_en: Methods of forming metal nitride films
abstract_en: Embodiments of the disclosure include methods of forming a film comprising conformally depositing a first film on a substrate; treating the first film with a first plasma to form a second film; treating the second film with a second plasma to form a third film; and selectively removing the first film, a portion of the second film, and the third film.

title_en: Polishing pad with window and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en:
This invention relates to a polishing pad and a method for manufacturing the same. The polishing pad may include a top pad layer and a window block. The top pad layer may include a groove pattern formed on an upper surface of the top pad layer. A first hole may be formed through the top pad layer. The window block may be inserted into the first hole. The top pad layer and the window block may have a structure coincided with following Formula 1.
         In Formula 1, the gap may indicate a height difference between an upper surface of the top pad layer and an upper surface of the window block, the Thk
         RTPC may indicate a thickness of the window block, and the Thk
         grv may indicate a depth of the groove pattern.

title_en: Treatment liquid for semiconductor manufacturing, treatment method of object to be treated
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a treatment liquid for semiconductor production that, when applied to an object to be treated that includes SiGe and Si, can selectively remove the Si. This treatment liquid for semiconductor production includes a nitrogen-containing polymer, a quaternary ammonium hydroxide, an organic solvent that has an SP value of at least 25 MPa1/2, and water, the nitrogen-containing polymer excluding polyalkylene imines.

title_en: Stiffener ring for packages with micro-cable/optical connectors
abstract_en: A semiconductor package includes a package substrate, a semiconductor chip disposed on the package substrate, and a stiffener disposed on the package substrate. The stiffener includes an inner portion configured to surround the semiconductor chip, the inner portion defining a space on the package substrate external to the inner portion and located between the inner portion and outer edges of the package substrate, and a plurality of leg portions extending outwardly from the inner portion toward one or more of the outer edges of the package substrate and corners of the package substrate.

title_en: Wafer edge tilt and etch rate uniformity
abstract_en: An edge ring for use in a plasma chamber includes a first pair of edge ring segments with each one of the first pair of edge ring segments having a first thickness and a second pair of edge ring segments with each one of the second pair of edge ring segments having a second thickness. Each of the first pair of edge ring segments is oriented adjacent to each of the second pair of edge ring segments and each of the second pair of edge ring segments is oriented adjacent to each of the first pair of edge ring segments.

title_en: Micro light-emitting diode
abstract_en: A micro light-emitting diode includes a first stacked layer, a second stacked layer, a third stacked layer, a bonding layer, at least one etching stop layer, and a plurality of electrodes. The first stacked layer is disposed on the third stacked layer. The second stacked layer is disposed between the first stacked layer and the third stacked layer. The first stacked layer, the second stacked layer and the third stacked layer are semiconductor light-emitting stacked layers having three different light-emitting colors. The first stacked layer includes a first active layer. The second stacked layer includes a second active layer. The third stacked layer includes a third active layer. The bonding layer is disposed between the second stacked layer and the third stacked layer. The at least one etching stop layer is at least disposed between the first active layer and the second active layer. The plurality of electrodes are respectively electrically connected with the first stacked layer, the second stacked layer, and the third stacked layer. At least one electrode of the plurality of electrodes contacts the etching stop layer.

title_en: System and method of thinning wafer substrate
abstract_en: Embodiments of present disclosure provides a wafer processing system which includes a processing tool comprising at least one grinding member used to remove material from a wafer substrate; an electrolyte supply line used to supply an electrolyte to the wafer substrate; a holding module for holding the wafer substrate, the holding module including a conductive base and a conductive porous member positioned on the top surface of the conductive base, a vacuum source being fluidly communicated with fluid channel formed in the conductive base to create a vacuum to hold the wafer substrate on the conductive porous member; an actuator assembly for driving a rotation of the grinding member and a rotation of the conductive base; and a power supply module to apply an electric current to the grinding member and to the conductive porous member through the conductive base.

title_en: Method for producing laminate substrate, and substrate processing device
abstract_en: A method for preparing a laminate substrate of the invention includes the following steps (A) to (D). (A) A joining layer that includes an oxide layer is formed on the surface of a first semiconductor substrate. (B) The oxide layer of the joining layer is brought into contact with a second semiconductor substrate, thereby joining the first semiconductor substrate and the second semiconductor substrate via the joining layer. (C) After joining the substrates, a modified layer is formed by a laser beam on a first intended division surface where the first semiconductor substrate is intended to be divided in the thickness direction. (D) The first semiconductor substrate joined to the second semiconductor substrate via the joining layer is reduced in thickness by dividing the first semiconductor substrate along the modified layer formed on the first intended division surface.

title_en: Crosslinkable (meth)acrylic polymer, adhesive composition, and adhesive member
abstract_en: This crosslinkable (meth)acrylic polymer has: a structural unit (A) derived from a (meth)acrylic acid alkyl ester compound; a structural unit (B) derived from a compound having an acidic functional group; and a structural unit (C) derived from a photobase generator which is decomposed due to light irradiation, and generates a base as well as a gas. With respect to the total amount of structural units in the crosslinkable (meth)acrylic polymer, the content of the structural unit (A) is at least 60.0 mass%, the content of the structural unit (B) is at least 1.0 mass%, the content of the structural unit (C) is at least 6.0 mass%, and the total content of (A), (B), and (C) is at most 100 mass%.

title_en: resin composition
abstract_en: This resin composition comprises an epoxy resin (A) and an inorganic filler (B), wherein the epoxy resin (A) contains a liquid epoxy resin (A-1); the inorganic filler (B) contains a carbon-containing inorganic filler (B-1) having a carbon content of at least 0.2 mass%; the amount of the liquid epoxy resin (A-1) is at least 0.5 mass% with reference to 100 mass% for the nonvolatile component in the resin composition; and the amount of the carbon-containing inorganic filler (B-1) is at least 10 mass% with reference to 100 mass% for the nonvolatile component in the resin composition.

title_en: Package structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A package structure and a manufacturing method thereof are provided. The package structure includes a redistribution layer, a conductive pillar, an active chip, an encapsulation layer, and another redistribution layer. The conductive pillar and the active chip are side by side disposed on the redistribution layer. The encapsulation layer surrounds the active chip and the conductive pillar, in which the encapsulation layer has a first through hole disposed between the active chip and the redistribution layer and a second through hole disposed between the conductive pillar and the redistribution layer, and a depth of the first through hole is less than a depth of the second through hole. The another redistribution layer is disposed on a side of the redistribution layer away from the redistribution layer and electrically connected to the redistribution layer through the conductive pillar.

title_en: Method for forming a partial shielding for an electronic assembly
abstract_en: Provided is a method for forming a partial shielding for an electronic assembly, comprising: providing an electronic assembly mounted on a mother board, wherein the electronic assembly comprises a substrate, and at least one electronic component and a conductive pattern mounted on a top surface of the substrate; disposing a mask onto the substrate to cover the at least one electronic component; forming an encapsulant layer on the mother board to encapsulate at least the electronic assembly; forming a trench through the encapsulant layer to expose at least a portion of the conductive pattern and at least a portion of lateral surfaces of the mask; forming a shielding layer on the mother board to cover the encapsulant layer and fill in the trench; and detaching the mask from the mother board.

title_en: Active-ray-sensitive or radiation-sensitive resin composition, active-ray-sensitive or radiation-sensitive film, pattern formation method, and electronic device manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention pertains to: active-ray-sensitive or radiation-sensitive resin composition that contains a compound represented by formula (Z-1) set forth in the description and a resin in which the polarity increases when being broken down by the action of an acid; and an active-ray-sensitive or radiation-sensitive film, a pattern formation method, and an electronic device manufacturing method which use said active-ray-sensitive or radiation-sensitive resin composition. Accordingly, provided are: an active-ray-sensitive or radiation-sensitive resin composition that has excellent resolution, excellent initial LWR performance, and excellent LWR performance after being aged; and the like.

title_en: Alloy with variable melting point as well as method of heat dissipation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an alloy with variable melting point as well as a method of heat dissipation. A first alloy is placed between a heat source and a heat dissipation member and is surrounded by a to-be-melted metal so that the first alloy is heated and melted to fill the material gap between the heat source and the heat dissipation member, thereby reducing the air thermal resistance, and that the first alloy continues diffusing and is melted and mixed with the to-be-melted metal to form a mixed alloy with a melting point higher than that of the first alloy. Therefore, the disadvantage of the first alloy overflowing after thermal expansion due to its lower melting point is avoided, thereby achieving the effect of variable melting point. Moreover, the mixed alloy acts as a very good interface material between the heat source and the heat dissipation member, which can effectively export heat to achieve the effect of heat dissipation.

title_en: Semiconductor device with innovative edge termination
abstract_en: This invention provides a semiconductor device with innovative edge termination, which comprises a substrate a body, and an electrode unit. The body is disposed on the substrate, and includes a cell region, an edge termination region that surrounding the cell region, and a insulating oxide layer. The body has a P-well. The edge termination region has a P-type extension area unit, an outer ring, a P-plus, a plurality of P-well, P-plus ring and JTE ring. The electrode unit includes a source is disposed on the insulating oxide layer, a drain is disposed on the substrate, and at least one gate is disposed on the cell region.

title_en: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing a semiconductor device and a semiconductor device produced thereby. For example and without limitation, various aspects of this disclosure provide a method for manufacturing a semiconductor device, and a semiconductor device produced thereby, that that comprises a transparent, translucent, non-opaque, or otherwise optically-transmissive, external surface.

title_en: Image sensor
abstract_en: An image sensor includes a substrate having a pixel separation recess, a plurality of photo-sensing elements arranged in the substrate, and a pixel separation region filling the pixel separation recess, wherein the pixel separation region includes a first insulating layer covering an inner wall of the pixel separation recess, a first conductive layer covering at least a portion of a side surface of the first insulating layer within the pixel separation recess, a second insulating layer covering a portion of a side surface of the first conductive layer within an inner space defined by the first conductive layer, and a second conductive layer filling all of a space not filled by the second insulating layer from among the inner space defined by the first conductive layer, and connected to and in contact with the first conductive layer.

title_en: Plasma processing apparatus and plasma processing method
abstract_en: The disclosed plasma processing apparatus comprises a chamber, a substrate support, and a high-frequency electric power supply. The substrate support is provided inside the chamber. The high-frequency electric power supply is configured to supply a source high-frequency electric power in a first partial period that includes a startup time of the source high-frequency electric power and a second partial period that follows the first partial period. The high-frequency electric power supply is configured to set a time series of a source frequency of the source high-frequency electric power in the first partial period to a frequency time series that increases gradually or in a stepwise manner from a first frequency to a second frequency that is higher than the first frequency without decreasing.

title_en: Optical sensor package
abstract_en: An optical sensor module includes a transparent lid spaced apart from the optical sensor die by a protective dam. The dam can be formed by photosensitive epoxy materials that can be patterned using a photolithography process. The epoxy materials can change between liquid and solid phases during assembly, and then can be fully hardened by curing. The protective dam can be formed as a single layer, or as a multi-layer stack of epoxy materials, in which the layers may have different properties. In some implementations, the epoxy dam acts as a spacer that provides a substantially uniform gap to minimize a tilt angle of the transparent lid with respect to the optical sensor.

title_en: Suction nozzle fixture of BGA (ball grid array) packaging can protect collision between suction nozzle body and circuit board through disposition of sealing ring
abstract_en: A suction nozzle fixture of BGA (ball grid array) packaging is provided. The suction nozzle fixture comprises a suction nozzle body and a sealing ring embedded to the suction nozzle body. The suction nozzle body has a first surface and a second surface mutually corresponding to the first surface, and an absorption portion is formed inside the suction nozzle body. The absorption portion is composed of an accommodation zone extended from the first surface toward the second surface and an air channel zone extended from the accommodation zone toward the second surface, and the first surface has an embedding groove circularly disposed to the periphery of the accommodation zone and is capable of being embedded with the sealing ring so that the sealing ring protrudes from the first surface and surrounds the periphery of the accommodation zone.

title_en: Environment data monitoring method, environment data monitoring system and environment data monitoring equipment
abstract_en: An environment data monitoring method, an environment data monitoring system and an environment data monitoring equipment are provided. The environment data monitoring method includes: obtaining a fan speed by a magnetic sensor; obtaining a first pressure by the first pressure sensor; obtaining a second pressure by a second pressure sensor; calculating a first pressure difference between the first pressure and the second pressure by a controller; determining whether or not the fan speed and the first pressure difference reach an alarm standard by the controller; and sending an alarm signal by the controller when the fan speed and the first pressure difference reach the alarm standard.

title_en: Circuit structure and manufacturing method of semiconductor device
abstract_en: Bipolar junction transistors (BJTs) are disclosed that are formed on a superlattice structure of stacked silicon and silicon germanium layers. The superlattice structure can be implanted with ions to form emitter, base, and collector regions of the BJTs. Altering width ratios of the implanted emitter, base, and collector regions can tune BJT performance. The BJTs can be implemented in a Darlington circuit configuration.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device includes a light-emitting substrate, a counter substrate, multiple color conversion layers and, a patterned distributed Bragg reflector. The counter substrate is disposed opposite to the light-emitting substrate, and has multiple sub-pixel regions. Each of the sub-pixel regions has a sub-pixel width. The color conversion layers are disposed between the light-emitting substrate and the counter substrate. The patterned distributed Bragg reflector is disposed on one side of the color conversion layers, and has multiple openings. Each of the openings has an opening width greater than or equal to 1 [mu]m and less than the sub-pixel width.

title_en: Chip on film package structure
abstract_en: A chip on film package structure includes a flexible circuit substrate, a chip and an elastic reinforcement. The flexible circuit substrate has a first surface and a second surface opposite to each other, and a chip mounting area defined on the first surface. The chip is disposed in the chip mounting area and electrically connected with the flexible circuit substrate. The elastic reinforcement is disposed on the first surface or the second surface of the flexible circuit substrate and corresponds to the chip mounting area. The elastic reinforcement includes two first stretchable sidewall portions opposite to each other and an upper cover portion connecting the two first stretchable sidewall portions. Orthographic projections of the two first stretchable sidewall portions on the flexible circuit substrate respectively correspond to two first edges of the chip mounting area and are located outside the chip mounting area. The upper cover portion and the flexible circuit substrate are spaced at a variable distance.

title_en: Curable resin composition, cured film, multilayer object, imaging device, semiconductor device, and method for producing multilayer object
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide: a curable resin composition capable of giving cured objects which, when an inorganic layer is formed thereon, prevent the inorganic layer from wrinkling, thereby suppressing process abnormality; a cured film formed from the curable resin composition; a multilayer object formed using the cured film; an imaging device and a semiconductor device which include the multilayer object; and a method for producing the multilayer object. This curable resin composition comprises a silsesquioxane, a solvent, and a silica filler as an inorganic filler. When the curable resin composition is dried under the conditions of 125 DEG C and 10 minutes to remove the solvent and heat-cured by a heat treatment at 300 DEG C for 1 hour, the resultant cured object has a modulus at 300 DEG C of 0.2 MPa or greater.

title_en: Plasma processing device
abstract_en: Provided is technology for appropriately performing plasma processing using pulsed DC signals. This plasma processing device includes: a plasma processing chamber; a substrate supporting portion that is disposed within the plasma processing chamber and that includes an electroconductive base, an electrostatic chuck disposed on the electroconductive base, a chuck electrode disposed in the electrostatic chuck, and a bias electrode disposed below the chuck electrode in the electrostatic chuck; an upper electrode that is disposed upward from the substrate supporting portion; an RF generating unit that is electrically connected to the electroconductive base, the bias electrode, or the upper electrode, and that is configured so as to generate RF signals; a pulsed DC generating unit that is electrically connected to the bias electrode, and that is configured so as to generate pulsed DC signals; an RF filter that is connected between the bias electrode and the pulsed DC generating unit; and a ringing suppression circuit that is connected between the bias electrode and the pulsed DC generating unit, and that is configured so as to suppress ringing that is superimposed on the pulsed DC signals.

title_en: Method for preparing thin film, thin film, semiconductor substrate and semiconductor device comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a thin film manufacturing method, a thin film obtained therefrom, and a semiconductor substrate and a semiconductor element including the thin film. According to the present invention, it is possible to provide a thin film manufacturing method, a thin film obtained therefrom, and a semiconductor substrate and a semiconductor element formed according to same, wherein the thin film manufacturing method can spatially divide high-aspect-ratio holes or trenches of the semiconductor element and perform a selective deposition process, thereby eliminating the thickness non-uniformity of a substrate at each hole or trench location without holes, voids inside the trenches, or seams.

title_en: Substrate treatment system, substrate treatment method, program, and storage medium
abstract_en: One example embodiment of the present invention provides a substrate treatment system. The substrate treatment system comprises a process module, a transport module, an imaging unit, an extraction unit, a calculation unit, and a transport control unit. The imaging unit has a field of view that includes a transport path for a substrate. The extraction unit is configured to extract a first feature pattern from an image of a substrate to which substrate treatment has been applied, and to extract a second feature pattern from said image. The calculation unit is configured to calculate, on the basis of the first feature pattern and the second feature pattern, the positional relationship between the position of a substrate support part and the position of the substrate while the substrate treatment is being performed. The transport control unit is configured to correct a transport position for the transport module on the basis of the positional relationship.

title_en: Calibration of an aligner station of a processing system
abstract_en: A method for calibrating an aligner station of an electronics processing system is provided. A calibration is retrieved, by a first robot arm of a transfer chamber, from a processing chamber connected to the transfer chamber. The calibration object has a target orientation in the processing chamber. The calibration is placed, by the first robot art, in a load lock connected to the transfer chamber. The calibration is retrieved from the load lock by a second robot arm of a factory interface connected to the load lock. The calibration object is placed, by the second robot arm, at an aligner station housed in or connected to the factory interface. The calibration object has a first orientation at the aligner station. A difference is determined between the first orientation at the aligner station and an initial target orientation at the aligner station. The initial target orientation at the aligner station is associated with the target orientation in the processing chamber. A first characteristic error value associated with the processing chamber is determined based on the difference between the first orientation and the initial target orientation. The first characteristic error value is recorded in a storage medium. The aligner station is to use the first characteristic error value for alignment of objects to be placed in the processing chamber.

title_en: Transistor structure with multiple vertical thin bodies
abstract_en: A transistor structure includes a semiconductor body, a source region, a drain region and a gate region. The semiconductor body has a convex structure and the convex structure has at least four conductive channels extending upward. The source region contacts with a first end of the convex structure. The drain region contacts with a second end of the convex structure. The gate region has a gate conductive layer, wherein the gate conductive layer is across over the convex structure. Two or four conductive channels are not parallel to each other, and there is no shallow trench isolation region among the at least four conductive channels.

title_en: Electronic package
abstract_en:
An electronic package, including: a carrier structure, an electronic component provided on the carrier structure, a heat dissipation structure provided on the electronic component, a heat conductor sandwiched between the electronic component and the heat dissipation structure, a first intermetallic compound formed between the heat dissipation structure and the heat conductor, and a second intermetallic compound formed between the heat conductor and the electronic component. By forming the first intermetallic compound and the second intermetallic compound creates a solid connection between the heat dissipation 
structure, heat conductor and electronic components and improves the heat dissipation effect.

title_en: Defect depth estimation for a semiconductor specimen
abstract_en: There is provided a system and method of examining a defect buried in a semiconductor specimen. The method comprises: scanning the semiconductor specimen using an electron beam with a given landing energy (LE); generating image data by collecting backscattered electrons (BSEs) emitted from the specimen at a specific escape energy (EE), wherein the specific EE is selected from a series of EEs corresponding to the given LE based on a relationship representative of expected measurements obtained at the series of EEs for different expected depths of the defect in the specimen; obtaining a measurement related to the defect based on the image data; and estimating an actual depth of the defect in the specimen based on the measurement and the relationship.

title_en: Electronic package and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides an electronic package and a manufacturing method thereof, characterized in that an electronic structure is tightly bonded to a carrier structure by a bonding layer, wherein, the bonding layer comprises a first bonding material and a second bonding material adjacent to each other, so that the second bonding material can fill in the deformation of the first bonding material, thereby, this is to ensure that no voids are generated between the bonding layer and the carrier structure after joining.

title_en: Slurry composition for metal film polishing
abstract_en: A slurry composition for polishing a metal film, and a method for chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) of a substrate using the slurry composition are provided. The slurry composition includes a polishing regulator, and the polishing regulator includes a copolymer comprising a polymer with an allylamine-based structural unit (A) and a polymer with a structural unit (Y)including at least one element among sulfur (S), phosphorus (P), and nitrogen (N).

title_en: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method thtereof
abstract_en: A semiconductor device and a manufacturing method thereof are provided. The semiconductor device includes a first gate, a first semiconductor layer, a first gate dielectric layer, a second gate, a second gate dielectric layer, a second semiconductor layer, a third gate dielectric layer, a first contact hole, a second contact hole, a source, a drain and a third gate. The first semiconductor layer is over the first gate. The first gate dielectric layer is between the first gate and the first semiconductor layer. The second gate is over the first semiconductor layer. The second gate dielectric layer is between the first semiconductor layer and the second gate. The second semiconductor layer is over the second gate. The third gate dielectric layer is between the second gate and the second semiconductor layer. The first contact hole and the second contact hole continuously penetrates through the second dielectric layer and the third dielectric layer respectively. The source and the drain respectively fill the first contact hole and the second contact hole and electrically connect to the first semiconductor layer and the second semiconductor layer. The third gated is over the second semiconductor layer.

title_en: Substrate holding part, substrate processing system, and substrate transfer method
abstract_en: To provide a technique capable of selectively receiving a substrate from a plurality of substrates with a vertical posture arranged in parallel along a horizontal direction. A substrate holding part according to an aspect of the present disclosure, includes: a main body having a first arm part and a second arm part in which a tip end part is separated and a base end part is communicated; a first holding guide that is fixed to the tip end part of the first arm part, and holds a peripheral edge part of the substrate; and a second holding guide that is fixed to the tip end part of the second arm part, and holds the peripheral edge part of the substrate. The length between the first and second holding guides is shorter than a diameter of the substrate. In the same flat surface of the first and second arm parts, both of the first and second arm parts and both of the first and second holding guides are positioned to an outside of a radial direction from the substrate in a state where the substrate is positioned near from the base end part from a position where it is held by the first and second holding guides.

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus, method and program of manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: It is possible to estimate an energy amount suitable for processing a substrate before the substrate is performed. There is provided a technique that includes: a processing structure configured to process a substrate based on at least one setting item in which process conditions for the substrate are defined; a manipulator configured to perform a setting operation for the process conditions of the at least one setting item; and a controller configured to be capable of controlling a calculation of an energy amount consumed under the process conditions which are set by the manipulator.

title_en: Transportation device, method to check the same, and processing machine
abstract_en: The transportation device includes a transportation member and a checking unit. The transportation member is movable along at least a first direction to undergo a predetermined process. The checking unit has a base, an approaching checking member, and a processing member. The base is disposed with the approaching checking member. A detection range is defined around a detection face of the approaching checking member. The approaching checking member is movable along the first direction with respect to the detection face. When the position of an object is detected going away, the approaching checking member sends a first-stage signal to the processing member. The processing member acquires the position of the transportation member along the first direction to acquire the deviation of position of the transportation member. Thereby, the data becomes a basis of compensation of position of the transportation member, and the accuracy of processing can be improved.

title_en: Rram array, control method thereof, and semiconductor device
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a resistive random-access memory (RRAM) array, a control method thereof, and a semiconductor device. The RRAM array comprises an m × n matrix of memory transistors, each corresponding to a resistor , and a set of source-line (SL) switching transistors corresponding to each column of memory transistors. The drain of each memory transistor in the i -th row is connected to the i -th row bit line via the corresponding resistor. The gates of the j -th column memory transistors and the gate of the j -th SL switching transistor are connected to the j -th word line. The sources of the j -th column memory transistors are connected to the source of the j -th SL switching transistor. The drains of all SL switching transistors are connected to a shared source line.For 1 ≤ i ≤ m , 1 ≤ j ≤ n , the source line is biased to a first potential, and a subset of the bit lines (referred to as first-type bit lines) are biased to a second potential, thereby reducing the drain-source voltage across the memory transistors connected to the first-type bit lines. This configuration mitigates leakage current between the drain and source terminals of at least some memory transistors and reduces the risk of breakdown caused by Vds.

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus, substrate processing method, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: Provided is a substrate processing apparatus comprising: a developing unit for developing a substrate having a metal-containing resist film formed thereon; a supply unit for supplying the substrate with a reaction adjustment fluid for promoting a curing reaction of the metal-containing resist; and a control unit, wherein the control unit controls the substrate processing apparatus to execute (A) a step for developing the substrate after exposure processing and before completion of patterning of the metal-containing resist to remove unexposed portions of the film and form recesses using the metal-containing resist on the substrate, and (B) a step for supplying the substrate with the reaction adjustment fluid after step (A) and before the completion.

title_en: Negative coefficient thermal expansion materials for dynamic bow compensation application
abstract_en: Mitigating wafer bow of a semiconductor wafer includes depositing one or more backside layers that compensate for wafer bow caused by one or more frontside layers. Deposition of a backside layer stack may mitigate wafer bow caused by one or more frontside layers, including changes in wafer bow caused by the one or more frontside layers when the wafer is heated. Each of the backside layers may be deposited by a backside deposition apparatus.

title_en: Chuck pin and substrate holding device
abstract_en: The chuck pin of the present invention is mounted on a spin base that rotates around a reference axis extending in the vertical direction, and includes a main holding section and an auxiliary holding section. The main holding section has an abutment surface that faces the reference axis when mounted on the spin base. The auxiliary holding section has an auxiliary surface that faces the reference axis when mounted on the spin base, and is mounted on the main holding section. The abutment surface extends in the vertical direction and has a constant length in top view. A portion of the abutment surface abuts against the outer edge of the substrate to hold the substrate. The auxiliary surface is formed so as to extend a portion of the abutment surface upward. The area of the auxiliary surface when viewed from the reference axis is smaller than the area of the abutment surface when viewed from the reference axis.

title_en: Joint quality determination system and joint quality determination method
abstract_en: A tool (22) holds a semiconductor chip (5). A vibrator (25) applies ultrasonic energy to the tool (22). During ultrasonic bonding, a sensor (30) acquires a signal waveform of vibration generated between the tool (22) and the semiconductor chip (5). A calculation unit (15) determines a quality of a joint state between the semiconductor chip (5) and a substrate (8) on the basis of the signal waveform.

title_en: Semiconductor device and method for fabricating the same
abstract_en: A method for fabricating semiconductor device includes the steps of first bonding a first wafer to a second wafer to form a first stack structure, forming first bumps on one side of the first stack structure, bonding a third wafer to a fourth wafer to form a second stack structure, forming second bumps on one side of the second stack structure, and then bonding the first stack structure to the second stack structure by bonding the first bumps and the second bumps.

title_en: Manufacturing method of package substrate
abstract_en: A manufacturing method of package substrate is provided, comprising forming a first circuit layer and a first build-up circuit layer on a first surface and a second surface opposite to a first dielectric layer, respectively, and after forming a plurality of a fist conductive blind holes from the second surface electrically connecting the first circuit to the first build-up circuit layer, forming a plurality of second conductive blind holes from the first surface electrically connecting the first build-up circuit layer to solve the problem of high density and fin pitch wiring demand that is not satisfactorily met by the prior art. This is to solve the problem of high density and fin pitch circuitry which cannot be satisfied by the prior art.

title_en: Phase change material radio-frequency (rf) switch having a reduced dielectric constant around a heater element and method for forming the same
abstract_en: A phase change memory switch may be provided by forming a heater element, a first electrode, and a second electrode over an insulating layer that overlies a substrate; by forming encapsulated cavities formed within a dielectric material layer between a strip portion of the heater element and the first electrode and between the strip portion and the second electrode by depositing a dielectric material around, and over, the heater element, the first electrode, and the second electrode; and by forming a phase change material (PCM) portion over the heater element, the first electrode, and the second electrode such that the phase change material portion contacts the first electrode and the second electrode and is spaced from the heater element.

title_en: Compound, composition, ink, photoelectric conversion element, and photosensor
abstract_en: Provided are a compound, a composition, an ink, a photoelectric conversion element, and a photosensor in which dark current in a photoelectric conversion element is suppressed. Provided is the compound represented by formula (1). In formula (1), D1, D2, L1, L2, m, n, A1, and A2 are as defined in the description.

title_en: Ink composition
abstract_en: Provided is a technique capable of contributing to performance improvement of a light-emitting element having a layer composed of metal oxide nanoparticles and disposed between a cathode and an anode. More specifically, the ink composition contains: metal oxide nanoparticles comprising a material selected from the group consisting of a hole injection material, a hole transport material, and an electron transport material, and having a 95% particle diameter (D95) of 60 nm or less when a volume-based cumulative particle size distribution is measured by dynamic light scattering; and a dispersion medium containing a glycol-based solvent.

title_en: Communication control method and related device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a communication control method and related device. The communication control method, through the controller of a pulse power supply, monitors the noise signal sensed at the target pin of an analog-to-digital converter and the interrupt information of a control module. Based on the monitored noise signal, noise information is obtained, and based on the noise information and interrupt information, a noise level is determined. Finally, based on the noise level, the communication parameters of the control module are configured. This achieves the purpose of configuring corresponding communication parameters under different noise levels, allowing the control module to communicate with other hardware modules using different communication parameters according to the noise level. This enables self-adjustment and regulation of communication parameters according to the noise level, which helps ensure normal communication between the communication module and other hardware modules in different noise environments, thereby improving the noise immunity of the pulse power supply.

title_en: Method for monitoring worf line
abstract_en: Providing is a method for monitoring word lines, which is used to monitor the depth uniformity of a plurality of word lines located in a plurality of trenches in the substrate. The method includes the following steps. A depth index (DI) about the word line depth calculated by Equation (1). A first wafer is scanned with an electron beam, and a plurality of first DIs are obtained according to a predetermined [theta], an SP and a W of each of the first word lines from scanning and the Equation (1). A plurality of real depths of the plurality of first word lines are obtained. Through regression analysis, the R2 values of the plurality of first DIs and the plurality of real depths are calculated, and it is confirmed that R2 is not less than 0.9. A second wafer is scanned with the electron beam, and a plurality of second DIs are obtained. A 3-sigma (3[sigma]) is calculated from the plurality of second DIs, and the word line depth uniformity of the second wafer is monitored according to the 3[sigma]. DI=tan([theta])*(SP-W)/2 Equation (1).

title_en: Light emitting diode display and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A light emitting diode display includes a back plate, a first light emitting diode element and a second light emitting diode element. The back plate has a first pad group and a second pad group. Pads of the first pad group have first connection regions respectively overlapping electrodes of the first light emitting diode element. The first virtual straight line passes through geometric centers of the first connection regions. The second virtual straight line passes through geometric centers of the electrodes of the first light emitting diode element. The first virtual straight line and the second virtual straight line have a first included angle θ1. Pads of the second pad group have second connection regions respectively overlapping electrodes of the second light emitting diode element. The third virtual straight line passes through geometric centers of the second connection regions. The fourth virtual straight line passes through geometric centers of the electrodes of the second light emitting diode element. The third virtual straight line and the fourth virtual straight line have a second included angle θ2. The first included angle θ1 is different from the second included angle θ2. Moreover, a manufacturing method of the light emitting diode display is also provided.

title_en: Display panel and method of manufacturing thereof
abstract_en: A display panel includes a substrate, a light-emission display layer, an encapsulation layer, a through-hole and a barrier layer. The light-emission display layer is disposed on the substrate. The encapsulation layer is disposed on the light-emission display layer. The through-hole penetrates through the substrate, the light-emission display layer and the encapsulation layer. The barrier layer is disposed on the sidewall of the through-hole.

title_en: Liquid treatment method, substrate treatment device and recording medium
abstract_en: This invention aims to provide a liquid treatment method capable of conducting a water-repellent treatment on the surface of a substrate, and meanwhile removing pure water and water-repellent agent existing in the patterns of the substrate so as to obtain a dry substrate promptly. When performing the drying of a horizontally held substrate W after pure water is supplied to the substrate W, in a first solvent supply step, a first solvent is supplied to the surface of the substrate W which has been supplied with pure water, and then, in a subsequent water-repellent agent supply step, water-repellent agent is supplied to the surface of the substrate W. In a second solvent supply step, a second solvent is supplied to the surface of the substrate W that has been water-repellent processed, and then, in a subsequent drying step, the second solvent is removed from the surface of the substrate W. The specific weight of the first solvent is lower than that of the water-repellent agent, while the specific weight of the second solvent is higher than that of the water-repellent agent.

title_en: Power transistor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: Provided is a power transistor including a substrate, an epitaxial layer, first to third conductive layers and first to third insulating layers. The substrate has a first area and a second area. The epitaxial layer is disposed on a substrate and has first and second trenches respectively in the first and second areas. A first conductive layer is disposed in the first trench. The second conductive layer is disposed in the second trench. The third conductive layer is disposed in the first trench and located above the first conductive layer. The first insulating layer is disposed between the first conductive layer and the epitaxial layer. The　second insulating layer is disposed between the second conductive layer and the epitaxial layer. The third insulating layer is disposed between the first and third conductive layers. Besides, the top surface of the first conductive layer is lower than the top surface of the second conductive layer.

title_en: Flexible semiconductor package
abstract_en: A flexible semiconductor package includes a flexible substrate, a chip and a thermal pad. The chip is mounted on the flexible substrate. The thermal pad is attached on an exposed surface of the chip by an adhesive, and a space exists between the thermal pad and the chip and surrounds the adhesive. The space is provided to accommodate the adhesive so as to prevent the adhesive from overflowing or being squeezed out from the thermal pad when being compressed.

title_en: Pellicle frame with attached adhesive layer, pellicle, exposure master plate with attached pellicle, method for exposure, method for producing semiconductor device, and method for producing liquid crystal display panel
abstract_en:
An object of the invention is to provide a pellicle adhesive, a pellicle, an exposure master plate with an attached pellicle, a method for regenerating the exposure master plate, and a method for reducing release residue, which are capable of reducing the 
residue adhered to the exposure master plate when the pellicle is released from the exposure master plate following lithography, and particularly following ArF lithography. 
 
     A pellicle adhesive of the invention is used for affixing a pellicle to an exposure master plate, and has as an acrylic-based polymer with an SP value of at least 10.0 but not more than 12.0 as a base material.

title_en: Periphery purge shutter and flow control systems and methods
abstract_en: An arrangement of two shutters radially outward from an injector block and a susceptor onto which a wafer carrier is removably mounted are configured to provide a flowpath through a reactor chamber that does not exhibit a vortex, thereby reducing or eliminating buildup on the inside of the reactor chamber and facilitating large temperature gradient between the injector block and the wafer carrier. This can be accomplished by introduction of a purge gas flow at a radially inner wall of an upper shutter, and in some embodiments the purge gas can have a different chemical composition than the precursor gas used to grow desired epitaxial structures on the wafer carrier.

title_en: Extreme edge sheath and wafer profile tuning through edge-localized ion trajectory control and plasma operation
